phrases.clear_morning: Sunrise is on the almond groves; from the 3/65 terrace the limestone cliffs are already in full light.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the 3/65 terrace now, the low sun would colour the cliffs and vineyard rows warm orange.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the Pollènça valley is full of stars; from the pool deck, the mountains are dark shapes.
phrases.partly_morning: Broken cloud over the Tramuntana this morning; sunlight moves across the almond groves seen from the casement windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The infinity pool has sun in intervals this afternoon; shadows from passing clouds move over the rolling hills.
phrases.partly_golden: Gaps in the cloud let the setting sun reach the cliffs; the 3/65 terrace gets brief golden intervals.
phrases.overcast: A single grey layer covers Mallorca today; from the pool deck the mountain ridge looks flat and colourless.
phrases.rain: It is raining on the Pollènça valley; the 3/65 terrace tables are empty, and guests have moved to the indoor pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: Right now a thunderstorm covers the valley; guests watch lightning over the cliffs from inside the converted monastery.
phrases.fog_haze: Low mist covers the Tramuntana today; from the terrace only the nearest almond trees and vineyard rows are clear.
phrases.snow: Mallorca rarely gets snow, but today white patches sit on the Tramuntana peaks, visible from the pool deck.
phrases.very_cold: An unusual freeze in the valley today; frost sits on the estate's olive groves, and the cliffs look sharp from the windows.
phrases.very_hot: Mallorca is very hot today; the outdoor pool is the busiest spot, and the vineyards sit in hard light.
phrases.mild_night: Warm air and cloud cover tonight; guests are finishing dinner on the 3/65 terrace without needing jackets.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the far cliffs are missing from view; the casement windows show the near valley fields and not much more.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water at the casement window, and the sky above the Tramuntana is full of stars.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the wooden casement windows this evening, and low cloud covers the Tramuntana ridge above the valley.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the Tramuntana tonight, and from the casement windows the Pollènça valley shows only a few scattered lights after midnight.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Strip is still lit before sunrise, seen from tower suites through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun over the valley; from tower suites at the north end of the Wynn corridor, the Strip is clear.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a cloudless sky, Encore Beach Club has full sun, and guests in tower suites see the Strip sharply.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches the Red Rock mountains, visible from double queen rooms that face the valley.
phrases.clear_night: From a guest room tonight, the whole Strip is lit, with distant mountains just visible past the neon.
phrases.partly_morning: Some cloud over Las Vegas this morning; from tower suites the Strip stays visible between passing shadows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud alternate over the Strip this afternoon, watched comfortably from a resort suite window.
phrases.partly_golden: Dusk with broken cloud: from double queen rooms, the Red Rock mountains show in patches of low sun.
phrases.overcast: Las Vegas sits under one grey layer today; the Strip view from the suites is flat but complete.
phrases.rain: It rarely rains in Las Vegas, but today the Strip is wet, seen from behind floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is crossing the valley; the Duplex living room, billiard table included, makes a dry viewing spot.
phrases.fog_haze: Desert haze today: the Red Rock mountains have disappeared from the double queen room windows for now.
phrases.snow: Las Vegas sees snow perhaps once a decade; today flakes are passing the floor-to-ceiling windows over the Strip.
phrases.very_cold: The desert is below freezing today; the cold clear air makes Red Rock sharp from double queen rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Real desert heat today, very hot even for Las Vegas; guests are in the water at Encore Beach Club, not out walking.
phrases.mild_night: If you were there tonight, mild and cloudy, XS Nightclub would be the loud option steps from your door.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Honest report: the distant mountains are not visible today; from tower suites only the nearer Strip shows clearly.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the Strip lights fill the floor-to-ceiling windows of the tower suites.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Tower Suites after midnight, and the Strip's lights show through it, blurred and wet.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze drifts over the Strip after midnight, and its lights look soft from the suite living room windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Dark sky over Central right now; from the Cotton Tree Suite the gardens are unlit while the skyline still glows.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight fills the large square windows this morning; guests at breakfast in the restaurant see the skyline in sharp detail.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear noon sky the Botanical Gardens show bright green from the Cotton Tree Suite, with the skyline behind.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Warm late sun colours the HSBC building and IFC tower, both visible right now from the rooftop bar.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a king room tonight, you would see lit skyscrapers filling the square window above the bed.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds cross Hong Kong this morning; the fitness center windows still show trees and city towers between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move over the gardens this afternoon, watched from the Cotton Tree Suite with the skyline behind them.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop bar, the last sun appears between broken clouds and lands briefly on the IFC tower.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the skyline towers behind the Botanical Gardens through the large square windows.
phrases.rain: Rain streaks the large square windows today; the gardens below the Cotton Tree Suite look a darker green than usual.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over Central right now; from a suite behind floor-to-ceiling glass, lightning shows the skyline in short flashes.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Hong Kong today; from the restaurant, the nearest towers are visible and the far skyline is not.
phrases.snow: Snow in Hong Kong is extremely rare, but today a few flakes pass the square windows above the gardens.
phrases.very_cold: Hong Kong feels below zero today, unusual here; the gardens look pale from the Cotton Tree Suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Central today; through the square windows the gardens and skyline sit under strong, steady sunlight.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the air is mild at the rooftop bar, and the HSBC building stays lit.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Plain report today: from the restaurant windows, the closest skyscrapers show, but anything beyond a few kilometres does not.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Cotton Tree Suite, back from a late dinner, see the skyline lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has the Cotton Tree Suite tonight sees the skyline lights behind the gardens through rain on the square window.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the Cotton Tree Suite after midnight sees the skyline lights behind the gardens, under low cloud tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Both piers show as dark shapes from the upper-floor corner suites while the sky stays clear before dawn.
phrases.clear_morning: From a seafront suite, morning sun lights the Palace Pier and the water through the French doors.
phrases.clear_midday: Clear midday over Brighton: the corner suites hold both piers and a bright English Channel in one frame.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun now colours the West Pier ruins, easy to watch from a balcony over the promenade.
phrases.clear_night: The Palace Pier is lit tonight; from a corner suite its lights show clearly over the dark water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds and sun alternate over Brighton Beach this morning; the balcony gives a clear look at both piers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon cloud shadows cross the beach; guests on balconies watch the light change over the Palace Pier.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud lets the low sun colour the beach; a balcony above Kings Road gives the full view.
phrases.overcast: Brighton sits under full grey today, but both piers stay clearly visible from the higher corner suites.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the promenade; a freestanding bathtub beside the French doors is a reasonable place to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Channel right now; guests watch from their suites while dinner continues at Cyan Brighton.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog off the Channel hides most of the Palace Pier today; guests in the L.RAPHAEL spa are not missing much.
phrases.snow: Snow on Brighton Beach is rare, but today flakes pass the French doors of the seafront suites.
phrases.very_cold: Guests behind the French doors today look out at the Palace Pier past frost on the balcony rails.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot weather is rare for Brighton; today the beach below the balconies is full of swimmers.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night on the seafront; the Palace Pier lights are still easy to see from the balconies.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today's visibility is under six kilometres; the Palace Pier shows from corner suites, but the horizon does not.
phrases.late_night: Back late from Cyan Brighton, guests in the corner suites see the Palace Pier beside the seafront lights along the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a corner suite tonight is watching rain run down the French doors, the Palace Pier out over the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a seafront suite after midnight sees low cloud over the Channel and the Palace Pier along the lit seafront.

phrases.clear_predawn: Predawn over Lake Lugano: from a private terrace, Monte San Salvatore is a dark shape against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: By nine the sun is fully on the terraces; Lake Lugano and Monte San Salvatore are clear from every suite.
phrases.clear_midday: Nothing hides Monte San Salvatore at noon; through the floor-to-ceiling windows the lake is a flat, bright blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Before sunset the low sun colours Monte San Salvatore; each of the eighteen private terraces faces it directly.
phrases.clear_night: City lights of Lugano and their reflections on the lake — that is tonight's view from a candlelit soaking tub.
phrases.partly_morning: This morning brings broken cloud; the lake below shows patches of sun, watched easily from a suite terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Over the lake this afternoon, cloud shadows come and go; the Dream Suites catch the widest arc of it.
phrases.partly_golden: The sun's last hour finds gaps in the cloud; Monte San Salvatore turns orange in patches, seen from the terraces.
phrases.overcast: An even grey sky over Lugano today; the lake turns silver, and Monte San Salvatore keeps its full outline.
phrases.rain: Rain over Lake Lugano right now; guests watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows, and the spa's sauna is busy.
phrases.thunderstorm: Storm over the lake this hour: lightning past Monte San Salvatore, watched from the suites, terraces empty until it passes.
phrases.fog_haze: Today the lake sits under haze; Monte San Salvatore shows only as a faint outline from the terraces.
phrases.snow: Lugano gets snow now and then; today white is settling on the private terraces and on Monte San Salvatore.
phrases.very_cold: It feels below freezing outside today; the air is clear and Monte San Salvatore stands sharp from every suite window.
phrases.very_hot: Above thirty-five degrees in Lugano today; terraces are quiet until evening, and the indoor pool is busier than usual.
phrases.mild_night: No stars tonight, but the city lights and their reflections on the lake are still visible from every terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Monte San Salvatore is mostly a guess today; from the terraces the near lake shows, the far shore does not.
phrases.late_night: Past one, Lugano's city lights reflect in the lake from the Dream Suite windows, and there is no rush to look away.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Dream Suites' floor-to-ceiling windows after midnight, and the city lights of Lugano blur on the lake.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud covers Lake Lugano, and from the Dream Suites the city lights reflect in the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: From an upper-floor room right now, São Jorge Castle is a dark outline above the city, no clouds anywhere.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests on the rooftop terrace already have full sun on the red roofs, the castle, and the Tagus.
phrases.clear_midday: At noon the Tagus shows bright blue from Classic River View rooms; São Jorge Castle sits sharp on its hill.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Right now the low sun turns São Jorge Castle's walls warm orange, easy to watch from an 18th-floor suite terrace.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear sky tonight, upper rooms look over lit hills toward the castle, with the dark Tagus beyond.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Lisbon this morning; between them, sun reaches Eduardo VII Park below the suite terraces.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patchy cloud this afternoon; from the rooftop terrace, the Tagus changes from grey to blue as gaps pass.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds break the light over Marquês de Pombal Square, seen from upper rooms.
phrases.overcast: Full cloud cover over Lisbon today; guests are eating at Akla instead, since the Portuguese seasonal menu does not depend on weather.
phrases.rain: From the upper floors, rain blurs the view down Avenida da Liberdade toward São Jorge Castle and the grey Tagus.
phrases.thunderstorm: From an upper-floor room, the thunderstorm over the Tagus is clearly visible; the 18th-floor terraces are sensibly empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers Lisbon today; from the rooftop terrace, the Tagus is hard to see and the castle only a faint shape.
phrases.snow: Lisbon almost never sees snow, yet flakes are passing the 18-floor tower right now; guests are photographing from their rooms.
phrases.very_cold: Today feels below zero, rare for Lisbon; the air is very clear, and the castle looks sharp from every River View room.
phrases.very_hot: Heat above thirty-five degrees today; guests favour shaded rooms over the sun loungers, watching the bright Tagus from behind glass.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud; the 18th-floor suite terraces stay usable, and Lisbon's lights do not need a clear sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Plainly put, the Tagus is not visible today from the Classic River View rooms; São Jorge Castle appears only faintly.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, city lights fill the Classic River View windows down to the Tagus, and São Jorge Castle shows again at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Akla, rain wets the Classic River View windows and blurs the lights toward São Jorge Castle and the Tagus.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Akla, the Classic River View rooms show the city lights under low cloud, spreading down toward the Tagus.

phrases.clear_predawn: Above level 15, King Suite windows show a dark Pacific before sunrise; the pool deck is still completely empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Sun is already on Surfers Paradise Beach; from a balcony above level 15, the ocean looks fully lit.
phrases.clear_midday: Full sun over the striped pool right now; the black-and-white umbrellas provide the only shade on the deck.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the corner windows of a king room, the low sun colours the skyline and the distant hills.
phrases.clear_night: Yamagen is open tonight; through King Suite windows above level 15, the Pacific is simply a dark expanse.
phrases.partly_morning: Patchy cloud this morning; from a balcony above level 15, sunlight comes and goes on the beach below.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon brings mixed sun and cloud; loungers by the striped pool are mostly taken during the bright spells.
phrases.partly_golden: Cloud breaks let low sun onto the skyline; the view from the corner windows changes every few minutes.
phrases.overcast: One grey layer covers the Gold Coast today; the ocean from the King Suite looks flat and pale.
phrases.rain: Steady rain outside; Yamagen's Japanese whisky collection is getting more attention than the beach at this exact moment.
phrases.thunderstorm: The storm sits over the ocean; suites above level 15 get the full view while the pool deck empties.
phrases.fog_haze: Sea haze today; from level 15 the horizon is gone, though the beach directly below is still clear.
phrases.snow: If snow ever reached Surfers Paradise, guests would watch it from their balconies; spaQ would seem very sensible.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air is almost unknown here; today the pool deck is empty and the Pure Gold ritual sounds practical.
phrases.very_hot: It feels above thirty-five degrees outside; the outdoor pool, under its black-and-white umbrellas, is the busiest place here.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the lit towers of Surfers Paradise rise beside the dark Pacific below the level fifteen suite balcony.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Distant hills are missing from the corner-window view today; the beach directly below the hotel stays perfectly visible.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the skyline lights show from the Ocean View suites; the same window will hold the sunrise over the Pacific.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Yamagen, rain runs down the suite window and the Surfers Paradise lights blur along the beach.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Yamagen is long finished, and the Surfers Paradise skyline lights show under low cloud from the Ocean View suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: River-facing balconies look onto a dark Salzach now; the fortress is a black outline above the quiet Old Town.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is being served on the terrace; the fortress and cathedral domes stand sharp under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Salzach reflects full sun, and the Fortress Hohensalzburg is plainly visible from Old Town-facing balconies.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: This hour of low sun lights the fortress and cathedral domes, seen from the Sacher Sky Suite terrace.
phrases.clear_night: Guests with Old Town-facing balconies see the fortress as a dark shape against the clear night sky across the river.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning brings some cloud over the fortress; breakfast on the terrace continues with sun arriving in intervals.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Between clouds this afternoon, sun reaches the cathedral domes; the view shifts every few minutes from the suite windows.
phrases.partly_golden: The low sun finds gaps in the cloud and lights the fortress in patches, visible from Old Town-facing balconies.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the fortress stands above the domes across the Salzach from the Sky Suite terrace.
phrases.rain: Raindrops on the tall windows today; the Old Town rooftops are still visible through them, and the Zirbelzimmer serves indoors as always.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Salzburg; from the suite's floor-to-ceiling windows, lightning appears above the hillside now and then.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the Salzach today; the fortress is hidden, and the Nordic steam bath offers a warmer version indoors.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the cathedral domes and the fortress; from a river-facing room the Old Town turns white.
phrases.very_cold: Cold, clear air today; the fortress and domes are very sharp across the river, and the Health Club sauna is running.
phrases.very_hot: Salzburg rarely feels this hot; balcony doors stand open along the river-facing rooms while the fortress sits in full sun.
phrases.mild_night: Balcony doors stay open tonight; mild air, no stars, and the Sacher Grill still serving its Wiener Schnitzel inside.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the terrace today the fortress is only a faint outline, and the cathedral domes are hard to see right now.
phrases.late_night: Past one, Old Town lights on the Salzach are hard to stop watching from the Sky Suite.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Sky Suite windows after midnight, and the Old Town lights blur on the Salzach under the fortress.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, haze moves across the fortress hill, and the Old Town lights show on the Salzach from the Sky Suite windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Still dark over the Zócalo; from Zócalo-facing rooms the Cathedral towers show as outlines against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: On the rooftop terrace this morning, clear sun lights the Cathedral towers, and the small details on them are easy to see.
phrases.clear_midday: No clouds over the Zócalo at midday; the Palacio Nacional stands in full sun across the plaza from the terrace.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Between three and sunset, warm light colours the Cathedral towers, close enough from the terrace to see their detail.
phrases.clear_night: Traffic light trails cross the plaza tonight; from upper Zócalo-facing rooms the lit colonial facades are fully visible.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds over Mexico City this morning; set tables on the rooftop terrace get direct sun between the clouds.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From a four-poster canopy room, the balcony shows the historic building opposite under alternating sun and cloud this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: One hour of sun left; from the rooftop, patches of light move across the Cathedral towers between clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under one grey layer today, the Zócalo looks muted from the rooftop; indoors, the Tiffany-style ceiling still has colour.
phrases.rain: Rain on the Zócalo today; the rooftop tables are empty, and the atrium's stained-glass ceiling is the dry alternative.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over the city; from Zócalo-facing rooms, flashes light the Cathedral towers for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Centro Histórico today; the Cathedral across the plaza shows as a soft outline from the terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Mexico City, but today white flakes are settling on the rooftop railings above the Zócalo.
phrases.very_cold: If you were on the rooftop terrace, you would see the Cathedral towers in hard winter light across an empty Zócalo.
phrases.very_hot: The Zócalo sits in heat above thirty-five degrees today; rooftop guests are choosing tables under the wood ceiling.
phrases.mild_night: Mild and cloudy tonight; if you were on the rooftop terrace, you would see the lit facades around the plaza.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is under six kilometres today; the Cathedral across the plaza stays clear from the terrace, but distant rooftops fade.
phrases.late_night: Lit colonial facades line the Zócalo below the upper front rooms deep into the small hours.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner in a Zócalo-facing room, the plaza lamps shine through rain on wet stone.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, a Zócalo-facing room looks out on the lit plaza under tonight's cloud, the Cathedral towers in outline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Catinaccio is only a dark outline behind the full-height glass of the Antermoja Suite.
phrases.clear_morning: The saltwater whirlpool already has its 180-degree Rosengarten panorama in full morning sun, sharp from summit to meadow.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday, clear sky: from the outdoor pool loungers, every ridge of the Rosengarten and the Vajolet Towers is sharp.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Enrosadira hour: from the glass sauna, the Rosengarten limestone is turning rose, exactly what this spa was built around.
phrases.clear_night: Stars over the massif tonight; if you were in the Antermoja rooftop pool, you would see them above the Catinaccio.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Rosengarten this morning; from the timber balconies, sun still reaches the meadow between shadows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Shadows from broken cloud are crossing the Rosengarten wall this afternoon, easy to follow from the outdoor pool loungers.
phrases.partly_golden: Only parts of the Rosengarten catch tonight's enrosadira; the glass sauna gives the clearest seat for what appears.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the valley today; the hay-barn sauna in the meadow still faces the full Rosengarten wall.
phrases.rain: Rain on the meadow today; the heated indoor-outdoor pool stays at temperature, and the Similde Spa saunas stay dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder is rolling off the massif; from behind a room's balcony doors, the storm over the Rosengarten is fully visible.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Rosengarten today; the glass sauna's panoramic windows show mostly white where the massif normally stands.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the meadow; the heated outdoor pool steams, and the Tiers cable car departs right outside.
phrases.very_cold: Air below freezing today under clear sky; the heated outdoor pool steams over the snow-covered meadow, Rosengarten behind.
phrases.very_hot: From the glass sauna, noon heat-haze shimmers over the dry meadow up to the pale rock peaks.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the cloud hides the peaks, but it is mild enough that room balconies facing the massif stay usable.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Rosengarten is only a faint outline today; the meadow and the natural pond stay clear, the massif does not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Antermoja Suite's rooftop pool is lit, the moon above the Catinaccio.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the glass sauna windows this evening, and low cloud covers the Rosengarten behind the house.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud covers the Rosengarten behind the Antermoja Suite, and only the resort's own lights show on the meadow.

phrases.clear_predawn: The lagoon is still dark; in Chapter Two villas the retractable roof shows the last stars before sunrise.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun already reaches the open-air bathrooms; the lagoon outside the timber frames is fully turquoise by nine.
phrases.clear_midday: Full sun at noon makes the lagoon its brightest turquoise, and the villa's slide gives guests a quick drop into it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Sunset colours the sky orange over the lagoon; guests are toasting at overwater deck tables facing the thatched villas.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the observatory has a clean sky; in Chapter Two villas the bedroom roof retracts to show Noonu Atoll stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Broken cloud this morning over the atoll; from the villa pools the lagoon shifts between bright and darker turquoise.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the outdoor massage deck, patches of sun and shadow cross the shallow lagoon and the distant islands this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: Gaps in the cloud let the low sun onto the lagoon; the rooftop telescope deck lanterns are already lit.
phrases.overcast: Today the sky over the lagoon is one grey layer; the open-air bathrooms still frame water, just paler.
phrases.rain: Wet decks today at the overwater villas; the rain dots the lagoon and the slide is unused for now.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were in a Chapter Two villa tonight, you would keep the roof closed and watch lightning over the lagoon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the atoll today; the distant islands are out of view and the lagoon fades into plain white.
phrases.snow: Nobody expects snow in the Noonu Atoll; if it ever fell, it would melt before reaching the villa decks.
phrases.very_cold: A freezing reading here is a data oddity; the lagoon below the water slide has never seen ice.
phrases.very_hot: Real heat over the atoll today; the villa slide into the lagoon looks like the most practical route down.
phrases.mild_night: No observatory session tonight under cloud, but the air is mild and the overwater cinema is an open-air alternative.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far islands across the lagoon are not visible today; the water beside the villa decks still is.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water in a Chapter Two villa comes with stars over the lagoon through the open roof.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain falls on the lagoon past the Chapter Two bedroom, and villa lights reflect on the wet water.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, cloud covers the Noonu Atoll sky over the Chapter Two bedroom, and villa lights show on the lagoon.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the harbour-facing rooms show a dark Victoria Harbour, with the Bank of China Tower already outlined against the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Through the circular window beside the round soaking tub, Victoria Harbour and the Island skyline sit in clean morning sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the floor-to-ceiling glass frames Star Ferry boats crossing Victoria Harbour under a completely blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the Bank of China Tower, and guests in harbour-facing rooms watch the skyline turn warm before dusk.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Presidential Suite tonight, you would watch the Symphony of Lights from the rooftop infinity pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit above the green ridgeline of The Peak this morning, while the lounge windows keep the full harbour in view.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the Lobby Lounge windows this afternoon see Star Ferry boats cross the harbour under patchy cloud.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds take some colour, and corner suites catch the skyline from two angles at once.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Victoria Harbour looks flat from the floor-to-ceiling windows, though the Star Ferry runs on schedule.
phrases.rain: Rain streaks the guestroom glass, and the IFC is still visible across the harbour, just softer than usual.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the floor-to-ceiling windows, lightning flashes over Victoria Harbour and the Bank of China Tower across the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers Victoria Harbour today, so the lounge windows show ferry shapes more clearly than the skyline behind them.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Hong Kong, but if it did, you would watch it over the harbour from behind the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.very_cold: A rare cold snap outside, yet the clear air gives sharp views of the Bank of China Tower from the rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Hong Kong today, so the rooftop infinity pool above Victoria Harbour is the logical place to be.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the Island skyline is lit as usual, and the lounge windows frame the whole stretch.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so The Peak is hard to make out, though the harbour water stays clear from the rooms.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the skyline lights across Victoria Harbour fill both windows of the Harbourview Corner Suite, hard to look away from.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain left open, rain streaks the harbour-room glass and the city lights look blurred across Victoria Harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtains stay open in the Harbourview Corner Suite, and the skyline lights show under low cloud across Victoria Harbour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Eiffel Tower stands dark against a clear sky in the single window of corner suite 415.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests on the balcony are having breakfast with croissants, facing the Louvre facade and the Eiffel Tower in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Tuileries and its round pond sit in full sun, easy to study from the Junior Eiffel Tower Suites.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Toward sunset, the Eiffel Tower turns gold beyond the open balcony doors, and the Grande Roue stands over the Tuileries.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in suite 415 tonight, you would see the Eiffel Tower lit against a clear Paris sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Louvre this morning, visible from the balcony breakfast tables along with the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Scattered clouds drift above the Tuileries this afternoon, and the Eiffel Tower is still clear from the suite windows.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds catch orange light behind the Grande Roue, seen from the rooftop.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the carved stone facade of the Louvre looks pale from the windows, and the Tuileries sits quiet.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Tuileries; guests watch it from their suite windows, the Eiffel Tower slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, guests stay inside with room service under silver cloches while lightning flashes over the Paris skyline.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of the Eiffel Tower today; only the Tuileries trees are visible from suite 415.
phrases.snow: Snow lies on the bare Tuileries trees, the round pond grey, the Eiffel Tower still visible from the Junior Suites.
phrases.very_cold: Paris feels below freezing; from suite 415 the bare winter trees and round pond of the Tuileries look sharp.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the summer trees around the Eiffel Tower barely move, seen through an open suite window.
phrases.mild_night: With a mild night and low cloud, guests in suite 415 can still see the Eiffel Tower lit beyond the Tuileries.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today; the Louvre facade remains clear from the balconies, but the Eiffel Tower is not.
phrases.late_night: In-room dinner finished, the Junior Suite Eiffel Tower window shows the Tower's shape above the Tuileries.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the window of the Junior Suite Eiffel Tower tonight, and the Tower's outline shows above the wet Tuileries.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Paris after midnight, and rooftop lights show past the Tuileries from the Junior Suite Eiffel Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the candles on the boma deck give the only light, and the bushveld below is still completely dark.
phrases.clear_morning: From a hammock on a private deck, the morning sun shows the Klaserie bushveld running unbroken to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests in the pool can watch the waterhole, which draws animals steadily through the hottest hours of the day.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun colours the bushveld, and the circular deck with its central fire pit faces straight into the view.
phrases.clear_night: After dark, 300 candles light the lodge, so the stars over the Klaserie stay clearly visible from every suite deck.
phrases.partly_morning: This morning the clouds are broken, and from a private deck's hammock the Klaserie bushveld still shows all the way out.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds thin the afternoon heat a little; animals still come to the waterhole, seen from the ground-level bunker or from the hide.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Kruger bushveld catch the colour, seen well from the elevated deck.
phrases.overcast: It is overcast across the whole reserve today, yet the hilltop position still gives a clear line to the far horizon.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Klaserie, and the dry Dundee riverbed below the boma deck may finally get some water.
phrases.thunderstorm: From a hilltop deck, thunderstorm lightning over the Klaserie bushveld shows the dry Dundee riverbed in brief white flashes.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the bushveld today, so the horizon is unclear, though the waterhole below the pool stays visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is extremely rare here; if it were falling now, the fire pit on the circular deck would be the busiest spot.
phrases.very_cold: From the hilltop deck, hard winter light falls on the Klaserie bushveld running unbroken to the horizon.
phrases.very_hot: If you were at the pool edge now, you would see heat-haze over the Klaserie bushveld beyond the waterhole.
phrases.mild_night: No stars are out on this mild cloudy night, so the fire on the boma deck and 300 candles do the lighting.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far horizon is missing; the nearby waterhole below the pool still shows clearly.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Zulu Suites leave the curtain open tonight and fall asleep with stars over the waterhole.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a Zulu Suite tonight can watch the rain hit the big windows as the bush turns grey for the night.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the Zulu Suites are likely in bed by now, the pool lanterns showing through their windows under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, swimmers in the heated infinity pool wait under a clear sky for the balloons over Göreme.
phrases.clear_morning: Just after dawn, dozens of balloons drift past the infinity pool at eye level, some near enough to read their markings.
phrases.clear_midday: By midday the balloons are long gone, and the restaurant tables face Pigeon Valley under full sun instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches across Pigeon Valley, and the stone arches of the terrace frame the ridges of Göreme clearly.
phrases.clear_night: After dark, lights on Uçhisar Castle show the rock high over the town, the main view from the illuminated pool.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Göreme this morning, but the balloons still rise within view of the pool terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Small clouds pass over Pigeon Valley in the afternoon, with Uçhisar Castle in full view on its rock.
phrases.partly_golden: Patchy clouds cross Red Valley in the last hour of sun, a view shared by the pool, Lil'a and many rooms.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky covers Cappadocia today, yet the eroded ridges of Göreme remain visible from Lil'a's tables.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Pigeon Valley, so the balloons stay grounded, and the heated pool steams a little more than usual.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were there during this storm, you would watch lightning over the valley from a cave-stone room, indoors and dry.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the ridges of Göreme today; from the terrace only the nearest fairy chimneys show through.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on Uçhisar Castle above the hotel, and the heated infinity pool stays usable anyway.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it feels below freezing, yet guests still swim in the heated pool while watching the morning balloons.
phrases.very_hot: From the terrace pool, heat-haze hangs over Pigeon Valley and the eroded ridges of Göreme below Uçhisar Castle.
phrases.mild_night: Under a mild clouded night, candlelit dinners continue on the terrace, with the town lights across the valley.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today; Mount Erciyes and Red Valley are hidden, but the nearer ridges of Göreme still show from the terrace.
phrases.late_night: With the room lights off after midnight, you would see only the village lights below Uçhisar's castle rock.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were finishing a last drink at your window tonight, you would see rain over the town lights and Uçhisar Castle.
phrases.grey_evening: With a last drink in the Tekeli Cave Suite, you would see town lights under low cloud below the castle rock.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the glass walls of the 14 rooms already show the Pacific as a dark band below the highlands.
phrases.clear_morning: From a room balcony, the layers are sharp this morning: grassland, tortoise reserve, national park, then the open Pacific.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun lands on the travertine infinity pool, and the water appears to end exactly where the ocean begins.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, the low sun would light the forested hills seen from the room terraces.
phrases.clear_night: Late at night, stars cover the clear sky above the fire pit and the Pacific beyond the crater's edge.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the volcanic slopes this morning, visible through the floor-to-ceiling glass of every room.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the Evolution Restaurant are watching cloud shadows move across the lowlands toward the Pacific this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds turn orange above the outer islands seen from the terraces.
phrases.overcast: Soft cloud cover sits over the highlands today, and the ocean beyond the tortoise reserve looks grey rather than blue.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the crater grassland right now, so the folding glass walls of the villas stay closed.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Pacific is visible from the treatment rooms of the Sumaq Spa, which face the ocean.
phrases.fog_haze: Highland fog has reached the ridge, so from the balconies only the nearest grassland is visible at the moment.
phrases.snow: Snow never reaches these highlands in practice; if it did, guests would watch it from behind the glass walls.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air sits over the highlands today, and the ocean on three sides looks clear from every balcony.
phrases.very_hot: Heat presses on the highlands this afternoon, and the travertine infinity pool is the busiest spot at the lodge.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night covers the archipelago, and the terrace outside the DNA Bar is dark and quiet.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the grassland and tortoise reserve show clearly from the terraces, but the outer islands do not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Pool Suite's glass walls frame the moonlit Pacific, the same water the first light will reach at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain ends the day at Pikaia Lodge, and a last grey light shows on the Pacific beyond the Pool Suite's glass walls.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud rests on the highlands tonight, and the Balcony Rooms' glass walls show mostly their own soft light where the Pacific lies beyond.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Danube-facing suites look out on a dark river, with the lit cables of Elizabeth Bridge across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the skylight rooms first, while the rooftop terrace shows church spires and domes under a clean blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the floor-to-ceiling suite windows frame the full city panorama, and the Danube is easy to follow from bank to bank.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the Duchess rooftop, where guests with cocktails watch the Danube and the historic skyline turn gold.
phrases.clear_night: After dark, the lit cables of Elizabeth Bridge fill the view from the Duchess rooftop, exactly as the hotel promises.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Budapest this morning, but from the suite windows the Danube and the domes are still clearly visible.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the rooftop terrace this afternoon, putting the church spires in and out of direct sunlight.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the Danube give the rooftop terrace a changing mix of light and shadow.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the arched rooftop window still frames the cityscape and spires, just without any shine on the river.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Budapest, so guests watch the wet rooftops through the skylight windows instead of sitting on the terrace.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm has emptied the Duchess rooftop, and the safest view of Elizabeth Bridge right now is from a Danube-facing suite.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Danube today, and from the suite windows the far bank appears and disappears without warning.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the rooftops of Budapest, a view the skylight rooms and marble bathrooms happen to frame rather well.
phrases.very_cold: It is freezing outside, so the rooftop terrace stands empty while guests watch the bright, cold city from their suites.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, most guests delay the Duchess rooftop until evening and keep the Danube view behind suite glass.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under a cloudy sky, and the lit cables of Elizabeth Bridge still stand out from the Duchess rooftop.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor today, so the distant domes are missing from the rooftop view, though the near church spires remain clear.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water, and the Loft window frames the Elizabeth Bridge over the Danube.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Spago, rain runs down the Loft suite's skylight windows and the city lights blur on the Danube.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Spago, a Danube-facing suite shows the river under low cloud and the city lights on the Buda side.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dome Terrace is empty, and the great cupola is already a dark outline against a clear Florence sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Arno Terrace, where Palazzo Pitti and Forte Belvedere are clearly visible across the river.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Dome Terrace shows the full skyline, from Brunelleschi's dome to Giotto's bell tower, with no clouds anywhere.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the Panoramic Suite balcony now, you would watch low sun on the Arno and Ponte Vecchio.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the rooftops are lit, and guests at the TornaB Panoramic Bar can see the cupola against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds drift over Florence this morning, but the Duomo stays visible from the Dome Terrace between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, clouds pass over the city while the Arno Terrace keeps its view of the dome of Santo Spirito.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds turn warm above the bell tower, seen from the Dome Terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Duomo looks flatter from the Dome Terrace, but it is still entirely there.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Arno; guests watch it from behind the Panoramic Suite windows instead of the terraces.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Florence; from the tower rooms, lightning occasionally shows the outline of the cupola.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the river today, so from the Arno Terrace Forte Belvedere is only a faint shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Florence, but today it falls on the Dome Terrace, and a thin white layer sits on the cupola.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air keeps the rooftop terraces quiet today, though the view of the Duomo is unusually sharp and clear.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Florence, and the Arno looks low and slow from the private balcony of the Panoramic Suite.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but mild air suits the Dome Terrace, with the lit rooftops of Florence easy to see.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the Dome Terrace, Brunelleschi's dome shows through the haze today, while Forte Belvedere across the Arno stays hidden.
phrases.late_night: Were you in the Panoramic Suite, you would sleep well, since the window shows the Arno and the Ponte Vecchio at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: If you carried a last TornaB Panoramic Bar drink to your window now, you would see rain over Brunelleschi's dome.
phrases.grey_evening: With a last drink from the Panoramic Bar, you would see Brunelleschi's dome above the lit rooftops under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lakeside gravel terrace is empty, and from a balcony room the water of Lake Como looks almost black.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the terrace of Ristorante Raimondi, and guests at breakfast can see the mountains across the clear water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the lake is fully lit, and the red cushioned chairs on the gravel terrace face calm blue-green water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun warms the western lake, and diners on the Raimondi terrace sit directly above brightly lit water.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on an upper balcony tonight, you would see a clear sky over the dark lake and shore lights.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the mountains this morning, but from the wide window seat the lake below stays mostly in sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the gravel terrace this afternoon, patches of shadow from the clouds move slowly across the surface of Lake Como.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun breaks through clouds, and from a balcony room the western lake turns gold in stripes.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the lake looks flat and pale, and the living room window seat is the practical viewing spot.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the lake, so lunch at Ristorante Raimondi moves indoors, where the panoramic windows still frame the wet water.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the balcony rooms, lightning flashes over the mountains across Lake Como while rain falls on the lakefront garden.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the far shore of Lake Como today, and only the nearest water shows past the iron railing of the terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow rarely reaches this shore, but today it dusts the mountains, visible from the warm living room through the wide window.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it feels below zero, so guests watch the clear lake from the living room window seat rather than the terrace.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day like this, the shaded tables of the Raimondi terrace sit directly above cooler lake air.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under a cloudy sky, and the private dock lights mark where the lake meets the hotel garden.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far mountains and hilltop tower are hidden, though near water stays clear from the terrace.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the lake rooms likely left the curtain open and fell asleep facing the moon on Lake Como.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the Gran Lago Suite after midnight sees rain on the glass and village lights blurred across the lake.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the Gran Lago Suite after midnight can watch low cloud pass over the village lights across Lake Como.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the Imperiale Suite, the Arc de Triomphe is already visible against a dark, clear sky before sunrise.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast tables on the terrace face the Arc de Triomphe and the Paris rooftops in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: With a clear sky at midday, the Imperiale Suite windows show all three landmarks at once, the Arc de Triomphe nearest.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun is warming the Haussmann rooftops, and the Eiffel Tower stands sharply above them from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_night: Guests on the seventh-floor terrace look after midnight over the Champs-Élysées lights toward the Arc de Triomphe under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds move over Paris this morning, but the Arc de Triomphe stays clear from the upper terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the rooftops, while the geraniums on the terrace keep their usual red.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the rooftop now, you would see the last sun touching the Eiffel Tower between clouds.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Paris, yet the Arc de Triomphe remains plainly visible at close range from the terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain keeps guests off the rooftop terrace, so the triple sightline belongs to the Imperiale Suite windows today.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is passing over Paris; guests watch it from inside the Imperiale Suite rather than from the terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze shortens the view today; the Arc de Triomphe is close enough to see, but Sacré-Cœur is not.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Haussmann rooftops, and the terrace geraniums are not having a good day.
phrases.very_cold: It feels below zero outside, so the triple-landmark sightline is best taken in through the Imperiale Suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: Paris feels very hot today; guests on the terrace keep their drinks cold and the Eiffel Tower in sight.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, but the mild air keeps guests on the rooftop terrace facing the lit Eiffel Tower.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the air is not clear; the Arc de Triomphe shows at close range, but Sacré-Cœur is missing from the sightline.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, with the lights off in the Suite Impériale, the only glow comes from the city around the Arc de Triomphe.
phrases.wet_evening: Back in the Suite Impériale after dinner, the Arc de Triomphe shows close through rain on the window glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the Suite Impériale window shows the Arc de Triomphe at close range and the city lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky over Paris is still dark, and the corner terrace of the Eiffel Tower Terrace Suite faces a quiet city.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the rooftop terrace, where the Eiffel Tower is clearly visible across the Paris rooftops under yellow awnings.
phrases.clear_midday: From the corner terrace at midday, the Arc de Triomphe, the Eiffel Tower, and Sacré-Cœur appear at the same time.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight falls on the sun-loungers of the corner terrace, with the Eiffel Tower standing above in clear air.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Eiffel Tower lights would be visible from the suite window if you were sitting at the writing desk.
phrases.partly_morning: On the breakfast terrace among the flowering trees, a few clouds are passing behind the Eiffel Tower this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud cross the sky above the Arc de Triomphe, seen from the rooftop dining table this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: During the last hour of sun, clouds catch some colour over the rooftops while the Eiffel Tower stays clear.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Paris, but the Arc de Triomphe is still easy to see from the rooftop railing.
phrases.rain: Inside the red velvet lounge, guests sit under the chandelier while rain falls on the terrace outside.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over Paris keeps everyone off LA TERRASSE, so the dark wood lounge is the sensible place right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the horizon today, so Sacré-Cœur is hidden, though the nearby Arc de Triomphe remains visible from the terrace.
phrases.snow: A rare snowfall whitens the Paris rooftops seen from the suite window, the Eiffel Tower grey behind them.
phrases.very_cold: From the lift's arched window now, you would see the Arc de Triomphe over bare winter trees in hard light.
phrases.very_hot: The yellow awnings on the rooftop terrace give shade today, which guests facing the Eiffel Tower clearly appreciate.
phrases.mild_night: A mild evening with clouds instead of stars, and the terrace café seating is comfortable enough for a late drink.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Sacré-Cœur on the horizon is not visible today; the closer Arc de Triomphe still shows from the corner terrace.
phrases.late_night: Up for water after midnight, you would see the Eiffel Tower from the Baverez Suite.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink at the suite window tonight, you would see the Eiffel Tower through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last glass in the Baverez Suite tonight, you would see the Eiffel Tower's shape under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop pool is still, and the dark outline of Sugarloaf is already visible against the lightening sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From a waterfront balcony, Copacabana Beach is clear in the morning sun, and the Atlantic looks very blue today.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests swimming in the rooftop pool at midday can see Copacabana Beach, the ocean, and Sugarloaf without moving at all.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The late sun turns Sugarloaf golden, and the wooden loungers on the terrace face the ocean at exactly the right angle.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a waterfront balcony tonight, you would see the lit beachfront promenade and the palm trees below.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Atlantic this morning, visible from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the waterfront rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over Copacabana this afternoon, and swimmers in the rooftop pool watch their shadows move across the beach.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over Sugarloaf catch warm light, best seen from the terrace loungers.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the ocean looks grey too, but the soaking tub beside the bathroom window still works perfectly.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Copacabana today, and guests watch the grey ocean from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the Atlantic, and from a waterfront balcony you could watch the lightning without getting wet.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the ocean today, so Sugarloaf is only a faint shape when seen from the rooftop pool.
phrases.snow: Snow is essentially impossible in Rio, but if it ever fell, the rooftop pool would offer the strangest view in town.
phrases.very_cold: Cold air over Copacabana is rare, and from the balconies the beach looks almost empty, which is unusual here.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, so the pool on the roof, shaped like an L, is the most logical spot in the building.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and the terrace loungers face a dark ocean while the promenade lights stay on.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so Sugarloaf is not on display, though Copacabana Beach, closer to the windows, still is.
phrases.late_night: Tonight the Ocean Emiliano Suite's window holds the lit Copacabana promenade, and at dawn it fills with sunrise off the Atlantic.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open in the Ocean Master Suite, rain streaks the window and the Copacabana promenade lamps blur behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight the curtain in the Ocean Master Suite is open on Copacabana's promenade lamps, low cloud resting over Sugarloaf.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific is a dark line past the balconies, and 75 room fireplaces are still warmer than the beach.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast guests at The Pointe Restaurant have a 240-degree arc of calm blue ocean and nothing scheduled except watching it.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every floor-to-ceiling window shows open Pacific, with driftwood scattered along Chesterman Beach below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun is crossing the water toward Japan, and guests on the balconies are watching the swells turn gold.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a room tonight, you would see stars over the Pacific and hear surf below your balcony.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the ocean this morning, which from a fireside armchair counts as very mild weather here.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun take turns over Chesterman Beach, and the Ancient Cedars Spa treatment rooms, hanging out over the waves, get both.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun is slipping between clouds, lighting the swells that roll past the rocky outcrop.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky, grey ocean, and 75 rooms where a burning fireplace makes the comparison with outside easy to settle.
phrases.rain: Rain is streaking the floor-to-ceiling glass; the Inn lends rain gear, so some guests are out on the beach anyway.
phrases.thunderstorm: Storm fronts are stacking swells against Chesterman Beach, which is exactly what the front-row rooms were built to watch.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken most of the Pacific for now, leaving the driftwood and the nearest surf visible from the windows.
phrases.snow: Snow on the beach and the evergreens is unusual here, best examined from beside a stone fireplace.
phrases.very_cold: With freezing air outside, guests watch the clear cold Pacific from heated rooms with the fires lit.
phrases.very_hot: A rare hot day on Vancouver Island, and the balconies over the tide line catch whatever breeze the ocean sends.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, but the surf is still audible from every balcony, and dinner at The Pointe continues.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Short visibility today hides the open horizon; the windows show nearby surf, driftwood, and not much beyond.
phrases.late_night: A fire burns on in a Premier Room, and white surf shows past the glass.
phrases.wet_evening: Past midnight the fireplace reflects in rain-streaked glass, the Pacific breaking white beyond it.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at The Pointe, the fire's glow shows in the room's glass, and low cloud covers the Pacific outside.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky over the Olifants is still dark, and the first guests on the restaurant terrace are listening for hippos below.
phrases.clear_morning: Sliding glass doors in the River Bungalows open onto a sunlit Olifants, where elephants sometimes cross before mid-morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a cloudless sky, guests in the Olifant Villa Suites can cool off in private pools while watching the river.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a Rhino Tent deck now, the low sun would turn the Olifants and the far bank golden.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out over the boma tonight, where guests eat outdoors with the dark Olifants close by below.
phrases.partly_morning: From the hammocks above the river, guests watch clouds and sun take turns over the Kruger bush this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Shade from passing clouds moves across the Olifants, easy to follow from the restaurant terrace with a drink.
phrases.partly_golden: A few clouds catch the last sun over the river, and the decks of the River Bungalows face it all.
phrases.overcast: Under a fully grey sky, the Olifants looks flat and quiet, and the lodge terraces still face the water.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the thatched roofs, and guests watch the Olifants rise slightly from behind their glass doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Kruger side of the river is best watched from inside a bungalow, not from the hammock.
phrases.fog_haze: Morning haze hangs over the Olifants, so the far bank is a faint line from the restaurant terrace today.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches this part of Kruger, so this line stays a reserve while the river flows as usual.
phrases.very_cold: On this unusually cold clear day, the sun on the river decks helps, and blankets appear at the terrace tables.
phrases.very_hot: In heat like this, elephants come down to the Olifants to drink, visible from every deck at the lodge.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars, but the lantern-lit tables of the bush dinner still face the dark bushveld tonight.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the air is not clear, so the distant mountains are missing, though the river below the decks stays sharp.
phrases.late_night: Long after dinner in the boma, the Olifants shows a thin line of moonlight below the River Bungalows.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at the Main Deck Restaurant, rain falls on the Olifants and the far bank shows through it.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner on the Main Deck is over, and the River Bungalows' glass doors frame the Olifants under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the 360° rooftop terrace is empty and the olive plain below is still a dark, quiet surface.
phrases.clear_morning: From the arched room windows, the olive grove and the Adriatic are both sharp under a clean blue morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity lap pool lines up with the sea, and guests swim with the whole olive plain in view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the white houses of Ostuni on one side of the rooftop while the Adriatic darkens on the other.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop tonight, you would see the illuminated White City take over from the vanished sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the olive grove this morning, and the rooftop terrace shows the sea in and out of shadow.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the olive plain this afternoon, visible from the infinity pool between stretches of plain Adriatic blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the White City between clouds, best seen from the striped sofas of the Rooftop Bar.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Adriatic and the olive grove look flatter from the rooftop, and the garden pool is quieter.
phrases.rain: Rain keeps guests off the rooftop today, so the vaulted indoor spa pool is doing most of the work.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, the rooftop closes and guests watch lightning over the Adriatic from the arched windows of their rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the sea line today, so from the rooftop the olive grove simply fades out instead of ending at water.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Puglia, but today the White City looks even whiter from the rooftop, and the spa pool is warm.
phrases.very_cold: On this unusually cold clear day, the indoor spa pool under its mosaic arches is busier than the rooftop terrace.
phrases.very_hot: With the air very hot today, guests alternate between the rooftop infinity pool and the lower garden pool near Bianca Bistrot.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night keeps the Rooftop Bar comfortable, with the lit White City clearer than the invisible sea.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the Adriatic is missing from the rooftop view and only the nearer olive trees remain distinct.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water at midnight, and the Corner Junior Suite window shows a pale Adriatic past the olive groves.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Corner Junior Suite's tall windows, and Ostuni's lights blur above the olive groves toward the sea.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain is open in the Corner Junior Suite tonight, and the Adriatic shows under low cloud past the olive groves.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before any sun reaches Phobjikha, the double-height glass wall already shows the monastery as a dark shape on the right.
phrases.clear_morning: This morning the stone terrace breakfast comes with a clear view of yaks grazing near the farmhouses on the valley floor.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the double-height glass wall frames the whole Phobjikha bowl, monastery included, without a single cloud in the way.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun is crossing the valley slopes now, and the lounge windows catch the pine forests in warm light.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a suite tonight, you would see stars over Phobjikha from a bathtub placed for exactly that.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Himalayan ridges this morning, visible from the terrace while breakfast juice is poured.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows are moving across the valley floor, and the glass wall in the main lodge shows all of it.
phrases.partly_golden: During the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the ridges turn gold, best watched from the stone terrace.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky covers Phobjikha today, but the monastery and the farmhouses below stay perfectly visible from the lounge windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the wetland reserve, and guests watch it from the fire-lit dining room with a hot meal.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls around the glacial bowl, and guests stay in their suites, wood stoves lit, watching from timber-framed windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist fills the valley this morning, hiding the farmhouses, though the nearest pine slopes still show from the terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow falls across the valley at 3,000 metres; every suite stove burns while the glass wall frames the white bowl.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it feels below zero, so guests watch the clear valley from behind the double-height glass wall instead.
phrases.very_hot: An unusually hot day for Phobjikha, and the shaded stone terrace is the preferred spot for looking at the monastery.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but a fire burns in the dining room and the evening air stays comfortably mild.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Haze shortens the view today; the near pine forests show from the terrace, but the far Himalayan ridges do not.
phrases.late_night: Tonight a few farmhouse lights are visible on the Phobjikha valley floor, and at dawn the monastery fills the suite glass.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the suite windows after midnight, and a few farmhouse lamps show faintly across the Phobjikha valley floor.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud drifts across the Phobjikha Valley after midnight, and a few farmhouse lights show through it from the suite windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the river under each tent deck is already audible, though the rainforest on both banks stays dark.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Waterfall Restaurant, breakfast comes with a clear view of the biggest cascade in the sanctuary, lit by morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the boulder pool below one tent looks green and still, while white water runs under its neighbour.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light reaches the canopy tower first, with mist drifting over the forested hills beyond the valley.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your deck tonight, you would hear the Tmor Rung clearly and see stars above the treetops.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Cardamom forest this morning, but the zipline across Raging Big Sister Falls is running as usual.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the Landing Zone Bar sit under the straw roof while patches of sun move across the waterfall.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun puts broken light on the river, watched from the rope chairs on a tent deck.
phrases.overcast: Diffused daylight flattens the shadows over the canopy, which suits the lounge tent view of the rushing rocky river.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the tent roofs, and guests watch the Tmor Rung from inside, armchairs facing the jungle canopy.
phrases.thunderstorm: If a storm were overhead now, you would watch it from your tent, since there is no horizon to see it coming.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits between the forested hills today, and from the canopy tower the valley appears in sections, not whole.
phrases.snow: Snow has never reached this Cardamom valley, so if it did, guests would photograph it from every one of the 15 decks.
phrases.very_cold: From the tent deck, hard winter light falls on the white water of the Tmor Rung and the frosted teak rail.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the still green pool beneath one of the tents is the obvious place to be.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the valley tonight, and the Edison bulbs in the tent bathrooms are the brightest things for miles.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the forested hills beyond the camp are hard to see, though the river under each deck remains close and clear.
phrases.late_night: Anyone up late in Tent 14 sees white water below and is slow to sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has the Jackie Kennedy Tent tonight can watch rain fall on the white water below as evening comes.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has the Jackie Kennedy Tent tonight can see the river's white water from the bed, clouds hiding the stars.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the valley-facing balconies look down on the streetlights of Merano, with the Adige Valley still dark between the mountain walls.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast coffee on the panorama terrace comes with the whole Adige Valley below, orchards in rows and the rooftops of Merano sunlit.
phrases.clear_midday: Full sun covers the garden pool at this hour, and the snow-capped peaks beyond the valley stand sharp and clear.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun crosses the terrace now, lighting the vineyard rows below while the eastern mountain wall slowly turns orange.
phrases.clear_night: From a valley-facing balcony tonight, Merano shows as a line of lights on the dark valley floor, nothing else moving.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit over the Adige Valley this morning, their shadows sliding across the orchards visible from the panorama terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the pool loungers get alternating sun and shade, while clouds pass between the hill and the far peaks.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, gaps in the cloud light patches of vineyard below the terrace, one row at a time.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the valley today, but from the bay windows of the suites, Merano and the orchards remain clearly visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Adige Valley right now, so dinner in the Prezioso glass loggia comes with wet rooftops far below.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is working through the valley, and guests in the glass loggia watch lightning over the mountain walls in comfort.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze fills the valley floor this morning, so the terrace view stops at the nearest orchards while the high peaks stay clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the panorama terrace and the vineyard rows below, and the 50,000-square-metre garden is turning white.
phrases.very_cold: Guests on the castle terrace this morning look past frost on the railings to the Adige Valley and Merano's rooftops below.
phrases.very_hot: On a day this hot, the heated pool and the shaded garden do the work, with the valley shimmering quietly below.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and dinner at the Orangerie carries on with the lights of Merano spread along the valley.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the far peaks and much of the valley are hidden; only nearby orchards show below the terrace.
phrases.late_night: With the curtain left open on purpose in Suite Royale 304, the bed faces Merano's lights on the Adige Valley floor.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Prezioso, the suite windows show Merano's lights blurred by rain on the Adige Valley floor below.
phrases.grey_evening: Hours after dinner at Prezioso, Merano's lights show across the valley floor under the low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the basalt wall of Malacara stands dark across the valley, visible already from any balcony or private lookout.
phrases.clear_morning: From the eastern viewpoint this morning, the Atlantic coastline is in sight — the clear-day condition is met today.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool holds strong sun, and the forested ridges of Malacara look sharp from the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun crosses the canyon now, and guests at the terrace tables watch the basalt wall of Malacara slowly change colour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the telescope suite tonight, you would have a clear sky over the canyons and no city glow.
phrases.partly_morning: Cumulus clouds pass over the Serra ridgeline this morning, visible from the timber deck beside the infinity pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at Restaurante Contemplar see broken clouds moving across Malacara this afternoon, with the valley in full view between them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun reaches the all-glass spa suites, where the escarpment sits at eye level under scattered clouds.
phrases.overcast: Grey cover sits over the canyons today, but the flat-topped escarpments are still clearly visible from every balcony.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the serra, so the glass-walled indoor pool is the sensible place to keep watching Malacara.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were at a front-line chalet window, you would see lightning on the basalt wall of Malacara Canyon across the valley.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits along the ridgeline today, and Malacara appears and disappears from the shared canyon viewpoint.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare at this altitude, but if it fell tonight you would watch it from a heated private pool.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold, warm water in one of the private pools makes watching the Malacara wall across the valley easier.
phrases.very_hot: At 650 metres the heat rarely reaches 35, but today it has, and the infinity pool facing Malacara helps.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the evening is mild, and chalet balconies face the dark shape of the canyon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today; the Atlantic coastline is not in sight from the eastern viewpoint, though Malacara across the valley still is.
phrases.late_night: Lights off in a front-line chalet after midnight, and the stars over Malacara Canyon are the only light left inside.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtains open before bed, rain runs down the chalet glass and the Malacara wall is a faint shape across the valley.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the canyon rim after midnight, and a few valley lights show below the front-line chalets' floor-to-ceiling glass.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the outline of Osorno is already visible from every bedside through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_morning: This morning the lake is calm, and guests at breakfast in the AWA Restaurant see the snow-capped cone of Osorno clearly.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the glazed pool is bright on both walls and overhead, with Lake Llanquihue flat and blue beyond.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun crosses Lake Llanquihue and reaches the private jetty, with the volcano sharp from all 25 rooms.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a room tonight, you would see stars over the lake through the full-height window beside the bed.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit over the lake this morning, but the cone of Osorno is still framed in the circular porthole window.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon clouds pass above Lake Llanquihue, and swimmers in the glass-enclosed pool watch them through the ceiling.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds take colour over the water, visible from the bar at ground level.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey ceiling of cloud, Osorno is hidden today, though the lake stays visible from the restaurant tables.
phrases.rain: Through the glass roof of the heated spa pool, swimmers watch the rain hit the panes above Lake Llanquihue.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is crossing the lake, so the private beach is empty and guests watch from behind floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the lake this morning, and from the rooms neither Osorno nor the far shore can be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling along the shoreline, and from the warm restaurant guests see the private jetty turning white.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it feels below zero today, and the snow cap of Osorno stands clear across the lake from every room.
phrases.very_hot: On this unusually hot day, the beach in front of the hotel is busy and the lake looks very inviting.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, so guests on the ground floor hear the lake more than they see it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over the lake today, so Osorno cannot be seen, only the water near the private beach.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water at the bedside in Suite 51, and the snow cone of Osorno shows across Lake Llanquihue.
phrases.wet_evening: Past midnight, rain runs across Suite 51's glass and the room reflects where Osorno would be.
