phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides Osorno over Lake Llanquihue tonight, and Room 46's fireplace glows in the glass.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balcony rooms look onto a dark, flat Canandaigua Lake, with no boats out yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning yoga is underway behind the open glass doors, and the lake outside is bright and completely calm.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the floor-to-ceiling lounge windows frame treetops in full sun, and the lake beyond shows a few small boats.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From a balcony at golden hour, the far shore looks sharp, and the lawn chairs sit in warm late sun.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the glass end of a barrel sauna looks straight down the dark lake under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: From a balcony this morning, scattered clouds move over Canandaigua Lake while one early boat crosses the water below.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the lake this afternoon, and guests in the lounge watch the light change through the tall windows.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds color over the lake, best seen from the Adirondack chairs on the lawn.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Canandaigua Lake today, but yoga continues behind the glass doors facing the water.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Canandaigua Lake, and diners in the Rose Tavern greenhouse stay dry as plates come off the wood-fired hearth.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is crossing the lake, and guests watch it from the lounge behind floor-to-ceiling windows, dinner still warm.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers most of Canandaigua Lake this morning, so the balconies show grey water close by and little else.
phrases.snow: Snow covers the grounds, the fire pit is lit by the shoreline saunas, and the outdoor pool is steaming.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it is below freezing, yet guests sit in the heated outdoor pool watching steam rise over the snowy lakefront.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the balcony rooms catch whatever breeze crosses the lake, and the dock below stays busy.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night sits over the lake, and the greenhouse at Rose Tavern glows with lights from the hearth.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far shore cannot be seen from the balconies, only the nearest stretch of water.
phrases.late_night: If you were in a Lake View King after a late dinner at Rose Tavern, you would see lights across Canandaigua Lake.
phrases.wet_evening: Over a last drink in a Lake View King, rain would blur the far-shore lights.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last glass at a Lake View King window tonight, you would see far-shore lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Petronas Twin Towers stand lit against a dark clear sky in the floor-to-ceiling windows of every guest room.
phrases.clear_morning: From the 38th floor, THIRTY8 offers the full circle of Kuala Lumpur in clear morning light, towers included.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the Petronas Twin Towers stand sharp in the 38th-floor windows of THIRTY8.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a guest room now, you would see the KL Tower and the skyline in low afternoon sun.
phrases.clear_night: The lit Petronas Twin Towers stand in the floor-to-ceiling windows of THIRTY8 under a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass above the Petronas Twin Towers this morning, seen through the generously sized windows of the rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the rooftop pool this afternoon get sun between clouds, and nobody in Kuala Lumpur needs a jacket.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the set tables at THIRTY8 while clouds break up over the KL Tower.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the 360-degree view from THIRTY8 is still complete, just without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the freestanding tub in a high-floor bathroom becomes the sensible place to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the suite corner windows are the place to watch lightning over the city skyline, far from the rooftop pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the city today turns the Petronas Twin Towers into pale outlines from the guest room windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is not expected in Kuala Lumpur, but if it fell, the 411 rooms would each have a window on it.
phrases.very_cold: A freezing day would be a first for Kuala Lumpur, and the elevated lobby would give its panoramic city view on arrival.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over Kuala Lumpur today keeps guests in the rooftop pool until the sun drops lower.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the lit Petronas Towers stand in the THIRTY8 windows while the show kitchens work.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far parts of the THIRTY8 panorama are missing, though the Petronas Twin Towers remain in view.
phrases.late_night: Guests in rooms facing the Twin Towers have probably fallen asleep with the curtain open, the city lights kept in view.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has the corner suite tonight ends the day watching the two Petronas spires through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a room facing the Twin Towers tonight watches the city lights spread under the low cloud before bed.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, El Ángel stands in the window of the corner rooms, with Reforma Avenue almost empty below.
phrases.clear_morning: A breakfast tray on a room balcony comes with a clear view of the Angel and the dense skyline this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is on the HSBC tower, and the Opera suite bathtub faces the whole bright skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light reaches the BBVA tower, seen from the high-floor dining room through floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_night: From the Cityzen rooftop tonight, the city lights spread out below and the mountains show on the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Chapultepec this morning, and corner-room guests can watch them pass beyond the Estela de Luz.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on the gym treadmills now, you would see broken cloud over the wide skyline while running.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun gets between clouds and lands on El Ángel, centered in the corner-room windows.
phrases.overcast: From the corner rooms, El Ángel stands center-frame on Paseo de la Reforma under a flat grey sky.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Reforma Avenue, and the Imperial suite bathtub is a dry place to watch El Ángel.
phrases.thunderstorm: From a corner room, lightning flashes over Paseo de la Reforma and lights the gold figure on El Ángel in the rain.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the distant hills today, and from the corner rooms only the nearer Reforma towers stay clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Mexico City, so guests at the pool windows are photographing white flakes over the skyline.
phrases.very_cold: It is freezing outside today, and the corner rooms keep El Ángel in view without opening the balcony door.
phrases.very_hot: Heat sits on Reforma Avenue this afternoon, and the indoor pool gives the same skyline view behind glass.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the city tonight, but the Cityzen rooftop still has city lights below and red chairs free.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the mountains behind the skyline are not there to see from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.late_night: Back from Bajel, El Ángel's column centers the Opera Suite window, Reforma lit around it.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the corner-room glass this evening, and El Ángel appears center-frame among the wet lamps of Reforma.
phrases.grey_evening: The corner rooms face El Ángel's column tonight, in city lights under a low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Schlern's flat top is already a dark shape in the panoramic windows of all 60 rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: From a balcony this morning, the meadow runs clear and unbroken all the way to the Sassolungo.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the 7-metre outdoor pool sits in full sun, with the Sella in plain view across the meadow.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the Sassolungo directly, and guests on the terrace sofas have nothing in the way of it.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars over the Schlern from your balcony at 1,800 metres.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the Sella this morning, but the terrace sofas are dry and the Schlern is out.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the meadow in front of the Sassolungo restaurant windows this afternoon, and the light changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the swimmers in the indoor pool watch the Dolomite peaks turn pink between the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Schlern and the Sassolungo are still fully visible from the rooms, just without any shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the meadow, so the 22-metre indoor pool is the drier place to look at the massifs.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is moving over the Sella, and guests are watching the lightning from behind the panoramic windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Seiser Alm today, and the peaks are missing from the Sassolungo restaurant windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Seiser Alm, and skiers come straight off the pistes to the hotel door.
phrases.very_cold: Below zero on the meadow today, and from the spa window the snow and the sunlit Dolomite peaks are both sharp.
phrases.very_hot: If you were at a balcony now, you would see heat-haze over the Seiser Alm meadow in front of the Schlern.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, so guests keep the balcony doors open, though the peaks are hard to make out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the terrace the near meadow and pine trees are clear but the Schlern is not.
phrases.late_night: The room lights are off, and the only light left comes from the stars over the meadow toward the Schlern.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, snow crosses the light from the panoramic windows, and wet flakes gather on the glass facing the Sassolungo.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight thin cloud crosses the Seiser Alm outside the panoramic windows, and the Sassolungo stays out of sight until first light.

phrases.clear_morning: Early sun reaches the Elbphilharmonie before the rest of the harbour, and the Skyview rooms get a clear sightline along the Elbe.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Elbe is bright and the container terminal cranes are easy to count from the Skyview rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the late afternoon, low sun lights the Elbphilharmonie glass, and guests in the Skyview rooms watch from their bathtubs.
phrases.clear_night: Skyline Bar 20up has a clear view tonight of ship lights on the Elbe and the lit Elbphilharmonie.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the harbour this morning, so from the 20th floor the container port is sometimes in shade, sometimes in sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in a Skyview room this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows moving across the docked ships below.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day colours the clouds above the Elbphilharmonie, seen through the floor-to-ceiling windows of Skyline Bar 20up.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Elbe looks grey too, but the Elbphilharmonie and the cranes are still visible from the 20th floor.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Skyview rooms, and the container port across the Elbe looks blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm over the harbour means guests at Skyline Bar 20up can watch lightning behind the cranes while staying dry inside.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the far side of the Elbe today, and even the Elbphilharmonie is only a faint shape from the 20th floor.
phrases.snow: If you were in a Skyview room now, you would see snow falling on the container port below.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day like this, visibility over the harbour is excellent and the cranes stand out from the 20th floor.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot days are rare in Hamburg, and today the Elbphilharmonie glass glares in the sun seen from Skyline Bar 20up.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild night, the lit container port and the ships on the Elbe are easy to see from the Skyview rooms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited, so from the 20th floor the Elbphilharmonie is clear but the far end of the container port is not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the port lights shine on the Elbe below the Skyview rooms, and at dawn the Elbphilharmonie will be in view.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open after midnight, rain on the Skyview windows blurs the port lights along the Elbe beside the Elbphilharmonie.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low cloud after midnight, the Skyview rooms' open curtains frame the harbour lights and the Elbphilharmonie's curved outline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lobby coffee is already out, and from the oceanfront rooms Haystack Rock is a dark shape against the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Continental breakfast comes with a clear view of the sea stacks, and the lawn in front of the lodge is bright green.
phrases.clear_midday: From the wrap-around verandas, Haystack Rock stands in full sun, with open water behind it and nothing in the way.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a veranda, you would watch the low sun turn the sea stacks and the shallow tidal water gold.
phrases.clear_night: From the wrap-around verandas, a clear night sky full of stars spreads above the Pacific off Cannon Beach.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the sky over Haystack Rock this morning, so the light on the beach changes between bites of breakfast.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, sun and cloud take turns over the open water, seen from the decks and patios of the oceanfront rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the sea stacks between clouds, and the verandas are the usual place to watch it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Haystack Rock still looks large from the balcony doors, and the room fireplaces are lit early.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the beach, so guests watch the sea stacks from the covered deck or beside a room fireplace.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Pacific, and the oceanfront rooms give a dry seat for lightning above the open water.
phrases.fog_haze: Coastal fog covers most of the beach today, and from the covered deck only the nearest sea stack shows through.
phrases.snow: Snow on Cannon Beach is rare, but today the lawn outside the lodge is white and every room fireplace is in use.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing on the verandas, so guests watch Haystack Rock from behind the balcony doors with the fire lit.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot weather is unusual here, and the covered deck is the shaded place to look at the sea stacks.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the surf is audible from the room decks and the lobby cookies are still out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the oceanfront rooms the beach is clear but the farther sea stacks are hard to see.
phrases.late_night: Lights are off in the oceanfront studios after midnight, and at dawn their windows will show Haystack Rock in the surf.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain beads on the balcony doors of the oceanfront studios tonight, and the fireplace light shows in the glass above the Pacific.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hides the moon over Cannon Beach after midnight, and the fireplace glow in the oceanfront rooms shows in the window glass.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Story Bridge lights show on the Brisbane River below the WET Deck under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the King Suite with River View, the Story Bridge is sharp this morning and Mt. Coot-tha is clear in the distance.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is over the river, and guests in the suite bar area watch the Kurilpa Bridge through the glass.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the Brisbane River from the west, and river-facing rooms get direct light through their floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would swim in the WET Deck pool at midnight with the Brisbane River in view.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over the river this morning, so the view from the river rooms changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud sit over Brisbane this afternoon, and from the suite windows the Story Bridge moves in and out of shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the hills beyond the Kurilpa Bridge are lit between the clouds, seen from the suite bar.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Brisbane today, but the river and Story Bridge are still easy to see from most rooms.
phrases.rain: From the WET Deck rooftop pool, rain falls on the Brisbane River and the lit Story Bridge after midnight.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the WET Deck rooftop pool, lightning flashes over the Brisbane River and the Story Bridge during the thunderstorm.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits on the river today, and Mt. Coot-tha is missing from the far end of the view.
phrases.snow: From the WET Deck rooftop pool, snow falls over the Brisbane River and the lit Story Bridge after midnight.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold Brisbane day, the Story Bridge and the river look sharp through the suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Brisbane, and the WET Deck pool is the obvious place to watch the river from.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and the pool is still open with the Brisbane River as its usual backdrop.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Mt. Coot-tha cannot be seen, and the view stops at the river and the nearer bridges.
phrases.late_night: City lights lie on the Brisbane River outside the King Suite, and dawn will show the Story Bridge in the same window.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the King Suite with River View, and the city lights blur on the Brisbane River.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Brisbane after midnight, and the city lights show again on the river from the King Suite with River View.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Canton Tower stands dark across the Pearl River, seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows of every room.
phrases.clear_morning: A clear morning shows the Canton Tower in full daylight across the river, while breakfast is served at SAIL restaurant.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a blue midday sky, the outdoor pool faces the Canton Tower directly across the Pearl River, with no haze between them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the late afternoon, sunlight falls on the Canton Tower, and guests on the garden terrace watch it from river level.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the LED display of the Canton Tower reflects across the Pearl River, visible from the cocktail terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds cross the sky above the Canton Tower this morning, seen from the private terrace of a Canton Tower View Suite.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you stood on the garden terrace this afternoon, you would see the Canton Tower across the Pearl River under broken cloud.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see the last sun lighting the Canton Tower between the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Low grey cloud sits over the Pearl River today, yet the Canton Tower stays clearly visible from the outdoor pool.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Pearl River, and guests in the soaking tub of the marble bathroom still see the Canton Tower.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, the pool and terraces are empty, and guests watch lightning behind the Canton Tower from their room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Pearl River softens the outline of the Canton Tower today, seen from the garden terrace at river level.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Guangzhou, but today it would be seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows rather than from the outdoor pool.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Guangzhou, so the outdoor pool is quiet and the Canton Tower stands sharp in clear air.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot this afternoon, so the outdoor pool is the practical place to look at the Canton Tower across the Pearl River.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky on this mild night, yet the LED display of the Canton Tower still reflects across the Pearl River.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today visibility is short, with no rain or fog, and the Canton Tower is only a dim shape from the garden terrace.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner at SAIL, the windows of the Canton Tower View Suites show the tower directly across the Pearl River.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open in a Canton Tower View Suite, rain on the glass blurs the city lights along the Pearl River.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain is open in a Canton Tower View Suite, and the city lights across the Pearl River show under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop suites face a dark ocean and a protected landscape that is still only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun is on the rooftop suites, and from the pool water the ocean and the parkland are both in view.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop suite, the midday sun lights the ocean and the protected landscape of the estate under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the balconies of the orange villas, and the countryside around them turns a warmer colour before sunset.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars over the protected parkland from a rooftop suite and a dark ocean beyond.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Costa Vicentina this morning, so the rooftop plunge pools get sun for a few minutes at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the waterfront lawn this afternoon, the red Adirondack chairs sit in sun and shade by turns, facing the river.
phrases.partly_golden: Seen from a rooftop pool, the last sun lights some of the ocean while clouds keep other parts of it grey.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the view from the balconies is a landscape of dull green trees and a colourless ocean.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the 220-hectare estate, and guests stay inside the Azeitona restaurant for a long, dry meal.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the ocean means the rooftop plunge pools are empty for now, and the lightning is watched from indoors.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has moved in from the sea, and the window of the spa treatment room shows white where the water normally is.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare on this coast, but today a little falls on the gardens around the orange villas.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for the Algarve, the sky is clear over the parkland, but nobody is in the rooftop plunge pools.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the estate, and the marble plunge pools on the rooftops are the only comfortable place outside.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the balconies of the villas look out at a dark landscape with no stars above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the rooftop suites, the trees and protected parkland show close at hand today, but the ocean beyond stays out of sight.
phrases.late_night: With the lights off in the rooftop suites, the moon on the ocean is the only glow left inside.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Azeitona, rain runs down the rooftop suite windows above the private plunge pools.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Azeitona is over, and from the rooftop suites low cloud covers the ocean out past the estate.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the moat below the Palace-facing rooms is still dark, and the swans are not yet easy to spot.
phrases.clear_morning: From a king room, breakfast comes with a clear view of the Imperial Palace gardens and the swans on the moat.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun sits high over the gardens, and the suite's floor-to-ceiling windows show the skyline with hard shadows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun is now on the Imperial Palace gardens, the part of the view that changes most by breakfast tomorrow.
phrases.clear_night: On the rooftop terrace tonight, the lit skyline is sharp, and the gardens below are mostly dark.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the moat this morning, so the king room view changes from bright to grey every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on the green planted terrace this afternoon, you would see the skyline under broken cloud, half in sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun is lighting the clouds over the gardens, visible from the rooftop terrace and the upper rooms.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the moat looks flat and the gardens look darker green, which the swans do not seem to mind.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the moat and the gardens, and guests in the fitness center watch it through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over Tokyo, and from the Palace-facing rooms the lightning shows the gardens for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the city today hides the far skyline from the suite windows, though the moat directly below is still clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the Imperial Palace gardens, a rare sight in Tokyo, and the king room windows face it directly.
phrases.very_cold: From the breakfast room, frost sits on the moat edge below the bare trees of the Imperial Palace Gardens.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Tokyo today, so the rooftop terrace is mostly empty and the gardens look pale in the strong sun.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds sit over the skyline on this mild night, and the rooftop terrace tables are lit and in use.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so from the fitness center windows the river is clear but the far skyline is not.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Palace-facing rooms left the curtain open and fell asleep to city lights on the moat water.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in a Palace-facing room after midnight watches the rain blur the city lights over the Imperial Palace moat.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a Palace-facing room after midnight watches low cloud catch the city glow above the moat.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Century City twin towers stand as dark shapes against a clear sky above the still-empty pool deck.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun under a clear sky hits the Century City towers, close enough to seem next door from the California Suite.
phrases.clear_midday: Striped cabanas on the pool deck give the only shade right now, with the twin towers sharp in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun turns the Century City towers orange, seen from the blue lounge chairs by the pool.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop terrace tonight, you would sit at a candlelit table with palm trees against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over Century City this morning, and a few guests already have the blue lounge chairs by the pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass between the sun and the pool, so the twin towers go bright and dull in turn above the cabanas.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over Century City catch orange light above the pool terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Century City towers look flat and close from the pool, and the cabanas sit mostly empty.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Los Angeles, and today it drips from the striped cabanas onto an empty pool deck.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over Century City is unusual, and in the suite living room the French doors stay closed on the storm.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze is common in Los Angeles, and today it softens the twin towers as seen from the California Suite balcony.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never falls in Beverly Hills, so a few flakes over the tropical gardens would surprise everyone by the pool.
phrases.very_cold: From the pool terrace, the Century City towers stand in hard winter light above the empty blue lounge chairs.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, so guests keep to the striped cabanas and the water while the towers stand in full sun.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the sky is cloudy, but the air is mild enough for dinner at the candlelit tables on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, and the Century City towers appear faded from the pool deck, their tops hard to make out.
phrases.late_night: Anyone in the California Suite has turned off every light, so the only glow in the room comes from Century City's windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has the California Suite tonight can watch rain run down the glass after midnight, the Century City towers behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the California Suite after midnight watches low cloud drift over the Century City towers, city lights under it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the spire of St. Stephen's stands dark against a clear sky from the upper-floor corner windows.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Lamée Rooftop terrace, morning sun lights the tiled roof of St. Stephen's a few streets away.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the tropical-print umbrellas on the rooftop give shade, and the cathedral towers stand sharp against blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Before sunset, low sun colours the stone of the Gothic towers orange, straight across from the Lamée terrace.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lit cathedral spire through the oval porthole window of a Topazz room.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Vienna rooftops this morning, while the spire stays clear from the king-bed rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Innere Stadt roofscape, and the neon stools on the terrace get sun between them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, cloud edges turn orange above St. Stephen's, visible from the event room terrace.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky sits over Vienna today, and the cathedral's patterned tile roof looks flat and dull from the suite windows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop terrace cushions, so guests watch the wet towers of St. Stephen's from behind the porthole windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the city, and lightning now and then shows the cathedral spire from the suite's corner windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Vienna today, and only the lower part of the cathedral roof shows from the Lamée terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the tiled roof of St. Stephen's, and the terrace umbrellas stay folded today.
phrases.very_cold: If you stood at a Topazz porthole window now, you could see frost on the glass around St. Stephen's tiled roof.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the tropical-print umbrellas on the Lamée terrace are the only shade with a cathedral view.
phrases.mild_night: Mild cloudy night in Vienna: guests on the Lamée terrace sit with the lit towers of St. Stephen's at eye level.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far Vienna rooftops are not clear, though the nearby cathedral spire still shows from the rooms.
phrases.late_night: After a late drink at Lamée Rooftop, the porthole shows the cathedral spire over lit rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner over, rain streaks the oval porthole window in Topazz after midnight, and St Stephen's spire shows above the wet tiled roofs.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the oval porthole window frames St Stephen's spire against low cloud, Vienna's lights spread under it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gulf outside the deluxe rooms is dark and flat, and the beach umbrellas stand empty on the sand.
phrases.clear_morning: From the lounge's arched windows, the Arabian Gulf already looks turquoise, with Al-Maha Island clearly visible offshore.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong, so most guests use the thatched umbrellas or the floating loungers in the infinity pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the La Mar beachfront terrace now, you would see the late light on the water at eye level.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the lounge bar's floor-to-ceiling windows frame the lit West Bay skyline across the calm water of the bay.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over Doha this morning, and from the suite windows the palm-lined beach is already in use.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the infinity pool this afternoon, giving guests on the floating loungers a few minutes of shade each time.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Gulf turn orange, seen from the Belgian Cafe's sea-facing terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Gulf looks more silver than turquoise today, but the cabana daybeds on the beach are still occupied.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Doha, so guests watch it from the lounge's arched windows while the beach loungers get wet.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the bay hides the West Bay skyline from the lounge today, though the nearby palm trees and beach are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Doha, so guests photograph the white flakes over the beach from the suite windows.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air for Doha today, so the thatched umbrellas stand empty and guests watch the Gulf from the lounge windows.
phrases.very_hot: From the beach, heat-haze over the water blurs the West Bay skyline beyond the empty thatched umbrellas.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the lit West Bay skyline shows across the calm Gulf water from the lounge windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today, so from the infinity pool the Doha skyline is not visible, only the nearer beach and palms.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Doha skyline lights shine across the bay, and at dawn the suite windows show the Gulf and Al-Maha Island.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the window of a city-facing room, and the West Bay skyline lights show across the water.
phrases.grey_evening: In the city-facing rooms the curtain is open late, and the West Bay skyline lights show under low cloud across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Parthenon is still lit above the dark hill, and the rooftop restaurant tables stand empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Acropolis Terrace Suite, the Parthenon shows sharp against a clear blue sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun falls directly on the outdoor pool, and the loungers around the blue water are mostly taken.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests at the rooftop restaurant this afternoon look up to the Parthenon on its hilltop under a clear late-day sky.
phrases.clear_night: After midnight, guests in the Acropolis Terrace Suite look out at the lit Parthenon under a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Lycabettus Hill this morning, while the Parthenon stays in sunlight most of the time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on the suite terrace now, you would see cloud shadows moving slowly across Philopappos Hill and the Acropolis rock.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds glow orange behind the Parthenon, visible from the rooftop tables.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Athens today, so the Parthenon appears flat and pale from the guest room balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain wets the empty loungers by the outdoor pool, and guests watch the Acropolis from their room balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the Acropolis hill right now, and the open-air rooftop tables are empty while diners wait indoors.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Athens today, and the Parthenon is only a soft outline from the Acropolis Terrace Suite.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Athens, but today it dusts the Parthenon, seen from heated guest rooms through closed balcony doors.
phrases.very_cold: From the Acropolis Terrace Suite, the Parthenon stands in hard winter light, with steam rising off the private jacuzzi.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon in Athens, and most guests stay in the pool water or in the shade of the greenery.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the illuminated Parthenon still shows clearly from the rooftop restaurant tables.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so the Parthenon close above the hotel is clear, but Lycabettus Hill further off is not.
phrases.late_night: Past one, the Parthenon's columns show over the Athens lights, hard to stop watching.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass of the Acropolis Terrace Suite, and the Parthenon is there on its hilltop through the wet evening.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Athens after midnight, and from the Acropolis Terrace Suite the Parthenon's outline shows above the lit streets.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the sixth-floor rooftop, the Sky Tower lights stand out against a dark clear sky before the sun rises.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Waitemata Harbour, and the marina below the rooftop shows every boat in sharp detail.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the harbour, and the wicker chairs on the rooftop are mostly in full light.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden hour suits the rooftop bar, with low sun on the timber decking and the Sky Tower lit orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop tonight, you would see the Sky Tower lights and the harbour under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds this morning over Auckland, so the harbour seen from the rooftop changes between bright and dull patches.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud this afternoon, and lounge sofas on the rooftop get sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds above the marina, a good moment for a drink at the Rooftop at QT.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Waitemata Harbour today, which makes the water look flat and grey from the sixth floor as well.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the timber decking, so guests are more likely inside at Esther than on the rooftop.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the sixth-floor rooftop, lightning flashes over Waitemata Harbour while heavy rain falls between the marina and the Sky Tower.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze today, and from the rooftop the Sky Tower is only a faint outline while the near marina stays clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Auckland, but if it fell today the green landscaping on the rooftop would carry a thin white layer.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold for Auckland, so the rooftop wicker chairs sit empty while the harbour and Sky Tower stay sharp and clear.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day in Auckland, and the timber decking on the rooftop is warm underfoot until the sun drops lower.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the Sky Tower lights show under the cloud from the rooftop bar sofas.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop the marina is clear but the far side of the harbour is not.
phrases.late_night: Were you in a suite now, you might leave the curtain open and fall asleep facing part of the Sky Tower.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink at the Rooftop at QT, you would see harbour lights and the Sky Tower through rain.
phrases.grey_evening: Were you on the Rooftop at QT for a last drink, the Sky Tower would show against low cloud over the harbour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, a bay-facing room shows Rainbow Bridge still lit, with the skyline a dark outline against the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: On a clear morning, Mount Fuji can appear beyond the skyline from a bay-facing room, which is not guaranteed on most days.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun on Tokyo Bay makes the water bright from the lounge seating, and Rainbow Bridge stands out clearly.

phrases.snow: If snow ever fell on Waikiki, guests in the balcony Jacuzzi would watch it land on the palm trees with real surprise.
phrases.very_cold: From the suite balcony, Waikiki Beach lies empty along the water toward Diamond Head in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, and the rooftop pool with its wave mosaic is the most popular place above Waikiki Beach.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night under cloud, with guests sitting in the rooftop hot tub and the Honolulu hotels along Waikiki in view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today: Waikiki Beach and the palm trees are clear from the balcony, but Diamond Head is hard to see.
phrases.late_night: Whoever wakes for water in the Penthouse Diamond Suite near midnight would see Diamond Head's long shape beyond the beach lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Penthouse Diamond Suite see Diamond Head through the rain tonight, the Waikiki shore lights bright on wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the Penthouse Diamond Suite sees the Waikiki hotel lights under low cloud, and Diamond Head beyond the beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lagoon outside the overwater villas is dark and flat, with no boats on it yet.
phrases.clear_morning: If you stood on the villa deck now, you would see the lagoon flat and turquoise under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly overhead, and the white umbrellas on the beach are the only shade near the loungers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls across the overwater villa decks, and the private pools match the lagoon almost exactly.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars over the lagoon from a villa deck, with very little light around.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the atoll this morning, and the lagoon colour changes from pale to deep turquoise under them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the beachfront restaurant deck get short breaks of shade this afternoon each time a cloud covers the sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the ocean turn orange while the villa pool surface stays completely flat.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky the lagoon looks pale and milky from the villa decks, closer to grey than turquoise.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the thatched roofs and on the infinity pools, and guests already in the water simply stay there.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the atoll means no beach dinner tonight, so guests watch the lightning from inside their villas.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the lagoon today, and from the overwater decks the horizon between water and sky is hard to find.
phrases.snow: Snow in the Maldives would be a first, and guests would be filming it from their villa decks, not swimming.
phrases.very_cold: The air over the atoll is unusually cold today, so the infinity pools stay empty and guests stay inside the villas.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day the sand is painful to cross barefoot, and most guests stay in their private pools until evening.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm with cloud cover, so the private beach dinner goes ahead by lantern and torch light, without stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so the near lagoon shows well from the villa decks but the resort's other islands do not.
phrases.late_night: Were you up for water near midnight in an overwater villa, you would see the lagoon moving just past the deck.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in an overwater villa tonight, you would watch rain fall on the lagoon past the deck.
phrases.grey_evening: With a nightcap in an overwater villa now, you would see villa lights on the cloudy lagoon.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop terrace is empty and the Adriatic below Lama Monachile is dark and flat under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop terrace above Lama Monachile, the Adriatic lies flat and blue under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the limestone cliffs look white and the sea very blue from the terrace, with no shade over the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the white lounge seating on the terrace, and the three sea-facing suites have warm light through their balcony doors.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky above the Adriatic is clear, and guests on the rooftop terrace have a late drink under the stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Polignano this morning, so the cove below the breakfast terrace changes between bright turquoise and darker blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some clouds and some sun this afternoon, and from the terrace the cliffs of Lama Monachile are sometimes in shadow, sometimes lit.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds pink above the roof, where lanterns are being set out on the terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Adriatic in front of the three sea-view suites looks flat and grey too, with little colour today.
phrases.rain: From the rooftop terrace, rain falls on the cove at Lama Monachile and the grey Adriatic beyond.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the sea-facing suites tonight watch lightning flash over the Adriatic beyond the cove of Lama Monachile.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the sea today means the horizon from the roof is unclear, though the cove directly below is still visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Polignano, but today a few flakes fall past the balcony and melt before they reach the cove.
phrases.very_cold: From the rooftop terrace, hard winter light falls on the limestone cliffs and the Adriatic beyond Lama Monachile.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the cliff today, and the white lounge seating on the terrace is mostly left alone until evening.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers the stars tonight, but the air is mild and guests stay late on the rooftop above the dark cove.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests on the rooftop terrace see Lama Monachile cove below but not the Adriatic horizon, hidden today in haze.
phrases.late_night: If you were in a sea-facing suite now, lights off, the only glow left would come from the window over the Adriatic.
phrases.wet_evening: If you ended tonight with a drink in a sea suite, you would hear the Adriatic under the rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last glass in a sea-view suite now, you would see village lights on the Adriatic under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, a clear sky shows the last stars fading above the two arms of Malacara canyon from the upstairs lookout.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the deck comes with the canyon walls fully lit and no cloud anywhere above the gorge.
phrases.clear_midday: At lunch, the restaurant looks straight into the canyon under a blue sky, with the forest below the walls in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the upstairs lookout, low afternoon sun lights both arms of Malacara above the forest under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: After midnight, stars shine in the clear sky between the two arms of the Malacara canyon above the deck fire.
phrases.partly_morning: From the hammock on the balcony, clouds pass over the canyon this morning and the walls change from shade to sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in the open-air spa pavilion now, you would see broken cloud through the gaps in the forest canopy.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, patches of light cross the canyon walls, seen from the deck where the fire is lit.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers the canyon today, so from the living room the walls look darker and closer than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the forest below the canyon walls, and the main house living room is the dry place to watch.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder echoes between the two arms of Malacara, and from the lookout the deck below is empty and wet.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist fills the gorge today, and from the jacuzzi behind the yellow arched doors only the nearest trees are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow, rare in these canyons, is settling on the deck boards and the roof garden while the walls fade behind it.
phrases.very_cold: On a day close to freezing, breakfast on the deck facing the gorge is a short and well-dressed affair.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air fills the gorge, and the shade of the spa pavilion under the forest canopy is where guests are.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over the canyon means no stars from the deck, though the fire and the river sound remain.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from the balcony the near canyon wall is clear but the far ridgeline is not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the cabin lights are off for sleep, and at dawn the upstairs lookout will frame both arms of Malacara.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the balcony door, and the Malacara river sounds over its stones in the gorge.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner the stone fireplace burns in the room, and low cloud covers the canyon walls above the Malacara river.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky over the Rome rooftops is clear and still dark, and the Settimo tables stand empty before the sun comes up.
phrases.clear_morning: From a room terrace, the sun loungers are already in full sun and the domed building nearby stands out clearly.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop jacuzzi gets direct sun, and the cantilever umbrella is the only shade on the terrace.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Twenty minutes before sunset, the edge tables at Settimo face St. Peter's dome directly, now in warm orange light.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the dome of St. Peter's is lit and visible from the seventh floor terrace under a clear, dark sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Villa Borghese trees this morning, and the twin-towered church above the canopy is in and out of shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the Settimo terrace this afternoon get sun between the clouds, with the Rome rooftops and domes in plain view.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were at an edge table now, you would see the low sun colour the clouds behind St. Peter's dome.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Rome today, so St. Peter's dome shows flat and pale from the seventh floor.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop terrace, and the sun loungers outside the room doors are wet and empty.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you stood at the Settimo terrace doors now, you would see lightning flash over St Peter's dome above the wet rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Rome today makes St. Peter's dome a faint outline from the seventh floor, with the nearer trees still clear.
phrases.snow: Snow in Rome is rare, but today a thin layer sits on the potted olive tree outside the room terrace doors.
phrases.very_cold: The air on the Settimo terrace is close to freezing, and the view of the domes is very sharp today.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the outdoor jacuzzi on the rooftop is the one place guests sit under the open sky.
phrases.mild_night: Under a mild cloudy night sky, the lit dome of St. Peter's still stands out from the Settimo tables.
phrases.reduced_visibility: If you were on the seventh-floor terrace now, you would see the Villa Borghese trees but not St. Peter's dome today.
phrases.late_night: If you left the curtain open tonight, you could fall asleep with St Peter's dome above the rooftop lights of Rome.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last glass inside Settimo tonight, you would see St Peter's dome through rain on the windows.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were up at Settimo now, you would see low cloud over lit rooftops and St Peter's dome in the distance.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, a high room in the Prestige Tower looks over a dark garden and the still-lit office towers of Toranomon.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the one-hectare garden below the Prestige Tower shows every tree in bright sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the garden, and Tokyo Tower stands sharp from the window next to the bathtub.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the balcony now, you would watch the office towers turn orange while the park below slowly darkens.
phrases.clear_night: After midnight, under a clear sky, the lit Minato skyscrapers show through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Prestige Tower rooms.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Minato this morning, so the garden below changes between shade and sun from the room windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the fitness center windows, the afternoon skyline shows patches of sun between the clouds while someone runs on a treadmill.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds above the temple pavilion, seen from a room on a high floor.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Tokyo today, and the garden is the brightest green thing in the view from 41 floors up.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the garden below while the indoor lap pool stays calm under its warm cove lighting.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the high rooms watch the lightning over Minato through the glass right now, with the balcony chairs left empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze thins the skyline today; the garden is still clear from the rooms, Tokyo Tower much less so.
phrases.snow: Snow on the one-hectare garden is rare in Tokyo, and today the upper rooms have a white view of it.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air outside; from the twin room windows the skyline looks unusually clear, as it often does on cold days.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day over Toranomon, and the indoor lap pool is where most guests spend the afternoon instead of the balcony.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, so the balcony with rattan chairs is usable, with office towers lit across the park.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today: the garden and the nearby towers are clear, but Tokyo Tower is not easy to make out.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water by the bed, and the lit towers of Minato fill a Prestige Tower window.
phrases.wet_evening: Before bed, rain streaks a Prestige Tower window and lit Minato towers blur behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight the curtains in a Prestige Tower room are open, and the lit city shows under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the red rock walls around the casita decks are still dark shapes against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the top of Boynton Canyon first, so breakfast guests at Che Ah Chi watch the walls turn bright red.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the pool deck has little shade outside the cabanas, and the canyon walls look pale orange under a strong sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Tii Gavo canyon terrace, the late sun lights the red rock on one side while the other side goes dark.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests on their private decks see stars above the canyon rim, with a kiva fire going inside.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Boynton Canyon this morning, so the red walls behind the tennis court switch between sun and shadow.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were by the pool this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows moving slowly across the canyon walls.
phrases.partly_golden: Around the fire pit, guests watch the last sun hit the red rock while scattered clouds turn pink above it.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the canyon walls seen from Che Ah Chi look darker brown than their usual red.
phrases.rain: Late at night in Boynton Canyon, rain falls on the casita decks below red rock walls lit by warm window light.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the canyon, so the pool deck is empty and guests watch lightning from inside their suites.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze fills Boynton Canyon today, so the upper red rock walls look faded and soft from the private patios.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare here, but today the ledges of the red rock walls carry white lines visible from every casita deck.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air fills the canyon today, and the few guests walking across the pool deck keep their coats on.
phrases.very_hot: From the private deck, heat-haze shimmers over the red rock walls of Boynton Canyon above the pinyon pines.
phrases.mild_night: Guests on the bar terrace this mild night sit under pendant lights, with cloud over Boynton Canyon and the fire pit glowing.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so from the pool deck the nearest red rock walls are clear but the far canyon rim is not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight a few casita windows show light among the pines, and Boynton Canyon's red rock walls return at sunrise.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the casita windows after dinner at Che Ah Chi, and lit windows of other casitas show below the canyon walls.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Che Ah Chi, the casita window shows low cloud over Boynton Canyon and lit adobe windows among the pines.

phrases.clear_predawn: If you were awake in a guest room now, the lit Skytree would stand against a clear dark sky before sunrise.
phrases.clear_morning: From a room facing Tokyo Station, the brick dome of the historic building sits in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the soaking tub by the floor-to-ceiling window faces a dense skyline under a plain blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches the brick dome of Tokyo Station, seen from the rooms that face it.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the indoor pool tonight, you would see the city lights clearly through the tall windows.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered morning clouds pass over the Tokyo skyline, which guests see from the 28th-floor arrival beside the chandeliers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Tokyo Skytree stands partly in sun and partly in cloud shadow, visible from the guest rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day comes between clouds onto the high-rise towers outside the lounge windows.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey cloud layer sits above the Tokyo skyline today, and the Skytree top may be inside it.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the lounge, and the skyline behind is blurred but still there.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the lounge can watch lightning over the Tokyo skyline today, dry behind the tall glass.
phrases.fog_haze: In haze like this, the Tokyo Skytree fades to a faint outline from the upper floors, and far towers vanish.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the windows of the upper-floor rooms, and the roofs of the skyline below turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Cold clear air like this gives the sharpest view of the Tokyo Skytree from the upper-floor rooms, every tower edge distinct.
phrases.very_hot: Tokyo is very hot today, and the indoor pool with its blue tiles is where guests are spending the afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy but mild night sky, the city lights of the Tokyo skyline show clearly from the dinner tables at Nadaman.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Tokyo Skytree is not visible from the rooms, only the nearer towers.
phrases.late_night: Dinner at Nadaman done, the room window shows the Skytree's thin outline over the city lights after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the room's floor-to-ceiling glass tonight, and the Skytree's thin spire shows through it above the city lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Under tonight's cloud, city lights spread toward the Skytree's spire beyond the guest room window.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is still dark from the suite balconies, and the sky above the horizon is slowly turning grey.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunrise comes straight out of the Atlantic here, so the balconies get full sun before the cooked-to-order breakfast is served.
phrases.clear_midday: From the upper-floor balconies, the wide sandy beach and the Atlantic sit under a cloudless midday sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the sea from behind the hotel, so from the upper-floor suites the water looks flat and pale.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests at the fire pit by the outdoor pool can see stars over the dark Atlantic.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the ocean this morning, and from the floor-to-ceiling windows the horizon still shows clearly.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Past the balcony, a few clouds hang over the sea and the wide sandy beach this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Atlantic turn pink while guests at TNT finish their margaritas.
phrases.overcast: The sky is one grey layer today, and from the suite windows the Atlantic looks the same colour as the sky.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the balconies, so most guests are in the indoor pool or the separate living rooms of their suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were there now, you would watch the lightning over the Atlantic from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the horizon today, so from the balconies the sand is visible but the sea soon disappears into grey.
phrases.snow: Snow on an oceanfront balcony is rare in Virginia Beach, but today the wide beach below the suites is white.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing on the balconies today, but the sky is clear and the Atlantic horizon is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: In this very hot weather, the outdoor pool between the palm trees is busier than the beach seen from the balconies.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night: no moon over the Atlantic, but the fire pit by the outdoor pool is lit.
phrases.reduced_visibility: If you stood on an upper-floor balcony now, you would see the wide sandy beach and near water but not the horizon.
phrases.late_night: Well past midnight, the ocean suites' floor-to-ceiling windows show moonlight on the Atlantic surf.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtains are open in the ocean suites after midnight, and the beachfront lights look blurred through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtains in the ocean suites stay open after midnight, and the Atlantic Avenue lights show under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky over Aoyama is still dark and clear, and Tokyo Tower's lights are visible from a higher room.
phrases.clear_morning: From a higher room, the morning sun shows Tokyo Tower clearly above the treetops of the Meiji Shrine grounds.
phrases.clear_midday: High midday sun lights Tokyo Tower evenly, and the fitness center's wide window shows the full skyline without haze.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights one side of Tokyo Tower, and the suite's floor-to-ceiling windows catch it without any haze.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see Tokyo Tower fully lit from your room window under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over Aoyama this morning, and the treetop canopy below the suite windows is green and bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds cross the sun this afternoon, so Tokyo Tower looks bright one minute and grey the next from the higher rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds turn pink above Tokyo Tower, and the rooftop terrace tables are being set.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Tokyo Tower still stands out from the upper-floor windows, just with less colour than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the suite's floor-to-ceiling glass, and the treetop canopy below looks darker and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the rooftop terrace is empty, and lightning behind Tokyo Tower is best watched from a room window.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of Tokyo Tower today, so the view from the higher rooms ends at the treetops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the treetop canopy below the suite windows, and Tokyo Tower looks pale through the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, but the sky is clear and Tokyo Tower is sharp from the upper rooms.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the rooftop terrace palms stand in full sun, and most guests stay inside behind the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm and cloudy, and the lit palms on the rooftop terrace frame Tokyo's lights with no stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Tokyo Tower is only a faint shape from the upper rooms and the far skyline is missing.
phrases.late_night: Late back from Belcomo, an upper-floor window shows Tokyo Tower's outline over the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner is done, and after midnight rain blurs Tokyo Tower's shape in the window.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the upper-floor windows frame Tokyo Tower's outline under the low cloud, the city lights spread out around it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the twin rooms look out at N Seoul Tower, still lit against a dark and cloudless sky over Namsan.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the Namsan treeline is sharp from the outdoor pool terrace, with the tower above it.
phrases.clear_midday: Around midday, the cabanas on the pool terrace give shade, and N Seoul Tower stands in full sun over the forest.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the low sun colour the Namsan hillside from a twin room window.
phrases.clear_night: From the suite living area, the city skyline and the lit traditional rooftops below are clear under a cloudless sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests at the indoor lap pool swim under the arched glass ceiling while scattered clouds pass over the tree-covered hills.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over N Seoul Tower this afternoon, so the view from most rooms changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: During the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the city skyline turn orange as seen from the high-floor buffet lounge.
phrases.overcast: The sky is overcast today, so from the twin rooms N Seoul Tower stands against flat grey above dark green forest.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Namsan trees outside the spa window, while guests sit in the hot plunge pool inside.
phrases.thunderstorm: With a thunderstorm over Seoul, the outdoor pool terrace is empty, and lightning shows behind N Seoul Tower from the rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Namsan today, and N Seoul Tower is only a faint outline from the pool terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Namsan forest, and from the indoor lap pool the hills behind the glass turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing clear day, the garden is quiet and the Namsan treeline looks very sharp from the rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Seoul today, so most guests on the pool terrace stay in the water or under the cabanas.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and from the suite window the illuminated traditional rooftops and the city skyline are both visible.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the buffet lounge the far city skyline is missing, and only the nearest buildings show.
phrases.late_night: Tonight the twin room's curtain stays open on purpose, and N Seoul Tower's outline on Namsan is the last sight before sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner the twin rooms look out at N Seoul Tower above Namsan, and tonight rain runs down the wide window.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the wide twin-room window shows N Seoul Tower's shape on Namsan and the city lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies over Gran Vía are quiet, and the church steeples show as dark shapes against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight already reaches the ornate facades across the avenue, seen through the curved windows of the exterior rooms.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky over the rooftops is fully blue, and the balcony chairs are in strong direct sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the Belle Époque buildings turn orange from the tenth-floor Jardín de Diana.
phrases.clear_night: Guests on the rooftop terrace have a drink under a clear night sky, the facades of Gran Vía below the glass railings.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Madrid this morning, and the church steeples seen from the balconies are in sun one minute, shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the tenth-floor terrace this afternoon, sun and cloud shadow fall in turns on the old Gran Vía fronts below.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds over the rooftops, a good evening for a cocktail at the Jardín de Diana.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Madrid today, so the Belle Époque buildings outside the curved windows look dull but perfectly clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Gran Vía, the wicker chairs on the balconies are wet, and the ornate facades opposite look darker.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were at a balcony door now, you would see lightning flash over the ornate facades of Gran Vía below.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog or haze covers Madrid today, and the church steeples normally seen from the balcony are only faint outlines.
phrases.snow: Snow in Madrid is rare, but right now it falls on the marble tables of the rooftop terrace and the rooftops beyond.
phrases.very_cold: Guests on the balconies today look down at Gran Vía in hard winter light, their breath showing in the cold.
phrases.very_hot: Madrid is very hot today, and the rattan chairs on the rooftop terrace are too warm to use until the sun drops.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the Jardín de Diana is a comfortable place to sit, even without a sunset to look at.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Madrid today, so the avenue below the terraces is clear but the far rooftops and steeples are not.

phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop terrace, the morning sun comes from behind the lodge and lights the whole valley to the west.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, guests on the timber walkways pass nyala grazing a few feet away.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The suites face west, so this hour puts the low sun straight through the glass and across the N'wanetsi valley.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your suite deck tonight, you would see a clear sky over the valley and no lights below.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the bushveld hills this morning, and the Long Bar frames the valley in changing patches of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the green hills west of the lodge this afternoon, easy to follow from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud in the west means the last sun reaches the suite decks in short bursts rather than one long stretch.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the valley looks dull, but elephant at the N'wanetsi are still easy to spot from the suites.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the N'wanetsi valley, and guests watch it from behind the glass walls of their suites, staying dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the valley means lightning seen from three glass sides of the suite, and timber walkways best avoided.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits in the N'wanetsi valley today, so the far end of the valley fades out while the river below stays clearer.
phrases.snow: If snow ever reached this clifftop, the glass-walled suites would be the driest place to watch it settle on the valley.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare freezing day, the suite decks stay empty and guests watch the valley through the glass instead.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the valley today, and from the rooftop terrace the only movement is animals heading for the river.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night at the riverbank villa, where the water sits at eye level and is heard more than seen.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the far end of the valley is missing from the suites, though the N'wanetsi below is clear.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the three glass walls of a loft suite show the N'wanetsi valley in moonlight.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtains are open in the loft suites tonight, and rain streaks the glass above the N'wanetsi River.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the N'wanetsi valley tonight, and the river below the glass-walled suites holds a faint grey light.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop pool area is empty and the Yoyogi Park canopy is still a dark mass under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From a park-facing room, the glass doors open onto a balcony where the treetops are fully lit by low morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Bright midday sun on the rooftop, and the white umbrellas over the teak loungers are the only shade by the infinity pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light reaches the forest canopy from the side, and from the jacuzzi the Tokyo skyline looks sharp and clear.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the park is dark and quiet below the balcony, and the two wooden chairs face it under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Yoyogi Park this morning, so the green canopy outside the floor-to-ceiling glass changes between bright and dull.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the rooftop pool are getting sun in short stretches this afternoon, with patches of cloud moving over the treetops.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the forest tops orange between clouds, seen from the two wooden chairs on the balcony.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Yoyogi Park canopy looks a darker green from the pool, and the loungers are mostly free.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the treetops across the way, and guests are watching it from inside behind the closed glass doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm nobody uses the rooftop jacuzzi, and the forest canopy is watched from a park-facing room instead.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the park today, so from the infinity pool the nearest treetops are clear but the Tokyo skyline is faint.
phrases.snow: Snow on the Yoyogi Park canopy is rare, and today the balcony railings and the round table have a thin white layer.
phrases.very_cold: From the balcony, frost lies on the black metal railings above the bare treetops of Yoyogi Park.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over Tokyo, so most guests on the rooftop are in the infinity pool rather than on the teak loungers.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the balcony with its two wooden chairs is comfortable without a jacket, the park dark beyond.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited, so the forest canopy is plain to see from the pool but the Tokyo skyline behind it is not.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the park-facing rooms are asleep by now, the curtain left open so the city lights show past the park.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the park-facing rooms after midnight sees rain on the glass doors and Shibuya's lights blurred across the park.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the park-facing rooms after midnight sees the city glow under low cloud beyond Yoyogi Park.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the harbour-view rooms look out on a dark causeway and the moored yachts still without their crews.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lands on the terrace, where guests with wine watch the yachts in the marina below.
phrases.clear_night: From the harbour-view rooms, the Parliament buildings stand lit by thousands of bulbs under a clear night sky.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon tea is under way in the Lobby Lounge, with broken cloud over the causeway and the Parliament buildings outside.

phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Inner Harbour, and from the bar's stained-glass windows only the nearest moored boats can be made out.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Parliament buildings and the yachts, a rare sight for guests looking out from the harbour-view rooms.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold, clear day over the harbour, and the fire pit on the terrace is where guests keep their coats on.
phrases.very_hot: On this very hot day the terrace sofas stay empty, and the moored yachts sit in a harbour with no wind.
phrases.mild_night: Mild and cloudy tonight, guests on the terrace sit by the fire pit facing the lit Parliament buildings across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so the harbour-view rooms show the causeway and nearby yachts but the Parliament buildings are only a faint shape.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has a harbour-view room tonight has turned the room lights off, and the harbour lights on the water fill the window.

phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake after midnight in a harbour-view room sees cloud low over the Inner Harbour and the city lights on the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the river-facing rooms look onto Old Town spires that are still lit against a dark, clear sky.

phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, a corner room shows the Limmat River, the lake and the Alps in one window.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last hours of sun, the whirlpool tub in the suite bathroom faces church spires lit by low evening light.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a river-facing room tonight, you would see the Old Town spires lit up under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over Zurich this morning, so the Alps appear and disappear from rooms on the upper floors.

phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Alps stay hidden, but the city rooftops and the medieval tower remain clear from the room windows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Zurich today, and the restaurant's large windows show wet trees while guests eat beside the wine barrels.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is passing over the city, and guests on the upper floors are watching lightning above the Old Town spires.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Limmat today, and from the river-facing rooms the church spires are only partly visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Zurich, and the Old Town rooftops seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside today, and in this clear air the snow-capped Alps stand out sharply beyond the lake.
phrases.very_hot: From the river-facing rooms, heat-haze hangs over the Old Town rooftops and spires above the Limmat River.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night covers Zurich, and the lit Old Town spires are the clearest thing in the river-facing room windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Alps and the far end of the lake cannot be seen, even from the upper floors.
phrases.late_night: Were you up past one in a river-facing room, you might go on watching the Old Town spires over the lit Limmat.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in a river-facing room, you would see the Old Town spires through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: A last drink at a river-facing window now, and you would see the Old Town spires and city lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the skyline outside the floor-to-ceiling windows is mostly dark towers with a few lit offices.
