phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun from the west hits the curved suite windows, and the hills behind the skyline turn warm yellow.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a high-floor suite tonight, you would see the Bay Bridge lights and lit streets below, no cloud above.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the skyline this morning, and the towers outside the Bay View suites go from bright to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooms on the upper floors, cloud shadows cross the city below and the taller buildings this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the skyline between the clouds, seen through the curved windows of the top suites.

phrases.snow: Snow is rare here, but if it fell today, you would watch it from a warm room with a full-height window.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold clear day, the skyline looks sharp from the rooms, and nobody is sitting out on the Terrace suites.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot weather is unusual for San Francisco, and today most guests stay behind the glass instead of walking to Union Square.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the lit towers still show through the suite windows, even the one beside the marble bathroom vanity.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Bay View suites the nearby towers are clear but the bay and bridge are not.
phrases.late_night: A Bay View suite is dark after midnight, and the skyline lights in its window are the only light left.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Bistro 888, the high-floor suites show the wet skyline lights through rain on the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After a late dinner at Bistro 888, the floor-to-ceiling windows upstairs show the skyline lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: If you were on the panoramic terrace before sunrise, you would see the dome of St. Peter's dark against a clear sky.

phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over St. Peter's this morning, and the tables on the rooftop terrace are set, mostly in sun.

phrases.very_cold: Very cold air keeps guests off the terrace, but the view of St. Peter's from Mirabelle's windows is exceptionally sharp.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the terrace jacuzzi is the most sensible place from which to look at the treetops.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the lit dome of St. Peter's rises over Rome's rooftops beyond the panoramic terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today: the nearby rooftops and umbrella pines are clear from the terrace, but St. Peter's dome is barely a shape.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water by the bed, and St Peter's dome is in view against Rome's lit rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight rain runs down the windows of Mirabelle, and the dome of St Peter's shows through it over the wet rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud passes over Rome after midnight, and from the Mirabelle windows St Peter's dome is an outline above the lit rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: The rooftop loungers are still empty in the dark, and La Giralda already stands out against a clear predawn sky.

phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Seville, and the only rooftop loungers in use are the ones under the fringed umbrellas.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy in Santa Cruz, and the lit Cathedral is still clear from the rooftop terrace.

phrases.very_cold: The air is close to freezing on the balconies, so most guests look at Ponte Vecchio through the tall windows instead.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the Arno today, and the Iridium Suites Spa by Clarins is a cooler option than the balconies.

phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in a river suite, Ponte Vecchio would be on your left, the Arno bright under cloud.

phrases.very_cold: Very cold air covers Budapest today, and the Basilica spires look sharp and clear from the seventh floor.

phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, dinner at SALT ends with a look at the Budapest skyline from the rooftop.

phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night keeps guests on the lakeside terrace after dinner at L'ARIA, looking at the lit towns across the water.

phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and the rooftop pool has no swimmers, only wet lounge chairs.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind Reunion Tower during this storm, and guests watch it from the suite windows rather than the rooftop pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the upper part of Reunion Tower today; from the suites, only its lower section shows clearly.
phrases.snow: Snow in Dallas is rare, but today it falls past the guest room windows while the downtown towers turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Frost edges the floor-to-ceiling glass of the king rooms, with Reunion Tower sharp in hard winter daylight.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day like this, most guests at the rooftop pool stay in the water rather than on the loungers.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Dallas, and the poolside bar on the roof has the lit skyline behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is reduced today, so Reunion Tower shows from the rooms but more distant buildings are only faint outlines.
phrases.late_night: Were you in a king room tonight, you might leave the curtain open and fall asleep facing Reunion Tower's round top.
phrases.wet_evening: If you took a last drink up by the rooftop pool tonight, rain would blur Reunion Tower's round top across downtown.
phrases.grey_evening: If you poured a last drink in a king room, you would see Reunion Tower's ball under cloud, the city lit around it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Empire State Building stands dark and sharp outside the room windows, with the Midtown skyline around it.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were there this morning, you would see the Empire State Building in full sun from your bed.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, every window of the Empire State Building is visible from the rooms, with no haze.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights one side of the Empire State Building, and the glass-enclosed Strand Rooftop Bar faces it directly.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Empire State Building is lit up, and guests at the rooftop bar stools face it with their cocktails.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass behind the Empire State Building this morning, seen from the rooms with direct views.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over Midtown this afternoon, so the Empire State Building moves in and out of shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Midtown skyline turn orange, and the rooftop bar's candles are already lit.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Midtown today, and the top of the Empire State Building is still clearly visible from the rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the Strand Rooftop Bar, and the Empire State Building looks darker and wet through it.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests at the glass-enclosed rooftop bar can watch lightning over the Midtown skyline without getting wet.
phrases.fog_haze: On a foggy day the top floors of the Empire State Building disappear, and the rooms show only its lower part.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the room windows, and the Empire State Building stands behind the falling flakes, greyer than usual.
phrases.very_cold: Today is very cold and clear, and the Empire State Building shows every detail from the room windows.
phrases.very_hot: Midtown is very hot today, and the Empire State Building shimmers slightly in the heat when seen from the rooms.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the Empire State Building is still lit, and the rooftop bar's wood stools are mostly taken.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Midtown today, so the Empire State Building is a pale shape and the far skyline is not visible.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Empire State rooms have turned everything off, leaving only Midtown's lights and the tower's tall shape in the window.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a room facing the Empire State Building tonight sees its spire through rain on the window, the Midtown lights blurred.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests awake after midnight in the Empire State rooms see Midtown lights under low cloud, the tower's spire inside it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lounge windows show Windermere as a flat grey surface, with the far shore still dark.
phrases.clear_morning: From a double room's sash window, the morning sun lights the distant hills and the calm water below.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, lunch is served on the terrace under grey umbrellas, with the striped lawn and the lake in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a cedar hot tub now, you would see the low sun turning the far shore orange.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the Lakeside Suites can see stars over Windermere and very few lights on the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the tree-lined hills this morning, and the gazebo on the lawn is sometimes in sun, sometimes in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, from the sash windows of the lounge, cloud shadows cross Windermere and the hills on the far shore.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the far shore turn orange, seen from the Lake Edge Restaurant.
phrases.overcast: Guests at the Lake Edge Restaurant tables this afternoon look down Windermere under a grey sky to the far shore.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the striped lawn and the lake today, while diners at the Lake Edge Restaurant watch it through the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the terrace under the grey umbrellas is empty and lightning is visible over the hills from the lounge.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Windermere today, so from the double rooms the far shore and the distant hills are hidden.
phrases.snow: From a Lakeside Suite, the lawn and gazebo are white with snow, and steam rises from the cedar hot tub.
phrases.very_cold: The air is close to freezing today, and the lawn below the sash windows is white with frost down to the water.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the shade under the terrace umbrellas is the most wanted place for lunch beside the lake.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and guests in the Lakeside Suites sit in the hot tubs with the lake dark before them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Lake Edge Restaurant the lawn and near water show, but not the far shore.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has a lake-view room tonight is likely asleep, and at dawn the sash window will show Windermere to the south.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests awake in the lake-view rooms after midnight can watch the rain run down the sash windows facing Windermere.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the Lakeside Suites after midnight can watch low cloud move slowly over Windermere from their window.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Makati skyline is still mostly dark from the private balconies, with only a few office lights on.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight reaches the outdoor pool early, and the lounge chairs between the palm trees are already in use.
phrases.clear_midday: From a balcony room at noon, the Makati towers stand sharp against a clean blue sky, with no haze.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the glass towers across from Greenbelt, and guests on their balconies watch the skyline turn orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the Makati skyline lit up through a floor-to-ceiling window, under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Makati this morning, and the tree canopy below the guest room windows moves between shade and sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the outdoor pool are getting a mix of sun and cloud this afternoon, which keeps the lounge chairs comfortable.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the Makati skyline catch orange light, visible from the suite living area window.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Makati today, so the skyline from the balconies looks dull but is fully visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Makati towers across from Greenbelt, and the palm trees around the pool are dripping.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Makati skyline is best watched from inside a room, behind the floor-to-ceiling glass, rather than from a balcony.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Makati today, and the farther towers seen from the balconies are only faint grey shapes.
phrases.snow: If snow ever reached Manila, guests on the private balconies would be photographing white flakes over the Makati skyline in disbelief.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air in Makati is almost unheard of, so today guests are choosing the sauna over the outdoor pool.
phrases.very_hot: From the private balconies, heat-haze blurs the Makati skyline above Greenbelt through the middle of the day.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night like this, the skyline lights across from Glorietta show clearly from a private balcony.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Makati today; the Greenbelt side is clear from the balconies, but the farther towers are not.
phrases.late_night: If you were falling asleep in a skyline room tonight, you might leave the curtain open to keep the Makati lights in view.
phrases.wet_evening: If you took a last drink from Bar Rouge to your room tonight, you would watch rain blur the Makati skyline lights.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink at Bar Rouge now, you would see the Makati skyline lit under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the terrace of Béatrice is quiet and the Hagia Sophia is still a dark shape across the Golden Horn.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the rooftop comes with Turkish tea, mezze and a clear line of minarets across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the Golden Horn and the Blue Mosque stands out sharply from the Béatrice terrace.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits Hagia Sophia's domes, and guests on the rooftop have the best seats in the fifty-room hotel.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the terrace tonight, you would see Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque lit up across the Golden Horn.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Istanbul this morning, so the minarets beyond the breakfast tables move in and out of sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Through the tall windows of the dining room, the mosque skyline shows under a sky half blue, half cloud.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky behind Galata Tower while diners settle in at Béatrice.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque are still clear from the rooftop, just without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop terrace, so guests take the dining room, where tall windows frame the mosque skyline in the rain.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Golden Horn is visible from the dining room windows, and the terrace is empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the far shore of the Golden Horn today, and Hagia Sophia is only a faint outline from the rooftop.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the Béatrice terrace tables, and the domes of the Blue Mosque turn white across the water.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air on the rooftop today, so most guests look at the Blue Mosque from the dining room windows.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the rooftop terrace is best after the sun drops, though Hagia Sophia is clear all day.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night keeps the terrace open, and Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque are lit under the low cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Golden Horn is visible from the rooftop, but Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque are not clear.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner at Béatrice, city lights across the water outline Hagia Sophia's domes.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtain open after midnight, rain blurs the city lights around the Blue Mosque's minarets.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains stay back at bedtime, shore lights under low cloud around Hagia Sophia's domes across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: From a King Corner room before sunrise, the Bangkok skyline is still dark except for a few lit office windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Pathum Wan, and the early swimmers in the 40-metre saltwater pool have the whole skyline to themselves.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the 9th-floor pool is in full sun, and the skyline stands sharp above the water with no haze.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun comes straight through the suite glass, and guests pull curtains halfway while the towers outside turn orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Penthouse Bar and Grill tonight, you would see the whole lit skyline under a clear sky.

phrases.partly_golden: Last hour of sun, and broken cloud over Pathum Wan turns the 180-degree view from the corner rooms pink and grey.
phrases.overcast: A grey ceiling covers Bangkok today; the towers are still clear from the suites, just without shadows or shine.
phrases.rain: Rain over Bangkok: water streaks the tall windows of the King Corner rooms, and the nearby towers look softer.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over Bangkok, and from the Penthouse Bar and Grill lightning shows the whole skyline for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the city, so the far towers fade from the pool view while the nearest buildings stay clear.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Bangkok, a very rare sight, and guests in the corner rooms watch flakes pass the tall windows.
phrases.very_cold: Unusually cold for Bangkok, so the 9th-floor saltwater pool is nearly empty and the skyline is very clear above it.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside at noon; the courtyard plants give shade, and most guests are in the saltwater pool rather than beside it.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, and the soaking tub in the suite faces a lit skyline under a low sky with no stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Short visibility today, so from the King Corner rooms the nearby towers are clear but the far side of Bangkok is not.
phrases.late_night: Were you falling asleep in a King Corner room tonight, you might leave the curtain open to the lit city skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were finishing a drink at the Penthouse Bar and Grill tonight, the city lights would show blurred through wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were at the Penthouse Bar and Grill for a last drink, you would see the city lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, from the rooftop terrace, the domes of Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque stand dark against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the rooftop terrace comes with Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque and the Sea of Marmara in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the Sea of Marmara shows bright blue from the Superior room windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the terrace now, you would see the sky turning orange behind the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Blue Mosque is lit, and guests at the candlelit terrace tables look at it under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds pass over Sultanahmet this morning, so sunlight on the Hagia Sophia dome comes and goes, seen from the terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun share the afternoon sky above the Sea of Marmara, visible from the Superior room windows.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the Blue Mosque take an orange colour, seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Sultanahmet, and from the room windows the Sea of Marmara looks grey too, but both domes stay visible.

phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Sea of Marmara is heard from the Superior rooms, and lightning sometimes shows the water for a second.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, and from the terrace Hagia Sophia is near enough to see, but the Marmara is not.
phrases.snow: Snow on the dome of the Blue Mosque is rare, and today breakfast guests on the rooftop terrace can see it.
phrases.very_cold: The air on the rooftop terrace is close to freezing, so the view of Hagia Sophia is enjoyed quickly, then from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot over Sultanahmet, so the rooftop terrace, with seats for 400, fills mainly after sunset.
phrases.mild_night: A warm night with clouds over Istanbul, and the lit Blue Mosque still shows clearly from the candlelit dinner tables.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so from the terrace the Blue Mosque is clear but the far side of the Marmara is not visible.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner upstairs, guests sleep now, Blue Mosque minarets above the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a Superior room tonight can watch evening rain on the window, city lights and the Blue Mosque's minarets beyond.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in Superior rooms can see Hagia Sophia's domes under low cloud tonight, city lights spread toward the Marmara.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Snoopy Rock is a dark shape above Oak Creek, and the infinity pool is still empty.

phrases.clear_midday: If you were on a balcony now, you would see Snoopy Rock sharp and red under the clear midday sky.

phrases.snow: Snow on Snoopy Rock is rare, so guests with red rock balconies have an unusual white and red view.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air keeps the pool deck quiet, and the red rocks look sharp under a clear Sedona sky.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot Sedona day, the infinity pool and the shade of the cabanas are where the guests stay.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the air is mild, and the SaltRock patio is still a good place to sit.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Snoopy Rock across Oak Creek is blurred and the farther formations do not show at all.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the red-rock rooms have turned off their lights, and the lawn fire pit is the one glow left inside.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in a red-rock room after midnight sees rain on the window, Snoopy Rock out there somewhere until first light.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a rock-facing room after midnight has cloud over Snoopy Rock and a few lit windows across the courtyard.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the infinity pool now, you would see the port and the CBD towers in low orange sunlight.

phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the pendant lights in the bar lounge are on, and the city view fills the windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from the corner rooms the nearby shophouses show clearly but the far CBD towers look faint.
phrases.late_night: Were you in a corner room tonight, you might leave the curtain open and fall asleep facing the lit financial district towers.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink by the window, you would see the financial district lights blurred by rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in an east-facing room now, you would see the financial district lights under low cloud.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the city today, so the BBVA tower beyond the terrace is a faint outline rather than a landmark.
phrases.snow: Snow in Barcelona is rare, but today a thin layer sits on the rooftop rattan chairs and the palm plants.
phrases.very_cold: With the air close to freezing, the rooftop is almost empty, and the Eixample view belongs to anyone in a thick coat.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day the shade sails over the Twenty One terrace are the most popular spot in the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night: the string lights are on, and the avenues below the terrace glow even without stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the far skyline from the rooftop is unclear, though the nearby Eixample streets are fine.
phrases.late_night: If you were awake after midnight here, the lit Eixample avenues would hold your eye.
phrases.wet_evening: If you looked out from the Twenty One rooftop now, you would see the Eixample avenues lit and wet through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were finishing a last drink by your room window now, you would see the Eixample avenues lit under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise under a clear sky, guests on floors six to twenty-two watch Coal Harbour's marina lights on the water.

phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open before bed in a Signature Harbour Mountain View room, rain blurs the marina lights on Coal Harbour.

phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Guangzhou, but a few flakes pass the 74th-floor glass, and swimmers in the indoor pool see them fall.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold outside today, and the clear air makes both banks of the Pearl River easy to see from a high suite.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, guests swim in the 74th-floor indoor pool with Canton Tower bright in the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Mild and cloudy tonight, and the lit Canton Tower is the main thing to see from Tian Bar on the 99th floor.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Canton Tower shows from the pool but the far bank of the Pearl River does not.
phrases.late_night: Back from Yu Yue Heen, guests see Canton Tower's slim outline beside the Pearl River.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Pearl River Suites see Canton Tower through rain on the glass tonight.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests awake in the Pearl River Suites can watch the city lights under low cloud, Canton Tower's slim shape among them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, a guest in a bridge-view room sees the Brooklyn Bridge as a dark outline over the East River.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the rooftop pool, and the Lower Manhattan skyline across the East River is sharp in clear air.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the Brooklyn Bridge and the Lower Manhattan skyline stand sharp across the East River from the rooftop pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun sits low behind the Lower Manhattan skyline, and guests in the infinity pool watch the towers turn orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop terrace tonight, you would see Lower Manhattan's lit windows and the Brooklyn Bridge clearly.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Manhattan, and from the teak seats on the rooftop terrace the skyline is partly in sun, partly in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From a skyline-view room this afternoon, cloud shadows cross the East River and One World Trade Center is in sunlight between clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun puts orange light on the clouds over Manhattan, watched from the rooftop bar with a drink.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Statue of Liberty is still visible from the rooftop, small and far across a dull East River.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in bed can still make out the Brooklyn Bridge through the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Lower Manhattan is visible from the guest rooms, and nobody is in the rooftop pool while the storm passes.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the East River, so from the rooftop terrace the Brooklyn Bridge is only partly visible and Manhattan is hidden.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftop terrace and the teak seats, and the Brooklyn Bridge looks white-topped from the room windows.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air keeps everyone off the rooftop terrace, but the skyline-view rooms give the same clear view of Manhattan behind glass.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the rooftop infinity pool is the busiest spot, and nobody is using the teak seats.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests stay late on the rooftop terrace, with the Brooklyn Bridge lit up over the East River.
phrases.reduced_visibility: With low visibility, the Brooklyn Bridge is clear from the rooftop, Manhattan is faint, and the Statue of Liberty cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: Well after midnight, a bridge-facing room's window frames the Brooklyn Bridge against the lit windows of Lower Manhattan across the East River.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtain is open after midnight, and through rain on the floor-to-ceiling window the Lower Manhattan lights blur across the East River.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain is open after midnight in a bridge-view room, and the lit city shows under low cloud beyond the Brooklyn Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the tall windows show Lake Geneva still dark, with the Alps only an outline on the far side.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun on the lake, and guests in the Prestige Junior Lake View suites see the Jet d'Eau without leaving bed.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop terrace has full sun on its orange loungers, with Geneva's rooftops and the Alps sharp behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Jet d'Eau from the side, and from the balconies the left-bank buildings turn a warm colour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a lake view suite tonight, you would see the left-bank skyline under a clear sky over Lake Geneva.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Lake Geneva, and from the desk by the tall windows the Old Town is in and out of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Jet d'Eau stands against a half-cloudy sky, easy to watch from the wrought iron balconies.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud gives Lake Geneva patches of light, visible from the suites' tall windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Jet d'Eau is still white against the lake, though the Alps are hidden behind the cloud.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the lake and the docked boats below the façade, and guests are staying in with their private spas.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, guests watch the lightning over Lake Geneva from behind the suites' tall windows, which is the comfortable option.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Lake Geneva, so from the balconies the Jet d'Eau is a pale shape and the Alps cannot be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Quai du Mont-Blanc, while the Gstaad cable cars on the rooftop keep diners warm with lake views.
phrases.very_cold: Frost sits on the wrought iron balcony railing above Lake Geneva and the Jet d'Eau in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot over Lake Geneva today, and the spray of the Jet d'Eau is the only cool-looking thing from the balconies.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night under cloud, and from the wrought iron balconies the docked boats sit quietly on the dark lake.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from the suites the Jet d'Eau and the waterfront buildings can be seen, but the Alps cannot.
phrases.late_night: Left-bank lights reflect in Lake Geneva after midnight, and at dawn the Prestige Junior Lake View suites frame the Jet d'Eau again.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the Prestige Junior Lake View suites, and the left-bank lights blur on the lake after midnight.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Lake Geneva after midnight, and the left-bank lights show on the water from the Prestige Junior Lake View suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop pool is empty and the lights of Century City are still on to the east.
phrases.clear_morning: From a corner suite balcony on level three, the Santa Monica Mountains show clearly in the west this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun covers the rooftop, where guests on yellow loungers under scalloped umbrellas face the downtown skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the sun dropping toward the Santa Monica Mountains from The Rooftop by JG.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the city lights of Century City are visible from the soaking tub through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the Santa Monica Mountains this morning, seen from the balconies of the Superior Corner Junior Suites.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over Century City this afternoon while swimmers in the saltwater pool twelve floors up watch them move east.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the palm trees below the terrace, with broken cloud over the hills behind them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the downtown skyline is still visible from the rooftop pool, only with much less contrast.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop today, so The Rooftop by JG is quiet and the terrace fire tables are off.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Los Angeles is rare, and today guests watch it from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows rather than the rooftop.
phrases.fog_haze: Guests at the rooftop pool today look west through haze that hides the Santa Monica Mountains behind the nearby palm trees.
phrases.snow: Snow in Beverly Hills is almost unheard of, so if it fell today, guests would be photographing it from the balconies.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold for Los Angeles today, so the terrace fire table is lit and the rooftop pool is mostly empty.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the scalloped umbrellas by the rooftop pool are the busiest spot, with the downtown skyline in clear view.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, and the lit boulevard stretching away from the terrace is the main thing to look at.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today: Century City is clear from the rooftop, but the Santa Monica Mountains to the west are not showing.
phrases.late_night: Past midnight, the Wilshire Boulevard lights lead east toward Century City, a good reason to put off sleep at a corner-suite window.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight the curtains are open in a corner suite, and Century City's lights blur through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, with the curtain left open, the lights of Century City show to the east under a hazy sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Adriatic outside the balcony glass doors is still dark, and the rooftop pool deck is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at Aura this morning happens behind tall glass, with the open Adriatic directly beyond the plates.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the heated infinity pool and the Adriatic beyond its glass rim show the same blue, with no visible join.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the late sun, guests on the wooden deck look out from the rooftop at the coastal town and the calm sea.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your balcony tonight, you would see a clear sky over a dark Adriatic and the coastal town.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds and sun take turns over the sea this morning, and breakfast on the balcony comes with both versions of the Adriatic.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Down at Mora Mora, the bistrò at the waterline of San Foca, fresh fish is served under a sky of broken cloud.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds over the Adriatic, seen from the rooftop pool and its glass edge.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the whole sky today, and the Adriatic looks flat and pale through the tall glass of the rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the two rooftop pools and on the waterfall outside Aura's windows, so breakfast is behind glass today.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is moving over the Adriatic, and guests watch the lightning from their balconies rather than from the rooftop deck.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the sea today, so the Balkan peaks are not visible and the horizon stops much closer than usual.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the rooftop deck around the heated infinity pool, with a grey Adriatic flat beyond San Foca.
phrases.very_cold: On a cold clear day the air is sharp on the rooftop deck, and the Balkan ridge may show across the Adriatic.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the infinity pool is the useful place to be, with the Adriatic right past the glass rim.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night over San Foca, and the rooftop pool lights are on while the sea stays dark beyond the deck.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today: the Balkan peaks and far horizon are missing, though the rocky coast below the balconies is clear.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the shore lights of San Foca show beyond the glass doors, and at dawn the Adriatic fills the same frame.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtains open after midnight, rain runs down the glass doors and the lights of San Foca blur along the Adriatic shore.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the Adriatic after midnight, so only the lights of San Foca show along the shore through the rooms' glass doors.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the baroque church façade outside the guest room windows is still only a grey shape against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: This morning the Vittoriano stands out sharply from NOTOS Rooftop, and the old Roman roofs stay clear to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun sits straight over the rooftop terrace, and the potted citrus tree gives the only shade near the sofas.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun colours the church domes visible from the terrace orange, and the Montecitorio bell tower is lit from the side.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop tonight, you would see the Vittoriano against a sky with no clouds at all.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Roman church domes this morning, seen from the wood-framed seats on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from NOTOS this afternoon, the old roofs of central Rome go bright and dull in turn as clouds cross the sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Vittoriano are pink at the edges when seen from the fifth-floor rooftop.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the baroque church façade outside the guest rooms shows little shadow, and the dome colours look darker.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the potted herbs of the rooftop terrace, and guests are inside, some in the spa's Roman bathing circuit.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Roman rooftops is visible from the guest room windows, and the rooftop terrace is empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Rome today softens the Vittoriano from the rooftop, and the nearer church domes stay clearer than the far rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow on the rooftops of Rome is rare, and from the guest room windows the church façade carries a thin white line.
phrases.very_cold: From the NOTOS Rooftop on the fifth floor, hard winter light falls across the Vittoriano and the Roman rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the rooftop terrace, and the ornamental grasses and sofa seating are in full sun until late afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, guests are still at the dining tables on the terrace, and no stars show above the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from NOTOS the Vittoriano is clear but the rooftops toward the horizon are not.
phrases.late_night: Sleep comes easily in the guest rooms after midnight; the city lights fill the window, and the church façade appears at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the guest-room windows this evening, and the lights of the historic centre blur on the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers Rome after midnight, and the guest-room windows show the baroque church façade against the glow of the lit rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Kyoto Tower stands pale and unlit in the right-side window of the Tower View suites.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Kanra Junior Suite see the white shaft of Kyoto Tower sharp against a clear blue morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is on the tatami, and from the shoji window Kyoto Tower looks plainly white, no lights yet.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the outdoor bath now, you would watch the low sun colour Kyoto Tower before its lights come on.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the red-lit spire of Kyoto Tower fills the window of the Tower View suites against a clear dark sky.
phrases.partly_morning: From the entrance corridor this morning, Kyoto Tower shows between the noren panels under a sky of broken cloud.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds cross Kyoto this afternoon, and from the suite window the top of the tower is sometimes in sun, sometimes in shade.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds turn orange behind Kyoto Tower, seen from the bamboo-screened balcony.
phrases.overcast: If you were in the Kanra Junior Suite now, you would see Kyoto Tower's white shaft under a flat grey daytime sky.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Shimogyo, and guests watch the wet shaft of Kyoto Tower from the dry side of the shoji window.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Kyoto, and from the Kanra Junior Suite each flash shows the tower clearly for a moment.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers Kyoto today, and Kyoto Tower is a pale outline rather than a sharp shape from the Tower View suites.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Kyoto, and from the heated room guests watch flakes pass in front of the white tower.
phrases.very_cold: On a day close to freezing, the outdoor hinoki tub is still in use, with Kyoto Tower sharp in the cold air.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air covers Kyoto, and from the suite window Kyoto Tower shows white against a very bright sky.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and guests in the balcony tub look at the red-lit spire of Kyoto Tower under low cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Kyoto today, so the tower is faint from the suites and Higashi Honganji Temple is hard to see.
phrases.late_night: In the Kanra Junior Suite the curtain is left open tonight, and Kyoto Tower's white shaft shows in the right-side window at bedtime.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Hanaroku, rain runs down the window of the Kanra Junior Suite, and Kyoto Tower's white shaft shows through it.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Hanaroku, the Kanra Junior Suite window shows Kyoto Tower's white shaft above the low lit skyline, cloud behind it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the harbor lights are still on below the Executive Waterfront View rooms, and Table Mountain is a dark shape.
phrases.clear_morning: From the 14th to 18th floors, Table Mountain and Lion's Head stand sharp against a clear blue morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Bright midday light fills the suite lounges, and Lion's Head shows every rock through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last hours of sun, the indoor lap pool looks out on a harbor lit from the west.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the 19th-floor Club Lounge has a clear view of the lit waterfront and the dark outline of Table Mountain.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit on Table Mountain this morning, while the V&A Waterfront below the glass facade is in full sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds are moving over Lion's Head this afternoon, so the light in the suite living rooms changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken clouds let patches of late sun reach Lion's Head, seen from the Club Lounge on the 19th floor.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Table Mountain looks flat and close from the upper rooms, and the harbor water is grey too.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and guests in the indoor lap pool watch the wet harbor through it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Atlantic is visible from the harbor-facing lounge, and Table Mountain disappears each time the rain thickens.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of Table Mountain today, so the Executive Waterfront View rooms mainly show the near end of the harbor.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Cape Town, but today the top of Table Mountain has a white edge seen from the upper floors.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold outside today, but the air is clear and Lion's Head is sharp from the suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: The city is very hot this afternoon, and the indoor lap pool with its view of the harbor is where guests are.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the lit V&A Waterfront is the main thing to see from the 19th-floor Club Lounge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the far view is short: from the Executive Waterfront View rooms the harbor is clear, but Table Mountain is faint.
phrases.late_night: If you came back from the Club Lounge after midnight, you would see the Waterfront lights under Lion's Head.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in the 19th-floor Club Lounge, rain on the glass would blur the Waterfront lights below.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in the Club Lounge after midnight, you would see the Waterfront lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Under a clear sky before sunrise, the lights of Oia's cliffside village stand out over the caldera from the terraces.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast of Greek yogurt and local honey is served while the morning light reaches the volcano across the caldera.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the infinity pool and the Aegean show the same deep blue, and most lounge chairs are taken.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were at the infinity pool now, you would watch the sun drop toward Thirassia island across the caldera.
phrases.clear_night: From the terrace sunloungers, the lit houses of Oia stand out on the cliff and the caldera water lies calm and black.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the caldera this morning, and their shadows cross the volcanic islands seen from the private pools.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Scattered clouds pass above the Aegean this afternoon, so the infinity pool is sometimes in sun and sometimes in shade.
phrases.partly_golden: Near sunset, a few clouds sit over the caldera, seen from the pool on the Oia cliff.
phrases.overcast: The sky is fully grey over Santorini today, and the caldera below the terraces looks grey-green instead of deep blue.
phrases.rain: Wet terraces today: guests inside the cliff houses watch the rain come down over the caldera.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the thunderstorm, lightning flashes over the volcanic islands and the restaurant's arched white walls are a good place to be.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the caldera today, so Thirassia island is only a faint outline from the edge of the infinity pool.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Santorini, but today a few flakes fall on the terraces while the caldera stays grey below.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air sits over the caldera today, the infinity pool is empty, and the volcanic islands look sharp and clear.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, guests stay in the private pools, and the Aegean below the cliff shows almost no waves.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Oia: the lit village is visible from the terrace, but no stars show above the caldera.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today Thirassia island cannot be seen from the infinity pool, and the far side of the caldera is also hidden.
phrases.late_night: Inside the cliff house every light is off after midnight, and Oia's village lights along the caldera fill the window.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open after midnight, rain streaks the window and Oia's village lights blur over the caldera water.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, cloud covers the caldera, and the open curtains of the cliff houses frame the lights of Oia village.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the CN Tower is still lit and Lake Ontario is a dark flat shape from the Club Level windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun is on Lake Ontario, and the CN Tower stands sharp against blue sky from a south-facing king room.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the saltwater pool is bright with sun, and swimmers can see the CN Tower and Rogers Centre dome.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun comes in low through the Simcoe Suite windows, lighting Lake Ontario one way and the northern city the other.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the CN Tower is lit in colour, seen from a south-facing room, with Lake Ontario dark below it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Lake Ontario this morning, and guests at the café have sun and shade in turns on the tree-lined terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the CN Tower goes in and out of cloud shadow, easy to follow from the Club Level lounge windows.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over Lake Ontario turns orange, seen from a king room on the south side.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Toronto today, so the lake looks flat and grey too through the suite's floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass of the saltwater pool room, and the CN Tower stands blurred behind the wet windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, lightning over Lake Ontario shows from the upper rooms, and TOCA is a good place to wait it out.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog today hides most of the CN Tower, so the Spa My Blend pool is mainly about the saltwater, not the view.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Lake Ontario, and from a king room the CN Tower fades to a grey outline behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the air over Toronto is sharp, and the lake view from Club Level reaches far south.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside today, which makes the indoor saltwater pool with its CN Tower view the sensible place to be.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Toronto, with the CN Tower lit in colour and the lake dark, seen from a Simcoe Suite.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the king rooms the far shore of Lake Ontario is not visible, only the near water.
phrases.late_night: Were you up late in a Simcoe Suite, you could watch the CN Tower over the lit city.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in a Club Level room tonight, you would see the CN Tower through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Over a last drink on Club Level tonight, you would see the CN Tower's top in low cloud above the lit lakeshore.

phrases.clear_predawn: If you were on an upper-floor balcony before sunrise, you would see the Taurus ridge clear against a sky turning light.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun is on the Taurus ridge, and from a sea-view room the palm gardens and calm Mediterranean are clear.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Mediterranean is turquoise under a cloudless sky, and guests move between the beach cabins and the seven pools.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun colours the wooden beach cabins and the Turkish flag on the private beach, with the sea flat behind them.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would sit in the hanging egg chair on a balcony with stars above the dark sea.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds hang above the Taurus ridge this morning, while the pool gardens and palms are in full sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Scattered clouds move over the Montgomerie golf course this afternoon, so the fairways get sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds over the sea, and the beach cabins throw long shadows on the sand.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Mediterranean looks grey too, but from the bathroom tub the view of the coast is complete.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the pool gardens and the golf course, and guests watch it from the balconies or move to the spa.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm sits over the sea now, and from a sea-view room lightning is visible between the water and the Taurus ridge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Taurus ridge today, so the balconies show only the pool gardens, the palms and a pale, nearby sea.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Belek, but today flakes fall on the palm gardens and the balconies while the pools stay empty.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day the Taurus ridge is sharp from the sea-view rooms, and the beach cabins stand empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over the golf course means most guests are in one of the seven pools or under the palms.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night the pool gardens are lit below the balconies, and the sea is a dark line beyond them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Taurus ridge cannot be seen from the sea-view rooms, only the pool gardens and nearby sea.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water, and the window of a sea-view room shows the pool lights and the Mediterranean.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the windows of the beachfront suites, and the pool lights look soft through the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, a beachfront suite window shows the pool garden lamps under a cloudy sky over the Mediterranean.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before sunrise, the executive-floor windows show a dark Osaka skyline with some lights still on.
phrases.clear_morning: In the 25th-floor lounge, breakfast guests get the sunrise over the Osaka skyline through floor-to-ceiling windows, with no cloud in the way.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the corner suite windows show Osaka's towers in full daylight, sharp and easy to count.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the west sides of the skyline towers, seen from the high-floor bar's wide windows.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the soaking tub tonight, you would see the lit city skyline through the bathroom window.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Osaka this morning, and the 25th-floor lounge breakfast still comes with most of the sunrise.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the city towers this afternoon, visible from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the corner rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: From the lounge bar, the last hour of sun colours the clouds above the Osaka skyline before the city lights come on.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Osaka today, so the skyline from the executive floors is flat and colourless but still fully there.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the high-floor lounge, and the city towers look blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the curved sofas of the upper-floor lounge are a dry place to watch lightning over the Osaka skyline.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Osaka today means the nearer towers show clearly from the 24th floor while the far skyline fades out.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the corner room windows, a rare sight in Osaka, and the city towers are turning white on top.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, clear day, the Osaka skyline is unusually sharp from the executive floors, best seen from behind the glass.
phrases.very_hot: The air over Osaka is very hot today, and the city towers waver slightly through the lounge bar windows.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy in Osaka, and the lit skyline from the corner suite stays clear below the cloud base.

phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has the corner suite after midnight can watch the Osaka towers glow under low cloud before falling asleep.

phrases.grey_evening: Haze covers downtown after midnight, and the lit windows of the office towers fill the view from the 30th-floor Astor suites.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the rooftop terrace have lunch at the shaded tables while clouds move slowly over the twin Torres Olímpiques.

phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the safest view of lightning over the Gothic Quarter is from the large room windows, not the rooftop.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Sagrada Familia and the sea today, and only the nearest Gothic Quarter rooftops show from the terrace.

phrases.grey_evening: If you took a last drink up to your room tonight, you would see low cloud over the lit Gothic Quarter rooftops.

phrases.snow: Snow on the beach is unusual in Brighton, and today the steam room has more users than the ironwork balconies.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold outside but clear, so the West Pier ruins stand out sharply from the balcony rooms, doors firmly closed.
phrases.very_hot: From the sea-view balconies, heat-haze blurs the West Pier ruins and the beach below in the strong midday heat.

phrases.grey_evening: If you took a last drink to a sea-view room now, the Palace Pier would show along the lit seafront under cloud.

phrases.very_hot: Very hot in London today, which is rare, and from the terrace the Thames and Waterloo Bridge shine in strong sun.
phrases.mild_night: Warm air and a cloudy sky over the Thames tonight, and from a higher river-facing floor the London Eye lights show plainly.

phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the 15 July Martyrs Bridge lit above the dark water from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Asian shore this morning, and the Bosphorus changes between grey and blue from the suite living room.

phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Asian shore shows from the window seat, a dry place to watch the storm cross the Bosphorus.

phrases.grey_evening: Curtain open in the Duplex Suite after midnight, the Asian shore lights reflect in the Bosphorus under low cloud.

phrases.clear_night: Above the lit rooftop pool, stars show in a clear night sky over the Valle Aurina toward the distant Dolomites.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud move down the Valle Aurina, and guests in the 25-metre pool watch sun and shadow cross the meadows.

phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills the Valle Aurina today, and from the LUNARIS top floor only the nearest chalets and trees are visible.

phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last glass at the window now, cloud would hide the Dolomites and show chalet lights down the valley.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Barra today; from the Lagoon View Rooms, Marapendi Lagoon is visible but the far shore is unclear.

phrases.grey_evening: After midnight the cloud hangs low over Barra, and the open curtains in the Lagoon View Rooms frame lights on Marapendi Lagoon.

phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the ocean right now, and the balconies are empty while guests watch the lightning from behind the glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, and from the balconies the far end of the beach is hard to make out.

phrases.clear_midday: At midday the binoculars on the windowsill get used, since the headland across the bay is sharp in the clear light.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun comes straight through the sash window of the twin room and lights the yellow throws on the beds.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the promenade below the bay window room and the sea dark beyond it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Llandudno Bay this morning, and from the dining room the water changes from grey to blue and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the headland is sometimes in shadow and sometimes in sun, which is a good reason for the binoculars.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the bay turns orange, seen from the sea-facing rooms on Craig-y-Don Parade.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Llandudno Bay is grey too, but the headland is still clear from the twin room window.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the sash windows, and guests in the dining room watch the bay through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm over the bay is best watched from the bay window room, with lightning over the water and the promenade empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Llandudno Bay today, so the headland is missing and the binoculars on the sill are not much help.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on this coast, but when it falls the promenade below the sea-facing rooms turns white for a short while.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air over Llandudno Bay today, and the headland is sharp while the promenade below the windows is nearly empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot for North Wales, and the promenade below the bay window room is full of people heading for the sea.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night on Craig-y-Don Parade, with the sea audible from an open sash window and nothing much to see.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the dining room the headland is only an outline and the far water fades out.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the promenade lights show on the water from the bay window room, and Llandudno Bay itself is for daybreak.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the bay window glass tonight, and the promenade lights along Llandudno Bay look blurred from the first-floor room.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Llandudno Bay after midnight, and the promenade lights show along the water below the bay window rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Washington Monument is already a dark outline in the window of a Corner King room.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Capitol dome first, and from the upper-floor restaurant windows both it and the Monument stand out clearly.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Summit rooftop garden gets full sun, and the Capitol dome shows plainly from the bar stools.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the Washington Monument pale orange, seen from the king rooms above the nearby rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Presidential Suite tonight, you would see the Capitol dome and the lit streets under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds over Washington this morning put the Capitol dome in and out of shadow, as seen from Summit.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The rooftop terrace has umbrella shade this afternoon, which matters little while clouds cover the sun every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds above the Monument catch the light while guests at Summit watch from their stools.
phrases.overcast: Flat grey cloud covers Washington today, but the Capitol dome is still easy to see from the upper-floor restaurant windows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the king rooms, and the Washington Monument looks grey through the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the rooftop terrace empties, and lightning is visible through the moon-shaped skylight of the lobby atrium.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Washington today softens the Capitol dome, which is only a faint shape from the Presidential Suite windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Summit rooftop garden, and the Washington Monument shows white on white from the Corner King rooms.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air keeps the rooftop terrace empty, so the Capitol dome view belongs to people behind the suite windows today.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the umbrella-shaded seats at Summit fill first, with the Monument standing in strong sun beyond.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night over Washington, and guests stay out at Summit, looking at the lit streets below the clouds.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Corner King rooms the nearby rooftops are clear but the Capitol dome is not.
phrases.late_night: The Corner King's lights are off now, and the lit city around the Monument's tall shape is the only light left.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtains open in a Corner King after midnight show rain on the glass and the wet lit city around the Washington Monument.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers Washington after midnight, and from a Corner King room the open curtain frames the lit avenues around the Monument's obelisk.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before the sun comes up, the infinity pool is quiet and the caldera cliffs slowly appear in grey light.
phrases.clear_morning: At the terrace restaurant, breakfast with champagne is being served and the volcanic islands are clearly visible across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: Strong sun on the infinity pool now, and the Aegean below the cliff looks very blue under a sky without clouds.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would watch the sun go down over the caldera from the edge of the pool.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Oia is clear, and from the Main Suite's plunge pool the stars are easy to see.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the caldera this morning, and guests at the terrace restaurant have shade for part of breakfast.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the Aegean below the cliff, so the water changes colour while guests swim in the infinity pool.
phrases.partly_golden: From the shaded terrace, the last sun lights the volcanic islands between the clouds for about an hour more.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the caldera today, so the Aegean below the infinity pool looks grey too, and the islands are still visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Oia, and in the white suite the glass doors stay closed while the caldera gets wet outside.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Aegean right now, and the infinity pool is empty while lightning shows up over the caldera.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the caldera today, so the volcanic islands are only faint shapes from the terrace restaurant tables.
phrases.snow: Snow in Oia is very rare, but today a few flakes fall past the white suite's glass doors toward the caldera.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing on the cliff today, and the infinity pool has clear water but no swimmers at all.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Oia today, and most guests are in the infinity pool or under the shaded terrace roof.
phrases.mild_night: A warm night with cloud over Santorini, and the glass doors of the suites are open toward the dark caldera.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the volcanic islands cannot be seen from the terrace restaurant, and only the near caldera cliffs show clearly.
phrases.late_night: Dinner is over, and Oia's lights show on the caldera water below the Main Suite.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the suite's glass doors after midnight, and a few lights from Oia shine over the caldera water below.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the caldera after midnight, and the house lights of Oia show along the cliff from the Main Suite.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea off the Corniche Kennedy is still dark, and the Penthouse balconies are quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun lights the limestone mountains behind the outdoor pool, and the first loungers are already taken.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Mediterranean outside Les Bains is a flat bright blue, and the pool umbrellas are all in use.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Sky Bar terrace, the late sun lights the rocky coastline and the water along the Corniche Kennedy.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a sea-view Junior Suite tonight, you would see a clear sky over a very dark Mediterranean.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the limestone mountains this morning, while the outdoor pool is already in full sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the Corniche this afternoon, so the sea by the pool changes between grey and blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds above the rooftop bar turn pink over the city and the mountains.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the view from the Penthouse is still sea on every side, just without the colour.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Corniche Kennedy, and guests have moved from the outdoor pool to the heated indoor one.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Mediterranean is best watched from behind the glass of a sea-view room, not from the balcony.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the sea today, and the limestone mountains behind the pool are only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on the Corniche Kennedy, but today a few flakes are falling past the sea-view balconies onto the palm trees.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the Sky Bar terrace is empty and guests watch the sea through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Marseille, and most guests are in the 250-square-metre outdoor pool rather than on the loungers.
phrases.mild_night: From a sea-view balcony, palm trees along the Corniche Kennedy stand under a cloudy night sky after midnight.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests by the outdoor pool today see the rocky coast but not the limestone mountains behind it.
phrases.late_night: Well after midnight the Penthouse light is on, and the Corniche shore lights show on the sea outside its windows.
phrases.wet_evening: The Penthouse curtains are open past midnight, and rain on the glass blurs the lights along the Corniche Kennedy coast.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, the Penthouse curtains stay open on low cloud over the Mediterranean, and the Corniche lights show along the shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Celest dining room is still empty, and the lights of Lyon are spread out below its windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the 32nd floor comes with a clear view of Lyon and, this morning, the Alps on the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun falls on Lyon, and from the high rooms of the pencil tower the whole city looks sharp and clear.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a high-floor room right now, you would watch the low sun colour the Alps beyond Lyon.
phrases.clear_night: Dinner at Celest tonight happens about 150 metres above a clear, lit-up Lyon, with no cloud over the city.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Lyon this morning, and the Alps appear and disappear from the top-floor rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the fitness room, someone on the treadmill sees patches of sun and shadow move across the city skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day lights the broken clouds over Lyon, seen from the restaurant windows on the 32nd floor.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the guest rooms still have a view over all of Lyon, but the Alps are hidden today.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the wide windows of the upper rooms, and the Lyon streets below look wet and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm over Lyon right now means guests at Celest watch lightning from 150 metres up, behind thick glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of Lyon from the high rooms today, and only the nearest buildings show through it.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the restaurant windows on the 32nd floor, and the roofs of Lyon are turning white below.
phrases.very_cold: The air over Lyon is very cold today, and from the upper floors the Alps stand out clearly.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, guests can reach the Westfield shopping centre from the hotel without stepping outside.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky on this mild night, but the lights of Lyon still show below the top-floor windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the nearer parts of Lyon show from the rooms but the Alps do not.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the top-floor rooms are likely asleep now, Lyon's lights spread below, and the Alps come back at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a high room in the Tour Part-Dieu tonight can watch Lyon's lights through the rain on the window.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a high-floor room tonight can watch Lyon's lights under the cloud from the wide windows before sleep.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Steffl spire is a dark shape against a clear sky from the high-floor SO Comfy windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the cathedral's tiled roof, and from Das LOFT the Danube Canal is clear on the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the floor-to-ceiling glass on the 18th floor shows the whole skyline sharply, from the Steffl to the Riesenrad.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the Innere Stadt rooftops orange below the SO Comfy rooms, with the spire standing clear above them.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at the bar of Das LOFT tonight, you would see the cathedral spire against a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over Vienna this morning, and sun comes and goes on the tiled cathedral roof seen from the restaurant.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the 18th floor this afternoon, cloud shadows cross the Innere Stadt rooftops and the Danube Canal is visible on the horizon.
phrases.partly_golden: Diners at Das LOFT watch the broken clouds behind the Steffl spire go orange, then red, as the sun sets.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Vienna today, but the cathedral spire and rooftops are still plain from the SO Comfy windows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of Das LOFT, and the cathedral spire looks blurred through the wet panes.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Vienna shows up well from the 18th floor, where the glass walls give a wide view of the storm.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Danube Canal today, and from the SO Comfy rooms even the nearby cathedral spire is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the windows of the 18th floor, settling on the cathedral's tiled roof and the Innere Stadt rooftops.
phrases.very_cold: It is bitterly cold outside today, and the clear air makes the Danube Canal and Riesenrad sharp from Das LOFT.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot Vienna afternoon, the city below the SO Comfy windows looks bright and hazy, the spire pale above it.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and from the 18th-floor bar the cathedral spire stands dark against the low cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the cathedral spire is clear from the SO Comfy rooms, but the Danube Canal and Riesenrad are not.
phrases.late_night: Back in the SO Comfy after dinner at Das LOFT, the window shows the cathedral spire over lit rooftops after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the SO Comfy window this evening, and St Stephen's spire shows above the wet, lit rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs low over Vienna after midnight, and the cathedral spire rises out of lit rooftops outside the SO Comfy windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Tagus-facing terrace is empty, and the lights of the 25 de Abril Bridge are still on.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast tables on the rooftop terrace already have a clear line to the river and the bridge this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the red tiles below the balconies look very bright, and the Tagus is a flat blue strip.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the sun go down toward the bridge from the Tagus terrace.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the bridge lights and Christ the King are visible from the terrace, and BAHR guests eat outside.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the castle quarter this morning while staff set the red tables on the terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From a balcony this afternoon the pine trees and colorful facades are in patches of sun and shade.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun on the Tagus terrace has clouds in it today, so the light on the bridge changes often.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the river looks grey too, and the queue for the older terrace is shorter than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on both rooftop terraces, so guests are watching the wet rooftops from their rooms instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm over the Tagus means the terraces are empty, and the bridge appears briefly with each lightning flash.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the river today, and from the Tagus terrace only the tops of the bridge towers are visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Lisbon, which almost never happens, and the red roof tiles below the balconies are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing on the rooftop today, so the view of the bridge comes with very few guests.
phrases.very_hot: Chiado is very hot today, and the tables at BAHR are the busiest spot for looking at the castle quarter.
phrases.mild_night: On this warm cloudy night both terraces still have people on them long after the sunset crowd has left.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so from the Tagus terrace the near rooftops are visible but Christ the King across the river is not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Tagus shows only the far bank's lights, a good hour to sleep until the long bridge appears at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the room window after dinner at BAHR, and the city lights along the Tagus blur toward the bridge.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at BAHR, the room window shows the 25 de Abril Bridge over a Tagus reflecting the city glow under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before the sun comes up, the lights on Tower Bridge are still on, seen from the apartment balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: Through the tall room windows, guests can already see barges moving on the Thames under Tower Bridge in bright morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday The Shard is reflected clearly in the rooftop infinity pool, and HMS Belfast sits in full sun on the river.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: On the rooftop terrace, a table is set for dinner while low sun turns Tower Bridge and the Thames orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see Tower Bridge lit up from a corner apartment on the higher floors.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over London this morning, and the busy riverbank pier below the windows goes in and out of sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Tower of London is partly in shade and partly in sun, seen from the apartment balconies.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, gaps in the cloud light up Tower Bridge, seen end-on from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers London, the Thames looks brown rather than blue, and The Shard is a flat shape above the rooftop pool.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Thames right now, and guests watch barges pass under Tower Bridge from inside their apartments.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over London, and from the floor-to-ceiling windows the lightning shows up in the sky above Tower Bridge.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog on the Thames today means the balcony view stops at Tower Bridge, and The Shard is mostly hidden.
phrases.snow: Light snow is settling on the Tower of London walls, seen from the balconies, and the Thames stays dark.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing on the balcony, so most guests look at Tower Bridge through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the rooftop infinity pool with its view of The Shard is probably the busiest spot here.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild cloudy night, and from the rooftop terrace the lights of Tower Bridge are clear with no stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so from the balcony Tower Bridge is clear but The Shard is hard to see.
phrases.late_night: City lights show on the Thames outside the apartments after midnight, and Tower Bridge will fill the floor-to-ceiling windows at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows after dinner, and the river lights blur below the two towers of Tower Bridge.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner, the apartment's tall windows show Tower Bridge over the Thames and low cloud above the lit City.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sky View Deluxe rooms look out over a still-dark Shenzhen Bay from the Ping An Finance Centre.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast in The Living Room comes with a clear view of the skyline, and Shenzhen Bay is easy to see.
