phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the 116th-floor Free Sky deck shows the whole city in sharp detail under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the Presidential Suite now, the low sun would light the skyline through the double-height windows.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the city lights fill the view from The Attic bar, one floor above The Glasshouse restaurant.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over Shenzhen this morning, and from the suite's corner windows the hills of Hong Kong are visible.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the soaking tub, a guest can watch cloud shadows cross the city around the KK100 tower this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day colours the clouds over Shenzhen Bay, as seen from The Living Room.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Shenzhen today, and the floor-to-ceiling windows on floors 36 to 44 show a flat, even light.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass ceiling of the 8th-floor pool, while swimmers look out at wet Shenzhen towers.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, guests in the Sky View Deluxe rooms watch lightning over the city from behind the windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides Shenzhen Bay today, so the nearest towers are the main thing visible from The Glasshouse windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Shenzhen, but if it fell today, guests would see it from the warm 8th-floor pool.
phrases.very_cold: In this very cold, clear air, the suite's corner windows show the hills of Hong Kong beyond Shenzhen Bay.
phrases.very_hot: Shenzhen is very hot today, and the indoor pool on the 8th floor still shows the city skyline through its windows.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Garden Pavilion and The Glasshouse serve dinner while the streets below stay lit.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so Shenzhen Bay and the Hong Kong hills are not in view from the rooms, only nearby towers.
phrases.late_night: In a Sky View Deluxe room the curtain stays open tonight, and the lights around Shenzhen Bay fill the window at bedtime.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at The Glasshouse, the suite's corner windows show the lights around Shenzhen Bay blurred by rain.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at The Glasshouse, the suite's corner windows show the city lights along Shenzhen Bay under low cloud tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: From an upper-floor balcony, the Atlantic is still dark, and a thin grey light shows at the far edge of the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the Sessions terrace comes with a clear ocean horizon this morning and sun already on the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands high over the beach, and the pool with underwater music is the coolest place to be.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a balcony now, you would see the late sun lighting the sand and the whole ocean horizon.
phrases.clear_night: On the rooftop terrace tonight, the fire pits are lit and the ocean is a dark line under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Atlantic this morning, seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the oceanview rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the beach this afternoon, so the striped cabanas on the rooftop get sun in turns.
phrases.partly_golden: From the upper balconies, low sun lights broken clouds over the Atlantic and the long sandy beach below.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlantic looks flat and grey too, but the view from the balconies is still wide open.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the beach, and guests are playing records in their rooms with the balcony door closed.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the upper-floor balconies, lightning flashes over the Atlantic while rain falls on the empty Wave Terrace stage below.
phrases.fog_haze: Sea haze hides the horizon today, so the ocean seems to end a short way from the balconies.
phrases.snow: Snow in Daytona Beach is rare, but if it fell today, the rooftop fire pits would be the busiest spot.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold for Daytona today, so the beach-level pools are empty and the view is best enjoyed from behind the windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the sand today, and most guests are in the pool with underwater music rather than on the beach.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over the ocean, and the Wave Terrace bar has music going at beach level.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from the balconies the ocean fades out well before the usual horizon line.
phrases.late_night: If you had an oceanview room tonight, you would be asleep by now, and the Atlantic would fill the window at sunrise.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had come up from the Wave Terrace for a last drink, you would watch rain fall on the Atlantic.
phrases.grey_evening: A last drink in an oceanview room, and you would see cloud over the Atlantic and the Wave Terrace at beach level.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pearl River is a dark line below the Club River Rooms, and the IFC stands lower than the window.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were at a Club River Room window now, you would see the Pearl River sharp in clear morning light below.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over Guangzhou, and from the Club River Rooms the IFC roof sits well below the window.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low afternoon sun reaches the Asaya pool on floor 93, and the Pearl River catches the same light outside.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at TOO HIGH tonight, you would see the Canton Tower lit up from the outdoor terrace on floor 107.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Club River Room window wall, morning light between scattered clouds falls on the Pearl River below the IFC.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Scattered clouds pass over Guangzhou this afternoon, and from the Club River Rooms the Pearl River moves between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun is lighting the clouds above the Canton Tower, seen from the bar stools at TOO HIGH.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pearl River looks flat and pale from the Club River Rooms, four hundred metres up.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling past the window wall of the Club River Rooms, and the IFC below looks blurred through the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Guangzhou means the TOO HIGH outdoor terraces are empty, while guests watch the lightning from inside the bar.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze today: from the suite dining area the Canton Tower is only a faint outline, and the river barely shows.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Guangzhou, but if it fell today the Manor Suite terraces would be the first place to see it.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold outside today, so the TOO HIGH outdoor terraces on floor 107 are probably the coldest seats in Guangzhou.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day in Guangzhou, the outdoor terraces at TOO HIGH are not much cooler at 107 floors up.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the city lights are still visible from the bar's floor-to-ceiling windows, Canton Tower among them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Reduced visibility today: the IFC below the Club River Rooms shows clearly, but the Canton Tower is hard to make out.
phrases.late_night: After a late drink at TOO HIGH, the Club River Room window shows city lights along both banks of the Pearl River.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Lingnan House, the Club River Rooms look out through rain to the lights along the Pearl River.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Lingnan House, the Pearl River lights look hazy from the Club River Rooms under tonight's low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: In the dark before the sun comes up, the club lounge windows show the Dallas towers only as lit points.
phrases.clear_morning: A guest room window on a clear morning looks west over the flat city, suburbs visible in the distance.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun lights every tower in the skyline, and guests in the club lounge see Dallas with no haze at all.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would watch the low sun turn the Dallas towers orange before dusk.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the lit skyline fills the view from the rooftop dining tables, and the wicker chairs are all still out.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the Dallas skyline this morning, and the double queen room windows frame both.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun take turns over the western suburbs this afternoon, which keeps the guest room view changing every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun tints the clouds pink above the skyline, the exact view from the rooftop wood tables.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Dallas skyline looks flat and dull from the club lounge, thirty floors above Market Center.
phrases.rain: Rain streaks the guest room windows, and the blue Adirondack chairs on the rooftop terrace sit empty and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is moving over Dallas, so guests watch the lightning over the skyline from the club lounge instead of the rooftop.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of the skyline today, and from the high-floor executive suites only the nearest buildings show.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Dallas, which is rare, and the rooftop wood tables are gathering a thin white layer.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the rooftop terrace stays empty and guests take the skyline view from the club lounge.
phrases.very_hot: Dallas is very hot today, so the rooftop chairs stay empty and the club lounge offers the same skyline indoors.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild, cloudy night, and guests at the rooftop dining tables face the lit skyline with no stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so the western suburbs beyond the guest room windows are a blur and only the close towers are clear.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the executive suites are probably asleep now, and the Dallas skyline lights will be in the window at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a high-floor executive suite tonight watches rain run down the window as the Dallas skyline lights come on.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has an executive suite tonight sees the lit Dallas skyline under low cloud from the window after midnight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balcony rooms look toward a dark city where St Peter's dome is already outlined against the lightening sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From Monte Mario hill this morning, the dome of St Peter's and the Roman hills are sharp under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests on the sunbeds by the outdoor pools have the whole city in front of them, St Peter's dome included.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last hours of sun, the dome of St Peter's and the Roman hills show every detail from the room balconies.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the large windows of La Pergola frame the lights of Rome and the lit dome of St Peter's.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Rome this morning, so the dome of St Peter's is sometimes in sun, sometimes in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the seven hills this afternoon while swimmers use the outdoor pools in the gardens.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on a balcony now, you would see the low sun colour the clouds above St Peter's dome.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky today, the city below Monte Mario looks flat, but St Peter's dome is still easy to find.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the gardens and the outdoor pools, so the indoor pool under its glass roof is the busier one.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Rome can be watched from the guest rooms on Monte Mario, and the balcony seating stays empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers Rome today, and from the balcony rooms St Peter's dome is only a pale shape, not a sharp one.
phrases.snow: Snow in Rome is rare, and today it falls on the gardens and the empty sunbeds while the indoor pool stays warm.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, the air over Rome is clear and the Colosseum and St Peter's are visible from the hill.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Rome today, so most guests are in the outdoor pools rather than on the sunbeds beside them.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the jacuzzi the lights of Rome show below without any stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so the dome of St Peter's is visible from the balconies but the distant mountains are not.
phrases.late_night: Back in your room after a late dinner at La Pergola, you would see St Peter's dome among the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink at La Pergola tonight, you would see St Peter's dome through rain on the windows.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last glass at your window now, you would see Rome's lights under cloud, St Peter's dome among them.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before the sun is up, the Eiffel Tower is a dark shape through the trees from the Haussmannian balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: On the fifth floor this morning, the Grand Palais glass dome and Notre-Dame are both clear on the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Eiffel Tower is sharp through the trees from the Haussmannian balconies.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun is on the Grand Palais glass dome now, and the Eiffel Tower is turning a warm colour from the balcony.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the illuminated Eiffel Tower and lit rooftops from the Imperial Suite balcony.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Paris this morning, and breakfast on the balcony comes with the Grand Palais dome in view.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the Haussmannian balconies this afternoon are watching cloud shadows move across the rooftops and the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the Eiffel Tower through broken cloud, seen from the Eiffel Junior Suite's small balcony.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Paris today, but the Eiffel Tower still shows plainly through the trees from the balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the bistro balconies, so breakfast moves inside, with the Eiffel Tower still visible through the French doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the balcony doors stay closed, and guests watch lightning over the Eiffel Tower from inside the suite.
phrases.fog_haze: In today's haze, the Eiffel Tower is only a faint outline from the balconies, and Notre-Dame cannot be found at all.
phrases.snow: Snow lies on the bistro balcony tables, and the Eiffel Tower shows white-grey through the trees from the Imperial Suite.
phrases.very_cold: Bitter cold keeps the balcony doors shut today, though the Eiffel Tower is sharp in the clear air from the suites.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air keeps the Haussmannian balconies mostly empty, and the Eiffel Tower wavers in the heat above the trees.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Paris, and guests sit out on the balconies with the illuminated Eiffel Tower in front of them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from the fifth floor the Grand Palais dome shows but Notre-Dame on the horizon does not.
phrases.late_night: The Eiffel Junior Suite is given over to sleep after midnight; at dawn its French doors will show the tower through the trees.
phrases.wet_evening: The Eiffel Junior Suite curtains are drawn back at two, rain blurring the glass and the tower's outline above wet lit rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: In the Eiffel Junior Suite tonight, the curtain is pulled back on rooftop lights and the tower's shape under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Frauenkirche twin towers stand dark against a clear sky outside the Tower suite windows.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop Terrace, every church tower of the Old Town is sharp this morning under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun lights the city rooftops of the Altstadt, and the Alter Peter dome is clearly visible from the Terrace.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop balcony now, you would see low sun on the Frauenkirche towers and Marienplatz skyline.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the city lights of Munich outline the Old Town skyline for guests finishing dinner on the Terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the Frauenkirche this morning, seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Bavaria suite.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the rooftop pool bar watch patches of sun and shade pass over the Old Town rooftops this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop Terrace, low sun lights the Frauenkirche's twin green domes under a sky of broken cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Frauenkirche twin towers look darker than usual from the circular sitting rooms of the suites.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Old Town, and the Matsuhisa restaurant is the dry option while the rooftop Terrace is wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Tower suites tonight watch lightning flash behind the Frauenkirche's twin domes through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the tops of the Frauenkirche towers today, so the suite windows show only the nearest city rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the Old Town rooftops and on the empty tables of the rooftop Terrace this hour.
phrases.very_cold: It feels below freezing on the rooftop today, so most guests look at the Frauenkirche from inside the suite sitting rooms.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the rooftop pool bar is the busiest spot, with the Frauenkirche towers in clear view.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Munich, and the Old Town lights are easy to see from the rooftop balcony.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the Frauenkirche towers are clear from the Terrace but the distant skyline is not.
phrases.late_night: In the Tower Suite the curtain is left open after midnight, Frauenkirche's twin towers framed above the lit Old Town rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the Tower Suite's floor-to-ceiling windows, and the lights around Marienplatz blur beside the Frauenkirche's twin towers.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, haze blurs the Frauenkirche's twin towers from the Bavaria Suite, and the Marienplatz lights glow soft beneath the cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, from an Oceanfront Apartment balcony, the Surfers Paradise skyline is only a line of lights far to the north.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning on the upper floors: the coastline from the Coolangatta rock wall to Surfers Paradise is visible in one unbroken arc.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, guests eating at the balcony dining tables have Kirra Beach and the ocean directly in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Surfers Paradise towers from the west, easy to see from the upper balconies right now.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there, you would see the lights of Surfers Paradise from the balcony and hear the waves on Kirra Beach.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over the ocean this morning, and the dune path with rope railings leads down to a mostly sunny beach.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the water this afternoon, easy to follow from the balconies of the side-facing Panoramic View Apartments.
phrases.partly_golden: From the balconies in the last hour of sun, broken cloud leaves the Surfers Paradise towers lit and Kirra Beach partly shaded.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the whole arc of coast today, and the heated outdoor pool is still a reasonable choice for a swim.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Kirra Beach, so most guests watch the grey ocean from inside, through the tall glass doors of the bedrooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Gold Coast now, and the upper Oceanfront Apartments give a wide view of lightning over the ocean.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze today, so from the balconies the Surfers Paradise skyline is faint and the far end of the arc disappears.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare on the Gold Coast, but if it fell today, guests would watch it from the balconies.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day by Gold Coast standards, and the heated outdoor pool is the warmest place to be outside the apartments.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside, so guests watch Kirra Beach through the glass doors of their air-conditioned apartments rather than from the balcony.
phrases.mild_night: Mild cloudy night, and the balcony dining tables are in use, with the lights of the Surfers Paradise skyline to the north.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is down today: Kirra Beach is clear below the balconies, but the Surfers Paradise skyline is not visible.
phrases.late_night: Surfers Paradise's lights mark the north end of the coastline from the Oceanfront Apartments, hours before dawn reaches the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass of the Oceanfront Apartments tonight, and the Surfers Paradise lights blur up the coast.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the coast tonight, and the Surfers Paradise skyline lights show north along the arc from the Oceanfront Apartments.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the infinity pool is still dark, and the northern volcanoes show only as outlines against the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: On a clear morning like this, the Bali Sea is visible from the pool edge beyond the jungle valleys.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests are taking the white umbrellas around the circular pool, with the volcanoes sharp under a blue midday sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see low sun on the coffee plantation and the coastal bay.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the firepit is lit, and the valley lights below are easy to count from the resort.
phrases.partly_morning: From the pool edge, patches of morning cloud hang over the green valley and the Bali Sea.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds are moving across the northern volcanoes this afternoon, and the lounge chairs by the circular pool are mostly taken.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky over the Bali Sea, seen from the pool edge.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky today, the pool edge and the sea are the same colour, and the volcanoes are a flat shape.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the coffee plantation right now, and the pool area is empty except for wet lounge chairs.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the northern volcanoes, and guests watch the lightning from their villas rather than from the pool.
phrases.fog_haze: The resort is inside the cloud today, so the pool ends in white and the volcanoes are not visible.
phrases.snow: From the infinity pool, snow falls over the coffee plantation toward the northern volcanoes and the Bali Sea.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold for Bali today, and the heated pool at the Istana Negara Presidential Suite makes more sense than the main one.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot even at this altitude today, so most guests look at the volcanoes from inside the infinity pool.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night at the firepit, with a few valley lights showing through gaps in the cloud below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today: the jungle valley near the pool is clear, but the Bali Sea and the volcanoes are not showing.
phrases.late_night: In the Istana Negara Presidential Suite the curtain is left open, so the valley lights are the last thing seen before sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner, the villa window shows rain on the glass and the valley lights blurred behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the villa window shows the valley lights below the cloud, and the infinity pool reflects a few of them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the park-facing upper rooms show Boston Common as a dark green block with the downtown skyline lit behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Boston Common, and from the floor-to-ceiling suite windows the whole tree canopy is in full sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the brass telescope on the windowsill points toward the Charles River, easy to pick out under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun comes straight into the park-facing suites, and the historic spires above the rooftops turn a warm color.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at the hotel entrance tonight, you would see the Theater District marquees lit up under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds this morning, and their shadows cross Boston Common while guests in the upper rooms watch from the window.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the red plaid sofa, the afternoon view is tree canopy, spires and rooftops, with clouds moving over the skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the downtown skyline behind Boston Common, with a few clouds above the historic brownstones.
phrases.overcast: Under a gray sky, Boston Common looks flat and dark green from the park-facing rooms, the downtown skyline gray behind it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the tree canopy of Boston Common; the Equinox spa inside the hotel is a reasonable alternative.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the downtown skyline is best watched from a park-facing suite, ideally the one with the fireplace.
phrases.fog_haze: In the fog, the upper park-facing rooms look onto the tree canopy of Boston Common, with the downtown skyline lost behind it.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on Boston Common's tree canopy and the brownstone roofs, seen from a warm suite with the fireplace on.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold outside, and the bare trees of Boston Common stand out clearly in the cold air below the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day in Boston, and guests are staying indoors, looking down at the shaded tree canopy of Boston Common.
phrases.mild_night: Mild and cloudy tonight, and from the hotel entrance the Theater District marquees are the brightest thing in view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: Boston Common is clear from the upper rooms, but the Charles River beyond is not visible.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the park-facing windows show the downtown skyline lights behind Boston Common.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner, the park-facing suites show downtown's lights blurred by rain across Boston Common.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the park-facing suites look across Boston Common to the downtown skyline lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the windows of the windmill suite show Ornos Bay still dark, the boats only shapes on the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From the guest rooms, the glass doors open to a bright blue Aegean, and the private beach umbrellas are already in rows.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun on the wooden pier makes the yellow loungers very bright, and the wicker pod daybeds are the only shade there.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the whitewashed hillside village across the bay, seen from the two wicker chairs beside the pool.
phrases.clear_night: At night the open-air terrace restaurant has its tables set under the pergola, with lights on the calm bay below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Ornos Bay this morning, so the infinity pool between the wooden cabanas changes colour every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at Buddha-Bar Beach are in the Aegean with lounge music playing, while a few clouds cross the sky above.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the seafront terrace now, you would see the last sun on the distant islands between broken clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Aegean outside the suite French doors is a flat blue-grey, and the white balcony rail stands out.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the striped umbrellas of the seafront terrace, and the spa and boutiques are busier than the private beach.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Ornos Bay means the wooden pier is empty, and lightning is visible from the suite windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the distant islands today, and from the seafront terrace only the near part of Ornos Bay is clear.
phrases.snow: Snow on Mykonos is rare, but today a few flakes fall past the windmill suite windows onto the stone terraces.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold clear day the wooden cabanas by the infinity pool are empty, and the bay looks sharp and still.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, so the pools are full and the pale sand of the private beach is too hot for bare feet.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, and dinner continues at the Elais restaurant while the lights of boats move across Ornos Bay.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so the distant islands cannot be seen from the pool, though the hillside village across the bay still can.
phrases.late_night: Awake after midnight in the windmill suite, you could watch village lights across Ornos Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were in a bay-facing suite with a last glass tonight, you would watch rain cross Ornos Bay toward Buddha-Bar Beach.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were finishing a last drink at your window now, you would see village lights across Ornos Bay under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Suite 733 shows the Eiffel Tower as a dark shape against a sky that is slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Croissants and orange juice sit on a balcony table, with Haussmann rooftops in full sun and nobody in a hurry yet.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, the Eiffel Tower stands sharp to the right and the Gothic spire to the left, without haze.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low afternoon sun reaches through the open French doors of the suite, and the Eiffel Tower turns a warmer colour.
phrases.clear_night: On the terrace tonight, candles burn on each table, champagne is poured, and the lit Eiffel Tower stands above the city rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Paris this morning, so the Eiffel Tower seen from the suite's bay windows goes in and out of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in the Penthouse this afternoon, you would see patches of sun crossing the rooftops and the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the boxwood spheres on the rooftop terrace, with a few clouds colouring behind the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the Haussmann rooftops today, and the Eiffel Tower is visible from the suite, only in duller light.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop terrace, and the indoor pool under its coffered skylight is the busier choice this hour.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning behind the Eiffel Tower is visible from the bay windows of the suite, while dinner at Le Cinq continues indoors.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of the Eiffel Tower today, and from Suite 733 only the lower part can be made out.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the planted balcony outside the suite, and the Eiffel Tower appears through it in white and grey.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing on the rooftop terrace, where the boxwood spheres have frost and the Eiffel Tower stands very clear.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot across Paris today, and most guests are at the indoor pool under the coffered skylight rather than on the terrace.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, and dinner tables on the terrace face the lit Eiffel Tower with the hydrangeas still white in candlelight.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the suite the Eiffel Tower is a faint outline and Sacré-Cœur cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: Were you reaching for water in Suite 733 around midnight, you would see the Tower's shape above the lit rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last glass in Suite 733 after midnight, you would see the Eiffel Tower through rain on the windows.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last glass in Suite 733 tonight, you would see the Eiffel Tower and city lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Royal Ocean View Suite windows show a dark Atlantic and an almost empty Ocean Drive below.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were in the Royal Ocean View Suite now, you would see clear morning sun on Lummus Park and the beach.
phrases.clear_midday: Up on the rooftop pool, most guests stay under the white umbrellas while the Atlantic looks flat and bright.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light reaches the rooftop infinity pool, and the Miami skyline is sharp in the other direction.
phrases.clear_night: From the rooftop pool deck tonight, you would see a clear sky of stars over the Atlantic and lights along Ocean Drive.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Lummus Park this morning, and breakfast on the deck still gets plenty of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, cloud shadows move across the water beyond the palm trees for most of the afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were at the rooftop pool now, you would see the last sun catch the clouds above the Miami skyline.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over South Beach today, so the Atlantic from the suite windows looks grey instead of turquoise.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Ocean Drive, and the lobby lounge with its cream armchairs is fuller than usual.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic right now, and guests watch it from the Royal Ocean View Suite windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over South Beach today, and from the rooftop pool the line between sea and sky is hard to find.
phrases.snow: Snow is practically unknown in Miami Beach, so if any fell, the breakfast deck over Ocean Drive would have a strange view.
phrases.very_cold: From the rooftop pool, hard winter light falls on Lummus Park and the empty sand of South Beach.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on South Beach today, so the rooftop pool and its white umbrellas are the busiest part of the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: Mild and cloudy tonight, and dinner at LT Steak & Seafood is well underway while Ocean Drive stays busy outside.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests at the rooftop pool this afternoon look down on Lummus Park and the beach, with the far Atlantic hidden in haze.
phrases.late_night: Room lights off in the small hours, the glow from Ocean Drive along Lummus Park is the only light inside.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, with the curtain open in the Royal Ocean View Suite, rain on the glass blurs the Ocean Drive lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open after midnight in the Royal Ocean View Suite, the lights of Ocean Drive glow under cloud beside Lummus Park.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Strip's lights are still on below the upper-floor suites, and the mountains show as a dark line.
phrases.clear_morning: From the floor-to-ceiling windows, the whole Strip runs north to south in clear morning light, with the mountains sharp behind.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the desert sun is strong, and the curved suite windows show the Strip in full, flat daylight.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun is lighting the towers along the Strip from the west, seen from the high-floor bar.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the brass telescope at the high-floor bar is pointed at the lit Strip, under a sky with no cloud.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Las Vegas this morning, and their shadows move across the Strip below the upper-floor suites.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The brass telescope at the bar points at the Strip this afternoon, with scattered clouds above the mountains.
phrases.partly_golden: Just before sunset, the broken clouds over the mountains turn orange, and the Strip lights come on below the suite windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Strip looks less bright from the suite windows, but the north-to-south line of towers is still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Las Vegas, and today it streaks the floor-to-ceiling windows while the Strip stays lit behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the mountains is visible from the high-floor bar, and guests at the marble counter have a dry seat for it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Las Vegas, so the mountains are faint from the suites and the far ends of the Strip are blurred.
phrases.snow: A rare Las Vegas snowfall is passing the curved suite windows, and the Strip below is wet rather than white.
phrases.very_cold: From the upper-floor suite windows, hard winter light falls on the Strip towers and the mountains behind them.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot desert air sits over the Strip this afternoon, and the heat shimmer is visible from the high-floor bar.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky on a mild night, and the lit Strip below the curved windows is the main source of light.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so the mountains are not visible from the suites, though the nearest part of the Strip is.
phrases.late_night: Up for water around midnight in the Entertainment Suite, you would see the Strip lit from north to south.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were finishing a last drink in the Entertainment Suite, you would see the Strip lights through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were finishing a last drink in the Entertainment Suite, you would see the Strip lit under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balcony of an upper-floor suite shows the Mediterranean as a dark flat line below a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the thatched beach cabanas, the sea is calm and blue this morning, and the sand is still mostly empty.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the green umbrellas on the beachfront terrace are the only shade between loungers and sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the pine-lined golf course, seen from a villa terrace beside its private pool.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see a clear sky over a black Mediterranean from an upper-floor balcony.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Belek this morning, and from upper-floor rooms the Taurus range is visible in the distance.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the lagoon in front of the Lagoon Suites changes colour each time a cloud moves off the sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds over the sea turn orange, seen from the suite living area balcony.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the whole sky today, so the sea from the beachfront terrace looks grey too, flat and quiet.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the golf course and beach, and most guests are inside the spa or the à la carte restaurants.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Mediterranean, and from the sliding doors of a sea-view suite the lightning is easy to watch.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, and from the upper floors the horizon line between sea and sky is hard to find.
phrases.snow: Snow is a rare sight in Belek, but today a few flakes fall over the lagoon in front of the Lagoon Suites.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day the loungers stay empty, and the sea is best watched through a king room's closed balcony door.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today in Belek, so the water park and the two poolside bars are busier than the beach cabanas.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Belek; from the beachfront terrace the sea is only a sound, not a view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the upper floors the Taurus range cannot be seen, only the nearby sea and beach.
phrases.late_night: Moonlight shows on the Mediterranean after midnight, framed by the wide sliding doors of the upper-floor sea-view suites.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight the pool lights blur through rain on the Lagoon Suite windows.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the Belek coast after midnight, and from the Lagoon Suites the lagoon shows the resort lights on its water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Palace Pier is a dark shape against a clear sky from the Deluxe Sea View rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: From the bay-window chairs, the beach and the pier are sharp in clear morning light over the Channel.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the binoculars in the Panoramic Suite show every detail of the Palace Pier under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in HarBAR + Kitchen now, you would see the low sun on the pier through the tall windows.
phrases.clear_night: The Palace Pier lights are easy to spot tonight from the sea-facing rooms, with a clear sky over the Channel.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the beach this morning, and the arched restaurant windows frame the pier between patches of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the sea below the Kings Road rooms changes colour each time a cloud moves off the sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a gap in the clouds lights the Palace Pier, seen from the bay windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Channel looks flat and pale from the Deluxe Sea View rooms, though the pier is still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of HarBAR + Kitchen, and the beach outside is mostly empty today.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the heated indoor pool underground is the calmest place, while lightning shows over the Channel from upper rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over the beach today, and the Palace Pier is only a faint outline from the sea-facing rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow on Brighton beach is rare, but from the sea-facing rooms the pebbles and the pier are white today.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold clear day over the Channel, and the pier looks sharp from the Deluxe Sea View rooms.
phrases.very_hot: From the HarBAR + Kitchen windows, heat-haze shimmers over the beach and the Palace Pier.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with clouds over the Channel, and the pier lights are visible from the bedroom windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far end of the Palace Pier is hard to make out from the bay windows.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Deluxe Sea View rooms sleep now, and their window will show the Palace Pier over the beach at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the Panoramic Suite tonight sees rain on the glass and the Palace Pier out on the water beyond it.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the sea-view rooms are likely asleep by now, the Palace Pier a long shape on the water under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, under a clear sky, the Gran Vía skyline shows its lit rooftop signs from the pool terrace.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were on the rooftop now, you would see clear morning sun on the Gran Vía buildings beyond the pool.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun falls straight onto the rooftop pool, so the floral pergola is the most wanted spot for shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the Gran Vía facades orange, best seen from the rooftop bar with a drink in hand.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lit Gran Vía skyline from the pool before heading down to The Pulse.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Madrid this morning, and the fitness center windows show the classic street facade in changing light.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A few clouds move across the Gran Vía skyline this afternoon, and the rooftop pool is in sun more often than not.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the arched windows of the terracotta lounge frame city rooftops and the hilltop fortress under cloud.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Madrid today, so the Gran Vía skyline looks flat from the rooftop and the spa gets more visitors.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop pool and pergola, and guests watch the wet stone facade from their balcony windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm sits over Madrid, the rooftop bar is closed for now, and The Pulse speakeasy is the sensible alternative.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the city today, and from the arched lounge windows the hilltop fortress is only a faint shape.
phrases.snow: Snow in Madrid is rare, but today it is settling on the rooftop pergola while the pool stays empty.
phrases.very_cold: Clear and very cold over Madrid today, the Gran Vía skyline stands out from the rooftop, and the pool stays empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Madrid today, and the rooftop pool is the busiest place in the hotel until the sun drops.
phrases.mild_night: Guests at the rooftop pool tonight look out under a cloudy, mild sky at the lit Gran Vía skyline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the lounge windows the nearby rooftops show but the hilltop fortress does not.
phrases.late_night: If you turned the room lights off after midnight, the lit windows of the stone facade outside would be your only light.
phrases.wet_evening: Were you up at the rooftop bar for a last drink tonight, you would see the Gran Vía lights through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were up at the rooftop bar for a last drink now, you would see Gran Vía's lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise under a clear sky, early light shows Edinburgh Castle on its rock through the arched Castle View Suite window.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Deluxe Castle View Room have the fortress in full sunlight before breakfast, with Princes Street Gardens below it.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over Edinburgh Castle, and the rocky hillside stands out clearly from every castle-facing window.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun from the west lights the castle stone, and west-facing rooms get the Scott Monument in the same warm light.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see Edinburgh Castle under a clear starry sky from a Junior Suite Castle View.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Edinburgh this morning, and from the arched windows the castle is sunlit one minute and shaded the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon some guests sit under the glass dome in the lounge, while others watch cloud shadows cross Edinburgh Castle.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud leaves the castle stone part gold, part grey, from the Castle View Suite.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky Edinburgh Castle looks flat and dark from the Deluxe Castle View Room, which is a very Scottish look.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the arched windows in front of the castle, and some guests swim in the indoor pool instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Edinburgh, and lightning behind the castle makes a good reason to stay on the tartan sofa.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of Edinburgh Castle today, and from the castle-facing rooms only the nearest part of the rock shows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Edinburgh, and the castle roofs turn white while guests watch from their arched windows.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, but the castle is sharp and clear from the Junior Suite Castle View.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot days are rare in Edinburgh, and today the castle rock sits in strong sun beyond Princes Street Gardens.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the fortress is a dark shape with no stars above it from the Castle View Suite.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Edinburgh Castle is only a faint grey outline from the rooms that face it directly.
phrases.late_night: In the Castle View Suite now, you would be asleep, Princes Street lit in the window and the Castle back at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in the Castle View Suite now, rain on the arched window would blur the Castle's outline.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in the Castle View Suite tonight, the Castle's outline would show under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop garden is dark and empty, with the Forbidden City's rooflines only an outline against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast tables sit by floor-to-ceiling windows, and this morning the sun falls clearly on the Beijing rooftops outside.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the guest rooms facing Jingshan Park get strong direct light, and the pavilion stands out sharply on the hill.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop garden now, you would see the Forbidden City's gilded roofs catching the low sun.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the rooftop garden now, you could see stars in the clear night sky over the Forbidden City.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Jingshan Park this morning, so the pavilion seen from the guest rooms moves in and out of shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the five terraces this afternoon, parts of the historic city are in sun and parts under cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun reaches the rooftop garden between clouds, lighting the gilded rooflines for a few minutes at a time.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Coal Hill today, and the quiet room at the lobby end shows the park without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Wangfujing Street, and guests in the lobby lounge watch the wet trees through the framed window.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Beijing right now, and guests watch the lightning from inside the suites rather than from the five terraces.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the city today, and from the rooftop garden the Forbidden City's rooflines are soft and pale.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the pavilion in Jingshan Park, and guests in the rooms watch it through the tall glass.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold outside today, and the trees seen from the lobby lounge window are bare, though the sky is clear.
phrases.very_hot: From the roof garden, heat-haze wavers over the gold roofs of the Forbidden City below Jingshan Park.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the rooftop garden is comfortable, but the Forbidden City's rooflines show only as dark shapes.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop garden the Forbidden City's gilded roofs are hard to make out.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Forbidden City's rooflines fill the room window, and the city lights around them make staying up late easy.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the guest-room windows, and the Forbidden City's roofs show through it below Jingshan's pavilion.
phrases.grey_evening: Late after dinner, a guest-room window shows the Forbidden City's rooflines under haze, city lights spread around Jingshan's pavilion.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dolomite slopes beyond the bathtub windows are only a dark outline against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is served in the wood-panelled parlours of Stube Badia while clear morning sun reaches the Puster Valley outside.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun fills the Puster Valley, and from the heated infinity pools the Dolomite rock stands out sharply above it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun comes through the wood-framed windows of the guest rooms, and the farmland in the valley looks golden.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the heated infinity pools are still open, and the stars show above the dark valley.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cover some of the Dolomite peaks this morning, visible from the valley-side rooms while breakfast runs in Stube Badia.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the afternoon, cloud shadows cross the Puster Valley farmland, seen from the loungers around the outdoor pool.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds above the Dolomites, best seen from the heated infinity pools facing the valley.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Dolomites look flat and closer than usual from the bathroom windows of the suites.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the cloister and outdoor pools, but the valley stays visible through the spa relaxation room's full-height glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Puster Valley is easiest to watch from the daybeds of the spa relaxation room, behind full-height glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills the Puster Valley today, so the hilltop rooms see the courtyard and the nearest pine trees but not the Dolomites.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the amber roofs and the cloister, and steam rises from the two heated infinity pools above the valley.
phrases.very_cold: On a clear, very cold day the snow-covered peaks look sharp through the full-height glass of the spa relaxation room.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, and the red umbrellas around the outdoor pool are where most guests spend the afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild under cloud, the indoor lap pool glows teal beside its stone arch, and the outdoor pools remain usable.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the Dolomite slopes beyond the bathtub windows are a faint outline and the far valley is missing.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has a valley room sleeps now, a few farm lights in the valley, and the Dolomites fill the window at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the valley rooms are probably asleep by now, snow passing the wood-framed windows that face the Dolomites by day.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the valley-facing rooms after midnight sees cloud hiding the Dolomites and the lights of San Lorenzo below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, from the upper rooms, São Jorge Castle is a dark shape on its hill under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the terrace of the Maria do Carmo restaurant, the Carmo Convent ruins stand in full morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the terracotta rooftops below the upper-floor rooms run down to the bright blue Tagus under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the terrace on Largo do Carmo, where guests are having wine beside the stone fountain.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the upper rooms show the lit towers of the Sé Cathedral with the Tagus dark behind them.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Lisbon this morning, and from the attic rooms the castle is sometimes in sun, sometimes in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on the terrace this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows moving across the Carmo Convent ruins.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights a few clouds above the Tagus, seen through the right-hand window of the attic rooms.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the terracotta rooftops lose their colour, but the castle is still clear from the Castle View rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Largo do Carmo today, and the terrace tables sit empty while the convent ruins get wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the attic rooms give a wide view of lightning over the Tagus through the right-hand window.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Tagus from the Rio View rooms today, while the Carmo ruins across the square remain visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Lisbon, but if it fell today the terracotta rooftops would turn white under the upper-floor windows.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the terrace stays empty and guests watch the castle from inside the Castle View rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Chiado, and the shade of the trees on Largo do Carmo matters at the terrace tables.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and if it is Wednesday, fado is playing in the hotel while the Carmo ruins stand dark outside.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Poor visibility today: from the upper rooms the Tagus is a pale strip and the castle hill only an outline.
phrases.late_night: A late dinner at Maria do Carmo ends upstairs, where the Premium Rio View window shows the lit riverfront along the Tagus.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the glass of the Castle View rooms and the rooftop lights blur toward São Jorge hill.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze drifts over the Tagus after midnight, and from the Premium Rio View rooms the river lights look soft and blurred.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the racecourse below the Corner King rooms is still dark, and the sky over Bangkok is clearing.
phrases.clear_morning: Early swimmers in the 16th-floor pool see the Bangkok skyline reflected in the water around the central pillar.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong, and the Champagne Bar on the 57th floor gives a sharp view across Bangkok.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon, the sun sits low over Bangkok and the racecourse grass looks bright from the Corner King rooms.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Champagne Bar tonight, you would see Bangkok lit up clearly in every direction.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the racecourse this morning, and guests in the gym watch them move across the skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud, some sun this afternoon, so the pool on the 16th floor is partly shaded while the skyline stays visible.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky behind the Bangkok towers seen from the Loft.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Bangkok today, and the city looks flat and quiet from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the racecourse below, and guests at the Champagne Bar watch it from 57 floors up.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Bangkok, and lightning is visible from the Loft on the 56th floor between the towers.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Bangkok this morning, so the far towers are faint and only the racecourse below is clear.
phrases.snow: From the Champagne Bar on the fifty-seventh floor, snow falls over the lit Bangkok skyline and the racecourse below.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Bangkok, and the open-air pool on the 16th floor has few swimmers despite the clear skyline.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside today, so most guests view the skyline from inside the Loft rather than from the pool.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and the lights of Bangkok are clear from the Corner King rooms above the dark racecourse.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests in the Corner King rooms today see the racecourse below while haze hides the far parts of Bangkok.
phrases.late_night: Asleep in a Corner King room now, you would miss the city lights, but dawn would show you the racecourse and skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: Were you in the Champagne Bar for a last glass now, you would see the city lights through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were up at the Champagne Bar windows tonight, you would see the city lights spread out under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Salute dome is a dark shape across the water from the Hemingway Suite balconies, with no gondolas yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Landmark Grand Canal rooms get clear light this morning, with the view running from the Salute dome to the Peggy Guggenheim Collection.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: This is the hour the Gritti Terrace is known for: low sun on the Salute dome and the palazzi across the water.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit Salute dome stands across the canal, seen from the terrace tables and the suite balconies.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over the Grand Canal this morning, and from the suite windows the campanile and rooftops show between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in the Hemingway Suite now, you would see gondolas pass under a sky that is half cloud, half blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud sits above the Salute dome, and the Gritti Terrace tables face it directly.

phrases.fog_haze: If you were at a Club del Doge table now, fog over the Grand Canal would hide most of the Salute dome.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Grand Canal, a rare sight, settling on the terrace chairs and the moored boats below the windows.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air sits over Venice, so the clear view of the Salute dome is taken from behind suite windows, not balconies.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the Gritti SPA is indoors and the terrace tables sit in the heat by the canal.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and guests at the terrace tables look across the dark canal to the lit Salute dome.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor, so from the rooftop terrace St Mark's Campanile is hard to make out, while the palazzi opposite stay clear.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Landmark Grand Canal rooms are likely asleep, palazzo lights on the water until the Salute's dome shows at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a Landmark Grand Canal room tonight probably watches the rain fall on the canal, palazzo windows lit across the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the Hemingway Suite after midnight sees the Grand Canal under low cloud, a few palazzo windows lit across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Aegean outside every room is still dark, and the waterfront terrace tables are empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From a suite terrace this morning, the bay is turquoise and the olive trees above the sandy beach are already lit.
phrases.clear_midday: Clear sky over Paradise Bay at midday, and most guests have moved from the sun loungers into the main pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the terrace, you would watch the sun go down over the Aegean mountains with nothing in the way.
phrases.clear_night: Late tonight, guests on the terrace sit by the fire pit under a clear sky of stars above Paradise Bay.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the bay this morning, and the pool deck already has its first guests on the wooden boards.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Scattered clouds pass over the Aegean this afternoon, giving the tables at the Pool Bar & Restaurant some shade now and then.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds in the west are lit by the last sun, and from the waterfront terrace the sea turns orange.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Aegean from the upper-floor suites looks flat and silver, and the loungers are mostly empty.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on both private beaches, and guests are inside the SENSE spa, where the indoor pool is open.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were at a suite window tonight, you would see lightning flash over the open Aegean beyond Paradise Bay.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the bay, so the horizon from the terrace is not sharp and the far coast is hard to see.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Bodrum, but today it is falling on the olive trees above the beach while the Aegean stays grey.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold, clear day, the outdoor massage beds stay empty and guests watch the sea through their suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot this afternoon, so most guests are in the main pool or their private suite pools, facing the Aegean.
phrases.mild_night: Under a mild cloudy sky after midnight, the terrace fire pit glows beside the pool above the dark Aegean.
phrases.reduced_visibility: If you were on the waterfront terrace now, you would see Paradise Bay and the beach, but not the Aegean horizon.
phrases.late_night: If you came back late from dinner at Gigi Bodrum tonight, you would see the moon on the open Aegean from your suite.
phrases.wet_evening: If you took a last drink from the Pool Bar to your suite tonight, you would watch rain fall on the Aegean.
phrases.grey_evening: With a last drink in a sea-view suite now, you would see low cloud over Paradise Bay and lights along the shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the clock tower of Flinders Street Station is already clear against a dark sky from the Yarra View Suite balcony.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the floor-to-ceiling windows of the corner rooms, and the Yarra River below looks blue rather than brown.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the skyline is sharp from the guest rooms, Eureka Tower and Australia 108 included, with no haze at all.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the suite balcony now, you would see low sun on the front of Flinders Street Station.
phrases.clear_night: Flinders Street Station is lit in purple tonight, seen directly from the Yarra View Suite balcony along with the skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the Southbank skyline this morning, and the Yarra River below the corner rooms turns grey, then blue again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun cross the Southbank skyline this afternoon, and the station clock tower is in light one minute, shade the next.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud turns orange over Flinders Street Station in the last hour of sun, which the suite balcony faces directly.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Melbourne today, but Flinders Street Station is across the street, so the view from the rooms loses little.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Flinders Street Station opposite, and from the guest room windows the Yarra River looks flat and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Southbank skyline is visible from the corner rooms, and the floor-to-ceiling windows give a wide view of each flash.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of Eureka Tower today, while Flinders Street Station, directly across the street, stays easy to see.
phrases.snow: Snow in central Melbourne is very rare, so if it were falling past the suite balcony now, guests would be filming it.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold Melbourne day the clear air makes the MCG and Australia 108 unusually sharp from the guest rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Melbourne today, and the air above the Yarra River shimmers when seen from the Yarra View Suite balcony.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the Yarra View Suite balcony is comfortable for watching the lit station and the river below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the MCG is not visible from the guest rooms, though Flinders Street Station across the street is.
phrases.late_night: In the Yarra View Suite the curtain stays open for sleep tonight, and the skyline lights across the Yarra fill the window.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Platform 270, rain runs down the Yarra View Suite window and the city lights blur along the river.
phrases.grey_evening: From the Yarra View Suite after dinner at Platform 270, Southbank lights reflect in the Yarra under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Li Galli islands are a low shape across the water from the rooftop pool, with no one swimming yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is being served on Terrace Regina under a clear sky, and Fornillo Tower is easy to pick out below.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop pool faces a bright sea, and the Li Galli islands look sharp under the full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a Deluxe Special terrace now, you would see the low sun lighting Fornillo Tower from the side.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Positano is clear, and from the sea-view rooms the Li Galli islands are only a dark outline.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds are passing over the limestone peaks this morning, but the infinity pool still has sun at the moment.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud move over the water this afternoon, so the colour of the sea off Fornillo Beach changes often.
phrases.partly_golden: The dining tables on the terrace face the last sun, which comes through gaps in cloud over the Li Galli islands.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the whole coast today, but Fornillo Tower and the islands can still be seen from the rooftop pool.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop pool, and guests watch the wet coast from the arched doorways of their suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over the sea right now, and lightning can be seen from the sea-view rooms while the terraces stay empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water today means the Li Galli islands are faint from Terrace Regina, though Fornillo Tower is closer and clear.
phrases.snow: Today a few flakes of snow fall over Fornillo Beach, an unusual sight from the suite terraces in Positano.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside today, so the Deluxe Special hot tubs are more popular than the rooftop pool.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the coast today, and most guests are in the infinity pool rather than at the tables.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, guests on the Deluxe Special terraces can sit in the hot tub above a dark sea.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so the Li Galli islands cannot be made out from the pool, though Fornillo Tower still can.
phrases.late_night: Anyone back in a Deluxe Special suite after dinner in Positano has the village lights spread down the cliff to the sea.
