phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the bay this morning, and guests at Opus are starting breakfast in the art deco dining room.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of shade cross the Arabian Sea this afternoon, visible from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Premium Sea-View Rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were at AER right now, you would see the last sun colouring the clouds above the Mumbai skyline.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Mumbai today, and from the soaking tub the treetops and the sea look flat and pale.
phrases.rain: Monsoon-style rain hides most of the Arabian Sea from the sea-view rooms, and the 3rd-floor pool is empty.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Arabian Sea, and the floor-to-ceiling windows of the sea-view rooms give a dry place to watch it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Mumbai, so from the 34th floor the skyline fades out and the sea has no clear horizon.
phrases.snow: Snow over Mumbai would be a first, and guests at the sea-view room windows would watch the Arabian Sea in disbelief.
phrases.very_cold: Cold air, unusual for Mumbai, moves through the open-air rooftop bar AER while the view of the bay stays clear.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot over Worli today, so most guests spend the afternoon in the water of the third-floor pool.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the mild air at AER and the lit city skyline still make a good evening.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the sea-view rooms the nearby water shows but the far skyline does not.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water and a look through the Premium Sea-View Room window, where the coast is city lights now.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Premium Sea-View Rooms tonight, and the Worli lights blur toward the Arabian Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Worli after midnight, and the skyline lights spread wide in the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Premium Sea-View Rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, river-side rooms show the Río de la Plata as a flat grey band under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Rooftop breakfast is served under a clear sky, with the pool and the Puerto Madero skyline in plain view.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop sundeck has full sun, and the lounge chairs by the pool fill up quickly.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The rooftop pool gets low golden light now, and the city skyline behind it looks sharp against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: From a high-floor suite, the floor-to-ceiling windows frame the lit Puerto Madero skyline under a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Ecological Reserve this morning, so the green seen from the rooms changes between shade and sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on the rooftop terrace this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows moving across the river.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky over the Río de la Plata outside the river-side windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the river and the reserve look dull from the glass walls, and the rooftop pool is mostly empty.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Río de la Plata turns the same grey as the sky.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm over the Río de la Plata means lightning seen from the river-side rooms and an empty rooftop pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of the river today, so the glass walls mainly show the near edge of the Ecological Reserve.
phrases.snow: From the river-side rooms, a rare snowfall over Buenos Aires would show white flakes dropping into the grey Río de la Plata.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold, the rooftop lounge chairs stay empty and guests watch the river through the glass walls instead.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Puerto Madero, and the rooftop pool is the busiest place in the hotel right now.
phrases.mild_night: From the rooftop terrace, Puerto Madero skyline lights glow under a cloudy sky on this mild night.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the glass walls the river fades out a short way from shore.
phrases.late_night: Everything is switched off in the river-side suites, and the Puerto Madero waterfront is the only light left inside.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass of the river-side rooms, and the Puerto Madero lights show blurred through it before bed.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtains open after midnight, the lights of Puerto Madero show under low cloud through the floor-to-ceiling windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over the beach is clear and dark, and the meandering pool sits empty below the balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: From the upper floors this morning, the view runs from the sand all the way to Isla Mujeres under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the beachfront terrace, and most guests have moved to the shaded daybeds or into the pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the palm-lined beach and the pier, seen through the gym's glass wall by anyone still pedalling.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see a clear sky from the panoramic balcony of the Ocean Front Suite King.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Caribbean this morning, and the turquoise water still shows through the glass balcony doors.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the pool this afternoon, so the palapa bar loses the sun every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds turn orange above Isla Mujeres, visible from the upper-floor rooms.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the whole Hotel Zone coastline today, and the sea looks darker than usual from the beachfront terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the meandering pool and the beach, and the terrace dining tables are empty for now.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Caribbean is easy to watch from behind the glass balcony doors of a guest room.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the water today, and Isla Mujeres is hard to make out even from the upper floors.
phrases.snow: Snow is reported today, which almost never happens here, and the palapa bar by the pool stands empty.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air for Cancún today, and the shaded daybeds on the terrace are empty while the sea stays turquoise.
phrases.very_hot: The heat today is extreme, so the meandering pool between the resort and the beach is the busiest place.
phrases.mild_night: Guests on the fourth-floor balcony on this mild cloudy night see hotel lights along the Hotel Zone coastline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the pool and the beach are clear but Isla Mujeres cannot be seen from the rooms.
phrases.late_night: The curtain stays open at bedtime in the Ocean Front Suite King, and moonlight shows on the Caribbean after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass doors of the Ocean Front Suite after midnight, and the Hotel Zone lights blur along the coast.
phrases.grey_evening: Clouds cover Punta Cancun, and from the Ocean Front Suite the lights of the Hotel Zone coastline show through the open curtain.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Chicago River below the Miru terrace is still dark while the lake horizon begins to turn pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the fitness center windows, early guests can see the skyline and Lake Michigan in clear morning sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over Navy Pier, and the Ferris wheel stands out sharply from the suite bedroom windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light hits the downtown towers, and from the rooftop terrace the glass fronts turn orange for an hour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the John Jacob Astor Suite tonight, you would see the lit skyline and a dark Lake Michigan beyond.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the lake this morning, and from the soaking tubs Navy Pier is sometimes in sun, sometimes in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the Miru terrace this afternoon have broken cloud above them and the river moving directly below.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, gaps between the clouds put patches of light on the towers seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Chicago today, so Lake Michigan looks grey too from the indoor pool windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Chicago River right now, and the Miru terrace seats are empty while diners stay inside.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Lake Michigan is visible from the suite windows, and nobody is sitting out on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of Navy Pier's Ferris wheel today, and the lake beyond it is not visible at all.
phrases.snow: Snow is coming down past the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Astor Suite, and the nearby towers look white at the edges.
phrases.very_cold: Air this cold can bring ice to the edge of Lake Michigan, clearly visible from the soaking tubs that face it.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Chicago today, so sailboats are out on Lake Michigan and the Miru terrace is quiet until evening.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Chicago, with the Ferris wheel lights on and the river still visible below the Miru terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the river below the terrace is clear enough, but Navy Pier and the lake are faint outlines.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner at Miru, the John Jacob Astor Suite windows show the river lights and the skyline towers after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open after midnight, rain streaks the John Jacob Astor Suite glass and the skyline lights blur bright through it.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open in the John Jacob Astor Suite, the skyline lights show under low cloud, and the river lights reach toward the lake.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic outside a north-facing Superior Oceanside window is still dark grey, with the horizon line just appearing.
phrases.clear_morning: From the corner room's wrap-around windows, the sea and the coastal cliffs are both sharp in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: On the timber deck, guests are eating at the wooden tables with the turquoise sea and distant headland behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the sun terrace now, you would see the low sun lighting the cliffs on the headland.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Atlantic is black beyond the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling glass, and diners mostly see their own reflections in it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the open sea this morning, and the water seen from the Superior Oceanside rooms changes from blue to grey.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the beer garden this afternoon, some tables are in sun and some in cloud shadow, all facing the Atlantic.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the cloud and puts bright patches on the sea below the sun terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the sea from the Newquay suite's picture window is grey too, and the horizon is a soft line.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the restaurant's tall glass windows, and the wooden tables on the deck outside are empty and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over the Atlantic, and from the corner room's wrap-around windows guests can watch lightning far out at sea.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the horizon today, and from the sun terrace only the nearest cliffs can be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on Pentire Headland, but today it falls past the Superior Oceanside windows and melts on the deck.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold on the headland, so guests watch the clear sea from inside the restaurant rather than the deck.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot for Cornwall today, and the beer garden benches facing the Atlantic are the most wanted seats in the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and a few guests sit out on the timber deck with the sea audible but not visible.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the distant headland cannot be seen from the deck and the horizon is a grey blur.
phrases.late_night: Dinner is long over, and white surf shows below the corner room's windows after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: Well after dinner, past midnight, rain runs down the Superior Oceanside window and the Atlantic can be heard beyond the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner, the Superior Oceanside window reflects the room lights tonight, and the Atlantic surf sounds through the glass under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Cathedral spires stand dark against a clear sky, seen from the four balconies of the Grand Master Suite.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the stone of the Cathedral front, and the rooftop loungers at L'Àtic are already in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: From the L'Àtic terrace, the Cathedral bell towers sit level with the tables in full midday sun under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Cathedral spires orange, and from the Grand Master Suite each balcony frames a slightly different side.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at L'Àtic tonight, you would sit level with the lit bell towers under a clear sky, no reservation needed.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Gothic Quarter this morning, and the Cathedral spires move in and out of sun from the rooftop.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud cross Barcelona this afternoon, so the white tables on the rooftop get sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the Cathedral spires between clouds, a view the rooftop wire chairs face directly.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Cathedral of Barcelona's bell towers stand level with the rooftop terrace, their stone pale and flat.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop terrace, so most guests watch the wet Cathedral spires from the balcony doors of their rooms instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the Gothic Quarter, and from the Grand Master Suite the Cathedral spires show briefly in each flash.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Barcelona today, and the bell towers level with L'Àtic look soft at the edges but are still visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Barcelona, but today a few flakes fall past the Grand Master Suite balconies in front of the Cathedral.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing on the rooftop, so the wire chairs stay empty while the Cathedral spires stand sharp.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day like today, the rooftop umbrellas give the only shade while the Cathedral stone shines in strong sun.
phrases.mild_night: On this warm cloudy night, guests at L'Àtic sit level with the illuminated Cathedral spires with no reservation needed.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility over Barcelona today means the Cathedral opposite is clear, but the wider city beyond the rooftop is not.
phrases.late_night: If you turned everything off in the Grand Master Suite, the Gothic Quarter lights would be the only glow left inside.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were up at L'Àtic for a last drink tonight, you would see the Cathedral's bell towers through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink at L'Àtic tonight, you would see the Cathedral's bell towers at eye level under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sky Lounge windows show the pier and the surf while the sky over the Indian Ocean turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is being set out eleven storeys up, and the coastline from Umhlanga Rocks to the Bluff is sharp today.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is straight over North Beach, and from the suite windows the sand looks almost white.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: By late afternoon the sun sits behind the building, and from the terrace the pier and the surf are evenly lit.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would look down at the promenade and the dark sea from a kitchenette suite window.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit in patches over the Indian Ocean this morning, and the Sky Lounge buffet goes on regardless.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud, some sun over the Golden Mile this afternoon, and the yellow lounge chairs by the pool are in use.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun puts colour on a few clouds over the sea, visible from the terrace above Snell Parade.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the surf at North Beach still breaks white, which is easy to check from the restaurant windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the promenade and the palms, and breakfast in the Sky Lounge happens behind dry glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over the Indian Ocean right now, and the floor-to-ceiling windows upstairs give a very wide view of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the sea today means the coastline towards Umhlanga Rocks is missing, though the pier is still there.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Durban, so flakes over the promenade get a lot of attention from the terrace.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold for Durban today, and the pool deck with its wood boards and yellow chairs stays mostly empty.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day like this one, the outdoor pool is where guests are, not the paved promenade across the road.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night in Durban, and the terrace is a reasonable place to sit and listen to the surf.
phrases.reduced_visibility: If you were in the Sky Lounge now, you would see the pier and the surf but not the Bluff.
phrases.late_night: The only light left in a studio suite now comes from the promenade lights along the Golden Mile.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain left open, rain streaks the studio suite window and the Golden Mile promenade lamps come through blurred.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open in a kitchenette suite, the Golden Mile promenade lamps shine along the beach under low cloud tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Still dark outside, but the clear sky before sunrise makes the Space Needle an easy shape from the view rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at Elevation Restaurant and Lounge starts before Seattle's morning rush, and the sky outside is completely clear.
phrases.clear_midday: From a Space Needle View room, the downtown skyscrapers and the landmark sit under a blue sky at midday.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights one side of the Space Needle, seen directly through the floor-to-ceiling room windows.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Space Needle is lit up, and the downtown towers show their lights through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.partly_morning: If you were there this morning, you would see clouds passing above the Space Needle and the downtown skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over Seattle this afternoon, so the Space Needle is sometimes in sun and sometimes in shade.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds turn orange above the Space Needle in the room windows.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers downtown today, but the Space Needle is still clearly visible from the view rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is running down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Space Needle looks blurred behind the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Seattle shows up well from the view rooms, with the Space Needle in the same frame.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the upper part of the Space Needle today, so the view rooms show mostly the nearer downtown buildings.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on downtown Seattle, a rare sight, and the Space Needle stands white-topped in the room windows.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside, and the air is clear enough to see every detail of the Space Needle.
phrases.very_hot: Seattle is unusually hot today, and the sheer curtains in the seating areas help against the strong sun on the glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the lit Space Needle and the downtown street lights show through the guest room windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the downtown buildings are clear from the rooms but the Space Needle is only a faint outline.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Space Needle View rooms show the Needle's saucer top above the lit downtown towers, hard to stop watching.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner at Elevation, the Space Needle's round top shows through the rain above the wet downtown lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from Elevation, the Space Needle View rooms have the Needle's thin outline against low cloud and lit downtown streets tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop terrace is empty and the outline of St. Stephen's spire is already visible against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the suite sitting rooms, morning sun lands on the ornate facades across the street, and the arched windows frame them.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun comes through the bar lounge's floor-to-ceiling windows and turns the church's green copper spire a brighter colour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop terrace tonight, you would see St. Stephen's spire as a dark shape against the clear sky.

phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the rooftop restaurant's angled glass walls show city rooftops that go from bright to grey as clouds move.

phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the Innere Stadt, and from the rooftop restaurant the lightning shows up briefly behind St. Stephen's spire.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over Vienna today hides St. Stephen's spire from the rooftop terrace, though the Peterskirche dome next door is still clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the Peterskirche dome and bell tower, seen close up from the Asaya Spa relaxation lounge.
phrases.very_cold: It feels well below freezing on the rooftop terrace, so guests watch the spire from behind the bar lounge windows instead.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the rooftop terrace is nearly empty, and the heat is visible as shimmer over the city rooftops.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild but cloudy, and the rooftop restaurant's glass walls show the city rooftops without any stars above them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor, so from the rooftop terrace only the Peterskirche dome and St. Stephen's spire stay sharp, not the far rooftops.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water at a window, and St Stephen's spire is on the skyline above the lit rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain left open after midnight, rain streaks the window and the city's wet lights blur around St Stephen's spire.
phrases.grey_evening: The suite curtains are open after midnight, and St Stephen's spire shows against cloud made pale by the city lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: The soaking tub window shows only a dark lagoon and a few stars at this hour, with sunrise still to come.
phrases.clear_morning: From a villa deck this morning, the shallow lagoon shows its turquoise colour clearly, with no other resort in sight.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun on the white sand beaches is strong, so most guests stay under the thatched roofs or in the villa pools.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Tables on the overwater dining deck are being set as the sun drops toward the ocean behind the palm trees.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the treetop dining pavilion lit among the palms and stars over the lagoon.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over North Malé Atoll this morning, and their shadows move across the lagoon below the villa decks.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the island this afternoon, so the turquoise of the lagoon changes shade every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: On the overwater dining deck, the last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and lights the set tables.
phrases.overcast: The sky over the atoll is grey today, and the lagoon under the hammock nets looks pale rather than turquoise.

phrases.thunderstorm: From the soaking tub window, lightning flashes above the distant islands while thunder rolls across the North Malé Atoll lagoon.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the ocean today, and the distant islands seen from the soaking tub window are faint or gone.
phrases.snow: Snow is not expected in the Maldives; if the report is right, flakes are landing on the thatched villa roofs today.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air is very rare on this atoll, so today the hammock nets over the lagoon are probably empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the island today, and the shallow lagoon beside the overwater villas is where most guests cool off.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy sky tonight, the air is warm, and the lit treetop dining pavilion stands out above the dark palms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the overwater villas the distant islands are not visible, only the lagoon close by.
phrases.late_night: In the overwater villas the glass stays bare at bedtime, and the lagoon below shows a few villa lights.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the glass of an overwater villa, and the lagoon shows in the light from the room.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, with the curtains open, the lagoon under the overwater villas catches their light beneath a cloudy sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Burj Khalifa stands as a dark outline above a quiet lake in the Palace Room window.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the Burj Khalifa warm gold, seen from a private Palace Fountain Suite balcony close to the lake.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the fountain jets are lit on the lake, and guests on the Thiptara terrace watch the illuminated tower above them.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass behind the top of the Burj Khalifa this morning, framed in the Palace Room window.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds move across the afternoon sky over Downtown Dubai, and the lake in front of the hotel changes from bright to grey.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the waterfront terrace now, you would see the last sun colour a few clouds beside the tower.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Burj Khalifa looks flat and silver, and the lake outside the Palace Rooms is dull.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Dubai, so guests in the Palace Rooms are watching drops on the lake and the tower behind it.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers Downtown Dubai today, and from Thiptara the top of the Burj Khalifa is hidden while the lake stays clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Dubai, but if it fell now, Palace Room guests would watch it against the Burj Khalifa.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing weather is nearly impossible in Dubai, but today the pool terrace is empty and the tower sharp in clear air.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside, so most guests stay behind glass in the Palace Rooms, where the fountain and tower fill the window.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and two guests on the waterfront terrace share shisha while the lit skyscrapers reflect in the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Palace Rooms the lake is clear but the upper Burj Khalifa fades into grey.
phrases.late_night: The only light left inside a Palace Fountain Suite after midnight comes from downtown across the lake, Burj Khalifa above it.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Thiptara, the Palace Room window shows the Burj Khalifa through the rain, high above the lake.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Thiptara, a Palace Room window shows the tower across the lake, its top in low cloud tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky over Midtown is clear but still dark, and the Empire State Building shows as an outline from the Junior Suite.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning sun lights the Midtown skyline, and from the suite desk the Empire State Building shows every detail.

phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Midtown this morning, and from the floor-to-ceiling windows they seem to move behind the Empire State Building.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Junior Suite window this afternoon, the Empire State Building stands in patchy sunlight under a part-clouded Midtown sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds over the Midtown skyline, a view guests in the terrace suite get from outdoors.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud sits over Midtown today, and the Empire State Building's top looks flat and pale through the wraparound windows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and the Empire State Building is a blurred shape while guests eat at Ai Fiori downstairs.
phrases.thunderstorm: Storm clouds sit over Manhattan, and each lightning flash shows the Empire State Building clearly from the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Midtown today, and from the upper-floor rooms only the lower part of the Empire State Building can be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Fifth Avenue, and guests in the Junior Suite watch the flakes pass in front of the Empire State Building.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air over Manhattan today, so the sky is clear and the Empire State Building shows sharply from the window.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot New York afternoon, the Empire State Building looks a little hazy through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night over Midtown, with the Empire State Building's lights showing under the clouds from the terrace suite.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far ends of the Midtown skyline are missing, though the Empire State Building nearby still shows.
phrases.late_night: Up late in the Junior Suite, you could watch the Empire State spire among the lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Were you having a last drink in the Junior Suite with Empire State View, rain on the window would blur the spire.
phrases.grey_evening: A last drink tonight in the Empire State suite would show you the spire against low cloud, Midtown lit around it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic outside the balcony doors is still dark, and the pine trees are only outlines.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the terrace comes with the ocean showing blue between the pine trunks this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests at the saltwater pool this midday look past the pine trees to the Atlantic under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on your balcony now, you would see the sun low over the Atlantic, straight ahead.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the ocean is clear, and guests on the Terrassa terrace eat with the sea dark below the pines.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit over the Atlantic this morning, so the water changes between grey and blue as seen from the pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Half the sky is cloud this afternoon, and from the covered terrace the Atlantic looks bright in places and dull in others.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds cover part of the sky, so the ocean beyond the terrace is lit in places.
phrases.overcast: Under a fully grey sky, the Atlantic from the balconies looks flat and grey too, with the horizon hard to find.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the saltwater pool, and most guests have moved to the heated indoor pool or the Turkish bath.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is passing over the Atlantic, and the lightning is easy to watch from behind the balcony doors.
phrases.fog_haze: From the breakfast terrace, the Atlantic beyond the pine trees is pale and faint in the midday haze.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare this close to Guincho, but if it fell, the outdoor jacuzzi would be the warmest place to see it.
phrases.very_cold: From the Terrassa terrace now, you would see the Atlantic through the pines in hard winter light, the lounge chairs empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the coast this afternoon, and the saltwater pool is the only place guests stay for long.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night, and guests sit on their balconies with drinks, though the Atlantic is just a dark space in front.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the Terrassa terrace, the pool and the near Atlantic water show in the haze, but the far horizon stays hidden today.
phrases.late_night: If you were sleeping in a sea-view room now, the Atlantic would be there in the window at first light.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were up for a last drink tonight, you would see rain on the balcony door and hear the Atlantic behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were finishing a glass by the balcony door now, you would see the coast lights toward Cascais under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop running track is empty and the Tagus River is a dark line beyond the city hills.
phrases.clear_morning: From a corner suite this morning, both Eduardo VII Park and the Tagus River are sharp under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The outdoor pool is in full sun at midday, and the red umbrellas are the only shade near the loungers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suite living rooms, and Lisbon's rooftops look orange from inside.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop tonight, you would see the lights of Lisbon under a completely clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Eduardo VII Park this morning, and runners on the rooftop track have the Tagus in view.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the city hills this afternoon, and the twin rooms get changing light through their large windows.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, gaps between the clouds put patches of light on the Tagus River in the distance.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky today, the view from the corner suites is flat and even, park and river both without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the outdoor pool and its loungers, so guests who want to swim are using the indoor pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm nobody uses the rooftop running track, and lightning over the city is visible from the suite windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Tagus estuary today means the river is only a pale shape when seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Lisbon, but today a few flakes fall on the palm trees around the outdoor pool.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing on the rooftop running track today, and the clear air shows the Tagus River in detail.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day like this, most guests stay under the red umbrellas or in the outdoor pool water.
phrases.mild_night: It is a warm cloudy night over Lisbon, and guests leaving CURA after dinner walk up to the rooftop for air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the corner suites Eduardo VII Park is clear but the Tagus River is not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the corner suites keep Lisbon's lights and the Tagus in one window, and the river itself returns at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the corner suite windows this evening, and the lit city shows through the wet glass out to the Tagus.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Lisbon after midnight, and the corner suites look over the park to the lit city along the Tagus.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Strip's lights are still on, and the desert mountains show as a dark line from the guest room windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning from a Sky Suite: MGM Grand and New York-New York are clearly visible in front of the desert mountains.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the Strip, and the one-touch system covers the floor-to-ceiling windows for anyone who prefers shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light reaches the desert mountains behind the Strip, and guests at the adults-only Liquid Pool Lounge are still outside.
phrases.clear_night: At night the Strip is fully lit, and the soaking tub beside the suite windows faces all of it directly.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Strip this morning, but the view from the Sky Suites still reaches the mountains.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Partly cloudy afternoon in Las Vegas, which means some shade for the lounge chairs under the blue umbrellas at the pool.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in a king room, you would see the last sun on the mountains while the Strip lights come on.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the Strip today, so the desert mountains look pale and the casino floor is as bright as ever.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Strip, which is rare here, and from the guest room windows MGM Grand looks grey and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning behind the mountains is easy to watch from a Sky Suite while the thunderstorm passes over Las Vegas.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the Strip today, so the distant mountains are faint and New York-New York is the clearest landmark.
phrases.snow: Snow in Las Vegas is unusual, but today a thin layer sits on the blue umbrellas by the outdoor pool.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold daytime air for Las Vegas, and the outdoor pool's lounge chairs are empty while the casino is not.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the Strip, and the adults-only Liquid Pool Lounge is where the afternoon actually gets spent.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Las Vegas, and the Strip is lit as usual below the king room windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, and the distant desert mountains are not visible, but MGM Grand across the Strip still is.
phrases.late_night: Anyone in a Sky Suite who wakes for a glass of water near midnight sees the Strip lights through the floor-to-ceiling window.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Sky Suites are likely ending the day at the window, the Strip lights blurred by rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a Sky Suite tonight can see the Strip's lights under low cloud from the floor-to-ceiling windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Aegean outside the villa bedrooms is still dark grey, and the private pools lie flat and quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: From the terraces above Elia, Delos and the Mykonian hills are already sharp in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the pool decks, and guests are using the thatched cabanas for shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the rocky coastline orange, seen from the infinity pool, and the sea towards Delos goes calm.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the open bedroom wall full of stars over a black Aegean.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Mykonian hills this morning, while the sea off Elia stays mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the water below the terraces, so Delos is bright one minute and dull the next.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the cloud, and from the glass balustrade the bay looks partly gold, partly grey.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the 360-degree view is still there, but the Aegean and Delos are flat and colourless today.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare on Mykonos, so guests are watching it hit the infinity pools from behind the bedroom glass doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the sea is visible from the sofas on the terrace, and the pool decks are empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits on the water, so from the pool decks Delos is only a faint shape and the distant islands are gone.
phrases.snow: Snow on Mykonos is almost unheard of, but if it fell, the stone fireplace in the villa bedroom would be lit.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold clear day, the sea view is as sharp as ever, but the private pools have no swimmers.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over Elia means most guests are in the infinity pools, looking at Delos from the water.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, with no stars, and the terrace sofas under the straw canopy are still in use.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Delos and the distant islands cannot be seen from the terraces, only the nearby coastline.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water in the sea-view bedroom, and the Aegean sounds through the open glass doors.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the sea-view bedroom's glass, and the pool ripples under a cloudy moon.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud moves slowly over the Aegean after midnight, and from the villa bedroom's wide window no stars show above Elia.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Nile is dark on all three sides of the tower, and the river-facing balconies are still quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: From a river-facing balcony, the clock tower and the city skyline across the Nile are sharp in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool edge and the Nile are the same bright level, with the stone bridge clear beyond.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun is going down over the Nile, and the same balcony that showed sunrise now shows sunset.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lights of both banks reach the water, and the riverside terrace has rattan seats free.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over Cairo this morning, but the clock tower across the Nile is still easy to see from the balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the city skyline this afternoon, and the infinity pool gets sun for a few minutes at a time.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on a balcony now, you would see the last sun through gaps in the clouds, above the bridge.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Cairo today, and the Nile looks grey too from the terrace lounge and its wicker seats.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Cairo, and the open-air terrace has no roof, so guests watch the wet Nile from their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm over the Nile is a rare event here, and the river-facing rooms have the widest view of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the city today, and the skyline across the Nile is only a faint outline from the pool.
phrases.snow: Snow in Cairo almost never happens, but if it fell today, you would see it from a balcony over the Nile.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold outside for Cairo, and the open-air terrace has more empty rattan chairs than usual.
phrases.very_hot: Cairo is very hot today, and the infinity pool, level with the Nile, is where most guests are right now.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests on the open-air terrace watch the Nile from rattan seats under the palm trees.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balconies the near bank and the bridge show, but the far skyline does not.
phrases.late_night: Long after midnight the river rooms have the bridge lights on the Nile to watch, and the lit city behind them.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open before bed, rain streaks the glass and the lights on both Nile banks blur in the water.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open in a Nile-facing room after midnight, lights from both banks reflect in the river under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balcony of a Superior Sea-View Room shows the Great Orme as a dark shape against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests at breakfast see the bay and the Ferris wheel through the large windows, under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Rooftop gives the whole arc of North Shore beach, the pier and the Great Orme in strong sunlight.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun falls across the Great Orme, and from the private balcony the pebble beach turns a warmer colour.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, diners at the restaurant windows see the town lights along the promenade and a dark bay beyond.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Llandudno Bay this morning, and from the Rooftop the Great Orme goes in and out of shadow.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were taking afternoon tea now, you would see patches of sun on the bay and the Ferris wheel.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the broken clouds above the pier orange, best seen from the Rooftop's glass balustrade.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Llandudno Bay today, and the Great Orme looks flat and dark from the seafront rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the large restaurant windows, so the bay view comes with wet glass and a hot pot of tea inside.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, lightning over Llandudno Bay is visible from the balcony rooms, though most guests watch it through the window.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the bay, and from the Rooftop the Great Orme is only a faint outline or not there at all.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare here, but when it falls the pebble beach and the pier turn white below the balcony rooms.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold clear air gives a sharp view of the Great Orme, and the Rooftop is for short visits in a coat.
phrases.very_hot: Llandudno rarely gets this hot, and the Rooftop terrace is in full sun with the pebble beach busy below.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the pier lights shine along Llandudno Bay below the Superior Sea-View Room balcony.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the seafront rooms the Great Orme is a blur and the far bay is hidden.
phrases.late_night: Promenade lights line the bay outside the seafront rooms after midnight, a good hour to sleep; the Great Orme shows at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Long after dinner at The Terrace Restaurant, rain runs down the seafront room's window and the promenade lights blur along Llandudno Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Long after dinner in the Terrace Restaurant, the Superior Sea-View Room shows the promenade lights along Llandudno Bay under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Hwangudan Shrine pavilion outside the guest room windows is only a dark shape against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the fitness center, early runners on the treadmills look out over downtown buildings in sharp, clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the skylight above the indoor pool throws bright reflections onto the blue mosaic tiles, and the city is clear beyond.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the dining room, the distant mountains behind the skyline show clearly in the late afternoon sun.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the city lights below the Junior Suite windows are clear and steady, with no cloud over Seoul.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Seoul this morning, so the Hwangudan Shrine pavilion outside the guest rooms is lit, then shaded, then lit again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun and cloud cross the mid-rise skyline this afternoon, seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the guest rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the skyline in broken patches from the dining room, with the mountains partly hidden by cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the downtown buildings outside the fitness center windows look flat, and the heated pool stays the better option.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the guest rooms, so the saunas and Korean baths are the sensible indoor choice.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Seoul skyline shows clearly from the Junior Suite windows, while the indoor pool under its skylight is unaffected.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the distant mountains behind the skyline today, and from the dining room only the nearest city buildings show clearly.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the roof of the Hwangudan Shrine pavilion outside the guest room windows, while the pool inside stays heated.
phrases.very_cold: From the guest room windows, the Hwangudan Shrine pavilion sits in hard winter light, frost edging the glass.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, most guests are in the indoor pool at the City Athletic Club, with the city visible beyond the glass.
phrases.mild_night: A warm, cloudy night in Seoul, and the city lights below the Junior Suites are soft, with no stars above downtown.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the distant mountains are not in view from the dining room; only nearby downtown buildings show.
phrases.late_night: In a Junior Suite the curtain is left open tonight, and downtown Seoul's lit windows are the last thing seen before sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Junior Suite windows after midnight, and the lights of downtown Seoul blur behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze drifts across downtown Seoul after midnight, and the lights of the mid-rise skyline show through it from the Junior Suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tauferer Ahrntal is still dark below the chalet windows, and the Dolomites show as a sharp outline.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests at breakfast on the chalet terrace this morning look down the Tauferer Ahrntal to the Dolomites under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday brings the JOHANNS lunch of small plates, and the Dolomites stand sharp under the high sun down the valley.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Apple strudel comes from the patisserie at tea time, as the slopes near the chalet lose the sun before the Dolomites do.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in your terrace whirlpool now, you would see stars in a clear sky above the Dolomites to the south.
phrases.partly_morning: From the chalet terrace, the Dolomites stand at the south end of the valley under patchy morning cloud.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the floor-to-ceiling windows show a mix of cloud shadow and sun moving across the slopes of the Tauferer Ahrntal.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud leaves some light on the Dolomites while the near ridgelines are already in shade.
phrases.overcast: If you were at the window now, you would see the Dolomites grey under low cloud at the valley's southern end.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the forested slopes of the Tauferer Ahrntal, with the Dolomites at the southern end of the valley.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were there during this storm, you would watch the lightning from inside the chalet, not from the terrace whirlpool.
phrases.fog_haze: From the chalet terrace, daytime fog covers the Dolomites at the southern end of the Tauferer Ahrntal.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the chalet roofs and the forested slopes, and the terrace whirlpool is the warm way to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing outside, yet from the chalet terrace the Dolomites look sharp where they close the valley to the south.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in the Ahrntal today, so the outdoor pool and its sun loungers get more use than the sauna.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, Tina Marcelli's kitchen at JOHANNS is busy and the Dolomites are hidden in the dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Dolomites at the southern end are missing from the glass, though the nearer slopes still show.
phrases.late_night: If you were awake after midnight, you could look down the valley toward the Dolomites, the chalet windows lit below the glass.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in the chalet after midnight, you would watch snow fall past the windows toward the Dolomites.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink at the chalet window now, you would see cloud over the Dolomites at the valley's south end.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gherkin is already a dark outline against a clear sky from the guest room windows.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were in the Walbrook Suite this morning, you would see St Paul's dome in full sun across the glass.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, sun reaches the desk by the window, and the Gherkin's glass panels reflect it straight back.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: By late afternoon, the sun lights the City towers outside the guest room glass, and the Shard turns orange on one side.
phrases.clear_night: From the restaurant tonight, the neoclassical building outside is lit, and the skyline behind it is clear and sharp.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the City this morning, and St Paul's dome is in sun one minute, shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A few clouds sit over the Gherkin this afternoon, visible from the desk by the window on the upper floors.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud leaves patches of orange on the City rooftops outside the room windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Shard and the Gherkin are still clearly visible through the glass, just without any shine.
phrases.rain: Raindrops run down the tall glass walls of the indoor pool, and swimmers look out at the church through wet panes.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the City towers is easy to see from the guest rooms, and the thunder arrives a few seconds later.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Shard today, and even the Gherkin is only a faint shape from the windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the City rooftops below St Paul's dome, which is rare enough that guests at the windows take photos.
phrases.very_cold: On very cold days the air over the City is clear, and every panel of the Gherkin shows from the windows.
phrases.very_hot: Heat over London this afternoon makes the towers around the Gherkin look slightly hazy from the guest room windows.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild, cloudy night over the City, and the lit neoclassical building outside the restaurant stands out clearly.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Shard is missing from today's view because of poor visibility, though St Paul's dome, much closer, still shows from the rooms.
phrases.late_night: After a late drink at Silverleaf, the Walbrook Suite's glass shows the Gherkin's curved outline among the City's lit windows.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtain is open before bed in the Walbrook Suite, and the City's lights blur through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the City after midnight, and the curtains of the Walbrook Suite stay open on the Gherkin's lit outline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lagoon villas look out on dark water and mangroves, and the plunge pools are still and quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: From a beach villa terrace, the Caribbean is already turquoise under a clear sky, and the loungers are empty.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the teak sun decks, so most guests sit in their private plunge pools.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a villa bedroom now, you would see the beach palms and the sea turn golden through the window.
phrases.clear_night: If you stood on a lagoon villa balcony late tonight, you would see stars over the calm water channel.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Caribbean this morning, and the open-air restaurant has its sea view with a few shadows on it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the thatched-roof boat is moving through the limestone channels under a sky that is half cloud, half blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds turn orange above the lagoon, seen from the tables at Saffron.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the whole estate today, so the Caribbean from the beach villas is more green than turquoise.
phrases.rain: From a lagoon-side villa balcony, rain falls on the calm water channel and the dark green mangroves beyond.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Caribbean keeps guests out of the plunge pools, so they watch the lightning from their villa bedrooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the lagoon today, and from Saffron the far side of the waterway is only a pale grey shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is reported, which almost never happens here, so the palms by the plunge pools would look strange with white on them.
phrases.very_cold: On an unusually cold day for Playa del Carmen, guests leave the plunge pools alone and use the bicycle trails instead.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over the whole estate today, so the private plunge pools are the only place anyone stays for long.
phrases.mild_night: A warm night with clouds, and the lagoon under a villa balcony is black except where the villa lights reach it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the open-air restaurant the sea is clear nearby but the horizon line is missing.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the moon is on the lagoon water, time for sleep, and at dawn the villa window shows green mangroves.
phrases.wet_evening: Before bed, rain streaks the beach villa's floor-to-ceiling window, and the palms outside look wet in the night.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open in a lagoon villa, low cloud hides the moon, and a few villa lamps show across the channel.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the moored boats in the marina basin are still dark shapes seen from the De Mar balcony.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop terrace, the white chairs are already in sun and the boats below sit on flat water.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun on the enclosed basin means the brasserie's waterfront tables are the busiest spot in the hotel right now.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun comes low across the moored boats, and guests on the rooftop terrace have it straight in their eyes.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the De Mar suite tonight, you would see the marina lights on the dark water from the balcony.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Brighton Marina this morning, and the water in the basin changes between grey and blue beneath the balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the De Mar balcony, afternoon light falls between clouds on the moored boats in the marina basin.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, some clouds are lit orange over the basin while guests watch from the waterfront bar.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the marina water looks grey too, and the rooftop terrace seating is mostly empty.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the moored boats, and the De Mar balcony is a place to look out from, not sit on.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the De Mar suite watch lightning flash over the moored boats in the enclosed marina basin below the balcony.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the basin, and from the balcony the nearest boats are visible while the far side is not.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Brighton, but today it is settling on the moored boats seen from the De Mar balcony.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air sits over the marina today, so the white chairs on the rooftop terrace have no takers.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot for Brighton today, and the turquoise sofa on the rooftop terrace sits in full sun above the marina.

phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain left open, the Premium Rooms' floor-to-ceiling window shows downtown's lit towers under tonight's low cloud.

phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has the duplex suite tonight can watch the lit village rooftops under low cloud before going to bed.

phrases.clear_morning: From the 13th-floor terrace of the Masterpiece Suite, the whole city and its water are clear in every direction this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun lights the City Hall tower, easy to pick out from the balconies without any haze in between.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the SUS rooftop terrace now, you would see the church spires turn orange as the sun drops.
phrases.clear_night: String lights are on at the rooftop bar, and the water beyond the skyline is dark and still under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the green church spire this morning, seen from the upper-floor rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the rooftops this afternoon, so the light on the City Hall tower changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds behind the City Hall tower, a view the balconies have on this side.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the 360-degree panorama from the Masterpiece Suite terrace is all muted rooftops and water today.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the upper rooms, and the picnic tables on the rooftop terrace stand empty.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, nobody sits at the rooftop bar tables; guests watch lightning over the water from upper-floor windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the church spires and the skyline today, so the 13th-floor terrace mostly shows white air in every direction.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftop terrace, and the city rooftops seen from the Masterpiece Suite are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the water and far skyline show clearly from the rooftop terrace, where few guests stay long.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot for Stockholm today, and the plunge pool on the Masterpiece Suite terrace is the coolest place with a 360-degree view.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night keeps guests at the rooftop bar's pink and teal tables late, with the city skyline in view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balconies the nearby church spire is clear but the far skyline and water are not.
phrases.late_night: If you turned off the room lights after midnight, the city lights along the water would fill the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last glass at an upper-floor window now, you would see City Hall's tower through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last glass at the window, you would see Stockholm's lights under low cloud, City Hall's tower among them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sagrada Família towers are already a dark outline from the upper rooms facing them.

phrases.clear_midday: Full midday sun on the suite windows makes the sheer curtains useful, and La Pedrera stands clear on the next corner.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the Sagrada Família from the west, and guests on the terrace watch Montjuïc turn orange.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the wicker pendants are lit on the 83.3 terrace, and the Sagrada Família towers stand under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Upper-room guests this morning see broken cloud put the Sagrada Família in sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop this afternoon, the Sagrada Família towers stand under a partly cloudy sky, with La Pedrera on the next corner.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the broken clouds over the Sagrada Família, and guests take the terrace seats early.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Barcelona, and from the 83.3 Terrace Bar the Sagrada Família shows but the sea does not.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop plants, and guests in the upper rooms watch the Sagrada Família through wet windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, the terrace empties and the lightning over the Eixample is better watched from the upper rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the city, so the Sagrada Família is a pale shape from the upper rooms and Montjuïc is not visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Barcelona, but today a few flakes land on the terrace plants while the Sagrada Família stays visible.
phrases.very_cold: From the empty 83.3 Terrace Bar, hard winter light shows the Sagrada Família towers and La Pedrera on the next corner.
phrases.very_hot: Under a very hot sky, the shaded terrace seats go first, and the Sagrada Família stands in strong sunlight.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, guests on the 83.3 terrace sit under the wicker pendants, the Sagrada Família in view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so from the terrace La Pedrera and the Sagrada Família are clear, but Montjuïc and the sea are not.
phrases.late_night: With the room lights off in an upper suite, you would see only the Eixample's lights and the Sagrada Família's towers.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink at the 83.3 Terrace Bar tonight, rain would blur the Sagrada Família's towers across the Eixample.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in an upper suite now, you would see the Sagrada Família's spires under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise on the Kaira Rooftop, guests sit on kilim cushions waiting for the first balloons to lift over Göreme.
phrases.clear_morning: Dozens of balloons are drifting over the fairy chimneys right now, close above the three terraces and their carpets.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the balloons are long gone, and the rooftop looks across Göreme's cave dwellings under a bright, empty sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun colours the fairy chimneys orange, seen from the terrace cushions with a Turkish tea tray within reach.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Kaira Rooftop serves dinner with live music, and Göreme's lights spread out below a clear starry sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds share the morning sky with the balloons, and from the rooftop both pass slowly over Göreme's carved skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the fairy chimneys this afternoon, watched from a cushioned sofa on one of the three terraces.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the terrace in the last hour of sun, you would see broken clouds turn orange over Göreme.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Göreme today, and the fairy chimneys show little colour from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the three terraces, so guests are inside the cave rooms or down in the underground hammam.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the valleys makes the rooftop a bad place to sit right now, and the cave rooms feel very solid.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of Göreme today, and from the terraces only the nearest fairy chimneys can be made out.
phrases.snow: Snow covers the fairy chimneys and the empty terrace cushions, and the underground hammam is the warmest place in the hotel.
phrases.very_cold: The air on the rooftop is close to freezing, so the view of Göreme is a short one before the hammam.
phrases.very_hot: If you stood on the Kaira Rooftop now, you would see heat-haze shaking the fairy chimneys of Göreme below the empty terraces.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, with no stars but Göreme's lights still visible from the lantern-lit Kaira Rooftop.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Haze limits the view today: the nearby fairy chimneys are clear from the terraces, but the far valleys are not.
phrases.late_night: The curtain in a cave room is left open after midnight, Göreme's lights in the window until the balloons rise at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the cave-room windows, and Göreme's lights blur over the valley where the balloons rise at dawn.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight low cloud moves over Göreme, and the town's lights show under it from the Kaira Rooftop, hours before the balloons.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before dawn, the downtown towers still show their night lights from the balcony doors of a Dallas Skyline room.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the brick mid-rise blocks of Uptown and the downtown towers beyond, seen through a Dallas Skyline room's balcony doors.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands high over Bank of America Plaza, seen clearly from the rooftop terrace dining area.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the downtown towers turn gold from the Upside West Village rooftop.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the terrace fireplace is lit and the lit downtown towers fill the floor-to-ceiling windows of the rooftop bar.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over downtown Dallas this morning, with sun coming and going on the brick mid-rise buildings outside the rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, patches of cloud move across the skyline while guests on the 8th-floor rooftop watch Bank of America Plaza.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over downtown turn orange, a view the rooftop terrace dining area faces directly.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Dallas skyline looks flat and grey from the rooftop lounge, but every tower is still visible.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop terrace today, so guests watch the wet downtown skyline from inside the rooftop bar.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over downtown Dallas shows up well through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the rooftop bar, which is the sensible place to be.
phrases.fog_haze: Dallas sits under haze today, and the downtown towers look pale and blurred from the Upside West Village rooftop lounge.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Dallas, but today the rooftop terrace is white and the fireplace gives the only warm seat outside.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day, the terrace fireplace is lit and the clear air makes the downtown skyline unusually sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the rooftop terrace this afternoon, so most guests look at downtown from behind the rooftop bar windows.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night covers downtown Dallas, and the rooftop terrace seating around the fireplace is in use.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop lounge Bank of America Plaza is a faint outline and nothing beyond shows.
phrases.late_night: Drapes stay drawn back on purpose in the Dallas Skyline category, and the lit downtown towers fill the window until sleep comes.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass of the Dallas Skyline rooms after midnight, and the downtown lights blur behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Dallas after midnight, and the downtown skyline lights show through the haze from the Dallas Skyline rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the private terraces look out onto a dark Atlantic under a clear sky with no cloud at all.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the clifftop gardens, and from the terraces the sea below the cliffs is already a deep blue.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pools of the clifftop villas sit under a cloudless sky, with the Atlantic directly beyond them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the limestone cliffs below the villa terraces orange, and the water stays calm and clear.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars over the Atlantic from your own sea-view terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Porches this morning, and the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows frame gardens, pool and ocean.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, clouds come and go above the pool, so the coastline below alternates between bright and shaded.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud sits over the sea while guests finish drinks on the terraces.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the whole sky today, and from the terraces the Atlantic looks grey too, flat and quiet.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the 54 acres of gardens, and most guests are watching the grey Atlantic from behind their room windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the Atlantic, and lightning far out at sea is visible from the windows of the rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the water today, and from the cliff terraces the horizon is hard to find.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare in the Algarve, but if it fell today the gardens would turn white above a dark sea.
phrases.very_cold: From the sea-view terraces, hard winter light falls on the limestone cliffs and the empty wicker chairs above Praia dos Tremoços.
phrases.very_hot: The heat today sends guests into the resort pool, which overlooks the cliffs and the coastline.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and dinner at Ocean Restaurant ends with guests back on their terraces, the sea dark below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the far ends of the coastline are not clear from the pool, only the nearest cliffs.
phrases.late_night: If you were in a sea-view room tonight, you might leave the curtain open and fall asleep facing the Atlantic below.
phrases.wet_evening: If you took a last drink in your room tonight, you would see rain on the glass and hear the Atlantic.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink at the window after midnight, cloud would hide the Atlantic but you would hear the waves.

phrases.clear_predawn: Still dark over Guanabara Bay, with a clear sky, and the rooftop pool has no one in it yet.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a Sugarloaf-view room now, you would watch the late sun turn the rock orange over Botafogo Bay.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Rio today: Sugarloaf is a grey outline from the rooftop, and Christ the Redeemer is hard to make out.
phrases.snow: Snow is not a thing Rio does, but if it fell today, guests would see it from the rooftop pool against Sugarloaf.
phrases.very_cold: A rare cold day for Rio, close to freezing, and the rooftop pool is empty while Sugarloaf stands sharp in clear air.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Botafogo today, and the rooftop pool is the only reasonable place from which to look at Christ the Redeemer.
phrases.mild_night: Warm night, low cloud, and from the rooftop bar windows the marina lights are clear while Sugarloaf is only a dark shape.

phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a Sugarloaf-facing room sees the mountain's shape under low cloud and the marina lights along Botafogo Bay.

phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the lake today, and from the balconies only the nearest water is visible, the mountains not at all.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare at this lake, but today it lands on the palm trees in the garden and around the pool.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold on the pool terrace today, so the loungers are empty and the mountains across the lake look sharp.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day like this, most guests are in the 20-metre pool rather than on the loungers beside it.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild cloudy night, and through the lounge bar's arched windows the lake is just a dark, flat surface.

phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open late in the View suites, the lights across Lake Garda reflect on the water under low cloud.

phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the lit falls and city skyline are both visible from the corner windows.

phrases.late_night: Up late in a Fallsview room, you could watch the Horseshoe Falls longer under city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in a Fallsview room tonight, you would see the Horseshoe Falls through rain on the window.
phrases.grey_evening: If you carried a last drink to a Fallsview room tonight, you would see the falls' mist and city lights under cloud.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the water today, so the distant island and The Pearl-Qatar coastline are hard to see from the rooms.

phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside, unusual for Doha, and the Corniche promenade seen from the upper floors is almost empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over West Bay, and the turquoise Gulf seen from the king room windows looks cooler than it is.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers a warm night, and the lit skyscrapers of West Bay still show from the rooftop terrace seating.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the open water beyond the Corniche fades and the distant island is not visible from the rooms.

phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in a Gulf-facing room, you would see the West Bay towers through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you carried a last drink to a Gulf-facing window now, you would see the West Bay towers lit under the haze.

phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover Brisbane tonight, but the air is mild, and from the balconies the lit skyline and the river stay in view.

phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Mumbai, and the lit Gateway of India stands out from the Souk restaurant on the 21st floor.
