phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Apollo room windows after midnight, and the Gateway of India's arch blurs above the wet harbour lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the Apollo rooms after midnight looks out on harbour lights under low cloud and the Gateway's arch.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Hudson River is still dark below the west-facing rooms, and the rooftop pool deck is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From a west-facing room this morning, the Hudson River is bright and flat under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is on the rooftop terrace, and the lounge chairs between the potted trees face a sharp Manhattan skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun comes straight through the suite windows now, and One World Trade Center stands in warm afternoon light.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a suite tonight, you would see the lit Manhattan skyline from the king bed under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds are moving over Hudson Yards this morning, and the Hudson River looks grey and blue from the west-facing rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the Hudson Yards towers this afternoon, seen from the rooftop terrace between its potted trees.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds over the Hudson River, and the west-facing rooms have the direct view of it.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the Manhattan skyline from the suite living room is flat and colourless, but every tower is clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is running down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites, and the Hudson River below is the same grey as the sky.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm guests stay off the rooftop pool deck and watch lightning over the Hudson River from the west-facing rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the Hudson River today hides most of the water from the west-facing rooms, leaving only the nearest Hudson Yards towers.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the floor-to-ceiling suite windows, and the Manhattan skyline behind it is partly hidden and white.
phrases.very_cold: If you were at a west-facing window now, you would see the Hudson River dark grey beyond empty rooftop lounge chairs.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the rooftop pool and its cabanas are the busiest part of the hotel, with the Vessel beyond the water.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and from the pool deck the Hudson Yards towers are lit under a low sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so One World Trade Center is hidden from the high-floor suites, though the Hudson River is still clear.
phrases.late_night: Lights are on late in a west-facing room, and the Hudson reflects the shore lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Before bed, the curtain stays open in a west-facing room, and rain on the glass blurs the lights along the Hudson.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open past midnight, the west-facing rooms' floor-to-ceiling windows show lights across the Hudson under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop yoga terrace is quiet, and the lights of Marina Bay Sands still show across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From a south-facing room, the Singapore Flyer and Marina Bay stand in clear morning light, with no cloud above them.
phrases.clear_midday: Under the striped awning on the pool terrace, guests have lunch at wicker tables while Marina Bay Sands sits in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the 25-metre rooftop pool, the low sun lights Marina Bay Sands across the flat water under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: At night the south-facing windows show Marina Bay fully lit, and the Formula 1 circuit is easy to follow by its lamps.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the CBD skyline this morning, seen from a king room with a floor-to-ceiling window.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above Marina Bay Sands, so the pool terrace is sometimes in sun and sometimes in shade.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the BAY@5 terrace for the last hour of sun, you would see clouds turn pink over Marina Bay.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Singapore today, but Marina Bay Sands and the Esplanade are still clear from the hotel windows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Marina Bay, and from the 21st-floor lounge the water looks grey while the drops run down the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests stay indoors and watch lightning over Marina Bay through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Singapore, and Marina Bay Sands is a pale shape across the water from the pool terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow has never fallen on Marina Bay, so if it did, guests at the rooftop pool would be very surprised.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day, which Singapore almost never has, the rooftop pool would have very few swimmers.
phrases.very_hot: The air over Marina Bay is very hot, and most guests stay in the water of the 25-metre rooftop pool.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, guests have a late drink on the BAY@5 terrace while Marina Bay Sands shines across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Esplanade is clear from the rooms but Marina Bay Sands looks faint across the water.
phrases.late_night: In a south-facing room, awake for water after midnight, you would see Marina Bay Sands' three towers over the bay's reflected lights.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were up in HAUS 65 for a last drink, rain on the glass would blur the towers of Marina Bay Sands.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in HAUS 65 now, you would see Marina Bay Sands under cloud, lights on the bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the 15 July Martyrs Bridge is still lit, and the Bosphorus lies dark below the suite windows.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Safran Terrace this morning, the Sultanahmet domes are clearly visible across a sky with no clouds at all.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the Bosphorus, and the suite windows show the wooded Asian shore in full detail.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see low sun on the Hagia Sophia skyline from the restaurant tables.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear, and the rooftop bar's glass walls look out on city lights and the Bosphorus.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds hang over the strait this morning, and from the Safran Terrace the Sultanahmet domes are still easy to see.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud cross the Bosphorus this afternoon, and the Asian shore moves in and out of shadow from the rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, patches of cloud over the historic peninsula colour the restaurant view orange and grey.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Bosphorus looks flat and silver from the suite windows, and the domes are duller than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Bosphorus today, and guests in the Safran Restaurant watch it from behind floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Asian shore during this storm, visible through the glass walls of the rooftop bar.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Bosphorus today, and from the rooms only the nearest water is visible, not the far shore.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Istanbul, and from the Bosphorus Suite balconies the domes of Sultanahmet are white on top.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, so the Bosphorus Suite balconies are empty and the view is enjoyed through glass.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Istanbul today, and the outdoor pool is the busiest spot in the hotel until evening.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night the 15 July Martyrs Bridge is lit across the strait, seen from the Bosphorus Suite jacuzzis.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooms the near Bosphorus shows but the Sultanahmet domes are only a faint outline.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Bosphorus Suites are given to sleep, and the strait returns to their wide windows at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Safran, rain runs down the Bosphorus Suite windows and the Asian shore lights blur across the strait.
phrases.grey_evening: After a late dinner at Safran, the Bosphorus Suites show the strait's shore lights on the water under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lake outside the Boathouse suite's glass walls is still and dark, with the far-shore fells just visible.
phrases.clear_morning: From a stone balcony in the main house, the morning ferry crosses a bright, calm Windermere towards the far shore.
phrases.clear_midday: Lunch tables on the stone terrace are set in full sun, with the lake and the forested hills clear across the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the fells across Windermere, and the Albatros is tied at the jetty below the gardens.
phrases.clear_night: From the Boathouse jetty on a clear night, stars over Windermere reflect in the calm water below the glass walls.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the fells this morning, and patches of sun cross the water in front of the Lakehouse rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Dining Room's glass walls show a lake that changes from grey to blue each time a cloud passes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the far shore turns orange above the terrace's set tables.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Windermere outside the bedroom balconies looks flat and pale, with the hills in dull green.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the lake today, and guests in the Boathouse suite can watch it from the copper bathtubs behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the far-shore fells is visible from the Dining Room, where the glass walls face straight across the lake.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Windermere today, so from the hotel's jetty the far shore and its hills cannot be seen at all.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the terraced gardens and the stone balustrades, while the lake below stays dark and open.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold, clear day outside, and steam rises from the copper hot tub on the balustrade terrace above the lake.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day for the Lake District, the Boathouse suite's rooftop terrace is the closest place to the water.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night, and the Albatros sits at the jetty below the gardens, with no stars over the lake.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far-shore fells are missing from the balcony view and only the near water shows clearly.
phrases.late_night: Dinner in the Dining Room ended hours ago, and the Boathouse suite's floor-to-ceiling glass now shows a few lights across Windermere.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Boathouse glass after midnight, the curtains open, and Windermere is a wet shine beneath the suite.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs over Windermere after midnight, and with the curtains open the Boathouse suite's glass shows the lake right below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea-level saltwater pools of the Galo Lido lie empty, and the Atlantic is still dark from every balcony.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Caniço de Baixo: from the sun terrace, the rocky coastline runs west under full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the saltwater pools carved into the volcanic rock are the coolest place, with the Atlantic very bright beyond them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sea stack off the coast turns golden in the late sun, seen from the set tables of the terrace restaurant.
phrases.clear_night: From the Atlantic balcony, the golden-lit sea stack stands below a clear night sky full of stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over the Atlantic this morning, and kayaks are already going out from the Galo Lido into the marine reserve.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the oval pool get sun between the clouds this afternoon, with the sea changing colour each time one passes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds turn orange above the terrace restaurant while the tables are set for dinner.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky from every Atlantic balcony today, but the saltwater pools at sea level are still open and nobody is complaining.
phrases.rain: Rain over Caniço de Baixo, so the sauna with its big window to the Atlantic is the popular place right now.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Atlantic this hour, and guests are watching the lightning from behind the large windows of their rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, and from the balconies the sea stack is a pale shape rather than a sharp one.
phrases.snow: Snow at sea level in Madeira is very rare, so a few flakes over the volcanic rock pools would surprise everyone.
phrases.very_cold: A freezing day on the south coast, sunny but cold, and the sauna window is the comfortable way to see the Atlantic.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the cliff today, and the saltwater pools of the Galo Lido are where most guests have gone.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, and the terrace restaurant tables look out at a dark Atlantic with the sea stack barely visible.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests on their balconies this afternoon see the Galo Lido rock pools below, while the coastline west fades into haze.
phrases.late_night: Whoever wakes for water near midnight hears the Atlantic and sees its white surf.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the sea-view rooms sees rain on the glass, the Atlantic loud below.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the Atlantic-facing rooms are probably asleep after midnight, cloud low over the sea and the waves heard on the rocks.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the east-facing rooms on floor 23 and up face both falls under a clear, still dark sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the 33rd floor, Watermark's floor-to-ceiling windows show the Niagara River and both falls under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun on the river leaves the falls fully lit, and the indoor pool windows frame them along with the city.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the 49th-floor suite now, you would see late sun on both falls with nothing blocking the view.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at an east-facing window on a high floor, you would see stars in the clear sky above Horseshoe Falls.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Niagara River this morning, and Watermark's 33rd-floor windows still show both falls under patches of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On a partly cloudy afternoon, the indoor pool's floor-to-ceiling windows look out at the falls and the city.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests on the 49th floor watch broken cloud change the light over Horseshoe Falls.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud sits over Niagara today, but from the double queen rooms the rushing falls are still clear in the window.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on both falls, and Watermark's floor-to-ceiling windows on the 33rd floor keep the view while the glass gets wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Niagara River means lightning above the falls, seen from high east-facing rooms with the fireplace on.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs over the Niagara River today, so from floor 23 and up the falls are only partly visible at best.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the high windows, and the indoor pool stays warm while the falls keep running outside.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold over Niagara, and the clear air makes both falls sharp from the 49th-floor Two-Bedroom Deluxe Suite Premium.
phrases.very_hot: From the east-facing rooms on floor 23 and above, heat-haze hangs over the Horseshoe Falls and its mist today.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Niagara, and guests at Watermark on the 33rd floor eat with the falls behind the glass.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Niagara today, so the falls still show from floor 23, but the city beyond is faint.
phrases.late_night: If you were in an east-facing room now, the window overlooking the Horseshoe Falls would be the only light left in the room.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in a high east-facing room tonight, rain would blur the window over the Horseshoe Falls.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in an east-facing room, you would look toward Horseshoe Falls, the city lit under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Grand Canal is quiet under a clear sky, and the canal-facing rooms have the first water buses to themselves.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the ground floor terrace comes with clear morning sun on the Grand Canal and gondolas already passing.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the rooftop terrace shows Venice's church towers sharply, with the Dolomites visible far behind.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the rooftop Jacuzzi now, you would see the low sun on Venice's rooftops and the snow-capped Dolomites.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the Grand Canal is clear, and the balcony rooms still show the bell tower against the dark.
phrases.partly_morning: If you were at a front window now, you could see water buses on the Grand Canal under patchy morning cloud.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go this afternoon, so from the rooftop terrace the Euganean Hills appear and disappear on the horizon.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day lights the stone bridge near the dining terrace, with a few clouds turning pink above.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, water buses and gondolas pass on the Grand Canal below the canal-facing rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Grand Canal, and guests watch the water buses pass from behind the closed balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Venice, and the safest view of the lightning is from a canal-facing room, not the rooftop terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Grand Canal today, so from the balcony rooms the facades opposite are only outlines.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Venice today, a rare event, and from the rooftop terrace the church towers have white tops.
phrases.very_cold: From the canal-facing rooms in Dorsoduro, frost sits on the balcony glass above the Grand Canal and its water buses.
phrases.very_hot: From the balcony doors, heat-haze lies on the Grand Canal and the slow boats out on the flat water.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the lamp posts on the dining terrace are lit, and the stone bridge is just beyond.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Euganean Hills and Dolomites are not visible from the rooftop terrace, only nearby church towers.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, lights across the Grand Canal reflect on the water from a canal room.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the windows of the Grand Canal rooms, and the lights across the water look blurred.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner is over, and from the canal rooms a few facade lights across the Grand Canal reflect on the water under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lights of Futian are on below the 67th-floor rooms, and Shenzhen Bay is a dark strip to the south.
phrases.clear_morning: From the south-facing rooms, the New Territories of Hong Kong are clearly visible across Shenzhen Bay this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests in the 68th-floor pool swim with a clear view of the city skyline through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the Ping An Finance Centre tower, and the telescope by the windows is pointed straight at it.
phrases.clear_night: Under a cloudless sky tonight, guests at MO Bar, seventy-nine floors up, look down on the lit Shenzhen skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Lotus Hill this morning, and the forest of Lianhuashan Park changes between shade and sun from the corner rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in the fitness center now, you would see cloud shadows moving slowly across the Shenzhen skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: Orange light comes through gaps in the clouds, and diners at The Bay by Chef Fei watch the hills turn dark.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Shenzhen, so the Hong Kong side of the bay looks flat and far from the Oriental Suite.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of OPUS 388, and the lights of Futian look blurred below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Shenzhen Bay is visible from the Mandarin Club on the 78th floor, and guests watch it from behind the glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the skyline today, and the telescope by the windows shows the Ping An tower only as a grey shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Shenzhen, but a few flakes fall past the windows of the spa treatment rooms on the 68th floor.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the outline of Lotus Hill looks unusually sharp from the north-facing corner rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Heat haze sits over Shenzhen Bay this afternoon, and Hong Kong's New Territories are only a pale line from the south-facing rooms.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with clouds, and diners at the RIN teppanyaki counter see the city lights without a single star above them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so Hong Kong is not visible across the bay and even Lotus Hill looks faint from the upper rooms.
phrases.late_night: Were you in a south-facing room now, you might leave the curtain open and fall asleep facing the lights across Shenzhen Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were at MO Bar for a last drink, rain on the glass would blur Hong Kong's lights across Shenzhen Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: If you took a last drink at the MO Bar tonight, you would see the lights along Shenzhen Bay under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sky Pool deck is still dark, and the Fanes group behind the house is only a black shape.
phrases.clear_morning: From a room balcony, Sassongher and the Sella group stand sharp against a clear sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop Sky Pool at midday, the Fanes massif stands sharp above San Cassiano under a clear blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Seen from the Sky Pool, the Conturines and Lagazuoi turn orange now while the valley below has already gone grey.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the rooftop pool glows blue on its timber deck, village lights below and the peaks dark against the stars.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit on Sassongher this morning, and from the terrace with wooden railings the rest of the range is clear.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Inside the glass Elements sauna, turning slowly high above the garden, the Sella group passes the window between patches of cloud.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on a balcony now, you would see the last sun hit Lagazuoi between the clouds before the valley dims.

phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the heated saltwater pool in the garden, and the massif behind it shows only in parts between showers.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, guests leave the rooftop Sky Pool and watch the lightning over Lagazuoi from their balcony doors.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has filled the valley around San Cassiano, and the picture window of the sauna frames white instead of Dolomite peaks.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the terrace planters, and from the suite soaking tub the Fanes group behind the house is half hidden.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, steam rises off the heated outdoor saltwater pool with the snow-covered massif standing behind it.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot for the mountains today, so the adults-only Sky Pool on the roof is the busiest place, Sassongher in full view.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, swimmers in the rooftop pool see village lights below but no stars and no peaks.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor: from the balcony, the near meadows and pine forest show, but the Sella group is only a faint outline.
phrases.late_night: The room is dark after midnight, and the village lights of San Cassiano under the Fanes massif are the only light left.
phrases.wet_evening: Snow falls past the open curtains of the suites after midnight, and the lights of San Cassiano show through it below.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtain open after midnight, the window gives low cloud over the Fanes massif and the lights of San Cassiano below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop shows the dark outline of Li Galli against a sea that slowly turns from black to grey.
phrases.clear_morning: In the breakfast room this morning, guests have a clear line across the water to Praiano while they eat their pastries.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the pool terrace is bright, and the blue umbrellas are the only shade between the loungers and the sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the colorful buildings of Positano, seen from the hotel terrace that faces the hillside village.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at the sky bar tonight, you would see the lights of Praiano along the coast under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the rooftop this morning, putting moving patches of shade on the sea toward Li Galli.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A few clouds share the afternoon sky above the pool terrace, but most loungers are still in full sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the clouds over the sea orange, seen from the tables at Adamo ed Eva.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the sky, and the sea below the terrace room is flat and grey, so the white railings look brighter.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the pool terrace, so the loungers are empty and the sea toward Li Galli is dull and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the rooftop, lightning flashes over the sea beyond Positano while heavy rain falls on the hillside houses.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water today hides Punta Licosa from the rooftop, though Praiano, much closer, is still easy to find.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on this coast, but today a few flakes fall past the white railings of the terrace rooms.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day the pool terrace stays empty, but the view to Li Galli from the rooftop is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Positano, and guests move from the loungers into the pool more often than usual.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, but the air is mild, so the sky bar has guests outside with drinks facing the sea.
phrases.reduced_visibility: If you stood on the rooftop now, you would see Praiano across the water but not Punta Licosa, lost in today's haze.
phrases.late_night: In the sea-facing Junior Suites the curtain is left open tonight, and the village lights of Positano show from the bed.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Junior Suite windows after midnight, and the lights of Positano blur softly down the hillside toward the sea.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtains of a Junior Suite open on Positano's village lights down the hillside, low cloud over the sea tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Tibidabo is only a dark outline before sunrise, and the red chairs up on Azimuth stand empty for now.

phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun falls on the wood deck of the terrace, and the Eixample roofline is sharp all the way to the mountains.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden hour reaches the striped sofas on Azimuth, and the view toward Passeig de Gràcia turns warm yellow.
phrases.clear_night: At night, guests on the eighth-floor terrace have cocktails with the lit towers of the Sagrada Família in view.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over Tibidabo this morning, while the sun still reaches the glass doors of the terrace rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the Eixample roofline this afternoon, and the rooftop palms get sun in short bursts.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the mountains catch the colour, seen from the penthouse private terraces.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Barcelona, and from the Azimuth terrace the Sagrada Família stands out flat against it.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the red chairs of the rooftop today, and the Eixample roofline looks dark and wet from the suite windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests watch lightning over Tibidabo from behind the hotel's square windows on Gran Via.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the mountains behind the city today, and from the rooftop only the nearest Eixample roofs are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare in Barcelona, but if it fell today, the rooftop's wood deck and loungers would turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the terrace stays empty, but the view toward Tibidabo from the rooms is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the Eixample, and the shade of the rooftop palms is the busiest spot on Azimuth.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night keeps the Azimuth terrace open late, with cocktails and the lights of the city below the eighth floor.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Tibidabo and the mountains are not visible from the rooftop; the Sagrada Família still is.
phrases.late_night: Around two the penthouse suite has its lights off, so the lit Eixample roofline is the only light left inside.
phrases.wet_evening: Behind open curtains in the penthouse suites, the Eixample rooftops show wet and lit through the rain toward Tibidabo.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight the Eixample rooftops are lit under low cloud, framed in the open curtains of the penthouse suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Inner-Alster Suite windows show both lakes as dark, flat shapes under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Deluxe City View room this morning, every church spire stands sharp against a cloudless sky over the Altstadt roofs.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun sits over the Binnenalster, and the water shows bright and clear from the Inner-Alster Suite window.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the west side of the church spires, seen from the red armchair in a Deluxe City View room.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Inner-Alster Suite tonight, you would see the dark water of both lakes under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Altstadt roofscape this morning, with sunlight reaching some spires and missing others.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun alternate over the Außenalster this afternoon, so the water changes colour several times from the suite window.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the tree-lined square turn orange, visible from the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Hamburg today, and the church spires from the Deluxe City View rooms look flat and pale.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Altstadt rooftops, so guests watch Hamburg today from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Inner-Alster Suite give a wide view of lightning over both lakes.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the Alster today means the far shore of the Außenalster is missing, even from the suite window.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the Altstadt roofscape, and the church spires show white edges from the Deluxe City View rooms.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, the clear air makes the distant tower sharp from the guest room windows.
phrases.very_hot: Hamburg is very hot today, and the trees on the square below the windows are the only shade in sight.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and both Alster lakes lie dark and still beyond the Inner-Alster Suite windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Außenalster beyond the Binnenalster is not clear, though nearby spires still show from the rooms.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, the Inner-Alster Suite window shows city lights on the Binnenalster water.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtain is open in the Inner-Alster Suite after midnight, and the lights around both lakes blur in the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain is open in the Inner-Alster Suite after midnight, and city lights show on the Binnenalster water under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests on the high floors look out through the glass at city lights under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From a high room this morning, Tokyo Bay to the south is a flat blue line under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the floor-to-ceiling glass on floors 47 to 52, Tokyo Bay lies bright to the south under a clear midday sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests at the floor-to-ceiling windows this afternoon look south over the rooftops to Tokyo Bay under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the bar lounge has candles on the tables and a clear view of Tokyo Tower and the bay beyond.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the skyline this morning, and from the 47th floor some of them look quite close.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of afternoon sun lie on the rooftops between the red Tokyo Tower and Tokyo Bay under broken clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over Tokyo Bay turn orange while Tokyo Tower's lights come on below the windows.
phrases.overcast: A full layer of grey cloud covers Tokyo today, and the spa treatment room's curved windows show a flat, colourless skyline.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and the restaurant with the bonsai centerpiece is drier than the streets far below.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the bay means guests on the 52nd floor watch lightning from behind glass, the better side.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Tokyo today shortens the view, so Tokyo Tower shows from the rooms but Tokyo Bay is only a guess.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the 47th-floor windows, and the city grid below is turning white, roof by roof.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air over Tokyo today usually means clear views, and the skyline to Tokyo Bay is unusually sharp from the windows.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day the city below shimmers with heat, and guests watch it from behind floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the candlelit bar lounge looks out on city lights with no stars above them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from the rooms Tokyo Tower is there but the Skytree and Tokyo Bay are not.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water at the window, and the city lights reach south from floor forty-seven to Tokyo Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass in the room, and the city lights blur toward Tokyo Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, low cloud covers Tokyo tonight, and the city lights show under it through the floor-to-ceiling glass.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Frioul Islands are only dark shapes against the sky from any of the 19 balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: From the fifth-floor pool, the morning sun is already on the water around Château d'If and the Frioul Islands.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sea in front of the restaurant windows turns a strong blue, with the rocky islands sharp on the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a top-floor suite terrace now, you would see the limestone cliffs turning orange before sunset.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the sky over Catalans Bay is full of stars, seen from any of the private balconies.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Frioul Islands this morning, so the sea seen from the restaurant changes colour every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon some cloud sits over the open sea, and swimmers in the heated infinity pool have sun on and off.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the limestone cliffs under a broken sky, best seen from the second-floor rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the sea off Catalans Bay looks flat and silver, and the Frioul Islands still show from the balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the sea in front of the restaurant, and the islands are visible but blurred behind the wet windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the open sea can be seen from every room right now, and nobody is using the fifth-floor pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Frioul Islands and Château d'If today, and from the balconies only the nearest water is visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Marseille, but today a few flakes fall on the balcony rails above a grey Catalans Bay.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, so the heated infinity pool has steam over it while the sea stays bright blue.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the Corniche this afternoon, and most guests are in the fifth-floor pool, looking out toward the Frioul Islands.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy mild night sky, lights from the hillside city buildings shine on the calm water of Catalans Bay.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Château d'If and the Frioul Islands are missing from the view, though Catalans Bay is clear.
phrases.late_night: Corniche lights lie on the water after midnight from the sea-view rooms, a good hour to sleep before dawn returns Catalans Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner in the restaurant below, rain runs down the sea-view room's glass and the Corniche lights shine on Catalans Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the view from bed is Catalans Bay, its shoreline lights softened by low cloud this late.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Snoopy Rock is only a dark shape from the Vista Cottages, and Oak Creek is louder than anything else.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Cliffs room this morning, the red rock panorama is sharp in clear light, with no cloud over Sedona.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is straight above Giants Thumb, and the tall cypress trees in the stone courtyard give some shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Elephant Rock turns a deeper red in the last sun, best seen from a Vista Cottage balcony with wicker chairs.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Sedona is clear and full of stars, and the string lights in the stone courtyard are on.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Snoopy Rock this morning, so the light on the Vista Cottage patios changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on a balcony this afternoon, you would watch cloud shadows move slowly across the red rock formations.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests are opening wine on their balconies as the last hour of sun colours the clouds above Giants Thumb.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the red rocks look flat and brown from Spirit Song Terrace, and cottage fireplaces are in use.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Oak Creek, and the creekside cottages are the place to hear it, with a fire going inside.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Sedona now, and lightning behind Elephant Rock is visible from the Vista Cottages, with every balcony empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits in the valley today and Snoopy Rock is a soft outline from the Vista Cottages rather than a clear shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the red rocks, a rare sight here, and the private patios at the cottages are white and empty.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing on the balconies today, so the view of Giants Thumb is a short one before guests go back in.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Sedona this afternoon, and the cedar outdoor showers at the cottages make more sense than ever.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, guests walk from Cress on Oak Creek back to their cottages without needing a coat.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so from the Cliffs rooms the nearer red rocks are clear but the far ones are not visible.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Vista Cottages have turned the lights off, and the night sky over Snoopy Rock is the only light left.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a Vista Cottage after midnight watches rain slide down the glass, the courtyard string lights blurred behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a Vista Cottage around two watches thin cloud drift toward Snoopy Rock, Uptown's lights soft under it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gateway of India stands dark against the harbour, seen from the windows of the heritage lounge.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Tata Suite, the Gateway of India and the Arabian Sea are both in clear morning sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: The courtyard pool reflects the red-domed façade under a blue sky, and the water is the coolest place at noon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the Gateway of India, and the harbour looks golden from the large windows of the heritage lounge.
phrases.clear_night: At Souk on the twenty-first floor, dinner guests look out over the dark harbour under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Gateway of India this morning, and sunlight reaches the Ravi Shankar Suite windows between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in the twin room this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows moving across the domed rooftop and skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the Arabian Sea in patches, seen from the suite living room windows over the harbour.
phrases.overcast: From the heritage lounge windows, the Gateway of India stands grey against low cloud over the harbour.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the harbour and the Gateway of India, while guests in the heritage lounge watch from wicker chairs.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Arabian Sea is visible from the Tata Suite windows, and the rain is loud against the glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the harbour today hides the far water, but the Gateway of India is still clear from the lounge windows.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Mumbai, but if it did, the Gateway of India would be white under the suite windows.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day is rare in Mumbai, and the Gateway of India looks unusually sharp from the Ravi Shankar Suite.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon in Colaba, and most guests are in the courtyard pool or inside the J Wellness Circle spa.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night, the Souk rooftop on the twenty-first floor still gives a wide view across the dark harbour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today hides the far side of the harbour from the suites, and only the Gateway of India stays clear.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight a glass of water in the Tata Suite comes with the Gateway of India's arch across the lit harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Souk, rain covers the Ravi Shankar Suite windows and the Gateway of India's arch shows through the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner at Souk, haze covers the midnight sky, and the Gateway of India's arch is seen beside the lit harbour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Han River is a dark band below the suite windows, and N Seoul Tower still shows its night lights.
phrases.clear_morning: From the restaurant windows this morning, the skyline and the distant mountains are sharp under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: High midday sun over Namsan makes the Han River look bright from the tall room windows of the hotel.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on N Seoul Tower, and guests in the hillside rooms watch the city take on a warmer colour.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight N Seoul Tower is lit against a clear dark sky, and the city lights reach the Han River.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Namsan this morning, but the tower on the hill stays clearly visible from the guest rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the Seoul skyline this afternoon, seen from the restaurant seats along the windows.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in a suite now, you would see the last sun between clouds over the Han River.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Han River and the dense cityscape look flat and pale from the suite windows today.
phrases.rain: With rain on Seoul today, the Han River is a blurred line through the wet glass of the suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, guests stay inside and watch lightning over the Seoul skyline from the rooms on the Namsan hillside.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides most of the Han River today, and N Seoul Tower on the hill is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Namsan, and the trees around the outdoor pool, now an ice rink, are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold outside, and the pool garden has become an ice rink, with skaters below the clear winter sky.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the outdoor pool is the busiest place, with the Seoul skyline beyond the trees.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky on this mild night, but guests still sit by the lit outdoor pool with the skyline beyond.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so the Han River is unclear from the rooms, though Namsan and the tower are close enough to see.
phrases.late_night: Around midnight, a glass of water on the nightstand, the city lights along the Han River fill the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open after midnight, rain runs down the suite's floor-to-ceiling windows and the city lights blur along the Han River.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtains open after midnight, the suite's floor-to-ceiling windows show the city lights along the Han River under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Grossmünster's twin towers are dark shapes across the Limmat, seen from a fifth-floor river-facing room.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the fourth floor comes with the twin towers of Grossmünster in full morning sun across the Limmat.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, Lake Zurich is visible in the distance beyond the river, with Fraumünster's spire to the right.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light reaches the Grossmünster towers across the Limmat, and locals already fill the terrace by the river under Weinplatz.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a river-facing room tonight, you would see the Grossmünster towers as dark outlines against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Zurich this morning, and from the breakfast table the twin towers are sometimes in shade, sometimes in sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the riverside terrace below Weinplatz, locals sit under a sky of broken cloud, the Limmat moving past beside them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day reaches the Grossmünster towers between clouds, watched from wicker chairs on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Limmat looks grey too, and the twin towers across the water stand without any shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Limmat and on the empty riverside terrace, while guests watch the towers through French doors from their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Zurich, and the bar lounge with its leather armchairs is the busiest room in the hotel.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Limmat today, and from a fourth-floor window the Grossmünster towers are only a pale outline across the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the river and on the wicker chairs of the rooftop terrace, and the twin towers have white roofs.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, so the river-facing rooms, not the terrace, are where guests look at Grossmünster today.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Zurich, and the Limmat below the terrace looks more inviting than the wicker chairs do.
phrases.mild_night: Mild air under cloud tonight, and the terrace beside the Limmat under Weinplatz still has locals at its tables late on.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Grossmünster towers across the Limmat are clear enough, but Lake Zurich in the distance is not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight a river-facing room is dark inside, and the only light left is the Limmat shining across from Grossmünster's twin towers.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the French doors after midnight, and Grossmünster's twin towers are across the wet Limmat, old-town lights on the water.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open in a river-facing room, the town lights reflect in the Limmat beneath Grossmünster's twin towers under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic outside the top-floor suite is still dark, and the private balcony is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests on the covered terrace have a clear ocean horizon this morning, with no cloud over Bantry Bay.
phrases.clear_midday: If you were on the top balcony now, you would see the pool and the Atlantic bright in clear midday sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun drops toward the Atlantic now, and guests on the suite's private balcony watch the water turn orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the jacuzzi on the top-floor balcony tonight, you would see stars over a black Atlantic.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are passing over Bantry Bay this morning, and the pool deck shifts between sun and shade every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Broken cloud sits over the Cape Town coastline this afternoon, and the umbrella on the covered terrace is only sometimes needed.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, patches of cloud over the Atlantic catch orange light, seen from the balcony rooms.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the ocean today, and from the infinity pool the horizon line is harder to find than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pool deck and the lavender garden, and guests have moved under the covered terrace.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Atlantic right now keeps guests off the top-floor balcony, and the lightning is watched from inside the suite.
phrases.fog_haze: Sea fog has reached Bantry Bay, and from the infinity pool the Atlantic is visible for only a short distance.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Cape Town, but if it were falling, the pool deck loungers would be covered in it.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day the sun is out over the Atlantic, but the infinity pool and the loungers stay empty.
phrases.very_hot: Heat over Bantry Bay this afternoon keeps the canopied daybed on the pool deck occupied, while the sunny loungers stay empty.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild, cloudy night over Bantry Bay, and the top-floor jacuzzi is in use with the balcony doors open.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the Atlantic horizon that the top-floor suite usually shows is not there, and the sea simply fades into grey.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water at midnight, and the coastline lights show from the top-floor suite.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open in the top-floor suite, rain on the glass blurs the coastline lights beside the Atlantic.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain is open in the top-floor suite tonight, and the Bantry Bay shore lights show along the Atlantic under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the double-level infinity pool is still, and Antiparos is a dark shape on the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balconies, the Aegean is calm and bright this morning, with the rocky islets clearly visible from the pool terrace.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong over the southwest coast, and the two infinity pools are the busiest places on the hillside.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on the lower level of the infinity pool face the setting sun, with Antiparos in silhouette straight ahead.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lit coastline from a rattan lounge chair on the stone terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the sea this morning, and guests on the sand terrace watch the cloud shadows move across the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A few clouds sit above Antiparos this afternoon, while the private pools of the Signature Suites stay mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_golden: Just before sunset, broken cloud over the sea turns orange, and the candlelit tables on the restaurant terrace fill up.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Aegean looks flat and grey from the guest-room terraces, and Antiparos is still visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the hillside gardens, so the spa and the art gallery are busier than the pool terraces.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the open sea is visible from the French doors of the rooms, and the infinity pools are empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water hides Antiparos today, and from the pool terrace only the nearest rocky islets can be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on Paros, but today a few flakes fall on the stone terraces while the sea stays grey.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing on the balconies, and most guests look at the Aegean through closed sliding doors.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Agia Irini this afternoon, and the double-level infinity pool is the only place anyone wants to be.
phrases.mild_night: On this warm cloudy night, the lights of the coastal village are visible across the dark water from the restaurant terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the distant islands beyond Antiparos are missing, though Antiparos itself is still clear from the pool.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the sea-facing rooms look out on coastline lights along the water, and the Aegean moves softly below.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the sliding doors of the rooms after midnight, and the coastline lights across the water show as soft blurs.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the Aegean after midnight, and from the Signature Suites only the coastline lights show across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Bulgari Suite terrace is empty and the Porta Nuova towers stand dark against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the garden-facing Superior Suites, morning sun lights the treetops in Sophie Agata Ambroise's garden on a clear Milan day.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Porta Nuova skyline is sharp from the rooftop terrace, and the potted plants are the only shade up there.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the suite living rooms through floor-to-ceiling windows, and the distant spires turn orange over the tree-lined city.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the lanterns on the rooftop terrace are lit, and the Porta Nuova towers show their lights under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Brera this morning, and from the tall guest-room windows the treetop canopy goes bright and dim in turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on the Bulgari Suite terrace this afternoon, you would see the Porta Nuova towers under a half-cloudy sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun puts colour on the clouds above Porta Nuova, seen from the rattan chairs on the terrace.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Milan today, so the Porta Nuova skyline looks flat from the terrace and the indoor pool looks better.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the garden, and guests in the Superior Suites watch wet treetops through the tall windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Milan means nobody sits on the rooftop terrace, and lightning shows the Porta Nuova towers briefly.
phrases.fog_haze: In fog, the Porta Nuova towers are hidden from the terrace, and only the nearest treetops in the garden stay visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the potted plants of the rooftop terrace, and the garden treetops below the suite windows turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day the terrace stays empty, and the view of Porta Nuova is sharp from behind the suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Milan, so guests leave the terrace for the indoor spa pool and the garden's shade.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild cloudy night in Brera, and locals are arriving for drinks at the hotel bar, as usual.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the terrace the Porta Nuova towers are only outlines and the distant spires cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: Late dinner is done; the Bulgari Suite windows show Porta Nuova's lights after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Bulgari Suite windows tonight, and the Porta Nuova skyline lights look soft through the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Milan after midnight, and from the Bulgari Suite the Porta Nuova skyline shows as a row of lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Neptuno Suite window shows the fountain's water jets under a dark, cloudless sky over Madrid.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Prado facade, and from the suite dining area the Neptuno statue stands in full daylight.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the arched window of the Neptuno Suite frames the fountain, the Prado and the Thyssen-Bornemisza under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the curved living room now, you would see low sun on the Madrid rooftops outside the arched windows.
phrases.clear_night: Night, clear sky: the fountain's water jets keep running below the Neptuno Suite window, with the Prado facade in view nearby.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Madrid this morning, and from the suite dining area the Neptuno statue stands in changing light.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, broken cloud sits over the Prado facade, and the fountain's jets catch sun in short intervals from the suite window.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds above the city rooftops seen from the curved suite living room's arched windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Prado, the Thyssen-Bornemisza and the fountain remain fully visible from the Neptuno Suite, just without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Neptuno fountain, which already has plenty of water, while guests watch from the suite dining area.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Madrid is visible through the arched windows of the curved living room, lightning briefly showing the rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Madrid softens the Prado facade today; from the Neptuno Suite the fountain statue is still the clearest object.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Madrid, but today flakes fall past the arched window onto the Neptuno fountain and the Prado facade.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it feels close to freezing, and the fountain's water jets look bright and sharp in the sun from the suite window.
phrases.very_hot: Madrid is very hot today; from the Neptuno Suite the fountain's water jets look like the coolest place in view.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the orange velvet chairs face arched windows with the city rooftops of Madrid outside.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is reduced today; the fountain and the Prado facade are still clear from the suite, but distant Madrid rooftops are not.
phrases.late_night: Back from the Rotunda, the Neptuno Suite's arched window frames the fountain jets after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain streaks the arched window of the Neptuno Suite, and the fountain and the Prado facade show through wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner in the Neptuno Suite, the arched window frames the fountain and the Prado facade under tonight's low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the towers of Plaza de España stand dark against a clear sky outside the guest room windows.

phrases.clear_night: If you were in a river-view room tonight, you would see the O2 dome across the Thames under a clear London sky.

phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Thames changes from grey to silver as clouds move, seen easily from the spacious rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, gaps in the cloud light parts of the Thames, visible from the Scoff & Banter terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the O2 dome and the Thames are still clear from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the river surface today, and the freestanding tub facing the windows gives a warm seat for watching the Thames.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows give a wide, sheltered view of lightning over the O2 and the river.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog on the Thames today hides the O2 dome, and from the rooms the river is a short grey stretch of water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the riverbend, a rare sight in London, and it shows well against the dark Thames from the rooms.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it is close to freezing, and the Thames looks sharp and bright from the windows of the king rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot for London today, and the Scoff & Banter terrace by the water is busier than the fitness club.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and the O2 across the river is still the main shape in the room windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, and both far ends of the Thames are hard to see, though the O2 opposite remains clear.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the river-view rooms are for sleep, and lights lie on the Thames until the O2's dome shows at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the river-view rooms after midnight, and the far bank's lights blur on the Thames.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the Thames after midnight, and lights from the far bank show in the water outside the river-view rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the castle keep stands dark against a clear sky, seen from the castle suites on floors fourteen to sixteen.
phrases.clear_morning: From the upper suites this morning, Osaka Castle and the green park below it are fully clear, with no haze at all.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun lights the whole castle park, and the window seats where afternoon tea is served give the full view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon, the low sun colours the castle walls and the trees of the park, seen over an afternoon tea set.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight under a clear sky, the lights on the castle keep show as a bright shape on the outdoor pool water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Osaka this morning, but the castle keep stays visible from the suites on floors fourteen to sixteen.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud and sun move across the castle park this afternoon, and the Osaka-jo Hall arena is clear from the rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud lets some sunlight reach the castle and the waterway beside the hotel.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the castle looks flat and pale from the upper suites, but every roof line is easy to see.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the castle park and the outdoor pool today, so the keep is watched through wet windows from the suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, the castle suites are a dry place from which to watch lightning over the keep and the city skyline.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Osaka today blurs the castle keep from the suites, and the park trees are clearer than the city skyline.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Osaka, but the castle roofs show a white edge, seen from the suites on floors fourteen to sixteen.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day nobody is in the outdoor pool, but the castle view from the suites is sharp and bright.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot over the castle park today, and the outdoor pool facing the keep is the sensible place to be.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the illuminated keep still shows on the pool water, though no stars are above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the castle keep is a faint shape from the suites and the city towers cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, after a glass of water, a castle-suite window shows the keep over the park among the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner over, rain runs down the glass of the castle suites and the keep's shape shows through it amid the city lights.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the castle suites on floors 14 to 16 face the keep's outline and the city lights under tonight's haze.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before sunrise, Funchal Bay is black from the balconies, and only the coastline lights mark where the land ends.
phrases.clear_morning: From a classic double room, the morning view is treetops first, then a calm blue Atlantic beyond.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the pool terrace is in full sun, and the white umbrellas are the only shade on the striped loungers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun comes from the west, so from the terraces the Cabo Girão cliffs are a dark shape against it.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests dining on the terrace see Funchal's coastline lit up along the bay and a black Atlantic below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are passing over Funchal Bay this morning, so the Atlantic seen from the balconies changes between grey and blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on a balcony with wicker chairs this afternoon, you would get sun in short periods between the clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun is lighting the pink arched walls, as clouds move across the western sky over Cabo Girão.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic seen through the Briza do Mar glass walls is nearly the same colour as the clouds.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pool terrace, and guests are watching the grey Atlantic from under the arches of the terrace restaurant.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the balconies are empty, and lightning over the Atlantic is best watched from behind the Briza do Mar glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Funchal Bay today means the Cabo Girão cliffs are missing from the western horizon, and the Atlantic fades to white.
phrases.snow: If snow ever reached the pool terrace, the palm trees would hold it for a few minutes at most.
phrases.very_cold: A rare freezing day in Funchal keeps guests off the balconies, though the view of the Atlantic from the rooms is unchanged.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the clifftop today, so the pool and the shade of the white umbrellas are the busiest spots.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and dinner for two on the terrace goes ahead with the lights of Funchal's coastline in view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the sea-facing balconies the Atlantic is there but the Cabo Girão cliffs are not.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner at Briza do Mar, the sea-facing rooms show the lights of Funchal along the bay after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Briza do Mar, rain runs down the sea-facing windows and the lights of Funchal Bay blur through it.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner at Briza do Mar, the sea-facing rooms look out on Funchal's coastline lights across the bay under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the London Eye stands dark and still outside the river-facing rooms, with a clear sky behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Whitehall Suite terrace, Trafalgar Square and the London Eye are both sharp under this morning's clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is on the Thames, and guests in river rooms can see the London Eye turning slowly.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden hour on the rooftop terrace means low sun on the oversized chess set and on the Victorian rooftops opposite.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the London Eye is lit up across the river, clearly visible from the rooftop terrace's teak chairs.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Thames this morning, but the London Eye is still clear from the river-facing rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, sun and cloud take turns over Trafalgar Square, which guests in rooms facing Nelson's Column can watch directly.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the City skyline turns pink above the rooftop terrace's topiary hedges.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers London completely today, and from the river rooms the London Eye looks flat and colourless against it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Thames; if you were there, you would likely trade the rooftop terrace for Kerridge's Bar and Grill.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Thames is best watched from a river-facing room, not from the rooftop terrace with its fire pit.
phrases.fog_haze: From the river-facing rooms today, fog over the Thames reduces the London Eye to a grey shape or hides it completely.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Whitehall Place, and from the suite living room the church spire has a white top.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing on the rooftop terrace today, where nobody is playing on the oversized chess set near the fire pit.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot for London today, so the rooftop terrace gets the full sun, and the Thames below looks slow and bright.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night sits over the Thames, and the London Eye's lights are easy to see from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, and the City skyline beyond the Thames cannot be seen from the rooftop terrace, only the London Eye.
phrases.late_night: After a late cocktail at Velvet, the river rooms frame the Eye's wheel and the Thames, bright with reflected city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Mezzogiorno, the river rooms show the London Eye's wheel through rain on the glass, and the Thames lights blur.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Mezzogiorno, the river rooms frame the Eye's wheel and the lit skyline across the Thames under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the SkyLounge windows show the IJ as a dark strip, with few lights at the Eye Film Institute.
phrases.clear_morning: From a room balcony, the morning sun lights the Basilica of Saint Nicholas and the Oosterdok canals under a clear blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the IJ is bright and busy, and guests at the SkyLounge can see the Eye Film Institute very clearly.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun gives the Basilica of Saint Nicholas a warm colour, seen best from the Executive Corner King Room.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the SkyLounge tonight, you would see the lights of the Eye Film Institute reflected in the IJ.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds and sun alternate over the Oosterdok canals this morning, and the balcony rooms get both within a few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the IJ is half in sun and half in cloud shadow, seen through the SkyLounge floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, gaps between clouds put patches of orange light on the Basilica, visible from the balconies.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Amsterdam today, and the canal view from Eastwood restaurant is flat in colour but still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the IJ, and the SkyLounge windows are the drier place to watch the Eye Film Institute from.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the IJ is visible from the SkyLounge, and nobody is using the room balconies right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the water hides the Eye Film Institute from the SkyLounge, and the Basilica is only a grey outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the city rooftops around the Basilica, which the balcony rooms look straight onto.
phrases.very_cold: Near-freezing air outside keeps the balconies empty, so the Basilica and the Oosterdok canals are watched through closed glass today.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the IJ looks cooler than it is, and the balcony rooms get direct sun for hours.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy sky tonight, the warm air makes the room balconies usable, with the Basilica and the Oosterdok canals still visible.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the Eye Film Institute across the IJ is faint from the SkyLounge, while the nearer Basilica stays clear.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has the Executive Corner King Room tonight may be awake after midnight, watching canal lights on the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has the Executive Corner King Room tonight watches rain run down the glass as the canal lights blur below.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has the Executive Corner King Room tonight can watch the canal lights come on under a low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sweni River is mostly sound: hippos below the stilted suites, water running past the decks in the dark.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun lights the Sweni River below the suites, and animals that arrive to drink now pass at eye level.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun filters through the thatched canopy over the lap pool, and the Sweni River below stays flat and bright.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the glass walls along the walkway, so the dense bushveld appears twice, once outside and once reflected.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the outdoor bed tonight, you would see a clear Kruger sky and hear hippos in the river below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over the concession this morning, and the river in front of the suites changes between grey and green.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Broken cloud this afternoon means the timber deck around the pool is in shade one minute and sun the next.
phrases.partly_golden: On the rocky ledge above the river, guests watch the last sun turn the valley and a few clouds orange.
phrases.overcast: If you stood on your suite deck now, you would see the Sweni River flat and grey under a clouded sky.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Sweni River and on the deck shower, so a guest showering now gets wet from two directions.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the bushveld keeps everyone inside the glass-walled suites, watching lightning above the river through the glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the valley today, and from the suites the far bank of the Sweni River is only an outline.
phrases.snow: Kruger almost never sees snow, so a few flakes on the game-viewing decks today would be very unusual.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing is rare in Kruger, but today the outdoor beds stay empty and the fire bowl is lit early.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over the bushveld sends guests to the lap pool, while animals come to the river for the same reason.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night on the deck: the fire bowl is lit, the wicker chairs are taken, and hippos are audible below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the suites the river and near bank are clear but the valley beyond is not.
phrases.late_night: Back in a riverside suite after a late dinner, you would see moonlight on the Sweni River through the glass wall.
phrases.wet_evening: A last drink in a riverside suite tonight would show you rain on the glass and the Sweni River below.
phrases.grey_evening: If you took a last drink to your suite now, you would see cloud over the bush and the river moving below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea-view rooms look east over a dark Indian Ocean, with the anchored ships showing only their lights.
phrases.clear_morning: From the 14th floor this morning, the container ships off Durban harbour are easy to count against a clear sea.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 6th-floor deck, midday sun lights the infinity pool edge and the red-topped lighthouse below on the rocks.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the red top of the uMhlanga Lighthouse, seen from the upper sea-view rooms.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in FireLake tonight, you would see the lighthouse beam turning over a black Indian Ocean.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the ocean this morning, and the ships waiting off Durban harbour are still visible from the rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the 6th-floor pool deck this afternoon, so the sun loungers get shade, then sun, then shade again.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds over the Indian Ocean, a view the rooftop restaurant windows face directly.
phrases.overcast: Full cloud covers Umhlanga today, the ocean looks flat and grey, yet the anchored ships still show from the upper rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the infinity pool and the empty loungers, and inside FireLake the floor-to-ceiling windows still show the sea.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the 6th-floor deck empties, and guests watch the lightning over the Indian Ocean from behind the restaurant glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the coast today hides the ships off Durban harbour, and only the nearer rooftops and the lighthouse show clearly.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Umhlanga, so if it were falling now the sea-view rooms would show a very unusual Indian Ocean.
phrases.very_cold: A rare freezing day on this coast leaves the rooftop pool deck empty, though the ocean view from the rooms is unchanged.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day the infinity pool on the 6th floor is the most popular place in the hotel, umbrellas included.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm and cloudy, the pool bar on the deck still has guests, and the lighthouse flashes below the hotel.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so the horizon and the anchored ships are missing from the room windows, but the coastline is still clear.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water, and the sea-view rooms show the anchored ships' lights out on the Indian Ocean.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at FireLake is over, and rain falls between the window and the ship lights.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at FireLake, the sea-view rooms look out on ship lights along the horizon under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Bosphorus is dark and calm below the Sultan Suite balconies, with the bridge lights still switched on.
phrases.clear_morning: From the pool terrace, the wooded hillside and the European shore show every detail under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests at the winter-heated infinity pool have full sun overhead now, with the Bosphorus flat and bright right beside them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the palace facade and its copper roof, while the Bosphorus Bridge stands clear in the distance.
phrases.clear_night: At the Tuğra restaurant tonight, the bridge is lit across calm water and the stone columns frame a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Asian shore this morning, seen through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites, with sun between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on a Sultan Suite balcony this afternoon, you would watch cloud shadows move across the Bosphorus.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun reaches the palm-lined gardens between clouds, and the water below the pool terrace reflects pink and grey.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the Bosphorus today, yet the Asian shore remains clearly visible from the suite windows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the pool terrace umbrellas, and the Bosphorus Bridge is visible through the drops from the Tuğra restaurant.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Asian shore is visible from the Sultan Suite balconies, and the strait turns dark under the storm.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze on the Bosphorus today hides the Asian shore, so the palace facade and gardens are the nearest clear sight.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Bosphorus after midnight, with the lights of the Bosphorus Bridge showing above the water.
