phrases.very_cold: Very cold today in Istanbul, with a clear view of the Bosphorus Bridge from the balconies and steam over the heated pool.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot sun on the pool terrace today, and the white umbrellas are the only shade beside the Bosphorus water.
phrases.mild_night: A warm night with cloud over the strait, and the candlelit tables of the terrace restaurant face the lit bridge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The Asian shore is only a faint outline from the suite windows today, as visibility is short, though near water stays clear.
phrases.late_night: Dinner at Tuğra is over, and Asian-shore lights shine on the Bosphorus outside the suite.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Sultan Suite windows tonight, and the lights along the Asian shore show through it across the Bosphorus.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Istanbul after midnight, and the Asian shore lights reflect on the Bosphorus below the suite windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balcony rooms look onto a dark Rush Street and a skyline with only a few lit windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Sun comes in through the tall windows of the king rooms, and from the balconies Lake Michigan is partly visible.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the two chairs on a balcony get full sun, with the Gold Coast skyline sharp in every direction.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the skyline from the west, and the partial Lake Michigan view from the terrace suites is brightest right now.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your balcony tonight, you would see the boutiques on Rush Street lit below under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the skyline this morning, so the light on the balcony changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From a Corner One-Bedroom Terrace suite, Lake Michigan is partly visible this afternoon, with cloud shadows moving across the Gold Coast.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights some towers of the skyline and leaves others in cloud shade, seen from the balcony chairs.
phrases.overcast: Under a gray sky, the lake and the sky are nearly one color from the terrace suites, so the fireplace gets used.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pink flowers on the balconies, and guests watch Rush Street from inside the tall windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the balcony rooms late tonight watch lightning flash over Lake Michigan and the Gold Coast skyline.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides Lake Michigan today, and from the balconies only the nearest Gold Coast towers are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is collecting on the wrought-iron railings of the balconies, and the fireplace in the terrace suites is on.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing outside, so the Rush Street view is better taken through the tall windows with the fireplace lit.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon over the Gold Coast, and most guests watch Rush Street from inside the king rooms rather than the balcony.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, and the lit fountain in the entrance courtyard is the brightest thing near the limestone columns.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Lake Michigan is not in view from the balconies and only the closer towers can be seen.
phrases.late_night: Whoever wakes for water near midnight in the corner suite sees skyline lights and Lake Michigan.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Corner Terrace suites tonight see rain on the tall windows and the skyline lights blurred toward Lake Michigan.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a Corner Terrace suite tonight can watch the skyline lights spread under low cloud toward Lake Michigan.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Inner Alster is dark below the balconies before sunrise, with a few lights showing in the buildings across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Deluxe Room with Balcony, the morning sun lights the Alster Pavilion and the City Hall tower across the lake.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the fountain throws a white column into the sun, and tour boats cross the Binnenalster under the balconies.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the wicker chairs on the balconies, and the church spires across the water turn warm orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at Haerlin tonight, you would see the lit facades of the waterfront buildings reflected in the still lake.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Hamburg this morning, with patches of sun on the Inner Alster and the tour boats below the terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Half the sky is cloud this afternoon, and the City Hall tower goes in and out of shadow across the water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds over the Alster Pavilion while guests on the balconies finish their drinks.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Hamburg today, and the Binnenalster looks almost the same colour as the sky from the balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of the Inner Alster, and guests watch it from behind the windows of the lake-facing rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over Hamburg, the balcony chairs are empty, and lightning shows briefly above the church spires across the lake.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Binnenalster today, so from the terrace the far shore and its buildings are only outlines.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the wicker chairs outside, and the promenade trees along the Alster are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: It is bitterly cold on the balconies today, and the lake view is clear all the way to the City Hall tower.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot Hamburg afternoon, the balconies over the water get what little breeze there is, and the fountain looks tempting.
phrases.mild_night: Mild and cloudy tonight, so a few guests sit out on the balconies and watch the lights along the waterfront.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the lake balconies, the Inner Alster fountain shows today, with the far church spires faint in the haze.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner at Haerlin, the waterfront lights are reflected in the Inner Alster from the lake-facing rooms.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the lake-facing Deluxe Rooms, and the city lights blur across the Inner Alster after midnight.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the Inner Alster after midnight, and the far-shore lights show in the water from the lake-facing rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gulf of Thailand is still dark outside the glass doors of the Saturn and Neptune overwater villas.
phrases.clear_morning: From the canopied beds, guests who are awake can see the sea already blue through the large windows.
phrases.clear_midday: Lunch at La Lune comes with a clear view across the water to the islands of the Koh Ampil archipelago.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the low sun on the Gulf from the outdoor stone soaking tub.
phrases.clear_night: At the Blue Moon bar tonight, the sky over the Gulf is clear and the sea is a few steps away.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the Gulf this morning, seen from the long jetty that runs out over the turquoise water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The pool gets both sun and cloud this afternoon, and the Gulf of Thailand is in view all around the island.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, dinner guests at La Lune watch the light move between clouds over the archipelago.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the Gulf of Thailand today, and the islands across the water look flat and pale from La Lune.
phrases.rain: Inside the overwater villas, guests watch the rain reach the Gulf through the full-height glass that faces the sea.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Gulf of Thailand shows the long jetty and the overwater villas of Koh Ampil above the rain.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the water today, so the Koh Ampil islands are hard to make out from La Lune.
phrases.snow: Snow over the Gulf of Thailand is very unlikely, but if it fell, you would see it from a canopied bed.
phrases.very_cold: From the overwater villa, the Gulf of Thailand lies flat in hard winter light, the sand at Blue Moon empty.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the island today, and most guests are in the Gulf off the beach villas' frontage.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy sky, the night at the Blue Moon bar is warm, and the Gulf starts just past the sand.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Koh Ampil islands are not in view from La Lune, only the nearest water.
phrases.late_night: Were you in Saturn tonight, you could leave the curtain open and fall asleep with moonlight on the Gulf of Thailand.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were at Blue Moon for a last drink tonight, you would watch rain fall on the Gulf of Thailand.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were finishing a last drink in a Saturn villa now, you would see low cloud over the Gulf of Thailand.

phrases.clear_predawn: Under a clear sky before dawn, the river is loud through an opened window, while the slope across the water stays dark.
phrases.clear_morning: At Latest Recipe, breakfast is served beside the river, with clear sky over the pine-covered hillside across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: From the arched room windows, the rice fields and green hills are in full sun, and the river shows its turquoise colour.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The terrace is the place for dinner now, with late sun on the Bhutanese hills and the valley across the river.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at Latitude tonight, you would drink wine indoors while the river went on outside under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the valley slopes this morning, and from the fitness centre glass walls the river is in partial sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud, some sun on the forested hillside this afternoon, and the heated indoor pool has the same view through its windows.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, cloud shadows cross the hills behind the river, visible from every one of the 59 rooms.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Paro today, so the river and the pine forest look darker than usual from the terrace tables.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Paro Chhu today, and the indoor pool windows still show the hillside, now wet and darker green.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the valley, and the safest place to watch the river is from a room window with curtains open.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits in the valley today, and the river is still visible below the rooms, but the hillside behind it is not.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the pine-forested hillside, and the heated pool is the warmest place to look at it.
phrases.very_cold: Through frost on the arched windows, the Paro Chhu runs past the pine hillside in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot for a Himalayan valley today, and the terrace by the river is quiet at midday, the indoor pool less so.
phrases.mild_night: Under cloud this mild night, the blue ceiling light of the indoor pool fills its tall windows facing the Paro Chhu.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low without rain or fog, so the river below the rooms is clear but the far valley slopes are faint.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, water by the bed, and the Paro Chhu runs past the arched windows.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Latest Recipe, rain runs down the arched room windows and the Paro Chhu is heard through the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Supper at Latest Recipe is over; window light shows the Paro Chhu under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the bedroom glass shows a dark ocean and a pale strip of sky above Surfers Paradise Beach.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balcony, sunlight covers the ocean and the first swimmers are walking down to Surfers Paradise Beach.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday on the rooftop terrace means strong sun over the pool, with the ocean bright blue to the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the hinterland ranges to the west, while the beach below the apartments slowly empties.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the city skyline lights are the main view from the terrace, with the dark ocean beside them.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the Gold Coast this morning, and the ocean under the bedroom window changes colour as they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the rooftop pool is in and out of shade, depending on which cloud is over Surfers Paradise.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see broken clouds turning orange over the hinterland ranges.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the whole coast today, so the ocean from the living room looks grey as well.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the beach and on the rooftop garden, and most guests are using their apartment kitchens instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the ocean right now, and guests watch each flash through the tall living room glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water this morning; Surfers Paradise Beach is visible from the balcony, but the hinterland ranges are not.
phrases.snow: Snow over Surfers Paradise would be a first, and every balcony at the resort would have a clear view of it.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold for the Gold Coast today, and the rooftop terrace has only a few people watching the beach.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot across Surfers Paradise, and the rooftop pool is the busiest part of the resort this afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky tonight, but the air is mild and the balcony is a comfortable spot for the skyline lights.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is reduced today: the beach and the nearest buildings can be seen from the rooftop, but the hinterland ranges cannot.
phrases.late_night: If you were in a bedroom tonight, you would sleep through the skyline lights and wake to the beach at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Over a last drink in the apartment tonight, you would see the Surfers Paradise skyline lights through rain on the glass doors.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in the living room now, you would see the Surfers Paradise skyline lit under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the skyline outside the panoramic bathtub is still lit by office towers, and Lianhua Mountain is a dark shape.
phrases.clear_morning: From the guest room windows, Lianhua Mountain looks sharp and green this morning, with the Futian towers standing clear beside it.
phrases.clear_midday: At the outdoor pool, the tan umbrellas give the only shade right now, and Ping An Finance Centre stands in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see Lianhua Mountain turn warm gold from the suite living room windows.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the skyscrapers are lit against a clear sky, and the panoramic bathtub faces them from most room categories.
phrases.partly_morning: If you stood at a room window this morning, you would see patchy cloud above the Futian skyline and Lianhua Mountain.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Club Level guests are at one of the five daily food presentations, while broken cloud sits over the skyline outside.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the top of Ping An Finance Centre, seen from the rooftop pool, while clouds shade the lower towers.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Shenzhen today, so the skyline from the suite living room looks flat, though Lianhua Mountain is still visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling window beside the bathtub, and the pool loungers outside are empty under wet umbrellas.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Futian towers is visible from the guest rooms, and nobody is using the outdoor pool at the moment.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides Lianhua Mountain from the suite living room today, and only the nearest Futian towers show through it.
phrases.snow: Snow over Futian is very rare, and today guests watch it from the guest room windows instead of using the outdoor pool.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air for Shenzhen today, and from the king bed the skyline and Lianhua Mountain look unusually sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Heat over Shenzhen is intense today, and at the outdoor pool people stay in the water or under the tan umbrellas.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Futian, and the lit skyscrapers around the rooftop pool are clear even without stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so Lianhua Mountain is not clear from the bathtub window, though the nearby Futian towers still are.
phrases.late_night: In the guest rooms the curtain is left open tonight, so the Futian skyline lights show from the bed after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open late tonight, rain streaks the bedroom glass and the Futian skyline lights blur behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze hangs over Futian tonight, and the lit skyline shows through the open curtains of the king rooms before bed.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, sea-facing rooms look out on a dark Indian Ocean, with the surf still breaking below the windows.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast time the palm-lined promenade is already in full sun, seen straight down from the sea-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a blue midday sky, the cream umbrellas on the rooftop deck are the only shade above the sunloungers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were at the Panorama Bar now, you would see the late sun on the pier and the ocean.
phrases.clear_night: From a suite balcony tonight, the sky is clear and the surf below is more heard than seen.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered morning clouds pass over the pier, and the rooftop pool is in sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the clouds are broken, so the surf below the sea-facing rooms changes from grey to bright blue and back.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the Indian Ocean turn pink, and the rooftop pool reflects the same colour.
phrases.overcast: A full grey sky sits over the Golden Mile today, though the view from the 33-storey Maharani tower still reaches the pier.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the promenade below, and the rooftop sunloungers are empty, but the ocean view from the suites is unchanged.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Indian Ocean shows best from the sea-facing rooms, where the storm is directly in front of the windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the ocean today shortens the view from the rooftop deck; the pier is visible, the far coastline is not.
phrases.snow: Snow in Durban is practically unheard of, so if it were falling, guests would be photographing it from the rooftop deck.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare freezing day, the rooftop pool stays empty and guests watch the surf from behind the suite windows instead.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over Durban today means the three pools are busy, with the ocean view the same at every height.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night keeps the rooftop bar pavilion comfortable, and the beachfront below the glass balustrade is quiet.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today: from the sea-facing rooms the pier and surf are clear, but the coastline past North Beach is not.
phrases.late_night: Awake past midnight, you could watch the Golden Mile's promenade lights for hours.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were at the Panorama Bar now, you would see rain on the glass and lamps along the Golden Mile.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in a sea-facing room now, you would see the Golden Mile's lamps under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Eiffel Tower is already clear above the Tuileries treetops from the 6th floor balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the tall suite windows, and the Louvre looks very close across the garden.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Belle Etoile terrace is in full sun, with the Eiffel Tower sharp above the zinc rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the rooftop seating, the low sun lights the Eiffel Tower from the side as the Haussmann roofs turn gold.
phrases.clear_night: If you stood on a sixth-floor balcony, you would see the Eiffel Tower above the Tuileries treetops under a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Broken cloud over the Tuileries this morning means the Louvre roofs go from bright to dull every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the Executive room balconies watch cloud shadows move across the garden and the Grand Palais beyond.
phrases.partly_golden: Just before sunset, broken cloud lets the sun reach the Eiffel Tower in patches, seen from the Belle Etoile terrace.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Paris, but the Eiffel Tower and the Grand Palais are still plain across the Tuileries.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Tuileries paths, and the suite windows show wet treetops with the Eiffel Tower behind them.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, the Belle Etoile terrace stays empty while lightning shows up behind the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Eiffel Tower today, so the view from the balconies ends at the Tuileries treetops.
phrases.snow: Snow lies on the Tuileries lawns, and the Louvre roofs are white from the 6th floor balconies.
phrases.very_cold: On a day close to freezing, the terrace seating is unused, but the air is clear to the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the marble bathroom window is open onto the rooftops and Sacré-Cœur in the distance.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy sky, the warm night makes the rooftop terrace usable, with the Eiffel Tower lit beyond the zinc roofs.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Eiffel Tower is only a faint shape above the Tuileries and Sacré-Cœur is not visible.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has an Executive room tonight probably fell asleep with the curtain open, the Eiffel Tower in its usual place above the Tuileries.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake after midnight in an Executive room looks through rain on the glass toward the Eiffel Tower above the Tuileries trees.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has an Executive room tonight can see the Louvre's long roofline across the Tuileries, the city lights soft under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the suite windows on the upper floors show the spires of St. Vitus as dark shapes against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the curved windows of the suites, the Old Town towers stand sharp in clear morning sun over Wenceslas Square.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the restaurant's arched mahogany windows frame green trees in full sun, with no cloud over Prague.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on Above Rooftop now, you would see the spires turn gold while the sun drops toward Petřín Hill.
phrases.clear_night: The Art Nouveau facade is lit after dark, and from the suite bar the city rooftops sit under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Wenceslas Square this morning, and the WOW Bohemia Duplex on the 8th floor catches sun between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon some of the Old Town towers are in sun and some in shadow, seen from the suite windows.
phrases.partly_golden: From Above Rooftop, the last sun lights the spires over Wenceslas Square under a sky with scattered clouds.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud sits over Prague today, so the City of Gold looks mostly grey from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Wenceslas Square, and guests in the restaurant watch wet green trees through the arched mahogany windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the suite bar windows, lightning flashes over the Old Town towers while rain streams down Prague's rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the spires of St. Vitus today; from the 8th floor duplex only the nearest rooftops are visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftops of Prague, and the curved suite windows show white roofs and church spires.
phrases.very_cold: It is bitterly cold outside on Wenceslas Square, and the clear air makes the Old Town towers unusually sharp from the suites.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot weather over Prague today; the green trees outside the restaurant's arched windows give the only shade in sight.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Prague, and from the suite bar windows the Old Town towers show as dark shapes.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Petřín Hill cannot be seen from Above Rooftop, though the nearer Old Town towers still can.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the lit rooftops around Wenceslas Square fill the WOW Bohemia Duplex windows, easy to watch for a long while.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the curved suite windows after midnight, and the lights of Wenceslas Square blur behind the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain is open after midnight in the WOW Bohemia Duplex, and low cloud hangs over the lit rooftops of Prague.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tagus is a dark band below the rooftop pool, and the Arrábida hills are only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: From the river-facing upper rooms, the morning sun lights Lisbon's rooftops and the Tagus beyond them under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Two or three guests float in the rooftop infinity pool at midday, with the Tagus and the hills clearly visible opposite.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon is the pool's best hour, with the sun going down behind the Serra da Arrábida across the river.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight, under a clear sky, the upper river-facing rooms have a view of lit Lisbon rooftops and the dark Tagus beyond.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Arrábida hills this morning, while the sun loungers by the rooftop pool are already in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the Tagus this afternoon, so the water seen from the rooftop pool changes between dull and bright.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, cloud edges over the Serra da Arrábida catch the light while swimmers watch from the pool.
phrases.overcast: Guests at the rooftop pool today look out past the city roofs to a grey Tagus under low cloud.
phrases.rain: Rain over Lisbon today, so the sauna and steam rooms at SAYANNA are busier than the rooftop loungers.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Tagus is visible from the upper river-facing rooms, and the rooftop pool is empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: From the rooftop pool, haze covers the Tagus and hides the Serra da Arrábida on the far shore.
phrases.snow: From the rooftop pool, snow falls on the Lisbon rooftops below and on the wide grey Tagus beyond.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing today, so the SAYANNA indoor pool is the sensible choice, while the Tagus stays sharp from the windows.
phrases.very_hot: With very hot air over Lisbon today, some guests choose the SAYANNA indoor pool over the rooftop sun loungers.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night; from the rooftop, Lisbon's rooftops are lit below and the Tagus is dark beyond them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Haze today: the rooftops near the hotel are clear, the Tagus is faint, and the Serra da Arrábida cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner at Flor de Lis, the upper-floor river rooms look out on city lights reflected in the Tagus.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the river-facing upper floors tonight, and the lights along the Tagus look blurred through it.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers Lisbon after midnight, and the river-facing upper rooms look onto city lights spread down to the Tagus.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the level 50 suites look out over a dark skyline, with Port Phillip Bay still black to the south.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the floor-to-ceiling windows on level 50 show Eureka Tower, the Yarra River and Port Phillip Bay.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is on the bay, and the floor-to-ceiling windows on levels 36 to 50 show it clearly.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Arts Centre Melbourne, seen from the afternoon tea tables above the Yarra River.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a level 50 suite tonight, you would see the whole Melbourne skyline lit under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the eastern suburbs this morning, and the MCG oval is visible from the suite bathroom tub.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the parklands this afternoon, watched from the open shutters of a high-floor room.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud turns orange above Port Phillip Bay, seen from the level 50 suites.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Melbourne today, but the skyline and bay are still visible from the high-floor rooms, only with less colour.
phrases.rain: Rain is running down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Yarra River below looks grey from the afternoon tea tables.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Port Phillip Bay shows clearly from 150 metres up, and the level 50 suites face it from all sides.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides Port Phillip Bay today, so the Atrium Bar's mirrored fifteen-floor canopy is the better thing to look at.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Melbourne, but if it fell today you would see it on the MCG oval from the suite bathroom.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Melbourne, and the clear air shows the eastern suburbs in detail from the high-floor rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside today, and heat haze sits over Port Phillip Bay in the view from the level 50 suites.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the Melbourne skyline lights show clearly from the suite dining area, with its telescope.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only the nearer skyline shows from the level 50 suites today, with Port Phillip Bay out of view to the south.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water stands by the bed and the skyline lights fill the floor-to-ceiling windows on level fifty.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtains open after midnight, rain on the glass blurs the city lights along the Yarra.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Melbourne after midnight, and the city lights show below the open floor-to-ceiling windows of the level 50 suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tiergarten canopy outside the park-facing rooms is still dark, and the zoo enclosures beside the Stue Bar are quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on the treetops, and guests at the floor-to-ceiling windows can see the distant Berlin skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun sits over Tiergarten, and the wood-decked balconies offer a clear look at the treetops and the skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the top of the Tiergarten canopy, and the soaking tub faces that view through the balcony doors.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the Tiergarten trees as dark shapes and the Berlin skyline lit beyond them.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds move over Tiergarten this morning, so the treetops outside the park-facing rooms go bright and dim in turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the clouds break up at times, and the zoo enclosures seen from the Stue Bar get brief sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds filter orange light across the treetops seen from the balcony beside the soaking tub.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the treetops and the city skyline outside the guest rooms look muted but are fully visible.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Tiergarten canopy, and the indoor lap pool, with its tall windows, is the one place to swim today.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the floor-to-ceiling windows of the park-facing rooms give a wide look at lightning over the Tiergarten trees.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over Tiergarten today, so the nearest treetops are visible from the rooms but the distant skyline is not.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the branches of the Tiergarten canopy, and the zoo enclosures outside the Stue Bar turn white too.
phrases.very_cold: If you were at a park-facing window now, you would see frost on the glass and the bare Tiergarten canopy beyond.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Berlin today, so most guests look at the Tiergarten canopy through the glass rather than from the balconies.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the zoo enclosures outside the Stue Bar are dark, and the park-facing balconies are comfortable for sitting.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Berlin today, so from the guest rooms the treetops are clear but the distant skyline is missing.
phrases.late_night: Sleep comes easy in the park-facing rooms after midnight, the Berlin skyline lit past the Tiergarten and the canopy due at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open after midnight, rain runs down the park-facing windows and the city lights show past the Tiergarten treetops.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtains open before bed, the lit skyline shows above the Tiergarten under low cloud from the park-facing rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the west-facing patios are still dark, and the vineyard rows of the Stags Leap District are only shapes below.
phrases.clear_morning: From the glass-railed terrace, breakfast comes with a clear view of green valley farmland and the hills beyond.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the white umbrellas by the kidney-shaped pool are the only shade, with sunlit vineyards stretching below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The five patios face west, so right now the low sun is directly in front of guests, over the Stags Leap vineyards.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the Stags Leap District is clear, and from a private patio guests can see stars above dark vineyards.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit over the Mayacamas Mountains this morning, while the vineyard rows below the suites are in and out of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the rolling hills this afternoon, visible from the rope-hung daybed swing on the balcony.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on a west-facing patio, you would see the last sun coming through gaps in the clouds over the valley.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the whole valley today, so the vineyards below look flat and the distant mountains are dull but visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the vineyard rows of the Stags Leap District, and guests watch it from behind the wide glass doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the valley means the outdoor showers stay empty, and the lightning is watched from inside, next to the fireplace.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills the valley below the suites today, so the vineyards are hidden and only the nearest hillside is clear.
phrases.snow: Snow in Napa Valley is rare, but today white flakes are falling past the glass doors onto the hillside and vineyards.
phrases.very_cold: Today is very cold, so the lounge chairs by the kidney-shaped pool are empty and the outdoor showers are not in use.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the kidney-shaped pool is the busiest place on the hillside, and the vineyards below look dry and bright.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild, cloudy night, warm enough that the outdoor shower on a private patio is a reasonable option.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the patios the nearby vineyard rows are clear but the Mayacamas Mountains cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: After one, the lights of Yountville below are reason enough to watch from the suites' glass doors a while longer.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the suites' glass doors after midnight, and the few lights of the valley below blur behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, cloud covers the Stags Leap District, and the valley lights below show hazy through the suites' glass doors.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the three stacked pools are still empty and the jungle peak is only a dark shape against the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the thatched-roof bungalows, Mount Agung is clearly visible this morning above the jungle canopy.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the three pool tiers, and most guests stay in the water or under shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light reaches the rice terraces below the curved pool edge, and the green turns slightly yellow.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the torches and the Balinese statue on the terrace are lit, and the sky over the jungle shows stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the jungle peak this morning, so the top pool gets sun for a few minutes, then shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on your villa terrace now, you would see cloud shadows moving slowly across the rice terraces.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day comes through gaps in the cloud and lands on the woven dome roofs among the trees.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the jungle valley looks darker green than usual, and the infinity pools reflect flat white cloud.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the jungle canopy, and guests in the villa suites watch it through the glass doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the highlands, so guests have left the three pool tiers and watch the lightning from their terraces.
phrases.fog_haze: Morning fog fills the valley below the bungalows, and the jungle peak is only partly visible from the top pool.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Bali, but if it fell today the thatched bungalow roofs would show it first.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day is rare in these highlands, and the three infinity pools have nobody in them right now.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon like this one, the water in the three pool tiers is the busiest place at the resort.
phrases.mild_night: It is a warm, cloudy night, and the candles on the terrace are the main light over the dark jungle.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Mount Agung is not visible from the bungalows today, and only the nearest rice terraces and jungle canopy show clearly.
phrases.late_night: Were you falling asleep in a villa suite now, you might leave the curtain open to the lit pavilions by the pools.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in a villa suite now, you would see rain on the glass and the pool lights.
phrases.grey_evening: If you finished a last drink at the villa suite's glass doors, you would see the pool lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests at a room window see dark Tiergarten treetops and the TV Tower with its lights still on.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear sky over Berlin this morning, so the Victory Column is sharp in the panorama from the 14th floor.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over Tiergarten, and the green stretches a long way from the suite's panoramic windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests arriving early for the Hugos bar get the window seat with the Victory Column in late sun.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the floor-to-ceiling windows at Hugos show the lit skyline, and dinner at a Michelin-star table comes with that view.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Tiergarten this morning, and the park still looks green from the room balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the desk by the window, the TV Tower stands under a sky that is half cloud, half blue this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in a 14th-floor window seat now, you would see the last sun on the Victory Column between clouds.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Berlin today, so the Tiergarten trees look darker than usual from the suite windows, but still clearly visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Tiergarten treetops, and guests have moved from the balconies to the indoor pool with blue lights.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Berlin, and from the Hugos windows the lightning shows the Tiergarten trees for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over Tiergarten today, so the Victory Column is hidden and only the nearest treetops show from the rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the Tiergarten trees, and the view from the 14th floor is mostly white and grey right now.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air outside today, so the balconies stay empty, and guests watch the clear view of Tiergarten from behind the glass.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot Berlin afternoon, the indoor pool with its blue lights has more guests than the sunny balconies.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over Berlin, and the city lights are still clear from the candlelit tables at Hugos.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the room windows the Tiergarten trees are clear but the TV Tower is not visible.
phrases.late_night: Guests facing Tiergarten have switched the room lights off, and only the skyline lights past the park reach the bed.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the suites after midnight can watch rain fall over Tiergarten, the city lights blurred through wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake after midnight in a Tiergarten-facing suite can watch low cloud drift over the park, the city lights under it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Seen from the rooftop infinity pool before sunrise, the Sagrada Família spires are dark shapes against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool, the towers of the Sagrada Família stand sharp against a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a cloudless sky, the lounge beds under the rooftop pergola are the shaded spots everyone looks for.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the city rooftops, and from the pool the Sagrada Família spires turn a deep orange.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests on the Deluxe Terrace balconies look down on the lights of Plaça de Catalunya.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds cross the Eixample this morning, and the Sagrada Família spires move in and out of shadow from the pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A few afternoon clouds sit over Tibidabo hill, while the rooftop infinity pool stays in sunshine most of the time.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken clouds turn orange above the Cathedral spires in the last sunlight, seen from the striped chairs on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Barcelona today, but the Sagrada Família towers are still easy to pick out from the rooftop pool.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop pool and its pergola, and the Eixample rooftops look darker and wet from the suite windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is passing over the city, and the rooftop terrace is empty while lightning shows behind the Sagrada Família.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the Eixample today, and from the pool the Sagrada Família towers are only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Barcelona, but if it fell today, the lounge beds under the rooftop pergola would carry a thin layer.
phrases.very_cold: On a day close to freezing, the rooftop pool is for looking at, not swimming, with the Sagrada Família sharp behind it.
phrases.very_hot: From the rooftop pool this afternoon, heat-haze shimmers over the Eixample roofs below the spires of the Sagrada Família.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild under a cloudy sky, and the Deluxe Terrace balconies over Plaça de Catalunya are comfortable for sitting out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop pool the nearby Eixample rooftops are clear but Tibidabo hill is not visible.
phrases.late_night: If you switched off the last light at two, the Eixample's glow would show the Sagrada Família towers in the window.
phrases.wet_evening: If you took one last drink up on the rooftop tonight, you would see the Sagrada Família towers through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: With a last drink at the window tonight, you would see the Sagrada Família spires under cloud over the lit Eixample.

phrases.clear_predawn: Still dark over Toronto, and from the 44th-floor windows at KŌST the CN Tower shows against a clear pre-dawn sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From a King room, the sheer curtains pulled back show the CN Tower and Lake Ontario in full morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop infinity pool at KŌST gets direct sun, with the CN Tower straight behind the swimmers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on Lake Ontario and the Rogers Centre dome, both visible from the rooftop pool at KŌST.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the CN Tower lit up through the floor-to-ceiling windows at KŌST.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Lake Ontario this morning, and guests on the Kravitz suite terraces see the CN Tower in patches of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Partly cloudy over Toronto this afternoon; from the 7th-floor Kravitz suites the skyline is clear enough to count the towers.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun puts broken cloud shadows on Lake Ontario, seen from the 44th-floor windows at KŌST.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the CN Tower is a darker grey shape from the rooftop pool, and Lake Ontario looks flat.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the King rooms, and the CN Tower is a wet grey outline behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, lightning over Lake Ontario is visible from the 44th floor, and nobody is in the rooftop pool.
phrases.fog_haze: In fog, the CN Tower disappears above a certain height, and dinner at KŌST is mostly about the Bajan menu.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the 44th-floor windows at KŌST, and the edge of the rooftop infinity pool turns white.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold outside, and the Kravitz suite terraces are empty, but the CN Tower is sharp in the clear air.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day the rooftop infinity pool is where most guests are, with the CN Tower directly behind it.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night; from the Kravitz suite terraces the CN Tower lights are visible but the stars are not.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the CN Tower is clear from the 44th floor, but the far side of Lake Ontario is not.
phrases.late_night: Were the lights off in a Kravitz suite after midnight, the lit city around the CN Tower would be the only glow.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were at KŌST for a last drink tonight, you would see the CN Tower through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were at KŌST for a last drink tonight, you would see CN Tower's outline against low cloud over the lake.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Ayung River can already be heard from the Riverfront Pool Villas, while the valley stays dark.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the rice terraces below the villas are bright green and the river is easy to follow.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun sits directly over the valley, and the private pool terraces are the busiest places on the hillside.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun now lights the forest highlands across the valley, seen from every lounger at the Riverfront Pool Villas.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the villa pool terraces are lit only by starlight, and the river noise comes up from below.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the valley this morning, and the rice terraces change from bright to dull green every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the curved infinity pool, swimmers look down at the rocky river while clouds move slowly over the jungle.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds leave patches of orange light on the forest highlands opposite the villas.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the valley today, and the lotus pond on top of the main building looks flat and grey too.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rice terraces, and most guests are watching it from the timber balconies rather than the pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls across the Ayung Valley, and the suspension bridge at the entrance is empty while lightning lights the forest briefly.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist fills the river valley today, and from the timber balconies only the nearest palms and treetops are clearly visible.
phrases.snow: Snow in Bali would be a first, but if it fell today the rice terraces below the villas would turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On this unusually cold day for Bali, the private villa pools are quiet and guests sit wrapped up on the balconies.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the valley, and the curved infinity pool above the river is the only reasonable place to be.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm, cloudy night the dining terrace is lit, and the river can be heard somewhere below the tables.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the river below the pool is clear but the far forest highlands are only an outline.
phrases.late_night: Dinner over, the pool lights of the Riverfront Pool Villas show on the Ayung River.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass of the Riverfront Pool Villas after midnight, and the Ayung River can be seen between the wet trees.
phrases.grey_evening: Before bed, the villa lights along the Ayung River glow under low cloud tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the castle is a dark shape across the bay, seen from the south-facing upper rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at the hilltop restaurant comes with the castle, the harbor and Kos all clear in the morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the free-form pool is the busiest spot, with Bodrum Bay and Kos sharp on the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the terrace loungers, the whitewashed town and the Castle of St. Peter from the side.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the town lights around the harbor from the candlelit terrace tables.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Bodrum Bay this morning, so the pool view switches between shade and sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the south-facing rooms, patches of cloud shadow move across the bay while Kos stays visible on the horizon.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds over the castle, which the terrace diners get for free.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the bay looks flat and silver from the terrace, and the castle loses its shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the free-form pool and the clay court, and the harbor looks grey from the upper rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: When a storm comes in, guests watch lightning over Bodrum Bay from inside the hilltop restaurant rather than from the pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the sea hides Kos today, though the castle and the harbor are still visible from the pool.
phrases.snow: Snow in Bodrum is rare, so a few flakes over the castle would pull most guests to the south-facing windows.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day the pool loungers stay empty, but the view of Kos is unusually sharp.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat most guests are in the free-form pool, looking at the castle with only their heads above water.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm and cloudy, so dinner on the terrace works, and the harbor lights show below under a starless sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Kos is missing from the pool panorama and the castle across the bay looks faded.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the harbour lights fill the window of the upper south-facing rooms; at dawn the castle will share that frame.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the south-facing upper rooms tonight, and the harbour lights look blurred around the castle's outline.
phrases.grey_evening: Under cloud after midnight, the town lights reach down to the castle and the harbour in front of the south-facing upper rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlas ridge is only a dark outline from the suite terraces, with the resort pool still and unlit below.
phrases.clear_morning: From the four-poster rooms, the morning light shows the palm gardens and the pool under a blue sky with nothing in it.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the wooden beams over the suite terraces give the only shade, and the Atlas peaks are clear against the sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The rooftop plunge pool faces the sunset, with the palm-dotted city and the Atlas ridge turning orange before dusk.
phrases.clear_night: Guests on the terraces after midnight see stars in the clear sky above the Atlas horizon and lantern light on the pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are drifting across the Atlas ridge this morning, so from the suite terraces the peaks appear and disappear by turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud pass over the olive groves this afternoon, and guests at the poolside bar get shade without asking for it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud above the Atlas turns orange, as seen from candlelit tables on the dining terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlas ridge is still visible from the villa terraces, just flatter and with less contrast than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the olive and palm groves, and the indoor pool with its gold mosaic tiles is the busier option.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Atlas means lightning on the ridge, best watched from under the wooden beams of a suite terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Atlas today, and from the suite terraces only the resort pool and the nearest palms are clearly visible.
phrases.snow: Snow in Marrakech itself is rare, but today a thin white layer covers the palm groves seen from the four-poster rooms.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold, the snow on the Atlas peaks is clear from the terraces, and the white sofas sit empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over the groves keeps guests in their villa plunge pools, with the Atlas ridge in view from the water.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over the Atlas, and the candlelit tables beside the terrace pool are where most guests end up.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Atlas ridge is not in the terrace view, leaving the pool, the palms and little else.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the lit villa pools face the Atlas, which returns at first light.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the pool villa windows after midnight, and low cloud covers the Atlas ridge to the south.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the Atlas ridge after midnight, so from the pool villas the courtyard lanterns show through a thin haze.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before sunrise, the Eiffel Tower is a dark shape seen from the rooftop herb garden under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop herb planters, the Eiffel Tower is already sharp in clear morning light over Paris.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the wooden deck, and the Eiffel Tower is clearly visible from the lounge chairs.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on the rooftop terrace watch the late sun turn the Eiffel Tower a warm colour before it sets.
phrases.clear_night: From the rooftop terrace, the Eiffel Tower rises above the Paris skyline under a clear night sky with stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Paris this morning, and the Eiffel Tower is sometimes in sun, sometimes in shade, seen from the rooftop.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the guest rooms, afternoon light through the floor-to-ceiling windows comes and goes as clouds pass over the tree-lined terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the Eiffel Tower between clouds while candles are lit on the rooftop under the orange awning.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Eiffel Tower looks flat and grey too, but it is still visible from the rooftop hot tub.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the wooden deck, so most guests sit in the lobby lounge under its painted ceiling instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the rooftop terrace is empty, and lightning shows the Eiffel Tower for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the upper part of the Eiffel Tower today, so from the rooftop only the lower legs are visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the lounge chairs and herb planters while the Eiffel Tower stands grey behind the falling flakes.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside, so the heated rooftop terrace and the hot tub get more use than the lounge chairs.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the shade under the orange awning is where guests sit, with the Eiffel Tower in full sun.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Henri Suite's outdoor bath faces the lit Eiffel Tower under a low sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; from the rooftop the Eiffel Tower is only a faint outline and the far skyline is not visible.
phrases.late_night: If you turned off the Henri Suite lights tonight, the only light left would be the city around the Eiffel Tower's outline.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were finishing a last glass in the Henri Suite tonight, you would see the Eiffel Tower's shape through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a late drink in your room tonight, you would find the Eiffel Tower's iron shape under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Windermere room's windows already show the outline of the fells against a clear sky over the lake.
phrases.clear_morning: From the bay window seat in the lounge, the terraced gardens and the wooded hills are sharp in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests in the Grasmere room can see the full length of Lake Windermere below, with no cloud over the fells at midday.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Afternoon tea is being served on the panoramic terrace, and the low sun lights the lake and the fells beyond.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Haweswater room tonight, you would see stars over Lake Windermere and the dark shape of the fells.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the wooded hills this morning, and the lounge's curved bay window frames patches of sun on the gardens.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the terrace, scones and jam are on the tables while clouds pass over Windermere and the fells behind it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun reaches the formal garden terrace between clouds, seen from the pink window seat in the lounge.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the fells and the lake today, and the gardens below the lounge window look a darker green.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the terrace, so afternoon tea moves inside to the lounge, where the bay window still faces the gardens.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder is loud over Lake Windermere, and guests in the lake-facing rooms can watch lightning over the fells from their windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of Lake Windermere today, and from the Windermere room only the nearest part of the gardens is clear.
phrases.snow: Snow lies on the terraced gardens and the wooded hills, and the fireplace in the guest rooms is lit.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold outside, and from the twin windows of the guest rooms the wooded hillside looks white with frost.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot weather is rare here, but today guests take afternoon tea in the lounge rather than on the terrace.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the lake below the hotel is dark, and only the gardens near the lounge windows are lit.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests on the terrace this afternoon see the gardens and the near water of Windermere, but not the far fells.
phrases.late_night: Back from a glass of wine by the sitting-room fire, guests in the Windermere room sleep now, the lake below their window.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the Haweswater room tonight would see rain on the window and the lake below catching what light there is.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has the Windermere room tonight is likely asleep by now, low cloud over the lake and a few shore lights below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the outline of Mount Agung is already visible above the dark forest ridge from the villa terraces.
phrases.clear_morning: From any of the 85 suites, both Mount Agung and Mount Batur stand sharp above the canopy this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests float in the infinity pool with the two volcanic peaks in plain sight.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns Mount Agung orange above the forest, and the tropical plants in front become dark shapes.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the infinity pool terrace tonight, you would see the volcanoes only as darker shapes against the sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit around the top of Mount Batur this morning, while Mount Agung shows clearly from the villa pools.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, patches of cloud pass over the forest canopy, and the volcanoes appear and disappear between them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, cloud edges above the ridge catch the light while the rooftop dining lamps come on.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the highlands today, so the peaks are hidden and the view ends at the green ridge.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the canopy below the villas, and the private pools are getting slightly fuller.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Payangan, lightning shows the ridge for a second, and nobody is in the infinity pools right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills the valley between the villas and the ridge, and both volcanoes are missing from the view for now.
phrases.snow: With snow falling over the forest ridge, Mount Agung stands above the canopy beyond the two heated infinity pools.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold morning in Payangan, steam rises off the two heated communal infinity pools.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, most guests stay in their private villa pools and look at the volcanoes from the water.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night covers Payangan, the rooftop dining area is lit, and the volcanoes stay out of sight.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the nearby canopy is clear but Mount Agung and Mount Batur cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: Were you to switch off every light in a pool villa now, the sky over Mount Agung's ridge would be the only glow.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in your villa now, you would see Mount Agung's outline through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Over a last drink in your villa after midnight, you would find cloud hiding Mount Agung and a few villa lights showing.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the upper Gulf-view rooms look out on a dark sea with the Palm Jumeirah's lights still on.
phrases.clear_morning: From a balcony this morning, the Palm Jumeirah's waterways are flat and bright, and the private beach is slowly filling with towels.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the private beach, so many guests are inside at Ossiano, watching the Ambassador Lagoon instead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From a skyline-view room in the late afternoon, the Dubai skyline across the calm water turns orange through the tall glass doors.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the terrace hot tub tonight, you would see the lit Dubai Marina skyline across the Palm's waterways.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Gulf this morning, and the Palm Jumeirah's arc is clear to see from the upper rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Aquaventure Waterpark this afternoon, which changes nothing for anyone standing in a queue for a slide.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the Dubai skyline adds colour to the sunset seen from the balcony.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Gulf looks flat from the upper rooms, so the suite's aquarium window has the better view today.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Dubai, and today it falls on the private beach while diners at Ossiano watch rays pass the windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Gulf is visible from the balconies, and the Aquaventure Waterpark slides are empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the water today, so the Dubai skyline is only a faint outline from the high-floor restaurant windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is reported over Palm Jumeirah today, which almost never happens, and the private beach is empty for once.
phrases.very_cold: Dubai is unusually cold today, and the terrace hot tub is the busiest spot with a view over the Palm's waterways.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside this afternoon, so the Aquaventure Waterpark slides are busy and the sun loungers by the archway are mostly empty.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night, the balcony's two chairs still face the lit skyline across the Palm Jumeirah waterways.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the upper Gulf-view rooms the far end of the Palm Jumeirah's arc cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: If you turned off every light in a skyline-view suite at three, Palm Jumeirah's waterway lights would be all that shows.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in your room, rain on the glass would blur the lights along Palm Jumeirah's waterways.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in a skyline-view room now, you would see Dubai's lights across the Palm's water under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Salesforce Tower is a dark shape against a clear sky from the city-view rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Fredericks is serving breakfast while the skyline outside the city-view rooms sits sharp under a clear San Francisco morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the downtown rooftops seen from the suite windows have no haze over them at all.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the glass of the Salesforce Tower, and guests in the One-Bedroom suite get the clearest version of the view.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a city-view room tonight, you would see the Salesforce Tower lit against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the skyline this morning, so the light on the downtown rooftops changes every few minutes from the suite windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Salesforce Tower moves in and out of shadow as clouds cross above the city-view rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun is lighting some downtown rooftops and leaving others grey, as seen from the One-Bedroom suite.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers San Francisco today, and the skyline from the city-view rooms looks a little less sharp.
phrases.rain: Rain is running down the suite windows, and the Redwood Room with its 800-year-old redwood bar is where most guests are.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, which is rare here, guests can watch lightning behind the Salesforce Tower from the city-view rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken the top of the Salesforce Tower today, a normal San Francisco event seen from the suites.
phrases.snow: Snow in San Francisco is very unusual, but if it were falling, the downtown rooftops outside the suite windows would turn white.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside, a rare thing here, and the skyline looks very clear from the city-view rooms.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day like this, the Salesforce Tower stands in strong light outside the city-view room windows.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, guests move between the Redwood Room bar and the lit skyline in the city-view rooms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the far end of the skyline is missing from the suite windows, while nearer rooftops stay clear.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the lights are off in the One-Bedroom suite, and the lit city skyline is the only light in the room.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the One-Bedroom suite windows tonight, and the city lights blur behind the glass, the Salesforce Tower's outline among them.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hides the top of the Salesforce Tower tonight, and the city lights fill the windows of the One-Bedroom suite.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gherkin and the Shard are dark shapes against a clear sky from the Jin Bo Law Skybar windows.
phrases.clear_morning: In Corner Suite Botolph, morning light arrives from the east and the City skyline outside is sharp and clear.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Gherkin, the Walkie-Talkie and St Botolph's steeple are all easy to count from the rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the glass of the Gherkin and the Scalpel, seen from the 14th-floor Skybar before dusk.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Jin Bo Law Skybar tonight, you would see the Shard and Tower Bridge against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the City this morning, and the Gherkin goes in and out of sunlight outside the guest rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the gym's floor-to-ceiling windows, the stone-clad buildings across the street are half in sun, half in cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the Shard between the clouds, a view guests get from the 14th-floor Skybar.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers the City today, but the Walkie-Talkie and the Gherkin are still fully visible from the rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the corner windows of Suite Botolph, and the City towers outside look darker and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, lightning flashes over the City skyline, visible from the upper floors and the Jin Bo Law Skybar.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the distant Shard today, so the view from the Skybar stops at the nearer Gherkin and Walkie-Talkie.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the City, and St Botolph's steeple outside the hotel windows has a white top.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing outside, with very clear air, so Tower Bridge and the Shard look sharp from the upper rooms.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot London day, the street below the gym windows is bright and the Gherkin's glass reflects strong sun.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night over Aldgate, and guests at the Jin Bo Law Skybar have the lit City towers under the clouds.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Gherkin and the Walkie-Talkie are visible from the rooms, but the distant Shard is not.
phrases.late_night: Well after midnight, the Corner Suite Botolph windows show Tower Bridge beside the City's lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Corner Suite Botolph windows after midnight, and the Gherkin's shape shows among the City's wet lights.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain is open in the Corner Suite Botolph tonight, and Tower Bridge and the lit City towers show under the cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Potomac is still dark below the balconies before sunrise, and the Washington Monument shows as a pale shape in the distance.
phrases.clear_morning: From a room balcony, Key Bridge and the Georgetown waterfront look sharp in the early sun over the river.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun sits high over the Potomac, and the Arlington skyline across the water looks sharp from the guest rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop now, you would see the Washington Monument in the low sun and the Potomac shining below.
phrases.clear_night: Key Bridge is lit up tonight, and from the balconies the Georgetown waterfront and Arlington skyline stand out against the dark sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over Georgetown this morning, and guests on their balconies have the Potomac directly below them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, patches of cloud pass over the Potomac, and the view of Key Bridge from the balconies changes with the light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the Potomac glow orange above Key Bridge, seen from a guest-room balcony.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the floor-to-ceiling windows still frame the Potomac, Key Bridge and a flat, pale Arlington skyline.
phrases.rain: Wet glass in the guest rooms blurs the view of Key Bridge while rain falls on the Potomac today.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the river right now; from the floor-to-ceiling windows, lightning shows the Arlington skyline for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Potomac today, and from the balconies Key Bridge is only a faint grey line.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Foggy Bottom, and the treetops along the riverbank below the suite windows are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: It is bitterly cold outside, so the balconies stay empty and most guests watch the Potomac from behind the windows instead.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air hangs over Washington today, and the Kingbird terrace above the water is quieter than usual at lunchtime.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the lights of Key Bridge and Georgetown reflect on the dark Potomac below the rooftop.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the Potomac and Key Bridge show from the balconies, but the Arlington skyline is only a grey outline.
phrases.late_night: The Georgetown lights reflect in the Potomac after midnight, easy to watch for another hour.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suite lounge, and the Georgetown waterfront lights blur over the Potomac.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze lies over the Potomac after midnight, and from the room windows the Key Bridge lights blur on the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, west-facing rooms look down on His Majesty's Theatre as a dark shape, with the city towers behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the office towers to the west, so the skyline from an upper-floor king room looks sharp today.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over Perth, and the heritage stonework seen from a corner room shows every carved detail.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the hotel directly from the west, so His Majesty's Theatre below the upper rooms turns warm yellow before sunset.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the terrace bar faces Hay Street and the lit office towers of the CBD.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the CBD this morning, and from the Club InterContinental on Level 16 their shadows cross the towers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Broken cloud this afternoon means the glass office tower outside the upper-floor rooms changes between bright and dull every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in a west-facing room now, you would see the last sun reach His Majesty's Theatre between the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Perth today, and from the suite's floor-to-ceiling window the CBD towers look flat against a white sky.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Hay Street, and the heritage facades seen from the upper rooms look darker and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, lightning over the CBD towers is visible from the upper-floor windows, and the terrace bar is empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Perth softens the far towers today, but His Majesty's Theatre, close below the west-facing rooms, stays clear.
phrases.snow: Snow in Perth is almost unheard of, so a few flakes outside a high-floor king room would be worth a photo.
phrases.very_cold: From a corner room window you would see hard winter light on His Majesty's Theatre and the towers beyond.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the CBD today, and from the twin room window the city buildings shimmer slightly in the heat.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars on this mild night, and guests at the terrace bar over Hay Street look toward the mural tower.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the farther CBD towers are missing from the upper-floor view, though His Majesty's Theatre is still clear.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water at the bedside, and the lit CBD towers fill the west-facing window beyond His Majesty's Theatre.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtains open before bed in the west-facing rooms, the rain blurs the lit CBD towers behind His Majesty's Theatre.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open past midnight, the west-facing rooms look onto the CBD tower lights under a low grey cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the arched stone windows show a dark, flat Mediterranean with no boats on it yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests on the hydromassage pool deck can already take the stairs straight into the calm morning sea.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sea below the sea-level windows turns its brightest turquoise, and the coastline mountains look very close.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the L'Antica Cartiera terrace now, you would see the low sun lighting the mountainous coastline.
phrases.clear_night: From the restaurant terrace tonight, candlelit tables face the dark sea while the hotel's lit windows reflect on the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Mediterranean this morning, and the water seen from the dining room changes from blue to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon some clouds shade the coastline mountains while the pool deck and the water around the private dock stay in sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the sea gives the terrace tables a mix of orange light and shadow.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the sea outside the arched windows looks pale and flat, and the Marmorata waterfall runs as usual.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the pool deck and the sea; the dining room's floor-to-ceiling windows offer a dry seat to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: With lightning over the Mediterranean, nobody takes the stairs into the sea, and guests watch from the arched stone windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, so from the sea-level windows the mountainous coastline is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snowfall here is rare, but if it came today the stairs from the pool deck into the sea would stay unused.
phrases.very_cold: A freezing clear day: the sea by the private dock is bright but empty, and lunch happens inside the tiled dining room.
phrases.very_hot: The air over the cliffs is very hot, so most guests cool off by walking down the deck stairs into the sea.
phrases.mild_night: Warm and cloudy tonight, with no stars, but the lit windows of the old paper mill reflect on the calm sea.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the arched windows, the sea shows only close to the Marmorata cliffs, and the far coastline is hidden in haze.
phrases.late_night: If you were back in a room after dinner at L'Antica Cartiera, you would see the hotel's own lights on the sea.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last glass in your room tonight, you would watch rain run down the arched window above the sea.
phrases.grey_evening: With a last glass at a sea-facing window now, you would see low cloud and the lights of Minori along the shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, odd-numbered rooms look over a dark, still Jacarepaguá Lagoon, with Pedra da Gávea a black outline from the even side.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun reaches the floor-to-ceiling windows of the even-numbered rooms, and Pedra da Gávea stands sharp against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Strong midday sun covers the rooftop pool on the ninth level, and Pedra da Gávea behind it has no cloud on it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the AtRio Rooftop the sun drops toward Pedra da Gávea, and the Two Brothers Mountain turns into a dark silhouette.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the city boulevards below the balconies are lit, the palm trees are dark, and the mountain is only a shape.
