phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over Jacarepaguá Lagoon this morning, so guests in odd-numbered rooms see patches of sun and shade on the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds sit on top of Pedra da Gávea this afternoon, but the rooftop bar still has sun between them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the mountains take on colour, best seen from the infinity pool.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Barra da Tijuca today, and Pedra da Gávea looks dull from the even-numbered rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the lagoon and the boulevards, and inside the soundproofed rooms the floor-to-ceiling windows are streaked with water.
phrases.thunderstorm: With a thunderstorm over Barra, lightning on the mountains is easier to watch from the indoor pool behind its glass walls.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the lagoon today, and from the balconies the mountains beyond the palm trees are soft and pale.
phrases.snow: Snow in Barra da Tijuca would be a first, and every floor-to-ceiling window would have a guest watching Pedra da Gávea.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare freezing day the rooftop infinity pool stays empty, and Pedra da Gávea is clear from the fitness center.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot across Barra today, and most guests on the 9th floor are in the infinity pool rather than beside it.
phrases.mild_night: If you were there tonight, under a warm cloudy sky, you would sit in a balcony wicker chair above the city boulevards.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the distant mountains are missing from the even-numbered rooms, and only the near palm trees show clearly.
phrases.late_night: Back from the AtRio Rooftop, you would see Pedra da Gávea's outline above boulevard lights.
phrases.wet_evening: If you took a last drink at the AtRio Lounge tonight, rain on the glass would blur the lit boulevards below.
phrases.grey_evening: With a last drink in an even-numbered room now, you would see the lit boulevards under cloud toward Pedra da Gávea.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Chicago River is dark under the corner Riviere suite windows, with the skyline still mostly unlit.
phrases.clear_morning: A clear morning in Chicago, and the king rooms get plain daylight on the nearby buildings outside their windows.
phrases.clear_midday: From the lobby lounge, the floor-to-ceiling windows show the city buildings in full midday sun, with no clouds at all.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the rooftop terrace at Raised, and the skyline across the Chicago River turns a warm colour for an hour.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Chicago is clear, so guests at Raised can see the lit skyline without anything in the way.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds move over the skyline this morning, but the Chicago River below the corner Riviere suites is still in sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in a Riviere suite this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows passing over the skyline and the river.
phrases.partly_golden: On the rooftop terrace, the last hour of sun colours the clouds above the Chicago River and the towers facing it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the skyline from the lobby lounge windows looks flat and grey too, but every building is still visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Chicago River, so the rooftop terrace at Raised is empty and guests watch from their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, nobody sits on the outdoor terrace, and lightning over the skyline is watched from the Riviere suite windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Chicago River today, and from the king rooms only the nearest buildings can be made out.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Loop, and from the lobby lounge windows the nearby buildings are partly hidden by the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold, ice may show on the Chicago River, and nobody lingers on the rooftop terrace at Raised.
phrases.very_hot: Chicago is very hot today, and most guests look at the river from inside their rooms instead of the outdoor terrace.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the Loop on this mild night, and the colourful stools on the rooftop terrace at Raised are mostly taken.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the river below the Riviere suites is clear while the farther skyline towers are not.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water at midnight in a corner Riviere suite, and the skyline lights show on the Chicago River.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the corner Riviere suites, and the skyline lights look blurred along the Chicago River after midnight.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze drifts across the upper floors of the towers after midnight, and the Riviere suites look onto the lit skyline and river.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Parliament building across the Danube is still lit, and the balconies are empty and quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Chain Bridge, and from the dining room tables guests can see Parliament sharply across the river.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the Danube looks bright from the balconies and Parliament stands in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the stone of Parliament, and a suite balcony is the obvious place to sit right now.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your balcony tonight, you would see Parliament, Chain Bridge and Matthias Church all lit under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over Budapest this morning, but the dining room view of Parliament across the river is still clear.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds move across the sky this afternoon, so the light on Chain Bridge changes every few minutes from the balconies.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky above Parliament, and guests are photographing it from the balconies.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Danube looks grey too, and the Donald Sultan art in the corridors gets more attention than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Danube, and the courtyard terrace tables are empty while guests watch Parliament from their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the balcony, lightning flashes over the lit Parliament Building across the Danube while rain sweeps the river.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the Danube hides most of Parliament today, and only the near end of Chain Bridge shows from the balconies.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Budapest, settling on the balcony rails and on the roof of Parliament across the river.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold outside, so the balconies stay empty and guests look at Chain Bridge through closed windows.
phrases.very_hot: From the balcony at midday, heat-haze blurs the Parliament Building and the Chain Bridge across the Danube.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and a few guests are sitting out on their balconies facing the lit Parliament.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Parliament across the Danube is a dim shape and Matthias Church cannot be seen at all.
phrases.late_night: In a room facing Parliament tonight, you would be asleep, and at first light its dome would appear across the Danube.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in your room tonight, you would see the Parliament's dome across the Danube through rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in a suite tonight, you would see the Parliament's dome across the Danube under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Acropolis is already a dark shape above the city from the balconies of the rooms that face it.
phrases.clear_morning: From the 5th-floor rooftop at Point-a, the Parthenon columns stand sharp and pale in the clear morning sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the Acropolis is in full sun and the rooftop hot tubs give a view of it without any walking uphill.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the Parthenon marble warm orange, best seen from a balcony table in one of the Acropolis-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_night: From the Point-a rooftop terrace, the floodlit Parthenon stands above the Athens rooftops after midnight under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Athens this morning, so from the rooftop the Parthenon goes in and out of sunlight every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on your balcony this afternoon, you would see white clouds moving behind the Parthenon columns.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun is lighting the Acropolis in patches as the clouds break up, seen from the roof garden.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Parthenon looks flat and pale from the rooftop terrace, but every column is still clearly visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Athens, and the indoor lounge with its glass ceiling is where guests watch it come down.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Athens, so guests have left the roof garden and watch the lightning from the lounge behind glass walls.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Athens today softens the Acropolis, so from Point-a the Parthenon is a pale outline rather than sharp columns.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Athens, but today the Parthenon has a white top, which the balconies of the Acropolis-facing rooms show clearly.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing on the 5th-floor rooftop, and the two hydromassage hot tubs are steaming in front of the Acropolis.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Athens, and the rooftop at Point-a gives the Acropolis view without the climb up the Sacred Rock.
phrases.mild_night: On this warm cloudy night, the floodlit Parthenon is the brightest thing visible from the hot tubs in the roof garden.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Athens, and the Acropolis, only 289 metres away, is still clear from the rooftop while distant rooftops fade.
phrases.late_night: Another hour awake after midnight goes easily with the Parthenon's outline above the Athens rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner at Point-a, rain blurs the lit rooftops under the Acropolis.
phrases.grey_evening: Long after dinner at Point-a, the Acropolis-facing rooms look out on the rock under low cloud and the lit rooftops of Athens.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the station forecourt under the balcony rooms is almost empty, and the sky over Madrid is already clear.

phrases.clear_midday: Sun on the rooftop terrace is strong at midday, so the tables behind the floor-to-ceiling windows get more use.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the tree-lined rooftops seen from the balcony rooms, and the rooftop bar starts filling for the evening.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far edge of the skyline today, so the rooftop windows show only the nearer rooftops and Atocha station.
phrases.snow: Snow in Madrid is rare, but today it is settling on the parked cars in the Atocha forecourt below the balcony rooms.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air outside today keeps the rooftop lounge seating empty, while the view of the skyline is sharp and clear.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the open balcony doors stay shut, and the rooftop bar only fills after the sun has dropped.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, so the rooftop bar's lounge seating is in use and the city lights are visible below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Atocha forecourt is clear from the balconies but the far skyline cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: Whoever is awake after midnight in a room above the Atocha forecourt is probably watching Madrid's rooftop lights a while longer.

phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the rooms facing the Atocha forecourt can watch Madrid's lights come on under low cloud as the day ends.

phrases.clear_predawn: From a suite terrace before sunrise, you would see the lights of Oia to the right under a clear sky.

phrases.very_cold: From the Imerovigli suite terraces, hard winter light falls on the caldera, with Oia to the right and the terrace chairs empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the cliff today, and the shaded pergola terrace is where guests sit between swims in the pool.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, so the suite terraces are usable late, even though the caldera sea below is dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so from the suite terraces Oia is hard to make out and Thirassia is not clear.

phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the arched glass doors of the suites, and the lights of Oia blur across the caldera.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a terrace chair now, you would watch the sun drop toward the Aegean with nothing in the way.

phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing on the cliff today, and the sun loungers by the round plunge pools stay empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Imerovigli this afternoon, and the cave pool is where most guests have gone.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night, a lit cruise ship is moving slowly across the dark caldera below the candlelit terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short, so from the infinity pool the near caldera cliffs are clear but Fira village is only a faint shape.
phrases.late_night: At midnight in a cave suite, a glass of water is poured and Fira's lights show across the caldera.
phrases.wet_evening: After a late dinner at Koukoumavlos, rain runs down the suite window and Fira's lights show along the caldera cliff.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the harbour-facing rooms already show the Harbour Bridge as a dark shape against a clear sky over Sydney.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: On the curved terrace, the wicker seats face the Opera House while the low sun lights the Harbour Bridge from the side.

phrases.very_cold: On a very cold, clear day, the windows of the lounge bar show the Harbour Bridge in bright winter light.
phrases.very_hot: Sydney is very hot today, and the koalas outside the room windows are doing what koalas do in heat, mostly nothing.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and the open walls of the lounge bar face the lights of the Harbour Bridge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooms the Opera House is a faint outline and the CBD skyline is mostly hidden.
phrases.late_night: The curtain stays open tonight in a harbour-facing room, and the skyline lights across the water are the last sight before sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtains are open late in the harbour rooms, and the Bridge's arch shows through rain across the lit harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open at bedtime in the harbour-facing rooms, and under cloud the Bridge's arch stands among the city lights across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: In the dark before dawn, guests on the suite terraces see black calm water and the lit towers of West Bay.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning sun reaches the blue sun loungers on the private beach, and a wooden dhow sits out on the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the white umbrella on the private beach is the only shade, and most guests have moved to the spa.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the arched openings of the balconies, and the Doha skyline across the bay turns yellow and then orange.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight Parisa's outdoor tables are set under a clear sky, with lanterns on the terrace and city lights across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Arabian Gulf this morning, seen from the wicker chairs on the suite balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace with brass tables, clouds throw moving shadows on the bay while the West Bay towers stay in sun.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on a Gulf-facing terrace now, you would watch the last sun light the clouds above the skyline.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Doha today, so the Gulf looks pale from the beach and the pink bougainvillea on the terrace stands out.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Doha, and today it falls on the empty sun loungers while guests stay inside the spa.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Arabian Gulf is visible from the suite balconies, and the Parisa outdoor tables are not in use for now.
phrases.fog_haze: From the suite balconies today, haze over the bay reduces the West Bay towers to pale grey shapes.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the landscaped gardens of the village, something almost nobody in Doha has seen from a hotel terrace.
phrases.very_cold: Hard winter light falls on the empty blue sun loungers along the private beach facing the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air hangs over the private beach, so the sea and the spa are the two sensible places to be.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the candlelit tables on the terrace still look over calm water and city lights.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the West Bay skyline across the bay is not visible from the beach, only the near water.
phrases.late_night: The West Bay lights reflect on the Gulf well past bedtime from a Gulf-facing suite.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the windows of the Gulf-facing suites after midnight, and the West Bay skyline lights show across the bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Doha after midnight, and the West Bay skyline lights show across the water from the Gulf-facing suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tower rooms look onto a dark city, and the garden pool between the buildings is still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at Elena is under way, and from La Mansión the French Embassy facade stands in full morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun reaches the heated pool in the garden, so the white lounge chairs and umbrellas are all in use.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From a Tower balcony, the late sun lights the city skyline, and the rooftops below turn a warm colour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see city lights from a Tower room and a dark, quiet garden from La Mansión.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Retiro this morning, and the glass-roofed dining room gets light and shade in turn during breakfast.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the sun comes and goes over the garden, and swimmers in the heated pool hardly notice the difference.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the ornate white facade of La Mansión between passing clouds, seen from the terrace.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the city today, but the view from the Tower rooms across the rooftops is still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the garden and the pool, and guests in La Mansión watch the wet French Embassy facade from their suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, the outdoor pool is empty and the Tower balconies give a wide view of lightning over Buenos Aires.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far city from the Tower windows today, though the French Embassy facade next door remains easy to see.
phrases.snow: Snow in Buenos Aires is rare, and today it settles briefly on the lounge chairs around the heated pool.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold, clear day, the heated pool steams in the garden, and few guests use the white lounge chairs.
phrases.very_hot: If you were at a Tower window now, you would see heat-haze over the Buenos Aires rooftops and the garden pool.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Retiro, and the Tower balconies are comfortable for sitting out and watching the city lights.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so the distant skyline is missing from the Tower windows, and the garden view from La Mansión is unchanged.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner at Elena, the Tower room window shows the city lights of Retiro at one in the morning.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Elena, the city lights look blurred through the rain on the Tower room windows.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Elena, a Tower room window shows the city lights of Buenos Aires under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the 13th-floor terrace shows a clear dark sky and the still-lit skyline around St. Stephen's spire.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the 12th floor this clear morning comes with the Schneeberg mountains visible beyond the rooftops of Vienna.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun lands on the sun terrace and on the wooden balcony chairs, with the cathedral spire sharp against blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a balcony now, you would see late sun on St. Stephen's spire and the rooftops below it.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the terrace on the 13th floor has a clear sky above it and the lit skyline of Vienna, cathedral spire included.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the church domes this morning, seen through the twin windows of the upper-floor rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun alternate over the Stadtpark this afternoon, and the balconies on floors 11 to 13 get both.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the edges of the clouds above the cathedral spire, as seen from the sun terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky today, the suite's floor-to-ceiling windows still frame the Stephansdom spire and the rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Stadtpark and on the empty balcony chairs, so guests watch the wet rooftops from inside their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Vienna, and the rooms on floors 11 to 13 give a wide view of lightning above the rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs over Vienna today, and breakfast guests on the 12th floor see neither the Schneeberg nor the far rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Stadtpark and the rooftops, and the view from the upper-floor twin windows turns mostly white.
phrases.very_cold: With the air close to freezing, the 13th-floor terrace is empty, though the sky over the Ringstrasse is clear.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Vienna, and the wooden balcony chairs facing the cathedral spire are too warm to sit on.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Vienna, and two guests in robes could sit on a balcony watching the lit cathedral spire.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Schneeberg is not visible from the breakfast room, though the cathedral spire nearby still is.
phrases.late_night: Room lights off after midnight, the only light left in an upper-floor suite comes from the city around the Stephansdom spire.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the twin windows of an upper-floor room, and the cathedral spire blurs above the lit rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the suite's floor-to-ceiling windows show lit rooftops under low cloud, the Stephansdom spire among them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Chain Bridge lamps are still lit, and the Danube is dark under the room windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight falls on Buda Castle across the river, and from most rooms the whole hillside is sharp and clear.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Danube looks bright from the suites, with the Chain Bridge and Fisherman's Bastion in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun is low behind Buda Castle now, so from the room windows the hill looks dark against a yellow sky.
phrases.clear_night: Buda Castle and the Chain Bridge are lit tonight, and their lights show on the water below the Corso Bar terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: This morning clouds move over Buda, so from the room windows the castle is in sun, then in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Corso Bar terrace this afternoon, broken cloud puts patches of shadow on the Chain Bridge and the river.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the Corso Bar terrace now, you would see the last sun colour the clouds above Buda Castle.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Budapest today, and the Danube looks grey too, though the Chain Bridge is still clear from the rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Danube, and guests watch the wet Chain Bridge from inside their rooms with the windows closed.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Buda hills means the Corso Bar terrace is empty and the castle appears for a second at each flash.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Danube today, and from the suites only the near end of the Chain Bridge can be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the roofs of Buda Castle, and the room windows frame a white hillside above a dark river.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, so the view of Fisherman's Bastion is enjoyed from behind the room glass today.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Budapest today, and the Corso Bar terrace is quiet until the sun drops behind Buda Castle.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the lit Chain Bridge and Buda Castle show clearly from the Corso Bar terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Chain Bridge is visible from the rooms, but Fisherman's Bastion on the hill is not.
phrases.late_night: If you were in a Danube-view suite now, you would be asleep, and at dawn the Chain Bridge would fill the window.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were finishing a last drink in the Corso Bar, you would see Buda Castle across the river through rain on the window.
phrases.grey_evening: If you took a last drink to the window now, you would see the Chain Bridge over the Danube under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the harbour-view rooms in the dark before dawn, the Hong Kong Island lights are still on across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: At Café On M, breakfast comes with a clear view of ferries crossing Victoria Harbour in bright sunshine.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the green hills behind Hong Kong Island show sharply from the Victoria Harbour View Suites.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites, and the harbour water is bright in front of the skyline.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a King room tonight, you would see the whole Hong Kong Island skyline lit across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the green hills this morning, but the ferries on Victoria Harbour are clearly visible from the suites.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, patches of sun and shade move across the Hong Kong Island skyline seen from the harbour-view rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky behind Hong Kong Island, framed by the suite windows.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Victoria Harbour today, though the Hong Kong Island towers are still clear from the King rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Victoria Harbour, and from the dry side of the suite windows the ferries still cross.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, lightning over the Hong Kong Island skyline shows from the harbour-view rooms, safely behind glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Victoria Harbour today, so from the suites the Hong Kong Island skyline is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Hong Kong, but if it fell today, you would see it over Victoria Harbour from the suites.
phrases.very_cold: A rare day close to freezing in Hong Kong, with the skyline and green hills sharp from the suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: From the floor-to-ceiling windows, a heat-haze blurs the Hong Kong Island skyline across Victoria Harbour at midday.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under a cloudy sky, and the lit Hong Kong Island skyline fills the King room windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the suites the ferries on Victoria Harbour are clear but the green hills are not.
phrases.late_night: Sleep loses nothing in the suites tonight: the Hong Kong Island lights reflect in Victoria Harbour, and the ferries return at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Victoria Harbour View Suite windows this evening, and the Hong Kong Island lights blur across the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze covers the hills tonight, and from the Victoria Harbour View Suites the lit Hong Kong Island skyline shows at eye level.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lagoon outside the Tiziano Lagoon View Suite is dark and flat, with San Giorgio Island only a shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast in the Marco Polo Ballroom happens under painted ceilings while the lagoon outside shows San Giorgio Island in clear sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the two sun loungers on the terrace sit in full sun, with St Mark's Campanile sharp against blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun falls on San Giorgio Maggiore across the water, seen from the set table on the terrace facing the Giudecca Canal.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop terrace tonight, you would see San Giorgio Maggiore lit up across the dark lagoon.
phrases.partly_morning: From the San Giorgio Terrace Suite, the morning lagoon changes between grey and bright as clouds pass over Venice.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at Caffè Baglioni look out at a lagoon half in sun and half in cloud shadow this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds over St Mark's Campanile, seen from the bathtub window in the marble bathroom.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the lagoon looks flat and pale, and San Giorgio Island stands low across the water from the suites.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the canal outside the hotel's stone balconies, and lunch at Luna Bistro happens indoors with wet windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm over the lagoon means lightning behind San Giorgio Maggiore, watched from inside the Tiziano Lagoon View Suite.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog on the lagoon today hides San Giorgio Island, so the room windows show mostly grey water and little else.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the terracotta planters on the terrace, a rare sight in Venice, with the Campanile white at the top.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the sun loungers on the terrace stay empty and the lagoon looks sharp and bright.
phrases.very_hot: In this very hot weather, Canova Restaurant indoors has more guests than the terrace, where the sun hits the wooden deck directly.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the candlelit table on the rooftop terrace faces the lights of San Giorgio Maggiore, with no stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so San Giorgio Island across the lagoon is only a faint outline from the rooms.
phrases.late_night: Boat lights cross the lagoon after midnight, easy to watch late from the Tiziano Lagoon View Suite.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Canova, rain runs down the Tiziano Lagoon View Suite window and the lagoon lights blur toward San Giorgio Island.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Canova, the Tiziano Lagoon View Suite shows low cloud over the lagoon and lights on the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Caribbean beyond the mangrove canopy is still dark grey from every private terrace at Kanai.
phrases.clear_morning: Sun is already strong over the reef waters, and the plunge pools on the suite terraces catch it directly.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the turquoise sea is at its brightest, and the shade of a terrace hammock is the sensible place.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Towards sunset the big infinity pool by the forest edge sits in warm light, facing south over the reserve.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your terrace tonight, you would see a clear sky over the dark Caribbean and the mangrove canopy.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the reef this morning, so the sea beyond the suite windows changes colour in patches.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the plunge pools this afternoon, guests see cloud shadows crossing the water, with sun in between.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights a few clouds over the palms, seen through the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.overcast: Guests on the terraces today look out over the mangroves to a flat grey sea under a dull sky.
phrases.rain: From the suite terrace, rain falls on the mangrove canopy and on the grey Caribbean beyond the plunge pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over the sea right now, and lightning out past the reef is visible from the suite terraces.
phrases.fog_haze: From the suite windows today, haze hides the far edge of the Caribbean, though the palms outside the terrace stay clear.
phrases.snow: Snow does not happen on this coast, so if it did, the view from the terraces over the mangrove would be unique.
phrases.very_cold: Cold like this is almost unknown here, and the plunge pools on the terraces are probably not in use today.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the beach this afternoon, so most guests are in the water of the big infinity pool beside the forest.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, but the air is mild, and the terrace seating outside the suites is comfortable.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today: the reef in front of the beach is clear, but the far horizon of the Caribbean is not.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner at TORO, the ocean-view suite's floor-to-ceiling windows show moonlight on the Caribbean past the palms.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain streaks the ocean-view suite windows and the Caribbean is heard, not seen.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, cloud hangs over the Caribbean, and from the ocean-view suites the pale line of surf shows along the beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lagoon channel under the Overwater Suites is dark and still, with birds already calling from the mangrove.
phrases.clear_morning: From a beach-side suite deck, the sea is turquoise this morning and the sand is already bright under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the plunge pools, and guests stay in the water or under the pergola daybeds.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches across the lagoon to the Overwater Suite docks, and the mangrove turns a warmer green before dusk.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the candlelit tables on the beach face a calm sea, and stars are clear above the Caribbean.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the estate, so from a lagoon-view deck the jungle canopy is bright one minute and shaded the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A few clouds give short breaks of shade this afternoon over the plunge pools, while the sea stays turquoise beyond the sand.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on an Overwater Suite dock now, you would see the last sun light the clouds above the mangrove.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Caribbean looks more green than turquoise from the open-air lounge, and the sand is less bright.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the lagoon channel, and guests in the Overwater Suites watch it from behind the sliding glass doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder is over the sea right now, so the terrace daybeds are empty and guests watch the lightning from inside.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water, and from the beach-side suites the horizon line between sea and sky is hard to find.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Playa del Carmen, so if it fell today, the mangrove and plunge pools would look very strange.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air is rare here, and today the wooden decks above the lagoon are quiet while guests stay inside the suites.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot across the estate, and most guests are in their plunge pools or the shade of the thatched lounge.
phrases.mild_night: On this warm cloudy night, the Overwater Suite decks are lit, and the mangrove across the channel is only a dark shape.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the beach suites the water close to the sand is sharp but the horizon is not.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the beach suites have switched everything off, and the pale sand beyond the glass doors is the only light left.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the Overwater Lagoon Suites after midnight can watch rain fall on the lagoon through the glass doors.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the Overwater Lagoon Suites after midnight can watch low cloud drift over the lagoon and the mangrove.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before the sun comes up, guests in the Panoramic Suite see a black Yarra River and a mostly unlit skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: Pacific Club breakfast comes with a clear view of the Yarra River and the skyline in full morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, guest rooms look across the Yarra River to Port Phillip Bay in sharp detail.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun fills the corner windows of the Panoramic Suite, and the Yarra River turns a warm colour below the CBD towers.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a King room tonight, you would see the lit CBD skyline reflected in the calm Yarra River.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the Melbourne skyline this morning, and the river below the King room windows shifts between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Executive Lounge this afternoon, the skyline stands under broken cloud, with patches of sun on the taller towers.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the undersides of the clouds above the Yarra River, seen from the suite's two-sided glass.
phrases.overcast: Low cloud covers the whole sky above the CBD today, and from the King room the Yarra River looks dull.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the guest rooms, and the CBD skyline across the Yarra is blurred but still there.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were at the suite's corner windows now, you would see lightning flash over the Yarra River and lit skyline.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of the Melbourne skyline, and from the Panoramic Suite only the near bank of the Yarra River is clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Melbourne, but flakes over the Yarra River would be a strange sight from the suite's corner windows.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, and the clear air makes the skyline across the river look sharp from the Executive Lounge.
phrases.very_hot: From the Panoramic Suite's floor-to-ceiling windows, heat-haze shimmers over the CBD rooftops across the Yarra River at midday.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and Pacific Club evening cocktails come with the lit CBD skyline across the Yarra River under low cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Murky air today means the rooms get the Yarra River and the closest towers, but Port Phillip Bay is out of view.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water at midnight in the Panoramic Suite, and the CBD lights show on the Yarra in both corner windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the corner windows of the Panoramic Suite after midnight, and the city lights blur in the Yarra below.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the CBD towers after midnight, and the Panoramic Suite windows show the city lights reflected in the Yarra.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the castle gate at the top of Nerudova is a dark outline from the Deluxe room windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Malá Strana rooftops and the dome of St. Nicholas Church, seen through an open white-framed window.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the cobbles of Nerudova are bright and busy, and the castle above them stands under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the baroque facades below the Deluxe rooms, and the castle walls turn a pale gold colour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see Prague Castle lit up above the dark rooftops of Malá Strana.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over Hradčany this morning, so the castle shifts between sun and shade from the upper windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests coming back up the old staircase this afternoon find the castle half in sunshine, half under passing cloud.
phrases.partly_golden: Gaps in the evening cloud let late light fall on the St. Nicholas dome while the castle sits in shadow.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky sits over Prague today, but the castle gate at the top of Nerudova is still plainly visible.
phrases.rain: Rain darkens the cobbles of Nerudova, and the café umbrellas on the square in front of the hotel stand empty.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, the Deluxe room windows stay shut, and lightning briefly shows the castle outline above the roofs.
phrases.fog_haze: In fog, the castle disappears from the Deluxe rooms, and only the nearest Malá Strana rooftops remain in view.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the Malá Strana rooftops and on the cobbles of Nerudova, with the castle white above them.
phrases.very_cold: From the deluxe rooms, Prague Castle rises close above the Malá Strana rooftops in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: Strong sun on a very hot day lights the cobbles up to the castle, and open windows let warm air in.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Prague, and from the upper rooms the lit castle is visible under a low sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the St. Nicholas dome is faint and the castle is a blurred shape, not the usual detail.
phrases.late_night: Lights off in a Deluxe room now, you would see only the glow of Malá Strana's rooftops in front of Prague Castle.
phrases.wet_evening: A last drink in a Deluxe room tonight, and you would watch snow fall on the rooftops in front of Prague Castle.
phrases.grey_evening: Had you a last drink in a Deluxe room now, you would see Prague Castle up close, the city lights under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sagrada Família spires stand dark against a clear sky from the upper-floor suite terraces.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see the Sagrada Família spires sharp under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the sun is directly above the rooftop pool and the Sagrada Família is sharp on the skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden hour on the rooftop terrace, with the tiled spires and Montjuïc lit orange and guests in the lounge seating.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the Sagrada Família against a clear night sky from your private suite terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over Barcelona this morning, and the yellow chairs on the rooftop terrace get sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Broken cloud this afternoon, so the Sagrada Família seen from the rooftop pool goes in and out of shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds above Montjuïc, viewed from the loungers by the rooftop hot tub.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Gothic Quarter roofs look flat from the rooftop terrace, but the potted plants add colour.
phrases.rain: Rain over the Eixample grid today, and the rooftop loungers stand empty while suite guests watch the Sagrada Família from inside.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Barcelona right now, nobody is in the rooftop pool, and lightning shows the Sagrada Família spires for a second.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the city today, so from the rooftop terrace the Sagrada Família is a soft outline rather than a sharp one.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Barcelona, but today flakes fall on the yellow chairs of the rooftop terrace and the spires beyond.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold, clear day in Barcelona, and the rooftop hot tub is the only warm place with a Montjuïc view.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot over the Eixample today, and most guests are in the rooftop pool rather than on the sun loungers.
phrases.mild_night: Mild and cloudy tonight, with guests on the upper-floor suite terraces seeing Plaza de Catalunya and the Sagrada Família at once.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so the Sagrada Família still shows from the rooftop terrace, but Montjuïc is not visible at all.
phrases.late_night: Lights off in a suite at two in the morning, only the Eixample glow and the Sagrada Família's spires remain in view.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtains open before bed, rain streaks the upper-floor suite windows and the Sagrada Família spires show across the wet lit Eixample.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtain open in an upper-floor suite after midnight, the Sagrada Família spires show against low cloud over the lit city.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific outside the ocean-view rooms is dark and flat, and the pool deck is still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From the floor-to-ceiling windows of a junior suite, the Pacific is bright blue this morning, with no clouds anywhere.
phrases.clear_midday: From the ocean-view suites, the Pacific lies flat and blue under a clear midday sky beyond the beachfront rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Pacific and the beachfront rooftops seen from the ocean view suites.
phrases.clear_night: After dark under a clear sky, the glass balcony doors of the suites open onto a black Pacific and many stars.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Pacific this morning, and guests at Sugar Palm are eating at the outdoor tables.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the pool deck this afternoon, so the lounge chairs are sometimes in sun and sometimes in shade.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the Pacific turn orange, seen from the glass balcony doors of the suites.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific outside the ocean-view rooms looks grey too, and the palm trees look darker than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the two outdoor pools, and most guests have moved to Sugar Palm's indoor tables.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Pacific is rare for Santa Monica, and the lightning is easy to watch from the ocean-view rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Pacific from the floor-to-ceiling windows today, and only the nearest palm trees are clearly visible.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Santa Monica, so a few flakes over the pool deck would be a surprise for everyone.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day like this, the two outdoor pools are empty and guests watch the Pacific from inside their rooms.
phrases.very_hot: From the ocean-view suites, a midday heat-haze blurs the beachfront rooftops and the flat Pacific past Ocean Avenue.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the outdoor tables at Sugar Palm are still in use after dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests in the ocean view suites today see the beach rooftops but not the Pacific far out in the haze.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the ocean-view suites have turned off every light by now, and the shoreline lights along the Pacific fill the window.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the ocean-view suites after midnight sees rain on the glass and the beachfront rooftops wet under the lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has an ocean-view suite tonight can watch low cloud over the Pacific as the beachfront lights come on.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the TV Tower is already a dark outline against a clear sky from the Panoramic Rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Panoramic Rooms, and the two cathedrals and the TV Tower show sharply from the higher floors.
phrases.clear_midday: Clear sky at midday, and the floor-to-ceiling windows frame the TV Tower over Mitte rooftops without a single cloud.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the TV Tower and both cathedrals, seen from a Panoramic Room above Potsdamer Platz.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the TV Tower is lit against a clear Berlin sky, easy to spot from the three tall windows.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the Panoramic Rooms wake to scattered clouds over Mitte, with the TV Tower clear between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on the balcony this afternoon, you would see clouds passing over Potsdamer Platz and the TV Tower.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the clouds above the TV Tower orange, framed by the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the TV Tower and both cathedrals are still visible from rooms above the 10th floor.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the three tall windows, and the TV Tower stands slightly blurred behind the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests watch lightning over Mitte rooftops from the upholstered seating, well back from the windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over Berlin today, so the TV Tower appears only as a faint shape from the Panoramic Rooms, if at all.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Mitte rooftops, and from the balcony the TV Tower looks darker against the white sky.
phrases.very_cold: It is freezing outside, so most guests view the TV Tower and cathedrals through the glass rather than from the balcony.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day over Potsdamer Platz, and the dark curtains in the Panoramic Rooms are drawn halfway against the sun.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the lit TV Tower is the main thing visible from the Panoramic Rooms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the German Church and French Cathedral are hard to make out and the TV Tower is faint.
phrases.late_night: Around two in the morning the inside lights are off, and the TV Tower's shape stands out against the lit skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the windows of the Panoramic Rooms, and the TV Tower is visible beyond the wet city lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner, the Panoramic Rooms show the TV Tower's round top above the lit rooftops of Mitte under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the indoor pool is empty, and through its arched windows the bridge over the Han River is still lit.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun comes through the glass of the Premier River rooms, and the full width of the Han River is clear.
phrases.clear_midday: High sun sits over the outdoor pool on the twentieth floor, and Bamseom Island is sharp in the Han River below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Bamseom Suite terrace gets the late sun now, with Namsan Tower easy to see in the clear evening sky.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight from the high-floor bar, the lit Seoul skyline is visible through clear air, with no haze at all.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds move over Seoul this morning, but the Han River is fully visible from the lounge bar's glass walls.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud cross the skyline this afternoon, and from the suite living room the Han River moves between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken clouds colour the sky over the Han River before sunset, seen from the outdoor pool twenty floors up.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Han River looks flat and grey too, and Restaurant Voisin's wide windows show it without any glare.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Han River today, and the indoor pool behind its arched gold-framed windows is the busier of the two.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm has reached Seoul, so the outdoor infinity pool is empty and guests watch the lightning from the lounge bar instead.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits low on the Han River, and from the Premier River rooms the far bank is only partly visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Mapo, and from the suite living room the Han River and the city skyline look white and grey.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing on the Bamseom Suite terrace, and Namsan Tower stands very clear across the river.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air covers Seoul today, and the outdoor pool on the twentieth floor, facing the river, is where most guests are.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the lit Seoul skyline is still clearly visible from the high-floor bar, with low clouds above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From Restaurant Voisin on the 22nd floor, the Han River is visible below in today's haze, with Namsan Tower out of sight.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has the Bamseom Suite tonight has left the curtain open and is falling asleep facing bridge lights on the Han River.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever is awake in a Premier River room after midnight watches rain run down the glass over the bridge lights on the river.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a Premier River room after midnight can watch haze drift over the Han River, city lights showing through.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the infinity pool terrace is empty, and the caldera below is still a dark shape under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the terrace doors of the cave-style suites, the volcanic islands show clearly in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the whitewashed buildings, and sailboats cross the caldera below the infinity pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on the outdoor lounge seating are watching the low sun colour the volcanic cliffs across the water.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a plunge pool tonight, you would see a clear sky over the dark caldera and the sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the caldera this morning, seen from the inner doorway of a vaulted suite.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon clouds pass over the volcanic islands while mezze plates are served at the outdoor dining tables.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud sits above the cliffs and the infinity pool terrace fills with guests.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the whole caldera today, and the Aegean looks flat and pale from the suite terraces.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the caldera path outside, and the sail shades over the plunge pools are dripping.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Aegean, and from behind the terrace doors you can watch lightning above the volcanic islands.
phrases.fog_haze: From the outdoor dining tables, the volcanic islands are blurred by haze today and the Aegean looks pale.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Santorini, but today a few flakes fall past the whitewashed buildings toward the sea.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air sits over the caldera today, and the outdoor lounge seating on the pool terrace stays empty.
phrases.very_hot: Under the sail shade of a private plunge pool, the very hot afternoon is easier, with the volcanic islands in view.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night, guests finish their white wine at the outdoor tables above the dark caldera.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the air is not clear, and guests at the infinity pool can see the nearby cliffs but not the volcanic islands.
phrases.late_night: Were you asleep in a suite now, Oia's lights would be on the water, and you would see the caldera at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Finishing a last drink in your cave suite tonight, you would see Oia's lights blurred by rain along the caldera.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last glass in your suite after midnight, you would see Oia's lights under the cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the skyline shows as dark outlines from the Zen Deluxe Suite, and the rooftop terrace is still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight comes through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the king rooms, and the Willis Tower stands sharp against a blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the whole skyline is clear from the rooftop terrace, down to the low brick buildings of Fulton Market.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the glass of the downtown towers, and guests on the rooftop are taking photos of the Willis Tower.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lit Willis Tower from the rooftop bar, with no cloud over Chicago.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over downtown this morning, and the skyline from the suite with the pool table changes from sun to shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace this afternoon, parts of the skyline sit in sun while others sit under cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds behind the Willis Tower, seen from the wicker seats on the rooftop.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Chicago today, and the timber soaking tub in the Zen Deluxe Suite faces a flat, colourless skyline.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the heated indoor pool is the busiest place in the hotel right now.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm sits over the city, and guests watch lightning behind the Willis Tower from the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers downtown today, and from the Zen Deluxe Suite the Willis Tower is only a faint grey outline.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the rooftop planters and on Fulton Market below, while the indoor heated pool stays warm for guests.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air over Chicago today, but the sky is clear and the Willis Tower stands sharp from the king room windows.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the daybeds by the indoor pool are more popular than the rooftop terrace in full sun.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the rooftop bar has guests outside, with the lit skyline and no stars above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop the nearer downtown towers show but the Willis Tower is not clear.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has the Zen Deluxe Suite has switched every light off, leaving only the city lights around Willis Tower in the glass.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Zen Deluxe Suite can watch rain on the glass wall, downtown lights blurred around the Willis Tower.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has the Zen Deluxe Suite tonight can see the city lights under low cloud, Willis Tower highest on the skyline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Oculus Suite windows show the Oculus still lit against a dark, clear sky over Tribeca.
phrases.clear_morning: From a king room, morning sun reaches One World Trade Center and the Financial District towers under a sky without clouds.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, direct sun makes One World Trade Center very bright when seen from the suite living room windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last hours of sun, the stone facades of Tribeca turn orange when seen from the soaking tub by the window.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lights of the Financial District from a king room with floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over lower Manhattan this morning, and the top of One World Trade Center is sometimes in shade, sometimes in sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Broken cloud this afternoon, and guests at the heated indoor pool are swimming between the marble columns instead of watching the skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: Low sun comes through gaps in the cloud and lights the terrace limestone facade for a few minutes at a time.
phrases.overcast: Under a gray sky, the Oculus looks flat and white from the Oculus Suite, and the suite lamps are on by afternoon.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suite living room, and the Tribeca stone facades outside look darker.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the terrace is empty and guests watch lightning over the Financial District from the upper rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of One World Trade Center today, so the Oculus, which is much lower, is the clearer view.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Oculus and on Tribeca, and the Empire Suite fireplace is lit on the 24th floor.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold, clear day over lower Manhattan, and the terrace along the iron railings is empty while the skyline is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the terrace stays mostly empty and guests sit in the suite living rooms with the view instead.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Tribeca, with four or five guests talking along the terrace railings after dinner at CUT.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from a king room the Oculus is clear, but lower Manhattan fades out after a few blocks.
phrases.late_night: With the lights off in the Oculus Suite around two, the lit Financial District towers give the room its only glow.
phrases.wet_evening: After a late dinner at CUT by Wolfgang Puck, rain runs down room windows and One World Trade looks blurred behind the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at CUT by Wolfgang Puck, the Oculus Suite windows show the Financial District lights under low cloud tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Higashi Otemon Gate is still lit across the road from the window bench of the Nijo Room.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the garden pond and cherry tree, seen from the garden rooms and the tables of TOKI.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the stone walls and corner watchtower of Nijo Castle stand in full sun outside the Nijo Suite.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun colours the hills behind the castle gate, visible from the window bench of the Nijo Room.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lit castle walls under a clear sky from the Nijo Room.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds drift over Kyoto this morning, while guests at FORNI look out at the 1,300 m² garden.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Broken cloud passes over the mountains this afternoon, seen from the upstairs rooms that face them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, patches of light cross the Nijo Castle gate and watchtower outside the Nijo Suite.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the garden by Shunsaku Miyagi looks flat and quiet from the Shiki-no-ma pavilion.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the garden pond and the stone path, while guests stay under the roof of The Garden Bar.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the underground onsen has no window at all, which today is probably an advantage.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the distant mountains behind the garden, so the suite windows show mostly the near trees and pond.
phrases.snow: Snow covers the stone lantern and the tiled roof of the garden pavilion, watched from the garden rooms upstairs.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is very cold today, and the castle gate and hills look sharp from the Nijo Room window.
phrases.very_hot: Kyoto is very hot today, so most guests watch the garden pond from the tables of TOKI instead.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the lit walls of Nijo Castle are visible from the Nijo Suite windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; the distant mountains are missing from the suite windows, but the garden pond is clearly there.
phrases.late_night: Were you falling asleep in the Nijo Room now, curtain left open, you would see the castle gate's roof across the road.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were finishing a last drink at The Garden Bar tonight, you would watch rain fall on the garden pond.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in The Garden Bar, you would see low cloud over the garden and no stars.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before dawn, from the upper-floor corner rooms, the Empire State Building is still lit under a clear dark sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight comes through the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Empire State Building stands sharp over Manhattan in the clear morning air.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the whole Manhattan skyline, including the Williamsburg Bridge, is easy to see from the corner rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a corner room now, you would see low sun on the Empire State Building and the skyline.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Empire State Building is lit white at the skyline's center, with lamp-lit streets and brick roofs nearer the hotel.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Manhattan, and from the upper rooms the Empire State Building goes in and out of sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From a balcony room this afternoon, the brick buildings and fire escapes across the street sit under broken cloud with some sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the midtown skyline between clouds, visible from the corner rooms while the street side is already in shade.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Empire State Building is a flat shape in the window, and the board games get more use.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the bicycles and skateboards stay inside while the Empire State Building looks grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Manhattan skyline is visible from the upper-floor corner rooms, and the balconies are empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Manhattan, so the Empire State Building is only a faint outline from the corner rooms, if it shows.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the brick rooftops below the Empire State Building are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the skyline is sharp from the corner rooms and nobody stays long on the balconies.
phrases.very_hot: In this very hot weather, the bicycles and skateboards mostly stay parked, and heat shimmer softens the Manhattan skyline.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild cloudy night, and from the corner rooms the Empire State Building is lit under a low sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Empire State Building and Williamsburg Bridge are hard to make out from the corner rooms.
phrases.late_night: At two, the Empire State Building's spire gets one more long look from the corner rooms, midtown lights spread behind it.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner tonight, rain runs down the corner-room windows, and the Empire State Building's spire shows through it among wet midtown lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from a late dinner, the upper-floor corner windows show the midtown lights and the Empire State Building under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Metrópolis dome is a dark shape outside the window of Suite 306, with the Gran Vía lampposts still lit.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the gilded dome, and the Belle Époque facade opposite Suite 306 shows every detail in clear air.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky over the Gran Vía rooftops is completely blue, and the hammocks on La Terraza are in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun hits the Metrópolis dome, and from the bistro tables on La Terraza it looks brighter than at noon.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lit Metrópolis dome and a clear sky through the rooftop restaurant's glass walls.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Gran Vía rooftops this morning, and the dome goes from shade to sun every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on La Terraza have a drink under a partly cloudy sky, with the ornate Gran Vía facades in front of them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Metrópolis dome turn orange, seen from the hammocks on La Terraza.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Madrid today, so the gilded dome looks dull from Suite 306, though its shape is still perfectly clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on La Terraza's potted plants, and the Metrópolis dome is best watched from behind the rooftop restaurant's glass walls.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Madrid empties the hammocks on La Terraza; from Suite 306 the lightning shows the Metrópolis dome for a second.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the Gran Vía rooftops, and from La Terraza the gilded dome is soft at the edges but still there.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Madrid, but today it settles on the bistro tables of La Terraza and on the Metrópolis dome opposite.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air leaves the La Terraza hammocks empty, so today the dome is watched from the window of Suite 306 instead.
phrases.very_hot: Under a very hot Madrid sun, guests on La Terraza keep to iced drinks from Manel Vehí's list, facing the gilded dome.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night the hammocks on La Terraza are occupied, with the lit Metrópolis dome just across the street.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Madrid; the Metrópolis dome across the street is clear from Suite 306, but the farther rooftops are not.
phrases.late_night: Back in Suite 306 after a late drink at La Terraza, you would find the Metrópolis dome above the Gran Vía lights.
phrases.wet_evening: If you took a last drink to Suite 306 tonight, you would see the Metrópolis dome through rain on the window.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were on La Terraza for a last drink tonight, the Metrópolis dome would show under cloud above lit Gran Vía.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the CN Tower stands dark against a clear sky from the Terrace Studio Suites' private terraces.
phrases.clear_morning: From a King room's floor-to-ceiling windows, the city skyline is sharp this morning under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop pool sits in full sun, with the CN Tower close and Lake Ontario bright behind it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were at Harriet's Rooftop Bar now, you would see low sun on the CN Tower's lattice above Lake Ontario.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the CN Tower against a clear night sky from the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are moving over Toronto this morning, and the CN Tower shows between them from the Birch House suite's glass walls.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the sun comes and goes over the rooftop pool, and Lake Ontario changes from grey to blue with it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud colours the sky over the CN Tower, seen from Harriet's Rooftop Bar.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the CN Tower looks flat from the rooftop, and Lake Ontario matches the colour of the cloud.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on King West today, and the CN Tower is a wet grey shape from the King room windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Lake Ontario means the rooftop pool is empty, and guests watch the lightning through floor-to-ceiling glass instead.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of the CN Tower today, and from Harriet's Rooftop Bar only the lower section is visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the rooftop bar's wood stools while the CN Tower comes and goes behind the falling flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the CN Tower stands sharp from the Terrace Studio Suites, and the private terraces stay empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot sun on the rooftop means the pool is the busiest spot, with the CN Tower close above the swimmers.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, guests sit out at Harriet's Rooftop Bar with the CN Tower close and no stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Lake Ontario is not visible from the rooftop pool, though the nearby CN Tower still is.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Birch House suite is dark, and the city lights around the CN Tower are the only light inside.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Birch House suite's glass after midnight, and the CN Tower's outline blurs behind wet city lights.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud passes over the city lights, and the CN Tower's outline shows through it from the King rooms' windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before the sun comes up, the Burj Al Arab is still lit, seen from the balconies facing it.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun lights the Palm Jumeirah fronds below the high-floor balconies, and the Burj Al Arab stands clear across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop infinity pool is the obvious place; the mosaic floor shows through clear water under a strong sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun turns the Dubai Marina skyline orange, seen from the elevated pool deck above the Palm fronds.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a Sky Terrace Suite tonight, you would see the Marina towers lit across calm Gulf water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Dubai Marina this morning, and the suite living room windows frame them above the turquoise water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Scattered clouds pass over the Palm this afternoon, so the elevated pool deck gets short breaks of shade between sunny spells.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop bar, the last sun colours the clouds pink behind the Dubai skyline across the water.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Gulf looks flat and pale from the balconies, and the Burj Al Arab is less sharp.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Dubai, so guests on the balconies are mostly watching it fall on the Palm fronds with some curiosity.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suite living rooms give a wide view of lightning over the Gulf.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Gulf today softens the Dubai Marina skyline into pale shapes, seen from the balconies on that side.
phrases.snow: Snow over the Palm would be a first for Dubai; the balconies would be the safest place to check it is real.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day, the Burj Al Arab still shows clearly from the balconies, and the pool deck is almost empty.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot outside, so the private pools of the Sky Terrace Suites are where most guests spend the afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, and the penthouse terraces with their plunge pools look toward the lit Dubai skyline across calm water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low; from the balconies the Marina skyline is a faint outline and the Burj Al Arab is hard to see.

phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the marina this morning, and the rooftop pool already has its first swimmers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the marina towers this afternoon, so the view from JW Kitchen changes between bright and shaded.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on a south-side balcony now, you would see the last sun on the yachts under broken clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the marina water looks grey too, and from the upper rooms the open sea matches it.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Dubai, and today the floor-to-ceiling windows by the soaking tub show the marina through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the marina towers is a rare thing here, and right now the balconies are empty while it lasts.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Dubai Marina today, so from the upper rooms the yachts are clear but the open sea is not.
phrases.snow: Snow over Dubai Marina is news, and guests at JW Kitchen are more interested in the window than in their plates.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold for Dubai today, the infinity pool is mostly empty, and the marina towers look sharp.
phrases.very_hot: The heat outside is extreme today, so most guests watch the yachts from JW Kitchen rather than from their balconies.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky tonight, but the marina lights and the lit towers still show clearly from the rooftop pool.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the yachts below the balconies can be seen but the open sea past them cannot.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner at JW Kitchen, the window shows the marina towers lit above the moored yachts.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at JW Kitchen, rain runs down the room windows and the marina lights blur between the moored yachts.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at JW Kitchen, the room windows show the marina tower lights on the water under cloud tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the harbour is dark from the king rooms, and the Convention Center is lit across the street.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the rooftop pool early, and the white loungers are already out under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the harbour glitters beyond the Convention Center, and guests are swimming in the rooftop pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Towards sunset the brick of the converted lofts looks warmer in low sun, seen from the harbour-facing king rooms.
phrases.clear_night: From the lounge with the pool table, the city lights are sharp tonight and the sky above downtown is clear.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the Convention Center this morning, with patches of sun on the water beyond it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, clouds pass over the South Boston skyline, and the open-air bar beside the rooftop pool is open.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the harbour turn orange, visible from the rooftop dining area.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Convention Center looks flat and close from the suite study, and the harbour is grey too.
phrases.rain: Raindrops cover the tall windows of the king rooms, and the harbour behind the Convention Center is dull grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were at a floor-to-ceiling window now, you would see lightning flash over Boston Harbour beyond the Convention Center.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the harbour today, and from the rooftop only the Convention Center across the street is clearly visible.
phrases.snow: Light snow covers the roofs of the brick lofts beyond the Convention Center, seen from the king rooms today.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is well below freezing, so the harbour view is enjoyed from behind the tall glass of the king rooms.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day in Boston, and the rooftop pool is the busiest place in the hotel, with the bar close by.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, so the open-air bar by the rooftop pool stays open under a starless sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Convention Center is clear from the rooftop but the far side of the harbour is not.
phrases.late_night: Back from a late dinner at the hotel, you would see the harbor lights on the water from a king room.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were in the lounge with a last drink tonight, you would see the harbour lights blur through wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink at the window, you would see Seaport lights on the harbour water under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Concert Hall's steel panels are still dark grey in the Corner Suite windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Bright sun now hits the curved steel of Walt Disney Concert Hall, seen straight from the guest room windows.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop pool is in full sun, and the downtown skyscrapers around it stand sharp against blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the Concert Hall's steel orange, and the rooftop restaurant terrace faces it directly.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the fire pits on the rooftop terrace are lit, with the downtown skyline clear and bright beside the Concert Hall.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over downtown this morning, and from the guest rooms the hills are still clearly visible.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the twelfth-floor lobby terrace, the Concert Hall's steel changes from grey to silver each time a cloud moves off the sun.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the dining terrace now, you would see the last sun catch the Concert Hall between clouds.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers downtown today, and the Concert Hall's steel looks flat and dull from the Corner Suites.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on downtown, and the twenty-two-metre footbridge to the pool is a short wet walk nobody is taking right now.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Los Angeles shows for a second in every floor-to-ceiling window, from floor twelve up to the presidential suites.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers downtown today; the hills are missing from the guest room windows, but the Concert Hall is close enough to see.
