phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the open Gulf is visible from the overwater villa bedrooms, with the glass doors closed for now.
phrases.fog_haze: From the overwater villa bedroom today, haze turns the Gulf pale grey and the far water is out of view.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Doha, yet today a few flakes fall over the lagoon pool and melt at once.
phrases.very_cold: Unusually cold for Qatar today, so the beach loungers are empty and guests keep to the five dining outlets instead.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today on the island, and the sea below the overwater villas is the easiest place to stay cool.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Moroccan lanterns on the pool terrace are lit and the Gulf beyond is black.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the beach the far water fades into the sky with no clear horizon at all.
phrases.late_night: The moon lights calm Gulf water below the overwater villa bedrooms late tonight.
phrases.wet_evening: From the overwater villa bedrooms, rain runs down the glass doors and the Gulf shows grey under low cloud tonight.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the Gulf after midnight, and the water directly below the overwater villas shows only the lantern light.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gulf is still dark from the balconies, and the five hundred metres of private beach are empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun comes straight through the floor-to-ceiling windows, so the sea-view rooms are bright well before breakfast.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, guests are under the red-striped umbrellas on the pool deck, with the Gulf very blue behind the palms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light reaches into the Gulf-facing rooms, and from the balconies the sun is dropping towards the water.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, Ain Dubai stands behind the beach and the Gulf is black and calm below the balconies.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds are over the Gulf this morning, and the outdoor soaking tubs on the terraces are already in use.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass in front of the sun this afternoon, so the pool deck has short shaded spells between bright ones.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on a balcony now, you would see the last sun colour the clouds over the Gulf.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the Gulf today, so the sea looks flat and pale from the balconies, and Ain Dubai turns as usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare here, but today drops run down the balcony glass and the pool deck stays empty.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the Gulf-facing balcony, lightning flashes over the dark sea beyond the Ain Dubai wheel during a late-night storm.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Gulf today softens the Ain Dubai wheel from the balconies and hides the horizon completely.
phrases.snow: Snow does not fall on Bluewaters Island, so if it did, guests would watch it from the balconies in disbelief.
phrases.very_cold: Cold weather like this almost never reaches Dubai, so the outdoor soaking tubs on the terraces are suddenly the warmest option.
phrases.very_hot: The air outside is very hot, so most guests are in the pool or behind the floor-to-ceiling glass of their rooms.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm with cloud cover, and a few guests are still out on their balconies looking towards the Ain Dubai wheel.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balconies the near beach is clear but the horizon over the Gulf is not visible.
phrases.late_night: Inside, every light is off, and the floor-to-ceiling windows give the only brightness, the lit beach along the Gulf.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtains open after midnight, rain streaks the floor-to-ceiling glass of the Gulf rooms, and the round Ain Dubai wheel shows through it.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open after midnight, the Gulf-facing rooms look out on the Ain Dubai wheel and the beach lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Terrace Suite balconies look out on a quiet Strip, the Bellagio fountains not yet running.
phrases.clear_morning: From the double rooms, the floor-to-ceiling windows show the Strip and the mountains behind it in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a cloudless midday sky, guests on the 14th-floor pool deck keep to the gray umbrellas, the Strip bright below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a Terrace Suite now, you would watch the Bellagio fountains at eye level in low golden sunlight.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the Strip is clear, and the balconies face the lit Bellagio fountains, High Roller and Paris tower.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Las Vegas this morning, and the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows frame the Bellagio fountains in soft light.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Scattered clouds move over the Strip this afternoon, and the purple loungers on the pool deck are mostly in sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds turn orange above the Paris tower, seen from the wrap-around balconies of the Terrace Suites.
phrases.overcast: The sky is grey over Las Vegas today, but the Bellagio fountains still perform directly across from the suite windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Strip; the Boulevard Pool is empty and guests watch the fountains from the suite living areas.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Las Vegas, and the floor-to-ceiling windows of the rooms give a dry view of lightning above the Strip.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the valley today, so the mountains behind the Strip are faint from the double room windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Las Vegas, but today a thin layer sits on the balcony rails of the Terrace Suites.
phrases.very_cold: If you were on a Terrace Suite balcony now, you would see hard winter light on the Bellagio fountains across the Strip.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the Strip, and the Boulevard Pool on the 14th floor is where most guests are right now.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the Terrace Suite balconies are a comfortable place to watch the Bellagio fountains run.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the mountains behind the Strip are not in view, though the Bellagio fountains across the road are.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight in a Terrace Suite, a glass of water is poured facing the Strip lights across Las Vegas Boulevard.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the Terrace Suites after midnight can watch rain run down the glass and soften the Strip lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a Terrace Suite tonight can watch haze drift over the Strip, its lights soft below the cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the main terrace is empty and the Pacific beyond La Jolla Cove is still dark and quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: From the suite windows this morning, La Jolla Cove and the open Pacific are fully lit under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun falls straight onto the terrace pergola, and the ocean past the palm trees shows a deep blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light comes through the French doors, and from the balcony the sun sits low over the Pacific.
phrases.clear_night: After midnight under a clear sky, the moonlit Pacific shows beyond the palms from the upper terrace over La Jolla Cove.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over La Jolla Cove this morning, seen through the Moorish tiled window of the lounge.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the main terrace are watching cloud shadows move across the Pacific between the pergola columns.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the cove catch orange light, visible from the upper-floor rooms.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific beyond the palm trees looks flat and silver from the suite sitting area.
phrases.rain: If you stood on the main terrace now, you would see rain falling on La Jolla Cove and the Pacific beyond.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were in the Whaling Bar right now, you would see lightning over the ocean while eating duck meatballs.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over La Jolla Cove today, and from the balconies only the nearest palm trees are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare in San Diego, but a few flakes over the cove would surprise everyone on the terrace.
phrases.very_cold: On this unusually cold day, the terrace is nearly empty and the sunny Pacific is viewed from behind the suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air hangs over Prospect Street, and the pergola shade on the terrace is the busiest place to watch the ocean.
phrases.mild_night: The night over the cove is mild and cloudy, and the Whaling Bar is serving Maine scallops beside dark windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the upper-floor rooms you see the cove clearly but not the far Pacific.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, with the suite lights off, the only light inside comes from the shore of La Jolla Cove.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtain is open after midnight, and through rain on the suite windows the lights along La Jolla Cove look soft.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud covers La Jolla Cove, and the village lights show from the upper-floor rooms before the curtains close.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Junior Grand View suites look out on a dark Río de la Plata and the docks of Puerto Madero.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Puerto Madero, and the balcony rooms show the green of the Ecological Reserve with the river beyond.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the outdoor pool faces the docks under a clear sky, and the river is bright in the strong sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light fills Kayla Restaurant near the top of the tower, and the skyline goes orange before dinner begins.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at the Crystal Bar tonight, you would see the lights of Puerto Madero under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds this morning, but from the 15th to 17th floors the Río de la Plata is clearly visible.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds move over Buenos Aires this afternoon, and their shadows cross the Ecological Reserve below the balcony rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the lounge windows show clouds lit from below over downtown Buenos Aires.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud over Puerto Madero today, so the heated indoor pool on the 19th floor has more swimmers than the outdoor one.
phrases.rain: Rain over the docks right now, and guests swim instead in the heated pool indoors on floors 19 and 20.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the Crystal Bar on the 32nd floor, lightning over the Río de la Plata is easy to follow right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far side of the Río de la Plata, and the suites look out on a pale, flat river.
phrases.snow: If you were on a balcony during a rare Buenos Aires snowfall, you would see the Ecological Reserve turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Today is very cold over Puerto Madero, so nobody uses the open-air pool by the docks and the river stays bright.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot across Buenos Aires today, and the open-air pool that looks toward the docks is the busiest spot in the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night, and the private dining alcove looks out on the lights of Puerto Madero through tall windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the high rooms the Río de la Plata ends in grey not far from the docks.
phrases.late_night: Were you asleep in a Junior Grand View suite, Puerto Madero's dock lights would fill the window until dawn shows the river.
phrases.wet_evening: Were you having a last drink at the Crystal Bar now, you would see Puerto Madero's lights blurred by rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were finishing a last drink in the Crystal Bar now, you would see Puerto Madero's lights under the cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is still dark from the private balconies, and the Beach Java Café has not opened yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun comes in low off the sea through the tall glass doors of an Oceanfront Executive suite.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the 50-foot water slide gets steady use, and the sandy beach below the balconies is bright and busy.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the outdoor pool and its striped lounge chairs, with the Atlantic flat behind the palm trees.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your private balcony tonight, you would see a clear sky over a dark Atlantic and hear the waves.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the sea this morning, and guests carry Beach Java Café coffee out to the balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the shoreline this afternoon, so the outdoor pool is in shade one minute and sun the next.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the Atlantic are visible from the upper-floor balconies above the pools.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlantic looks grey too, and the indoor lazy river is the easier choice today.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the outdoor pool and the beach, while guests move to the indoor pools and the two indoor whirlpools.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm nobody uses the 50-foot water slide, and lightning over the Atlantic can be watched from the suite living room.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water today shortens the shoreline view from the balconies, and the horizon is hard to find.
phrases.snow: Snow on a Myrtle Beach balcony is rare, but today the indoor lazy river and whirlpools are the warm option.
phrases.very_cold: It is a very cold day, so guests watch the Atlantic through the balcony doors and use the indoor whirlpools.
phrases.very_hot: From the Oceanfront Executive balcony, heat-haze shimmers over the sand between the outdoor pool and the Atlantic.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, pale lines of surf show along the Atlantic shore below the private balconies at Sea Crest.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the balconies today only the sandy beach and the pools below are clear, and the far Atlantic is not.
phrases.late_night: Awake after midnight in an Oceanfront Executive suite, you could watch shoreline lights for hours.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in an Oceanfront Executive suite tonight, you would watch rain run down the balcony doors.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in an Oceanfront Executive suite tonight, you would see the lit shoreline under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the turret room looks down on Seneca Lake still dark, with the sky above the hills already turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is on the wrap-around porch this morning, with granola parfaits on the table and clear sky over the lake.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the lawn and formal gardens are in full sun, and Seneca Lake below the hill is bright blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the low sun over the water from the gazebo on the lawn.
phrases.clear_night: Nobody in the fifteen rooms is watching television tonight, because there is none, only Seneca Lake under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the wooded hills this morning, and from the sunrooms the lake changes between grey and blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the porch this afternoon have a mixed sky, with patches of sun crossing the southern tip of Seneca Lake.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the clouds above Seneca Lake orange, and the wrap-around porch has the widest seat for it.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the lake-view rooms show still water and dark hills, with no shadows on the lawn.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the hilltop, and the wrap-around porch keeps guests dry while they watch it fall on Seneca Lake.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, lightning over the lake is visible from the sunrooms, and the gazebo on the lawn stands empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Seneca Lake today, so guests in the turret room see the garden and nothing much beyond it.
phrases.snow: Snow covers the lawn and the gazebo roof, and the lake below the hill looks dark against the white hillside.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the wrap-around porch is empty, but the view down to Seneca Lake is sharp and far.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the shade of the wrap-around porch is the busiest spot, with Seneca Lake flat and bright below.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and a few guests sit out on the wrap-around porch with the lake dark below them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the lake-view rooms the near water is clear but the far hills are missing.
phrases.late_night: The turret room's curtain is left open for sleep tonight, and Watkins Glen's lights show at Seneca Lake's southern tip below.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the turret room windows after midnight, and the lights of Watkins Glen blur below the hill toward Seneca Lake.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Seneca Lake after midnight, and the lights of Watkins Glen show below the turret room window.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Chicago skyline stands dark and sharp outside the city-view rooms, with only a few office windows lit.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests showering behind the open glass walls get a clear view of the Chicago skyline in bright morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the towers of the skyline show every detail from the large room windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low afternoon sun lights the Chicago skyline in warm colors, seen from the dining floor of The Albert.
phrases.clear_night: After dark, the rooftop bar faces a fully lit Chicago skyline under a clear sky, with every tower outline visible.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Chicago this morning, and the skyline outside the city-view rooms changes between shade and sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Diners at The Albert this afternoon look out at a partly cloudy skyline, some towers in sun and others in shade.
phrases.partly_golden: Just before sunset, scattered clouds over the Chicago skyline turn orange, seen from the tables at The Albert.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Chicago today, and the skyline looks flat from the large windows of the guest rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the large room windows, and the Chicago skyline behind them is wet and a little blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Chicago skyline is visible from the city-view rooms, a free show for anyone wrapped in a fluffy robe.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the upper parts of the skyline today, so the glass shower walls face mostly a white sky.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling across Chicago, and from The Albert the skyline towers appear less sharp behind the falling flakes.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air over Chicago today makes the skyline unusually sharp from the large windows of the city-view rooms.
phrases.very_hot: On this very hot day, the Chicago skyline shimmers slightly in the heat when seen from the rooftop bar.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover Chicago tonight, but the air is mild and the lit skyline shows well from the rooftop bar.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low in Chicago today, so the farther skyline towers are not visible from the room windows, only the nearer ones.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water, and the large window of a city-view room shows the Chicago skyline lights.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtain is open in a city-view room tonight, and the Streeterville skyline lights blur behind rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Streeterville after midnight, and the city-view rooms keep the lit skyline in their large windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies above the water are still empty and the two headlands are dark shapes against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From any balcony this morning, Mazzarò Bay is flat and blue, and striped loungers are already out on the private beach.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the two pools, and most guests have moved under the white umbrellas on the beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the two wooded headlands, and from the pool terrace the rock slowly turns warmer in colour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your balcony tonight, you would hear the sea directly below and see a clear sky over the bay.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Taormina Bay this morning, and the water below the balconies changes between grey and blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the bay this afternoon, and the striped loungers on the terrace are in and out of sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over Isola Bella turns orange, and the terrace loungers face straight at it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the sea off the private beach looks dark, but the rocky islet is still easy to see.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Mazzarò Bay, and guests watch it from behind the balcony doors or from the suite living areas.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the bay, the pools and the beach are empty, and the balcony doors are shut against the wind.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water makes the two headlands look pale from the balconies, and the far end of the bay is unclear.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare at sea level here, but today a few flakes fall on the empty pool terrace and melt at once.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold for Sicily today, so guests step onto the balconies only for a quick look at the bay.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the two pools and the sea off the private beach are the only comfortable places to be.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under a cloudy sky, and guests sit out on the furnished balconies with the sea directly below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the balconies, Mazzarò Bay and the two wooded headlands show clearly, but the coast beyond them fades out today.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the room lights are off, and the only glow inside comes from shore lights reflected in Taormina Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtains are open past midnight, and Taormina's lights blur through the rain on the balcony glass above the bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Before bed, with the curtains open, the lights around Taormina Bay reflect in the water under a cloudy sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: On the top-floor balconies, early risers wait for sunrise over a Pacific that is still completely dark.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the pier and the long coastline toward Shell Beach, seen from the top-floor suites.
phrases.clear_midday: The sun stands high over the Pacific at midday, and the pool deck has the same ocean view as the suites.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a balcony now, you would see the late sun on the water from an Adirondack chair.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the hot tub still has its ocean view, though the Pacific is now mostly dark.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the Pacific this morning, and breakfast can be carried out to a private balcony.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the coastline this afternoon, while table tennis continues on the Play Deck.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds turn orange and pink above the ocean behind the pool deck.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the whole 22 miles of coastline today, but the pier is still clear from the suites.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Pacific and the Play Deck, so the mini-golf course is empty for now.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the balcony doors stay shut and the ocean is watched from inside the suite.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over Pismo Beach hides most of the coastline, and even the pier is faint from the balconies.
phrases.snow: Snow over Pismo Beach almost never happens, yet today a few flakes drift past the oceanfront balconies.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, the Pacific is clear from the top floor but few guests use the balcony chairs.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the coast today, and the ocean-view pool is the busiest part of the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild under a cloudy sky, and the balcony chairs facing the Pacific are comfortable to sit in.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Shell Beach and the far end of the coastline cannot be seen from the suites.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the surf shows white from the Oceanfront Suites, and the sound of the sea makes sleep easy to put off.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain streaks the Oceanfront Suites' balcony doors, and the Pacific blurs behind them.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud passes over the Pacific outside the Oceanfront Suites, and the coastline lights toward Shell Beach show under it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Andaman is still dark from the Ocean Pool Villa deck, with the headland a flat shape against the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the infinity pool at treetop height, the sea is already bright blue and a single boat sits out on the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday guests keep to the umbrellas on the villa deck, and the sea below looks white with glare.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the beachfront deck now, you would watch the sun drop toward the sea behind the rocky shore.
phrases.clear_night: Late at night the stars fill the clear sky above Nai Thon bay below the Ocean Pool Villa deck.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the bay this morning, so the sea seen from the villa living room windows changes colour every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud, some sun this afternoon, which means guests on the beach club loungers get shade and sun in turns without moving.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the Andaman turns orange, seen from a private pool on the upper terraces.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the bay today, and from the spa treatment room the sea beyond the garden is grey too.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the hillside, and the covered terrace at Jampa keeps the tables dry while the sea turns dull green.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, the floor-to-ceiling windows of the villa living room give a wide view of lightning out over the Andaman.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the bay today hides the distant hills beyond the infinity pool, and the horizon line of the sea is gone.
phrases.snow: Snow is reported over the bay today, which never happens here, and the villa pool decks are the place to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: A cold day for Phuket, and the sea from the infinity pool edge is clear, with nobody in the water.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the hillside today, and the sea-level pool at the beach club is where most people have gone.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night there are no stars above the Ocean Pool Villa deck, just the sound of the sea below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the far hills and horizon are missing from the infinity pool, though the near headland still shows.
phrases.late_night: Up for water near midnight, you would see the Andaman at night beyond the villa pool.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in the villa tonight, you would watch rain run down the windows above the sea.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in the Ocean Pool Villa now, you would see cloud over the bay and hear the sea.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the harbour is still dark and the Royal Palace is a flat shape from the higher-floor windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight reaches the Gamla Stan rooftops early, and from a waterfront room the spire of Riddarholmen Church is sharp.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the water of Riddarfjärden is bright, and the floor-to-ceiling windows show the Royal Palace without any haze.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the red brick of the Norstedts building, and guests on the balconies are taking their drinks outside.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the Royal Palace and Riddarholmen Church as dark shapes across the harbour.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Stockholm this morning, so the Gamla Stan rooftops are in sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the suite seating area, patches of sun cross the green treetops and the city rooftops between the clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the Royal Palace orange whenever a gap in the clouds opens over the harbour.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Riddarfjärden looks grey too, and the spire of Riddarholmen Church stands out against the flat clouds.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Royal Palace across the water looks slightly blurred through the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Stockholm, and from a waterfront room each flash shows the Royal Palace for a moment.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs over the harbour today, so the Royal Palace is a faint shape and Riddarholmen Church is mostly hidden.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Old Town roofs, and from the suite sitting room the waterway looks dark against the white.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold day in Stockholm, and from the higher floors the harbour looks still, with nobody on the balconies.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day the balcony upgrade makes sense, with the Royal Palace in full sun across the harbour.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Stockholm, and from the king-bed rooms the Gamla Stan rooftops are only dark outlines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Royal Palace is unclear and Riddarholmen Church cannot really be seen from the windows.
phrases.late_night: Past one in the morning, the Royal Palace roofline and the harbour lights are enough reason to keep the suite lights on.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the suite windows after midnight, and the Royal Palace is a long low shape across the harbour lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud passes over the harbour after midnight, and from the higher floors the Royal Palace is a long shape among the city lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the observation deck on the 16th floor faces a still dark Øresund, and the first ferry has not yet passed.
phrases.clear_morning: From a corner room above the seventh floor, the morning sun lights Nordhavn and the wind turbines out on the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the DFDS ferry is easy to see on the Øresund, and guests on the rooftop terrace have sunglasses on.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a window seat now, you would watch the sun go down orange over Copenhagen's low rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the Øresund is clear, and the 16th-floor deck shows the lights of Nordhavn below the tower.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Nordhavn this morning, and from the rooftop sauna the wind turbines are sometimes in sun, sometimes not.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the rooftop terrace sit under broken cloud this afternoon, watching cruise ships move slowly through the harbor.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the Øresund turn pink, seen from the box windows on the upper floors.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the view from the 16th-floor deck still includes Nordhavn and the turbines, just without much colour.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the corner rooms, and the indoor pool is the busier choice today.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Øresund, so the rooftop terrace is empty and guests watch the lightning from their rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the harbor today, and from the observation deck the wind turbines cannot be seen at all.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over Nordhavn, and the rooftop sauna is the warmest place from which to watch it come down.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it is very cold today, yet the view from the upper floors to the wind turbines is sharp and clear.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day for Copenhagen, the rooftop terrace is quiet until evening and the indoor pool is not.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night like this, guests sit out on the rooftop terrace with wine, looking at the harbor.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the 16th-floor deck, the harbor at Nordhavn shows today with no sign of the far wind turbines.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the corner rooms show only the harbour lights of Nordhavn; by dawn the same window will add the Øresund.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner, the corner room's tall window shows Nordhavn's harbour lights blurred by rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Back late from dinner, the corner room's tall window shows Nordhavn's harbour lights under the low night cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests in the upper-floor suites see a dark Lake Michigan and a skyline with only some lit windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight comes across Lake Michigan into the high-floor rooms, and the desk by the window gets the brightest spot.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the lake is deep blue from the luxury collection suites, and every skyline tower stands out clearly.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the skyscrapers around the hotel orange, and the view from the suites is at its best this hour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a high-floor room tonight, you would see the lit skyline and a completely black Lake Michigan.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Lake Michigan this morning, so the water seen from the suites changes between grey and blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Around the pool table, the floor-to-ceiling windows show a skyline half in sun and half under cloud this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the lake take some orange colour, seen best from the upper-floor suites.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky lies over Chicago today, and Lake Michigan from the high-floor rooms is almost the same colour.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites, and the skyline behind it looks blurred and darker than usual.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Lake Michigan is visible from the upper floors, while guests in the lobby cocktail bar only hear the thunder.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of the skyline today, and from the high-floor rooms Lake Michigan has no visible far edge.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the suite windows, and the skyscrapers along North Michigan Avenue slowly turn white at the top.
phrases.very_cold: Well below freezing outside, with clear air, the lake seen from the suites looks very still and the skyline very sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside today, so guests watch the bright lake and skyline from the suite windows rather than going out.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over the city, and the lit windows of the skyline stand out clearly from the upper-floor rooms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, and from the high-floor rooms the lake fades to grey and the more distant towers are not visible.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight a glass of water sits by the bed in an upper-floor suite, and the skyline lights show above Lake Michigan.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner in the upper-floor suites, rain runs down the glass and the skyline lights blur above Lake Michigan.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner after midnight, the upper-floor suites' floor-to-ceiling windows show the skyline lights under low cloud, Lake Michigan past them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop terrace is empty, and the skyline towers along the Magnificent Mile stand dark against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Junior King Suite terrace, the morning sun lights 875 North Michigan Avenue with no clouds in the way.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop sectional seating sits in full sun, and every tower of the Chicago skyline shows sharp edges.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the terrace now, the low sun would light the dining chairs and the skyline towers in warm colour.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the string lights of the glamping tent are on, and Tribune Tower is lit against a clear dark sky behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds pass over the mid-rise buildings this morning, seen from a guest room balcony facing the Allerton Hotel.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun move across the Magnificent Mile skyline this afternoon, visible in full width from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day comes through gaps in the clouds and reaches the potted topiaries on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the upper floors of 875 North Michigan Avenue look pale and the terrace dining chairs stay empty.
phrases.rain: Rain keeps guests off the rooftop terrace today, so the skyline is watched from behind the Junior King Suite windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Chicago, and from the guest rooms lightning shows up now and then between the towers.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of 875 North Michigan Avenue today, and from the rooftop only the nearest buildings are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftop terrace and its topiaries, while the skyline behind it fades to white and grey.
phrases.very_cold: It is bitterly cold outside, so the private balconies stay closed and the Allerton Hotel is viewed through the glass.
phrases.very_hot: On this very hot afternoon, the rooftop sectional seating is mostly empty and the skyline looks slightly blurred by heat.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the glamping tent on the rooftop is in use, with the lit Tribune Tower behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop terrace the nearer towers are clear but the far skyline is not.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water by the bed, and the Junior King Suite window shows the lit Magnificent Mile skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Junior King Suite windows after midnight, and the skyline lights along Michigan Avenue blur behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the top of 875 North Michigan Avenue tonight, and the lit skyline shows under it from the Junior King Suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the fjord below the room windows is still dark, and the Douglas firs show only as a black edge.
phrases.clear_morning: From bed, guests can watch the sun clear the ridge and the dawn fog burn off Finlayson Arm in strips.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the whole length of the fjord is visible from the heated outdoor pool, with eagles circling below the balconies.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were at a room window now, you would see late sun on the fir slopes down Finlayson Arm.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the Malahat ridge is clear, and the soaking tub below the twin windows faces a very dark fjord.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are moving over the ridge this morning, so sunlight reaches the fjord in patches between the Douglas firs.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on the wooden yoga deck this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows sliding down Finlayson Arm.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud turns the fjord a mix of grey and gold, best seen from the balconies.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the inlet looks flat and steel-coloured from the guest rooms, and the eagles are flying below the windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the tiled roofs, and the water in the heated outdoor pool stays warm while the fjord blurs below.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, guests tend to stay inside the rooms and watch lightning over the forested hills across Finlayson Arm.
phrases.fog_haze: From the ridge, fog fills Finlayson Arm today and hides the water, with only the Douglas fir tops showing above it.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare here, but today it lies on the Douglas firs around the resort while the fjord stays dark green.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, and most guests watch the fjord from behind the room windows rather than the deck.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day for Vancouver Island, the heated outdoor pool is the easiest place to look down Finlayson Arm.
phrases.mild_night: Under cloud late tonight, guests in rooms facing the drop see a low grey sky over Finlayson Arm from the Malahat ridge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests in the rooms today look down on the near Douglas firs, while haze hides the far end of Finlayson Arm.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the rooms facing Finlayson Arm have turned off every light, and the pale water below is the only glow left.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever is awake in a room above Finlayson Arm after midnight can watch rain run down the twin windows by the tub.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the fjord-facing rooms after midnight would see pale cloud filling Finlayson Arm below the windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Chicago River below the river-view rooms is dark and still, with few people on the Riverwalk yet.
phrases.clear_morning: From the corner windows of an upper-floor room, the Wrigley Building and Tribune Tower stand in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun sits high over the Chicago River, and the Marina City towers look sharp from the suite windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun hits the Wrigley Building and Tribune Tower, and the suite dining area gets orange light through its wide window.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the city lights reflect on the Chicago River, exactly the view the upper river-view rooms are known for.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Chicago River this morning, and the glass skyscrapers near Marina City go bright and dull in turn.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in a river-view suite this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows moving across the water and the Riverwalk.
phrases.partly_golden: The rooftop terrace has the last hour of sun now, with broken clouds over Marina City and the glass skyscrapers nearby.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Chicago River looks flat and grey too, though the river-view rooms still look straight onto it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Riverwalk directly below, and from an upper-floor room the Chicago River surface is dotted with drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over downtown Chicago, so the rooftop terrace is empty and guests watch the lightning from their room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Tribune Tower today, and from the corner windows the Chicago River is only faintly visible.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Riverwalk and Marina City towers, and the rooftop terrace fire pits are the only warm spot outside.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day, few people walk the Riverwalk below, and guests take in the river from the upper rooms instead.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the Chicago River today, and the rooftop terrace is mostly empty under the strong sun.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, guests on the rooftop terrace sit by the fire pits with Marina City lit up in view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the river-view rooms the Chicago River and Riverwalk are clear but the far skyline is not.
phrases.late_night: Up for a glass of water near midnight, you would see city lights on the Chicago River from a river-view room.
phrases.wet_evening: Were you having a last drink in a river-view room tonight, you would see city lights ripple on the rainy Chicago River.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were finishing a last drink in a river-view room, you would see city lights on the river under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the bridge between the two towers is empty, and the canals below are still dark against the city.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests at breakfast in the high-floor restaurant see rooftops and the harbor sharply, with no haze between them.
phrases.clear_midday: From the suite living area, the parkland looks bright green at midday and the skyline stands clear behind it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low afternoon sun reaches through the angled windows of the upper rooms, and the harbor shows a long golden strip.
phrases.clear_night: At night the high-floor restaurant looks out on Copenhagen's lights and the lines of car headlights on the highways.
phrases.partly_morning: From the upper bridge this morning, cloud shadows cross the Copenhagen rooftops and the canals beyond them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the high-floor lounge, the brass telescope points at the skyline, which goes in and out of cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in a high-floor room now, you would see the last sun light the harbor between gray clouds.
phrases.overcast: A flat gray sky covers Copenhagen today, and the canals and rooftops look paler than usual from the upper floors.
phrases.rain: Rain streaks the angled floor-to-ceiling windows of the high-floor restaurant, and Copenhagen's city lights blur along the wet highways below.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the bridge between the towers, guests can watch lightning over the harbor without getting wet.
phrases.fog_haze: Thick fog sits over Copenhagen today, and through the lounge telescope guests see only the nearest rooftops, not the harbor.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the rooftops and parkland, and the high-floor lounge is a warm place to watch it through the glass.
phrases.very_cold: Well below freezing outside today, and from the bridge the parkland and rooftops look white with frost.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot for Copenhagen today, and the shade of the high-floor restaurant has a clear view of the harbor and canals.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and from the high-floor restaurant the highway headlights and city lights are clear under the clouds.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the upper-floor bridge, the nearby rooftops show through the haze, but the harbor and far skyline stay hidden today.
phrases.late_night: Guests back from a late dinner likely sleep now, city lights reaching the horizon.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a high-floor room tonight can watch the rain run down the angled glass, the city lights spread to the horizon.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the high-floor rooms are probably asleep now, the city lights spread under low cloud beyond the angled windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lagoon-facing terraces sit quiet, and birds start calling in the mangroves before the water turns turquoise.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were on the villa deck now, you would see the turquoise Caribbean beyond the bamboo fence in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Under the bamboo palapa roof of a beachfront villa, the shade matters at midday, with the Caribbean bright through the fence.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun comes through the palms on the infinity pool terrace, and the striped loungers face a calm Caribbean.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the overwater dining decks tonight, the string lights would be reflected in a very still lagoon.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the El Camaleón golf course this morning, and from golf-course-facing rooms the fairways go from shade to sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the beach terrace, a few afternoon clouds pass over the white sand and the palms by the sea.
phrases.partly_golden: Orange and pink clouds sit over the beach at sunset, seen from the tiered seating behind the wood-louvered facade.
phrases.overcast: The sky over Playa del Carmen is fully grey today, and the lagoon by the mangroves looks green rather than turquoise.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the mangroves, and guests on the lagoon terrace stay under the wooden roof with their wine glasses.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, the floor-to-ceiling windows of a villa living room show lightning over a dark sea and empty beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the sea today, and from the beachfront restaurant the horizon line is hard to see past the palms.
phrases.snow: Snow is not something Playa del Carmen gets, but if it fell today, the thatched villa roofs would hold it briefly.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day is rare here, but if it happened, the plunge pools on the villa decks would stay empty.
phrases.very_hot: The heat is strong today, so guests on the villa decks are in the plunge pools rather than on the loungers.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the night is mild and the lit steps on the beachfront terrace are still in use.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from the beachfront terrace the sand and the near water are clear, but the horizon is not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, with the beachfront villa lights off, the only light left comes from the moon on the Caribbean beyond the windows.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of a beachfront villa, and the sea shows white where the waves break.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner is over, and from a lagoon-facing room the string lights of the dining decks show on the water under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gangnam grid is still mostly lit from inside its office towers, seen from a corner suite.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Teheran-ro: the distant mountains behind the skyline show plainly from the guest room windows.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the glass towers, and the fitness center windows face them directly.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would watch low sun hit the glass skyscrapers from the 24th-floor Lounge.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the city towers are lit under a clear sky, and the Timber House has live music as usual.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Gangnam this morning, and the hills beyond the skyline remain visible from the suite windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the 24th-floor Lounge, the glass towers along Teheran-ro stand under broken afternoon cloud and patches of sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun leaves some clouds pink over the skyline, visible from the Lounge on the 24th floor.
phrases.overcast: A grey ceiling of cloud sits over Seoul today, but the dense downtown skyline stays clear from every room.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and the towers along Teheran-ro look dull from the Lounge.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the lightning over the Gangnam towers shows clearly through the suite windows, with the city still lit.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Seoul hides the distant mountains today; from the guest rooms only the nearest Gangnam towers are visible.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Gangnam grid, and the water in the 17-meter heated indoor pool stays warm regardless.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold and clear today, so the hills behind the Seoul skyline stand out sharply through the guest room glass.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot Seoul day the 23rd-floor pool offers a swim with the city towers in view through the glass.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over Gangnam, and the Timber House has live music while the lit towers show through the windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the distant mountains are not in view; the nearest Teheran-ro towers still show from the Lounge.
phrases.late_night: Were you in the Park Suite reaching for water at midnight, you would see Teheran-ro's office lights on two sides.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in the Lounge tonight, you would see Gangnam's towers lit behind rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in the 24th-floor Lounge tonight, you would see Gangnam's towers lit under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the harbor-facing rooms look out on dark still water, with the Opera House only a shape across the port.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at Restaurant aye aye comes with clear sunlight on the water outside the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Opera House stands sharp across the inner port from every harbor-facing balcony.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the pine beams in the harbor-facing rooms, and guests move out to the waterside terrace.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the hotel's lights reflected on the calm harbor from the terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Copenhagen this morning, so the light on the Opera House changes every few minutes, seen from the arched windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, broken cloud sits over the harbor, and the terrace above the harbor has sun on it half the time.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds turn orange above the Opera House, viewed from the harbor-facing balconies.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Copenhagen today, and the Opera House across the water looks as grey as the sky from the rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the harbor, and guests watch it from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of Restaurant aye aye.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the brick vaults and pine beams of the old warehouse feel especially solid, while lightning shows over the port.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog on the harbor today hides the Opera House from the harbor-facing rooms, and the water below the balconies is still visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the waterside terrace, and the sauna and steam room inside are the busier choice.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing outside today, the terrace above the harbor is empty and the Opera House stands clear across the port.
phrases.very_hot: Copenhagen rarely gets very hot, but today it is, and the waterside terrace catches whatever breeze crosses the harbor.
phrases.mild_night: Mild and cloudy tonight, guests stay late on the terrace above the harbor, the Opera House visible across the port.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so from the harbor-facing rooms the Opera House is a blurred outline and the far shore is not clear.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the harbor-facing rooms are probably asleep now, and at dawn the arched window shows the Opera House across the port.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a harbour room tonight sees rain on the arched window and city lights moving on the inner port.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a harbor room after midnight can watch city lights on the water, cloud low over the Opera House.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lagoon around the overwater villas is dark and flat, with stars still above the decks.
phrases.clear_morning: From the hanging swing seat on a villa deck, the turquoise lagoon is already bright under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands straight over Kihavah, and the white sandbar is almost too bright to look at from the pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the beach now, you would watch the sun drop toward a calm ocean before dinner on the sand.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the overwater observatory is clear, with no clouds between the guests and the stars.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the lagoon this morning, and their shadows pass across the turquoise water near the villas.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the house reef this afternoon, so the water by the stilts changes colour every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights scattered clouds over the lagoon, seen from the overwater deck as its string lights come on.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the atoll today, and the lagoon by the villa stilts looks pale instead of turquoise.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the thatched roofs of the overwater villas, and the lagoon surface is covered in small circles.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the atoll, so the seaplane is not flying and guests watch lightning from inside their villas.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the lagoon today hides the far side of the atoll, though the reef below the villa stilts stays visible.
phrases.snow: Snow has never been recorded over this lagoon, so if any fell today it would melt before reaching the villa decks.
phrases.very_cold: If it were ever this cold on Kihavah, the spa's black soaking tub would be busier than the villa bathtubs.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the island today, and guests stay in the lagoon or inside SEA, behind cool aquarium glass.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night covers the atoll, so the observatory sees nothing, but the string lights on the overwater deck still work.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the sandbar is out of sight from the overwater villas, and the open ocean past the reef is hidden too.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water in an overwater villa, and the lagoon shows pale under the deck's string lights.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain moves over the lagoon, and the deck lights of the overwater villas show it falling on the water.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud moves over the lagoon outside the overwater villa bedrooms, and the deck lights show on the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: In the dark hour before sunrise, La Giralda is a black outline from the balcony rooms facing it, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balcony rooms that face La Giralda, the tower shows in full morning sun under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the inner courtyard gives shade under its arches, while the rooftop terrace is in direct Seville sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see the late sun turning La Giralda's stone a warm orange.
phrases.clear_night: La Giralda is lit for the night, and guests on the rooftop terrace see it clearly against a dark, clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Breakfast is being served beside the arched courtyard windows while a few clouds pass over the cathedral outside.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over Seville this afternoon, and the Giralda view from the balcony rooms changes with them.
phrases.partly_golden: Scattered clouds catch the last sun above La Giralda, seen from the marble tables on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the cathedral and tower still show plainly from the rooftop terrace, only without any shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain keeps guests off the rooftop terrace today; the balcony rooms still give a view of La Giralda in the wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Seville this hour sends guests down from the rooftop terrace to the arched galleries of the courtyard.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Seville today, so La Giralda looks pale and flat from the rooftop terrace, though still there.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Seville, but today a thin layer would sit on the rooftop terrace tables below La Giralda.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, the rooftop terrace is bright but almost empty, and La Giralda stands sharp in clear air.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Seville this afternoon, so most guests stay among the ferns and fountain in the courtyard rather than the roof.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the live guitar is playing in the courtyard while La Giralda is lit beyond the rooftop.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Seville today; La Giralda is close enough to see from the rooftop terrace, but nothing further.
phrases.late_night: Sleep is the better use of this hour in the Giralda-facing rooms; at dawn the window will hold the whole tower.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain blurs the windows of the balcony rooms, and the Giralda is only an outline over the wet roofs.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, haze hangs low over Seville, and the Giralda's outline shows against the city glow from the balcony rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sassongher peak behind the roof is still a dark shape, while Corvara's rooftops below stay unlit.
phrases.clear_morning: From a room balcony this morning, the pale limestone of the Sella group across the valley catches the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun lights every peak seen through the restaurant's tall glass walls, and hardly a shadow is left on the rock.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last hours of sun, guests in the rooftop whirlpool watch the Dolomite peaks turn from pale to orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your balcony tonight, you would see stars above the Sassongher peak and the lights of Corvara below.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Sella group this morning, but the Sassongher peak directly behind the hotel is clear.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass across the afternoon sun, so the meadows and pine forests below the terrace change from bright to shaded.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds around the Sella group, seen from the balconies over Corvara.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky today, the Sassongher peak looks flat and close from the room windows, and the valley colours are dull.
phrases.rain: Rain over Corvara this hour, and behind the restaurant's tall glass the tables stay dry while the forested slopes remain visible.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, lightning over the Sella group is easier to watch from a room window than from the open-air whirlpool.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Sella group today, and from the balconies only Corvara's nearest rooftops and the pines show through.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Corvara, and from the sauna's floor-to-ceiling glass the pine forests slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, steam rises from the rooftop hot tub while the snow-covered peaks stand sharp behind it.
phrases.very_hot: Hot afternoons are rare in Alta Badia; the balcony doors stand open and the pine forests look dry under the strong sun.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the village lights show below the balconies while the Sassongher peak stays hidden in the dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Sella group is not visible from the balconies; Corvara's rooftops and the nearest pines are.
phrases.late_night: Anyone waking for a glass of water near midnight in a room under the Sassongher peak sees Corvara's lights just below.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a village-side room after midnight can watch snow fall past the glass onto Corvara's lights below.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake after midnight in a room over Corvara sees the few village lights under low cloud on the Dolomites tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Empire State Building is still lit in the window of a king bedroom, and the Hudson is dark.
phrases.clear_morning: From the corner suites, morning sun reaches the Hudson River and the Midtown towers through wraparound windows.
phrases.clear_midday: At the rooftop lap pool, the sun is bright on the lounge chairs and the Midtown buildings stand sharp against blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden hour reaches the corner suites now, and the Midtown skyline takes an orange color in the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the soaking tub tonight, you would see the lit Manhattan skyline through the window beside you.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Midtown this morning, and the Empire State Building goes in and out of shadow, seen from the king bedrooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the high-floor terrace, guests on the dark sofas get sun and cloud in turns, with the Hudson River below.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the undersides of the clouds above Midtown, seen from the wraparound windows of a corner suite.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers all of Manhattan today, and from the rooftop lap pool the Empire State Building looks flat and pale.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the king bedrooms, and the Midtown skyline is grey and blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Manhattan means the rooftop lap pool is empty, and lightning shows above the Midtown skyline from the suites.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Empire State Building today, and from the corner suites the Hudson River is a grey shape.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past forty-five floors of windows, and the lounge chairs by the rooftop pool are covered in white.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold on the terrace today, so most guests watch the clear view of the Hudson River from inside.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over Manhattan today, and at the rooftop lap pool the blue cabana is the most wanted spot.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and on the terrace guests sit on the dark sofas with the lit skyline in front of them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the corner suites the Empire State Building is only a faint outline.
phrases.late_night: Around two the corner suite's lights are off, and the skyline around the Empire State Building is the only light left.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the corner suite windows, and the Empire State Building's spire blurs in the wet Midtown skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: After a late dinner, the corner suite's wraparound windows show the Midtown lights under low cloud, the Empire State Building's spire among them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lagoon outside the fifteen basin-facing rooms is flat and dark, with San Giorgio a black outline.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Altana Suite terrace, the whole lagoon is visible this morning, and San Giorgio catches the low sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun on the water outside VERO Restaurant is strong, so lunch guests by the lagoon edge mostly wear sunglasses.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the terrace now, you would see San Giorgio Maggiore turning orange across a calm lagoon.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of San Giorgio sit on the dark water below the basin-facing rooms.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds this morning, and the gridded lounge window shows patches of sun moving across the waterfront outside.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the lagoon this afternoon, and the Altana terrace gets sun for a few minutes at a time.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day shows between clouds, and the terrace tables facing San Giorgio are already being set.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky over the lagoon today, and the Murano glass lamps in the rooms are on in the afternoon.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the lagoon, and guests at VERO Restaurant watch the drops hit the water from indoors.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, the Pura spa's sauna and steam room seem a sensible choice, while lightning flashes over San Giorgio.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the lagoon today, and from the basin-facing rooms San Giorgio is only a faint grey shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Venice, but today it falls on the Altana terrace and melts as soon as it touches the lagoon.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air over the lagoon today, and the view of San Giorgio from the Altana terrace is unusually sharp and clear.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the lagoon in front of VERO Restaurant is bright and completely still, with San Giorgio shimmering.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Venice; guests on the terrace facing San Giorgio are eating outside without jackets.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Altana terrace the far side of the lagoon cannot be seen, only San Giorgio.
phrases.late_night: Up late in a basin-facing room, you could watch boat lights cross the lagoon.
phrases.wet_evening: If you took a last Alchemia cocktail up to a lagoon room, you would see rain blur the lights across the basin.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink at Alchemia Bar tonight, you would see the lights across the lagoon under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Strip signs are still lit below the top-floor windows, and the desert mountains are dark shapes.
phrases.clear_morning: From the wingback armchair, the Eiffel Tower replica stands clear in the window under a cloudless desert sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong over the outdoor pool, and most guests have moved to the white curtained cabanas.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun from the west lights the High Roller and the Paris tower, seen from the Strip View One-Bedroom Suite.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight, with no cloud over the desert, the lit casino signs and the Paris tower fill the king room window.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds are passing over the golf course this morning, seen from the suite with the four-poster bed.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the city sprawl and the distant desert mountains while guests sit by the outdoor pool.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds turn orange above the Strip, and the casino signs start to switch on.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Eiffel Tower replica looks flat and plain today, which is rare for Las Vegas.
phrases.rain: Rain is running down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the top floors, and the lounge chairs by the pool are empty.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the dark mountains beyond the Strip can be watched from the suite living room, with the window closed.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the distant desert mountains this morning, so the view from the wingback armchair stops at the Strip.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Strip, a rare sight, and guests are photographing it from the top-floor windows.
phrases.very_cold: Clear and close to freezing today, so nobody sits on the lounge chairs by the pool, and guests stay behind the windows.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot today, and the outdoor pool is the busiest place in the hotel, cabanas included.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night over Las Vegas, and the lit Strip shows clearly from the suite living room windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the distant desert mountains are missing from the view, though the Strip itself is still clear.
phrases.late_night: The curtain stays open tonight in the Strip View One-Bedroom Suite, so the Strip's lights show from the bed.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass in the Strip View Suite, and the Strip lights show blurred through it.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the Strip View One-Bedroom Suite looks out on the boulevard's casino lights under low cloud, the Paris tower among them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Bosphorus View Rooms look onto a dark strait and the Asian shore lights still switched on.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Mecidiyeköy, and from the 15th-floor Gold Lounge the strait and the Asian shore show in full detail.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop infinity pool is in full sun, the gold spheres bright, the Bosphorus flat and blue below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites, and Istanbul's rooftops turn orange between the tower and the strait.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests at the rooftop terrace tables see city lights and the dark Bosphorus beyond the glass railings.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the Asian shore this morning, and a Bosphorus View Room is a good place to watch them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, patches of cloud pass above the strait while Demlique serves afternoon tea a long way above Mecidiyeköy.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in the Gold Lounge now, you would see the last sun colouring the clouds over the Bosphorus pink.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Istanbul today, and from the high-floor rooms the skyscrapers and the strait appear in flat, even light.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites, and the Bosphorus below is the same grey as the sky.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the strait, and lightning shows through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the indoor pool with its green marble tiles.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Istanbul, so from the upper rooms the Bosphorus is a pale line and the Asian shore barely shows.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the tower in Mecidiyeköy, and from the Bosphorus View Rooms the rooftops of Istanbul go slowly white.
phrases.very_cold: Cold and clear over Mecidiyeköy, and from the Bosphorus View Rooms the strait and the Asian shore are unusually sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Istanbul today, and most guests at the rooftop infinity pool stay in the water, mojitos on the side table.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Mecidiyeköy, and the rooftop terrace tables are set, with the Bosphorus dark beyond the glass railings.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests in the Bosphorus View Rooms today look down on the near Mecidiyeköy rooftops, with the Asian shore lost in haze.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Bosphorus View Rooms sleep now; the strait, only shore lights tonight, will be in their window at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a Bosphorus View Room tonight sees rain on the glass and the Asian shore lights blurred across the strait.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a Bosphorus View Room tonight can watch the strait under low cloud, the Asian shore lights spread along the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Mediterranean below the castle is still dark grey, and the pool loungers stand empty under the pines.
phrases.clear_morning: From an upper-floor sea-view suite, the Ramatuelle vineyards and the Provence mountains are sharp in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the pool, and most guests have moved under the white umbrellas or into the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The rooftop terrace catches the low sun now, and the sea beyond the pine trees has turned from blue to gold.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a marble balcony tonight, you would see Saint-Tropez in the distance under a clear, starry sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the Gulf of Saint-Tropez this morning, visible from the open-air fitness terrace between the stone arches.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon a few clouds pass over the Ramatuelle vineyards, and the pool loungers are mostly taken anyway.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights a few clouds over the sea, seen from the orange cushions on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Mediterranean looks flat and pale from the balconies, and the Valmont Spa is busier than the pool.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pool and its stone surround, and guests watch it from behind the arched glass doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you stood at an upper-floor window now, you would see lightning above the Mediterranean beyond the pines over Pampelonne Beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Pampelonne Bay hides the Provence mountains today, though the pine forest below the balconies is still clearly visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Saint-Tropez, but today a thin layer sits on the stone arches of the fitness terrace above the gulf.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air sits over the Gulf of Saint-Tropez, and nobody is using the treadmill on the open-air fitness terrace.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day like this, the Rolls-Royce Cullinan down to Jardin Tropézina beach is more popular than the rooftop terrace.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, but it is mild, and diners at Le Voltaire are in no hurry to leave the terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so from the balconies the sea and the pine forest are clear but Saint-Tropez and the mountains are not.
phrases.late_night: Were you up for a glass of water near midnight in a sea-view suite, you would see lights along Pampelonne Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in a sea-view suite now, rain would blur the few lights along Pampelonne Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were finishing a last drink in a sea-view suite now, you would see lights along Pampelonne under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the heated infinity pool is already warm, and Delos and Rineia are dark shapes across the strait.
phrases.clear_morning: From the suite terrace, the morning sea is deep blue and Rineia Island shows clearly across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong, and swimmers in the infinity pool look straight at the Aegean and distant islands.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the horizon orange behind Delos, and guests stand at the infinity pool edge to watch it.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the pool glows with blue underwater lights, and the marina lights of Tourlos are visible beyond the terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the Aegean this morning, with the white buildings of Mykonos Town visible from the pool terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun take turns over the strait, so the water around Rineia changes between dark and bright blue.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in the hot tub of the Spa Pool Suite now, you would see the sun set between broken clouds.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky sits over the Aegean today, but Delos and Rineia are still clear across the strait from the terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the pool terrace, and most guests are at the Oqua Spa for Thalasso treatments instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Aegean is visible from the glass doors of the suites, and the infinity pool terrace is empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides Delos and Rineia today; from the terrace wall only the nearest rocky islets can be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on Mykonos, but a few flakes are landing on the terrace while the pool stays heated.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air for Mykonos today, so the heated infinity pool steams a little against the clear view of Delos.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the infinity pool is the only comfortable place outside, with the Aegean flat and bright beyond it.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the blue underwater lights of the heated infinity pool meet the marina lights across the bay.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; the near coastline and the infinity pool are clear, but Delos and Rineia cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, from the Signature Spa Pool Suite, the lights of Mykonos Town and the marina shine across the bay.
phrases.wet_evening: Late after dinner, rain runs down the suite's glass doors, and the lights of Mykonos Town blur across the bay.
phrases.grey_evening: After a late dinner, the suite's glass doors show the lights of Mykonos Town across the bay under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the oceanfront balconies an hour before dawn, the Atlantic is only dark water and the pool deck below is still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun comes up over the Atlantic right in front of the beach-level pool, straight into the eyes of early swimmers.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sand next to the pool is very bright, and the white umbrellas on the deck are suddenly popular.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the penthouse balcony, the late sun behind the hotel lights the shoreline north and south, and the water slowly darkens.
