phrases.clear_night: If you were in a corner suite tonight, you would see only dark water on two sides of the room.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the ocean this morning, and the turquoise water outside the guest-room windows changes colour each time one passes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the rooftop terrace, patches of sun and shade cross the low-rise skyline of Miami Beach through the afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun reaches the pool deck between clouds, and palm trees put long shadows on the teal chairs.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the ocean beyond the pool is grey too, and the mint umbrellas on the sand stand out.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pool deck and the sand, and most guests are inside Pauline watching the garden terrace get wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, the wraparound windows of the corner suite show lightning over the Atlantic from two directions at once.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, and from the oceanfront balconies the Atlantic fades out a short distance from the shore.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Miami Beach, but if it fell today the beach-level pool would be an odd place to see it.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing day the lounge chairs by the pool stay empty and the Atlantic is watched from inside the oceanfront rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the sand today, so the beach-level pool and the Atlantic beyond it are where guests stay.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night the garden terrace at Pauline fills up, and a few guests stay out on the pool deck.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the penthouse balcony the coastline north and south stops short and the far horizon is missing.
phrases.late_night: The Miami Beach coastline lights fill the corner suite's wraparound windows late into the night.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open after midnight, rain blurs the corner suite's windows and the lit coastline of Miami Beach.
phrases.grey_evening: Past midnight the corner suite's curtains are open, and the low clouds over Miami Beach show the glow of the city lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the White House is still lit, and from the VUE Rooftop it looks closer than on television.
phrases.clear_morning: From the upper west-facing rooms, the Washington Monument stands sharp against a clear sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: From the VUE Rooftop on the 11th floor, the White House and the Washington Monument stand sharp under a clear midday sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun comes through the wraparound glass of the VUE Rooftop, and the Monument turns a warm colour for an hour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the 11th floor tonight, you would see the White House lit up two blocks away.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the National Mall this morning, seen from the window of the suite seating area.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over Pennsylvania Avenue this afternoon, and the rooftop glass gives a dry seat to watch them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud puts shifting patches of light on the Washington Monument from the rooftop windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Monument and the Mall still show clearly through the hotel's multi-pane windows today.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the wraparound glass of the enclosed VUE Rooftop, and the White House is still in view beyond it.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the enclosed rooftop is the sensible place to watch lightning over the Mall without getting wet.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Washington Monument from the upper rooms today, while the White House, two blocks away, stays easier to see.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the National Mall, and guests on the 11th floor watch it settle from behind the rooftop glass.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, so the Washington Monument is best looked at from a west-facing room window.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the Mall today, so the view of the Monument from a suite window is the comfortable version.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the White House lights are clear from the rooftop even without stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the Monument is a dim outline from the rooftop, though the nearby White House stays clear.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the upper west rooms frame the White House and the Monument's obelisk against city lights, hard to stop watching.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the west-facing windows tonight, and the White House and Monument's tall shape show through the wet city lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the moon after midnight, and the west-facing upper rooms keep the White House and the city lights in view.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sliding panels of each suite open onto a dark, dry Nhlaralumi riverbed under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the secluded hide, this clear morning shows the sand of the riverbed and the dense woodland beyond it.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong over the Timbavati, and the plunge pool on each suite deck is the sensible place to be.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last hours of sun, the decks over the sand give a clear, long view of the empty riverbed.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night like this, dinner is sometimes laid on the riverbed sand, with no walls between guests and the sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Kruger woodland this morning, and from the bar deck the riverbed is in and out of shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on your suite deck this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows crossing the sand of the Nhlaralumi.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the woodland across the riverbed in patches, seen from the wide decks of the lounge.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the library is a quiet option, and the hide keeps its clear line onto the dry riverbed.
phrases.rain: Rain on the canvas roof is loud in the suites, and guests watch the riverbed get wet from behind the glass panels.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Timbavati means the sliding panels are closed, and lightning over the woodland is watched from inside the suite.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the riverbed today, so the woodland beyond the sand is a soft grey shape from the lounge deck.
phrases.snow: If it ever snowed in the Timbavati, you would watch it fall on the dry riverbed from the lounge deck.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold day like this, the plunge pools stay empty and guests keep to the split-level lounge.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoons are normal in the Timbavati, and the plunge pool beside each suite deck is in steady use.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and guests on the suite decks listen for whatever walks the riverbed in the dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far side of the riverbed is unclear from the hide, though the sand nearby is plain.
phrases.late_night: The suite panels stay open late, the Nhlaralumi riverbed below under a wide night sky.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the suite's glass and ripples the plunge pool as the bed is turned down.
phrases.grey_evening: Before bed, the suite's own light shows on the plunge pool while cloud covers the Nhlaralumi.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the terrace is quiet and Botafogo's lights are still on across the dark bay below Sugarloaf.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool deck, Sugarloaf stands sharp in full sun this morning, and breakfast is already on the table.
phrases.clear_midday: If you were on the pool deck now, you would see Sugarloaf Mountain sharp against a clear midday sky over Guanabara Bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Inside the gazebo, the white curtains soften the low sun, and the bay islands look golden in the last daylight.
phrases.clear_night: On the candlelit terrace tonight, the small lights of boats in Botafogo and the airport's lights across the bay are clear.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Sugarloaf this morning, seen from the king bed through the guestroom's floor-to-ceiling window.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, cloud shadows move across Guanabara Bay while guests read on the pool deck lounge chairs.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the bay catch orange light, watched from the gazebo's lounge seating.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Rio today, but Sugarloaf is still clearly visible from the living room's glass walls.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the living room, and Sugarloaf shows through the drops as a darker shape.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Guanabara Bay, and the guestroom's floor-to-ceiling window frames each lightning flash above Sugarloaf.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze thins the skyline beyond the garden palms today, and Sugarloaf is only a pale outline from the hilltop.
phrases.snow: From the Claudia suite's marble bathtub window, snow falls over Sugarloaf and the boats in Botafogo.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air for Rio leaves the garden paths between the clipped shrubs empty, though Sugarloaf stands sharp and clear.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the hilltop, so the rooftop pool is the busiest place, with Sugarloaf straight ahead.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars on this mild night, but from the terrace table you can still see lit boats in Botafogo.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from the pool deck Sugarloaf is faint and the far side of Guanabara Bay cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water at midnight in the Claudia suite, and the window shows Sugarloaf's outline over the Botafogo boat lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Claudia suite's window after midnight, and the bay's boat lights blur.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud drifts over Sugarloaf tonight, and the lights of Botafogo show beneath it from the Master Suite Claudia window.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Victoria Penthouse terrace faces a dark Atlantic, and Lummus Park below is empty and quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: From a balcony room, the sun comes up over the Atlantic and the blue umbrellas open on the white sand.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun on South Beach, and the round plunge pool on the penthouse terrace is the obvious place to be.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the palm trees along the promenade yellow, seen from the suite armchairs by the window.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the penthouse terrace tonight, you would see stars over the Atlantic and a dark Lummus Park.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds over the Atlantic this morning, with the white sand and the palm trees clear from every balcony.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over Lummus Park this afternoon, and the beach umbrellas go in and out of the sun below the terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over South Beach take some colour, watched from the penthouse plunge pool.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the Atlantic today, and the turquoise water looks less bright from the suite window than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the promenade and the folded umbrellas, and guests watch it through the glass from their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Atlantic, lightning out at sea, and the soundproofed rooms make it a quieter show than on Ocean Drive.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over South Beach today softens the line between sand and sea, as seen from the upper rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow this far south almost never happens, so a few flakes over Lummus Park would be the main subject on every balcony.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold day for Miami Beach, the sand is empty and the penthouse plunge pool goes unused.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on Ocean Drive today, so the penthouse plunge pool and the turquoise water get most of the attention.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night on South Beach, and the penthouse terrace is comfortable for sitting outside without seeing many stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so from the balconies the sand and near water are clear but the horizon is not.
phrases.late_night: Anyone up late in the Victoria Penthouse watches the Ocean Drive lights along South Beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has the Victoria Penthouse tonight sees Ocean Drive's lights on the wet promenade through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the beach-facing rooms are probably asleep now, the Ocean Drive lights along Lummus Park under low cloud outside.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Haystack Rock is already a dark shape in the oceanfront windows, with the tide audible below.
phrases.clear_morning: From an oceanfront room this morning, the texture of Haystack Rock is readable in the clear light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is on the sand and the Pacific, and the private decks are the obvious place to sit.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The afternoon wine tasting is under way, and Haystack Rock stands against a clear sky that will soon turn orange.
phrases.clear_night: From the ocean-facing terraces, moonlight shows Haystack Rock against the Pacific under a clear late-night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Pacific this morning, and sunlight reaches Haystack Rock only between them, seen from the oceanfront rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the deck with the wicker seating, guests are watching cloud shadows cross the beach toward Haystack Rock.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Haystack Rock take some colour, which suits the afternoon wine tasting.
phrases.overcast: Low cloud covers the whole coast today, and from the king rooms' sliding windows Haystack Rock has no shadow on it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the beach, and a whirlpool tub, a plush robe and a lit fireplace make a sensible plan.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Pacific is visible through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the living room, with the gas fireplace on.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has moved in from the ocean, and Haystack Rock is only a faint outline from the private decks today.
phrases.snow: Snow on an Oregon beach is rare, but today white flakes fall past the oceanfront windows toward the sand and Haystack Rock.
phrases.very_cold: Today is very cold and clear, and the sand in front of the ocean-facing terraces lies empty up to Haystack Rock.
phrases.very_hot: Heat like this is unusual on the Oregon coast, and guests stay on the ocean-facing terraces for the wind off the Pacific.
phrases.mild_night: If you stood at an ocean-facing window on this mild night, you could see Haystack Rock under a thin moon between the clouds.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so Haystack Rock is clear from the oceanfront windows but the far horizon of the Pacific is not.
phrases.late_night: With the suite's lights off, moonlight on the Pacific around Haystack Rock is the only light left inside.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from the Dining Room, rain streaks the oceanfront windows and only the sound of the tide marks where Haystack Rock is.
phrases.grey_evening: The four courses are over, cloud covers the moon, and the suite's fireplace shows in the arched window toward Haystack Rock.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over Mazzarò Bay is still dark, and the boats in the bay are only shapes from the balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: From the panoramic pool, Etna is clearly visible on the horizon this morning, beyond the Taormina cliff.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the striped umbrellas on the private beach are fully in use, and the sea is calm and blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the white seafront buildings and the wooded cliff, seen from the tiled terrace.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a sea-facing balcony now, you would see stars over Mazzarò Bay on this clear night.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Etna this morning, so from the pool the volcano appears and disappears between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some clouds, some sun this afternoon; guests on the sunloungers by the pool are moving between shade and light.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds over Taormina Bay while staff set the Brizza tables right beside the sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the sea below the scalloped parapet looks flat and grey too, and Etna is hidden.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Mazzarò Bay today, and guests watch it from the dining room through the tall windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the sea-facing balconies, lightning over Mazzarò Bay shows the Taormina cliff and rain on the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the bay today means Etna is not visible from the pool, though the Taormina cliff still is.
phrases.snow: Snow at sea level here is rare, but if it fell today, the potted citrus trees on the terrace would be covered.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Sicily; nobody is on the sunloungers, but Etna shows clearly on the horizon from the pool.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, so most guests are in the infinity pool or in the sea off the private beach.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night: on the sea-facing balconies, guests can hear the water in Mazzarò Bay without seeing much of it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Etna is not on view from the pool; the rocks and boats in the bay are.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and from a sea-facing room the lights along Mazzarò Bay show on the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the arched glass doors after midnight, and the lights of Taormina blur on the cliff across Mazzarò Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud moves over Mazzarò Bay after midnight, and the lights of Taormina show through the haze from the arched glass doors.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Harbour Bridge is a dark outline in the corner window of a Bridge View room.
phrases.clear_morning: From an Opera House View room, the morning sun is already on the white roof and the water below.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the harbour, and the Bridge View rooms get the clearest picture of the steel arch.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: An Opera House View room on an upper level shows the white roof turning slightly orange in the late sun.
phrases.clear_night: At night the CBD office towers are lit, and the blue neon pyramid shows clearly from the hotel windows.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Harbour Bridge this morning, visible through the floor-to-ceiling window of a corner room.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the harbour this afternoon, so the Opera House is alternately in sun and shade.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were there for the last hour of sun, you would see clouds turning pink above the Harbour Bridge.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Sydney today, but the Opera House and Harbour Bridge are still fully visible from the upper rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the harbour right now, and the indoor pool is the sensible place to spend an hour.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, a higher-floor Bridge View room gives a dry seat for watching lightning over the harbour.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the harbour today, and the Harbour Bridge appears only in parts from the corner window.
phrases.snow: Snow over Sydney is extremely rare, and today the Opera House roof looks even whiter from an upper room.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold outside for Sydney, so most guests watch the Harbour Bridge from behind the glass of their room.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot Sydney day, the indoor pool is busier than usual and the harbour looks bright and flat.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the lit office towers of the CBD show through the window without any stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is reduced today, so the nearby Opera House is clear but the Harbour Bridge looks faded and grey.
phrases.late_night: The curtain stays open for sleep in a Bridge View room, the arch and the bright harbour framed in the corner window.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Bridge View room's corner window tonight, and the Harbour Bridge arch shows across the wet harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs low over the harbour after midnight, and the Harbour Bridge's arch shows against the city lights from a corner window.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea-facing rooms look out on a dark Mediterranean, with the sky over the water slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun comes in through the sea-facing room windows, and the Mediterranean already looks bright blue beyond the glass.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the top-floor corner suites show both the sea and the skyline in strong, flat sunlight.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches the city-facing rooms, and the Sagrada Familia stands out clearly against the green hills behind it.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a corner suite tonight, you would see city lights on one side and dark sea on the other.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift in pieces over Barcelona this morning, and from the gym windows the city switches between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the beachfront suites this afternoon, the sea changes colour each time a cloud passes, from deep blue to grey.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun comes through broken cloud, and the floor-to-ceiling suite windows frame orange patches on the rooftops.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the Mediterranean looks flat and pale from the beachfront suites, and the horizon is hard to find.
phrases.rain: Rain streaks the glass of the 44-storey tower, and the gym's cardio machines face a grey, wet view of the city.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Mediterranean shows clearly from the high corner suites, which also take in the city at once.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the city today hides the mountains behind Barcelona, so the city-facing rooms see rooftops and little more.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Barcelona, but if it fell today, you would watch it from a warm suite behind floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.very_cold: Cold clear air over Barcelona today makes the mountains behind the city sharp from the vanity desk in the suites.
phrases.very_hot: Heavy heat sits over the Olympic Port today, and guests in sea-facing rooms watch the Mediterranean from behind cool glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the city-facing rooms look out on the lights of Barcelona with no stars above them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Short visibility today means the Sagrada Familia is only a faint shape from the suites and the far hills do not appear.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, city lights and the open sea are in view from the corner suites.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the sea-facing rooms, and the Olympic Port lights blur over the Mediterranean.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight the cloud is low over Barcelona, and the city lights look soft and blurred from the city-facing rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before dawn, the harbour is dark and the Hong Kong Island towers are lit, seen from a balcony.
phrases.clear_morning: From the 50th-floor Swim Club pool, morning sun lights the whole of Victoria Harbour and the island towers opposite.
phrases.clear_midday: From the 50th-floor Swim Club pool, midday sun shines on Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong Island skyline under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a balcony now, you would see warm late light on the Hong Kong Island skyline across the harbour.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the lit skyline of Hong Kong Island stands clear across the water from the leather stools at the hotel bar.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Victoria Harbour this morning, and the pool on the 50th floor is half in sun, half in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Between the clouds, patches of sun move across the harbour, easy to follow from the floor-to-ceiling windows of a suite.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Hong Kong Island are coloured pink, best seen from the rooftop bar.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Hong Kong today, but all 495 rooms still face the water of Victoria Harbour.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Victoria Harbour, and the suite living room with its floor-to-ceiling windows is the dry place to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Hong Kong Island is visible from the hotel bar, where leather stools face the floor-to-ceiling window.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits low over Victoria Harbour today, and the towers on Hong Kong Island appear as pale shapes from the suite windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Hong Kong, but if it fell today, you would see it over the harbour from the fitness center.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the harbour view from the 50th-floor pool is sharp and the lounge chairs are empty.
phrases.very_hot: Hong Kong is very hot today, and the water of the rooftop infinity pool is where most guests watch the harbour from.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and the lit Hong Kong Island skyline shows from every one of the 495 harbour-facing rooms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the harbour water shows from the suite windows, but the Hong Kong Island towers are faint or missing.
phrases.late_night: Back down from the 50th floor after midnight, the suite windows show Hong Kong Island's lights across Victoria Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, the suite's floor-to-ceiling windows show Victoria Harbour through the rain, Hong Kong Island's lights blurred on the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the suite's floor-to-ceiling windows show the Hong Kong Island skyline lit under low cloud across Victoria Harbour.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the Summit Suite terrace, Elliott Bay is still dark under a clear sky before sunrise.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun comes through the black-framed guest room windows onto the exposed brick, and the green trees outside are bright.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, Elliott Bay lies blue and sharp beyond the Railspur District from Firn's rooftop.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches the wicker chairs on Firn's terrace, and the downtown Seattle skyline stands sharp against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the downtown Seattle skyline at night from Firn's rooftop under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over Elliott Bay this morning, seen from the private terrace of the Summit Suite without the rooftop crowd.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on Firn's terrace have cocktails on the low tables while broken clouds pass above the downtown Seattle skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds over Elliott Bay, which is the view framed by Firn's rooftop bar.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Elliott Bay looks pale from Firn's rooftop, and the Railspur District below sits in flat, even light.
phrases.rain: Rain is a normal Seattle fact, and guests in the rooms watch it fall on the green trees through black-framed windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over Elliott Bay is rare in Seattle, so the storm seen from the Summit Suite today counts as an event.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of Elliott Bay today, so from Firn's rooftop the water is a guess rather than a view.
phrases.snow: Snow in Seattle is unusual, and today it settles on the wicker chairs of Firn's terrace while Elliott Bay stays grey below.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold, the Firn rooftop terrace is mostly empty, and Elliott Bay looks very clear across the horizon.
phrases.very_hot: Seattle rarely gets this hot, and the shade of the mature trees outside the guest room windows is suddenly valuable.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night keeps guests on Firn's terrace, with cocktails on the low tables and the downtown skyline but no stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far shore of Elliott Bay cannot be seen from Firn's rooftop today, only the water closest to the Railspur District.
phrases.late_night: Late tonight, lights along Elliott Bay show through the Summit Suite windows, and there is no reason to look away yet.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Summit Suite windows after midnight, and the lights along Elliott Bay show through it in a blur.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtains of the Summit Suite are open after midnight, and the lights along Elliott Bay show under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Mailani Tower balconies look over a dark, quiet Waikiki Beach with no umbrellas open yet.
phrases.clear_morning: From an ocean-facing Historic Wing room, Diamond Head is clearly outlined against a blue sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a strong midday sun, guests on the private beachfront stay under the pink umbrellas between swims.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At the Mai Tai Bar right now, the sun is going down over the sea in front of Waikiki Beach.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a Mailani Tower balcony tonight, you would see stars over a calm, dark Pacific.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move across the sky this morning, seen from the striped chairs facing the open room doors.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, clouds pass over Diamond Head while the water off Waikiki Beach keeps its bright turquoise colour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the tables at Azure look out on broken clouds and a sea turning orange.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the whole sky today, so the sea off the private beachfront looks grey instead of turquoise.
phrases.rain: Seen from the Mailani Tower balconies, rain falls on Waikiki Beach and the pink umbrellas stand empty.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Pacific is visible from the ocean-facing rooms, and the Mai Tai Bar tables are empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the sea today, and Diamond Head is only a faint shape from the Historic Wing.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Honolulu, but if it did, the Mai Tai Bar would be the warmest beachfront place to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold day, the balconies of the Mailani Tower still show a clear, bright Pacific below.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on Waikiki Beach today, and most guests at the private beachfront are in the sea.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the air is warm enough for drinks outside at the Mai Tai Bar.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the ocean-facing rooms Diamond Head is hard to make out, though the beach is clear.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Mailani Tower may have slept facing Waikiki Beach, drapes pulled back, the moon on the sea.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests up in the Mailani Tower tonight watch the rain come in over Waikiki Beach as the shore lights come on.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has an oceanfront room in the Mailani Tower tonight can watch the lights along Waikiki Beach under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Higashiyama ridgeline shows as a dark line above the pond, seen from the garden-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Carp are already moving in Shakusui-en this morning, and the Heritage Garden balconies look over them under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands over the garden, and the stone bridge throws a sharp shadow onto the pond water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the fourth-floor Heritage Garden balconies, the late sun lights the Higashiyama Mountains while the pond below turns to shade.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the paper lanterns mark the stone path through the garden, and the stars are clear above the ridgeline.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Higashiyama Mountains this morning, and the pond in Shakusui-en changes from bright to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were at the omakase counter at Sushi Ginza Onodera this afternoon, you would watch cloud shadows cross the garden.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, cloud edges turn orange over the city rooftops seen from the Kyoto View rooms.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the pond garden today, and the herons in Shakusui-en are easy to spot against the water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pond this hour, and guests in the garden-facing rooms watch the drops from behind glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Higashiyama Mountains, and the Heritage Garden balconies stay empty while rain hits the pond below.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Higashiyama ridgeline today, so from the garden rooms the view ends at the far side of the pond.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the stone bridge and the teahouse roof in Shakusui-en, and the carp keep moving under it.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold outside today, and the wooden deck over the koi pond is empty while the sky stays clear.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the garden this afternoon, and the willows at the koi pond offer the only shade.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the city rooftops show their lights to the Kyoto View rooms, with no stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the pond and stone bridge are clear from the garden rooms, but the Higashiyama ridgeline is not.
phrases.late_night: The curtain in a garden-facing room is left back for sleep, and lit windows across Shakusui-en show in the pond.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at Sushi Ginza Onodera is over, and rain on the garden-facing windows is blurring the paper lanterns beside the pond.
phrases.grey_evening: After late dinner at Sushi Ginza Onodera, low cloud covers Kyoto, and the city lights show from the upper-floor Kyoto View rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Ginger Royal Suite looks out on a dark Vltava and the still-lit castle across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the wraparound windows of the curved suites, with Prague Castle sharp across the river.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun and no cloud at all, so terrace guests see the Vltava, the castle and Petřín Hill together.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were at the rooftop bar now, you would see the low sun on the castle walls across the Vltava.
phrases.clear_night: At night the illuminated castle stands above the dark river, seen through the curved glass walls of the rooftop bar.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over Hradčany this morning, visible from the wraparound windows of the curved suite.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace this afternoon, the castle across the river goes in and out of sunlight between passing clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the castle under broken clouds, a scene the rooftop bar faces directly.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the Vltava today, and Prague Castle looks flat and pale from the suite windows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the curved glass walls of the rooftop bar while the castle stays visible, slightly blurred, across the river.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Prague Castle right now, and guests behind the glass of the rooftop terrace watch it from dry seats.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the Vltava today hides Petřín Hill, and only the outline of the castle shows from the Ginger Royal Suite.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Old Town roofs and the castle, watched from inside the warm curved suite through its wide windows.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the curved suite today look across the Vltava to Prague Castle through windows edged with frost.
phrases.very_hot: Heat covers Prague today, and guests on the rooftop terrace look at the castle across a very bright Vltava.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the illuminated castle still shows above the dark Vltava from the rooftop bar.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Petřín Hill and the castle are faint from the suite, though the Vltava is clear below.
phrases.late_night: Sleep comes easy in the Ginger Royal Suite tonight: city lights on the Vltava now, Prague Castle at the window by dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open after midnight, rain on the Ginger Royal Suite windows blurs the Vltava lights below the castle hill.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Prague after midnight, and the Ginger Royal Suite's open curtain shows the river lights under the castle hill.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies of the 289 rooms look out on a dark Naama Bay and the promenade lights on the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Liwa Restaurant terrace, the bay is already bright blue and the straw umbrellas on the beach are going up.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool and Naama Bay look like one surface, which is exactly the effect the terracing was built for.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Horizon pavilion faces the low sun now, and its Moorish lanterns are not needed yet.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your balcony tonight, you would see the promenade lights reflected in the still water of the bay.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Sinai mountains behind the bay this morning, and the beach loungers are mostly still empty.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the Red Sea this afternoon, while guests on the beach shift their loungers to stay in the sun.
phrases.partly_golden: On the Liwa terrace, the last sun comes and goes between clouds over the bay before the lanterns are lit.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Naama Bay today, and the water below the balconies looks grey too instead of blue.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare here, so guests watch it from their balconies with some surprise while the pool terrace empties.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, lightning over the Sinai mountains can be watched from behind closed balcony doors, while the Turkish bath stays busy.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Sinai mountains today, so from the Liwa terrace the bay ends in a pale line rather than hills.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Sharm El-Sheikh, but if it did, the heated pools would be the obvious place to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day is unusual here, and the Turkish bath gets more visitors than the sandy beach with its straw umbrellas.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the infinity pool is the busiest part of the resort and the tennis courts are the emptiest.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, but the Moorish lanterns at the Horizon pavilion are lit and the night air is warm.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the far side of Naama Bay is not clear from the balconies, and the Sinai mountains are hard to make out.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the promenade lights of Naama Bay show in the water, and from the rooms the view is easy to watch late.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at Liwa is done, and rain blurs the promenade lights on Naama Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at the Liwa Restaurant, the room window shows the promenade lights reflected in Naama Bay under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the master suites look out on a dark Caribbean, with the pier only a faint shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun on clear water shows the reef offshore quite plainly from the master suites.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the white sand on both private beaches is bright enough that most guests keep their sunglasses on.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light comes through the louvered balcony panels, and the pier casts a long shadow on the turquoise water.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a private terrace tonight, you would see stars over the sea and hear waves on the reef.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Punta Nizuc this morning, and the beach attendant's wicker wagon is already out on the sand.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun alternate over the adults-only beach, so the lounge chairs are shaded for short stretches.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds pink above the pier, seen from the wicker chairs on the balcony.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Caribbean looks more green than turquoise from the suite windows, and the beach is quieter.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on both private beaches, and guests at La Punta watch it hit the sea while they eat seafood.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Caribbean shows up clearly through the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the pier is empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water hides the reef today, so the master suites face a pale sea with no clear horizon.
phrases.snow: Snow in Cancún would be a first, but if it fell today the palms along the beach would carry it briefly.
phrases.very_cold: On this unusually cold day for Cancún, the plunge pools on the private terraces stay unused and the sea stays empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Punta Nizuc, and most guests are in the sea or a plunge pool, not on the sand.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm and cloudy, and the balcony lounge seating is a comfortable place to sit with the sea in front.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from the master suites the pier is clear but the reef offshore cannot be made out.
phrases.late_night: Sleep suits the master suites now; the pier lights show on the water, the reef back in the window at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: A rain shower passes over Punta Nizuc after midnight, running down the master suites' windows while the Caribbean sounds beyond the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, cloud passes over Punta Nizuc, and from the master suites the surf shows white along the private beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dallas skyline is a dark outline from the level 12 terraces, with only a few lit windows.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop terrace, clear morning sun lights the Uptown mid-rise buildings and the Dallas skyline beyond the fire pit.
phrases.clear_midday: From the penthouse terrace, the Uptown mid-rise buildings stand sharp against a cloudless sky at midday.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the arched wooden ceiling of the rooftop terrace, and the skyline is lit orange for about an hour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would sit by the fire pit under the pergola with the Dallas skyline fully lit.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over Uptown this morning, and their shadows pass across the pool lawn below the terraces.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the level 11 terraces watch cloud patches drift over the skyline while the pool deck stays in sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds above the skyline are lit orange, seen from the rooftop lounge chairs.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the skyline from the suite terraces looks flat and close, with no shadows on the pool deck.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the blue loungers outside the suite French doors, so guests are watching the skyline from the living room.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the top-floor terraces, lightning flashes over the Uptown skyline as heavy rain falls on the empty blue loungers.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far towers of the Dallas skyline today, and from the rooftop terrace only the nearest Uptown buildings show.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Dallas, but today it covers the pergola and the pool loungers, and the skyline is partly hidden.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air on the rooftop terrace means guests stay close to the fire pit under the pergola, skyline still clear.
phrases.very_hot: Heat haze blurs the skyline from the pool deck, where the striped umbrellas give the only shade on this very hot day.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud cover over Dallas, and the rooftop terrace lounge chairs under the arched ceiling are mostly taken.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the far end of the Dallas skyline is hidden from the terraces, and only nearby Uptown buildings show.
phrases.late_night: The curtain is left open on purpose in a Stoneleigh suite, and the Dallas skyline lights show through the French doors.
phrases.wet_evening: After a late dinner, the Dallas skyline lights show soft and blurred through rain on the Stoneleigh suite's living-room glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the Dallas skyline is lit beneath low cloud in the windows of the penthouse suite on level twelve.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the 11th-floor lounge is dark and empty, with Plaza Cibeles below under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on a fifth-floor terrace this morning comes with clear sky over Palacio de las Cortes and Madrid rooftops.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Cibeles Palace tower stands sharp against blue sky, seen from the red cushioned seats on the rooftop.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the Royal Palace, seen from a king room window, while staff at the rooftop bar set out glasses.
phrases.clear_night: After midnight under a clear sky, the lit tower of the Palacio de Cibeles stands out from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the tree canopy this morning, seen from a balcony table set for breakfast.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the double-deck lounge on the 11th floor, Plaza Cibeles sits under a mix of cloud and afternoon sun.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on a fifth-floor terrace now, you would see the last sun hitting Palacio de las Cortes between clouds.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Madrid today, but the Cibeles Palace tower is still clear from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop terrace cushions, so guests watch Plaza Cibeles from inside the 11th-floor lounge.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were in the eleventh-floor lounge now, you would see lightning flash over Palacio de Cibeles during the thunderstorm.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the city, and from the fifth-floor terraces Palacio de las Cortes looks pale and flat today.
phrases.snow: Snow in Madrid is rare, but today it falls on the red cushions of the rooftop terrace and on Cibeles Palace.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air keeps the rooftop terrace empty, and the Royal Palace is better watched from a king room window today.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the fifth-floor terraces sit empty, and Palacio de las Cortes stands in full sun.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and guests at the rooftop bar sit outside with cocktails facing the Palacio de Cibeles.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; the Cibeles Palace tower is still there from the rooftop, but the far skyline is not.
phrases.late_night: Were you up for water around midnight, you would see the Cibeles Palace tower against the city lights from the window.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in the eleventh-floor lounge tonight, you would see Plaza Cibeles wet and bright through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in the 11th-floor lounge tonight, you would see the lights of Plaza Cibeles under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Room 41's window shows the Rialto Bridge as a dark shape over a quiet Grand Canal.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the latticed canal-view windows of the lounge, where guests watch boats pass on the Grand Canal.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the canal-side terrace is in full sun, with the Grand Canal busy with boats in front of it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden hour on the rooftop altanella: Room 41 and Room 43 guests share a view of terracotta roofs and bell towers.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lit Rialto Bridge from Room 41, with the supper club open downstairs.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over the Grand Canal this morning, so the moka bar on the ground floor gets changing light.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the corner suite this afternoon, the Rialto Bridge is sometimes in sun and sometimes under a passing cloud.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the broken clouds orange above the bell towers seen from the rooftop altanella.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Grand Canal looks grey too, and the Venini chandeliers in the dining room stay switched on.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Grand Canal and on the empty canal-side terrace, so guests take their drinks at the cocktail bar inside.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Venice right now, and lightning shows the Rialto Bridge for a second through Room 41's window.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Grand Canal today; from the corner suite the Rialto Bridge is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the terracotta rooftops seen from the rooftop altanella, a rare sight in Venice.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, so the rooftop altanella stays empty while guests watch the Grand Canal from the lounge windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot weather sits over Venice today, so the canal-side terrace has few takers until the evening.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, boats still pass the canal-side terrace, and the Grand Canal is dark except for their lights.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Rialto Bridge is still clear from Room 41, but distant bell towers are hidden.
phrases.late_night: Lights off in Room 41 after midnight, the only brightness in the room comes off the Grand Canal under the Rialto arc.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks Room 41's window this evening, and palazzo lights across the Grand Canal move on the water near the Rialto arc.
phrases.grey_evening: Under cloud this evening, Room 41 has the Rialto arc in its window and palazzo lights on the Grand Canal.

phrases.clear_predawn: A clear dark sky sits over the SkyPark pool before sunrise, with the CBD towers still lit across Marina Bay.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Gardens-facing room, the Supertrees and the domed conservatory are clearly visible under a clear blue morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the high-floor restaurant windows show the southern coastline and harbor in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop deck now, you would see the harbor turning orange as the sun goes down.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Spectra light show runs on Marina Bay under a clear sky, with the CBD towers lit across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the CBD skyscrapers this morning, seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows of a high-floor guest room.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the infinity pool this afternoon, giving swimmers short breaks from the sun while the CBD towers stay in view.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the harbor turn orange, which guests on the rooftop deck can see.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the downtown skyline today, as seen through the floor-to-ceiling window of a marble bathroom.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the SkyPark and on Marina Bay below, and the pool is quieter than usual under a grey sky.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the floor-to-ceiling windows, lightning over the CBD skyline lights up the rain falling on Marina Bay after midnight.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Singapore today, so from the 57th-floor pool the CBD towers look pale and flat.
phrases.snow: Snow in Singapore would be a first, and the SkyPark pool would be a very strange place to watch it from.
phrases.very_cold: Air close to freezing is almost unknown in Singapore, so the Supertrees outside the Gardens-facing rooms are under a rare cold sky.
phrases.very_hot: From the 57th-floor infinity pool now, you would see heat-haze over the CBD towers across Marina Bay.
phrases.mild_night: It is a warm cloudy night, and from a city-facing room the Spectra lights can be seen on Marina Bay below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the 57th-floor SkyPark pool, the near towers of the CBD show across Marina Bay, but the far skyline fades into haze.
phrases.late_night: The curtain stays open on purpose in a city-facing room, and the CBD lights across Marina Bay fill the window at bedtime.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the city-facing rooms tonight, and the CBD lights blur across Marina Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight the CBD skyline lights reflect in Marina Bay under low haze, seen through the city-facing rooms' floor-to-ceiling windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the panoramic terrace already faces Göreme, where the balloon fleet will lift off beyond the fairy chimneys.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool, balloons rise over Göreme past the fairy chimneys in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a midday sky, the rooftop pool faces Uçhisar Castle, and its carved cave openings are easy to read from a lounger.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the rock face of Uçhisar Castle, three hundred metres from the Lobby Bar and the pool.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the dark shape of Uçhisar Castle behind the rooftop pool under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Göreme this morning, and the balloons rise between them, watched from the panoramic terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over Uçhisar this afternoon, so the castle behind the rooftop pool is lit one minute and shaded the next.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud leaves patches of light on the rock of Uçhisar Castle, seen from the terrace.
phrases.overcast: The sky over Cappadocia is grey today, but Uçhisar Castle is three hundred metres away and still clear from the pool deck.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop pool and its wooden deck today, and the rock of Uçhisar Castle turns darker in the wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Cappadocia, no balloons are flying, and a table at Aside Restaurant is the sensible place to be.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over Uçhisar today, and from the rooftop pool the castle three hundred metres away is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the fairy chimneys behind the entrance courtyard, and the cave suites stay warm inside the rock.
phrases.very_cold: It is bitterly cold on the panoramic terrace today, though the sky is clear and Uçhisar Castle stands sharply outlined against it.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the rooftop pool is the coolest way to look at Uçhisar Castle, three hundred metres away.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild cloudy night in Uçhisar, and the private jacuzzis of the two Royal Cave Suites are in use.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low and Göreme across the valley is hidden, but Uçhisar Castle, three hundred metres away, still shows from the pool.
phrases.late_night: Were you in a cave suite now, you would be asleep, the first balloons over Göreme only hours away.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in the Lobby Bar now, you would watch rain run down the glass where Uçhisar Castle stood at dusk.
phrases.grey_evening: If you carried a last drink from the Lobby Bar to your window tonight, you would see Uçhisar's lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Arabian Gulf is still dark from the suite balconies, and the beach below is completely empty.
phrases.clear_morning: A clear morning on Saadiyat: guests at the infinity pool have the Gulf in front of them and no crowds.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the white sand, and most guests are in the shade or the pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The rooftop lounge is the place now, with the low sun on the Gulf and palm shadows getting longer.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your balcony tonight, you would see a clear sky over a very dark Gulf.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over the Gulf this morning, so the light on the turquoise water changes from one minute to the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds give the beach a few minutes of shade this afternoon, which the guests on the sand accept gladly.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop lounge, the last sun comes through gaps in the clouds and lands on the Gulf.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky from the gardens to the horizon today; the Gulf looks silver rather than turquoise from the suites.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare on Saadiyat, and today the villa guests watch it hit the white sand from indoors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests on the suite balconies watch lightning over the Arabian Gulf flash across the white sand and the empty beach loungers.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Gulf this morning, so from the balconies the water and the sky meet without a clear line.
phrases.snow: Snow on Saadiyat is not something anyone expects, but if it fell, the palm trees by the pool would look very strange.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Abu Dhabi, so guests look at the Gulf from inside their suites instead of from the sand.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot now, and the infinity pool is the only place outside where guests stay for more than a few minutes.
phrases.mild_night: A warm, cloudy night, and the rooftop lounge has more people than seats, all facing the dark Gulf.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the horizon is missing from the suite balconies, though the beach and the pool are plainly there.
phrases.late_night: In the Gulf suites the curtain is left open tonight, and moonlight on the water is the last thing seen before sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain streaks the suite windows, and the infinity pool shows bright and wet between the palms.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the view from a Gulf suite is the white beach and the water under a hazy, starless sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Harbour Bridge is only a dark outline across the water from the Grand Harbour Suite balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: From a harbour-facing room, the morning sun already lands on the moored sailboats and the CBD skyline behind them.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the blue-striped umbrellas on the waterfront terrace are the only shade between lunch and the harbour.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on the terrace are watching the sun go down behind the CBD towers, glasses already raised.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a wrap-around balcony tonight, you would see the lights of the Harbour Bridge across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the city skyline this morning, seen through the sliding doors of a harbour room.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Beach Club has sun between the clouds this afternoon, and the striped umbrellas are all taken.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the CBD turn orange while diners settle at the waterfront terrace tables.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the harbour view from the rooms is flat but complete, sailboats and skyline included.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the striped umbrellas of the Beach Club, and the terrace tables are mostly empty.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Sydney Harbour is best watched from behind the sliding doors of a harbour room.
phrases.fog_haze: This haze over the harbour makes the Harbour Bridge faint from the balconies, though the moored boats nearby stay clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unheard of in Sydney, but if it fell, it would land on the Beach Club umbrellas first.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Sydney, and guests on the Grand Harbour Suite balconies keep jackets on while looking at the Bridge.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the shade under the blue-striped umbrellas is the most wanted spot on the terrace.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the CBD skyline lights are still visible across the harbour from the waterfront terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Harbour Bridge is hard to make out from the balconies, though the nearer sailboats are clear.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight in a Grand Harbour Suite, and the skyline lights shine across the harbour to the Bridge's arch.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the Grand Harbour Suites' glass after midnight, and the city lights near the Bridge show softly across the harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open before bed, the Grand Harbour Suites show the lit CBD skyline and the Bridge's arch under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop loungers are empty and La Pedrera's stone facade is a dark shape against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the wooden rooftop this morning, La Pedrera's curling facade stands in full sun with the Sagrada Família clear behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun hits the pool deck hard, so most guests sit under the rattan canopy at the marble bar.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light makes La Pedrera's stone facade look warmer, and its chimneys stand out clearly from the rooftop bar.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at the rooftop bar tonight, you would see La Pedrera lit up and the Sagrada Família behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: From the wooden rooftop this morning, patchy cloud sits above La Pedrera's curling stone facade and the Sagrada Família behind it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the pool this afternoon, so swimmers get sun for a few minutes, then shade.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud puts La Pedrera's facade in and out of light as seen from the terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky today, La Pedrera's stone facade looks flatter from the rooftop, and the pool water looks less turquoise.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop deck, so the loungers are empty and guests stay in their rooms with the speakers on.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Barcelona closes the rooftop pool for now, and guests in the interior-facing rooms hear thunder but see little.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Barcelona today softens the Sagrada Família behind La Pedrera, while the closer stone facade still shows clearly.
phrases.snow: Snow in Barcelona is rare, but today a thin layer sits on the rooftop loungers and on La Pedrera's roof.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing on the rooftop, the pool has no swimmers, and La Pedrera looks sharp in the cold air.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the rooftop pool is the busiest spot in the hotel, with La Pedrera visible from the water.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and guests sit at the marble bar with cocktails, La Pedrera's chimneys lit across the rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the Sagrada Família is missing from the rooftop sightline, though La Pedrera's chimneys still show clearly across the roofs.
phrases.late_night: Up late, you could sit at a window looking at La Pedrera and Sagrada Família.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink on the rooftop, you would see rain over Casa Milà's chimneys and the Sagrada Família behind.
phrases.grey_evening: Over a last drink on the rooftop tonight, you would see La Pedrera's chimneys under the haze and the Sagrada Família behind.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the rooftop bar before dawn, the Oriental Pearl Tower is a dark shape across the Huangpu River under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning sun lights the Pudong skyline across the Huangpu River, and the glass walls of the corner suites show every tower.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the high-floor restaurant terrace faces the Oriental Pearl Tower directly across the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun from the west hits the Pudong towers, and from the rooftop bar the Huangpu River turns the same warm colour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a Panoramic Bund room tonight, you would see the lit Oriental Pearl Tower under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over Pudong this morning, and the corner suites' windows show sun on some towers and shade on others.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the high-floor restaurant terrace watch cloud shadows cross the Huangpu River and the Pudong skyline this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the rooftop bar faces broken clouds over the Oriental Pearl Tower, some towers lit, some grey.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Oriental Pearl Tower stands across the Huangpu River beyond the floor-to-ceiling windows of the corner rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Huangpu River, and the corner guest rooms keep the view of Pudong behind wet floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the indoor lap pool is the calmer choice, while lightning over Pudong shows from the upper rooms' windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Huangpu River hides the top of the Oriental Pearl Tower today, while the lower Pudong towers remain in view.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Shanghai, but today the corner suites' floor-to-ceiling windows show flakes falling over the Huangpu River.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold clear day, the Pudong towers look sharp from the corner guest rooms, and the rooftop bar is quiet.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot sun covers the Huangpu River today, so most guests choose the indoor lap pool over the high-floor restaurant terrace.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, guests at the rooftop bar sit outside and face the lit Oriental Pearl Tower across the river.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Huangpu River shows from the corner suites while the Oriental Pearl Tower is only an outline.
phrases.late_night: Were you in a corner room now, you might leave the curtain open and fall asleep facing Pudong's lights across the Huangpu.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink at your window tonight, you would see Pudong's lights across the Huangpu River through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: Over a last drink in a corner room tonight, you would see the Pudong lights across the Huangpu under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop La Terrazza is empty and the domes of Rome stand dark against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning sun lights the dome of a nearby church and the dark cypresses seen from a guest room window.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Mausoleum of Augustus sits in full sun outside the windows of the Bvlgari Suite.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light reaches La Terrazza now, and the view runs from Villa Medici across to the Tiber without a cloud.
phrases.clear_night: After midnight under a clear sky, the rooftop La Terrazza looks over Rome's lit domes toward the river Tiber.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the rooftops this morning, seen from the bathtub window with its view of church domes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon some clouds pass between the sun and La Terrazza, so the Tiber shows bright and then grey in turns.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on La Terrazza in this last hour of sun, you would see the domes lit orange between broken clouds.
phrases.overcast: A full cover of grey cloud sits over Rome, and from La Terrazza the domes and the Tiber look flat today.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Piazza Augusto Imperatore, and guests watch it from the fifth-floor tables of Il Ristorante Niko Romito.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm has emptied La Terrazza, and lightning now flashes behind the church dome seen from the guest room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the city today, and from La Terrazza the Tiber is hard to make out while the nearer domes show.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Rome, but today a thin layer covers the roof of the Mausoleum of Augustus outside the Bvlgari Suite.
phrases.very_cold: From La Terrazza now, you would see hard winter light on the Tiber and frost on the empty chairs.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot sun today keeps guests under the large parasols on La Terrazza, where the rooftops of Rome look very bright.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night the red cushioned chairs on La Terrazza are mostly taken, the domes dark under the cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so from La Terrazza the Tiber and Villa Medici are not clear, though the nearest domes remain in view.
phrases.late_night: Past midnight the lights along the Tiber are easy to look at from La Terrazza, and there is no hurry to stop.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at Il Ristorante – Niko Romito is done, and from La Terrazza the lights along the Tiber blur in the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: Hours after dinner at Il Ristorante – Niko Romito, the room windows show low cloud over the lit city out to the Tiber.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Koutoubia minaret is already a dark outline from the rooftop terraces, three hundred and fifty meters away.
phrases.clear_morning: From the pool, the minaret stands clear above the clipped hedges on the right, and the first swimmers have the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the courtyard pool, and the white umbrellas by the loungers are the only shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a Royal Suite terrace now, you would see the low sun turning the minaret's stone orange.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the rooftop sky bar looks out over the medina under a clear sky, the minaret the nearest shape.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass behind the minaret this morning, and guests on the rooftop terraces watch them move from the lounge chairs.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Broken cloud over the courtyard pool this afternoon means the white umbrellas are needed only part of the time.
phrases.partly_golden: Patches of cloud turn red behind the Koutoubia as the sun drops, and the rooftop terrace lanterns are already lit.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the minaret's stone looks flat and dull from the rooftop suites, with no shadows on the medina.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the courtyard pool and its white umbrellas, and the piano bar is where most guests sit this hour.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning behind the Koutoubia minaret is visible from the upper-floor terraces, though guests are watching it from inside their suites.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Marrakech today softens the minaret's outline, but at 350 meters it is still clearly there from the pool.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Marrakech today, which almost never happens, and the rooftop lounge chairs have a thin white layer.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing today, so the Royal Suite terraces, each with a fireplace, are the warmest spot with a Koutoubia view.
phrases.very_hot: From the rooftop, heat haze blurs the low roofs on the way out to the Koutoubia minaret.
phrases.mild_night: A warm, cloudy night over the medina, and the courtyard pool's lights show on the calm water between the loungers.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so the medina panorama from the sky bar does not reach far, though the nearby minaret stays clear.
phrases.late_night: The Koutoubia minaret is easy to watch late from the Royal Suite, medina lights around it.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, the Royal Suites' windows show the Koutoubia minaret through the rain, its square tower above the wet medina roofs.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the Royal Suite windows show the Koutoubia minaret above the lit medina roofs, under a low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea toward Naxos is dark and flat, and the three pools are still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From a sea-view terrace, the Naxos mountains look sharp this morning, and the outdoor breakfast tables already have juice on them.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun on the infinity pool: the white ottoman seats are mostly taken, and Naxos sits clear across the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The light on the Naxos mountains is turning orange, which is why nobody is leaving the pool yet.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the lights of the bay town show across the water from the infinity pool, with a few sailboats.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Naxos this morning, so the mountains across the water go from bright to grey and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Half the sky is clouded this afternoon, but the sea between the pools and Naxos stays blue enough for swimmers.
phrases.partly_golden: Patches of cloud catch the last sun over Naxos, and guests stay in the water to watch from the pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Aegean beyond the stone walls looks flat and silver, and the spa is busier than the pools.
phrases.rain: If you were on your terrace now, you would see rain falling on the three pools and across the water toward Naxos.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were there in this storm, you would watch lightning over the water toward Naxos from your room, not the pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, so from the breakfast table Naxos is only a faint shape, if visible at all.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on Paros, but if it came today, the three outdoor pools would be empty and Naxos hidden behind it.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Paros: the pools are unused, and guests look at Naxos through closed balcony doors instead.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot this afternoon, and the three pools are the only comfortable place to look at Naxos from.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, so the terraces off the sea-view rooms are in use, with the bay town lights across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Naxos and the distant islands are not showing from the infinity pool, only the nearby sea.
phrases.late_night: With the room lights off after midnight, the sea-view rooms get their only light from Naxos across the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at Galazia Hytra is finished, and through rain on the glass doors the lights of Naxos show faintly across the water.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Galazia Hytra, the sea-view rooms look out on scattered lights across the water under low cloud tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies of the ocean-view rooms face a dark Pacific with a thin pale line at the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight comes straight off the ocean into the tall-windowed suites, and Coogee Beach below is already bright.

phrases.late_night: If you were in an ocean-view room now, you could fall asleep with the curtain open to the lights along Coogee Beach.
phrases.wet_evening: With a last drink in an ocean-view room tonight, you would see rain on the glass and the beach lights.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last glass in an ocean-view room now, you could see the lights along Coogee Beach under low cloud.

phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, cloud covers the Mall, and the Tidal Basin lights and the Lincoln Memorial's columns fill the window.

phrases.grey_evening: If you had a nightcap in a beach villa now, cloud would hide the moon and jetty lights would mark the lagoon.
