phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Mexico City today, but from the upper floors the Auditorio Nacional is still easy to find in the forest.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Chapultepec canopy, and the private terraces are empty while guests watch from behind the windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Reforma skyline is visible from the blue velvet sofa, and the thunder is loud even this high up.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Mexico City, so from the terraces the Chapultepec canopy is clear but the far skyline is only an outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Mexico City, but if it were falling now, the sauna would be the sensible choice over the terrace.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold, clear day in Mexico City: the distant mountains are sharp from the king-bed suites, and the terraces stay empty.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, guests are staying out of the sun, and the pool is busier than the private terraces.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and the white lounge seats on the Carlotta bar terrace are taken, with the city lit below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today: the Chapultepec canopy below the terraces is clear, but the distant mountains are not visible at all.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water by the bed after midnight, and the lit Reforma skyline fills the suite's floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the glass of the Carlotta bar, and the Reforma lights below blur into long streaks.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze hangs over Reforma after midnight, and the avenue lights show through it below the suite windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Thames outside the bay windows is dark and flat, and the Canary Wharf towers already have lights on.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear sky over London this morning, so guests in upper-floor Executive Suites see the full length of the river panorama.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is on the Quadrato terrace, and lunch tables there sit a few steps from the Thames.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Canary Wharf towers, and from a window seat the river looks bright and busy.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the pool tonight, you would swim toward a clear view of Canary Wharf lights across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Patches of cloud move over Canary Wharf this morning, and the bay windows show the Thames in changing light.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud alternate over the river this afternoon, a good time for a slow coffee on the Quadrato terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud turns orange above the Thames, seen best from the Penthouse Suite.
phrases.overcast: Full grey cloud covers London today, but the Thames and The Shard are still visible from the room windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Thames right now, and the steam rooms and sauna are the sensible indoor option.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Canary Wharf, and the floor-to-ceiling windows give guests a wide, dry view of the lightning.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Thames today, and from the bay windows the Canary Wharf towers are only pale outlines.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on West India Quay, a rare sight in London, and guests watch it from the indoor pool.
phrases.very_cold: If you were at a bay window now, you would see hard winter light on the Thames and frost on the quayside.
phrases.very_hot: From the bay windows, heat-haze shimmers above the Thames and the Canary Wharf towers in the midday heat.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and from the window seats the lights of Canary Wharf show on the dark Thames.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Poor visibility over London today: The Shard is hidden from the rooms, while the Thames and nearby Canary Wharf towers remain visible.
phrases.late_night: Up late in an Executive Suite, you could watch the lights on the Thames until two.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink at the bay window after midnight, Canary Wharf's lights would blur in rain over the Thames.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last glass at the window seat tonight, you would see city lights reflected on the Thames under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the infinity pool is a dark flat surface and the Aegean behind it is barely lighter.
phrases.clear_morning: From the infinity pool, the Aegean lies flat and bright blue under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the white walls of the cave suites are very bright, and the sea beyond the plunge pools is calm.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the infinity pool's edge line up exactly with the Aegean horizon.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the infinity pool is lit from below and the sea behind it is dark under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Aegean this morning, seen through the three windows of the suites.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the sea this afternoon, and guests in the infinity pool get sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_golden: Through the arched openings of the cave pool, the sun is setting behind a few clouds over the Aegean.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the Aegean today, so the sea looks grey too from the suite terraces, not its usual blue.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the white terraces and the infinity pool, with the grey Aegean Sea beyond them.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Aegean right now, and from the cave suites the lightning is visible through the terrace openings.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the sea today, so the horizon line that the infinity pool usually matches is not sharp.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on Mykonos, but today a few flakes fall on the white terraces beside the infinity pool.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air today for Mykonos, and the infinity pool terrace is empty while the sea below stays blue.
phrases.very_hot: The heat is strong on the terraces today, and most guests are in the infinity pool or their private plunge pools.
phrases.mild_night: A warm night with clouds over the Aegean, and the lit infinity pool is the brightest thing in view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over the sea today, so the far horizon and any passing cruise ships are not visible from the suites.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the cave suites are probably asleep now, and at dawn their glass doors will show the Aegean again.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the cave suites are likely in bed, rain running down the glass doors while the pool lights shine outside.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a cave suite after midnight sees low cloud over the Aegean and the pool lights outside the glass doors.

phrases.clear_morning: The sun has risen out of the ocean, and breakfast at The Placery comes with a bright, clear Atlantic view.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a cloudless sky, the beach below the balconies is wide and bright, and the rooftop umbrellas give the only shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the rooftop terrace from behind the hotel, and the sand and water in front turn a warmer colour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on an upper oceanfront balcony tonight, you would see a clear sky of stars over a dark Atlantic.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit above the ocean this morning, and from The Placery the breakfast view is mostly blue with white patches.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the beach this afternoon, and the pool beside the sand gets sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the Atlantic turns pink, and the rooftop sofas face straight at it.
phrases.overcast: Full cloud cover sits over Virginia Beach today, and from the oceanfront rooms the sea and sky are two shades of grey.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the beach and the balcony railings, so lunch at The Placery is the dry way to see the ocean.
phrases.thunderstorm: Behind closed balcony doors in the oceanfront rooms, guests can see each flash of lightning over the Atlantic and the beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the water today, and from the oceanfront balconies only a short stretch of the Atlantic is visible.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the sand below the balconies, a rare sight in Virginia Beach, and the rooftop terrace is white and empty.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, so the balconies are for a quick look at the Atlantic before the door shuts.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the boardwalk this afternoon, and the pool just behind the beach is the busiest spot.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and from the city-view rooms the evening entertainment on Atlantic Avenue is still going on below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the upper oceanfront rooms do not get their usual sharp horizon, and the sea just fades out.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, with the room lights off in an oceanfront king, the boardwalk along the sand gives the only light inside.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the oceanfront room windows tonight, and the boardwalk lights fall on wet sand and a thin edge of surf.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight cloud hangs low over the Atlantic, and the boardwalk lights mark the edge of the sand from the oceanfront kings.

phrases.clear_morning: From the Executive Club workspaces, the towers stand sharp against a clear sky while breakfast is served inside.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the twenty-five-metre pool, and the towers are clearly visible from the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light comes through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the lounge bar, and the towers catch the low sun.

phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the city today, but the Petronas Twin Towers remain clear from the Executive Club lounge.

phrases.thunderstorm: From the tower-facing rooms, lightning flashes behind the Petronas Twin Towers as a thunderstorm moves over Kuala Lumpur.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the city today, and the tops of the Petronas Twin Towers look blurred from the pool.
phrases.snow: Snow in Kuala Lumpur would be unheard of; if it fell today, guests in tower-facing rooms would watch it with disbelief.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air over Kuala Lumpur is unheard of, and today the outdoor pool is likely empty while the towers look sharp.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the twenty-five-metre elevated pool is the sensible place, with the towers in full view.
phrases.mild_night: It is a warm cloudy night, and the lit Petronas Twin Towers fill the view from the elevated pool.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; the Petronas Twin Towers are still visible from the suite windows, but the distant mountains are not.

phrases.grey_evening: After a late Yun House dinner, the tower-facing suites face the Petronas Twin Towers, tops in cloud, the city lit around them.

phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, lightning over the Huangpu River is visible from the guest rooms on floors 86 to 98.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Oriental Pearl Tower today, so guests in Jin Yan on the 103rd floor see mostly white outside.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the windows of the Shanghai Suite, and the Pudong skyline below turns pale and partly hidden.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the whole Pudong skyline shows sharply from Kinnjyou Inaka on the 104th floor.
phrases.very_hot: Strong sun and very hot air cover Shanghai today, and the Huangpu River lies in full sun below the Shanghai Suite windows.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, live jazz plays in the Yi Lounge while city lights show through the 84th-floor windows.

phrases.grey_evening: Past midnight the Shanghai Suite curtains are open, and city lights glow under low cloud around the Oriental Pearl Tower's spheres.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the Atlantic, so from the balconies the horizon is not a sharp line today but a blur.

phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold day the infinity pools stay empty, and guests view the Atlantic from behind the sliding glass doors.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over the cliffs today, so most guests spend the afternoon in the rooftop pool under the white umbrellas.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Calheta, and the open-air restaurant terrace is full, with the dark Atlantic just beyond the tables.

phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in your room tonight, rain would run down the glass doors above the Calheta lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is dark and flat from the balconies, and the sky over it has started to go pale.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun comes in from the land side, so the balconies are in shade while the Atlantic stays bright.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would hear the waves from a balcony chair and see stars over the water.
phrases.partly_morning: From The Reel's floor-to-ceiling windows this morning, scattered clouds sit over the sea and the beach.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the beach this afternoon, and the outdoor pools go from sun to shade every few minutes.

phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the ocean-facing king rooms after midnight, and the lit outdoor pools show through the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hides the moon over the Atlantic after midnight, and the beachfront lights along Ocean Boulevard show from the king rooms.

phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Porto, so the cathedral tower is faint from the upper rooms and the farther rooftops are not clear.

phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has an upper room tonight can watch rain on the glass as rooftop lights come on below the Cathedral tower.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the upper rooms after midnight sees city lights on the rooftops under low cloud, the Cathedral tower among them.

phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the Fallsview Rooms ended the day at the wraparound window, the city lights hazy under cloud near the Horseshoe Falls.

phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so distant downtown high-rises are unclear from the rooms, though Millennium Park remains visible from the suite.
phrases.late_night: Guests waking for water around one see Millennium Park's lights and the Bean's curve.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone in the Millennium Park suite tonight can watch the rain fall over the park lamps as the day ends.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the Millennium Park suite after midnight sees the park lamps and the Bean's curve under a low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the outline of the Atlas is already visible from the pool terrace, with the paddocks still dark below.
phrases.clear_morning: From a balcony room, the morning sun lights the palm-lined gardens and the horses are already out in the paddocks.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the three pools are in full sun, and the Atlas range stands sharp beyond the horse paddocks.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the restaurant terrace now, you would see the late sun turn the Atlas peaks orange across the paddocks.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear, and from the gardens guests can see stars above the dark line of the Atlas.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit over the Atlas this morning, so the peaks show only in pieces from the pool terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, cloud shadows move across the horse paddocks while the Atlas range stays mostly in sun behind them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds above the Atlas turn pink, seen from the gardens along the central axis.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlas is only a flat shape beyond the paddocks, and the pools look less inviting than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the formal gardens, which is rare here, and the Chenot spa is busier than the pools.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over the Atlas right now, and lightning is visible from the guest room balconies above the gardens.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Atlas today, so from the outdoor restaurant the view ends at the horse paddocks and the palms.
phrases.snow: Snow on the Atlas peaks is normal in winter, but today a few flakes reach the gardens of Selman itself.
phrases.very_cold: The air is close to freezing this morning, and the snow line on the Atlas has come down toward the paddocks.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, so the Atlas looks tawny and pale across the paddocks and most guests stay in the three pools.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night, and the balcony of a guest room is a comfortable place to look out over the dark gardens.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Atlas Mountains are not visible from the pools; the paddocks and the gardens still are.
phrases.late_night: After midnight one garden room is lit late, its window facing south toward the Atlas.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the guest room windows tonight, and the garden lamps show the line south toward the Atlas.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight low cloud covers the High Atlas, and the rectangular pool shows pale at the end of the formal gardens.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop pool deck is quiet, and the Nile below is still too dark to see clearly.
phrases.clear_morning: From a guest room's floor-to-ceiling window, the Nile is bright and the Pyramids show clearly on the western skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun on the rooftop makes the canvas cabanas the useful spot, with the Nile thirty-two floors below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a balcony now, you would see the sun going down behind the Pyramids across the Nile.
phrases.clear_night: After midnight from the rooftop lounge, the lit bridge and city lights shine on the Nile under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the Nile this morning, and breakfast trays are already set out on the balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over Cairo this afternoon, so the Pyramids appear and disappear from the pool deck.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests on the rooftop loungers watch the light change on the Nile between clouds.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Cairo today, and the Pyramids are hard to see from the suite windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Cairo, and today the fitness center windows show the Nile under a wet grey sky.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the rooftop lounge, lightning flashes over the Nile and the lit bridge below, with rain on the glass panels.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Cairo hides the Pyramids today, though the Nile directly below the towers is still clear.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never happens in Cairo, yet today flakes are falling past the guest room windows toward the Nile.
phrases.very_cold: Cold air sits over Cairo today, so the spa is busier than the rooftop pool and the Pyramids look sharp.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the rooftop today, and most guests are in the pool or under the canvas cabanas.
phrases.mild_night: After midnight under a mild, cloudy sky, the lit bridge and Cairo city lights shine across the Nile below the rooftop lounge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Cairo today, so the Pyramids are not visible from the pool deck, only the Nile directly below.
phrases.late_night: Late into the night, Cairo's lights are reflected in the Nile below the guest-room windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner, rain runs down the guest room's floor-to-ceiling window, and the bridge lights blur on the Nile.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the floor-to-ceiling window of a Nile-facing room shows the bridge lights and the city glow under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: If you were in a dual-panorama suite now, you would see the clear sky paling over the Mediterranean before sunrise.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balcony with white chairs, the Mediterranean and the Taurus Mountains are both sharp this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the umbrella on the rooftop terrace is the only shade between the orange loungers and the sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun lights the Taurus ridge seen through one glass wall, while the sea stays bright through the other.
phrases.clear_night: Through the suite's floor-to-ceiling glass after midnight, stars shine in a clear sky over the Gulf of Antalya.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit over the Taurus Mountains this morning, while the Mediterranean side of the suite windows stays mostly clear.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the yellow loungers get sun and shade in turns as clouds pass over the Gulf of Antalya.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours a few clouds above the sea, visible from the balcony with white chairs.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Mediterranean looks grey too, but the Taurus ridge is still clearly visible from the suites.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the two outdoor pools and the private beach, so many guests are inside at the Anjana Spa.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Gulf of Antalya is best watched from behind the floor-to-ceiling glass, not from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides most of the Taurus ridge today, and from the balcony the sea fades into grey after a short distance.
phrases.snow: Snow at sea level is rare in Antalya, so a white Taurus ridge seen from the suites is an unusual sight.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day like this, the orange loungers on the rooftop terrace are empty and the pools are quiet.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air today, so the two outdoor pools and the private beach are where most guests are spending the afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, and the terrace with orange seating is a comfortable place to sit facing the dark sea.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the Taurus ridge is not visible from the suite windows and only the nearby sea shows.
phrases.late_night: Well after midnight, the shore lights along the Gulf of Antalya are easy to watch from the dual-panorama suite's glass walls.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the dual-panorama suite's floor-to-ceiling glass, and the lights along the Antalya seafront look blurred against the Mediterranean.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze covers the Taurus ridge tonight, and the seafront lights fill the second glass wall of the dual-panorama suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the floor-to-ceiling bedroom windows show a dark Arabian Gulf and the lights of the Abu Dhabi skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: After the breakfast buffet at Rosewater, guests head up to the Observation Deck, where the telescopes point at a clear coastline.
phrases.clear_midday: Under the midday sun, the curved pools and the sandy beach are full, and the Gulf water is bright turquoise.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Observation Deck at 300, the whole coastline is lit from the side by the low afternoon sun.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the skyline lights from the rooftop dining terrace, with the marina directly below.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Gulf this morning, and the yellow chairs on the Observation Deck face a mostly sunny coastline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the five towers this afternoon, and the sandy beach gets short periods of shade between the sunny ones.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds over the marina, a good moment to be on the rooftop dining terrace.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Abu Dhabi today, so the Gulf looks flat and silver from the bedroom windows instead of turquoise.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Abu Dhabi, and today guests watch it from the bathroom's panoramic Gulf window rather than the beach.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the Observation Deck at 300 gives a wide view of lightning over the Gulf and the coastline.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the coast today, so the telescopes on the Observation Deck show less of the coastline than usual.
phrases.snow: Snow in Abu Dhabi would be a first, and from the bedroom windows flakes over the Gulf would be a strange sight.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing day in Abu Dhabi, the curved pools stay empty and the Gulf view is best from inside the suites.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot outside today, so the sandy beach is quiet and guests stay in the water of the curved pools.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night, the rooftop dining terrace is comfortable, and the skyline lights show under the low clouds.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Observation Deck at 300 the far end of the coastline cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Abu Dhabi skyline lights are easy to see from the bedroom windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling bedroom windows after midnight, and the Abu Dhabi skyline lights look soft behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the Arabian Gulf after midnight, and the city lights look soft through the bedroom's floor-to-ceiling windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the outline of Diamond Head is already visible from a high-floor lanai, with the Pacific still dark.

phrases.clear_midday: At midday the water over Kuhio Beach turns its brightest turquoise, and the rock breakwater shows clearly from the balconies.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits Diamond Head from the west, and guests on the terrace have the wicker chairs facing the ocean.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the lanai tonight, you would see stars over the Pacific and the dark shape of Diamond Head.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift past Diamond Head this morning, seen through the floor-to-ceiling windows, while Kuhio Beach stays in sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Scattered clouds move over the Pacific this afternoon, and swimmers in the heated pool get sun between them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above Diamond Head turn orange, which the high-floor balconies face directly.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the ocean from the suite living area looks flatter and less turquoise, but the breakwater is still clear.

phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the Pacific, and the floor-to-ceiling windows give the suites a wide view of lightning offshore.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Honolulu today blurs Diamond Head from the kitchen window, though Kuhio Beach stays visible from the lanai.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unheard of in Honolulu, so guests on the balconies would be watching Kuhio Beach in disbelief.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air in Honolulu is extremely rare, but the view of Diamond Head from the lanai would be very sharp.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day the terrace chairs under the palm trees give some shade, and the heated pool is less tempting.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night in Waikiki, and guests on the lanai hear the Pacific without seeing much of it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Diamond Head is faint from the kitchen window, though Kuhio Beach and the breakwater show clearly.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water at the kitchen sink after midnight comes with the shape of Diamond Head past Kuhio Beach.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the Premium Oceanfront windows and the outline of Diamond Head shows and fades behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud passes over Waikiki Beach after midnight, and the oceanfront suites' tall windows show the lit shoreline of Kuhio Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, from the top-floor suite terrace, the Frauenkirche and Alter Peter towers are dark shapes against a slowly brightening sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Theatinerkirche's twin towers, seen through the floor-to-ceiling windows beside the indoor pool.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, swimmers in the rooftop spa pool have the Munich skyline under a clear sky as their backdrop.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a street-facing room now, you would see late sun on the Old Town roofs and the Frauenkirche.
phrases.clear_night: Night over Munich, and the lit towers of the Theatinerkirche stand out through the spa's tall windows.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass above the Old Town this morning, watched from the top-floor suite terrace with coffee.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop spa pool, afternoon sun and broken cloud fall across the Old Town roofs and the Frauenkirche towers.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, patches of light move across the roofscape seen from the upper street-facing rooms.

phrases.rain: Rain falls on Maximilianstrasse, while the indoor pool stays warm and the Theatinerkirche towers blur a little behind wet glass.

phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over the Old Town, and from the street-facing rooms the Frauenkirche towers are only faint outlines today.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the roofs of the Old Town, visible from the warm side of the indoor pool's windows.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold, the Ludwig Suite's Finnish sauna makes more sense than its terrace, though the view stays clear.
phrases.very_hot: Munich is very hot today, and the rooftop spa pool is the obvious place to look at the skyline from.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night over Munich, and the Theatinerkirche towers are lit as usual beyond the indoor pool windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; the Theatinerkirche's twin towers are still visible from the pool, but the farther roofscape is not.
phrases.late_night: Long after midnight, the upper street-facing rooms keep the Frauenkirche towers in view over the lit Old Town roofscape.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight rain runs down the glass of the street-facing rooms, and Maximilianstrasse shines wet under its lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Around two, low cloud moves over the Old Town lights seen from the Ludwig Suite.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Petronas Twin Towers are still lit, and from the Club Towers View Room the Skybridge is clearly visible.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning sky over Kuala Lumpur, and the outdoor pool above the park canopy already has the towers sharp behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the pool above the KLCC Park, and the towers stand without any haze beyond it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light hits the Petronas Twin Towers, and the corner living rooms of the Twin Towers suites face them directly.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a king bedroom tonight, you would see the lit towers and the Skybridge with no cloud in between.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds pass over Kuala Lumpur this morning, but from the suite living room windows both towers are fully visible.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Broken cloud this afternoon means the outdoor pool gets sun in short periods, with the towers staying in view the whole time.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds turn orange above the towers, and guests at the lounge bar windows watch it.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the KLCC area today, though the towers are close enough to stay clear from the Club Towers View Room.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the KLCC Park and the pool is empty, but the marble bathroom tub still faces the towers.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Club Towers View Rooms tonight watch lightning flash behind the Petronas Twin Towers and the Skybridge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the city today, so the towers look pale from the pool and the Skybridge is harder to pick out.
phrases.snow: Snow in Kuala Lumpur would be a first, and if it happened, the Club Towers View Room would face a white Skybridge.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air in Kuala Lumpur is unusual, and today the spa is a better choice than the outdoor pool above the park.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon in Kuala Lumpur, and the outdoor pool is the most comfortable place to look at the towers.
phrases.mild_night: A warm, cloudy night, and the lit towers fill the floor-to-ceiling windows of the lounge bar with no rain so far.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the towers are still visible from the penthouse living room, but the wider city skyline is not.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water in the Club Towers View Room, and the Skybridge is in the window above the lit city.
phrases.wet_evening: The Club Towers View Room curtain is open after midnight, and rain on the glass softens the city lights around the Skybridge.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze blurs the city lights after midnight, and the curtains in the Club Towers View Room are open on the Skybridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise under a clear sky, the lit Basilica of Fourvière stands on the ridge above the Rhône from the river-facing rooms.

phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun fills the corner rooms through both windows, and the yellow curtains are pulled back for the river and the rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Light Bar terrace, the low sun warms the colour of the rooftops across the Rhône, with Fourvière clear above them.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in Bar Le Melhor tonight, you would see the lit basilica on the ridge and the dark river below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Fourvière this morning, and the upper river-facing rooms get alternating shade and sun on the Rhône.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, patches of cloud move across the city rooftops seen from the eighth floor, with the river bright between them.
phrases.partly_golden: Dinner guests at Les 3 Dômes watch the last sun come and go between clouds over the basilica and the Rhône.

phrases.rain: Rain streaks the floor-to-ceiling windows of Les 3 Dômes, and the far bank of the Rhône shows only as blurred shapes.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm over Lyon means the eighth-floor windows show lightning over the ridge, while the Light Bar terrace stays empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over the Rhône today, and from the upper rooms the basilica on the ridge is hidden or only faintly visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftops across the Rhône, and from the corner rooms both windows show a white city.
phrases.very_cold: The Light Bar terrace is quiet in the freezing clear air, and Fourvière looks sharp across the Rhône.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Lyon today, and the heat haze makes Fourvière look slightly washed out from the upper rooms.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and diners at the rooftop tables have the illuminated church tower and Lyon's roofs behind them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today, so the eighth-floor windows show the Rhône and the nearest rooftops but not the Massif des Bauges.
phrases.late_night: City lights reflect in the Rhône after midnight, and from the river-facing rooms Fourvière's outline on the ridge is worth watching longer.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at Les 3 Dômes is over, and rain blurs the Rhône and lights of the 6th arrondissement from the river-facing rooms.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Les 3 Dômes, the river-facing rooms look out on city lights reflected in the Rhône under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, stars fill the clear sky over Buahan Valley, seen from the open-air bales with no walls.

phrases.clear_midday: At midday the red umbrellas by the infinity pool give the only shade, and the whole valley is in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches across the Buahan Valley, and the rice terraces below the wooden chairs turn a deeper green.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a bale tonight, you would hear the Ayung River and see stars with no wall in between.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit over the mountain peaks this morning, while the waterfall across the valley stays in clear view.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, cloud shadows move across the jungle valley below the infinity pool, and the loungers are in and out of shade.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds over the seven peaks are still bright while the valley slowly darkens.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the mountain peaks look flat against the clouds, and the copper tub still faces the full jungle canopy.

phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder sounds over Buahan Valley, and from the bales the lightning above the seven peaks is hard to miss.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist fills the valley today, so from the wooden deck the volcanic peaks are hidden and only the nearest trees show.
phrases.snow: Snow in northern Ubud would be a first, but if it came, the open-air bales would show it falling on the jungle.
phrases.very_cold: It is unusually cold for Bali today, and guests in the bales are using the curtains for more than privacy.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot across the valley today, and the infinity pool with its red umbrellas is where most guests have ended up.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm and cloudy, and the sound of the Ayung River reaches the beds in the open-air bales.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the terrace the nearby rice terraces are clear but the seven mountain peaks are not.
phrases.late_night: Asleep in an open bale now, you would wake at first light to the seven peaks across Buahan Valley.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in your open-air bale tonight, you would watch the rain fall across Buahan Valley.
phrases.grey_evening: If you finished a nightcap in your bale around two, you would see low cloud over Buahan Valley from the open deck.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over Copacabana Beach this afternoon, so swimmers in the rooftop pool get sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds around Sugarloaf, best seen from the rooftop pool right now.

phrases.thunderstorm: Thunderstorm over the sea, and guests in the ocean-view rooms are watching lightning above the Atlantic from behind glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water today, and the Cagarras Islands are hard to make out from the corner windows.
phrases.snow: Snow does not happen in Rio, so if you were there, you would be watching a very rare beach from the rooftop.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold for Rio today, so the beach below the restaurant windows is nearly empty while the sea stays blue.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the beach this afternoon, and the rooftop pool is the coolest place to look at Sugarloaf.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night, and from the corner suite windows the Atlantic is dark while the promenade below is still lit.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Cagarras Islands cannot be seen from the rooms, though the beach below is clear.
phrases.late_night: The curtain stays open tonight in the ocean-view rooms, and the lights along the beach fill the corner windows.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtains are open late in the ocean-view rooms, and rain blurs the lamps along Copacabana Beach.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Copacabana after midnight, and the beach lamps run along the sand below the ocean-view rooms.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a park-side room now, you would see low sun on the Chapultepec trees and long shadows across Polanco.

phrases.partly_afternoon: From the upper rooms this afternoon, cloud shadows move slowly across the Bosque de Chapultepec and the towers behind it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the clouds over the skyline orange, best seen from the Club Lounge windows.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the city today, so the skyline from the guest rooms is soft and the mountains are not visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare in Mexico City, but if it fell today, the Chapultepec canopy would look white from floor 40.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the air is clear enough to show the mountains behind the skyline from the Club Lounge.
phrases.very_hot: From the 40th floor, heat-haze hangs over the Polanco roofs and the Chapultepec canopy in the hot afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the night sky, but it is mild, and the city lights below the 40th floor stay bright.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today: the forest below the windows is clear, but the far skyline and mountains are mostly hidden.

phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a Club Level room after midnight sees the city lights under low cloud, and the Potomac shows their reflection.

phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a penthouse after midnight can watch low cloud move over the wheel while the city lights glow beneath it.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the terrace furniture, and the mountains across the lake are white from the top to the shore.
phrases.very_cold: The air on the lakeside terrace is close to freezing today, and the mountains across the lake are white with snow.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot afternoon on the floating pool deck, where most guests are in the water rather than under the umbrellas.
phrases.mild_night: A warm, cloudy night, and the candlelit lakeside terrace has guests in the wicker seats looking out at the dark lake.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop suites the near water is clear but Bellagio and the mountains are faint.
phrases.late_night: Sleep is the right choice in the Suite Greta tonight: Bellagio's lights show across the lake, and the mountains come back at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at La Terrazza Gualtiero Marchesi, rain runs down the Suite Greta windows and Bellagio's lights blur across the lake.
phrases.grey_evening: Long after dinner at La Terrazza Gualtiero Marchesi, the Suite Greta window shows Bellagio's lights across the water under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Grand Deluxe room already shows the whole bay, with the fortress still a dark shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is being served on the terrace, with moored boats and the stone fortress clear across the bay.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over Praia dos Pescadores, and the eleven rooms look onto a bright, flat Atlantic.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the green-walled room, the open shutters frame terracotta rooftops that turn orange in the last afternoon sun.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the marina lights from the French doors of the fireplace room.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Cascais Bay while guests eat breakfast on the terrace, the fortress visible between patches of shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun move across the bay this afternoon, and the teal umbrellas on the terrace are mostly in use.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the boats in the marina between clouds, seen from the terrace tables.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Cascais Bay looks flat and silver from every room, and the fortress stands out clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Praia dos Pescadores, and guests watch it from the fireplace room through closed French doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Atlantic shows from the Grand Deluxe room, where guests get a full circle of the storm.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over Cascais Bay, and from the terrace only the nearest moored boats can be made out.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare in Cascais, but if it fell today, the terracotta rooftops seen from the attic bathroom would be white.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold clear day over Cascais Bay, and the fireplace room keeps the marina view without the wind.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the teal umbrellas on the terrace are the only shade with a view of the bay.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night over the bay, and the marina lights are the main thing to see from the terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the far side of the bay and the Atlantic horizon are missing from the Grand Deluxe view.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Grand Deluxe room shows boat lights on the marina water; at dawn it will show all of Cascais Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the French doors after midnight, and the boat lights in the marina blur across Cascais Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Cascais Bay after midnight, and the marina lights show through the haze from the Grand Deluxe room.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before sunrise, the upper suites look out on a dark ocean, with the lighthouse a small shape to the north.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balcony of an ocean view suite, the wide sandy shore and the blue ocean are clearly visible this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Adirondack chairs on the lawn face a bright, wide beach under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low afternoon sun reaches the two white lounge chairs on the lawn and lights the forested headland behind the beach.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars over the open ocean from an ocean view suite balcony.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the beach this morning, but the hot tub windows still show a wide stretch of sand.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun and shadow cross the water this afternoon, seen through the sliding glass door of a king bedroom.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the ocean take on colour above the lighthouse, seen from the upper rooms.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the whole beach today, and the ocean and sand look much the same colour from the balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the lawn and the picnic table, so the fireplace in the suites is the better seat right now.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the open ocean is visible from the upper suites, and the indoor hot tub has a roof and large windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Tillamook Head Lighthouse today, so from the upper rooms only a short stretch of sand is visible.
phrases.snow: Snow on the beach is rare in Cannon Beach, but today the lawn chairs and the sand carry a thin white layer.
phrases.very_cold: The lawn chairs are empty in this freezing air, and guests watch the ocean from suites with the fireplaces lit.
phrases.very_hot: On this very hot day, the garden loungers sit in full sun, and the water beyond the lawn looks the better option.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild with cloud cover over Cannon Beach, and the ocean can be heard from the suite balconies.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the lighthouse is not in view from the upper rooms, only the nearer sand and water.
phrases.late_night: The surf breaks white in the night from the Captain's Quarters, sound filling the room.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the ocean suite's sliding glass door, and the surf shows white along Cannon Beach.
phrases.grey_evening: Late after dinner in town, the Captain's Quarters window shows white surf under low cloud over the ocean.

phrases.clear_predawn: Guests at the frameless windows before sunrise see Merano's lights on the Adige Valley floor under a clear, paling sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the frameless windows, the whole Adige Valley is sharp this morning, vineyard slopes and Merano both in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Lunch in the glazed Panorama Restaurant comes with a clear line of sight down the valley to the Dolomite ridges.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The water of the infinity pool reflects an orange-pink sky right now, and the snow on the peaks turns the same colour.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the valley below is a line of streetlamps running south from Merano, clear enough to count them from the terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Panorama Restaurant this morning, patches of cloud hang over the Dolomite ridges beyond Merano and the Adige Valley.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud cross the valley this afternoon, so the vineyard slopes switch between sun and shade while swimmers watch.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the terrace in this last hour of sun, you would see the clouds over the Dolomites turning pink.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers the plateau today; the valley and Merano stay visible from the rooms, the far ridges less clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the frameless panoramic windows, and the Adige Valley below looks grey and blurred from the mountain-facing beds.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Dolomites is visible from the glazed Panorama Restaurant, which is a better place to watch it than the terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has filled the valley today, so from the pool the view ends just past the rim, with Merano hidden below.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the plateau, and guests in the warm saltwater pool watch it settle on the terrace chairs.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day like this, the fur-draped terrace chairs face sharp white Alpine peaks under clear light.
phrases.very_hot: Anyone at the pool edge today sees Merano and the Adige Valley blurred by heat-haze beneath the Dolomite ridges.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, with the Stube's old wood panelling lit inside and Merano's lights still showing from the terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Haze limits the view today: Merano and the near slopes are visible from the rooms, but the Dolomite ridges are not.
phrases.late_night: The curtain stays open in a panoramic room tonight, and Merano's lights fill the Adige Valley until sleep comes.
phrases.wet_evening: Late after dinner in the Panorama Restaurant, rain on the room windows blurs Merano's lights in the valley below.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner in the Panorama Restaurant is over, and from the room windows Merano's lights run along the Adige Valley under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Ambassador suites look out on a dark Liangma River, with China Zun still lit against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight reaches the corner guest rooms early, and the CCTV Tower stands sharp beyond the green parkland.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the indoor pool is bright, and swimmers see the whole skyline through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the glass of China Zun, and guests on the rooftop terrace have a clear view of it.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop terrace tonight, you would see the Beijing skyline fully lit under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Beijing this morning, and from the 26th-floor executive lounge the skyline shows in patches of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From a Terrace Suite, the afternoon view mixes sun and cloud shadow across the Liangma River and the towers beyond.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights China Zun from the side while cloud covers parts of the skyline around it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the view from the Ambassador suites is less bright but complete, river, China Zun and skyline all visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in the executive lounge watch a wet Liangma River below.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were at an Ambassador suite window now, you would see lightning flash over China Zun and the Liangma River.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Beijing today reduces China Zun to an outline, seen from the corner rooms across the parkland.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the rooftop terrace furniture, while the pool and Cai Yi Xuan stay warm inside.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold and clear today, so the Terrace Suite's outdoor terrace is empty and the view is enjoyed from behind glass.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside today, so the indoor pool is the practical spot, with the same skyline view through its windows.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and two chairs on the rooftop terrace face the lit skyline with no need for coats.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the Ambassador suites today, the Liangma River is visible, but China Zun and the far skyline are not.
phrases.late_night: The Ambassador suites face the Liangma River lights after midnight, and China Zun's tall shape will show at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: In the Ambassador suites the curtain stays open late, and rain on the glass blurs the city lights along the Liangma River.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtains open in an Ambassador suite, the city lights show under low cloud along the Liangma River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lake-view rooms on the upper floors look out on a dark Lake Michigan under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun comes straight off Lake Michigan into the lake-view suites high on the upper floors.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Lake Michigan horizon is a flat, sharp line from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the upper suites.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon turns Lake Michigan orange, and the Palmolive Building spire stands out beside the suite windows.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the infinity-edge pool see the lit Chicago skyline with no cloud above it.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds cross Lake Michigan this morning, and their shadows move over the water below the lake-view rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the 32nd floor and above, the afternoon lake shows patches of sun and shade as clouds pass.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in a lake-view suite now, you would see the last sun on Lake Michigan under broken clouds.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Lake Michigan today, and the water seen from the upper suites looks grey too.
phrases.rain: Rain streaks the floor-to-ceiling windows, and Lake Michigan is a dull band beyond the glass of the lake-view rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Lake Michigan shows clearly from the upper suites, and nobody is using the infinity-edge pool right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides Lake Michigan today, so guests on the upper floors see only white outside the suite windows.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the windows of the lake-view suites, and Lake Michigan is hard to tell from the sky.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold and clear today, and Lake Michigan looks bright and hard-edged from the lake-view rooms high above the street.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Chicago today, and most guests are in the infinity-edge pool with its view of the skyline.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and couples at the night spa event finish with a swim in the infinity-edge pool.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so Lake Michigan fades a few blocks out and the far horizon is not visible from the suites.
phrases.late_night: Late tonight, shoreline lights reflect on Lake Michigan from lake-view suites, easy to watch longer.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the lake-view rooms after midnight, and Lake Michigan looks grey past the wet city lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud passes over Lake Michigan after midnight, and the shore lights show through it from the lake-view suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lake outside the Suite Mont Blanc terrace is dark and the ridge of Mont Blanc is only a shape.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool, swimmers can see the Jet d'Eau rising against a clear sky over Lake Geneva this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high, and from the corner terrace Mont Blanc is clearly visible above the lake, with no haze.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the rooftop terrace restaurant, and the cathedral spires of the Old Town look yellow in the low light.
phrases.clear_night: From the lake-facing rooms, the shore lights of Geneva lie on the water of Lake Geneva under a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Geneva this morning, and from the restaurant's tall windows the Alps show in the gaps between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in the pool this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows moving across Lake Geneva below.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights part of the Jura and leaves part in cloud, seen from the rooftop terrace restaurant tables.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Geneva today, so Mont Blanc is hidden, though the Rhône is still visible below the gold-draped windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lake Geneva, and from the indoor rooftop pool swimmers can watch it hit the water outside.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over the lake, and from the suite windows lightning shows the mountain ridgeline for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Lake Geneva today, and from the corner terrace neither the Jet d'Eau nor Mont Blanc can be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Geneva, and swimmers in the indoor rooftop pool watch it land on the lake through the glass.
phrases.very_cold: Behind frost-edged glass in the Suite Mont Blanc, the Jet d'Eau rises over Lake Geneva in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: Geneva is very hot today, and the rooftop pool is an easier place than the terrace to look at Mont Blanc.
phrases.mild_night: Under a mild, cloudy sky tonight, the round tables on the rooftop terrace restaurant face the Old Town spires in the dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today: the Rhône and the near shore show from the rooms, but Mont Blanc and the Jura do not.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner at Il Lago, the window of the Suite Mont Blanc shows the city lights reflected in Lake Geneva.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from Il Lago, rain on the window blurs the lights across Lake Geneva.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Il Lago is over, and after midnight the lights around Lake Geneva glow under low cloud from Suite Mont Blanc.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tramuntana ridge is a dark line above Deià, seen from the balconies of the upper-floor suites.
phrases.clear_morning: This morning the Deià rooftops and olive groves are fully clear from the stone terrace, with the Mediterranean visible below.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the pool terrace, and the sun loungers are the busiest spot on the estate.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the Tramuntana ridge, and the stone terrace seating faces it directly until the sun goes down.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a suite tonight, you would see stars over the Tramuntana and a few lights from Deià village.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit over parts of the Tramuntana ridge this morning, while the olive groves below the hotel are in full sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Shadows from the clouds move across the valley this afternoon, visible from the pool terrace and the balconies of the suites.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day lights the Deià rooftops below the stone terrace, with clouds over the ridge behind.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Deià today, so the Tramuntana ridge looks flat and close from the upper-floor suite windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the olive groves and the terraced gardens, and the balcony doors of the rooms stay shut.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the suite windows give a direct view of lightning over the Tramuntana ridge across the valley.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far side of the valley this morning, and the Mediterranean is not visible from the pool today.
phrases.snow: On the rare days snow reaches the Tramuntana peaks, the ridge above Deià turns white, seen from the suite balconies.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the Tramuntana ridge shows every detail from the stone terrace, and the pool loungers stay empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoons here mean the private plunge pools of the villas get used, with the ridge and village rooftops in view.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the balconies of the suites face the dark shape of the Tramuntana ridge over Deià.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Deià rooftops are clear from the pool, but the Mediterranean further down the valley is not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the village lights of Deià show below the Tramuntana ridge, and the Executive Suites face them late into the night.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at El Olivo, rain runs down the suite windows and Deià's village lights show below the Tramuntana ridge.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at El Olivo, the Executive Suites look out on Deià's village lights under low cloud below the Tramuntana ridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gulf outside the sea-view suites is still dark, with the Ain Dubai wheel standing beside it.
phrases.clear_morning: From the two woven chairs on the balcony, the Palm Jumeirah is sharp across clear morning water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the lagoon pool is bright, and guests on the yellow-striped loungers stay under the umbrellas.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the Gulf and the Ain Dubai wheel together in the window of a sea-view suite.
phrases.clear_night: From a sea-view suite after midnight, the lit Ain Dubai wheel stands beside the Gulf under a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Gulf this morning, and the Palm Jumeirah is still clear from the balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Scattered clouds move over Bluewaters this afternoon, shading the lagoon pool for a minute at a time.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the clouds pink behind the palms, as guests take the candlelit outdoor tables.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Gulf outside the upper-floor suites is flat and pale, and the wheel looks grey too.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare on Bluewaters, and today it darkens the 250 metres of beach below the sea-view suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder sounds over the Gulf, and guests watch the lightning from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows rather than the balcony.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Palm Jumeirah from the balconies today, though the Ain Dubai wheel next door is still visible.
phrases.snow: Snow in Dubai almost never happens, so a white beach under the sea-view suites would be a very strange sight.
phrases.very_cold: If you were on a balcony now, you would see the Gulf and the wheel, with the sandy beach empty.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the beach is empty at noon and most guests are in the lagoon pool or under umbrellas.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy night sky, the lights of the Ain Dubai wheel shine over the Gulf beyond the balcony.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Palm Jumeirah cannot be seen from the balconies, only the nearby beach and wheel.
phrases.late_night: With the suite lights off in the small hours, only the Palm Jumeirah lights reach the room across the Gulf.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the sea-view suites, and the lights of Palm Jumeirah blur across the Gulf.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud passes over the Gulf after midnight, and the Palm Jumeirah lights look soft from the sea-view suites' windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Rodeo Drive is empty below the suite balconies, and the Hollywood Hills are still only a dark shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on a suite balcony comes with a clear view of the palm trees and Los Angeles rooftops below.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the curved windows of the suites show the whole Los Angeles cityscape without a single cloud over it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the full length of Rodeo Drive, seen from the balcony, all the way to the Hollywood Hills.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the rooftop terrace has its fire pit going and the Century City skyline sharp against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit over the Hollywood Hills this morning, framed by the curved windows of a suite living room.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on a suite balcony this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows moving across the Los Angeles skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the clouds over Rodeo Drive orange, best watched from a furnished balcony.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Rodeo Drive and the Hollywood Hills are still clearly visible from the suite balconies, just without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare here, so guests in the suites are watching a wet Rodeo Drive through the curved balcony windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Hollywood Hills is unusual for Los Angeles, and the suite windows are the safest place to watch it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze today softens the Hollywood Hills seen from the balconies, while Rodeo Drive directly below remains easy to see.
phrases.snow: Snow in Beverly Hills would be a historic event, and the suite balconies would show it falling on Rodeo Drive.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Los Angeles: the Mediterranean-style pool is quiet, and the Hollywood Hills look sharp from the suites.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the Mediterranean-style pool is the busiest spot, and the balconies stay mostly empty until evening.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the rooftop fire pit is lit and the Century City lights spread out beyond the grass.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balconies Rodeo Drive is clear but the Hollywood Hills are only a faint outline.
phrases.late_night: Near two, Rodeo Drive lights fill the suite's curved glass, easy to watch for hours.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner after midnight, the suite's curved windows show Rodeo Drive wet and shining in the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: After a late dinner, the suite's curved windows show the lights of Rodeo Drive under low cloud tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the harbor channel outside the southeast-facing rooms is dark and still, with the sky just starting to lighten.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light falls on the water of the harbor channel, and the southeast-facing rooms get it directly through their windows.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun sits high over Boston Harbour, and from the corner windows of a king room the channel looks blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun comes low across the harbor channel, and the king rooms with corner windows fill with warm light.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the office buildings lit up through the guest room windows under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: From the corner windows, morning light falls on the harbor channel under a sky of broken cloud.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud, some sun over Boston this afternoon; the channel below the southeast-facing rooms shows patches of grey and blue.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun is turning the clouds over the harbor channel orange, seen from the king room's corner windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the harbor channel lies flat beyond the floor-to-ceiling windows, with the World Trade Center Pier dull below.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the harbor channel, and anyone in the suite watches it run down the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Boston Harbour right now, and the view from the corner windows is mostly dark cloud and lightning.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the harbor channel today, and from the southeast-facing rooms the Atlantic side of the view has simply disappeared.
phrases.snow: Snow is coming down over the harbor channel, and the water looks almost black next to it from the guest room windows.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day over Boston Harbour; the channel looks clear and sharp, and the indoor pool makes a lot of sense.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day in Boston, the water of the harbor channel is the coolest-looking thing from the room windows.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and the office buildings seen from the guest room windows are lit against a low sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so from the southeast-facing rooms the near part of the harbor channel is clear but the Atlantic is not.
phrases.late_night: Past midnight a few dock lights show on the harbor channel, and the corner windows face where the sun comes up.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the suite's tall windows before bed, and the city lights shine on the wet water of the harbor channel.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hides the moon over the harbor tonight, and the city lights shine on the water past an open curtain.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the duplex suites' floor-to-ceiling windows show only a dark, flat Arabian Gulf, and the building itself is closed for restoration.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning sun reaches the rooftop infinity pool and its white sun loungers, though no guest can use them until late 2027.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the open Arabian Gulf beyond the sea platform looks turquoise and very bright under a sky with no cloud.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a suite living room, you would see low sun on the Arabian Gulf through the angled floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the high-floor lounge windows look over the city sprawl of Dubai, with the lounge itself dark during renovation.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered morning clouds pass over Jumeirah Beach, which stretches away to the left when seen from the hotel's private island.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, broken cloud puts moving patches of shade on the Arabian Gulf below the rooftop infinity pool.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the Gulf turn orange, a view the closed suites cannot offer until late 2027.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky the Arabian Gulf seen from the helipad level looks pale and flat rather than turquoise.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Dubai, but today it falls on the rooftop infinity pool and the empty white sun loungers beside it.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you stood at a suite's floor-to-ceiling window now, you would see lightning flash over the Arabian Gulf.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Dubai skyline seen through the angled suite windows, and the far end of Jumeirah Beach fades into grey.
phrases.snow: Snow over the Arabian Gulf would be a first for Dubai; the teal mosaic indoor pool is under a roof anyway.
phrases.very_cold: In hard winter light, the Arabian Gulf lies flat and bright past the empty white loungers on the rooftop pool deck.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the private island today, and the Arabian Gulf beyond the sea platform shows almost no waves.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the Dubai sky on this mild night, and the high-floor lounge windows face the city sprawl without guests behind them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the suite windows show an unclear Dubai skyline and no far end of Jumeirah Beach.

phrases.grey_evening: Back up in a suite after dinner, the angled floor-to-ceiling windows show Dubai's city lights under a hazy sky.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see warm light on the palm tree outside the king bedroom balcony.
phrases.clear_night: A clear night at Triton restaurant: candles on the poolside tables and distant town lights across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over Paros this morning, and from the lawn by the pool the bay looks turquoise where the sun reaches it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the pool terrace watch cloud shadows move across the sea toward Antiparos, with a few sailboats in the bay.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the sky over the distant hills pink and purple, seen from the candlelit terrace.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the Aegean, so the sea from the room balconies looks grey too, and Antiparos sits low and dark ahead.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Aegean today hides the hills of Antiparos, and only the nearest water is clear from the pool terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow on Paros almost never happens, but today a few flakes are landing on the lawn and the bougainvillea by the pool.
phrases.very_cold: From the pool terrace, hard winter light falls on the empty daybeds and on Antiparos low in the water ahead.

phrases.late_night: Guests back late from dinner at Triton are probably asleep now, a few distant town lights showing across the sea.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the sea-view rooms after midnight sees rain on the glass and the far town lights blurred behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever is awake in a sea-view room after midnight sees low cloud and a few town lights across the water toward Antiparos.

phrases.clear_midday: At midday the parasols on the CODA terrace are in use, and the red rooftops of Malá Strana look very bright.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop terrace, you would see low sun on Prague Castle and long shadows across the red roofs.

phrases.partly_afternoon: From the courtyard, the fountain and boxwood hedges are under a half-cloudy sky, much like the hotel's own photos.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day colours the Týn Church towers while clouds leave the Old Town spires in shade.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the suite living room's tall windows still show the gardens, just with flatter colours than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain keeps the CODA terrace tables unused today, and the red rooftops of Malá Strana look darker and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: During thunderstorms the rooftop terrace is no place to sit, so guests watch lightning over the red rooftops from their room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides Prague Castle from the CODA rooftop today, so the view ends at the nearest red roofs of Malá Strana.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the courtyard's boxwood hedges and on the red roofs beyond, and the rooftop tables stand empty.

phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs low over Malá Strana after midnight, and from the CODA rooftop Prague Castle's long roofline shows above the lit streets.

phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool sits in full sun, and the jungle canopy around it is bright green.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on the terrace with wooden chairs are watching the late sun move across the jungle valley.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, from the Riverfront Pool Villas the valley is dark and stars show above the jungle.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the rice terraces this morning, so the valley changes between sun and shade every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the pool is partly in shade from passing clouds, with the river still clear in the valley below.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, lights are on in the woven wooden pavilion and clouds turn orange over the jungle.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the jungle highlands look darker green, and the Ayung River is still easy to follow from every room.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rice terraces, and the pavilion roofs keep the dining tables dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the valley, and guests in the Riverfront Pool Villas can watch lightning above the jungle from indoors.
phrases.fog_haze: Morning fog fills the valley, so the river is hidden and only the nearest trees show from the terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow in Bali is practically unheard of, but if it were falling, the pool would be the last thing anyone used.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air almost never reaches Bali, but today the infinity pool is quiet and the rice terraces look very clear.

phrases.grey_evening: With the curtains open after midnight in a Riverfront Pool Villa, the Ayung River moves close below under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before the sun comes up, the Frauenkirche towers are just two dark shapes from the high-floor rooms.

phrases.very_cold: Very cold and clear over Munich: the Alps are sharp behind the Old Town, and the private balconies stay empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Munich today, and the private balcony of the Premium Room is only comfortable once the sun drops.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Munich, and the Premium Room balconies are warm enough to sit out facing the Old Town.

phrases.fog_haze: Morning haze over the river blurs the view from the balcony, and the Clérigos Tower is only partly clear.
phrases.snow: White rooftops are a rare sight from the guest room windows, but today snow falls on Porto's terracotta tiles.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the outdoor infinity pool stays empty and the view of the Douro is sharp from inside.
phrases.very_hot: Guests on the pool terrace this afternoon look out over heat-haze on the rooftops to the Douro and the Clérigos Tower.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, guests on the terrace sit by the bistro table and look toward the dark Douro.

phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last glass in the Frida Kahlo suite tonight, you would see the lit Douro riverside under low cloud.

phrases.fog_haze: From the balconies, the sand shows below in the fog, and the Atlantic fades to grey a short way out.

phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day the beach outside the windows is empty, and the hot tub is the only busy outdoor spot.
phrases.very_hot: The sand is very hot today, so most guests are in the oceanfront pool or under the palm trees.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night, the fire pit is lit and a few guests stand with drinks on their balconies.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the balconies, the waves break on the sand below, the far edge of the Atlantic lost in low haze.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a front balcony now, you would see low sun on the Harbour Bridge above the ferry terminal.
