phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the caldera below Imerovigli is still dark, and the heated plunge pool is the warmest place to wait.
phrases.clear_morning: From the open windows of a guest room, Skaros Rock and the volcanic islands are sharp in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the glass-railed terrace, so the two loungers under the grey umbrella are the useful spot.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Since the hotel sits higher than anything else on the caldera edge, guests on the suite terraces see the sunset first.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the outdoor pool on the suite terrace is lit, while the caldera below stays completely dark.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Skaros Rock this morning, so the view from the plunge pool changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the volcanic islands are under patches of cloud and patches of sun, seen from the glass-railed terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the suite terrace now, you would watch the last sun colour the clouds above the caldera.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the dark volcanic stone of the hotel looks darker, and the caldera below is grey too.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the terraces today, so guests use the indoor cave pool under its arched white plaster walls.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the caldera is best watched from inside a guest room, with the windows closed for once.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Aegean today hides the volcanic islands, and Skaros Rock is only a faint shape from the terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Santorini, but if it fell today the heated plunge pool would be the obvious place to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing on the terrace today, which makes the heated plunge pool of the Signature Suite useful.
phrases.very_hot: The air over Imerovigli is very hot today, so most guests stay in their private pools or in the cave pool.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild with cloud over the caldera, and guests are still outside in their terrace plunge pools.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so from the glass-railed terrace the volcanic islands are not visible, only the nearer Skaros Rock.
phrases.late_night: Were you falling asleep in a suite tonight, you might leave the curtain open to the lights along the caldera rim.
phrases.wet_evening: With a last drink in the Signature Suite tonight, you would see rain on the glass and lights along the caldera.
phrases.grey_evening: Were you having a last drink in the Signature Suite now, you would see the caldera's village lights under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the upper-floor rooms look out over dark Rotherbaum rooftops toward the Alster Lakes, with few lights on yet.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop terrace, the tree canopy and the city buildings are in full sunlight, and the amber umbrellas are already open.
phrases.clear_midday: A clear sky over Hamburg means the Alster Lakes show plainly from the upper floors, with no haze in between.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in an upper-floor room now, you would see low sun on the Rotherbaum rooftops and the lake beyond.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the facade and red awnings are lit, and guests sit on the street-level terrace under tall trees and a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds this morning move over the city skyline, but the upper-floor panorama toward the Alster is still mostly open.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the rooftop terrace, the wooden deck goes in and out of sunshine as clouds pass over Hamburg this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights parts of the Alster Lakes between clouds, seen from the upper floors of the hotel.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Alster Lakes look flat from the upper rooms, so the Elyseum indoor pool gets more use.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the amber umbrellas of the rooftop terrace while guests swim indoors in the teal-lit Elyseum pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the upper-floor windows give a wide view of lightning over the Hamburg skyline and the Alster.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Alster Lakes from the upper floors today; only the nearest Rotherbaum rooftops and tree tops can be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the wooden deck of the rooftop terrace, and the rooftops toward the Alster are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold and clear over Hamburg, so the Alster Lakes look sharp from the upper rooms and the rooftop terrace stays empty.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the amber umbrellas of the rooftop terrace give the only shade, with the Alster bright beyond.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Hamburg, with guests still outside on the street-level terrace under the red awnings.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far shore of the Alster is not clear from the upper floors, only the near rooftops.
phrases.late_night: If you came back late to an upper-floor room tonight, you would see shore lights reflected on the Außenalster.
phrases.wet_evening: Finishing a last drink by an upper-floor window now, you would see city lights through the rain toward the Außenalster.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in an upper-floor room now, you would see city lights under cloud around the Außenalster.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the CCTV Headquarters stands as a dark shape in the Premier Room windows, with a clear sky behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun comes through the glass ceiling of the 6th-floor pool, and the CCTV tower is clear from the water.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Premier Room chaise lounges have a sharp view of the CCTV Headquarters across Chaoyang.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the side of the CCTV Headquarters, seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a guest room tonight, you would see the CCTV tower lit blue and city lights around it.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds this morning over Beijing, but the skyline is clear from the suite windows and the CCTV tower stands out.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Premier Room windows, the CCTV Headquarters stands under a partly cloudy afternoon sky across Chaoyang.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud in the last hour of sun, and one side of the CCTV Headquarters turns orange, seen from the Premier Rooms.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky over Beijing today; the CCTV Headquarters is still clear from the suite windows, just without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass ceiling of the 6th-floor pool while guests swim underneath, the CCTV tower blurred beyond it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over Chaoyang, and the CCTV Headquarters appears for a second with each flash, seen from the guest room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Beijing today; from the Premier Room chaise lounges the CCTV Headquarters is a pale outline rather than a sharp shape.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the glass ceiling above the 6th-floor pool, and the water below stays warm for anyone swimming.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold and clear over Beijing, so the CCTV Headquarters shows every edge from the Premier Room chaise lounges.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot over Chaoyang today, so most guests swim under the glass ceiling on the sixth floor instead of walking outside.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night over Chaoyang; the CCTV tower lights show through the guest room windows, no stars above them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Beijing today; the CCTV Headquarters still shows from the Premier Rooms, but the far skyline does not.
phrases.late_night: Were you in a Premier Room tonight, you could leave the curtain open and fall asleep facing the angled CCTV tower.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were finishing a last drink in a Premier Room, you would see the CCTV Headquarters through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in a Premier Room now, you would see the CCTV loop against city lights under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before sunrise, the sky over Baa Atoll is already clear and the lagoon below the villa decks is black.
phrases.clear_morning: From an overwater villa deck, the lagoon is already bright turquoise this morning, and the hammock net is in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the hammock net between the deck posts hangs above the pale turquoise lagoon of Baa Atoll.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on the overwater bar terrace are watching the sun drop toward the lagoon, cocktails in hand, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: If you were lying in the hammock net tonight, you would see a clear sky above and resort lights across the lagoon.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Baa Atoll this morning, so the lagoon below the overwater villas changes between bright and dull turquoise.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the swing sofa on the villa deck moves in and out of cloud shadow while the lagoon stays calm.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the lagoon turn orange, which guests at the overwater bar terrace can see directly.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the lagoon around the water villas looks pale green rather than turquoise, and the decks are cooler.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the thatched roofs and the lagoon at once, and the teak dining tables on the decks are wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Baa Atoll, so the hammock nets are empty and guests are watching the lightning from inside their villas.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the lagoon today hides the horizon, though the turquoise water just below the villa deck is still clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is not a thing in Baa Atoll, but if it fell today the thatched roofs of the villas would turn white.
phrases.very_cold: A freezing day in the Maldives would be a first, and the lap pools beside the overwater villas would be empty.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot over the lagoon today, so the shaded poolside seats and the villa lap pools are both in use.
phrases.mild_night: On this warm cloudy night the overwater bar terrace is lit, but there are no stars above the lagoon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the far side of Baa Atoll cannot be seen from the villa decks, only the turquoise water close by.
phrases.late_night: Anyone who wakes thirsty tonight in an overwater villa sees resort lights across the lagoon.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the overwater villas are likely in bed now, rain falling on the lagoon and the resort lights across the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in an overwater villa after midnight would see the resort lights on the lagoon under a hazy sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests on the Bellevue Suite balcony see a dark, calm lake, with the Jet d'Eau directly across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: On a clear morning like this one, the Jet d'Eau stands out sharply against blue sky from the lake-view rooms.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the lake, and the Jet d'Eau is bright white from the Presidential Suite balcony.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the Bellevue Suite balcony now, afternoon tea would come with the Jet d'Eau in low golden sunlight.
phrases.clear_night: Clear night in Geneva, and guests end the evening in the Leopard Bar with vintage spirits and a cigar.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over Lake Geneva this morning, but the Jet d'Eau is clearly visible from the lake-facing rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on the Bellevue Suite balcony this afternoon, you would see the Jet d'Eau under a partly cloudy sky.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds color the sky behind the Jet d'Eau as seen from the Bellevue Suite balcony.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Geneva today, so the lake looks grey too, though the Jet d'Eau still shows from the suite balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain on Lake Geneva right now, and guests watch it from behind the balcony windows of the suites rather than outside.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is passing over Lake Geneva, and the private balconies of the suites are empty while guests stay inside.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the lake today, and from the Bellevue Suite the Jet d'Eau is hard to see across the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Geneva, and the balcony of the Presidential Suite has a white layer, with the Jet d'Eau beyond it.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold over Lake Geneva today, and a look at the Jet d'Eau from the suite balcony is a short one.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Geneva today, and the spray of the Jet d'Eau across the water looks tempting from the lake-view rooms.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Geneva, and the Leopard Bar is where guests finish the evening with a cigar.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over the lake, so the mountains usually seen from the suite windows are not visible, only the near water.
phrases.late_night: Sleep makes sense in the Bellevue Suite now, with shore lights on the lake; at dawn the window holds the Jet d'Eau.
phrases.wet_evening: Before bed the curtain is open in the Bellevue Suite, and rain blurs the lights across the water around the Jet d'Eau.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open in the Bellevue Suite, the shore lights across the water show under cloud where the Jet d'Eau rises by day.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Eiffel Tower and the Arc de Triomphe appear as dark shapes from the upper balconies under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: On the terrace, the rattan chairs and set tables sit in clear morning sun, with Haussmann facades opposite.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the Eiffel Tower and the Arc de Triomphe are sharp in daylight from the lounge chairs on a suite balcony.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Haussmann facades opposite the curved windows, and the balconies get the lowest sun of the day.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a balcony tonight, you would see the Arc de Triomphe lit below and the Eiffel Tower lit gold.
phrases.partly_morning: Through the tall rounded room windows this morning, broken cloud moves over the Haussmann facades opposite.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun move across the Arc de Triomphe this afternoon, and the Eiffel Tower stays visible from the upper terraces.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, from the suite balconies, broken cloud puts the Eiffel Tower in and out of shade.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Paris today, and the Arc de Triomphe looks flat and pale from the upper balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the balcony bistro tables, so guests are watching the Haussmann facades from behind the curved windows instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, the terraces and balconies empty out, and lightning over Paris can be seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Eiffel Tower today, and from the balconies only the nearer Arc de Triomphe is a faint shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the rattan chairs of the terrace, and the Arc de Triomphe shows white on top from the balconies.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing on the balconies today, so the lounge chairs are empty, though the Eiffel Tower is perfectly clear.
phrases.very_hot: On a hot afternoon, the lounge chairs on the balcony are in full sun, and the Arc de Triomphe is bright below.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night: guests sit at the small bistro tables on the balconies while the Eiffel Tower stays lit.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Eiffel Tower is a dim outline from the balconies, while the Arc de Triomphe remains clear.
phrases.late_night: Guests up late in upper-floor suites watch the Arc and Eiffel Tower over city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Upper-floor guests watch evening rain on the glass, Arc and Eiffel Tower in one frame.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has an upper-floor suite tonight sees both the Tower and the Arc in one frame, city lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Royal Dramatic Theatre across Nybroviken is already a dark shape from the Sea Salon suites.
phrases.clear_morning: Sun on the bay this morning, and from the rooftop terrace the ferries at the quay are easy to count.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the lobby's floor-to-ceiling windows show the waterfront in full sun, no clouds anywhere over Stockholm.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the historic spires beyond the rooftop terrace, and Djurgården island takes on a warm colour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a Tower suite tonight, you would look over Nybroviken under a clear, starry Stockholm sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Nybroviken this morning, and the sea view rooms get sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the suite dining area, the tall windows frame a bay that is half in sun and half under cloud.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over Djurgården island are easy to watch from the rooftop terrace sofas.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Stockholm today, yet the Royal Dramatic Theatre beyond Nybroviken stays plainly visible from the Sea Salon suites.
phrases.rain: Rain on Nybroviken, and the red velvet sofas in the lobby face a wet waterfront through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the bay; the rooftop terrace is empty and guests watch the lightning from the suite windows instead.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Nybroviken today, and from the Tower suites the Royal Dramatic Theatre is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the ferries at the quay, seen from a warm room under a crystal chandelier.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold over Stockholm today; the rooftop terrace is quiet and guests watch the bay from the sea view rooms.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day for Stockholm, and the cream umbrellas on the rooftop terrace are the only shade over the marina view.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night on Nybrokajen, and the rooftop terrace lounge seating is still usable after dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Djurgården island is not clear from the rooftop terrace, though the ferries at the quay are.
phrases.late_night: Quay lights shine on the water of Nybroviken after midnight, outside the Sea Salon suites.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner tonight, rain runs down the Sea Salon suite windows and the quay lights blur across Nybroviken.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, cloud covers Nybroviken, and the quay lights show in the water from the Sea Salon suite windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea-view balconies look out on a dark Atlantic, with a few lights still on along the Funchal hillside.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, Funchal Bay lies flat and blue below the three sundeck terraces on the cliff.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the curved pool, and most guests have moved under the taupe umbrellas.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light comes in low through the floor-to-ceiling windows of Il Gallo d'Oro, straight off Funchal Bay.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see a clear sky over Funchal Bay from the restaurant windows, stars included.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are passing over the Atlantic this morning, so the sea platform at the cliff base switches between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the cliffside hot tub, the view this afternoon is blue sea with white clouds moving slowly above it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun is lighting the volcanic rock below the terraces, with some cloud between the hotel and the horizon.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Funchal Bay today, and the Atlantic seen from the balconies is grey too, flat and calm.
phrases.rain: From the floor-to-ceiling windows of Il Gallo d'Oro, Funchal Bay lies grey under steady rain beyond the sundeck terraces.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Atlantic, visible from the sea-view balconies; nobody is on the sea platform at the cliff base.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Funchal Bay today, and from the Il Gallo d'Oro windows the far shore is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Funchal, but if it did, you would watch it fall past the balconies toward the Atlantic.
phrases.very_cold: Guests at the Il Gallo d'Oro windows this morning look across Funchal Bay, with the sundeck loungers empty in the cold.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today on the promontory; the shade under the parasols on the lowest terrace is the most wanted spot.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and dinner continues on the terrace beside the flowering tree, the ocean dark beyond the gardens.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is reduced today: the sea just below the terraces is clear, but the far side of Funchal Bay cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the sea-view rooms are asleep now, and the town lights above Funchal Bay will turn into the open bay at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in a sea-view room after midnight watches rain run down the glass, Funchal's lights blurred across the bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a sea-view room after midnight watches low cloud pass over Funchal Bay, the hillside town lights under it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies over Al Bateen Marina look onto still yachts and the lit towers of Abu Dhabi.
phrases.clear_morning: From the fitness centre treadmills, early runners face a clear sky over the marina and white boats in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the pool umbrellas are the busiest spots, with the city skyline sharp under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun lights the marina water orange below the waterfront dining terrace, where the first tables are being set.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see yachts and city lights on the water from your balcony, curtains open.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered morning clouds pass over the marina while guests in the twin rooms look down at the packed white boats.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the clouds give the pool loungers some shade now and then, with the skyline still visible between them.
phrases.partly_golden: On the Annex rooftop, the last hour of sun colours the clouds over the Abu Dhabi skyline orange.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Abu Dhabi today, and from the twin room windows the marina boats and towers appear in flat light.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare here, so guests at the suite windows mostly just watch it fall on the yachts in the marina.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Arabian Gulf is visible from the waterfront dining terrace, where the rattan chairs stand empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Abu Dhabi today softens the skyline, so from the balconies the nearest yachts are the clearest things in view.
phrases.snow: If you stood on your balcony now, you would see snow falling past the lit towers over Al Bateen Marina.
phrases.very_cold: A clear but very cold day for Abu Dhabi, so most guests take the marina view through the fitness centre windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot by the pool this afternoon, so guests are either in the water or under the umbrellas, skyline in full sun.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars on this mild night, but from the lantern-lit balconies the yachts and lit towers stay easy to see.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balconies the yachts in the marina are clear but the far skyline towers are not.
phrases.late_night: If you were asleep in a marina suite, you would wake at dawn to yachts and the skyline across the water.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in your suite tonight, you would see rain on the glass and the lit marina.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were on the Annex rooftop with a last drink, you would see city lights on the marina under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Stromboli is a dark shape across the Tyrrhenian, seen from any of the 27 room terraces.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the vineyard rows, and from the pool both Panarea and Stromboli show clearly across the sea.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the white pergola under the lemon trees gives real shade, while the sea beyond stays bright blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the restaurant terrace, Stromboli and Panarea stand clear across the Tyrrhenian in the low late-afternoon sun.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your room terrace tonight, you would probably see Stromboli's eruptions glowing across the dark water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Panarea this morning, but from the restaurant terrace the island stays visible between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on sun loungers by the pool watch cloud shadows move slowly across the Tyrrhenian toward Lipari.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the lighthouse lantern room from the side, with broken clouds above the sea.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Stromboli and Panarea look flat and far, though the vineyard rows around the terraces stay green.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the vines and the pool, so guests sit under the reed ceiling of the terrace with the egg chair.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Tyrrhenian is easy to follow from a room terrace, with Stromboli sometimes showing for a second.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides Panarea and Stromboli today, and from the rooftop terrace only the nearby lighthouse and the sea are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on Salina, but if it fell today the vineyard rows below the terraces would turn briefly white.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Salina leaves the pool area empty, though Stromboli looks sharp from the room terraces.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the vineyard, and the shaded pergola under the lemon trees is the busiest place at the resort.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night keeps guests on the restaurant terrace late, though Stromboli's glow stays hidden behind the cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so Stromboli and Panarea cannot be seen from the pool, only the sea just offshore.
phrases.late_night: The curtain is left open on purpose, so any flash from Stromboli over the sea is the last thing seen before sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the room windows after midnight, and the curtains are open on the wet terraces and the sea toward Stromboli.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open after midnight, the room terraces face a hazy Tyrrhenian, and tonight's cloud hides Stromboli's glow.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the ocean-facing rooms, a clear sky before sunrise shows the first pale light over Haystack Rock and the beach.
phrases.clear_morning: From a balcony table, the beach and Haystack Rock are fully visible this morning under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the water, and The Needles stand out clearly next to Haystack Rock.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a higher floor now, you would watch the late sun change the colour of Haystack Rock.
phrases.clear_night: Clear night over the ocean: guests in the king rooms sit by the fireplace, the water dark beyond the window.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the beach this morning, and from the sliding doors Haystack Rock is still easy to see.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, cloud shadows move across the sand below the balconies while sunlight comes and goes on Haystack Rock.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, gaps in the cloud let orange light reach Haystack Rock in front of the ocean rooms.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Cannon Beach today, but Haystack Rock and the shoreline remain plainly visible from the ocean-facing rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Cannon Beach today, so the spa's warm indoor pool is busier than the balconies facing Haystack Rock.
phrases.thunderstorm: In a thunderstorm nobody sits on the balconies, but the room windows still show Haystack Rock above rough water.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the beach today, and Haystack Rock appears only as a faint outline from the upper rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare at Cannon Beach, but today white flakes fall on the sand in front of the ocean-facing rooms.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing on the beach today, so the balconies stay empty and Haystack Rock is watched through the window.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day for the Oregon coast; the sliding doors are open and the sea breeze reaches the room.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests sit out on the private balconies and listen to the ocean they cannot really see.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Haystack Rock is only a blur from the rooms and The Needles cannot be made out.
phrases.late_night: Around one, a sip of water, and white surf rolls past the windows toward Haystack Rock.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtain is open in an ocean-view room, and rain on the window blurs the shape of Haystack Rock to the south.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain stays open after midnight, low cloud over the beach toward Haystack Rock.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the river-facing rooms look out on a dark Thames with Big Ben still lit on the left.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the suite terraces above the Thames give a direct view of Westminster Bridge and the London Eye.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the Thames, and from the room desks the Houses of Parliament stand out clearly.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the stone of Big Ben, seen from the balconies over the river on the left.
phrases.clear_night: If you were eating at Chino Latino tonight, you would see the London Eye lit up above the dark river.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Westminster this morning, and from the river-facing rooms Big Ben moves in and out of sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A mix of sun and cloud sits over the Thames, and the London Eye on the right is sunlit between clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over Lambeth Bridge turns orange, seen from the suites' private outdoor areas.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers London today, but the Houses of Parliament and Big Ben are still easy to see from the river-facing rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Thames and Westminster Bridge today, and the suite terraces are empty while guests watch from the room desks.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the river-facing rooms give a dry view of lightning over the Houses of Parliament and the Thames.
phrases.fog_haze: Thick fog over the Thames today means the balconies still show Lambeth Bridge, while the London Eye stays hidden.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Westminster Bridge and the Thames, while the heated indoor pool stays warm behind its large windows.
phrases.very_cold: From the empty suite terrace above the Thames, hard winter light falls on the London Eye to the right.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot London day, the private outdoor areas of the suites get full sun, and the Thames below looks still.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests at Chino Latino have the lit London Eye in view along the river.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor, so the Thames and Lambeth Bridge show from the rooms but the London Eye is hard to make out.
phrases.late_night: Back from dinner at Chino Latino, you would see city lights on the Thames and the London Eye to the right.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in a river room tonight, rain would blur the London Eye across the Thames.
phrases.grey_evening: Finishing a last drink in a river-facing room now, you would see the Eye's wheel across the lit Thames under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Nile below the tower is a dark surface, with Cairo Tower still lit against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast guests on the upper floors can already count feluccas trailing white wakes under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong, and the outdoor pool on the river-facing side gets bright reflected light from the Nile.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Nile very bright, and Gezira Island's canopy looks dark against it from the Nile-view rooms.
phrases.clear_night: After midnight under a clear sky, the Nile below the tower carries the lights of Qasr El Nil Bridge and Cairo Tower.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Cairo this morning, and the Nile changes between grey and bright below the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on the Water Garden terrace this afternoon, you would get cloud shade for a few minutes at a time.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds throw patches of shadow on Gezira Island, visible from the rooftop plunge pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the Nile looks flat and dull, but the feluccas still cross it below the tower windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Cairo, so guests at the floor-to-ceiling windows are watching a wet Qasr El Nil Bridge with some interest.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm over the city means the outdoor pool is empty, and lightning over Gezira Island is watched from indoors.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Cairo today, so from the guest rooms the Nile is clear but Cairo Tower is only a soft outline.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Cairo, which almost never happens, and guests in the indoor pool watch it come down over the Nile.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing today in Cairo, so the Water Garden terrace is quiet and the spa is the busier choice.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot across Cairo today, and the rooftop suite's private plunge pool is the most useful thing in the building.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over Cairo, and the Nile still carries the lights of both banks under the tower.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today; from the rooms the Nile and Qasr El Nil Bridge are clear, but the far skyline is not.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight a glass of water takes a minute, and the Nile-view rooms have both banks' lights on the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Nile-view room windows after midnight, and the lights along the Gezira bank blur on the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze sits over Cairo after midnight, and the Nile-view suites show softened bridge lights along the river.

phrases.clear_predawn: In the dark before sunrise, the suite linking the two Nation Towers shows Corniche lights with the Gulf still black.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Corniche room, the morning sun lights the Grand Mosque while the Gulf shows its clear turquoise colour.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the private beach cabanas are the shaded spot, and the water in front of them is at its brightest.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were at the Azura Panoramic Lounge now, you would watch the sun go down over the Abu Dhabi skyline.
phrases.clear_night: Night in the bridge suite means city lights on all sides, and the Grand Mosque is lit up in the distance.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit over the Gulf this morning, seen through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the bedrooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over Marina Mall this afternoon while guests at the beachfront dining tables sit in woven chairs facing the water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day reaches the geodesic dome on the beach, where a table for two is set.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Abu Dhabi today, so the Gulf looks flat and grey from the Corniche rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare here, and today it is falling on the Corniche, best seen from behind the bedroom windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Gulf gives the bridge suite a 360-degree view of lightning, while the beach cabanas stand empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the city today, and the Grand Mosque is only a faint outline from the upper floors.
phrases.snow: Through the floor-to-ceiling windows of a Corniche room, snow falls over the Gulf water and Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold for Abu Dhabi today, and the beachfront dining tables with woven chairs stay empty below the Corniche rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside today, so the shade of the beach cabanas matters more than the view of Marina Mall.
phrases.mild_night: A warm, cloudy night, and guests at the Azura Panoramic Lounge see the Corniche lights but no stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Corniche rooms the Grand Mosque is not visible, only the nearby waterfront.
phrases.late_night: Hours after a last drink at Azura, the bedroom's floor-to-ceiling windows frame the Corniche lights along the water after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Bridge Suite glass after midnight, and the Corniche lights blur wet and gold before the curtains close.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtains are open before bed in the bridge suite, and the city lights spread along the Corniche under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Diamond Head shows only as a dark shape from the balconies on floors 19 to 23.
phrases.clear_morning: From the eighth-floor infinity pool, early swimmers have a clear look at the Pacific and the Waikiki shoreline.
phrases.clear_midday: If you stood at a window on the 19th floor now, you would see Diamond Head sharp under the clear midday sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the Pacific orange outside the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites, with Diamond Head to one side.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the cabanas by the rooftop pool are lit, and the Honolulu skyline and the mountains stand out under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Diamond Head this morning, seen from the balconies of the Deluxe Ocean View rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in the hot tub this afternoon, you would see clouds moving above the Waikiki shoreline.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Pacific turn orange and violet outside the suite windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific looks flat and grey from the infinity pool, and Diamond Head is still easy to see.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Waikiki Beach right now, and guests on floors 19 to 23 watch it from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, lightning over the Pacific can be seen from the Deluxe Ocean View rooms, while the pool terrace is empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Honolulu blurs the outline of Diamond Head today, though the Waikiki shoreline is still visible from the pool.
phrases.snow: Snow this close to Waikiki Beach is almost unheard of, and the eighth-floor hot tub is where most guests are.
phrases.very_cold: Cold weather like this is rare in Honolulu, and the hot tub on the eighth floor has the Pacific in view.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day the infinity lap pool on the eighth floor is the obvious place to look at the Pacific.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the lit cabanas and the city skyline are clear from the rooftop pool.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Diamond Head is mostly hidden today from the eighth-floor pool terrace, though the nearby Waikiki shoreline remains sharp.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and Deluxe Ocean View windows show the shoreline lights of Waikiki Beach toward Diamond Head.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Umi, rain runs down the glass of the Deluxe Ocean View rooms, and the Waikiki shoreline lights blur through it.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Umi, the Deluxe Ocean View rooms have the Waikiki shoreline lights under low cloud, out toward Diamond Head.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is still dark from every balcony, and the coastal road below carries almost no cars.
phrases.clear_morning: From any of the 101 balconies this morning, the ocean is flat and blue under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the pool, and most guests have moved to the loungers under the palms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a Junior Suite balcony now, you would see the low sun lighting the Atlantic in front of you.
phrases.clear_night: From the seasonal rooftop bar tonight, the ocean is black and the clear sky above it shows plenty of stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are passing over Cascais this morning, so the sea seen from the balconies changes between grey and blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud shade crosses the pool this afternoon, which the guests on the grey loungers do not seem to mind.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the broken clouds over the Atlantic turn orange, best watched from any of the balconies.
phrases.overcast: Under a low grey sky, the Atlantic beyond the coastal road lies flat and grey below the balconies at Guia.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Guia coast, so guests are eating behind the glass walls of the restaurant instead of outside.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm the balconies are empty, and lightning over the Atlantic is visible from inside the rooms through the glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Sea fog has reached the coast today, and from the balconies the Atlantic is more heard than seen.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Cascais, but if it did, the pool loungers and palms would carry a thin white layer.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing on the balconies today, so the Atlantic view is mostly taken from behind closed glass doors.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon like this, the pool is the busiest spot in the hotel and the balconies the quietest.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night like this, the balconies stay in use late, with the ocean dark but audible below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the balconies, the coastal road, the pool and the nearest Atlantic water show today, but the horizon does not.

phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the balcony glass of the Junior Suites, and the lights along the coastal road shine through it.
phrases.grey_evening: Back in the suite after the meal, the coast road lights show under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the ocean-facing balconies look out on a dark Atlantic with a thin pale band at the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: From an oceanview king room, the Atlantic is bright blue this morning and the beach below has only a few early walkers.
phrases.clear_midday: The eight poolside cabanas offer shade on the brick deck at noon, with the Atlantic very bright beyond the palm trees.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the pool deck and palm trees, and the Azure terrace opens for dinner with the beach in view.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars over the Atlantic from your balcony and the fire pit terrace lit below.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the Intracoastal Waterway this morning, visible from the waterway-side balconies while breakfast is served at Azure.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the beach this afternoon, so the pool deck changes between shade and sun every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds turn pink above the Atlantic, seen from the Tiki Hut by the pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic looks grey too, and most guests at Azure sit indoors rather than on the terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the pool deck and the empty cabanas, while guests watch the beach through the wide room windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you stood on your ocean-facing balcony now, you would see lightning flash over the Atlantic as a thunderstorm passes.
phrases.fog_haze: Sea haze hides the far end of the beach today, and from the balconies the Atlantic fades into grey.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unheard of in Daytona Beach, yet today a few flakes fall past the balconies toward the empty pool deck.
phrases.very_cold: Cold air keeps the pool deck and cabanas empty today, and the Atlantic is seen mostly from behind room windows.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the beach today, so the shaded cabanas and the Tiki Hut have more guests than the sand.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild under clouds, and the beachfront fire pit terrace has a few guests facing the dark Atlantic.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the balconies today, the horizon line is not visible and the far end of the beach looks blurred.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the oceanview kings are falling asleep now, facing the Atlantic, the drapes pulled back so the pool lights show.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the ocean-view rooms probably see rain on the window now, and the Atlantic breaking white along the beach.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has an ocean-view room tonight sees low cloud over the Atlantic and the pool lamps along the shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlas peaks show as a dark line beyond the palms, seen from the pool terrace.
phrases.clear_morning: From a garden-facing room, the morning sun lights the olive trees and the mountain slopes behind them.
phrases.clear_midday: Golfers on the fairways play toward the Atlas Mountains under a sky with no cloud in it anywhere.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a guest room balcony now, you would see the golf course and the Atlas turn orange.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the mountains today, so the view from the pool terrace stops at the nearest palms.
phrases.snow: Snow in the Palmeraie is rare, but today it falls on the golf course while the villa fireplaces burn.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day like this, the snow on the Atlas peaks looks close from the terrace lounge chairs.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot this afternoon, so the four outdoor pools are busy and the olive trees give the only shade.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy, mild night sky, the Moroccan lanterns on the dining terrace are the main source of light.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, and the Atlas Mountains cannot be seen from the pool terrace, only the palms nearby.
phrases.late_night: Late tonight, stars fill the southern sky above the Atlas from the garden-facing villas.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the pool-facing room windows after midnight, and low cloud hides the Atlas.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the Atlas tonight, and only the terrace lanterns show between the palms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, N Seoul Tower is still lit on Namsan hill, seen from the upper-floor rooms of the Executive Tower.

phrases.very_hot: Very hot over Myeongdong today, and the high-rises shimmer slightly in the heat when seen from the upper rooms.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night over Seoul, with N Seoul Tower lit under the clouds and the Myeongdong high-rises lit as well.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the upper rooms the nearby high-rises are clear but N Seoul Tower is not in view.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water sits on the suite bedside, and N Seoul Tower stands out above the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the suite's large window after midnight, and the lit high-rises of Myeongdong blur out toward Namsan and N Seoul Tower.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud passes over the tower on Namsan, seen from the suite window, while Myeongdong's lights show beneath.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Mayacamas ridge is a dark line behind the vines, and the balcony tubs are still empty.

phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the balcony fire pits are lit above the dark Beringer vines.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the nearest vine rows are clear, but the Mayacamas ridge is only a faint shape.

phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the Vineyard View suites after midnight watches rain run down the glass above the Beringer vines.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a Balcony Vineyard View suite after midnight sees low cloud over the valley, the pool lights hazy under it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Andaman is a dark flat line past the lawn, and the main pool is still empty.

phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the lawn, so most guests swim in the main pool and watch the Andaman from the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the lawn now, you would watch the sun go down over the Andaman across open grass.

phrases.late_night: Awake near midnight for a glass of water, you would see the Andaman between the villa's pines.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in a beachfront villa tonight, you would hear rain on the roof and see it streak the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Were you up for a last drink in a beachfront villa, you would see cloud over the Andaman and hear the sea.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Nile under the Corniche Suite terraces is still dark, and Cairo Tower stands against a slowly lightening sky.

phrases.clear_midday: At midday the spa treatment rooms look out on a bright Nile and Cairo Tower under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Presidential Suites on floors 25 to 28, the Pyramids show as a small shape on the western horizon this afternoon.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Cairo skyline this afternoon, seen through the arched windows of the restaurant.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds over Gezira Island turn orange as the sun drops, and the Nile under the terraces takes the same colour.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Cairo today, so the river and Cairo Tower look flat and dull from the guest room windows.

phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Nile is unusual here, and the indoor pool is the obvious place to be for the next hour.
phrases.fog_haze: Morning haze hangs over the river, and from the balconies the Cairo skyline is only a soft grey outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Cairo, which almost never happens, and guests photograph it from the terraces above the Nile.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold for Cairo, the teak terraces stay empty and guests watch the Nile from inside their rooms.
phrases.very_hot: The Cairo afternoon is very hot, and the two outdoor pools are busier than the private suite terraces.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests eat behind the arched restaurant windows with the dark Nile directly outside.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Presidential Suites the Pyramids cannot be seen, only the river and Gezira Island nearby.
phrases.late_night: City lights lie on the Nile below the Corniche Suites after midnight, and at dawn the same window shows Gezira Island.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the Corniche Suite glass, and the Nile below shows the lights of Gezira Island.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner, the Corniche Suite window shows city lights on the Nile under low cloud, Cairo Tower across on Gezira Island.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Positano and the Li Galli islands are only outlines from the villa terraces, and the sea is still dark.
phrases.clear_morning: From a villa balcony, the morning sun reaches Positano's houses first, then the water and the anchored boats below.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun on the clifftop terrace means the turquoise umbrellas are in use, and the Li Galli islands are sharp.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the cliffs around Positano, and guests on the largest villa terraces have the clearest view of it.
