phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the sea below the striped loungers changes colour each time a cloud moves off the sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights some of Positano's cliffs and leaves others in cloud shadow, seen from the lounge windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Mediterranean looks grey too, but the Li Galli islands are still clearly visible from every villa.
phrases.rain: Rain on the Amalfi Coast keeps guests in the lounge with the draped curtains, watching the wet pine trees and the sea.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the sea is best watched from a villa bedroom, where lightning shows over Positano and thunder follows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Li Galli islands today, so the view from the terraces stops at the nearest boats and cliffs.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Positano, but today white flakes fall past the balconies and melt as soon as they touch the sea.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day the alfresco gym is empty, and guests watch the Positano hillside from inside the villas.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over the coast makes the plunge pools the most used spaces, with Positano in full sun behind.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night keeps guests out on the seaside terrace, among the potted cacti, long after dinner.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the terraces show the sea and the nearest cliffs, but not the Li Galli islands.
phrases.late_night: Lights off in a villa bedroom at two in the morning, the only glow left comes from the houses of Positano.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the lounge windows this evening, and the house lights of Positano look blurred across the hillside.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low cloud this evening, the village lights of Positano are clear from the lounge, down the hillside to the sea.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, upper-floor rooms face a dark Pacific to the south, with the Ko'olau range only a black outline.
phrases.clear_morning: From a corner room, Diamond Head and the Ala Wai harbor are sharp and clear in the morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: The Sky Deck lap pool on the 8th floor gets full sun now, and the palms beside it give little shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in an upper room now, the low sun would light the Ko'olau range while the Pacific stays bright.
phrases.clear_night: At night, the floor-to-ceiling windows show the Honolulu cityscape lit below and a clear sky above the Pacific.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit over the Ko'olau range this morning, while the ocean side of the tower is still in sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, guests at the poolside bar on the Sky Deck watch clouds pass between the palms and the tower glass.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over Diamond Head show from the corner rooms, and the harbor darkens slowly.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific from the 39th floor looks flat and pale, and the Ko'olau range is a dull green.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Ko'olau range to the northeast is half hidden in low cloud.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, lightning over the Pacific is easiest to see from the upper rooms, behind the full-height glass.
phrases.fog_haze: In haze, Diamond Head from the corner rooms is only a faint outline, while the nearer Ala Wai harbor stays clearer.
phrases.snow: If snow ever fell on Honolulu, the deep soaking tubs in the rooms would be the warmest place to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare cold Honolulu day, the heated lap pool on the Sky Deck is warmer than the air around it.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, so the two whirlpools and the lap pool on the 8th floor are busier than the poolside bar.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night, the Honolulu cityscape below the windows is clearer than the sky, which shows no stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so Diamond Head is faint from the corner rooms and the far Pacific horizon is not visible.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight in a corner room, a glass of water comes with the Ala Wai harbor lights in the window.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtains are open in the king rooms tonight, and Honolulu's lights blur through rain on the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtains stay open in the corner rooms tonight, and the Ala Wai harbor lights show under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the cathedral towers below the terrace are dark shapes, and the city lights of Lyon are still on.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Medici Suite terrace, the cathedral façade and the terracotta roofs of Old Lyon are sharp in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Market umbrellas on the rooftop terrace give shade, while the Part-Dieu towers stand clearly behind the terracotta rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun turns the Old Lyon rooftops a deeper orange when seen from the heated panoramic pool.
phrases.clear_night: Dinner guests in the glass-enclosed verrière look down on Lyon Cathedral lit up at night, with the city lights beyond.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Lyon, and the cathedral below the rooftop terrace is in shadow one minute and sunlit the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the terracotta rooftops this afternoon, and from the rooftop terrace the Part-Dieu skyscrapers are still easy to see.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the Medici Suite terrace now, you would see the last sun on the cathedral façade between broken clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Old Lyon rooftops below the verrière look flat and brown rather than orange.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Lyon, and the glass-enclosed verrière keeps diners dry while the cathedral below gets wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm sits over Lyon, and from the verrière guests watch lightning above the Old Lyon rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers Lyon today, so the Part-Dieu skyscrapers are faint from the rooftop terrace, though the cathedral stays visible.
phrases.snow: Guests in the glass verrière tonight look down on Lyon Cathedral, lit below, as snow falls on the Old Lyon rooftops.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold on Fourvière Hill, and most guests view the cathedral from inside the verrière rather than the terrace.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the market umbrellas on the rooftop terrace get more use than the lounge chairs in the sun.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night over Lyon, and from the terrace the lit cathedral shows well without any stars above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the rooftop pool, daytime haze hides the Part-Dieu towers beyond the cathedral and the Old Lyon roofs.
phrases.late_night: With the lights off in the Medici Suite after midnight, the only glow in the room comes from Old Lyon below.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtain open past midnight in the Medici Suite, rain runs down the glass and Old Lyon's wet rooftops shine below the cathedral.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtains open in the Medici Suite after midnight, the lights of Old Lyon spread below under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Golden Gate Bridge lights are still on, and Bay View King guests can see them across the dark water.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Alcatraz Suite, the island and the bridge are both sharp this morning, with no fog over the bay.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the tall-masted ships at Hyde Street Pier stand in full sun, seen from the bay-side room windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun falls on the Marin Headlands behind the Golden Gate Bridge, a view the Argonaut One-Bedroom Suite faces directly.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Alcatraz Suite tonight, you would see the bridge lights and the dark shape of Alcatraz Island.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the bay this morning, so the Golden Gate Bridge moves in and out of shadow from the room windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud, some sun over San Francisco Bay this afternoon, and the red tugboat at Hyde Street Pier is easy to spot.
phrases.partly_golden: From the bay-side suite windows, low sun lights the Golden Gate Bridge under scattered cloud, with Alcatraz dark on the water.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the whole bay today, but Alcatraz Island is still clearly visible from the Bay View King rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Fisherman's Wharf, and the room windows show a wet pier and a grey San Francisco Bay.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the bay is rare here, and guests in the bay-side rooms can watch lightning beyond the Golden Gate Bridge.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has come through the Golden Gate today, so from the suites the bridge towers are only partly visible.
phrases.snow: Snow in San Francisco is almost unheard of, but today a few flakes fall past the windows facing Aquatic Park Cove.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Bay View King rooms this morning look across hard winter light on the water to the Golden Gate Bridge.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day by San Francisco standards, and the water of Aquatic Park Cove looks tempting from the bay-side windows.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and the Golden Gate Bridge lights show clearly from the Argonaut One-Bedroom Suite.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooms Alcatraz Island is faint and the Marin Headlands behind the bridge are not visible.
phrases.late_night: From the Alcatraz Suite, bay lights and the Golden Gate towers are easy to watch past two.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at the Blue Mermaid, tonight's rain blurs the bridge towers from the Alcatraz Suite.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at the Blue Mermaid, the Alcatraz Suite window shows pier lights on the bay under cloud toward the Golden Gate.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Indian Ocean below the cliff is still dark, and the infinity pool deck is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From the terrace of the One Bedroom Ocean View Suite, the whole coastline is sharp under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The funicular is taking guests down to Sundays Beach Club, where the umbrellas are the only shade at noon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the green cliffs above the beach cove, seen from the sun loungers on the oceanfront deck.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the suite tonight, you would see stars over the ocean from your private pool.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Indian Ocean this morning, and guests on the deck are choosing loungers early.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Down at Sundays Beach Club, the turquoise bean bags are half in cloud shadow, half in afternoon sun.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds break up the last sunlight over the sea, which looks orange and grey from the cliff-edge suite terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the ocean below the cliff loses its turquoise colour, and the infinity pool looks grey too.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the oceanfront deck, so the loungers stay empty and the private beach below is quiet today.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the clifftop suite, lightning over the Indian Ocean lights the private beach cove below in short white flashes.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far horizon today, and from the cliff edge only the nearest water and the cove are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Bali, so any flakes over the clifftop pools today would be a rare sight for guests.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air is unusual on this clifftop, but the view of the Indian Ocean from the suite terrace is unchanged.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the cliff today, and most guests are in the infinity pool or in the sea below.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night, guests in the suite can hear the sea below the cliff but cannot see much of it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the oceanfront deck the sea has no clear horizon and the far coast is hidden.
phrases.late_night: Past one, the Ocean View Suite's light stays on, the Indian Ocean sounding below.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the Ocean View Suite window tonight, and its pool light shakes under the drops.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, cloud moves over the Indian Ocean and waves break white under the Ocean View Suite.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Great Pyramid is a dark triangle against a clear sky from the Premium Pyramid View rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: On the breakfast balcony, both pyramids stand sharp through the arched railing, with clear sky above the plateau.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Great Pyramid stands in full sun behind the palm-lined gardens and the outdoor pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the stones of Khufu's pyramid orange, seen from the terrace beyond the palm trees.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at the 139 Pavilion bar tonight, you would see both pyramids as dark shapes under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Giza plateau this morning, and the pyramids change from grey to bright as seen from the balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pool, the Great Pyramid sits under a half-clouded sky, with palm trees in front of it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds above the Great Pyramid, framed in the restaurant's arched window.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Giza today, and the Great Pyramid looks flat and pale from the Premium Pyramid View rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain in Cairo is rare, but today it falls on the gardens, and the pyramids still show through it from the balconies.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Giza plateau is unusual, and guests in the restaurant can watch it behind the Great Pyramid.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Giza today, so the Great Pyramid is only a soft outline from the breakfast balcony.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Cairo, but if it fell today, guests would see white on the Great Pyramid from their rooms.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold daytime air over the Giza plateau, and the pyramids stand sharp and clear from the breakfast balcony.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the water of the outdoor pool is the comfortable place to look at the pyramids from.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and from the 139 Pavilion bar the two pyramids are dark shapes with no stars above them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today, but from the balconies the Great Pyramid, under one kilometre away, is still clear while Khafre's looks faded.
phrases.late_night: With every light off in a Pyramid View room, you would see only the garden path lights and the Great Pyramid's shape.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink at the 139 Pavilion tonight, you would see the Great Pyramid's shape through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in a Pyramid View room, you would see the lit gardens and Khufu's outline under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: If you were on a sea-view balcony before dawn, you would see the cruise port lights below and a dark Atlantic beyond.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were there this morning, you would see the Desertas islands on the horizon from the rooftop pool.
phrases.clear_midday: If you stood on a sea-view balcony now, you would see Funchal Bay flat and blue under the midday sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The afternoon sun lights Funchal's hillside buildings in warm colour, seen from the rattan chairs on the balconies.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight in Galaxia, the star-effect ceiling is on, and the real stars are out over Funchal's city lights.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Funchal Bay this morning, and swimmers in the infinity pool get sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, clouds cover parts of the ocean south of the Sky Bar, and the Desertas islands show only now and then.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds over the Atlantic turn orange, visible from the sea-view balconies.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the whole bay today, so from the infinity pool the Atlantic appears flat and grey.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Funchal, and the indoor pool with its waterfall feature is busier than the rooftop today.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm over Funchal Bay, guests watch the lightning out at sea from behind their balcony doors.
phrases.fog_haze: From the Sky Bar, haze sits over Funchal Bay today and hides the Desertas islands beyond the nearer water.
phrases.snow: Snow at sea level is almost unheard of in Funchal, but the indoor pool would be the obvious place today.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day is rare in Funchal, and the Laurea Spa is a more popular choice than the outdoor pools.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day like this, the shade of the palm trees around the curved pool is where most guests sit.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the stars are hidden, but Funchal's city lights are still visible from the tables in Galaxia.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the cruise port and rooftops are clear from the balconies, but the horizon and the Desertas are not.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the sea-view rooms are likely asleep now, Funchal's hillside lights on the bay water until dawn shows the Atlantic.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the sea-view rooms are likely at the window tonight, Funchal Bay's lights blurred through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the sea-view rooms can watch Funchal's hillside lights come on around the bay under tonight's low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, from a villa deck, the Gulf of Thailand is still only a dark line under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: On a clear morning, the villa plunge pool and the Gulf of Thailand beyond it look almost the same blue.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the cream umbrellas around the infinity pool are the only shade, and the sea beyond is bright and flat.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Sunset Bar's two levels both face west, so right now the low sun sits over the Gulf from either one.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the outdoor soaking tub tonight, you would see stars over the sea and very little else.
phrases.partly_morning: From the canopied bed, the floor-to-ceiling windows show a turquoise sea with a few white clouds above it this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Gulf this afternoon, and the horizon lap pool changes colour with each one.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the western Gulf turns orange above the daybeds on the villa decks.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Gulf of Thailand looks grey too, but the covered terrace with the rattan sofa still faces it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the oceanfront boardwalk right now, and the distant hills across the water are hard to make out.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Gulf, so guests watch it from the covered terrace rather than from the beachfront sundeck.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, and the small island opposite the beach is only a faint shape.
phrases.snow: Snow in Cambodia would be a first; if it fell today, the teak loungers by the infinity pool would be empty.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air is almost unknown here, and today the sea from the villa windows looks the same as ever, just colder.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, so the infinity plunge pool flush with the villa deck is where most guests stay until late afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm with cloud overhead, and the candle-lit daybeds on the villa decks face a dark, quiet Gulf.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the sea near the island is clear enough, but the distant hills and the horizon are not visible.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Ocean Pool Villas probably fell asleep with the curtain pulled back, the moon on the Gulf of Thailand.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Oceanfront Pool Villas are probably asleep now, rain on the tall windows and the Gulf of Thailand under it.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the Oceanfront Pool Villas are probably asleep now, the Gulf of Thailand moving under low cloud past the plunge pool.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies on levels 16 to 26 look over a dark Yarra and the still-lit CBD skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Southbank, and the St Paul's Cathedral spire stands out sharply from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is on the Yarra, and from the balcony the river and Southbank are easy to see.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the Flinders Street Station dome, which guests on the Jarrah terrace can watch over a drink.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lit CBD skyline from the living room windows of a suite.
phrases.partly_morning: Some cloud sits over Melbourne this morning, but the cathedral spire is still clear from the upper-floor balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of shadow and sun move across the Southbank precinct, seen from the Jarrah Restaurant terrace this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the CBD skyline turns orange, seen from the balcony of a Premium Apartment.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Melbourne today, and from the suite windows the Yarra looks grey as well.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Southbank, and guests are using the indoor part of Jarrah rather than the alfresco terrace.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the CBD skyline means the balconies are empty and the lightning is watched from behind floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of the Melbourne skyline today, and from the upper floors only the nearest part of Southbank shows.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Melbourne, but a few flakes over the Yarra would be visible from the upper-floor balconies.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Melbourne; the sauna and spa are in use while the skyline stays sharp outside the windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot across Southbank, so the magnesium mineral pool is busier than the sunny Jarrah terrace this afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the Melbourne skyline lights show from the Quay West balcony above the Yarra River.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the upper-floor balconies today, the Yarra and the cathedral spire show, but the farther CBD towers are missing from the view.
phrases.late_night: The curtain stays open at bedtime in the Premium Apartment, so the skyline lights across the Yarra fill the window after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open after midnight, rain streaks the living-room windows and the skyline lights blur over the Yarra.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open after midnight, the living room's floor-to-ceiling windows show the CBD lights under low cloud, reflected in the Yarra.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sailboats in the Vieux-Port sit still under a clear sky, seen from the upper-floor balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: A window table in the Provençal breakfast room shows the harbour in full morning sun, boats and all.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands high over the marina, and the oval room window frames the packed boats clearly.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights Fort Saint-Nicolas across the water, and the upper-floor balcony suites face it directly.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on an upper-floor balcony after midnight, you would see the clear night sky over the Vieux-Port and lit boats.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds this morning, so the breakfast tray on the balcony is eaten with the port half in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the Vieux-Port this afternoon, and from the upper rooms the boats go bright and dim in turn.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on a balcony now, you would see the last sun reach Fort Saint-Nicolas between broken clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Vieux-Port looks flat and quiet from the oval window, though the boats are all there.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the marina today, and the breakfast room with port views is busier than the terrace.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm sits over Marseille, and guests watch lightning above the harbour from inside their rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog today, so from the balconies the nearest boats are clear but Fort Saint-Nicolas is hard to make out.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Marseille, but today a few flakes drift over the Vieux-Port, seen from the hotel rooms.
phrases.very_cold: Below the upper-floor balconies, the empty terrace of Le Beauvau bar faces the Vieux-Port boats in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day the egg chair on the balcony stays in the shade, with the city rooftops beyond.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the terrace bar has people at its tables with the boats below them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the upper balconies the marina is clear but the far side of the port is not.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the oval window shows the Vieux-Port masts under the quay lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Late after dinner, the oval window shows the Vieux-Port in rain, the boat lights blurred on wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, with the cloud low over the Vieux-Port, the harbour lights shine on the water through the oval window.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Recoleta parks under the Le Mirador balconies are still dark, and the river line is not yet visible.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Le Mirador balcony, the cemetery's marble roofs and the distant Río de la Plata are both clear this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun lands on the two wooden loungers on the rooftop deck, with the towers of Buenos Aires sharp in every direction.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At the Alvear Roof Bar, the last sun reaches the rattan chairs, and beyond the glass railing the skyline is turning orange.
phrases.clear_night: From the eleventh-floor Roof Bar, the lights of the Buenos Aires skyline stand out under a clear night sky after midnight.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Recoleta this morning, so the parks below the French balconies switch between shade and sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Soft clouds sit above the towers this afternoon, and the rooftop loungers are a good place to watch the tree-lined city.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds over the skyline, and guests at the Roof Bar have spritz cocktails in hand.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the cemetery's marble roofs look flat and pale from the Le Mirador balconies today.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop terrace, so the rattan chairs are empty and guests watch the skyline through the pool windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Buenos Aires, and the large indoor pool windows show the lightning above the skyline.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the distant Río de la Plata from the French balconies today, and only the nearer Recoleta parks are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Buenos Aires, which almost never happens, and the rooftop loungers are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the loungers on the rooftop deck stay empty, though the view of the towers is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot over Buenos Aires today, and the rattan chairs on the rooftop terrace are mostly empty until the sun drops.
phrases.mild_night: Mild cloudy night, and the neon sign on the rooftop terrace is lit while guests sit outside facing the city lights.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so from the Le Mirador balconies the parks are clear but the Río de la Plata cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Le Mirador suites are dark inside, and the lit Recoleta skyline is the only light in the room.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Le Mirador windows tonight, and the lights of Recoleta look soft through the wet glass at bedtime.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtains in a Le Mirador suite are open after midnight, and the lights of Recoleta show under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the sky is clear, and north-facing suites on the upper floors show the Estaiada Bridge in dark outline.
phrases.clear_morning: A clear morning, and from the Deluxe High Floor rooms the Pinheiros River and the Estaiada Bridge share one window.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky the rooftop pool is in full sun, and the umbrellas over the lounge chairs are open.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The last hours of sun colour the Estaiada Bridge orange, best seen from the north-facing Premium with Bathtub rooms.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the skyline lights are sharp from the Presidential Suite, and the Estaiada Bridge is part of the picture.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds this morning, and the fitness center windows show the treetops below in patches of sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon clouds pass over the rooftop pool, and the green hillside in view goes light and dark as they move.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in a north-facing suite now, you would see the last sun on the Pinheiros River between broken clouds.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over São Paulo today, and the skyline from the suite living areas looks flat, with no shadows on the trees.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the outdoor part of the pool, and the partially indoor section is where most swimmers are right now.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the city, and from the upper floors the lightning over the Pinheiros River is visible without going outside.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Zona Sul today, and from the north-facing suites the Estaiada Bridge is visible but the far skyline is not.
phrases.snow: Snow in São Paulo would surprise most guests, and the fitness center windows would be the warmest place to check the treetops.
phrases.very_cold: From the north-facing upper suites, hard winter light falls on the Estaiada Bridge and the Pinheiros River below.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, and the rooftop pool is where the business travellers are, looking at the city through the glass wall.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky tonight but the air is mild, and the Estaiada Bridge is still visible from the north-facing suites.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop pool the nearby towers are clear but the green hillside is not.
phrases.late_night: Asleep in a north-facing suite now, you would wake at dawn to the Estaiada Bridge and the Pinheiros River.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were finishing a drink in a north-facing suite tonight, you would see the Estaiada Bridge through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a late drink in a north-facing suite, you would see the Estaiada Bridge and the lit city under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lagoon outside the damasco suite is still dark, and San Giorgio Maggiore's bell tower is a plain shape.
phrases.clear_morning: From the roof terrace suite, the morning sun lights the whole lagoon and the island of San Giorgio Maggiore across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the lagoon in front of the Riva degli Schiavoni is bright and flat, best watched from a shaded room window.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on the terrace are watching the low sun turn San Giorgio Maggiore's bell tower gold across the lagoon.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see a clear sky over the lagoon and the dark outline of San Giorgio Maggiore.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds cross the sky over the lagoon this morning, seen from the windows of the lagoon-view damasco suite.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the clouds move slowly over San Giorgio Maggiore, and the light on the lagoon changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, pink and purple clouds hang over the lagoon as the terrace candles are lit.
phrases.overcast: Flat grey cloud covers the lagoon today, and the gold leaf walls of the indoor spa pool look brighter than the water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Riva degli Schiavoni, and guests in the indoor spa pool swim under the brass chandelier instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the lagoon is visible from the damasco suite windows, and guests wait it out in the Oriental Bar & Bistrot.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the lagoon today and San Giorgio Maggiore has disappeared, leaving only the water in front of the hotel.
phrases.snow: Snow over the lagoon is rare, and from the roof terrace suite the flakes can be seen falling toward San Giorgio Maggiore.
phrases.very_cold: On a day close to freezing, the terrace is empty and the lagoon is watched from behind the suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air hangs over the Riva degli Schiavoni, and the lagoon view is mostly taken from inside the damasco suite.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy sky, the night is warm enough for the candlelit terrace, and the lagoon lies dark in front of it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short, so San Giorgio Maggiore across the lagoon is a faint outline from the damasco suite, not a clear view.
phrases.late_night: After midnight a few boat lights cross the lagoon outside the damasco suite; at dawn the window shows San Giorgio's bell tower.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at the Oriental Bar and Bistrot, the damasco suite window shows the Riva's lights blurred by rain on the lagoon.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at the Oriental Bar & Bistrot, the damasco suite window shows a few boat lights on the lagoon under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky over Paris is clear but still dark, and from the top-floor windows the Eiffel Tower is already an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Eiffel Tower above the Haussmann rooftops, and even the Cosy Rooms have this view.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the Eiffel Tower is sharp in every window, from Cosy Room to Junior Suite.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun hits the Eiffel Tower from the side, and the top-floor Junior Suite has the most direct angle.
phrases.clear_night: From the top-floor Junior Suite's wide windows, the Eiffel Tower's iron frame stands against a clear late-night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Paris this morning, but the Eiffel Tower stays in view from the guest room windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A few clouds pass behind the Eiffel Tower this afternoon, and the top floor windows frame all of it.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds sit above the Haussmann rooftops while the low sun still reaches the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.overcast: Low cloud covers Paris today, and from the Cosy Room window the Eiffel Tower shows as a dull outline above the rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the window glass, and the Eiffel Tower is still there behind it, a little blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Paris, and guests are watching the Eiffel Tower from behind the grey curtains, not from the street.
phrases.fog_haze: From the room window today, fog covers the upper half of the Eiffel Tower; the lower half still shows above the rooftops.
phrases.snow: Flakes of snow pass the guest room window, and the Eiffel Tower behind them turns grey and less sharp than usual.
phrases.very_cold: From the Junior Suite's wide windows, the Eiffel Tower stands in hard winter light above the Haussmann rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day in Paris, the Eiffel Tower view from the room window costs no effort at all.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over Paris, and the lit Eiffel Tower is the main thing in the window.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Paris today; the Eiffel Tower is only faintly visible from the room windows, its details lost.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Eiffel Tower is in the Junior Suite window, and the lit rooftops around it make it hard to stop looking.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner, rain runs down the Eiffel Tower Junior Suite's wide windows, and the tower's outline shows above wet rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner, there is low cloud over Paris, and the Junior Suite window shows the Tower's outline above the lit rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea-facing rooms on the upper floors face a dark Indian Ocean and a thin pale line at the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: Rooftops of uMhlanga slope down to a bright blue Indian Ocean this morning, seen from the window of a high sea-facing room.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the heated rooftop pool sits in full sun, and its far edge lines up with open water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the coastline in both directions from the Back Yard rooftop bar, where the evening's first drinks are being poured.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see a clear sky over a black Indian Ocean from a fourteenth-floor sea-facing room.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds throw moving shadows over the uMhlanga rooftops this morning, and the ocean behind them stays mostly sunlit.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the navy loungers by the rooftop pool get sun between the clouds, with the Indian Ocean flat beyond the railing.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud turns orange above the coastline, seen from the Back Yard bar and pool deck.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Umhlanga today, and from the sea-facing rooms the line between ocean and sky is hard to find.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the single pane of each room window, and the Indian Ocean beyond the rooftops turns a dull grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the rooftop pool deck empties, and the lightning over the Indian Ocean is watched from the sea-facing rooms instead.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the coast today, and from the upper rooms the uMhlanga rooftops are clear but the ocean horizon is not.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Umhlanga, so a white flake past a fourteenth-floor window would surprise every guest in the sea-facing rooms.
phrases.very_cold: A rare freezing day on Umhlanga Ridge, with the heated rooftop pool steaming slightly and the Indian Ocean looking very clear.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the grey umbrellas by the rooftop pool are where guests sit, with the Indian Ocean behind them.
phrases.mild_night: Warm air and full cloud tonight, and from the sea-facing rooms the Indian Ocean is only a darker band below the sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today: the uMhlanga rooftops are there, but the far ocean horizon that the high rooms usually show is missing.
phrases.late_night: Anyone back late from dinner at Together & Co, now in a sea-facing room, sees the suburb lights end at the Indian Ocean.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the high sea-facing rooms watches rain run down the glass, the suburb lights blurred toward the Indian Ocean.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a high sea-facing room tonight looks over uMhlanga's lit rooftops to the Indian Ocean under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the terrace rooms face a dark outline of Table Mountain, with the city lights of Cape Town still on below.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop deck, Table Mountain, Lion's Head and Signal Hill are all sharp this morning, with the Atlantic beyond.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the pool terrace under the pergola is the shaded spot, with Lion's Head in full sun straight ahead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the terrace now, the late sun would turn Table Mountain's cliffs orange above the pine trees.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the rooftop pool is clear, and the lights of Cape Town city show below Signal Hill.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit on top of Table Mountain this morning, while the rooftop deck itself is in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, clouds move across Lion's Head, and the two wicker chairs on the terrace get sun in turns.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over Table Bay take colour, watched from the terrace with a glass of wine.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Table Mountain and Lion's Head are still fully visible from the terrace rooms, just without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pool and the subtropical garden, so guests watch it from inside the terrace rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Table Bay is visible from the rooftop deck, though guests sensibly watch it from the rooms instead.
phrases.fog_haze: If you were on the rooftop deck now, you would see fog covering the flat top of Table Mountain above the pines.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Cape Town, but today a thin white layer lies on the top of Table Mountain above the pines.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air keeps the rooftop pool empty today, though Table Mountain and Lion's Head are unusually sharp.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Oranjezicht, and the pool terrace with its pergola shade is the busiest place in the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Cape Town, and guests on the rooftop deck can still make out the city lights below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Atlantic horizon is missing from the rooftop deck, but Lion's Head is still clear.
phrases.late_night: Guests at Camissa House are likely asleep by now, city lights filling the windows until Lion's Head shows again at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the terrace rooms watch rain run down the glass as the city lights come on under Table Mountain's flat top.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the terrace rooms are likely at the window now, watching city lights spread under low cloud toward Lion's Head.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea below Glicine's veranda is still dark, and the lights of Amalfi town are on along the coast.
phrases.clear_morning: From the arched terrace doors of a sea-view room, the water is bright blue and the coastal villages are easy to see.
phrases.clear_midday: At the cliffside pool, guests are swimming in heated saltwater while the Tyrrhenian lies flat and blue under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun turns the sea gold in front of the colonnade terrace, where the first dinner tables are being set.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the Senzafine rooftop tonight, you would see the lights of Amalfi town and stars over the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the coast this morning, and the pool terrace is half in sun, half in shade, with calm sea below.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud sits above the cliffs this afternoon, but the sea in front of Restaurant Al Mare is mostly lit by sun.
phrases.partly_golden: On the terrace facing Positano, the last sun comes through gaps in the cloud and lights part of the coast.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the whole coast today, so the sea from the Glicine veranda looks grey too, with no sparkle.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the colonnade terrace, and guests eat under its arches while the sea below turns dull grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the sea-view rooms on higher floors watch lightning flash over the Tyrrhenian while thunder rolls above Amalfi.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the sea today, so from the pool the coastal villages are faint and the horizon is not clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Amalfi, but today a few flakes fall past the arched terrace doors toward a cold grey sea.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold on the coast today, and steam rises from the heated saltwater pool above a bright, clear sea.
phrases.very_hot: The sun is very hot on the cliffs today, and most beach club guests are in the sea or the pool.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, but the air is mild and dinner continues outside at Senzafine with the dark sea below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the cliffside pool, Amalfi town shows along the rocky coast in haze, but the farther villages do not.
phrases.late_night: Long after midnight, the lights of Amalfi show along the coast from the sea-view rooms.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the arched doors of the sea-view rooms after midnight, and the lights of Amalfi blur along the coast.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud drifts over the coast after midnight, and Amalfi's lights show along the shore through the sea-view rooms' arched doors.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dallas skyline is still a row of dark shapes behind the glass railing of the 20th-floor pool.
phrases.clear_morning: Léonie serves breakfast in the open air this morning, with the downtown towers sharp and clear under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the 75-foot infinity pool, and the water is the brightest thing on the 20th floor.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From a corner king suite terrace, the late sun reaches across the Dallas skyline and turns the glass towers yellow.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the downtown lights from the black soaking tub in your bathroom.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Uptown this morning, and guests on the treadmills watch them move across the Harwood District buildings.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The rooftop terrace has wicker chairs in sun and shade this afternoon, as clouds cross the Dallas skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over downtown are lit from below, seen from the guest room windows.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Dallas today, and the white sofas on the rooftop terrace face a skyline without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, so the nearby Beaux-Arts building looks slightly blurred from the guest rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the downtown towers, and guests watch it from their room windows while the rooftop infinity pool stays empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Dallas today, and from the infinity pool the far towers are pale outlines behind the glass railing.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Dallas, but today it falls past the suite windows onto the Harwood District buildings below.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the corner suites this afternoon look out through tall glass at the Dallas skyline in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: Dallas is very hot this afternoon, and the 75-foot infinity pool is the only part of the roof with people in it.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night in Uptown, and dinner at Léonie continues in the open air with the city lights below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Calatrava bridge is not visible from the rooms, only the nearer downtown high-rises.
phrases.late_night: Were you up for water around midnight in a corner king suite, you would see downtown Dallas lit across both glass walls.
phrases.wet_evening: If you carried a last drink to a corner suite window tonight, you would see downtown's towers lit through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were finishing a last drink in a corner king suite now, the downtown skyline lights would show under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies look out on a dark bay where the moored superyachts still show their lights.
phrases.clear_morning: From a balcony this morning, the Aegean is bright blue and the white villas on the hillside are easy to count.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the sunbeds, so guests are moving between the shade of the olive trees and the turquoise bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the low afternoon sun, the rocky headland across the bay turns orange beyond the moored boats of Yalikavak Marina.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Yalikavak Bay is clear, and diners at KITCHEN see the marina lights on the water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the bay this morning, and the superyachts in the marina are still at their berths.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the hillside villas this afternoon, so the turquoise of the bay changes shade every few minutes from the terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on your balcony now, you would see the low sun lighting the clouds above the rocky headland.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Aegean looks grey rather than turquoise, and the pergola terrace has plenty of free lounge seats.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the marina and the sunbeds, which makes the hammam and steam room the busiest places in the hotel.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the bay briefly shows the superyachts at their berths, and most guests watch from behind the balcony glass doors.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water hides the open sea today, so the balcony view stops at the nearer boats in the marina.
phrases.snow: Snow on the Bodrum peninsula is rare, but today a few flakes are reaching the balconies above the grey Aegean.
phrases.very_cold: On a bitterly cold but clear day, the sauna and the hammam have more guests than the pergola terrace outside.
phrases.very_hot: In this very hot afternoon, the shaded pergola and the spa plunge pool are more popular than the sunbeds by the bay.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and dinner at KITCHEN comes with the lights of the marina rather than stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor today, so from the balconies the open sea cannot be seen, only the boats and the near hillside.
phrases.late_night: Tonight the marina lights show on Yalikavak Bay from the rooms, and at dawn the boats and open sea return.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain is falling over Yalikavak Bay after dinner at KITCHEN, and the marina's boat lights show through the wet balcony glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at KITCHEN, the rooms look out on marina lights and a few boat lights on the bay under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky over Tiergarten is clear but still dark, and from the upper rooms the TV Tower is already easy to find.
phrases.clear_morning: From the upper suites, Tiergarten looks green and sharp this morning, with the Victory Column easy to spot.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church, which guests on the terrace see without a single cloud.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches the penthouse windows, and from there the TV Tower looks slightly orange in the clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a suite tonight, you would see the lit city reaching to the horizon under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: This morning brings broken cloud over Tiergarten, and from the higher rooms the Victory Column still shows plainly.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon tea in the Library Lounge comes with a sky that is half cloud, half sun over the Memorial Church.
phrases.partly_golden: Just before sunset, the penthouse windows show the TV Tower with some clouds lit pink behind it.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers all of Berlin today, but the TV Tower still shows clearly from the 15th-floor lounge.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites, and Tiergarten below looks darker and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests in the upper rooms watch lightning over the city from behind glass, with the TV Tower in view.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the TV Tower today, so the nearby Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church is the only landmark guests can see.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Tiergarten, and from the suites above the 20th floor the park slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is very cold, and the outdoor terrace is empty while the sky over the Memorial Church stays clear.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Berlin today, and the Memorial Church stands in strong sun below the penthouse windows.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the city lights still stretch to the horizon when seen from the suite windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church is clear from the rooms, but the TV Tower is not visible.
phrases.late_night: Guests above the 20th floor have turned off every light inside; only the skyline toward the TV Tower lights the room.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the penthouse suite watch rain run down the windows tonight, the TV Tower's spire showing above the wet lit city.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a room above the twentieth floor tonight can see the TV Tower's thin spire under low cloud across the lit city.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise under a clear sky, the lit Parthenon shows above the city from the eighth-floor rooftop pool.
phrases.clear_morning: From the 8th-floor pool, the Acropolis and Lycabettus Hill are both sharp under a clear Athens sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop loungers sit under white umbrellas, and the Parthenon is in full sun across the city.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the rooftop pool now, you would see the late sun on the Acropolis and the hills.
phrases.clear_night: The Parthenon is lit up tonight, and guests at The Grand restaurant have it in view from their tables.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Athens this morning, so the Acropolis, seen from a corner suite, is sometimes in sun and sometimes in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, scattered clouds cast shadows over Philopappos Hill while swimmers in the 8th-floor pool watch the Parthenon.
phrases.partly_golden: Under broken cloud in the last hour of sun, the Acropolis changes between orange light and grey shadow from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Athens today, but the Parthenon is still clearly visible from the corner suites.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop pool, so most guests have moved to the 25-metre heated indoor pool at Aegeo Spa.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Acropolis is best watched from a corner suite, with nobody out on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Athens today and the Parthenon is only a pale shape from The Grand restaurant on floor 9.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Athens, but today the Acropolis has a thin white cover, visible from the corner suites.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing outside, the air is very clear and Lycabettus Hill looks very close from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Athens today, so most guests stay under the white umbrellas by the rooftop pool with the Acropolis in view.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, and two people on a balcony are looking at the lit Parthenon without any stars above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Acropolis can be seen from the corner suites but Lycabettus Hill is only a faint outline.
phrases.late_night: If you were in a corner suite after midnight, the lights of Athens around the Acropolis would be the only light left.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in a corner suite now, you would see the Acropolis through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: A last drink in a corner suite now would show you the Acropolis under low cloud and the lit city around it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Acropolis stands dark against a clear sky above the rooftop pool, with the Athens rooftops still quiet below.
phrases.clear_morning: This morning the sun is full on the Acropolis, and the cushioned chairs on the rooftop terrace face it directly.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the rooftop pool deck, so most guests are in the water with the Acropolis straight ahead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would watch the Acropolis turn orange in the late afternoon sun.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Acropolis is lit by floodlights under a clear sky, visible from the rooftop terrace chairs and the higher balconies.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Acropolis this morning, and the dining area's panoramic windows show them moving across Athens.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the rooftop pool this afternoon, so the Acropolis is in sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the Acropolis between clouds, seen from the cushioned chairs on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky today, the Acropolis is still clearly visible from the higher-floor balconies, just without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop pool deck right now, so guests have moved to the indoor pool with its blue-lit water.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Athens, and from the dining area's windows the lightning shows the Acropolis for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Athens today makes the Acropolis look pale and less sharp from the rooftop pool deck.
phrases.snow: Snow in Athens is rare, but today it is falling on the rooftop terrace chairs and on the Acropolis behind them.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing on the rooftop today, so the Acropolis view is mostly enjoyed through the dining area windows.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the rooftop pool deck, and the water is the most comfortable place to see the Acropolis.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the floodlit Acropolis is still clear from the rooftop terrace and the higher-floor balconies.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Acropolis is faint from the rooftop pool and the far rooftops are hard to see.
phrases.late_night: Long after midnight the Acropolis hill is in plain view above the lit Athens rooftops from the higher-floor rooms.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the glass in the higher-floor rooms, and the Acropolis shows close above the wet rooftops of Plaka.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner, the higher-floor rooms face the Acropolis rock, low cloud over it and the Plaka rooftops lit.

phrases.clear_predawn: If you were in a suite lounge before sunrise, you would see the ANZAC Bridge lights on the dark harbour.
phrases.clear_morning: From the gym windows, the waterfront and the Sydney skyline sit in clear morning light while guests work out.
phrases.clear_midday: On the 5th-floor pool terrace, the timber loungers are in full sun and Sydney Tower stands sharp against a blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a king room now, you would watch the CBD skyline turning gold from the balcony before sunset.
phrases.clear_night: Darling Harbour is dark and calm tonight, and from a suite lounge Sydney Tower stands lit against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the ANZAC Bridge this morning, seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites in Pyrmont.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud pass over Darling Harbour this afternoon, so the pool terrace gets sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the skyline turn orange, framed by the balcony doors of a suite.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Sydney today, but the harbour and the ANZAC Bridge are plainly visible from the rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Darling Harbour, and guests watch it through floor-to-ceiling windows from the warm-toned rooms.
