phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Acropolis this morning, so the sightline from the King Deluxe rooms changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud cross the Acropolis this afternoon, and from the rooftop Première tables the Parthenon is sometimes bright, sometimes shaded.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds sit above the Acropolis while the rooftop dining tables fill for dinner.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Parthenon shows clearly from the suite windows, just without its usual bright colour.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Athens today, and the Acropolis-view dining room behind glass is the dry place to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Athens, and lightning sometimes shows the Acropolis for a second from the suite windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Athens today, so the Acropolis from the King Deluxe rooms is a soft outline rather than sharp detail.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Athens, but today it falls on the Parthenon, and guests watch it from the heated suites.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing in Athens today, but the Acropolis shows sharp and clear from the suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Athens today, and the Acropolis view is easier to enjoy from inside a King Deluxe room.
phrases.mild_night: A warm night with cloud over Athens, and Lycabettus Hill shows lit up from the suite living room windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Acropolis from the rooftop is only a faint shape and Lycabettus Hill is hard to see.
phrases.late_night: With the suite's lights off in the small hours, only the lights of Athens around the Acropolis hill show through the glass.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Première, the Acropolis shows through rain on the window of the King Deluxe Acropolis View Room.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Première, the King Deluxe Acropolis View Room window frames the hill under low cloud, city lights around it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the red rooftops of Malá Strana are dark grey from the guestroom windows, with no lights on the terraces yet.
phrases.clear_morning: From an open window in a beamed guestroom, the dome of St. Nicholas Church stands out sharply in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a cloudless midday sky, tables on the three terraces of Terasa U Zlaté studně get full sun below the castle walls.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun turns the red tiles below the terrace a deeper orange, and the city spires throw long shadows.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the top terrace, you would see a clear sky over Prague and the dark shapes of church spires.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Malá Strana this morning, so the view from the guestroom windows changes between shade and sun every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Between the barrel planters on the terrace, the St. Nicholas dome is in sunlight while some rooftops sit under cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud leaves the terrace half lit and the red roofs below still bright.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Prague today, which makes the red roofs below the three terraces look even redder by contrast.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the terraces, so lunch at Terasa U Zlaté studně moves indoors behind the panoramic windows and brass chandelier.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over Prague Castle sends guests inside, where the panoramic restaurant windows give a dry seat for watching lightning over the rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog today hides the city spires from the guestroom windows; only the nearest red rooftops of Malá Strana are visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the terrace planters and on the red tiles below, turning the rooftop view from the restaurant mostly white.
phrases.very_cold: From the terraces below the castle walls, frost covers the red Malá Strana rooftops toward the St. Nicholas dome.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot over Prague today; the vines on the barrel planters give the terrace tables some shade against the castle walls.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the open window of a beamed guestroom lets in soft air and the sounds of Malá Strana.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today: the red rooftops right below the terrace are clear, but the far city spires are not visible.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has a rooftop-view room tonight has likely left the curtain open on purpose, falling asleep to the lights across Malá Strana's roofs.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in a guestroom after midnight watches rain run down the window, the Malá Strana rooftops wet under the city lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a room after midnight can watch low cloud pass over Malá Strana, the city lights showing beneath it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the castle is a dark shape on its rock in the tall windows of the Caledonian Suite.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the castle rock and the church steeple seen from the room seating areas facing Princes Street Gardens.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the Saltire flag on Edinburgh Castle is easy to see from the castle-view rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low afternoon sun lights the castle stone above Princes Street Gardens, the same view diners get at The Pompadour.
phrases.clear_night: From the tall windows of the Caledonian Suite, the shape of Edinburgh Castle shows against a clear night sky full of stars.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Caledonian Suite this morning, the castle rock goes from sun to shadow as clouds cross Edinburgh.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Broken cloud over the castle this afternoon puts the rock in sun one minute and shadow the next, seen from castle-view rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, patches of light cross the castle and the church steeple outside the suite windows.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Edinburgh today, but the castle is still clearly visible from the windows of Dean Banks at The Pompadour.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Princes Street Gardens, and guests swim lengths in the indoor lap pool beside its painted skyline murals.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the thunderstorm, lightning shows the castle on its rock for a second at a time from the Caledonian Suite windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over Edinburgh hides most of the castle today, and from the castle-view rooms the church steeple is only a faint shape.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the castle rock and on Princes Street Gardens, turning the view from the tall suite windows white.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold and bright outside today, and the castle stands sharp above Princes Street Gardens in the suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: A rare very hot day in Edinburgh, and from the castle-view rooms the castle rock stands in strong, direct sun.
phrases.mild_night: Mild and cloudy tonight, with the castle outline above Princes Street Gardens visible from the room seating areas.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today, so from the suite windows the castle looks flat and grey and the church steeple is hard to see.
phrases.late_night: Sleep fills the Caledonian Suite with Castle View after midnight; at first light its tall windows will frame the castle's outline.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Caledonian Suite windows after midnight, the curtain open on wet Princes Street lights and Edinburgh Castle's outline.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hangs over the castle tonight, and the curtain of the Caledonian Suite stays open on the lights of Princes Street.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the crater of Etna is already a dark shape above the pool terrace, with the sea still grey below.
phrases.clear_morning: From the restaurant terrace this morning, both the crater and the Ionian Sea are sharp in one clear view.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool is in full sun, and the vineyard terraces below run down toward a very blue sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches the glass-walled suites, and the valley town below sits in orange light while Etna stays clear above.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the candles are lit on the restaurant terrace, and the lights of the valley show clearly beyond the balustrade.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit around the top of Etna this morning, but the coastline is clear from the lawn loungers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon clouds pass over the vineyards in turn, so the garden umbrellas are needed only part of the time.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the crater take colour, and tables are being set by the stone well.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the crater today, so the pool terrace view is mostly the vineyard terraces and a flat, pale sea.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the striped loungers in the garden, and the restaurant terrace tables are empty for now.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were in a glass-walled suite right now, you would watch lightning over the valley from a dry chair.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Ionian Sea from the pool today, and even the crater above is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the citrus trees and the garden loungers today, a rare sight at this height on Etna's slopes.
phrases.very_cold: Guests on the restaurant terrace this afternoon look up at snow on Etna's crater and frost on the balustrade.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the vineyard terraces, and the infinity pool is the most popular place on the estate.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, candles burn on the terrace tables and the valley lights are visible beyond the balustrade.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the pool terrace, haze hides Etna's crater and the Ionian Sea today, and only the vineyard terraces show.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water by the bed, and the volcano-facing rooms look out on the valley town lights below.
phrases.wet_evening: On Etna's southern slope, rain runs down the glass-walled suite tonight, and the valley town's lights show through it.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Etna's slopes after midnight, and from the glass-walled suites the valley town shows as scattered lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tagus shows as a grey band past the dark Alfama rooftops from the river-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: From a terrace table, the white Church of São Vicente de Fora stands sharp against a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under the white umbrellas on the terrace, guests look at the whole Tagus estuary in strong midday light.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the rooftop terrace now, you would see late sun on the Alfama rooftops and the Tagus beyond the Pantheon dome.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would sit by candlelight on the terrace with the Alfama rooftops dark below.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Tagus this morning, and both windows of a river room are open.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the orange tiles of Alfama while a guest paints watercolours on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the dome of the National Pantheon between clouds, straight ahead from the wine bar.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Lisbon today, so the Tagus looks flat and silver from the terrace pool with red tiles.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Alfama rooftops, and guests watch it from inside the wine bar, a former photographer's apartment.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the terrace empties, and lightning over the Tagus is best seen from a river-facing room window.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the river today; from the terrace only the nearest Alfama rooftops and the church tower show.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Lisbon, yet today a few flakes drift past the river-facing windows toward the Alfama rooftops.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the pool with red Bisazza tiles stays empty while the Tagus looks sharp and bright.
phrases.very_hot: In this very hot weather, the rooftop pool is the only comfortable place to look at the Tagus before evening.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, but it is warm enough to sit outside on the terrace lounge above the Alfama rooftops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low: the near rooftops and São Vicente church show clearly, but the Tagus beyond them does not.
phrases.late_night: A few Alfama lights show below the river-facing rooms after midnight, and dawn will bring the Tagus back into the same windows.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open in a river-facing room after midnight, Alfama's lights show blurred through the rain down to the Tagus.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Lisbon after midnight, and the river-facing rooms keep their curtains open on Alfama's lights down to the Tagus.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Kowloon towers across the harbour are still lit, seen from a Grand Harbour View Suite.
phrases.clear_morning: Early guests doing tai chi beside the rooftop infinity pool have Victoria Harbour and Kowloon in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the hills behind Kowloon are sharp from the lounge windows, and the harbour water looks bright.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun reaches the panoramic bathtub, so a bath now comes with a gold-coloured Hong Kong skyline.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the ICC Tower lit across the harbour from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit over the Kowloon hills this morning, but the harbour itself is in sun below the suite windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop pool, ferries cross Victoria Harbour under an afternoon sky of sun and scattered cloud.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the undersides of the clouds over Kowloon, visible from the tables at Lung King Heen.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Victoria Harbour looks flat and grey too, though the Kowloon towers stay clear from the suites.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the guest rooms, and the harbour beyond turns a dull colour.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Kowloon shows up well from the lounge, and the rooftop terrace is empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the hills behind Kowloon today, so the harbour view from the suites stops at the nearer towers.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Hong Kong, so flakes passing the suite windows above the harbour would be news.
phrases.very_cold: On this unusually cold day for Hong Kong, the rooftop terrace is empty while the harbour stays clear from the suites.
phrases.very_hot: Hong Kong is very hot today, so most guests watch Victoria Harbour from the lounge rather than from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, with the Kowloon skyline lit under low cloud and ferries still crossing below the rooftop terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from the guest rooms the near harbour and Kowloon show, but the hills do not.
phrases.late_night: The Kowloon lights shine on Victoria Harbour after a late dinner at Lung King Heen.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtains open after midnight in a Grand Harbour View Suite, and rain on the glass blurs the Kowloon lights across Victoria Harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Kowloon tonight, and the harbour lights show through the glass of the Grand Harbour View Suites before bed.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Royal Dramatic Theatre across Nybroviken bay is still just a dark shape from the Deluxe Sea View windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the ferries on Nybroviken bay, easy to watch from the French windows of a sea-view room.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the water of Nybroviken bay is bright and the church spires beyond stand out clearly from the upper rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the balcony, the low sun falls on the Royal Dramatic Theatre across the water and on the moored vessels below.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in Andy's Cocktail Bar tonight, you would see the moored vessels on Nybroviken bay under a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Stockholm this morning, and the ferries on the bay move in and out of sunlight below the arched windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Old Town skyline is sometimes in sun and sometimes in shadow, seen from the balcony beside the red geraniums.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the water of Nybroviken, with the Royal Dramatic Theatre still lit across it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the water of Nybroviken looks flat and the church spires beyond are grey, seen from the sea-view rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Nybroviken bay and the French windows stay closed, so guests watch the wet ferries from inside the room.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Stockholm, and from the arched windows lightning shows the Royal Dramatic Theatre across the water for a second.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Nybroviken today, and from the sea-view rooms the Royal Dramatic Theatre on the far side is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the moored vessels in the bay, and the balcony outside the room is white and empty.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold outside, so the French windows stay shut and guests look at the bright bay from the tufted chairs.
phrases.very_hot: On this very hot day the balcony's red geraniums get full sun, and the ferries on Nybroviken look busy.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and Andy's Cocktail Bar still has its harbour view over Nybroviken and the moored vessels.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so the church spires beyond the bay are not visible, though the Royal Dramatic Theatre across the water is.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, the Deluxe Sea View windows frame moored boats and their lights on Nybroviken, easy to watch for hours.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the Deluxe Sea View windows tonight, and the lights along Nybroviken bay shine on the wet water.
phrases.grey_evening: Under tonight's low cloud, the quay lights around Nybroviken bay show in the water from the Deluxe Sea View rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sagrada Família is already a dark shape from the ninth-floor terraces, with the sky clear above Barcelona.
phrases.clear_morning: From the La Dolce Vitae rooftop, guests see the Sagrada Família in clear morning sunlight, with nothing in the way.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun reaches the whole rooftop pool, and the Sagrada Família stands sharply visible across the city under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sunlight falls on the Passeig de Gràcia, and the orange seating on the rooftop terrace looks even more orange than usual.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the illuminated Sagrada Família from the rooftop, with a clear sky over Barcelona.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Sagrada Família this morning, but from the ninth-floor penthouse terraces it stays fully in view.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun alternate over the Passeig de Gràcia this afternoon, seen from the rooftop terrace with its orange seating.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken clouds turn orange in the low evening sun behind the Sagrada Família, watched from the lounge seating by the rooftop pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Sagrada Família is still visible from the rooftop terrace, just without any shadows today.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop pool and terrace, so guests watch the city from their bedroom windows instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the La Dolce Vitae rooftop is empty, and lightning over Barcelona is best watched from a bedroom window.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Barcelona blurs the Sagrada Família today, and from the ninth-floor terraces its outline is only faintly visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Barcelona, a rare sight, and from the rooftop terrace the Sagrada Família shows through the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air on the ninth-floor terraces today, so guests check the clear Sagrada Família sightline quickly and go back inside.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the rooftop pool is the busiest place in the hotel, with the Sagrada Família visible beyond.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night on La Dolce Vitae: the pool is lit, and so is the Sagrada Família across Barcelona.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the air is not clear enough to show the Sagrada Família from the rooftop, though the Passeig de Gràcia is visible.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the ninth-floor penthouse lights are off, and the only light inside comes from Passeig de Gràcia below.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, the ninth-floor penthouse windows show the Sagrada Família's spires through the rain and the wet lights of Passeig de Gràcia.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner after midnight, a ninth-floor penthouse window frames the Sagrada Família spires under low cloud, lit city around them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop infinity pool is empty and the sea beyond the golf course is still dark grey.
phrases.clear_morning: From the guest room windows, the golf course is bright green and the Caribbean already shows its turquoise colour.
phrases.clear_midday: Under the slatted pergola of an Inspira suite terrace, guests have shade while the sea below is at its brightest.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the rooftop pool, the golf course and the tree line run down to the sea in low clear sun.
phrases.clear_night: From a rooftop terrace daybed, a clear night means stars overhead and the sea reduced to a dark flat shape.
phrases.partly_morning: If you were there this morning, you would see cloud shadows moving across the golf course from the room windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the Caribbean this afternoon, so the turquoise seen from the teak lounge chairs comes and goes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds above the rooftop pool take on orange, with the jungle canopy going dark.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Cancún today, so the sea past the golf course looks green-grey rather than turquoise from the suites.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the golf course and the sea, and most guests are inside one of the 13 restaurants.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Caribbean is visible from the room windows, and nobody is on the rooftop daybed right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water, so from the Inspira terrace the golf course is clear but the sea is a pale blur.
phrases.snow: Snow in Cancún would be a first; the rooftop infinity pool would be the strangest place to watch it fall.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold is rare in Cancún; the teak lounge chairs stay empty and guests look at the sea through the glass doors.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot today, and the rooftop infinity pool above the sea is where the Inspira guests spend the afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: Late tonight, under a cloudy mild sky, the rooftop pool above the Caribbean lies quiet at Atelier Playa Mujeres.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the golf course shows from the room windows but the far line of the sea does not.
phrases.late_night: Up for water near midnight, the Caribbean is heard beyond the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows after midnight, and the resort's lights show as soft spots through the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud drifts over the Caribbean, and from the Inspira suites the resort's pool lights show through the haze.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Story Bridge lights are still on, and the river below the windows is dark and flat.
phrases.clear_morning: Early swimmers in the 3rd-floor pool get a clear view of Story Bridge and the Kangaroo Point Cliffs in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the Brisbane River, and the gym windows frame Story Bridge in bright light.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun falls on the Kangaroo Point Cliffs, and from the rooftop terrace the river turns a warmer colour.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight Story Bridge is lit over the dark river, and a guest in the Stamford Suite can see it from the piano.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning clouds move over Brisbane, so the moored sailboats below the room windows are in sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the 3rd-floor pool this afternoon, the city skyline is half in cloud shadow and half in sun across the river.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud sits above Story Bridge and the moored sailboats on the Brisbane River.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Brisbane River looks grey too, but Story Bridge and the cliffs are still visible from every room.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the river and the moored sailboats, while the rooftop terrace lounge seating sits empty and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the Stamford Suite tonight watch lightning flash over the Brisbane River as rain streaks the panoramic windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the Brisbane River today, and the Kangaroo Point Cliffs across the water look faded from the room windows.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never happens in Brisbane, but if it did fall today, guests would watch it over the river from their rooms.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold and clear over Brisbane today, so the cliffs and Story Bridge look unusually sharp through the room windows.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot Brisbane day, the 3rd-floor pool with its bridge view is probably the busiest spot in the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the room windows the purple lights on Story Bridge stand out over the river.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Brisbane River and the sailboats nearby are clear, but the far city buildings are not.
phrases.late_night: Were you in the Stamford Suite tonight, you would be asleep, and the Brisbane River would fill the panoramic windows at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in the Stamford Suite tonight, you would see Story Bridge through rain over the river.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in your room now, you would see city lights on the Brisbane River under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Deluxe with Sea View rooms look onto a dark Stockholms ström, with Skeppsholmen Island only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunrise over Stockholms ström is the reason to pick a Deluxe with Sea View room, and this morning it is clear.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the binoculars on the room desk are useful for sailboats on the water outside.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the Old Town rooftops seen from the Balcony rooms, while the waterfront side stays bright until sunset.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit windows of Gamla Stan's red-brick waterfront buildings show above the water of Stockholms ström.
phrases.partly_morning: From the window seat, this morning shows a docked vessel and Gamla Stan's red-brick buildings under broken cloud.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over Stockholms ström this afternoon, so the sailboats outside the desk window move between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the suite's French doors open onto Old Town rooftops, half of them already in shadow.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the harbour today, and from the tall room windows the water looks flat and colourless.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows of the rooms, and the waterfront buildings across the harbour look darker than usual.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the window seat is the obvious place to be, with lightning showing over Stockholms ström for a moment.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the water today means Skeppsholmen Island is hard to make out, even from the Deluxe with Sea View rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Old Town rooftops outside the Balcony rooms, and the balconies themselves are white too.
phrases.very_cold: It feels well below freezing outside, so the suite's French doors stay shut and the rooftop view is seen through glass.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day for Stockholm, the suite's French doors stand open and the Old Town rooftops sit in full sun.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night over Gamla Stan, and the docked vessel outside the window seat is still easy to pick out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Skeppsholmen Island is not clear from the Sea View rooms, though the harbour water is.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the curtain stays open in a Deluxe with Sea View room, and Gamla Stan's quay lights show on the water.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain streaks the tall glass, and lit windows show here and there across the wet Old Town rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner over, the Deluxe with Sea View windows show Gamla Stan's waterfront lights reflected in Stockholms ström under low midnight cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the caldera is still black water from the suite terraces, and the volcano is hard to make out.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light is on the volcano and Thirassia island, seen from the suite terraces across a calm blue caldera.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the shade sails over the plunge pool terraces are useful, and the Aegean below looks deep blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lowers over the caldera, and the Lycabettus Restaurant tables face the volcano directly before dinner service.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would sit in a heated hot tub under a clear sky, the dark caldera below.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the caldera this morning, and their shadows move across the water seen from the cave suites.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Through the white arched opening of the indoor plunge pool, the caldera shows patches of sun and patches of cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud sits over the volcano in the last hour of sun, and the terrace daybeds face it directly.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the caldera loses its deep blue, but the volcano and Thirassia island stay clearly visible from the terraces.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the terraces today, and the caldera stays in view from the indoor plunge pool behind its white arch.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the cave suite terrace, lightning over the caldera shows the volcano and Thirassia island for a moment above the dark sea.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the caldera makes the volcano less sharp today, and Thirassia island is only a faint outline from the terraces.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Oia, but today flakes fall past the terrace doors while the heated hot tubs stay warm.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air today, but the caldera is sharp from the suite windows and the heated hot tubs are still in use.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat guests stay in the private plunge pools under the shade sails, and the Aegean below is very bright.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under a cloudy sky, and dinner at Lycabettus Restaurant goes on with the volcano as a dark shape.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor today, and the volcano across the caldera cannot be seen from the terraces, only the nearer cliffs.
phrases.late_night: Whoever wakes for a glass of water in a cave suite near midnight finds a few lights across the caldera below.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the cave suites probably watch rain on the terrace doors tonight, the lights of Oia spread along the caldera cliff.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the cave suites are probably in bed now, cloud low over the caldera and Oia's lights along the cliff.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the high-floor windows show both falls as pale shapes, with the Horseshoe's mist already rising.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Horseshoe Falls directly below, and guests in the king rooms can see the gorge clearly.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the floor-to-ceiling windows show Horseshoe Falls and its white mist in strong sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the Fallsview King Suite now, you would watch low sun colour the mist from the window seating area.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the sky above both falls is dark, and the jetted tub in the Regency Suite faces at them.
phrases.partly_morning: Patches of morning sun move across the Horseshoe and American Falls, watched from the Fallsview King Suite's window seating area.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, gaps in the cloud light up the Horseshoe briefly, then the mist turns grey again outside the queen rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the gorge leave the falls partly in shade, seen from the high floors.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, both falls are still clearly visible from the upper rooms, just without any shadows or shine.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the falls below carry on much as usual, only a little blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the gorge now, and guests in the restaurant dining room watch lightning above the Horseshoe through the glass.
phrases.fog_haze: If you were at a floor-to-ceiling window now, you would see the Horseshoe Falls fade into fog partway down the gorge.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past forty-two floors of windows, and the restaurant dining room looks straight onto a white, half-frozen Horseshoe.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is below freezing, and ice builds along the edges of the Horseshoe, clear to see from the king rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Niagara Falls today, and the mist from the Horseshoe, seen from the Regency Suite tub, looks almost useful.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night over the gorge, and the Fallsview King Suite's window seat looks down at both falls in the dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the Horseshoe below is clear from the rooms but the American Falls are only a faint outline.
phrases.late_night: Past one, lights across the gorge show the Horseshoe's white water, hard to stop watching.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at STK Steakhouse Fallsview, rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the Fallsview Regency Suite above the Horseshoe Falls.
phrases.grey_evening: After a late dinner at STK Steakhouse Fallsview, the Regency Suite window shows the Fallsview district lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Acropolis is a dark shape above Plaka, seen from the suite balconies under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop terrace, morning sun lights the Acropolis clearly, and the olive plants throw short shadows on the floor.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong, and a Deluxe Suite balcony shows the Acropolis, Hadrian's Arch and the Temple of Olympian Zeus.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see the Acropolis turning gold in the late sun.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear, and from the rooftop terrace, among the olive plants, the Acropolis stands out against the dark.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the Acropolis this morning, and the Greek flag near Hadrian's Arch is visible from the balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over Plaka this afternoon, and the Executive Suite balconies show Hadrian's Arch in changing light.
phrases.partly_golden: Just before sunset, broken clouds turn orange above the Acropolis, and the rooftop terrace is the place to watch it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Acropolis looks flat and pale from the balconies, but Hadrian's Arch is still easy to pick out.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the narrow Plaka street below the iron balconies, and the Acropolis is blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Athens means guests watch the lightning above the Acropolis from inside their suites, not from the balconies.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Athens today, so the Acropolis is a faint outline from the rooftop terrace and the hills beyond are hidden.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Athens, but today white flakes are falling past the suite windows with the Acropolis behind them.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside today, and the rooftop terrace is empty, though the Acropolis view is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: The air over Plaka is very hot this afternoon, and guests look at the Acropolis from inside their suites, not the balconies.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night like this one, guests sit on the rooftop terrace with wine, facing the dark Acropolis.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Hadrian's Arch below is clear but the hills beyond the Greek flag are not visible.
phrases.late_night: The Deluxe Suite lights are off at two, so the only glow in the room comes from the streets around the Acropolis.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtain open in the Executive Suite after midnight, the Acropolis shows through the rain beyond the wet lights of Plaka.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open after midnight, the Executive Suite window shows the lit streets of Plaka and the Acropolis under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over the Atlantic is already lighter than the boardwalk below the oceanfront balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunrise comes straight out of the sea here, so every one of the 156 balconies catches it directly.
phrases.clear_midday: From the higher floors at midday, the surf break is a clear white line between the beach and the open Atlantic.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon puts the sun behind the hotel, so the balcony lounge chairs sit in shade while the beach stays bright.
phrases.clear_night: At night the boardwalk lights are visible from the balconies, and beyond them the Atlantic is simply dark.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds hang over the ocean this morning, and the two outdoor pools are open below the balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the patio umbrellas, but the palm trees and the sea are in sunlight most of the afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: From the balcony lounge chairs, the broken cloud over the Atlantic catches the last low sun from the land side.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlantic looks grey too, and the higher-floor view ends at a flat horizon.
phrases.rain: Rain keeps most guests inside today, where the studios and suites with kitchens make a long wet day easier.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Atlantic is best watched from a king room with the balcony door closed.
phrases.fog_haze: From the oceanfront balconies, the surf break fades into daytime fog beyond the sand and the two pools.
phrases.snow: A rare snowfall covers the sand between the boardwalk and the surf, seen from every oceanfront balcony.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air outside means the balcony doors stay shut, though the view of the Atlantic is as wide as ever.
phrases.very_hot: Guests on the oceanfront balconies this afternoon look down through heat-haze at the two pools and the Atlantic beyond.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night the patio market lights are on, and the Atlantic beyond is heard more than seen.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today: from the balconies the beach and surf break are clear, but the far horizon is not.
phrases.late_night: Past one in the morning, the boardwalk lights show the white surf from the king rooms.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the king room glass after dinner at Ocean 27, and the boardwalk lights blur over the wet sand.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner is over after midnight, and from the king rooms the boardwalk lights show under low cloud while the surf rolls in.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the marina is quiet from the north-facing rooms, moored yachts still dark and the sky slowly turning pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From a higher south-facing room, the Atlantic looks flat and blue this morning, and the first loungers at Purobeach are already taken.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun on the freeform pool means most guests are in the water or under the palm trees beside it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a south balcony now, you would see low sun on the Atlantic and long shadows on the sand.
phrases.clear_night: At night a south-facing balcony faces only dark Atlantic and a clear sky of stars, while the marina side stays busier.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds are passing over the marina this morning, so the yachts seen from north-facing rooms move in and out of shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The beachfront restaurant has a mixed sky behind its straw umbrellas this afternoon, and the sea changes colour with each cloud.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds over the Atlantic turn orange, best seen from the higher south-facing floors.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky today, so the Atlantic from the south rooms looks grey too, and the sun loungers at Purobeach are mostly empty.
phrases.rain: From the north-facing windows, rain falls on the moored yachts and the dark water of Vilamoura marina.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Atlantic is a good reason to stay inside, and the south-facing rooms have the clearest view of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water today, so the Atlantic horizon is hard to find even from the higher south-facing floors.
phrases.snow: Snow in Vilamoura is almost unheard of, but if it were falling now, the pale sand at Purobeach would briefly look paler.
phrases.very_cold: From the south-facing balconies, hard winter light falls on the empty Purobeach loungers and the Atlantic beyond.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot this afternoon, and the thatched parasols on the beach are the most wanted spots, followed closely by the pools.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, with the beachfront restaurant's woven pendant lights on and the sea dark behind the straw umbrellas.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Limited visibility today: the marina and yachts are clear from north rooms, but the Atlantic horizon on the south side is not.
phrases.late_night: If you were in a marina room tonight, you could leave the curtain open and fall asleep facing the boat lights.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink at the window of a marina room, you would see the yacht lights through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were finishing a last glass in a north-facing room now, you would see the marina lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: The London Eye is still lit before sunrise, easy to pick out through the bar windows on the sixteenth floor.
phrases.clear_morning: A clear morning puts the BT Tower, the London Eye and The Shard in sharp focus from the window seat.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday in the rooftop bar, sunlight reaches the trailing greenery and every tower on the skyline is clearly visible.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights one side of The Shard, seen from Madera's floor-to-ceiling windows across the rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear, and the corner room windows show the London Eye lit in colour across the city.
phrases.partly_morning: This morning, patches of cloud move over Marylebone, and their shadows cross the rooftops below the sixteenth-floor bar.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the window seat this afternoon, The Shard is in sun while a cloud sits above the London Eye.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun on The Nest rooftop turns the gaps between clouds orange above the London rooftops.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Madera's windows still show The Shard and the London Eye, just without any shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the large room windows, and the London Eye looks slightly blurred through the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, guests in the 16th-floor bar can watch lightning over the skyline from behind floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides The Shard completely today, so the view from the window seat stops at the nearest rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on The Nest rooftop, and the London rooftops below the room windows are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day the air is clear, and the BT Tower and The Shard look sharp from the corner room.
phrases.very_hot: From The Nest rooftop, heat-haze shimmers over the Marylebone rooftops, with the London Eye small and bright beyond them.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night, and the Edison bulbs in the rooftop bar are on with the lit skyline behind them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means The Shard is only a faint grey shape seen through the windows of the sixteenth-floor bar.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the corner room is dark, and the only light left is the city in the window, the Eye's wheel in frame.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at Madera is over; after midnight, rain on the corner room window blurs the lit city around the London Eye's wheel.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Madera ended hours ago; from the window seat the London Eye's wheel shows against cloud over the lit city.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Chao Phraya is a dark band below the balconies, and the sky over Bangkok is clear.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool, the river and the Bangkok skyline are both sharp in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the umbrellas by the rooftop pool matter, because the sun over the Chao Phraya is very strong.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light comes straight through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites, with the Chao Phraya turning orange below.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the Bangkok skyline is lit up beyond the pool, seen from the beige seating of the rooftop lounge.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the river this morning, and guests on the Riverfront Premier balconies get sun in short intervals.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on a villa terrace this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows crossing the Chao Phraya between patches of sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds over the Chao Phraya, and the rooftop lounge is the obvious place to watch.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Bangkok today, and from the balconies the Chao Phraya looks brown and flat, the skyline without colour.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Chao Phraya right now, and guests watch it from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Bangkok means the balconies are empty, and the lightning over the river is watched from behind the suite windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Bangkok today softens the skyline from the rooftop pool, though the Chao Phraya directly below stays clear enough to see.
phrases.snow: Snow in Bangkok would be a first, so if it were falling now, all 101 balconies would be occupied.
phrases.very_cold: If you were at the floor-to-ceiling window now, you would see hard winter light on the Chao Phraya below the balconies.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the Chao Phraya, and most guests have moved from the balconies into the rooftop pool.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and the 101 balconies facing the Chao Phraya are comfortable places to sit late.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far Bangkok skyline is missing from the rooftop, but the Chao Phraya below is still visible.
phrases.late_night: Were you in a Riverfront Premier now, you might leave the curtain open and fall asleep facing the lights on the Chao Phraya.
phrases.wet_evening: Over a last drink in the rooftop lounge, you would see rain falling on the Chao Phraya and the lit far bank.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in a Riverfront Premier tonight, you would see cloud over Bangkok and lights on the Chao Phraya.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the last stars fade in a clear sky above the Serra de Sintra beyond the Imperial Suite terrace.
phrases.clear_morning: From the king rooms, the terracotta roofs of Sintra villas are lit by the morning sun below the forested hills.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool is in full sun, and the white umbrellas over the loungers are the only shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the balcony wicker chairs, golfers on the final holes and the wooded hills behind them are lit by low afternoon sun.
phrases.clear_night: On the terrace bar, candles are lit under the slatted pergola and the wooded hills outside are completely dark.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cross the Serra de Sintra this morning, so the monastery chapel below the suite terraces is sometimes in shadow.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were there this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows moving across the golf course from the balcony chairs.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the historic tower beyond the golf course, seen from the marble soaking tub, between clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the forested hills seen from the suite lounge's curved windows look flat and dark green.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Serra de Sintra forest, and guests in the gym watch it through the floor-to-ceiling window.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the Sintra hills, and the suite terraces are empty while lightning shows the forest for a second.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Serra de Sintra today, and from the pool only the nearest pines on the hillside can be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Sintra, but today a thin layer covers the golf course and pine trees below the balconies.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold, clear day in the natural park, with empty pool loungers and a clearly visible Serra de Sintra.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, most guests are in the infinity pool, and the dense forest on the hillside looks completely still.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under a cloudy sky, and dinner at Midori ends with a walk back past the candlelit terrace bar.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the monastery chapel below the suite terraces is clear but the far Sintra ridges are not.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, with a glass of water poured, the Sintra suite windows show a few villa lights on the Serra de Sintra.
phrases.wet_evening: Past midnight, back from Midori, rain runs down the suite windows and a few villa lights show on the Sintra hillside.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Midori, the Sintra suite windows show a few villa lights on the hillside under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Palm Beach Junior Suites look out on a dark, flat Gulf with the Dubai skyline still lit.
phrases.clear_morning: From the thatched cabanas on the private beach, the morning water is already turquoise under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong, and guests on the shaded terrace keep to the wicker seats behind the latticed railings.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The outdoor pool is picking up the Dubai skyline as the sun drops toward the Gulf this afternoon.
phrases.clear_night: On the rooftop terrace tonight, the candles are lit and the Dubai Marina skyline is bright across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Gulf this morning, seen through the Moorish arched windows of the suite sitting areas.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the Palm Jumeirah crescent this afternoon, so the private plunge pools get sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the waterfront terrace, you would see the last sun turning the clouds pink and orange over the Gulf.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Gulf looks flat and pale from the guest room balconies, and the palms stand without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Palm Jumeirah crescent today, a rare event here, and guests watch it from the shaded terrace.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Arabian Gulf is visible from the suite sitting areas, and the outdoor pool is empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the water today, and from the Palm Beach Junior Suites the Dubai skyline is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Dubai, but if it fell, the thatched cabanas on the private beach would turn white.
phrases.very_cold: From the terrace, the white sun loungers sit empty in hard winter light, with the Dubai skyline across the water.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot today, so most guests are either in the private plunge pools or inside behind the arched windows.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers the sky on this warm night, and the candle-lit tables on the rooftop terrace face the Dubai Marina lights.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Dubai skyline is not in view from the waterfront terrace, only the nearest water and palms.
phrases.late_night: Room lights off in a Palm Beach Junior Suite, the Dubai skyline across the Gulf is the only light inside.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the arched suite windows, and the skyline lights across the Gulf look soft and blurred tonight.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the Gulf after midnight, and the Dubai skyline lights reflect in the water seen from the Palm Beach Junior Suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lake outside the Casa al Lago windows is a flat grey surface, with the hills still dark.
phrases.clear_morning: Sun reaches the tiered lawns early, and guests on the pool terrace can see the wooded hills across the water clearly.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the outdoor swimming pool is in full sun, and the lake below shows its blue colour under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the formal gardens, and the terrace above the lake is being set for dinner.
phrases.clear_night: From the terrace above the lake, stars fill the clear night sky over the dark water of Lake Como.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Moltrasio this morning, and from the suite's twin windows the lake changes colour as they move.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud, some sun on the pool terrace this afternoon, so the tall cedars throw shadows that come and go.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the hills across the lake in patches, seen from the Casa al Lago rooms.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the lake looks grey too, and guests are reading in the grand salon under the Murano chandelier.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the formal gardens today, while the glass roof keeps it off the indoor pool and its stone arch.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm sits over the lake, so dinner has moved indoors and guests watch the lightning from the salon windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the far shore today, and from the Casa al Lago only the nearest water is visible.
phrases.snow: Snow on the tiered lawns is rare at Lake Como, but today the cedars are white and the lake is very still.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air sits over the lake today, the gardens are empty, and guests look at the hills from the salon windows.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day the outdoor swimming pool is the busiest spot, with the tall cedars giving some shade.
phrases.mild_night: From a Casa al Lago window on this mild cloudy night, you would see the terrace lights shining on the lake water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the pool terrace the forested hills across the lake are not clearly in view.
phrases.late_night: Past midnight a few shore lights show on Lake Como from the Casa al Lago, and the lake will show fully at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the Casa al Lago windows, and the lake shows only in a few lights across the water.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, haze hangs over Lake Como, and the Casa al Lago windows show the far-shore lights blurred in it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the top-floor balconies face an empty Plaza de Catalunya under a clear dark sky, with almost nobody crossing yet.
phrases.clear_morning: When the blinds open in a top-floor room, the whole square is already bright, trees and fountains sharp in the sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests on the rooftop terrace can see the Sagrada Familia in the distance, with every umbrella up against the strong midday sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the top-floor balconies, low afternoon sun lights the stone fronts around Plaza de Catalunya and its fountains.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a top-floor balcony tonight, you would see the square lit below and a clear sky over the rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Barcelona this morning, and from the room windows the treetops of the square go bright, then dim, then bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The courtyard has sun on some white chairs and shade on others, depending on which cloud is passing over Barcelona.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the rooftop terrace gets a low orange light between clouds, with the Sagrada Familia far off.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the whole of Plaza de Catalunya today, so the view from the balconies is flat but still very wide.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the square and its fountains, and most guests are eating at Nineteen rather than on the balconies.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Barcelona empties the rooftop terrace, and the lightning over the square is watched from behind room windows instead.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the city today, so from the rooftop terrace the Sagrada Familia is only a faint outline, if that.
phrases.snow: Snow in Barcelona is rare, and today guests on the top-floor balconies watch it land on the trees of the square.
phrases.very_cold: Guests on the top-floor balconies look down at Plaza de Catalunya, its fountains and trees in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the umbrellas in the courtyard are where guests sit, with the stone walls giving some shade.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the balcony is comfortable for sitting out while the lights of Plaza de Catalunya stay on below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Sagrada Familia cannot be seen from the rooftop terrace, though the square itself is clear enough.
phrases.late_night: Only the lit fountains of Plaza de Catalunya give any light to the top floor at this late hour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the top-floor windows after midnight, and the lamps of Plaza de Catalunya show through it in blurred points.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the top-floor rooms tonight, and the lamps of Plaza de Catalunya show through the open curtains.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the castle silhouette is already dark against a clear sky from the top-floor dormer windows.
phrases.clear_morning: From the penthouse suite, St. Vitus Cathedral stands sharp on its hill this morning, with no cloud over New Town.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun lights the whole castle across New Town, and the rooftop windows of the private dining room show it clearly.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the outdoor terrace now, you would see the low sun turn the castle walls a warm colour.
phrases.clear_night: At night the castle is lit and easy to see from the top-floor rooms, with a clear sky above Prague.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over Hradčany this morning, but the cathedral towers are visible from the angled skylights of the guest rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud move over the city skyline this afternoon, so the castle appears and disappears from the penthouse suite.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day lights the castle between clouds, visible from the top-floor rooms across New Town.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Prague today, and the castle is a flat shape against it from the rooftop windows upstairs.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the dormer skylights of the top-floor rooms, and the castle across New Town is partly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Prague now, and from the top-floor rooms the castle shows briefly with each flash of lightning.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over New Town hides most of Prague Castle today; from the penthouse suite only the cathedral towers show faintly.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the roofs of New Town, and the heated bathroom floors upstairs are a practical detail today.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold and clear over Prague today, so the castle outline looks sharp from the angled skylights of the guest rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon in Prague; the outdoor terrace is in use, and the castle shows clearly in the dry air.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Prague, and guests on the outdoor terrace can see the lit castle across New Town.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today: the castle is a faint shape from the rooftop windows, and the cathedral towers cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: Past one, the penthouse windows show the castle skyline above the city lights, worth another hour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the penthouse suite's rooftop windows after midnight, and the wet city lights blur toward Prague Castle across New Town.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, haze drifts low past the penthouse suite's rooftop windows, and the castle outline shows above the lit city.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Herengracht outside the Brentano Suite's five windows is dark and still, with no boats moving yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the canal houses across the Herengracht, and the suite living room's tall windows show green treetops.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the rooftop terrace's white chairs face the old Amsterdam cityscape, with full sun on them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun comes through the dining room's garden-view windows, and the Herengracht water turns a warm colour before sunset.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Brentano Suite tonight, you would see lights from the canal houses reflected on the Herengracht.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Amsterdam this morning, so the treetops outside the bathroom window are sunny one minute and shaded the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of blue sky and cloud pass above the rooftop terrace, where guests on the white chairs look over the canal houses.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud lets light fall on the Herengracht in patches, seen from the suite's five windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the canal water looks grey too, and the Guerlain spa's indoor pool is a brighter place to be.
phrases.rain: From the Brentano Suite's five windows, rain falls on the Herengracht, with the lit canal houses reflected in the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Amsterdam; the rooftop terrace is empty, and the dining room windows show the garden in sudden flashes.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs over the Herengracht, so the canal houses on the far side appear only as faint shapes from the suite windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the canal houses and the treetops outside the bathroom window, a rare sight in Amsterdam.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air sits over Amsterdam, and guests on the rooftop terrace keep their coats on while looking at the canal houses.
phrases.very_hot: On this very hot day, the rooftop terrace's white chairs stand in full sun, and few guests sit there for long.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night on the Herengracht: the Brentano Suite's windows are open, and the canal is quiet below them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop terrace only the nearest canal houses are clear and the farther cityscape is not.
phrases.late_night: Dinner at Spectrum done, canal-house lights reflect in the Herengracht, seen from the Brentano Suite.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the five windows of the Brentano Suite, and the Herengracht looks wet and bright in the street lamps.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the Herengracht after midnight, and the Brentano Suite's five windows show lamp light on the canal.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sagrada Família is only a dark shape at the end of the Passeig de Gràcia from the rooftop.
phrases.clear_morning: From a balcony suite, the morning sun lights the trees along the Passeig de Gràcia and the historic buildings.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the umbrellas on the Mirador rooftop give the only shade, and the Sagrada Família stands sharp on the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Warm afternoon light comes through the tall room windows, and the Sagrada Família looks golden above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at the Mirador bar tonight, you would see the Sagrada Família lit at the end of the avenue.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Tibidabo this morning, while the Passeig de Gràcia below the rooftop is already in sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the rooftop terrace move between sun and cloud shade, with the Sagrada Família in view the whole time.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken clouds over the Sagrada Família turn orange with the setting sun, as seen from the wooden pergola on the rooftop.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Barcelona today, and the Sagrada Família is a pale outline from the rooftop bar.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Passeig de Gràcia, so the balcony suites' tall windows are the dry place to watch the avenue.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests at the tall room windows watch lightning flash over the Sagrada Família and the rooftops along Passeig de Gràcia.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Sagrada Família today; from the Mirador bar the Passeig de Gràcia fades out after a few blocks.
phrases.snow: Snow in Barcelona is rare, so a white layer on the rooftop's white furniture is something guests photograph from the pergola.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day the rooftop terrace is nearly empty, though the air is clear enough to see Tibidabo plainly.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon on the rooftop: the umbrellas and potted palms give some shade, but most guests come up only toward evening.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy late-night sky, the lights of the Passeig de Gràcia run from the Mirador rooftop toward the Sagrada Família.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the Mirador rooftop, the Passeig de Gràcia shows plainly through the haze, with the Sagrada Família out of sight today.
phrases.late_night: Long past two, the Passeig de Gràcia's lights lead to the Sagrada Família's spires.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain on the tall room windows blurs the avenue lamps, and the Sagrada Família towers show on the horizon.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner, the tall windows show the lamps of the Passeig de Gràcia and the Sagrada Família spires under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the harbour outside every balcony is still, and the floatplanes have not yet started their first flights.
phrases.clear_morning: If you stood on your balcony now, you would see floatplanes landing on the Inner Harbour under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The rooftop terrace chairs look over boats and the city skyline, and the Parliament dome is easy to pick out today.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the Parliament dome across the water, and ferries are turning at the point in front of the balconies.
phrases.clear_night: Diners at the AURA window tables see the blue bridge lit up across the dark harbour, cocktails in hand.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over Victoria's Inner Harbour this morning, and the two garden ponds below the rooms are calm.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooms, a floatplane lands on the Inner Harbour, with a few afternoon clouds over the dome and the boats.
phrases.partly_golden: Gaps in the cloud let the last sun reach the Parliament dome, seen from the water-level terrace at AURA.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the harbour today, but floatplanes still land in their lanes in view of every room.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Japanese garden and its two ponds, best watched from the tub in a marble bathroom.
phrases.thunderstorm: While the storm passes, floatplanes stop flying, and guests watch lightning over the harbour from behind floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: From the balconies, fog hides the far side of the Inner Harbour and leaves only the marina and the Japanese garden ponds.
phrases.snow: After midnight, snow falls past the balcony over the Inner Harbour, with the lit blue bridge glowing across the water.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, so the rooftop terrace chairs are empty while the harbour view stays clear.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot for Vancouver Island today, and the AURA terrace at water level is where guests watch the boats go by.
phrases.mild_night: Under mild cloud tonight, the evening lights of the Inner Harbour and the lit blue bridge show from every balcony.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the city skyline across the water is faint from the rooftop terrace, but the marina below is clear.
phrases.late_night: In the corner suites tonight the curtain is left open, and the city lights reflect in the harbour until sleep comes.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open in a Laurel corner suite, rain runs down the glass and the harbour lights blur across the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open in the Laurel wing corner suites tonight, and the harbour lights show on the water under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Queen's Necklace lights are still on along Marine Drive, seen from every sea-facing room.
phrases.clear_morning: From the blue velvet armchair by the large window, the Arabian Sea is bright and flat under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the rooftop infinity pool, and the white daybeds are mostly empty until later.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun is setting over the Arabian Sea, and a Seafront Corner Suite shows the full bay in three directions at once.

phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the Ringstrasse this morning, and the balcony rooms look down on Beethoven Park in changing light.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Scattered clouds pass behind the Gothic spire this afternoon, seen from guest rooms that face the city rooftops.
phrases.partly_golden: From the eighth-floor rooftop, low sun lights the St. Stephen's spire between scattered clouds over the city roofs.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the domes and spires are still clear from the eighth floor, only without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Beethoven Park, and the indoor pool with its blue-lit water is the busier place right now.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, lightning over the city rooftops can be watched from inside the guest rooms, not from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Vienna Hills and most domes today, so from the eighth floor only the cathedral spire is visible.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the flower planters of the rooftop bar, and Beethoven Park below the balconies turns white.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the Vienna Hills are sharp from the eighth floor, and the balconies stay empty.
phrases.very_hot: Strong, very hot sun covers the Ringstrasse and Beethoven Park, and the rooftop terrace has few guests before evening.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, guests sit outside at Atmosphere Rooftop Bar with the Karlskirche dome in view below the clouds.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the Vienna Hills cannot be seen, and the spires and domes look faded from the rooftop.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has a sixth-floor room tonight has likely left the curtain open on purpose, falling asleep to the lights along the Ringstrasse.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever is awake in a sixth-floor room after midnight watches rain run down the glass above the Ringstrasse lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the sixth-floor rooms after midnight can watch low cloud pass above the lit curve of the Ringstrasse.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea beyond the infinity pool is still dark, and the restaurant terrace has no guests yet.
phrases.clear_morning: From the floor-to-ceiling windows of a sea-facing room, the Mediterranean is blue and flat this morning, with nothing between room and water.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests on the white loungers at the private beach move under the thatched umbrellas for shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the palm trees on the restaurant terrace, and the sea view is at its clearest of the day.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars over the open water from the terrace of a ground-level sea room.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the distant Sicilian hills this morning, while the 60-yard infinity pool already has its first swimmers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the golf fairways this afternoon, so the sea seen from the restaurant terrace changes colour every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the Mediterranean gives the sunset view from the Sciacca terrace extra colour.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the whole coastline today, and the sea beyond the private beach looks silver rather than turquoise.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the olive groves and the fairways, and the restaurant terrace tables are empty for now.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Mediterranean right now, and guests watch the lightning from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of their rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water today, so from the beach loungers the horizon is not sharp and the hills are hidden.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on this coast, but today a few flakes land on the palm trees beside the outdoor pool.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day for Sicily, the sea is still blue from the room windows, but the beach loungers stay empty.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot across the 230 hectares today, and most guests are in the infinity pool or under the thatched umbrellas.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, dinner on the restaurant terrace goes on, with the sea audible but barely visible.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the distant Sicilian hills behind the pool are not visible, though the sea nearby is.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the sea-facing rooms have turned the lights off, and the window is the only pale light left, open water beyond.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in a terrace room after midnight can watch rain run down the tall windows toward the sea.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a terrace room after midnight watches low cloud drift over the private coastline, the sea breaking just beyond the glass.

phrases.clear_predawn: Over the Gulf the sky is clear and still black, and from the suite windows the Dubai Marina towers are lit.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Gulf-facing room, the morning sea is turquoise under a clear sky, with the Burj Al Arab small in the distance.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop infinity pool is in full sun, and the Palm Jumeirah residences below look sharp and bright.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last hours of sun, guests in Marina-facing rooms watch the Dubai Marina skyline turn orange and then grey.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Ain Dubai wheel is lit and easy to see from the rooms that face it.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds this morning make moving patches of shade on the Gulf outside the suite living room windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were at the rooftop pool this afternoon, you would see clouds passing over the Dubai skyline between stretches of sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun comes and goes behind clouds, changing the colour of the Gulf outside the marble bathroom window.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky today, the Gulf outside the Gulf-facing rooms looks flat and pale rather than turquoise.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare here, but today drops run down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites while the Gulf stays visible.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, lightning over the Gulf is visible from the upper floors, and the rooftop pool is empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water today hides the Burj Al Arab, so Gulf-facing rooms see only the nearer sea.
phrases.snow: If snow ever reached Palm Jumeirah, guests in the suites would watch it fall past floor-to-ceiling windows over the Gulf.
phrases.very_cold: A freezing day is rare in Dubai, so the rooftop infinity pool is quiet and the Marina skyline is very clear.
phrases.very_hot: Outside it is very hot today, so most guests stay behind the suite windows, where the Gulf still looks bright.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Ain Dubai wheel is lit all the way round for the rooms that face it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Burj Al Arab is not visible from the Gulf-facing rooms, only the nearer water.
phrases.late_night: With the lights off in the Marina-facing suites, the Dubai Marina skyline is the only light left inside.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from Sushi Samba, the Marina-facing rooms show the Dubai Marina skyline lights blurred by rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After a late dinner at Sushi Samba, the Marina-facing rooms show the skyline lights of Dubai Marina under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky is clear but still dark, and from the upper-floor windows the Powder Tower shows only as an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: From the suite terraces, morning sun lands on the Old Town spires and on the hedges of the courtyard garden.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, lunch tables in the garden restaurant stand between the hedges and the flower beds.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the Powder Tower, and upper-floor guests can watch it turn orange from their windows.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a suite, you would see the lit Old Town spires through the terrace doors under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over St. Henry's Tower this morning, seen from the upper floors, with sun between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the courtyard garden gets sun and shade in turns, and the peacock on the lawn does not seem to mind.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds block part of the low sun, so the Old Town spires look paler than usual from the suite terraces.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Prague today, so the Powder Tower from the upper rooms shows up flat and without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the garden terrace tables, so the indoor pool and the sauna are the busier places right now.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests at the Two Steps Bar hear the thunder but stay inside the palace walls, drinks intact.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over Prague hides the Powder Tower from the upper floors, so today the courtyard garden is the better view.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the courtyard hedges, and the soaking tub by the window looks like the sensible place to be.
