phrases.very_cold: Guests in the upper-floor rooms this morning look out past frost on the glass to the Powder Tower.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the tall trees of the courtyard garden give some shade over the terrace tables.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Prague, and the garden facade is lit while late cocktails continue at the Two Steps Bar.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the upper rooms the Powder Tower is clear but the farther Old Town spires are not.
phrases.late_night: If you had an upper-floor room tonight, you would sleep through the city lights, the Powder Tower at your window by dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Over a last cocktail at the Two Steps Bar tonight, you would see rain on the glass and wet city lights.
phrases.grey_evening: If you came up from a last cocktail at the Two Steps Bar, you would see the lit rooftops under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the two white chimneys of the National Palace are already a pale shape in the Junior Suite window.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is being served with the palace towers sharp in the window, no mist over Sintra this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the brass telescope beside the bed points at the Moorish Castle, clearly visible on the hill above.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the terracotta rooftops below the window seat orange, and the palace chimneys stay very white.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Junior Suite tonight, you would see the palace below and the castle above under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the forested ridge this morning, so the Moorish Castle appears and disappears from the second-floor window.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun move across the green hillside outside the window seat while guests finish a slow afternoon in their rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the palace chimneys are lit between clouds while the castle hill is already in shadow.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Sintra today, and from the breakfast table the palace towers look flat and pale.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the terracotta rooftops below, and the window seat is the driest place to watch the palace.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Sintra hills, and guests watch lightning above the Moorish Castle ridge from behind closed windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Sintra's Atlantic mist has come in, and from the Junior Suite the castle above is hidden while the palace chimneys remain.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Sintra, but today a few flakes fall past the window onto the terracotta rooftops below.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the Moorish Castle on its ridge is sharper than usual from the second floor.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, guests stay in their rooms and the hillside outside the window seat looks still in the heat.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Sintra, and from the window seat the palace chimneys are still easy to make out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Moorish Castle is not visible from the Junior Suite and only the palace chimneys below show.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Junior Suite window seat faces the town lights around the palace's two cone chimneys, mist drifting through.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtain open after midnight, rain runs down the Junior Suite window and the palace chimneys show above the wet, lit rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: The Junior Suite curtain is open after midnight, and the village lights show under low mist around the National Palace chimneys.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Eiffel Tower is already a dark shape against a clear sky from the four Premium balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on a Premium balcony comes with pastries, coffee and the Eiffel Tower standing above the tree canopies in clear sunshine.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the open French doors of a Premium room frame the tower in full sun, no cloud anywhere.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a Premium balcony now, you would see the late sun lighting one side of the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.clear_night: From the balconies tonight, the illuminated Eiffel Tower stands against a clear dark sky, with the Paris streets below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Eiffel Tower this morning, so the tree canopies between the balconies and the tower are lit in patches.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the tower goes in and out of shadow as clouds move, easy to follow from a Premium room.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud behind the Eiffel Tower turns orange, seen from the four small balconies.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the Eiffel Tower today, which makes the teal walls of the rooms look brighter by comparison.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Champ de Mars, so the balcony breakfast moves inside, behind the closed French doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, guests in the Premium rooms watch lightning near the Eiffel Tower from behind closed French doors.
phrases.fog_haze: The upper half of the Eiffel Tower is in fog today; from a Premium balcony only the base shows above the trees.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the small balconies and on the Champ de Mars, with the Eiffel Tower grey behind it.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, so the Eiffel Tower view is enjoyed through the glass of the French doors today.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the walk across the Champ de Mars to the tower looks longer from a Premium balcony.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and guests with Premium balconies can sit outside with the lit Eiffel Tower in front of them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Only a faint grey outline of the Eiffel Tower shows from the balconies today; its top cannot be made out.
phrases.late_night: Up past midnight in a Premium room, you might watch the tower instead of sleeping.
phrases.wet_evening: With a last drink in a Premium room tonight, you would see the Eiffel Tower through rain on the French doors.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last glass in a Premium room, you would see the tower's shape above the city lights under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Under a clear sky before dawn, Puget Sound is a dark flat shape seen from the soaking tubs in water-view rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Elliott Bay, and the port cranes stand out sharply from the soaking tub window of the suite bathroom.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Elliott Bay lies blue past the port cranes below the Grand Corner Junior Suite windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the Grand Corner Junior Suite now, you would see low sun across Elliott Bay and the cranes.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the downtown skyline is lit under a clear sky, visible through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the guest rooms.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Grand Corner Junior Suite, morning sun falls between scattered clouds onto Elliott Bay and the port cranes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the suite dining table this afternoon, the clouds over Elliott Bay move slowly and the light changes often.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in the Grand Corner Junior Suite now, you would see low sun on Elliott Bay under broken cloud.
phrases.overcast: From the floor-to-ceiling windows, Elliott Bay lies grey under a low overcast sky, with the port cranes along the water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Elliott Bay, and guests in the glass-walled bathrooms watch it from the warm water of the tub.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Puget Sound right now, and guests probably leave the suite privacy shade up to watch the lightning.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs over Elliott Bay today, and from the suite bathroom window even the port cranes are only grey outlines.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Seattle, a rare event, and the red-brick building below the suite bathroom window is turning white.
phrases.very_cold: From the suite bathroom window, hard winter light falls on Elliott Bay and the port cranes.
phrases.very_hot: Seattle is very hot today, unusual for the city, and guests are using the Topgolf Swing Suite simulator instead of walking outside.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Seattle, and the suite dining area, fireplace lit, looks out on a dark Elliott Bay.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests at the soaking tub this afternoon see the near water of Elliott Bay, but not the far shore.
phrases.late_night: If you turned the Grand Corner Junior Suite lights off now, the port lights on Elliott Bay would fill the room.
phrases.wet_evening: Having a last drink in the Grand Corner Junior Suite now, you would see Elliott Bay's lights blur behind the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a nightcap in a water-view room tonight, you would see the shore lights under low cloud over Elliott Bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the 21st-floor Deluxe Room City View shows a dark skyline with only a few lit office windows.
phrases.clear_morning: From the spa treatment room, the red broadcast tower stands out sharply against a clear morning sky over São Paulo.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the oval pool has no shade at all, so guests on the wood deck move under the palms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the arched windows of Seen Restaurant, and the high-rises across São Paulo turn a warm orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at the rooftop bar tonight, you would see car lights moving along Avenida Paulista far below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over São Paulo this morning, and the tree canopy below the suite living room falls in and out of shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some high-rises are in sun and others in cloud shadow this afternoon, seen from a 21st-floor Deluxe Room City View.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the undersides of the clouds above the skyline, a good moment for a seat at Seen.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the green park below the guest room windows looks dull and the high-rises lose their shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the guest rooms, and the wood pool deck is empty today.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the São Paulo skyline is visible from Seen Restaurant, where diners stay dry behind the arched windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far high-rises today; from the spa treatment room the red broadcast tower is only a faint shape.
phrases.snow: Snow in São Paulo almost never happens, but today the 23rd-floor windows at Seen show a few flakes over the skyline.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare freezing day, nobody uses the outdoor pool, and the palms on the deck look out of place.
phrases.very_hot: The afternoon is very hot in São Paulo, and the unshaded oval pool between the high-rises is the busiest spot.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars on this mild night, but from the rooftop bar São Paulo's city lights are as bright as usual.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the 22nd-floor Presidential Suite the far edge of the skyline cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: Guests on the 21st floor are likely asleep now, and the skyline lights fill their windows until the sun comes up.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the twenty-first-floor Deluxe Rooms are probably asleep now, the São Paulo skyline lights blurred by rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a 21st-floor Deluxe Room City View tonight can watch the São Paulo skyline lights shine under the cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Tokyo Tower rises as a dark outline against a clear paling sky, with city lights below the lobby windows.
phrases.clear_morning: On a clear morning like this one, Tokyo Tower and Mount Fuji are both visible from the lobby windows.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun falls on Tokyo Tower, and guests in the high-floor lounge see the whole skyline without one cloud.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a guest room now, you would watch the sky behind Tokyo Tower turn orange toward sunset.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the Artist-in-Residence rooms late tonight look out over the city lights spread below Tokyo Tower under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Tokyo this morning, but Tokyo Tower stays clearly visible from the lounge bar windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the Artist-in-Residence rooms this afternoon have painted walls inside and broken clouds over Tokyo Tower outside.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds orange over Tokyo Tower, seen from the front desk windows on the 25th floor.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Tokyo today, so the lounge view is a dull Tokyo Tower and no Mount Fuji at all.
phrases.rain: From the guest rooms, Tokyo Tower looks blurred today through wet floor-to-ceiling glass, and Mount Fuji is hidden by rain.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Tokyo means lightning near Tokyo Tower, watched from inside the 25th-floor lobby or the lounge bar.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the skyline today, and Tokyo Tower shows only as a pale outline from the high-floor lounge.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Tokyo, a rare sight, and guests on the 34th floor watch flakes pass in front of Tokyo Tower.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air over Tokyo today usually means clear views, and Mount Fuji is visible from the lobby windows.
phrases.very_hot: Heat sits over Tokyo today, and the air above the city looks hazy around Tokyo Tower from the guest rooms.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night like this, Tokyo Tower is lit in orange under the clouds, seen from the guest rooms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Tokyo Tower is clear from the lounge but Mount Fuji is not visible at all.
phrases.late_night: After midnight in an Artist-in-Residence room, the curtain stays open on purpose, Tokyo Tower framed among the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight rain slides down the lobby windows, and the city lights blur on the side where Tokyo Tower stands.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the top of Tokyo Tower after midnight, and the city lights look soft and hazy from the Artist-in-Residence rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Douro is dark and still outside the first-floor rooms, and the infinity pool has no swimmers yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the white Baroque facade, and the first lounge chairs by the outdoor pool face a clear sky over Porto.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool edge meets a bright blue Douro, and a cruise boat may pass below the second-floor windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches the poolside gazebo, where guests in rattan seats look at the green hills across the Douro.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the city lights make long reflections on the Douro, seen from the infinity pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds and sun alternate over the Douro this morning, and the river view from the restaurant changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the infinity pool this afternoon, broken cloud sits over the Douro and a bridge stands beyond the water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky above the Douro, seen from the second-floor rooms.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Porto today, so the Douro looks flat and silver from the restaurant tables by the window.
phrases.rain: Steady rain falls on the Douro today, and most guests have moved from the outdoor pool to the heated indoor pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the river is visible from the first-floor rooms right now, while the outdoor pool stays empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs over the Douro today, and from the gazebo the green hills on the other bank are only a faint shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Porto, but a few flakes fall on the lounge chairs while the sauna and Turkish bath stay warm.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, most guests choose the sauna over the outdoor pool, though the Douro view is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Porto, so the shaded gazebo and the infinity pool are the popular places for watching the Douro.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy in Porto, and city lights still reflect on the river beside the infinity pool.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the Douro is clear in front of the pool, but the bridge and the far hills are not.
phrases.late_night: Guests on the second floor are probably asleep now, city lights on the Douro outside, the river back in view at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake on the second floor after midnight watches the rain slide down the window, city lights blurred on the Douro.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake on the second floor after midnight watches low cloud move over the Douro, the city lights showing in the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the glass doors of each suite show a dark Atlantic and the outline of Lion's Head against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool deck, the Twelve Apostles stand sharp in morning sun while Camps Bay beach below is still nearly empty.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the rooftop pool, and most guests are on loungers under the shade umbrellas.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At the Baptiste rooftop bar, the sun is dropping toward the Atlantic and every seat facing the water is taken.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight guests sit in their terrace jacuzzis under a clear sky, with the Atlantic dark and the beach quiet below.
phrases.partly_morning: If you were on your private terrace this morning, you would see broken cloud over Lion's Head and sun on the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the Twelve Apostles this afternoon, seen from the loungers on the rooftop pool deck.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns clouds over Camps Bay orange, and the Baptiste rooftop is the busiest place in the hotel.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud sits low on the Twelve Apostles today, and the suites' glass doors show a flat sea under a dull sky.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Camps Bay beach, and guests watch it through the sliding glass doors instead of from their terraces.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Atlantic has emptied the rooftop pool deck, and the storm is best watched from behind a suite's glass doors.
phrases.fog_haze: Sea fog hides Lion's Head today, and from the suites only the near end of Camps Bay beach is visible.
phrases.snow: Snow in Camps Bay is very rare, but today the Twelve Apostles have white tops when seen from the rooftop pool deck.
phrases.very_cold: If you stood at the sliding glass, you would see Lion's Head in hard winter light above an empty Camps Bay beach.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Camps Bay, and on the rooftop deck nobody moves far from the pool or the shade umbrellas.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Camps Bay, with diners under the wooden pergola and the beach dark beyond the parked cars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor today, and from the rooftop pool deck the Twelve Apostles are only a faint outline in the distance.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the sliding glass of the suites shows the lights of Camps Bay, and at dawn it will show Lion's Head.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the sliding glass of the suites, and the lights of Camps Bay blur beneath the outline of Lion's Head.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs low over Lion's Head after midnight, and the Camps Bay street lamps show through the suites' floor-to-ceiling glass.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gulf outside the low-rise rooms is still dark, and the beach below the balconies is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From the four-poster suites, floor-to-ceiling windows show the Arabian Gulf already turquoise, with Palm Jumeirah clear in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the Arabian Gulf lies flat and turquoise beyond the white sand of the private beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a balcony now, you would watch the Gulf turn orange-pink with the Ain Dubai wheel beyond.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the Gulf is clear, and from upper floors Ain Dubai stands out against the dark water.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit over Bluewaters Island this morning, seen from the beach, while the lazy river pool is already in use.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the palm gardens this afternoon, giving short breaks of shade to guests floating along the lazy river pool.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the thatched beach pavilion, and a few clouds take on the same orange-pink as the Gulf.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Gulf looks flat and pale from the suite windows, and Ain Dubai is a dull outline.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Dubai, but today it is falling on the private beach and the lazy river pool below the rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the balconies, lightning flashes over the Arabian Gulf beyond the Ain Dubai wheel and Bluewaters Island.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the water today, and from the beach Ain Dubai is only a faint shape across the Gulf.
phrases.snow: If snow ever fell on this beach, guests on the balconies would be the first to photograph it.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold day, the Gulf still looks turquoise from the suite windows, but nobody is in the shallow surf.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat the lazy river pool through the palm gardens is the busiest place on the property.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night covers the JBR beachfront, and the beach tables at Caña by Tamoka are full with no stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the suite windows the near water is clear but Palm Jumeirah cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: With every light in the four-poster suite switched off, the only glow now comes from Bluewaters Island across the water.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Caña by Tamoka, the suite windows show rain over the Gulf and the Ain Dubai wheel on the horizon.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner at Caña by Tamoka, the suite windows show the Ain Dubai wheel on the horizon under a hazy sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the bay outside the upper-floor windows is still dark, with Coronado Island a flat shape across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From the outdoor yoga terrace, the water is bright and Coronado Island shows clearly under a sky with no clouds.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun on San Diego Bay, and from the double queen rooms the USS Midway sits in full daylight.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the low sun colouring the bay from the Vistal rooftop tables.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the string lights are on at the rooftop terrace, with the Coronado Bridge a line of lights to the south.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over the bay this morning, and from the wellness centre training floor Coronado Island is clear across the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over Coronado Island this afternoon, and from the suite living rooms the marina goes from shade to sun and back.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the edges of the clouds above San Diego Bay, seen from the Vistal rooftop bar.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the whole bay today, and from the upper-floor rooms Coronado Island looks flat and colourless.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Embarcadero, so the yoga terrace is empty and guests watch the wet bay from their windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, lightning over San Diego Bay is visible through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the upper-floor rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the bay today, and from the rooftop terrace Coronado Island is hidden; only the near water shows.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in San Diego, but a few flakes over the bay would be a strange sight from the Vistal tables.
phrases.very_cold: On this unusually cold day, the patio heaters on the rooftop terrace matter more than the bay view in front of them.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over the Embarcadero today, so the outdoor yoga terrace is empty and the bay is in hard, flat light.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night on the rooftop terrace, where guests sit under the string lights with Coronado Island dark across the bay.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; from the upper-floor rooms Coronado Island is a faint shape and the Coronado Bridge is not visible.
phrases.late_night: Guests on the upper floors have turned everything off by now, and only the Coronado lights across the bay show.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has an upper-floor bay room tonight can watch rain run down the glass, Coronado's lights blurred across the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has an upper-floor bay room tonight sees the lights of Coronado under low cloud across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the twin towers of Týn Church are a dark shape against a clear sky from the 8th-floor Powder Tower Suite.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lands on the Old Town's red roofs, clearly seen from the rattan chairs on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, Prague Castle sits sharp on its hill in the view from the Powder Tower Suite.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun deepens the colour of the terracotta rooftops, and from the balcony the Týn Church towers throw long shadows.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the balcony tonight, you would see the lit rooftops of the Old Town under a clear dark sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered morning clouds pass over Prague Castle, and the castle silhouette is lit and shaded in turn from the 8th floor.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the rooftop terrace this afternoon watch patches of sun move across the red Old Town rooftops between clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the Týn Church towers from the side while clouds above the rooftops turn orange.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Prague today, the red rooftops look flatter, but the Týn towers stay clear from the Powder Tower Suite.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Old Town rooftops today, so guests watch the wet terracotta from their rooms rather than from the terrace.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over Prague, and from the 8th floor the lightning behind the castle silhouette is the main event right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over the Old Town, and from the balcony only the nearest red rooftops and the Týn towers are visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the red rooftops, turning them white as seen from the warm rooms on the 8th floor.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air keeps the rooftop terrace empty today, but the view of Prague Castle from inside the suite is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Strong, flat light sits on the red rooftops this very hot day, and the rattan terrace chairs are mostly empty.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky on this mild night, but the lit Týn Church is easy to see from the terrace tables.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Prague Castle is a faint outline from the 8th floor while Týn Church, much closer, stays clear.
phrases.late_night: Tonight the Powder Tower Suite curtain is left open for sleep, the castle's shape on the skyline the last thing seen.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the Powder Tower Suite window after midnight, the curtain open on wet lit rooftops and the castle skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low cloud after midnight, the Powder Tower Suite's open curtain frames the castle outline past the lit Old Town rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: If you were on the Tamar Suite balcony before dawn, you would see the Kowloon lights still on across the harbour.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the restaurant with the cobalt blue panelling, where set tables face Victoria Harbour and the city skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, Victoria Harbour is bright from the wraparound balcony, and the Kowloon skyline looks sharp across the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the soaking tub this afternoon, you would watch the low sun colour the Kowloon skyline across Victoria Harbour.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear, and the Symphony of Lights plays across the harbour, seen from the Tamar Suite living room.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit over Hong Kong this morning, but the Bank of China Tower stays in plain sight from the rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Between the clouds this afternoon, patches of sun move across Victoria Harbour below the top-floor balcony of the Tamar Suite.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun is turning the clouds over Kowloon orange, a view the suite living room window frames directly.
phrases.overcast: Solid grey cloud covers Central today, so the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows show a flatter, duller version of the skyline.
phrases.rain: From the navy-walled restaurant, guests watch rain fall on Victoria Harbour through the glass, under the lantern chandeliers.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the harbour is visible from the Tamar Suite living room, with the Kowloon skyline appearing and disappearing between flashes.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the harbour today, and from the soaking tub the Kowloon skyline is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow in Hong Kong is almost unheard of, but a few flakes over the harbour would be visible from the wraparound balcony.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold day, the balcony of the Tamar Suite is for a short look only, before stepping back inside.
phrases.very_hot: The air outside is very hot today, so most guests view Victoria Harbour through the floor-to-ceiling windows rather than from the balcony.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the lit skyline fills the restaurant windows while the doorman polishes the gold fan logo downstairs.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so from the wraparound balcony the far side of Victoria Harbour is unclear and the Kowloon skyline barely shows.
phrases.late_night: The Kowloon lights reflect in Victoria Harbour after midnight, and the Tamar Suite window will show the same water at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner, the Tamar Suite living room shows Victoria Harbour through rain, the Kowloon lights blurred on the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, low cloud hangs over Victoria Harbour, and the Kowloon lights show hazy from the Tamar Suite living room.

phrases.clear_predawn: Nobody is in the rooftop pool yet, and La Giralda is a dark outline against the clear sky before dawn.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool, La Giralda and the Cathedral stand sharp against a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests swim in the rooftop pool with the Giralda tower directly in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Cathedral stone in yellow, seen from a lounger on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would sit in a warm jacuzzi and look at La Giralda against a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds pass over Seville this morning, so sunlight on the Cathedral comes and goes, seen from the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon snacks are being served on the interior patio while clouds and sun alternate over the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun reaches La Giralda between clouds, and the white rattan chairs on the terrace face it directly.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Seville today, but the Cathedral is still clearly visible from the rooftop pool.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop terraces today, and the jacuzzi water stays warm whatever the weather does.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Seville means nobody is in the rooftop pool, and the Cathedral is briefly lit by lightning.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Seville this morning, and the Giralda tower is only a soft grey shape from the rooftop pool.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Seville, and today guests in the warm jacuzzis can watch it fall on the Cathedral roofs.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day in Seville, the heated jacuzzi terraces are the warmest place to look at La Giralda.
phrases.very_hot: Guests in the rooftop pool this afternoon look up at La Giralda through the heat-haze over the Seville rooftops.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky on this mild night, and guests sit in the jacuzzis with the Cathedral straight ahead of them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Seville today, so the nearby Cathedral is clear from the rooftop pool while distant rooftops are not.
phrases.late_night: Well after midnight the top-floor rooms frame the Giralda's outline above the rooftops, and there is no hurry yet to sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain streaks the top-floor windows, and the outline of the Giralda shows above the wet rooftops of Santa Cruz.
phrases.grey_evening: From the top-floor rooms, haze moves across Santa Cruz after midnight, and the Giralda's outline fades and returns over the lit rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Stadtpark below the park-facing rooms is still dark, and the Strauss monument is hard to make out.
phrases.clear_morning: From a high-floor balcony this morning, the Stadtpark canopy is green and the Stephansdom spire stands sharp against blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Riesenrad is visible at the horizon from the upper park-facing floors, a small wheel beyond the skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the Vienna skyline, and guests in upper rooms see the Strauss monument below in the park.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the Vienna skyline from the bathroom's floor-to-ceiling windows while brushing your teeth.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the Stadtpark this morning, and the tree canopy below the room windows changes between shade and sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds cover parts of Vienna this afternoon, so the Riesenrad at the horizon comes and goes from the upper floors.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun reaches the historic rooftops seen from the balcony, with cloud shadows crossing the park.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Ringstrasse and the skyline are still visible from park-facing rooms, but the Riesenrad is not.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Stadtpark canopy, and guests watch it from their rooms rather than walking to the Strauss monument.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Vienna, and the upper-floor windows give a wide view of lightning above the Stadtpark.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over the Stadtpark today, so from the balcony the tree canopy shows but the Stephansdom spire does not.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Stadtpark trees and the Strauss monument below, seen from park-facing rooms on the upper floors.
phrases.very_cold: In very cold clear air, the view from the upper floors reaches past the Stadtpark to the Riesenrad at the horizon.
phrases.very_hot: Vienna is very hot today, and the Stadtpark canopy below the balcony looks like the most useful shade in town.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, guests on the high-floor balcony look out over the Stadtpark toward the Vienna skyline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the upper floors the Stadtpark and Strauss monument show, but the Riesenrad and skyline do not.
phrases.late_night: Tonight the Ringstrasse lights show across the Stadtpark from the upper park-facing rooms, and the Stephansdom spire comes back at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the upper park-facing rooms after midnight, and the city lights blur beyond the Stadtpark trees.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Vienna after midnight, and from the upper park-facing rooms the city lights show hazy beyond the Stadtpark.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Payangan River Valley below the balconies is still dark, with only a thin line of sky above the bamboo.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were there this morning, you would see the whole valley and bamboo forest sharp and green from your private balcony.
phrases.clear_midday: From the private balconies, the Payangan River Valley and its bamboo forests lie in clear midday sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun from the west lights the bamboo forest from the side, and every balcony gets the same view of it.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the valley is clear, so diners in the bamboo Nest pod can see stars above the rice fields.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the valley this morning, and the yoga pavilion deck has light that changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the brick-columned terrace have drinks in shade and sun by turns, as clouds cross the jungle.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Payangan valley turn orange, which the infinity pool reflects as well.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the bamboo forest today, so the valley from the balconies looks darker green than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Payangan River Valley right now, and guests watch it from their private balconies.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the valley, and the elevated bamboo Nest pod is not a good place for dinner right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills the Payangan River Valley today, and from the balconies the bamboo forest below is only partly visible.
phrases.snow: If snow were really falling over the valley today, the infinity pool would be the strangest place in Bali to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day over the Payangan valley is rare in Bali, and the open yoga pavilion has no walls against it.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the valley this afternoon, and the infinity pool is the one place where guests stay cool.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy over the rice fields, and diners at the candlelit Nest pod need no jacket.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the bamboo just below the balconies is clear, but the far side of the valley is not.
phrases.late_night: A short sleep now in the valley rooms, and at dawn the bamboo forest fills each window again.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at the Nest is over, and rain now falls on the bamboo forest seen from the room balconies.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner at the Nest, the suite windows face low cloud over the Payangan River Valley and its bamboo forest.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before the sky brightens, the lit CN Tower is the only clear shape from the two-story suite windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Lake Ontario is flat and blue this morning, and the spa treatment rooms look out over the marina and treetops.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the lake, and the 28th-floor pool has clear sightlines to the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the downtown towers from the west, and the fitness centre windows face straight at them.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the CN Tower lit from a table at Valerie, with no cloud in between.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are drifting over Lake Ontario this morning, and the two-story suites get a mix of sun and shade on the skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lounge chairs by the 28th-floor pool, patches of sun move across the lake between the clouds this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the skyline turn orange, and the top floor of Valerie faces them.
phrases.overcast: A grey cloud cover sits over Toronto today, and the lake and CN Tower look flat and colourless from the guest rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is running down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the indoor tennis courts at 10XTO are the dry option right now.
phrases.thunderstorm: From Valerie on floors twenty-seven to twenty-nine, lightning flashes over Lake Ontario beside the lit CN Tower.
phrases.fog_haze: Thick fog sits over the lake today, and from the 28th-floor pool only the nearest stretch of water is visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the suite windows, and the CN Tower comes and goes behind it, depending on how heavily it falls.
phrases.very_cold: Air this cold keeps guests behind the glass, where the fitness centre windows still show the CN Tower in sharp daylight.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day the 28th-floor pool is where most guests end up, with Lake Ontario below the glass railing.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and the lit CN Tower and downtown skyline are easy to see from Valerie's windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor today, so the lake fades to grey after a few kilometres and the CN Tower looks less sharp.
phrases.late_night: Anyone up late in a two-story suite watches the skyline lights around the CN Tower.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has the two-storey suite tonight can watch rain run down the tall windows, the skyline lights blurred behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever is awake in a two-story suite after midnight sees the downtown lights under low cloud, the CN Tower to the northeast.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the second-floor balconies look out on a dark Pacific, with Children's Pool Beach still empty below.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is included, and this morning the sea lions on the rocks below are easy to spot from the balconies.
phrases.clear_midday: Under bright midday sun, the wicker chairs on the balcony face a blue Pacific and a red-tiled rooftop.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Afternoon cookies are out, and the balconies catch the low sun over the water with the coastal road below.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would hear the Pacific from a four-poster bed, with the beach dark below.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the ocean this morning, and the Scripps Park lawn is green under the balcony.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, patches of cloud move over the Pacific, and the daily afternoon cookies are already out.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud over the Pacific has turned orange and pink, and the balconies face it with the coastal road below.
phrases.overcast: The sky over La Jolla is grey today, and the Pacific looks grey too from the second-floor balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Children's Pool Beach, and guests watch it from the rattan chairs in the suite living rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Pacific keeps everyone off the rooftop terrace, so the storm is watched through the room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Coastal fog covers the water today, and from the balconies the nearby lawn and rooftops are the clear part.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches La Jolla, but if it did, guests would see it from the ocean-facing rooms.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold day, the balcony wicker chairs stay empty and the sea lions still lie on the rocks.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in La Jolla, and the balconies over the water get what breeze there is off the Pacific.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and the second-floor balconies are a good place to listen to the waves.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balconies Children's Pool Beach is clear but the horizon line is not visible.
phrases.late_night: Long past midnight the coast road lights show on the water from the ocean-facing rooms, the surf easy to hear.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the ocean-facing rooms after midnight, and the wet coast road shines below.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze drifts over Children's Pool Beach after midnight, and the coast road lights show through it from the ocean-facing rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over Cox Bay is already clear, and the breakers show as pale lines from the beach house decks.
phrases.clear_morning: From bed in the suites, the floor-to-ceiling windows show a bright Pacific, evergreens, and waves arriving one after another.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the bay, and the Surfside Grill is serving fish tacos beside the beach path.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Because the bay looks west, the low afternoon sun now shines straight into the windows of every suite and beach house.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a deck hot tub now, you would see stars over the Pacific and hear the breakers.
phrases.partly_morning: Some cloud, some sun over Cox Bay this morning, and guests with coffee watch the surf from the Adirondack chairs.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud move across the Pacific this afternoon, and the beach path to the Surfside Grill stays busy.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the bay turns orange, seen from the wooden bench facing the beach.
phrases.overcast: If you were at the deck window now, you would see grey waves breaking on Cox Bay below a cloudy sky.
phrases.rain: Rain is hitting the west-facing windows, so guests stay by the gas fireplaces and watch the surf from inside.
phrases.thunderstorm: There is thunder over the Pacific, and guests watch lightning above the breakers through the west-facing windows of the beach houses.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Cox Bay today, and from the decks the Pacific breakers show only as pale white lines in the grey.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the dune grass and the decks, a rare sight here, while the hot tubs stay hot.
phrases.very_cold: From the decks, steam from the barrel saunas drifts toward the Cox Bay surf in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day for Vancouver Island, and the short walk from deck to the Pacific is the main attraction.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night like this, guests sit around the fire pit with drinks, the ocean a few steps away.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the distant hills across the bay cannot be seen from the windows, but the near breakers can.
phrases.late_night: The suite is dark after midnight, and the only light comes through the floor-to-ceiling windows from the white surf on Cox Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open before bed, rain streaks the suite windows and the Cox Bay surf comes in loud through the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open after midnight in the suites, and under low cloud the lit beach houses reflect on Cox Bay's wet sand.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lake suite terraces in Melide face Lake Lugano under a clear sky with the Alps outlined by first light.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Deluxe room balcony, the morning sun is on the water and every mountain ridge across the lake shows clearly.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the lake-facing terraces look out on Lake Lugano, blue and flat under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The south-facing lake suites get the low afternoon sun on their terraces, and the Alps turn orange across the water.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at dinner in Le Rive tonight, you would see stars over Lake Lugano through the restaurant's glass doors.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit over the mountain ridges this morning, and the rooftop lawn is in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud shadow move across Lake Lugano this afternoon, easy to follow from the floor-to-ceiling windows of any room.
phrases.partly_golden: Just before sunset, a few clouds above the Alps catch the last orange light, in full view from the Le Rive terrace.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Lake Lugano today, and the hills across the water look flat and dull from the outdoor pool loungers.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the lake, and the sliding glass doors of Le Rive stay closed while guests still see the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the lake suite terraces, lightning flashes over Lake Lugano while thunder rolls across the mountains behind Melide.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog on Lake Lugano today hides the far shore, so the balconies look out on white air and nothing else.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftop lawn and on the terraces, and the Alps across the lake are white where visible.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold outside today, and most guests watch the lake from behind the floor-to-ceiling glass, not from the terraces.
phrases.very_hot: From the lake-facing terraces, a faint heat-haze hangs over Lake Lugano and the empty lounge chairs by the pool.
phrases.mild_night: Late on a mild, cloudy night, the lake suites' lit terraces look out over Lake Lugano under thick cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: If you were on a lake suite terrace now, you would see Lake Lugano close by but not the Alps.
phrases.late_night: The curtain stays open in a lake suite tonight, and shore lights on Lake Lugano show in the window until sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: Well after dinner at Le Rive, rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass and the shore lights reflect in Lake Lugano.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Le Rive is long over, and from the lake suites a few shore lights reflect in Lake Lugano under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dom Luís I Bridge is still lit, and the indoor pool windows show a dark, clear sky over Porto.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the terrace comes with a clear view of Porto's terracotta rooftops across the Douro this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the infinity pool terrace, and the cream umbrella gives some shade to the teak loungers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Under the slatted wooden arch on the rooftop terrace, the late sun turns the Douro and Porto's skyline gold.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the rooftop pool now, you would see Porto's lit skyline and the bridge under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Porto this morning, and from a river-facing room the Dom Luís I Bridge is in sun then shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon a mix of sun and cloud hangs over the Douro, and the hot tub is a good place to watch.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds catch the last sun over Porto, and from the private terraces the river looks part gold, part grey.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Porto today, but the bridge and terracotta rooftops are still clear from the indoor pool windows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Douro right now, so guests are using the indoor pool and watching the wet city through the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Porto, and the lightning across the river is best watched from a room, not the rooftop pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Douro today, hiding most of the bridge, so the rooftop terrace view is mainly white.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Porto, but a few flakes are falling over the river, seen from the warm indoor pool.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing on the private terraces today, so the sun lounges are empty and the Douro is very clear.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Porto, and the infinity pool is the coolest place to look at the bridge.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the round soaking tub you can see Porto's lit riverside.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the terrace the bridge is clear but Porto's skyline behind it is only a faint outline.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, Porto's lights show on the Douro beside the Dom Luís I Bridge.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight rain runs down the river-facing windows, and Porto's lights blur across the Douro by the Dom Luís I arch.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Porto after midnight, and from a river-facing room the city lights look soft beside the Dom Luís I Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Acropolis is a dark shape above the rooftops from the upper-floor premium rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: From the eighth-floor rooftop, the morning sun lights the Acropolis clearly, with Lycabettus Hill also in view.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun on the rooftop pool means the cabanas are the shaded choice, and the Acropolis stays in full view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the Acropolis stone yellow, seen through the circular porthole window above the Athens rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at dinner on the eighth-floor rooftop tonight, you would see the Acropolis lit against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Athens this morning, and sunlight reaches the Acropolis only between them, seen from the premium rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud and sun alternate this afternoon above the rooftop pool, where the lounge seating faces the Acropolis.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day reaches the Acropolis under broken cloud, as tables are set in the rooftop dining area.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Acropolis is still clearly visible from the lounge bar windows, just without sunlight on it.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Athens, and guests watch the wet rooftops and the Acropolis from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of the lounge bar.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the eighth-floor St' Astra restaurant, lightning flashes over the Acropolis and the wet rooftops of Athens.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Athens today reduces the Acropolis to a pale outline from the eighth floor, with the city rooftops faded too.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Athens, but today it falls on the city rooftops below the upper-floor premium rooms and their Acropolis view.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold in Athens today, so the Acropolis is best viewed from the lounge bar, behind glass.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the rooftop pool and its cabanas are the sensible place to look at the Acropolis.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover Athens on this mild night, but the Acropolis is lit beyond the open glass panels of the rooftop restaurant.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Athens today, so from the rooftop the Acropolis is faint and the mountain panorama is not visible.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Premium suites are unlit, and the only light comes from Athens rooftops and the Acropolis on its hill.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the porthole window after midnight, and the Acropolis shows through it across the wet city lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze moves across Athens after midnight, and from the premium rooms the Acropolis shows as a soft shape above the city lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Art Executive Suite looks over a dark city with its lights still on, toward the Río de la Plata.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Buenos Aires: from the gym's floor-to-ceiling windows, the skyline is sharp in the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the retractable roof over the rooftop pool is open, and swimmers have the full skyline under a blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the 15th-floor suite, you would see the low sun on the city and the river beyond it.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the city lights spread below the Art Executive Suite, and stars show through the glass roof of the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds this morning, so the soaking tub in the marble bathroom frames a cityscape under a mixed sky.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, cloud shadows move across the skyline seen from the gym's floor-to-ceiling windows, with sun between them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over Buenos Aires turn orange above the skyline seen from the rooftop pool.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the city today, but the skyline is still clear from the 15th floor, just without any shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain over Buenos Aires, and the glass roof is closed over the rooftop pool, so the city view stays available to swimmers.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, the Art Executive Suite gives a wide view of lightning over the city and toward the river.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog today, so from the high-floor rooms only the nearest Retiro buildings show, and the Río de la Plata is hidden.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never falls here, but today the heated rooftop pool under its glass roof would be the place to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day by Buenos Aires standards, and the air is clear enough to see the river from the Executive Suite.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, and the retractable roof over the rooftop pool is open, so swimmers see the skyline from the water.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night, and from the Art Executive Suite the city lights spread toward the dark line of the river.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the 15th floor the Río de la Plata is not in view, only the nearer towers.
phrases.late_night: In the 15th-floor Art Executive Suite the curtain is left open tonight, and city lights spread toward the River Plate.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass of the Art Executive Suite, and the city lights toward the River Plate blur after midnight.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hangs over Buenos Aires after midnight, and the lit skyline shows beneath it from the Art Executive Suite.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Sky Tower stays lit in the dark before sunrise, visible from the rooms on the upper floors.
phrases.clear_morning: From a 37th-floor room, the Waitematā Harbour shows clearly in the morning sun through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Sky Tower looks very clear outside the guest room windows, with city rooftops below it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Towards sunset, the harbour catches the warm low sun, and the suites' tall windows show it from the high floors.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at Bar Albert tonight, you would see the CBD lights and the Sky Tower under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Patches of cloud cross the Waitematā Harbour this morning, in view from the rooms on floors 28 to 37.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, clouds move behind the Sky Tower, and guests in Bar Albert watch the light change on the harbour.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky over the city skyline outside the dining room windows.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Auckland today, but the Sky Tower and the harbour are both still visible from the upper floors.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of Bar Albert, and the harbour looks grey and flat through the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests on the 38th floor see lightning over the Waitematā Harbour from inside the rooftop bar.
phrases.fog_haze: In Bar Albert today the windows show mainly fog, the harbour hidden and only the upper Sky Tower in view.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Auckland, so a few flakes outside the suite windows would be a story to tell at Bar Albert.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold clear air over Auckland today, and the Sky Tower and harbour both show clearly from the upper rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot sun on the city today, and the guest rooms' floor-to-ceiling windows face the Sky Tower and bright rooftops.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night over Auckland, with the CBD lights spread below the rooftop bar and no stars above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so from the rooms the far side of the harbour is not clear, though the Sky Tower still is.
phrases.late_night: In the Sky Tower rooms, the curtain is left open at bedtime, the tower's outline framed above the lit city.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the high-floor windows, and the Sky Tower's spire shows between showers beside the blurred harbour lights.
phrases.grey_evening: From the high-floor rooms after midnight, low cloud drifts over Waitemata Harbour and hides the top of the Sky Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over São Jorge Castle is still dark from the Limão Rooftop Bar, and the tile terrace is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From a guest room's triple window, the terracotta rooftops and the Tagus River are sharp under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Limão Rooftop Bar terrace has full sun on its blue-and-white tiles, and Serra da Arrábida shows to the south.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun from the west lights São Jorge Castle to the east, seen from the rooftop bar on the 10th floor.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the Limão terrace tonight, you would see a clear sky over the Tagus Estuary and the dark rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Lisbon this morning, and the 10th-floor terrace gets sun between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun alternate over the Tagus this afternoon, so the river changes colour as seen from the guest room windows.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over Serra da Arrábida turn orange, visible from the Limão Rooftop Bar.
phrases.overcast: From the 10th-floor terrace, São Jorge Castle sits under an unbroken grey sky today, with no shadows on its walls.
phrases.rain: Late-night rain falls on the blue-and-white tiles of the tenth-floor terrace, with Lisbon's lights hazy toward the Tagus.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Tagus Estuary is visible from the 10th floor, and the terrace is empty during the storm.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the city hides Serra da Arrábida today, though the nearer terracotta rooftops still show from the guest rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Lisbon, but if it fell the rooftop terrace tiles would be white and the castle hard to see.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day, the rooftop terrace is nearly empty, though São Jorge Castle is sharp in the dry air.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot sun on the rooftop terrace today, so most guests watch the Tagus from inside the lounge through the glass doors.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, and guests at the Limão Rooftop Bar sit outside with Lisbon's rooftops below and no stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Serra da Arrábida and the far side of the Tagus are not visible from the terrace.
phrases.late_night: A few window lights show across Lisbon's rooftops after midnight, and by dawn the Tagus and castle hill are back in view.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the triple window after midnight, blurring the city lights toward the castle hill and the Tagus.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers São Jorge Castle after midnight, and the city lights spread below it to the Tagus from the Limão rooftop.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, La Isabela's pool is still empty, and the spires of Barcelona Cathedral are already outlined against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop terrace, the Sagrada Familia is sharp under a clear morning sky, and the first guests are claiming sun loungers.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun on La Isabela means the blue umbrellas are in use, and the pool is the coolest place on the roof.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: A low golden sun is setting behind the spires of Barcelona Cathedral, seen from the lounge seating on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the rooftop garden's greenery is lit, and Montjuïc hill shows as a dark shape against the city lights.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over the Sagrada Familia this morning, and from the rooftop terrace it appears between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud pass over La Isabela this afternoon, so the sun loungers get sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see the last sun passing between clouds behind the cathedral spires.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Sagrada Familia is still visible from the rooftop, but with no sun the blue umbrellas stay folded.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on La Isabela's pool and loungers, and the Colonial Suite's private terrace is also wet today.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Barcelona has cleared the rooftop terrace, and guests are watching lightning above Montjuïc from indoors.
phrases.fog_haze: In today's haze, the Sagrada Familia is only a faint outline from the rooftop terrace, and Montjuïc is harder to make out.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Barcelona, but today a few flakes land on La Isabela's loungers and on the Colonial Suite's private terrace.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day, the rooftop pool has no swimmers, though the view of the cathedral spires is unusually clear.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Barcelona, and on La Isabela most guests stay in the pool or under the blue umbrellas.
phrases.mild_night: The rooftop garden is lit on this mild, cloudy night, and the city lights toward Montjuïc replace the missing stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Sagrada Familia cannot be seen from the rooftop terrace, though the pool and loungers are unaffected.
phrases.late_night: Lights off in the Colonial Suite around two in the morning, the only glow comes up from Las Ramblas below.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the Colonial Suite window, and the lamps of Las Ramblas show wet and bright below.
phrases.grey_evening: Late after dinner, the room window shows low cloud over Barcelona and the street lamps along Las Ramblas under it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the marina lights are still on below the Harbour View balconies, and the seaplanes have not started yet.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Harbour View balcony this morning, the first seaplanes are crossing Burrard Inlet under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Juliet balcony, the Coal Harbour marina sailboats sit in clear midday sun below the North Shore Mountains.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the Juliet balconies now, and the sailboats in the marina cast long shadows on the water.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the terrace lounge tonight, you would see the marina lit up and the mountains dark behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Some cloud covers the tops of the North Shore Mountains this morning, while the Coal Harbour docks get sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the H2 Rotisserie windows watch patches of sun move across Coal Harbour between the clouds this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Burrard Inlet turn orange, seen from the Premium Tower rooms.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Vancouver today, and from the room desks the mountains are only a dark line behind the marina.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Coal Harbour docks, so most guests have moved to the indoor pool and the cedar barrel saunas.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Burrard Inlet is visible from the Harbour View balconies, and the seaplanes have stopped flying for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has come in over Coal Harbour, and from the balconies only the nearest sailboats in the marina can be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow covers the red Adirondack chairs by the outdoor pool, and the mountains behind the marina have gone white.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the cedar barrel saunas are busy and the snow-capped mountains stand out behind the marina.
phrases.very_hot: Guests at the pool this afternoon look out on heat-haze over the Coal Harbour marina and its boats.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and guests on the terrace lounge sit by candles looking at the lit marina.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the H2 Rotisserie windows today, the sailboats in the marina are easy to see, but the North Shore Mountains are hidden.
phrases.late_night: If you switched off the lights in a Harbour View room, the only glow left would be the marina on Coal Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: Over a last drink at the H2 bar tonight, you would see rain on the glass and the marina lights on Coal Harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: If you took a last drink at H2 tonight, you would see the marina lights in Coal Harbour under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the pool terrace is empty and the beach below is still dark, with the marina jetty just visible.
phrases.clear_morning: From a balcony this morning, the sand of Calheta Beach is bright and the Atlantic is calm and blue.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the curved pool, so most guests have moved under the white parasols.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the volcanic cliff behind the hotel orange, seen from the balconies with mountain views.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your balcony tonight, you would see stars over the Atlantic and the dark shape of the marina breakwater.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Calheta Bay this morning, and sunlight on the pool terrace comes and goes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the balcony tables, the Atlantic is partly blue and partly grey this afternoon, depending on the clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the bay are lit from below, visible from the pool terrace.
phrases.overcast: The sky over Calheta Bay is grey today, but the sandy beach and the breakwater are clearly visible from the ocean-view rooms.
phrases.rain: From the balcony, rain falls on the empty pool terrace and the marina breakwater below the volcanic cliff.
phrases.thunderstorm: There is thunder over the Atlantic, and guests watch the lightning from behind balcony doors rather than from the beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the bay today, so from the pool terrace the marina jetty is clear but the horizon is not.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown at sea level in Calheta, but if it fell, the palm trees by the pool would look strange.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold day, the beach below the balconies is empty and the spa's indoor pool is the warmer option.
phrases.very_hot: The air over the sand is very hot, and most guests have left the beach for the curved pool and the parasols.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild cloudy night, the three bars are open, and the sound of the Atlantic reaches the balconies.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the balconies, the beach and the marina jetty show clearly, with the far sea hidden in haze today.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the marina lights are all that shows on Calheta Bay from the ocean-view rooms; dawn brings back the sand.
phrases.wet_evening: Back in the ocean-view rooms after dinner, rain runs down the glass and the marina jetty lights blur over Calheta Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner is over, and from the ocean rooms the marina lights show on Calheta Bay under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Santa Monica Pier is a dark outline from the upper-floor balconies, and the sand below is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Plantation shutters are open in the ocean-view rooms this morning, and the Pacific is clearly visible from the balcony.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, from the balconies, the blue-and-white striped umbrellas are up on the sand and the lifeguard tower stands in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: On the terrace, the wicker seats face the Pacific while the low sun lights the Santa Monica Pier in warm evening colour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see a dark Pacific and stars from the balcony wicker chairs.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the Pacific this morning, and guests on the pool deck are choosing between the cabanas and the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Santa Monica Pier moves in and out of cloud shadow, seen from the upper-floor ocean-view rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken clouds catch the last sun above the pier, and the terrace lounge chairs are mostly taken right now.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pacific looks flat and grey from the balconies, and the sand is quieter than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the sand and the empty pool deck, while guests watch the wet pier from inside the ocean-view rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Pacific, so the balconies are empty and the spa is the sensible place to be.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has moved in from the Pacific, and from the balconies the Santa Monica Pier is only a faint shape today.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare in Santa Monica, but today it is falling on the striped cabanas of the pool deck.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, a rare thing here, and the balcony wicker chairs are empty while the Pacific stays blue.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the sand, so the shaded cabanas and the outdoor pool are the busiest parts of the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under clouds, and on the terrace guests can hear the Pacific more clearly than they can see it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the ocean-view balconies the Santa Monica Pier is unclear and the far horizon is not visible.
phrases.late_night: Anyone awake in an ocean-view room past one is in no hurry to sleep, watching waves break white beside the pier's line.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone up late in the ocean-view rooms sees rain on the glass and the Pier's long shape out over the Pacific.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone up late in the ocean-view rooms can watch the waves roll in beside the pier under tonight's low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the private balconies look onto a dark Andaman Sea, and the forested headland is only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balcony, the cove is already turquoise, and the first guests are taking the sun loungers on the white sand.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, most guests have moved from the beach into the pools or under the palm trees.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the rocky headland and the sandy cove, and the balcony is the easiest place to watch it.
phrases.clear_night: Stars over the Andaman tonight, and through the sliding glass doors the cove is dark except for a pale line of sand.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the forested hills this morning, while the sea in front of the balconies stays bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Broken cloud over the hills this afternoon, and from the balcony the water sports in the cove move between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun comes through broken cloud, and the bay below the balconies changes colour every few minutes.
phrases.overcast: Full cloud over Merlin Beach today, and from the lawn paths the cove looks flat green rather than turquoise.
phrases.rain: Steady rain over the cove today, and guests have moved from the sun loungers to the sliding glass doors of their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Andaman has emptied the beach and pools, and the spa is suddenly the busiest place here.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the bay hides the rocky headland from the balconies today, and the sea has no clear horizon.
phrases.snow: Snow does not fall in Phuket, so if the forecast says snow, the cove and palm trees still look the same.
phrases.very_cold: Phuket almost never gets this cold, and guests on the balconies are more likely in jackets than swimwear today.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the sand today, so the pools and the palm shade are where most guests stay.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm with cloud over the Andaman, and the private balconies are comfortable without a jacket.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the cove and sand are clear from the balconies but the horizon of the Andaman is not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the curtain is left open on purpose, so the sand of the cove is the last thing in view before sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight the rain runs down the sliding glass doors, and the curtain is open to the sound of the Andaman.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain in a king room is open after midnight, and under hazy cloud the surf of the cove shows faintly white.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Royal Palace is a dark outline across the rooftops, seen from the quiet roof terrace.
phrases.clear_morning: From the infinity pool, the sunbeds on the roof terrace are in full sun and the Royal Palace is clearly visible.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun lights the Almudena Cathedral dome and the Royal Palace, both seen from the rooftop jacuzzi.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun colours the palace facade, and from the white pergola terrace the church spires stand out clearly.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the rooftop pool tonight, you would see the Royal Palace lit up across the rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Madrid this morning, and the Torre de Madrid is visible from the rooftop pool between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the sunbeds get sun and shade in turns this afternoon, with the palace in view across the roofs.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun reaches the palace between clouds, watched from the garden terrace of a Red Level room.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Almudena dome and the Royal Palace look flat and pale from the roof terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop terrace and the potted trees, and the palace looks washed out across the roofs.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm sits over Madrid, so the roof terrace is empty and the palace shows briefly in each lightning flash.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Madrid today softens the Royal Palace, though its outline still shows from the infinity pool.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Madrid, but today it settles on the sunbeds and on the palace roofs across the way.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing on the roof terrace today, so the jacuzzi has guests but the sunbeds do not.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Madrid this afternoon, and guests stay in the infinity pool with the palace in front of them.
phrases.mild_night: A warm night with cloud over Madrid, and from the garden terrace of a Red Level room the lit palace is visible.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the palace and cathedral dome are clear from the pool but the wider skyline is faint.
phrases.late_night: In a Red Level room the curtain is left open after midnight, so the Royal Palace roofline shows across the lit rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtains open after midnight, rain streaks the Red Level window and the Royal Palace roofline shows across the wet, lit rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers Madrid after midnight, and the room windows look out on city lights up to the Royal Palace across the rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the balcony of a king oceanfront room, the Atlantic is still dark before sunrise, with a pale line on the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun comes up directly over the water, so the oceanfront rooms get full light through their balcony doors early.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sand below the balconies is bright, and guests on the terrace sit under the wooden pergola for shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon puts the sun behind the hotel, so the beach and the ocean in front of the balconies are evenly lit.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the balcony tonight, you would hear the waves more than see them, with the ocean fully dark.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Atlantic this morning, and the lobby's corridor doors frame patches of sun on the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds move across the ocean this afternoon, and from an oceanfront balcony the water changes between grey and blue.
