phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, diners on the open-air terrace have clouds over the ocean turning pink in front of them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the ocean is flat and dull, and the blue balcony chair still gives a direct view of it.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the beach and the terrace tables outside, while guests swim in the indoor pool under the skylights.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the oceanfront rooms give a wide view of lightning over the Atlantic, and the balconies stay empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog today hides the horizon, and from the balcony only the sand and the first grey waves show.
phrases.snow: Snow on the sand in Virginia Beach is rare, and today the balcony view shows a white beach next to grey water.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day the beach is empty, and most guests watch the ocean from behind the balcony doors instead.
phrases.very_hot: The afternoon is very hot, and the short walk from the sand to the indoor pool is the most popular route today.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night the terrace tables under the pergola are set, and the ocean is a dark shape just ahead.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balcony the beach is clear but the far horizon over the ocean is not.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the king oceanfront rooms have the lights off by now, only the pale surf showing at the window.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, whoever has an oceanfront room can watch rain come in off the Atlantic and run down the balcony doors.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever is awake in a king oceanfront room after midnight watches low cloud drift over the ocean and the lit shoreline.

phrases.clear_morning: Dozens of balloons pass low over the rooftop terrace this morning, some close enough to read their registration markings.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Sunset Café serves drinks on the stone terrace facing the fairy chimneys of Göreme valley.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the rock-carved houses below the terrace, and Uçhisar Castle stands clear on the skyline.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop terrace tonight, you would see a clear sky over Göreme and the outline of Uçhisar Castle.
phrases.partly_morning: Balloons cross above the rooftop terrace this morning, under a sky of broken cloud, with Göreme's fairy chimneys below.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the fairy chimneys this afternoon, seen from the terrace where the Sunset Café serves drinks and snacks.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun shows the mosque minaret and tufa rock formations from the terrace, with broken cloud above Göreme.
phrases.overcast: If you were on the terrace now, you would see Göreme's rock-cut rooftops and Uçhisar Castle under a flat grey sky.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the empty rooftop terrace, and guests in the rock-cut cave rooms stay inside and dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder sounds over Göreme valley, the terrace is empty, and lightning briefly shows the fairy chimneys and Uçhisar Castle.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits in Göreme valley today, so from the rooftop terrace the fairy chimneys are faint and Uçhisar Castle is hidden.
phrases.snow: Snow lies on the rock-carved rooftops below the terrace, and guests stay warm inside the rock-cut caves and stone-arched rooms.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing on the terrace today, so most guests watch the fairy chimneys briefly and then go back inside.

phrases.mild_night: The night is mild under cloud, and a few guests sit on the rooftop terrace cushions facing the dark valley.

phrases.late_night: After midnight, Göreme's town lights fill the window of a cave suite, hours before the first balloons rise over the roof.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the cave suite window after midnight, and Göreme's lights show below the sky the balloons cross at dawn.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Göreme after midnight, and with the curtain open the town's lights show from the cave suite windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop pool's four stone-framed windows show a dark São Paulo skyline with scattered lit windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Jardins canopy, and from a Suite Deluxe the skyline stands sharp behind the trees.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the treadmills face a dense skyline under a blue sky, which makes the gym unusually bright right now.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, the late sun would colour the mid-rise buildings seen from the marble soaking tub.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over São Paulo is clear, and the city lights are visible through the full-height windows of the Suite Deluxe.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit above the Jardins neighbourhood this morning, while swimmers in the rooftop pool get a mostly bright view.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over Ibirapuera Park this afternoon, and their shadows move across the skyline framed by the pool windows.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the undersides of a few clouds, visible from the French doors of a guest room.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the mid-rise buildings outside the soaking tub window look flat, and the herringbone floors look warmer by comparison.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on São Paulo, and the indoor rooftop pool stays sheltered, with the wet skyline visible through its four windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the city, and guests in the Suite Deluxe can watch lightning above the skyline from behind full-height glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers São Paulo today, so from the gym windows only the nearest buildings are clear and the far skyline fades.
phrases.snow: Snow in São Paulo is unheard of, but if it fell today the rooftop pool's four windows would show it over Jardins.
phrases.very_cold: Cold, clear air sits over São Paulo, and the sky makes the Jardins canopy and skyline sharp from the upper floors.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot weather sits over the city, and guests in the rooftop pool have the stone walls between them and the sun.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the French doors of a guest room open onto the rooftops and the lit buildings beyond.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the soaking tub window the nearer mid-rise buildings show but the distant skyline does not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the São Paulo skyline lights fill the Suite Deluxe windows, and at dawn the Jardins canopy will show again.
phrases.wet_evening: Back in the Suite Deluxe after dinner, rain runs down the full-height windows and the São Paulo skyline lights show through it.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the full-height windows of the Suite Deluxe frame the lit São Paulo skyline under a low layer of cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, from an Atlantic-facing balcony the sea is still dark and the sky just starting to lighten.
phrases.clear_morning: From a private balcony, the Intracoastal Waterway lies flat and bright under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the ocean outside the floor-to-ceiling windows is turquoise, and the blue umbrellas on the beach are all open.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun falls on the Intracoastal side of the building, so balconies facing the waterway get the warm light now.
phrases.clear_night: From a private balcony tonight, the Atlantic is black under a clear sky and a few stars show over the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds and sun take turns over the beach this morning, exactly like in the photos of the corner oceanfront suite.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud shadows cross the turquoise water this afternoon, and the beachside bar kiosk has blue chairs in front of it.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in the corner suite now, you would see the last sun colouring the clouds over the Atlantic.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Fort Lauderdale today, so the ocean seen from the balconies looks grey too.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the lagoon pool, but the covered glass skywalk keeps guests dry on the way to the beach.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Atlantic means the beach is empty, and watching the lightning from a balcony is the main activity.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, so from the floor-to-ceiling windows the horizon is unclear and no yacht is visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown here, and from the balconies the palm trees on the beach would look very strange in it.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare cold day the lagoon pool has few swimmers, and most guests view the ocean from inside their rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, so the three-acre lagoon pool is the busiest place, and the beach umbrellas are all in use.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and guests on the Intracoastal-facing balconies can stay out late without needing a jacket.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so the far horizon is missing from the windows, though the beach and blue umbrellas below are clear.
phrases.late_night: Were you up for a glass of water near midnight in an Intracoastal room, you would see lights along the waterway.
phrases.wet_evening: With a last drink in an Intracoastal-facing room tonight, you would watch rain run down the glass over the waterway lights.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were finishing a last drink in an Intracoastal-facing room now, you would see lights along the waterway under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the jungle ravine below the stilted rooms is still dark, and the Ayung River is only a sound.
phrases.clear_morning: From a room terrace, the forest canopy over the Ayung River shows every shade of green under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Full sun covers the infinity pool deck at midday, and the white umbrellas give the blue sunloungers their only shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the forest canopy below the infinity pool, and the blue sunloungers along the deck are mostly taken.
phrases.clear_night: Stars fill a clear sky over the ravine tonight, and from a stilted villa the Ayung River is loud.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the ravine this morning, and the open-air spa pavilion already has its massage tables ready.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the jungle valley this afternoon, so the light on the canopy changes constantly from the pool deck.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky above the ravine, and staff set the riverside dinner table.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the twin rooms' terrace doors still open onto a canopy of palms and dense green jungle.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the forest canopy around the stilted villas, and the thatched roof keeps the spa pavilion's massage tables dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls through the valley, and from the rooms the lightning briefly shows the whole ravine above the Ayung River.
phrases.fog_haze: Morning mist fills the ravine below the infinity pool, so the far side of the valley is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow never falls in Payangan, but if it did, you would watch it from a room terrace landing on the canopy.
phrases.very_cold: It is unusually cold for Bali today, and guests on the room terraces look out at the jungle in extra layers.
phrases.very_hot: With very hot air over the ravine, the infinity pool is busier than the sunloungers beside it.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the candlelit dinner setup beside the Ayung River is one of the few lights in the valley.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the canopy around the pool shows well, but the volcanic mountains beyond the forest do not.
phrases.late_night: The pool lights are easy to watch late, and the Ayung River sounds below.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls past the terrace doors of the twin rooms, and the forest canopy above the Ayung River is wet and grey.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the Ayung valley after midnight, and the infinity pool is the one point of light the open curtains show.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop pool is empty, and the tallest towers of the skyline are already outlined against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight reaches the pool deck early, and from the loungers the Jardins canopy shows green all the way to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the blue umbrellas on the rooftop give the only shade, and the skyline stands sharp in every direction.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the high-rise buildings orange, and guests in the infinity pool face the sun as it drops.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lit towers of São Paulo from the heated pool under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: From the rooftop pool this morning, the São Paulo high-rises stand under a sky of patchy clouds.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the gray sofas of the rooftop lounge, the afternoon shows a skyline half in sun, half under cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day slips between clouds and lights some towers while others stay gray, seen from the pool deck.
phrases.overcast: A flat gray sky covers São Paulo today, but the skyline stays fully visible from the rooftop, just without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the pool deck and the loungers are empty, so guests watch the skyline from the suite windows instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind the high-rise buildings, and the safest place to watch it is a high-floor suite, not the pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over São Paulo hides all but the nearest towers, and the horizon seen from the rooftop is a gray blur.
phrases.snow: If you were at the heated rooftop pool now, you would see snow falling over the high-rise skyline and the Jardins trees.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold day, steam rises from the heated pool, and the skyline behind it looks unusually clear.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the city, and the only cool place on the rooftop is in the water, facing the towers.
phrases.mild_night: The night is warm and cloudy over Itaim-Bibi, the pool is lit, and the towers show as rows of lights.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop only the closer high-rise buildings show, and the horizon is not visible at all.

phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in a high-floor suite after midnight watches the rain run down the glass over the lit São Paulo skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a high-floor suite tonight can watch low cloud move across the lit towers of São Paulo after midnight.

phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in the hot tub this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows crossing the rolling hills beyond the terrace.

phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder is rolling over the Lakeland hills, and guests have left the outdoor hot tubs for the Champagne Bar.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the hills today, so the view from the rooms stops at the trees closest to the windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the wooden deck of the spa lodge, while the stone hot tub keeps steaming beside the pond.
phrases.very_cold: It is bitterly cold outside today, which makes the hot tubs at the Lake House look like a very good idea.
phrases.very_hot: The Lake District is unusually hot today, and the outdoor pool at the Lake House is where most guests are.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the candles along the jetty are lit and a rowing boat sits moored below the chairs.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Lake House the nearest hills are visible but the far Lakeland ones are not.
phrases.late_night: Back in a spa suite after a late dinner at SOURCE, you would see the window light reflected in the private pond.
phrases.wet_evening: With a last glass in the Champagne Bar tonight, you would see rain on the pond and the lit windows reflected there.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last glass in the Champagne Bar tonight, you would see lit windows reflected in the pond under cloud.

phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, guests at Sir Elly's rooftop bar drink with the lit Pudong skyline under low cloud.

phrases.grey_evening: Haze drifts across Pudong after midnight, and the city lights show soft over the Huangpu from a Grand Luxe River Room.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the stone of the Royal Palace warm orange, and guests on the blue loungers get the full view.

phrases.very_hot: The air over Madrid is very hot today, so the rooftop pool is the sensible place to watch the Royal Palace.
phrases.mild_night: From the twelfth-floor Ginkgo Sky Bar on this mild cloudy night, the Royal Palace stands lit below the low grey sky.

phrases.grey_evening: Haze passes over Madrid after midnight, and from the Exterior rooms the outline of the Royal Palace shows against the city lights.

phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over the Aegean, and the pool bar still has the dark caldera in front of it.

phrases.partly_afternoon: On the padel court this afternoon, players get some cloud cover between spells of sun over the bay.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud sits above Naxos, seen from sunbeds along the infinity pool.

phrases.wet_evening: After midnight the suite curtains are open, and rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows above the private pool.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hangs over Kalafati after midnight, and the sea can be heard below the open curtains of the suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests in the upper-floor rooms see stars over the Pacific through a clear sky beyond La Jolla Cove.
phrases.clear_morning: From an upper-floor balcony, the morning sun lights the palm trees and the water of La Jolla Cove directly below.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Pacific looks deep blue from the rooftop terrace, and the horizon is a straight, sharp line.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests at the Birdseye tables watch the sun lowering toward the Pacific horizon, with clear sunset visibility on most evenings.
phrases.clear_night: Through the sliding glass doors of an upper room, the night sky is clear and the Pacific below is dark.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds hang over the Pacific this morning, and sunlight reaches the cove below the rooftop between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the ocean from the Birdseye terrace shows patches of dark and bright water as clouds pass over it.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds in the last hour of sun take colour over the Pacific, and the rooftop dining tables face straight at them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific from the rooftop looks flat and silver, and the horizon is harder to find.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop terrace today, so the view of the cove is better from behind the sliding glass doors upstairs.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, lightning over the Pacific is visible from the upper-floor rooms, which is a rare sight in San Diego.
phrases.fog_haze: Marine fog hides the horizon today, and the cove rocks below the Birdseye rooftop are the only part of the view left.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on La Jolla today, which almost never happens, and the rooftop dining tables are empty.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day by San Diego standards, the ocean from the balcony looks the same but the rooftop stays quiet.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the breeze off the Pacific is the main reason people sit on the Birdseye rooftop terrace.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night after midnight, palm trees on Prospect Street stand beside the Birdseye rooftop tables above La Jolla Cove.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop the cove and nearby rocks are clear but the far horizon is not.
phrases.late_night: Whoever is up late in an upper-floor room watches the village lights beside the cove.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has an upper-floor room tonight is probably asleep, rain running down the glass in front of the village lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has an upper floor this evening watches the village lights glow under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Oudezijds Achterburgwal lies dark and still below the Canal House Suite balconies, with no boats moving yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the brick houses along the Oudezijds Voorburgwal, seen from the Prestige Suites across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the canal water is bright under a clear sky, and bicycles pass on the quay below the balconies.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the brick facades on the Oudezijds Voorburgwal while Library Or serves afternoon tea inside.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Canal House Suite windows look straight onto the dark water of the Oudezijds Achterburgwal.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Canal Ring this morning, and breakfast tables at Bridges have canal views through the large windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, patches of sun and cloud cross the brick bridge seen from the upper rooms above the Oudezijds Voorburgwal.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the orange shutters on the courtyard facade get direct light between the passing clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the garden terrace at Oriole Garden Bistro is set for lunch among the greenery.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on both canals today, so the Canal House Suite balconies stay empty and the hammam is busy.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests watch heavy rain hit the Oudezijds Voorburgwal from the windows of the Prestige Suites.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits low over the canals today, and the brick houses across the Oudezijds Voorburgwal appear only as outlines.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the Canal House Suite balconies and the quay bicycles, while the heated indoor pool stays warm.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold, clear day in Amsterdam, and the sauna and hammam are the popular rooms rather than the balconies.
phrases.very_hot: In this very hot weather, the walled garden shades the Oriole Garden Bistro tables while the canals sit in strong sun.
phrases.mild_night: Guests in the Canal House Suites keep the windows open on this mild, cloudy night above the Oudezijds Achterburgwal.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, and from the Prestige Suites only the houses directly across the Oudezijds Voorburgwal are clear.
phrases.late_night: Back late from dinner at Bridges, you would find the Oudezijds Voorburgwal's lights on the water below a Prestige Suite.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in a Prestige Suite, you would see rain falling on the lamplit Oudezijds Voorburgwal.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in a Prestige Suite, you would see lights along the Oudezijds Voorburgwal under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Basilica dome is a dark shape in the suite windows, with Erzsébet Square still unlit below.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast under the glass dome gets full sunlight this morning, and Erzsébet Square below is already busy with people.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands high above the glass dome, and the breakfast room needs no lamps at all.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a balcony now, you would see the low sun on the trees of Erzsébet Square.
phrases.clear_night: From the suites tonight, the dome of St Stephen's Basilica is a clear outline against a dark, cloudless sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Erzsébet Square this morning, and the light under the breakfast dome changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Balcony rooms facing the square get a mix of sun and shade this afternoon as clouds move across the city.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Basilica dome turn orange for anyone watching from a suite window.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Budapest today, so breakfast under the glass dome is calm and evenly lit rather than sunny.
phrases.rain: Raindrops run across the breakfast room's glass roof, and guests eating below can still see Erzsébet Square.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows through the glass roof above the breakfast tables, and guests watch the storm over Erzsébet Square.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over Budapest today, and from the balcony rooms the Basilica dome is only a faint shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Erzsébet Square, and from the balcony rooms the trees below are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold outside today, so most guests stay behind the suite windows and look at the Basilica from there.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day like this, the balconies facing the square are mostly empty until the sun drops.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and a few guests are still out on their balconies above Erzsébet Square.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: Erzsébet Square below is clear enough, but the Ferris wheel and far skyline are hard to see.
phrases.late_night: Erzsébet Square lights fill the suite windows through the sleeping hours, and the Basilica dome will show again at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open after midnight, rain on the windows of the square-facing rooms blurs the lights of Erzsébet Square.
phrases.grey_evening: The suite curtains stay open after midnight, and under low cloud the lights of Erzsébet Square show below the Basilica dome.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the ocean-facing balconies look out on a dark Atlantic with a thin line of light at the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were there this morning, you would watch the sun rise out of the Atlantic from the terrace's striped chairs.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the yellow umbrellas and blue lounge chairs on the beach are filling up below the balconies.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the striped lounge chairs on the terrace while the Atlantic stays bright to the horizon.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a king room balcony now, you would see a clear night sky full of stars over the Atlantic.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit over the Atlantic this morning, and the two-queen rooms get patches of sun through the balcony door.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the sand and the water this afternoon, best watched from under the green umbrellas on the terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests on the third-floor terrace in the last hour of sun watch low light cross the sand between broken clouds.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the whole Atlantic today, so the indoor pool is probably busier than the beach outside the balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the beach and the boardwalk, and most guests are watching it from behind the sliding balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Every room faces the sea, so right now guests watch lightning over the Atlantic through the sliding glass balcony doors.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the horizon today, and from the terrace only the nearest cabanas on the sand are easy to make out.
phrases.snow: Snow on the Virginia Beach shore is rare, but the sand below the balconies is turning white while the Atlantic stays grey.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing on the third-floor terrace today, and the striped lounge chairs facing the Atlantic are empty.
phrases.very_hot: From the third-floor terrace, heat-haze shimmers over the empty striped lounge chairs and the wide sand to the Atlantic.
phrases.mild_night: A warm, cloudy night on the strip, and guests sit by the outdoor pool next to Lager Heads after dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: If you stood on the third-floor terrace now, you would see the beach and near water but no horizon line.
phrases.late_night: After midnight every light in the king rooms is off, and the boardwalk lights through the glass door are the only glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at Lager Heads is over, and from the king rooms the rain blurs the boardwalk lights along the wet beach.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from Lager Heads, the king rooms look out on boardwalk lights under low cloud, and the surf can be heard.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gulf outside the Premier Sea-View balconies is dark and flat, with the West Bay towers still lit.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were there this morning, you would step onto the balcony and see the Arabian Gulf under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong over the rooftop pool, and the Gulf below shows its brightest turquoise.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light reaches the sandy beach, where a few guests walk along the water with the Doha skyline across the bay.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the rooftop terrace has candles on the tables under the woven canopies, and the lit skyline is clearly visible beyond.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over West Bay this morning, and from the balcony the sea changes between grey and blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the outdoor pool, between the palm trees, guests watch clouds move slowly over the Gulf this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the marina turn orange, seen from the curved pier beside the yachts.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Doha today, so the Gulf outside the step-out balconies looks flat and pale, with little shine.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Doha, and today it falls on the empty blue loungers of the private beach below the rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, lightning over the Gulf can be seen from the suite living rooms, with the balcony doors kept shut.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the water today, and the West Bay glass towers across the bay are only pale shapes from the beach.
phrases.snow: Snow in Doha would be a first, but if it fell, the rooftop pool terrace would show it for a few minutes.
phrases.very_cold: On this unusually cold day the pool loungers stay empty, and guests look at the Gulf from behind the balcony doors.
phrases.very_hot: The heat is severe today, so most guests look at the Gulf from inside the rooftop pool rather than from the beach.
phrases.mild_night: This mild cloudy night, the candles on the rooftop terrace stay lit and the Doha skyline shows clearly without any stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the step-out balconies today the near water shows plainly, but the West Bay glass towers across the bay do not.
phrases.late_night: West Bay tower lights shine on the water off the Premier Sea-View rooms after midnight, and the whole Gulf shows at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner at Nobu, rain runs down the balcony doors and the West Bay tower lights blur across the Gulf.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner at Nobu, the Premier Sea-View rooms look out on the lit West Bay towers under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lake below the Terrace Studio balconies is dark and still, and the Prealps are a black outline.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the terrace comes with a clear view of Lake Garda and the limestone cliffs beyond the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the outdoor pool is in full sun, and from the loungers the rocky mountains look sharp and clear.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the stone balustrade terrace, and the cypress trees below cast long shadows toward the water.
phrases.clear_night: From a suite bathtub tonight, the harbor lights of Riva del Garda are visible through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Prealps this morning, and the terrace breakfast still has a full view of the lake.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on a Terrace Studio balcony this afternoon, you would see patches of sun moving across the lake.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud leaves some cliffs lit and others in shade, seen from the terrace.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky all day, so the view from the hot tub is a grey lake under grey mountains.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the outdoor pool, while guests in the indoor pool watch it through the glass walls.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm has moved over Lake Garda, and the Terrace Studio balconies are empty while lightning shows above the cliffs.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the lake today, and from the balustrade terrace the mountains appear only as pale shapes.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the cypress trees around the hotel, and the Finnish sauna in the CXI Spa is busy.
phrases.very_cold: From the Terrace Studio balconies, the Garda Prealps and the lake stand in hard winter light above frost on the rail.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the terrace this afternoon, so the outdoor pool and the shade of the cedar trees are the busiest spots.
phrases.mild_night: Dinner on the terrace tonight is under cloud, with the town lights of Riva reflected on the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the terrace the near cypress trees are clear but the cliffs across the lake are not.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the lake-view suites are probably asleep now, Riva's harbour lights on the water until the Prealps show at first light.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Terrace Studios are in for the evening, watching Riva's harbour lights blur through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a Terrace Studio after midnight looks out at Riva's harbour lights on the lake under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the 57-meter infinity pool lies still beside the sand, and Jimbaran Bay is a flat grey surface.
phrases.clear_morning: From the villa terraces on the hillside, the Indian Ocean is clearly visible this morning, with no cloud over the bay.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the beachfront pool, and most guests stay in the water or under the trees.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a villa's wooden deck now, you would see the sun going down over Jimbaran Bay without any cloud.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the bay is clear, and from an oceanview terrace the stars are easy to see above the water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Jimbaran Bay this morning, and the yoga pavilion by the beach is already in use.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the ocean this afternoon, so the light on the 57-meter pool changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the bay turns orange, visible from the lounge chairs on the villa decks.
phrases.overcast: The sky over Jimbaran Bay is fully grey today, and the sea looks grey too from the Imperial Villa at the top.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the bay and the beachfront pool, and the thatched roof of the yoga pavilion keeps its floor dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Indian Ocean right now, so the pool is empty and guests watch the lightning from their villas.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the far side of Jimbaran Bay today, but the sand beside the pool is easy to see.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Bali, so if it fell today, guests would watch it from the villa pools in disbelief.
phrases.very_cold: On this unusually cold day for Bali, the private villa pools stay empty and guests look at the bay from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the beach this afternoon, and the 57-meter pool is the busiest place at the resort.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy sky tonight the air is warm, and couples are still sitting on the oceanview terraces facing the dark bay.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far edge of Jimbaran Bay cannot be seen from the Imperial Villa, only the nearby beach.
phrases.late_night: Well past midnight, moonlight on Jimbaran Bay is easy to watch from the Imperial Villa.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Imperial Villa windows after midnight, and the shore lights of Jimbaran Bay blur behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers Jimbaran Bay after midnight, and the lights along the shore show through the haze from the Imperial Villa.

phrases.clear_predawn: Still dark over Paris, and from the top-floor terraces the Eiffel Tower is a tall black shape under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the private balconies of the Terrace Junior Suites comes with sunshine and a sharp view of the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the glass skylight of the dining room lets plenty of daylight onto the set tables.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Haussmann rooftops and the green copper dome of the church tower, seen from the top-floor terraces.
phrases.clear_night: From the plant-filled top-floor balcony, the Eiffel Tower stands against a clear night sky over the Haussmann rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: This morning some clouds cross the sky behind the Eiffel Tower, seen from the terrace breakfast tables among the plants.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the 8th arrondissement, and the Eiffel Tower is clear between them from the upper balconies.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, some clouds turn orange behind the Eiffel Tower, seen from the terraces with red geraniums.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey overcast sky, the Eiffel Tower stands flat and dim above the Haussmann rooftops beyond the top-floor terraces.
phrases.rain: Rain today, and the terrace plants get watered for free while guests eat in the dining room under the glass skylight.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the Eiffel Tower is sometimes lit by lightning, best watched from behind the closed French doors of a suite.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over Paris today hides the Eiffel Tower from the top floors, and only the nearest rooftops stay visible.
phrases.snow: White Haussmann rooftops today, and the Eiffel Tower shows grey through the falling snow from the terraces of the top-floor suites.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air on the balconies today, but a clear view of the Eiffel Tower for anyone who steps out briefly.
phrases.very_hot: Paris is very hot today, and the top-floor balconies get full sun, with the Eiffel Tower sharp above the rooftops.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the lit Eiffel Tower is visible under the clouds from the terraces of the top-floor suites.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today without rain or fog, and the Eiffel Tower is only a faint shape from the top-floor balconies.
phrases.late_night: A sip of water near one, and the Eiffel Tower's outline rises above lit Paris rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: Before bed, rain streaks the Terrace Junior Suite glass, the Eiffel Tower above wet rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Before bed, the Terrace Junior Suites face the Eiffel Tower above rooftop lights under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Red Sea outside the room windows is still dark, and the beach umbrellas are still closed.
phrases.clear_morning: Three cyclists in the open-air spin class face a bright, cloudless Red Sea while most guests are still at breakfast.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong over the curved pool complex, and the red sun loungers under the palms fill up first.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From Salt's terrace, the last hours of sun light the whole 180-degree arc of Nabq Bay in a warmer colour.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear starry sky tonight, guests eat beside Mangal's open fire with the Red Sea dark and close.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests at the twin room's two windows this morning look out on palm trees and the Red Sea under broken cloud.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the eight pools this afternoon, so swimmers get a few minutes of shade between long stretches of sun.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on Salt's terrace now, you would see the low sun lighting some clouds over Nabq Bay, not all.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Nabq Bay today, so the Red Sea beyond the beach umbrellas looks grey too, flat and calm.
phrases.rain: Rain in Sharm is rare, and the glass-walled teppanyaki restaurant is a drier place than the tables on the sand at Mangal.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests at the room windows tonight watch lightning flash over the Red Sea beyond the palms and the beach umbrellas.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Nabq Bay today softens the far end of Salt's 180-degree view, though the sand right below is clear.
phrases.snow: Snow in Sharm El-Sheikh would be a first, but the indoor heated pool would be the obvious place if it happened.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold outside today, so most guests are in the indoor heated pool or the Turkish bath, not the sea.
phrases.very_hot: Heat like today's keeps the beach umbrellas open and the eight pools full, with the shade under the palms taken early.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds and mild air tonight, and the sand-level tables at Mangal are full, the Red Sea dark three metres away.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from Salt's terrace the near beach is clear but the far ends of the bay are not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the room's window is open to a low moon on the Red Sea.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at Mangal is over, and the room window shows rain falling past the palms onto the Red Sea.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Mangal is over, and the room windows show the palms and a low hazy sky over Nabq Bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gulf of Antalya is still dark from the balconies, and the infinity pool is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From a sea-view balcony, the Mediterranean is bright and flat this morning, with the Taurus Mountains sharp in the distance.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the white loungers, so most guests are in the infinity pool or under the pergola.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: On the terrace, the low sun lights the water and the Taurus Mountains at the same time.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at the rooftop Pablito Bar tonight, you would see a clear sky above the dark Gulf of Antalya.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are moving over the Bey Mountains this morning, while the sea side of the hotel stays mostly in sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the sea from the Asmani Restaurant windows changes colour each time a cloud passes over the gulf.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds over the Taurus Mountains are lit from below, as seen from the balconies.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the Gulf of Antalya today, and the Bey Mountains look flat and dull from the balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the beach platform and the empty loungers, and guests watch the sea through the dining room windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, lightning over the Gulf of Antalya is easy to see from the 10th-floor Asmani Restaurant, behind glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the sea today, and the Taurus Mountains are only a faint shape from the poolside terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Antalya, but today the Bey Mountains are white from the balconies, and the sea below looks cold.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the mountains are sharp and white from the Asmani Restaurant, and nobody is on the loungers.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the poolside terrace, so the only comfortable outdoor spots are the infinity pool and the pergola shade.
phrases.mild_night: From your private balcony tonight, you would see the lights of Antalya along the gulf under a low cloudy sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the balconies today, the sea is in view but not the Taurus Mountains, because the air is not clear.
phrases.late_night: Around midnight, a glass of water by the bed, and the sea rooms look out at lights along the Gulf of Antalya.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain crosses the Gulf of Antalya after midnight; coast lights blur on the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud covers the Bey Mountains, and the lights along the Gulf of Antalya show from the sea-view rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Night still covers the Douro before dawn, and a high river-view room shows the bridge as a dark outline.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on a private balcony comes with a clear view of the Douro River and the bridge this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the Douro, and the terrace gives a clear look at the Dom Luís I Bridge.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a river-facing room now, you would see the bridge in low gold light through the large windows.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Dom Luís I Bridge is still easy to make out from the upper river-facing rooms.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over Porto this morning, but the bridge and the river show well from a balcony breakfast table.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the Douro this afternoon, and guests on the terrace watch a rabelo boat pass the bridge.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the Dom Luís I Bridge gives the river-facing rooms a changing view.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Porto today, yet the balcony breakfast table still faces the bridge and the Douro directly.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Douro, so breakfast moves indoors to the room, with the bridge visible through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm the terrace empties, and guests watch the lightning over the Dom Luís I Bridge from their room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the Douro today hides the far end of the bridge, even from the higher river-view rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow in Porto is rare, but if it fell today the river-facing rooms would show white on the bridge iron.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day the terrace stays quiet, and most guests look at the Douro from behind the large windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Porto this afternoon, so the balconies stay empty and guests watch the bridge from indoors.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests sit on the terrace with a drink from the bar, facing the river.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Serra do Pilar Monastery is faint from the rooms, while the nearer bridge stays clear.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water in a river-facing room comes with the bridge's arch and Ribeira lights on the water.
phrases.wet_evening: In the river-facing rooms after midnight, rain blurs the arch of the Dom Luís I Bridge and the Douro reflects riverside lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud passes over the Douro after midnight, and from the river-facing rooms the lights around the bridge blur and clear.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the harbour under the Grand Sea View room is still dark, and the moored boats are hard to see.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Grand Sea View room the sun comes up over St. Mawes harbour, and fishing boats are already moving.
phrases.clear_midday: Under the cream parasols on the terrace, lunch guests look across clear blue water to the village and wooded hillside.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the yachts in St. Mawes harbour, and the terrace is the usual place for an Idle Mary.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the harbour from the sash windows with the boats dark on the water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the harbour this morning, and the Grand Sea View room still gets sun between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over St. Mawes this afternoon, so the water seen from the restaurant windows changes between blue and grey.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud sits over the wooded hillside while the ferry crosses in front of the terrace.
phrases.overcast: From the window seat, the estuary is grey and the low green headland has no sun on it today.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the harbour, so guests watch the boats from the restaurant tables instead of the terrace.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the terrace is empty, and the storm over St. Mawes harbour is watched from behind the restaurant's large windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the estuary hides the headland across the harbour, and from the sash windows only the nearest moored boats show.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in St. Mawes, but today it is settling on the terrace furniture and the stone seawall below the hotel.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day like this, the terrace stays empty and guests take the harbour view from the restaurant windows instead.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot weather is unusual here, so the shade of the white parasols on the harbourside terrace is in demand.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and a few guests sit on the terrace with an Idle Mary, the harbour quiet below them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the terrace today the tree-covered slope beyond the harbour is faint, and the low headland is not visible at all.
phrases.late_night: Long after dinner, village lights shine on the harbour from the Grand Sea View room.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open after midnight, rain blurs the village lights across St Mawes harbour from the Grand Sea View room.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open after midnight in the Grand Sea View room, the lights of St Mawes show on the harbour water under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Yarra River rooms look out on Eureka Tower and Australia 108 standing dark against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From a private balcony on the river side, the morning sun lights Southbank across the Yarra River.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the floor-to-ceiling windows show Port Phillip Bay in the distance, with no cloud over the CBD.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the glass of Australia 108 and Eureka Tower, seen from the corner rooms above Flinders and Queen Streets.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lights of Southbank reflected in the Yarra River from your window.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the sky above Eureka Tower this morning, and the river rooms get sun between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Flinders rooms face Flinders Street Station under broken cloud, while river rooms look toward Southbank.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds behind Australia 108, a view the corner rooms frame in two windows.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the whole CBD today, and the Yarra River looks flat from the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests in the indoor pool swim beside the green wall of ferns instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Southbank is visible from the river rooms, and the private balconies are empty during the storm.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of Australia 108 today, so the windows show only the lower part of the Melbourne skyline.
phrases.snow: Melbourne almost never sees snow, yet this hour white flakes fall past the corner room windows above Flinders Street.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air over Melbourne today, so the private balconies are empty and guests watch the Yarra River from behind glass.
phrases.very_hot: In very hot weather the Yarra River rooms with a balcony get full sun through the glass until late afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and guests on the private balconies look at Eureka Tower lit up across the Yarra River.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Port Phillip Bay cannot be seen from the windows, though the Yarra River below is clear.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water by the bed, and Southbank's lights reflect in the Yarra River.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the Yarra River rooms after midnight, and the Southbank lights blur across the river.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain is open past midnight in the Yarra River rooms, and the Southbank lights reflect in the river under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the terraces above Elia Beach are quiet, and the Aegean is a dark flat surface below the villas.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at the Nouveau restaurant comes with a clear view of the shore, and the sea already shows its turquoise colour.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests in the private infinity pools can see the rocky hillside and the small beach below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a terrace now, you would see the low sun on the Aegean before dinner at Cabbanes.
phrases.clear_night: Late at night, stars fill the clear sky above the villa terraces and the private pools high over Elia Beach.
phrases.partly_morning: From the villa terraces this morning, a few clouds pass over the Aegean above the rocky hills and Elia Beach.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the bay this afternoon, and from the pools the water by the small beach changes between turquoise and grey.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the clouds pink and blue, and the infinity pool reflects them while guests hold cocktails nearby.
phrases.overcast: An overcast sky makes the Aegean look grey from the terraces, though the oysters at the on-site bar are the same.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the thatched roofs of the terraces, and the view across the Aegean is shorter than usual.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the open Aegean is visible from the suites, where the floor-to-ceiling doors stay closed for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the sea today, so from the Nouveau restaurant the shoreline is clear but the horizon is not.
phrases.snow: Snow on Mykonos is rare, but today a few flakes fall past the villa terraces toward the cold Aegean.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold outside today, and the private pools sit unused while the Aegean below stays bright and blue.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Elia Beach, and most guests stay in the infinity pools rather than on the sunbeds.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night sits over the villas, and dinner at Cabbanes continues outside without the usual stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: If you stood on a villa terrace now, you would see the rocky hillside above Elia Beach, but not the far Aegean.
phrases.late_night: Falling asleep in a villa above Elia now, you might leave the curtain open to the moon on the Aegean.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in your villa tonight, you would see rain hitting the glass doors and the pool outside.
phrases.grey_evening: Were you having a last drink in your suite after midnight, you would find cloud over the Aegean and the sea heard below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the bifold glass doors of the suites open onto a dark and very quiet Agioi Anargyroi bay.
phrases.clear_morning: Early guests are already on the loungers by the infinity pool, with the whole bay clear in front of them.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong, and the thatched umbrellas on the beach club are the only shade worth having.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the suites, the island silhouette across the bay stands out clearly while the sun drops toward the Paros hills.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars over the bay from a sunlounger beside the infinity pool.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the bay this morning, and the glass doors of the suites are already folded open.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over Agioi Anargyroi bay, and the rattan pod chairs under the pine trees stay in shade anyway.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud over the Paros hills colours the last hour of sun, seen from the dinner tables at RADA.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky today, so the bay looks flatter than in the photos, and the beach club loungers sit mostly empty.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare on Paros, and today it falls on the thatched umbrellas and the private pool terraces.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, guests watch lightning over the sea from behind the closed glass doors of their suites.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, so the island silhouette across the bay is only faintly visible from the suites.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Paros, but if it fell today, the olive trees around the pool would be briefly white.
phrases.very_cold: From the suite, hard winter light lies on the empty infinity pool and the cold bay at Agioi Anargyroi.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon on the bay; the outdoor massage spot among the spa's bamboo is one of the few shaded places.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the outdoor dining tables at RADA are set with the bay dark beyond them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the suites the sea is clear but the island silhouette across the bay is not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the suite's curtain stays open to the moonlit bay, and the sea sounds softly through the glass doors.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight rain runs down the suites' bifold glass doors, and the bay behind them blurs with each new shower.
phrases.grey_evening: From the suites, haze crosses the bay in the small hours and the moonlight on the sea dims and returns.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lake below the Junior Suite balconies is still dark, with the Alps a faint line behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: From the curved balcony dining table, Lake Zurich and the Alps are both sharp under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the lake, and the rooftop garden's white shade sails are actually useful.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Alps across Lake Zurich, seen from the private balconies on the Adlisberg hillside.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see a dark Lake Zurich from the suite windows, and the funicular running until midnight.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the morning sky over the lake, and the Alps appear and disappear behind them from the Junior Suite balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, parts of Lake Zurich are in sun and parts in cloud shadow, seen from the lounge's wingback chairs.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the Alps turn orange, which is the view from the curved suite windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky the lake looks flat and grey too, and the Alps are not visible from the balconies today.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the private terrace furniture, while inside the suite living room the curved windows still show a grey Lake Zurich.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Lake Zurich shows up clearly from the lounge's panoramic windows, and the balconies are empty for a reason.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides Lake Zurich today, and from the curved balconies only the nearby forest on the Adlisberg hillside shows.
phrases.snow: With snow coming down over Lake Zurich, steam rises from the infinity pool and the white Adlisberg hillside is quiet.
phrases.very_cold: On a day close to freezing, the Alps are very clear across Lake Zurich, and the infinity pool is steaming hard.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Zurich, and the rooftop garden's shade sails and the infinity pool are where guests spend the afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with clouds: the lake is dark below the balconies, and the funicular keeps running until midnight.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today: the lake is there, the Alps are not, and the distant hills are faint from the bathroom window.
phrases.late_night: Were you in a Junior Suite now, you might leave the curtain open and fall asleep facing the lights along Lake Zurich.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in the lounge now, you would see Lake Zurich's shore lights through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you took a last drink up to a Junior Suite tonight, you would see Lake Zurich's shore lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the Corner Suites before sunrise, English Bay is dark and the North Shore Mountains are just a shape against the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the ocean-facing Deluxe Rooms are getting a clear morning view of the snow on the North Shore Mountains.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over downtown, and from the indoor lap pool the nearby city buildings stand out sharply.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the high-floor lounge, late sun is lighting English Bay and the city skyline while the mountains turn orange.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the 34th-floor patio has a clear view of city lights in every direction, with the mountains dark beyond them.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are sitting over the North Shore Mountains this morning, but the downtown towers outside the guest rooms are in sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in a Corner Suite this afternoon, you would see patches of sun moving across English Bay between clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the cloud edges pink above the West End skyline, seen from the upper-floor windows.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Vancouver today, and the mountain tops behind the city are hidden from the Deluxe Rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is running down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the guest rooms, and the downtown towers look blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the wraparound glass of the Corner Suites gives a wide view of lightning over the Pacific.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the North Shore Mountains today, so the view from the high-floor lounge stops at the closest downtown towers.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the windows of both towers, and swimmers in the indoor lap pool can watch it through the glass.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day like this, the snow on the North Shore Mountains shows sharply from the ocean-facing rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Vancouver is very hot today, so the 34th-floor outdoor patio is quiet and most people watch the skyline through glass instead.
phrases.mild_night: Late on this mild cloudy night, downtown tower lights fill the Corner Suite windows toward the North Shore Mountains.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Corner Suites still show English Bay but not the mountains behind it.
phrases.late_night: With the Corner Suite lights off after midnight, the window shows only city lights toward the North Shore Mountains.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner, the Corner Suite windows are wet with rain, and low cloud hides the North Shore Mountains tonight.
phrases.grey_evening: Late after dinner, the Corner Suite windows show West End lights under low cloud where the North Shore Mountains are by day.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over the Atlantic is slowly getting lighter, seen from any room balcony at the south end.
phrases.clear_morning: From the room balcony, the sandy beach and the calm Atlantic show clearly under a cloudless morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the balcony chairs, and the Atlantic looks very blue from every room balcony on this side.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls across the sandy beach seen through the suite's teal-framed doors, with the sun now behind the hotel.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a balcony tonight, you would see stars over the Atlantic and not much else.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the ocean this morning, and from the king room balcony the sea changes between grey and blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the beach below the balconies is partly in sun and partly in cloud shadow, changing every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the Atlantic turn orange, and guests on the balconies are taking photo after photo.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey overcast sky, the sandy beach below the balconies runs out to a flat, colorless Atlantic.
phrases.rain: From the balcony chairs, rain falls on the empty sand and the boardwalk, with the grey Atlantic beyond.
phrases.thunderstorm: Behind the teal-framed suite doors, guests can watch lightning strike the Atlantic without stepping onto the balcony.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the water today, and the ocean disappears a short distance from the sand when seen from the suite balcony.
phrases.snow: Snow on the sand is rare here, but today the balconies look over a white beach and a dark grey Atlantic.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing on the balconies today, so most guests watch the Atlantic through the teal-framed doors instead.
phrases.very_hot: If you were on your balcony now, you would see heat-haze over the sand and most people down in the water.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night under cloud at the quiet south end, and the sound of the Atlantic comes through the open balcony doors.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the room balconies, the sand and the near Atlantic water show in the haze, with no horizon line today.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the boardwalk lights reach the sand outside the king rooms, and there is no hurry to stop watching the ocean.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the balcony doors of the ocean-view suites, and the boardwalk lights blur over the wet sand.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight a grey haze covers the Atlantic, and from the ocean-view rooms the boardwalk lights spread along the sand.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the 27th-floor terrace is empty and the Royal Palace is already a dark shape on the near horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: From the twin room window, Madrid's low-rise rooftops sit under a clear blue sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: High sun over the rooftop pool at midday, where red umbrellas give the only shade between the lounge chairs.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden hour on the glass-floored sky bridge, where a waiter carries cocktails over a long drop to the street.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at the 26th-floor Eden bar tonight, you would see Madrid's lights spread out under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Madrid this morning, seen from the marble bathroom window and its view of the rooftops.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the Vertigo platform this afternoon, and the Royal Palace stays in plain view.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the broken clouds above the wraparound terrace, with the Royal Palace below them.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Gran Vía today, watched from the high-floor dining area through its floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.rain: Rain on the glass floor of the sky bridge today, so guests stay inside the dining area and look out.
phrases.thunderstorm: With thunder over Madrid, the 27th-floor terrace is the wrong place to stand, and lightning is watched from the room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the view from the rooftop terrace, and the Royal Palace is only a faint outline today.
phrases.snow: Snow over Madrid is rare, but today the rooftops seen from the twin room window carry a thin white layer.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air on the 27th-floor terrace today, so the wicker chairs stay empty while the Royal Palace remains fully visible.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon in Madrid, and the 21st-floor pool is the busiest place in the hotel right now.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy sky, this mild night brings guests up to the rooftop bar, where the DJ booth's neon lights are on.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the wraparound terrace the distant skyline is missing, though the nearby Royal Palace is still there.
phrases.late_night: Whoever left the curtain open tonight is falling asleep with the Royal Palace on the near horizon, city lights around it.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the twin rooms after midnight watches rain run down the glass, the Royal Palace on the near horizon.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a twin room tonight can watch low cloud drift over the city lights, the Royal Palace on the near horizon.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before sunrise, the caldera under the infinity pool suite is still dark, with a pale strip of sky above.
phrases.clear_morning: From the floor-to-ceiling windows of a suite, the morning sun lights the volcanic cliffs and the sea is a calm blue.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Aegean below the private plunge pools is deep blue, and the sunloungers on the terrace are in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would watch the low sun colour the volcanic cliffs from the massage cabana.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the pool is lit, the dining tables on the terrace have candles, and Oia's white houses glow across the caldera.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the caldera this morning, so the infinity pool suite gets sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests reading by the infinity pool this afternoon watch cloud shadows move across the Aegean and the volcanic island.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the caldera take some colour, seen from the terrace dining tables.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Aegean below the plunge pools looks darker than usual, and the volcanic island is still visible.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the caldera today, so the only rain shower worth using is the one inside the honeymoon suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Aegean shows through the floor-to-ceiling suite windows, and nobody is in the outdoor massage cabana right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the caldera makes the volcanic island hard to see today, and the Aegean below the infinity pool looks pale grey.
phrases.snow: A rare sight for Santorini today, with a little snow on the terrace sunloungers and the caldera grey below the plunge pools.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day like this, the sunloungers by the infinity pool stay empty and the volcanic island looks very clear.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Oia, and most guests are in their private pools rather than on the sunloungers facing the caldera.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the lights of Oia across the caldera are visible from the candlelit terrace tables.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests at the pool terrace today see the sea below, but not the island far across the caldera.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the honeymoon suites sleep now, village lights on the cliff tonight and the blue caldera to see at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has the infinity pool suite tonight watches rain on the floor-to-ceiling glass, Oia's village lights blurred across the caldera.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has the infinity pool suite tonight sees Oia's village lights across the caldera under a low cover of cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the ocean outside the guest-room windows is a dark flat line, and the Penthouse is not yet serving breakfast.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the eighteenth floor comes with a clear view of the Pacific and the Palos Verdes mountains in the distance.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high and the ocean looks very bright from the king-bed rooms designed by Thomas Schoos.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the rooftop booths, guests are watching the sun drop toward the Pacific while the Santa Monica Mountains turn orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Penthouse lounge tonight, you would see a clear sky over the dark Pacific and the Promenade lights.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the water this morning, but the Palos Verdes peninsula is still visible from the upper rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, cloud shadows move across the Pacific, and the large suite windows give a wide view of it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the palm trees and the clouds over the ocean, seen from the rooftop bar.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pacific looks grey too, and the Santa Monica hills are flat and dull from the eighteenth floor.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Santa Monica, so guests in the Penthouse restaurant are watching wet windows instead of a sharp horizon.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Pacific is unusual here, and the Penthouse windows on the eighteenth floor give a wide view of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Morning fog is common on this coast, so the ocean outside the fourth-floor rooms is hidden in white right now.
phrases.snow: Snow in Santa Monica almost never happens, so if you were in a suite now you would see something very rare.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold, clear day is rare on this coast, and the Pacific looks sharp and blue from the Penthouse windows.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the ocean seen from the upper rooms looks cool, though the Promenade below is in full sun.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky tonight, but the air is mild and the Penthouse lounge is serving cocktails with the dark Pacific outside.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the ocean near the shore is visible from the rooms, but the Palos Verdes mountains are not.
phrases.late_night: Long after midnight the shore lights line the coast in the room windows, and the Pacific shows white where it breaks.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the window of a Pacific-facing room after midnight, and the Santa Monica shore lights show through it.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open after midnight in a guest room, low cloud hides the moon and the shore lights show where the Pacific begins.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the garden suites look onto dark hedges and tall trees, with the dome of San Lorenzo only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: From a suite window this morning, Brunelleschi's Dome stands sharp above the terracotta roofs under a clear blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the white loungers by the outdoor pool are in full sun, and the hydrangeas get very little shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the central fountain in the Giardino della Gherardesca, and the hedges throw long shadows across the garden.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the Duomo dome lit against a clear sky from the suite sitting room.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Florence this morning, so the terracotta rooftops below the Duomo switch between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the white loungers at the outdoor pool move in and out of sun as clouds pass this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the dome of San Lorenzo beyond the garden catches light between the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the frescoed vaulted ceiling of the gallery hall is brighter than anything outside the tall windows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the hedges and the central fountain, and the suites with garden views are the drier place to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the outdoor pool stands empty, and guests watch the lightning over Florence from the suite windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the city today means the Duomo dome from the rooftop is a pale shape rather than a sharp one.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Florence, but today it is settling on the hedges and the fountain rim in the Giardino della Gherardesca.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the garden stays empty and most guests see the hedges from behind the tall windows.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Florence today, so the wading pool and the shade of the tall trees get the most use.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the hedged garden below the suite windows is dark and the fountain is still running.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is reduced today, so the Duomo dome from the rooftop looks softer than usual, and nothing further away can be seen.
phrases.late_night: The garden suites sleep after midnight, only the city's lights past the Gherardesca trees; at dawn their windows show Brunelleschi's Dome.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain streaks the suite windows, and Florence's lit rooftops look blurred around the round shape of the Duomo.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud covers Florence, and the city lights look hazy across the rooftops from the suite sitting room.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky is still dark over Victoria Harbour, and from the suites the lit towers of Hong Kong Island stand out.
phrases.clear_morning: From the floor-to-ceiling windows, every tower on Hong Kong Island appears clearly across the water this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: The infinity pool deck is in full sun now, and the two wooden daybeds face a bright blue harbour.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the pool deck now, you would watch low sunlight on the Hong Kong Island towers across the harbour.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the skyline lights show twice from the suites, once on Hong Kong Island and once on the harbour water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Victoria Harbour this morning, and from the harbour-view rooms the skyline moves between shade and sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the rooftop pool deck are getting sun in short periods between clouds, with the harbour below them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the harbour turn orange above the daybeds on the pool deck.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky sits over Victoria Harbour today, but the Hong Kong Island skyline is still fully visible from every room.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the harbour, so most guests are inside, watching wet windows and a grey skyline from their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Hong Kong Island is visible from the suites, and nobody is on the outdoor pool deck right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the top floors of the Hong Kong Island towers today, though the harbour water stays visible from the rooms.
phrases.snow: Hong Kong practically never sees snow, so any flakes falling past the floor-to-ceiling windows would be a rare sight.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold and clear today, so the wooden daybeds on the pool deck are empty and the skyline is very clear.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon over Victoria Harbour, and the rooftop infinity pool is where most guests are spending it.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night in Hong Kong, with the lit skyline still clear across the harbour from the pool deck.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far towers on Hong Kong Island look faded from the rooms, though the harbour is clear.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the floor-to-ceiling windows of a harbour-view suite show Hong Kong Island, its lights reflected on Victoria Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the harbour-view rooms, and the Hong Kong Island skyline lights blur on the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Tonight the Hong Kong Island skyline lights reflect on Victoria Harbour under low cloud, seen from the harbour-view rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the 14th-floor executive suites look down on a still-dark Plaza Rodríguez Peña and the Sarmiento Palace.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the rooftop pool, and the white lounge chairs are still empty under a cloudless Buenos Aires sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands directly over Plaza Rodríguez Peña, and the palm trees in the park throw very short shadows.
