phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the French-style front of the Sarmiento Palace, seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the upper rooms.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lights of the mid-rise skyline from a 14th-floor executive suite.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Recoleta this morning, and guests on the balcony drink tea above the green treetops.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop pool this afternoon, guests watch patches of sun and cloud move across the Buenos Aires skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky over Buenos Aires above the Sarmiento Palace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the floor-to-ceiling windows of the guest rooms show a flat, even light on the mid-rise skyline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Plaza Rodríguez Peña today, and the Negresco Bistró is the drier place to spend the hour.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Recoleta, and from the 14th floor guests watch lightning above the city skyline from behind the windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Buenos Aires today, and from the executive suites the Sarmiento Palace is a soft grey shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Buenos Aires, but today a few flakes drift past the floor-to-ceiling windows above Plaza Rodríguez Peña.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the rooftop pool stays empty and the white lounge chairs stay unused.
phrases.very_hot: The air over Recoleta is very hot this afternoon, and most guests are in the turquoise water of the rooftop pool.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Recoleta, and the balcony is a comfortable place to sit above the dark treetops.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far skyline is missing from the suite windows, though Plaza Rodríguez Peña stays clear.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water, and the city lights show in the fourteenth-floor suite windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the executive suite windows tonight, and Plaza Rodríguez Peña looks wet and bright.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the plaza after midnight, and the city lights shine below the suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: It is still dark over Llandudno Bay, and from a sea-facing room the Great Orme headland is only a black outline.
phrases.clear_morning: From the grey armchairs by the bay window, the pebble beach and promenade are sharp under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over Llandudno Bay, and from a sea-facing room the water looks pale blue to the headland.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the terrace now, you would see the low sun colouring the Great Orme headland across the bay.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Llandudno Bay is clear, and the sea-facing rooms get a view of stars and the dark headland.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds and sun take turns over the pebble beach this morning, seen from the bay window with a Nespresso in hand.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, broken cloud sits over the bay, and the promenade below the sea-facing rooms is partly in shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day reaches the terrace, and the clouds above the Great Orme headland are turning gold.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the sea in Llandudno Bay looks grey too from the double rooms, calm and flat.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pebble beach and promenade, so the grey armchairs by the bay window are the dry seats.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Llandudno Bay can be watched from a sea-facing room, and nobody is sitting on the iron terrace furniture right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has moved into the bay, so from the bay windows only the pebble beach shows and the headland is hidden.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the pebble beach and the iron terrace furniture, a rare sight for Llandudno Bay from the double rooms.
phrases.very_cold: The iron terrace furniture has no takers today, with the air over the promenade and pebble beach close to freezing.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day for North Wales, the terrace with its iron furniture faces a bright, still Llandudno Bay.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers Llandudno Bay on this mild night, and the promenade below the sea-facing rooms is almost empty.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the sea-facing rooms the Great Orme headland is only a faint shape across the bay.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, the promenade lights show on the water of Llandudno Bay from the sea-facing bay windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the bay window of a sea-facing room tonight, and the promenade lights show in blurred lines over Llandudno Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open before bed, the sea-facing bay window shows the promenade lights along Llandudno Bay under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Reforma-facing rooms look out on the golden column of El Ángel with almost no traffic on the avenue yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Early morning gives the clearest sightline, and the detail on the golden column is easy to read from mid-floor windows.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over Reforma, and the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows frame the monument in full daylight.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the gold of El Ángel, seen from the suite living room along with the glass towers.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests at the rooftop pool see the city skyline lit up in every direction under a dark sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Mexico City this morning, and the golden column brightens and then dims as the sun comes and goes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon some cloud sits over the glass towers, but the monument outside the Reforma-facing rooms stays in plain view.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were at the restaurant windows now, you would see broken cloud and low gold light on El Ángel.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky covers Mexico City today, so the golden column looks dull from the rooms, though the avenue below is clearly visible.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Paseo de la Reforma, and guests watch it from the restaurant's tall windows with the monument wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the city right now, and from the suite living room the lightning shows behind the glass towers.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Mexico City, and the glass towers fade behind El Ángel, which is still clear from the Reforma-facing rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never falls here, but if it did today, the golden column would stand out against a white avenue.
phrases.very_cold: Cold enough to freeze on Reforma today, and the clear air shows every detail of El Ángel from mid-floor rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Under a very hot sun, the Reforma-facing rooms show the gold of El Ángel at full brightness, with the avenue busy below.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Mexico City, and the lounge chairs by the rooftop pool face the lit skyline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far skyline behind the glass towers is not visible, though El Ángel next door is clear.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the front rooms sleep now with the curtain left open, the Angel's gold column and tower lights in the window.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a Reforma-facing room tonight can watch rain run down the glass, the Angel's column close across the wet avenue.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a Reforma-facing room now sees the column of El Ángel and the lit avenue under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Cathedral tower is a dark shape against a clear sky from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_morning: From the suite's floor-to-ceiling windows, the morning sun is already on Porto's terracotta rooftops and the Cathedral.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the clear sky over Porto makes the tiled rooftops look bright from the room windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see the low sun on the Cathedral and the historic rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Porto is clear, and the Cathedral tower stands out above the rooftops from select rooms.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds pass over Porto this morning, while swimmers in the indoor pool look out at the yellow Baroque building.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds move across the sun this afternoon, so the terracotta rooftops seen from the rooms change between bright and dull.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud sits over Porto as the sun goes down, and the Cathedral tower is clear from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Porto's rooftops look flat and dull from the suite windows, and the spa is a reasonable plan.
phrases.rain: If you were at a room window now, you would see rain falling on Porto's tiled rooftops and the Cathedral tower.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Porto, so guests watch the Cathedral tower from the room windows rather than the rooftop terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over Porto hides the top of the Cathedral tower today, leaving only the nearest tiled rooftops visible from the rooms.
phrases.snow: A few snowflakes, unusual for Porto, fall on the tiled rooftops outside the room windows today.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside, so the clear view of the Cathedral from the rooftop terrace is enjoyed in coats.
phrases.very_hot: The sun is very hot on Porto's rooftops today, and few guests stay long on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the rooftop terrace is comfortable, with the Cathedral tower a dark outline above Rua das Flores.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooms the Cathedral tower is only a faint shape and far rooftops are unclear.
phrases.late_night: Past one o'clock, the Cathedral tower is a shape above the lit rooftops in the suite's windows, no hurry to stop looking.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the suite windows this evening, and the Cathedral tower rises above the wet, lit rooftops of Porto.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Porto after midnight, and the suite windows look onto lit rooftops around the shape of the Cathedral tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Porta Nuova towers are dark shapes from the panoramic terrace, and the trimmed topiaries are still in shadow.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Porta Nuova glass towers, and guests on the fitness centre treadmills see them through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky over Milan is completely clear, and the whole Porta Nuova skyline stands sharp beyond the terrace railings.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun colours the Porta Nuova towers orange, and the panoramic terrace is the place to watch it from.
phrases.clear_night: After midnight, the lit Porta Nuova towers stand under a clear sky beyond the panoramic terrace and its trimmed topiaries.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Porta Nuova this morning, so the towers go bright and dim in turn from the panoramic terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in the Principe Terrace suite this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows crossing Piazza della Repubblica below.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights some Porta Nuova towers and leaves others under cloud, seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: A grey ceiling of cloud sits over Milan today, and the Porta Nuova skyline looks flat from the fitness centre windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the panoramic terrace topiaries, and guests watch it from the draped windows of their rooms instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder is over Milan, and lightning shows the Porta Nuova towers for a second at a time from the fitness centre windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of Porta Nuova today, and only the nearest rooftops are visible from the guest room windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the trimmed topiaries of the panoramic terrace, with the Porta Nuova towers white-topped behind them.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing on the panoramic terrace today, where the air is clear and the Porta Nuova towers look very sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Milan today, and the panoramic terrace railings are warm to touch while the Porta Nuova glass reflects hard sunlight.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Milan, and the Porta Nuova tower lights are visible from the rooftop terrace without a coat.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Milan today, and the farther Porta Nuova towers are not clear from the panoramic terrace.
phrases.late_night: Were you up for water near midnight, you would see the Porta Nuova towers lit above Piazza della Repubblica.
phrases.wet_evening: After a last drink at the Principe Bar tonight, you would see the Porta Nuova lights through rain on the window.
phrases.grey_evening: If you came up from a last drink at the Principe Bar now, you would see Porta Nuova's lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Chao Phraya is already busy with boats, seen from a State Room balcony directly above the water.
phrases.clear_morning: A clear morning puts bright sun on the river, and the red loungers by the pool are mostly still empty.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the pool terrace, so the shade of the tropical garden is popular.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the riverside dining terrace, the low sun lights the Chao Phraya and the Bangkok skyline before dinner.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would hear jazz in the Bamboo Bar and see the lit skyline from a balcony.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over Bangkok this morning, and the river boats below the State Room balconies carry on as usual.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun comes and goes over the pool this afternoon, and the red loungers are in shade for minutes at a time.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, some clouds over the Chao Phraya turn orange, seen from the dining terrace.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Bangkok today, and the Chao Phraya looks brown and flat from the floor-to-ceiling suite windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the river, so dinner at Le Normandie happens behind glass, with the Chao Phraya still in view.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests watch lightning over the river from inside the suites rather than from the balconies.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Bangkok, making the skyline pale, but the river directly below the balconies is easy to see.
phrases.snow: Snow has never been recorded in Bangkok; if it ever fell, the State Room balconies would be the place to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold day, nobody uses the pool, and guests look at the river from behind the suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Bangkok today; the pool is the sensible place, with the tropical garden around it.
phrases.mild_night: Guests on the State Room balconies after midnight watch boat lights move along the Chao Phraya under a cloudy sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far skyline is not clear from the suites, but the Chao Phraya right below remains visible.
phrases.late_night: A State Room curtain is left open on purpose, so lights along the Chao Phraya reflect in the water until sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the State Room windows after midnight, and the lights along the Chao Phraya look blurred through the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze covers the Chao Phraya after midnight, and the lights across the river look soft and blurred from the State Rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the south-facing balconies look over a dark Los Angeles basin, with the skyline not yet lit by the sun.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at Boxwood comes with a clear sky over West Hollywood, and the north balconies show the Hollywood Hills in full sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: From the tenth-floor rooftop pool, the Hills to the north and the basin to the south are sharp under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the Hollywood Hills from the west, and the palm trees in front of the balconies cast long shadows.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the Century City skyline lit up through the glass railing of the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Hollywood Hills this morning, and guests on the north balconies watch them pass with coffee.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds move across the Los Angeles basin, so the south-facing suites get patches of sun and shade on the skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the undersides of the clouds above the rooftop fire pit, while the city below turns grey.
phrases.overcast: From the tenth-floor rooftop terrace, the Century City towers stand grey under low cloud beyond the citrus trees.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Los Angeles, so the rooftop citrus trees get watered for free and the pool stays empty.
phrases.thunderstorm: From a south-facing balcony on North San Vicente, lightning over the Los Angeles basin shows the wet skyline for a moment.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze thins the Los Angeles skyline from the south balconies, and the Hollywood Hills to the north look pale and far away.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches West Hollywood, but a dusting on the Hollywood Hills would be visible from the north-facing balconies.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare freezing day the rooftop pool has no swimmers, and the fire pit on the terrace is the busiest spot.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the basin, and the tenth-floor pool is the only logical place to look at the view from.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night keeps guests on the rooftop terrace, where the tropical cushions are taken and the city lights are on.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Century City towers look faint from the rooftop and the far basin is hidden.
phrases.late_night: City lights fill the south-facing suite windows late tonight, and the bedside light stays on.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the suite windows after midnight, and the lights of the city to the south blur through it.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight a thin haze covers the Los Angeles basin, and the city lights look soft through it from the south-facing suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Paseo de la Castellana is nearly empty, and upper-floor guests see it from bed under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the upper-floor rooms, early sun lights the green treetops along Paseo de la Castellana under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands high over Madrid's low rooftops, and the suite windows show a flat blue sky without a cloud.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the rooftops of Salamanca yellow, and from the suites the boulevard fills with people heading home.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lamps of the Castellana in a straight line from an upper-floor window.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the low rooftops this morning, and the marble bathroom gets changing light through its tall window.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun alternate over the Castellana this afternoon, so the treetops outside the room windows look bright, then dull.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over Madrid turn orange, visible from the bathtub by its tall window.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Madrid today, and the low rooftops outside the suite look flat and colourless, with no shadows anywhere.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Paseo de la Castellana, and from the upper floors the traffic moves slowly with lights on.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over Madrid now; from the suite, lightning shows up briefly above the rooftops and then the rain gets heavier.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the city today, so the far end of the Castellana is unclear even from the upper floors.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Madrid, but today it is landing on the green treetops outside the floor-level room windows.
phrases.very_cold: If you were at an upper window now, you would see hard winter light on the bare treetops along Paseo de la Castellana.
phrases.very_hot: Madrid is very hot this afternoon, and the sunlit boulevard outside the upper-floor windows has fewer people on it than usual.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy sky the night is mild, and from the suite the lights of the Castellana are the only thing moving.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so from the upper-floor rooms the Castellana is clear nearby but fades out before its far end.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the lit length of Paseo de la Castellana shows in the suite windows, and there is no hurry to look away.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open after midnight, rain blurs the lights of Paseo de la Castellana in the suite windows.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain is open after midnight in the suites, and the boulevard lights of Paseo de la Castellana show under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Eiffel Tower is a dark shape opposite Room 502's balcony, and the breakfast table is still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balcony of Room 502, the Eiffel Tower stands against a clear morning sky above the 16th arrondissement rooftops.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the red umbrellas on Lordy's Paris Club terrace give the only shade, and the striped chairs fill up.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden light falls on the Eiffel Tower, seen from the sitting area balcony over the roofs of the 16th arrondissement.
phrases.clear_night: Guests on Room 502's balcony have the Eiffel Tower, lights on, directly opposite, and no cloud over Paris at this hour.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Paris this morning, and from the sitting area the top of the Eiffel Tower shows between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On Lordy's Paris Club terrace this afternoon, the sun comes and goes over the striped chairs and red geraniums.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds sit over the Paris rooftops while the last sun of the day lights the Eiffel Tower opposite Room 502.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Eiffel Tower looks flat and dark from the balcony, but the geraniums keep their colour.
phrases.rain: Through the rain on Room 502's balcony doors, the Eiffel Tower rises grey above the wet rooftops of the sixteenth arrondissement.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests watch the Eiffel Tower from inside Room 502, with the balcony doors shut against the wind.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of the Eiffel Tower today, so the wrought-iron banister with Gustave Eiffel's signature is the closest thing to it.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the Room 502 balcony railing, and the Eiffel Tower opposite shows white lines along its ironwork.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, so the striped chairs on Lordy's terrace stay empty while the Eiffel Tower stands sharp.
phrases.very_hot: From the Room 502 balcony, the Eiffel Tower rises through midday heat-haze above the 16th arrondissement rooftops and the red geraniums.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and the lit Eiffel Tower is still fully visible from Room 502's balcony.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the sitting area only the lower part of the Eiffel Tower is clear above the rooftops.
phrases.late_night: In Room 502 the curtain is left open for sleep after midnight, so the Eiffel Tower fills the window above the rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Lordy's Paris Club, the Eiffel Tower is seen from Room 502 through rain on the glass, above wet rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Supper over at Lordy's Paris Club, the sitting area window shows the Eiffel Tower's outline above rooftop lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the upper-floor rooms look out on Knippels Bridge with only a few cars crossing it.
phrases.clear_morning: From the canal-side rooms, the water of Christianshavn's canal is bright and flat under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the copper rooftops and spires seen from the king rooms stand in full sun, with sharp shadows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: On the rooftop terrace, the teak seats face a low sun that is turning the city skyline orange.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Royal Library's glass front shows a reflection of the harbor lights to the upper-floor rooms.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are moving over Copenhagen this morning, and the spires outside the suite windows go in and out of sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Christiansborg tower, seen from the suite living room, catches sun between passing clouds this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the dining tables on the rooftop terrace get warm light broken by clouds.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the harbor today, and Knippels Bridge looks flat and colorless from the upper floors.
phrases.rain: If you were at an upper-floor window now, you would see rain falling on the canal below Knippels Bridge.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were in a suite right now, you would watch lightning over the harbor from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the harbor hides the far end of Knippels Bridge, so from the upper rooms only its nearest part shows.
phrases.snow: Outside the king room windows, snow settles on the copper rooftops and the spires slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, so the rooftop terrace is empty and guests watch the harbor from their rooms instead.
phrases.very_hot: Guests in the upper-floor rooms this afternoon look across Knippels Bridge to copper rooftops shimmering in the heat.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night, with the fire table lit on the rooftop terrace and guests on the outdoor sofas.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the upper floors Knippels Bridge is clear but the spires beyond it are not.
phrases.late_night: Back from a late dinner, you would see harbor lights in the Royal Library's glass.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in a canal-side room now, you would see Knippels Bridge through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in a canal room now, the Royal Library's glass would show the harbor lights under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Brisbane River below the 21st-floor Terrace is dark, and the city skyline shows only its lights.
phrases.clear_morning: From a river-facing suite, morning sun lights South Bank Parklands and the Brisbane River under a completely clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Brisbane River runs past South Bank Parklands below the 21st-floor Terrace in bright sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The last afternoon sun turns the Brisbane River gold, and a balcony with a glass of wine is the obvious seat.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Kurilpa Bridge is lit across the water, and the freestanding tub faces the whole Brisbane skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered morning clouds move over Brisbane, and the floor-to-ceiling windows show the river alternating between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the 21st-floor Terrace have patches of blue sky above South Bank Parklands and the river this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the city skyline catch orange light above the infinity pool.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Brisbane today, and the river from the balcony looks grey as well.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on South Bank Parklands, so the river-facing suites are the dry place to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were in a suite right now, you would watch lightning over the city skyline through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Brisbane River softens the city skyline today, and the Kurilpa Bridge is only partly visible from the Terrace.

phrases.clear_night: If you were in a villa tonight, you would see stars over a very dark Indian Ocean from your own terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the Bukit Peninsula this morning, and from the spa treatment room guests see gardens and ocean below.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the oceanfront lounge has sun and shade in turns, as clouds move slowly across the sky above the sunbeds.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds from below, and the cliff-edge tables at Il Ristorante have the full view.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Indian Ocean turns grey too, but the infinity pool on the clifftop is still in use.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the villa terraces, and the inclinator down to the private beach is probably not in demand right now.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is moving over the ocean, so guests are watching the lightning from inside their villas rather than from the terraces.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the water today, and from the breakfast tables the horizon between sea and sky is hard to find.
phrases.snow: Snow does not fall in Bali, so this line exists only on paper, while the villa terraces stay warm as usual.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing weather would be a first for the Bukit Peninsula, and the outdoor sunbeds at the oceanfront lounge would stay empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the cliffs today, and most guests are in the infinity pool or under the lounge umbrellas.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm, cloudy night the wooden staircase columns are gold-lit, and the ocean beyond them is a dark shape.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the horizon is missing from the villa windows, though the waves at the cliff base are clear.
phrases.late_night: Past midnight, one villa window is kept lit, facing the moonlit Indian Ocean.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Il Ristorante – Niko Romito, rain runs down the villa windows tonight.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Il Ristorante, night cloud covers the Indian Ocean beyond the villa windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Crystal Pier is a dark shape against a grey Pacific when seen from the Surf Pad balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the Pacific lies flat and blue beyond Crystal Pier, with surfers waiting past the sandbar.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the ocean looks very blue from the private patios, and the sand in front of Crystal Pier is bright.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a balcony now, you would see the sun dropping toward the Pacific directly behind Crystal Pier.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the stars are out over a dark Pacific, and the sound of the surf reaches every room balcony.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Pacific this morning, but Crystal Pier and the beach are clear from every room balcony.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the water this afternoon, and the beach below the balconies has patches of sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds behind Crystal Pier turn orange, and the tables at JRDN face straight into it.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky the Pacific looks flat and silver from the balconies, with Crystal Pier clearly visible.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the boardwalk and on Crystal Pier, and guests watch it from behind the glass doors of their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the ocean right now, and from the Sanctuary rooms lightning shows up above the Pacific.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over Pacific Beach today, so from the balconies Crystal Pier is only a faint line and the horizon is gone.
phrases.snow: Snow is extremely rare in San Diego, yet today a few flakes fall over the sand in front of the balconies.
phrases.very_cold: The air on the balconies is close to freezing today, rare for San Diego, but Crystal Pier and the ocean are sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot over Pacific Beach today, and from the private patios the ocean and the surf look cooler than the sand.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers the stars on this mild night, but the surf is audible through the open glass doors of Surf Pad rooms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Crystal Pier shows from the balconies but the ocean fades to grey before the horizon.
phrases.late_night: Sleep comes late in a Surf Pad room, white night surf breaking beside Crystal Pier.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtains stay open in the Surf Pad rooms after midnight, and rain on the glass blurs the boardwalk lights by the Pacific.
phrases.grey_evening: The Surf Pad curtains stay open after midnight, and under the cloud the surf breaks pale beyond the glass doors.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before dawn the sky over Auckland is clear and dark, and the Sky Tower shows head-on from the tower-facing suites.
phrases.clear_morning: From a corner guest room, the whole Sky Tower is in frame this morning, with nothing in the sky around it.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over Auckland, and the Sky Tower rooms show every detail of the structure in sharp light.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun colours the Sky Tower and the CBD rooftops, seen from the Churchill Bar on the 20th floor.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests at the Churchill Bar see the lit Sky Tower above the city lights.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass behind the Sky Tower this morning, and guests in the Sky Tower rooms watch them from the window.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon patches of cloud move over the Auckland skyline, visible through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the lounge.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests at the Churchill Bar have drinks while the last sun lights some clouds above the Sky Tower and leaves others grey.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the CBD today, so the Sky Tower looks pale and less sharp from the suites.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Sky Tower rooms, and the tower behind the glass looks blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Auckland is best watched from inside the Churchill Bar, where lightning shows behind the Sky Tower.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Sky Tower today, and from the Queen Street rooms only the lower structure is clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is a very rare sight in Auckland, and today flakes pass the Sky Tower outside the suite windows.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, rare for Auckland, and the Sky Tower stands very sharp from the corner guest rooms.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day in Auckland, the Sky Tower shows clearly through the suite windows in strong, bright sunlight.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild with cloud overhead, and guests at the Churchill Bar look out at the lit Sky Tower.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is reduced today, so the Sky Tower is still clear from the suites but the farther skyline is not.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Sky Tower suites may have left the curtain open, to fall asleep facing the tower and the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the Sky Tower suites after midnight watches the rain run down the glass, the tower's shape straight ahead.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a Sky Tower room after midnight watches low cloud drift across the tower's upper half above the lit streets.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the valley below the 35 rooms is still dark, and the farmhouses show only as shapes from the balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun reaches the farmhouses and pasture of Phobjikha this morning, all sharp through the floor-to-ceiling glass of the rooms.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear sky at noon, guests at Vista eat Bhutanese food with the whole valley visible in the windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the pine-forested mountains across the valley, seen from the private balconies of the rooms.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Phobjikha is clear, and the fire at Chang Lounge & Bar burns beside windows that show mostly stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cover part of the valley this morning, so from the room windows some farmhouses are in sun and others in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, cloud shadows move slowly across the meadows below, which is easy to follow from the terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud turns the sky above the pine forest purple and orange, seen from the terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey overcast sky, the farmhouses and meadows of Phobjikha lie without shadows below the lounge windows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the meadows and the crane sanctuary below, and most guests are inside by the fireplace at Chang Lounge.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were there during this storm, you would watch lightning over the pine-forested mountains from behind the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills the valley floor today, so the farmhouses are hidden and only the nearest pines show from the balconies.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the meadows and the farmhouse roofs below, and the view from every room is mostly white.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, and the valley is sharp and clear from the balconies for anyone wrapped up enough.
phrases.very_hot: It is unusually hot for Phobjikha today, and guests with balconies mostly keep the glass between themselves and the sun.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, candles are lit on the terrace, and the pine forest across the valley is a dark shape.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the room windows the near meadows are clear but the far mountains are not.
phrases.late_night: The curtain is left open on purpose tonight in a valley room, so a few farmhouse lights in Phobjikha show through the glass.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open after midnight, rain streaks the room's tall glass and a few farmhouse lights show across Phobjikha.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers Phobjikha after midnight, and with the curtains open the rooms' floor-to-ceiling glass shows a few farmhouse lights below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the lake outside the floor-to-ceiling windows is still dark, with the mountain ridges already outlined against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the terrace lounge chairs, and from any suite the hillside town across the lake is sharp and clear.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool and the lake behind it are the same blue, and most green loungers are taken.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the wooded mountains across the water, and the terrace tables at Al Lago are being set for dinner.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lake from your balcony as a dark surface under clear stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit over the mountain ridges this morning, but the water in front of the suites' glass doors is calm and bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the corner balcony with the curved sofa, afternoon cloud shadows pass over the lake and the wooded hills.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds above the mountains, and diners on the Al Lago terrace get the full view.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the lake turns grey too, and guests watch the moored boats from the wood-clad balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the lake, so guests stay behind the floor-to-ceiling windows and the paddle boards stay on the beach.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm over the mountains means the Riva speedboats stay at the dock, and lightning is best watched from a suite.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the mountain ridges today, and from the terrace dining table the far shore is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the wooded hills across the lake, and guests watch it from the warm side of the glass.
phrases.very_cold: If you stood at a suite's floor-to-ceiling window now, you would see frost on the glass above the empty pool deck and the lake.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoons send guests into the infinity pool or out on the lake in a kayak, away from the hot deck.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the balcony doors of the lake-facing rooms stay open to the sound of water at the dock.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the mountain ridges across the lake are not visible from the windows, only the near water.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the suite windows frame village lights on the lake, a night to sleep through until the mountains return at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open after midnight, rain runs down the suites' floor-to-ceiling glass and the hillside village lights blur in the lake.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight the suite's floor-to-ceiling glass is left uncovered, and the hillside village lights reflect in Lake Como under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop pool is still and the KL Tower stands dark against a clear sky over KLCC Park.
phrases.clear_morning: From an Executive Studio window, the KL Tower rises out of green treetops under a cloudless morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool reflects a clear blue sky, and guests in the cabanas look straight at the KL Tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the KL Tower face and the Petronas Twin Towers at their oblique angle from the Man Tao bar.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at the rooftop bar tonight, you would see the lit KL Tower under a clear sky over the park.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass behind the KL Tower this morning, seen from the guest room windows above the KLCC Park canopy.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Petronas Twin Towers this afternoon, while swimmers in the infinity pool face the KL Tower.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud turns orange above the KL Tower, watched from the lounge beds on the rooftop.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Kuala Lumpur today, and the KL Tower shows in dull light from the rooftop pool.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop terrace, and from inside the Man Tao bar the KL Tower looks grey and blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Kuala Lumpur, and from the guest room windows lightning shows the KL Tower for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers Kuala Lumpur today, and from the infinity pool the KL Tower is only a faint shape over the park trees.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Kuala Lumpur, so if any fell, guests at the pool would see white flakes against the KL Tower.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day is rare here, but the clear air makes the KL Tower sharp from the Executive Studio windows.
phrases.very_hot: The afternoon is very hot in Kuala Lumpur, and most guests are in the infinity pool rather than on the lounge chairs.
phrases.mild_night: Under a warm cloudy night sky, the pendant lights of the Man Tao bar are on and the KL Tower is lit.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop the KL Tower is visible but the Petronas Twin Towers are hard to see.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the Executive Studio window shows the KL Tower's shape above the lit city.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the Executive Studio glass tonight; the KL Tower rises over wet city lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Kuala Lumpur tonight, and from the Executive Studio window the KL Tower's shape stands above the lit city.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Odle peaks are a dark outline against a clear sky from every south-facing suite window.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Peitlerkofel and the Odle group first, while swimmers in the 22-metre outdoor pool watch it arrive.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the full wall of glass in each suite shows every ridge of the Dolomites in sharp detail.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Odle group pale orange, seen from the rooftop pool of the penthouse without anything in the way.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars above the Dolomites from the outdoor pool at 1,800 metres.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Peitlerkofel this morning, and the indoor pool windows show the peaks appearing and disappearing.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon some clouds sit above the Odle group, and the stone terrace benches face a sky half blue, half white.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the Dolomites turn pink while guests sit by the terrace fire bowl.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Odle peaks look flat and close from the suites, and the indoor pool stays the warmer option.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the pine forest and the outdoor pool, and the glass of the indoor pool keeps the Dolomites in view.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, lightning over the Dolomites is visible from the full wall of glass in each suite.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Odle group today, and from the indoor pool only the nearest pine trees show through the windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the stone terrace and the plunge basin outside the Finnish sauna, with the peaks only partly visible.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is very cold today, and the glacial plunge basin by the Finnish sauna is colder still.
phrases.very_hot: Through the suite's full wall of glass, midday heat-haze hangs over the valley below the Odle group and the Peitlerkofel.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over the Dolomites, and the fire bowl on the stone terrace is lit for guests outside.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Peitlerkofel across the valley is not clear, though the near forest can still be seen.
phrases.late_night: Back in your suite after a late dinner, you would see the night sky over the Odle group through the glass wall.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in your suite tonight, you would see snow on the glass wall that faces the Odle.
phrases.grey_evening: Were you having a last drink in your suite now, cloud would cover the valley where the Odle peaks are.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Danube is dark and flat below the floor-to-ceiling windows, with Buda Castle still lit on the far bank.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun comes from behind the hotel, so from every room the Castle District across the river is evenly lit.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the green hills behind Buda Castle stand out clearly from the room windows, and the Danube looks bright.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The sun sets behind the Castle District, so from the ninth-floor Sky Lounge the Danube turns orange for about an hour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a balcony tonight, you would see Buda Castle and the Chain Bridge lit up across the black water.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the Buda hills, so the light on Matthias Church changes every few minutes, seen from any room.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From a corner suite this afternoon, parts of the Danube are in sun and parts in cloud shadow at the same time.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests on the rooftop terrace watch the last sun hit Buda Castle while clouds above the hills turn pink.
phrases.overcast: Under a gray sky the Danube looks gray too, but the Chain Bridge and Castle District stay clearly visible from the balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and Elisabeth Bridge across the Danube looks blurred from the rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm over the Buda hills is best watched from inside a suite, not from the open Sky Lounge terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Danube today, and from the ninth floor only the top of Buda Castle may show above it.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on both banks, and from the rooms the roofs of the Castle District slowly turn white across the river.
phrases.very_cold: On a day close to freezing, the Sky Lounge terrace is mostly empty, and most guests watch the Danube from their rooms.
phrases.very_hot: The weather in Budapest is very hot today, and the Danube looks pale from the balconies, the Buda hills slightly hazy.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm and cloudy, and from the Sky Lounge terrace the lit Chain Bridge is clear but there are no stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooms the Danube and Elisabeth Bridge are clear, but the green hills behind are not.
phrases.late_night: Back from a drink at the Liz and Chain Sky Lounge, you would see city lights moving on the Danube after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: Were you at the Liz and Chain Sky Lounge tonight, the Danube would show wet and bright through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: A last drink at the Liz and Chain Sky Lounge tonight would show you city lights on the Danube under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Thames is dark and flat below the river balconies, with Tower Bridge still showing its night lights downstream.
phrases.clear_morning: On the terrace, the morning sun lights St Paul's dome across the water, and early boats pass under Blackfriars Bridge.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the 12th Knot windows frame The Shard and the City skyline sharply, with no cloud anywhere above London.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a river balcony now, you would watch the low sun colour the Thames gold toward Tower Bridge.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Illuminated River bridges and St Paul's are lit across clear dark water, seen from the rooftop bar sofas.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the City this morning, so the sunlight on St Paul's comes and goes from the terrace tables.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, guests under the globe pendant lights at the 12th Knot see cloud shadows cross The Shard and the City.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over Tower Bridge turn pink, and the Thames below the balconies is calm.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Thames looks brown and flat from the river rooms, and Tower Bridge stands in dull light.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the 12th Knot, but St Paul's and the river stay clearly in view.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were at the rooftop bar now, you would watch lightning over the City skyline from behind the glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Thames today; from the terrace, Blackfriars Bridge is visible but St Paul's dome is only an outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the moored boats and the South Bank, seen from the warm rooms with Tom Dixon furniture.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day over London, and the river balconies are empty, while guests watch Tower Bridge from inside.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot afternoon in London, and the rooftop bar sits in full sun, so most guests stay behind the glass.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the Illuminated River bridges show their colours on the water below the 12th Knot.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; from the terrace, Blackfriars Bridge and the near Thames are clear, but Tower Bridge is not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the river-view rooms are asleep, city lights on the Thames outside, and Tower Bridge back in view at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Behind an open curtain in a river room after midnight, rain blurs the City lights on the Thames toward Tower Bridge.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtain open in a river room after midnight, the city lights reflect on the Thames under low cloud toward Tower Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the upper-floor windows show dark rooftops and spires over Copenhagen, and Tivoli lies quiet below without its lights.
phrases.clear_morning: From Room 606, the morning sun lights the rooftops and spires of Copenhagen under a clear blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the floor-to-ceiling windows of the upper rooms frame Tivoli Gardens and the city spires in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun gives the rooftops a warm colour, and the executive suite's Swan chair faces a clear Copenhagen skyline.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear, and from the upper floors the park lights of Tivoli show brightly among the dark rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: If you were in an upper-floor room this morning, you would see broken clouds moving over the spires of Copenhagen.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun alternate over the rooftops this afternoon, seen from the panoramic windows of the upper rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the upper rooms look onto lit clouds above Copenhagen and construction cranes against the sky.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers all of Copenhagen today, and the skyline looks flat from the desk by the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftops of Copenhagen, and the upper-floor windows are the dry place to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is passing over the city, and lightning over the spires is visible from the floor-to-ceiling windows upstairs.
phrases.fog_haze: Thick fog over Copenhagen today leaves the upper rooms with a view of the nearest roofs and nothing beyond them.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the rooftops and spires of Copenhagen, and from Room 606 the view is mostly white.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is well below freezing, and the spires of Copenhagen stand sharp and clear beyond the upper-floor windows.
phrases.very_hot: Copenhagen is unusually hot today, and the upper-floor windows show the rooftops and spires in hard, bright sunlight.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the upper rooms the park lights of Tivoli are the brightest thing in view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the view from the upper floors stops at the nearer rooftops, and the far spires of Copenhagen cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: Room 606 is for sleep now, the city lights left outside the window and Tivoli Gardens just below due back at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the upper-floor windows tonight, and the city lights blur across the rooftops around Tivoli Gardens below.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud hangs over Copenhagen, and the upper-floor windows show lit rooftops down to Tivoli Gardens just below.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before the sun comes up, the Washington Monument shows as a grey shape from the balcony windows on Pennsylvania Avenue.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the Washington Monument, and guests in the balcony rooms see it past thin curtains and the green iron railing.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Monument stands sharp against a blue sky, while lunch is served at Cafe du Parc downstairs.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the Jenny Lind Suite now, you would see late sun on the Monument from the soaking tub.
phrases.clear_night: The Washington Monument is lit at night and clearly visible from the balcony windows on the Pennsylvania Avenue side.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass behind the Monument this morning, and Peacock Alley has not started its afternoon tea yet.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Monument this afternoon, visible from the double queen rooms between tea and dinner.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Monument turn orange, seen from the suite living room windows.
phrases.overcast: Guests in the rooms see the Washington Monument past the iron rails under a grey sky at noon.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the windows of the Pennsylvania Avenue rooms, and the Monument looks pale and grey behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Monument right now, best watched from behind the glass of a guest room rather than from the balcony.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the top of the Monument today; the neoclassical building just below the windows remains clear.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the wrought-iron balcony railings while the Monument slowly disappears into white, as seen from the guest rooms.
phrases.very_cold: It is bitterly cold outside today, and the Monument looks very sharp in the clear air from the room windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over Pennsylvania Avenue today, and the Monument shimmers slightly when viewed from the suite living room.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, with the lit Monument visible from the balcony windows and the Round Robin Bar still serving.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; the Monument is only a faint outline from the rooms, though the federal building below is clear.
phrases.late_night: The Jenny Lind Suite is dark after midnight, and the only light left comes from the city around the Washington Monument.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the Jenny Lind Suite window after midnight, and the wet Pennsylvania Avenue lights shine beside the Washington Monument's thin outline.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, haze drifts over Pennsylvania Avenue, and the Monument's obelisk shows against the city glow from the Jenny Lind Suite.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the 4th-floor balconies look over dark pine trees toward a sea that is still just a grey line.
phrases.clear_morning: On the breakfast terrace, guests eat under a clear sky with the coast fully visible behind their coffee cups.
phrases.clear_midday: Full sun on the timber decking now, and the white umbrellas by the outdoor pools are all in use.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From a 4th-floor room, the late sun lights the pine tops while the sea behind them turns pale gold.
phrases.clear_night: After midnight, from a fourth-floor balcony, pool lights glow on the timber decking below the dark pines under a clear starry sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the pinewood this morning, and the breakfast terrace gets sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud over the Atlantic this afternoon, but the wooden loungers at the beach club still have people on them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun puts orange light on the clouds, best seen from the panoramic bedroom windows facing the coast.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the whole coast today; the sea is still there beyond the pines, just without any colour.
phrases.rain: From the fourth-floor balconies, rain falls on the pine trees and the grey sea beyond Falésia Beach.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the sea this hour, and guests watch the lightning from behind the panoramic windows rather than from the pools.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits between the pines and the water today, so the 4th-floor view ends roughly where the forest ends.
phrases.snow: From the fourth-floor balcony, a thin layer of snow lies on the pine trees above the grey Atlantic water.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for the Algarve, with clear light on the sea and nobody on the timber decking by the pools.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside this afternoon, which explains why the thatched umbrellas at the beach club are the most popular spots.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night, and the balconies on the 4th floor are warm enough to sit out after dinner at Al Quimia.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so from the balconies the pine forest is clear but the sea beyond it is a faint shape.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the fourth-floor windows show the Atlantic beyond the pine tops.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Al Quimia, rain runs down the fourth-floor windows and the pines in front of the sea look wet.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Al Quimia, the fourth-floor rooms show the pool lights between the pines and low cloud over the sea.

phrases.clear_predawn: If you stood at a sea-view window before sunrise, you would see a clear pale sky above Copacabana Beach.
phrases.clear_morning: From the suite terrace, morning sun lights the sand of Copacabana Beach and the Cagarras Islands offshore under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is bright on Copacabana Beach, and many guests stay in the shade of the suite terrace plants.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the upper-floor sea-view rooms, late afternoon sun lights Copacabana Beach and Morro do Leme under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, bright stars hang above Copacabana Beach and the sea beyond the suite terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit over Leme Mountain this morning, but the beach in front of the hotel is bright between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across Copacabana Beach this afternoon, and the suite terrace goes in and out of shade.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds over the Cagarras Islands, visible from the upper-floor rooms.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Rio today, and from the French doors of the guest rooms the sea looks grey too.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Copacabana Beach, and guests in the sea-view rooms watch it from behind closed French doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Atlantic, and the view from the suite terrace is lightning above the Cagarras Islands.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides Leme Mountain today, so the upper rooms see the near sand of Copacabana Beach and little else.
phrases.snow: Snow is not a thing Rio does, but if it fell today the suite terrace would be the place to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: Rio almost never feels this cold, so the suite terraces are empty and Copacabana Beach is nearly deserted.
phrases.very_hot: If you were on the suite terrace now, you would see heat-haze over the near-empty sand of Copacabana Beach.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Rio, and the suite terrace with its tropical plants is comfortable for sitting out late.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the Cagarras Islands are out of sight from the upper rooms, but Copacabana Beach in front is still clear.
phrases.late_night: The curtain stays open on purpose in an upper-floor sea-view room, so the lights along Copacabana Beach fill the window until sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Cipriani, a sea-view room shows rain on the glass and the lamps along Copacabana Beach.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Mee, the sea-view rooms frame Copacabana Beach, the Avenida Atlântica lights along the sand under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Midtown skyline is still mostly office lights seen through the floor-to-ceiling windows of city-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: River-facing rooms get the clear morning sky over the Hudson, while the skyline side catches direct sun on its towers.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the Midtown towers look sharp from the wicker seating on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lands on the Midtown skyline, and the rooftop terrace is the place to watch the towers turn orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop terrace tonight, you would have the fire pits lit and a clear sky over Midtown's lights.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered morning clouds move over the Hudson, and guests in river-facing rooms see patches of sun on the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the desk by the floor-to-ceiling windows, the afternoon view is Midtown towers under a sky half filled with cloud.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud near sunset puts patches of sun and shade on the Midtown towers, visible from the terrace fire pits.
phrases.overcast: Overcast today, so the Midtown skyline from the city-facing rooms is grey on grey, with the tallest tops near the cloud base.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop terrace, so the wicker seating is empty and guests watch Midtown through wet windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the floor-to-ceiling windows of the river-facing rooms show lightning over the Hudson while the terrace stays empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the Hudson today hides the far bank, and from the rooftop the Midtown towers show only their lower floors.
phrases.snow: Snow is collecting on the rooftop terrace furniture, and the Midtown skyline is partly hidden behind falling flakes.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold, clear day gives the river-facing rooms a sharp view of the Hudson, and the terrace is nearly empty.
phrases.very_hot: On a hot afternoon, few guests sit on the rooftop terrace, and from the windows the Midtown skyline wavers in heat haze.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night on the rooftop terrace, with the fire pits lit and Midtown's lights showing under the cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the nearest Midtown towers are clear from the rooftop, but the far skyline is missing.
phrases.late_night: If you turned off the lights in a city-facing room now, the Midtown skyline would be the only glow left.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were finishing a last drink in a city-facing room, you would see Midtown's lights blurred by rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in a city-facing room after midnight, the Midtown lights would show under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Rhône under the suite terraces is still dark, and the Alps show only as a faint outline.
phrases.clear_morning: From a king room's floor-to-ceiling windows, the morning sun lights the historic waterfront buildings on the far bank of the Rhône.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Alps are clear behind the Old Town, and the rooftop terrace tables sit in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the Alpine foothills, and guests on the private terraces sit with a drink before dinner.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the Rhône lit up from the rooftop terrace, with candles on the outdoor tables.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Alps this morning, so the peaks appear and disappear from the suite windows every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Old Town is in sun and the Alps are under cloud, both visible from the same private terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun reaches the rooftop terrace between clouds, and the outdoor tables are set for dinner.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Alps are a flat shape behind the Old Town, and the Rhône looks grey from the suites.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the private terraces, so guests watch the Rhône through the floor-to-ceiling windows of their suites instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the river-facing rooms watch lightning flash over the Rhône and the Old Town during tonight's thunderstorm.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Alps and most of the Old Town today, and from the suites only the Rhône itself is visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the rooftop terrace tables, and from the suites the Old Town roofs are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air keeps guests off the private terraces, so the clear view of the Alps is enjoyed from behind the glass.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the purple agapanthus on the rooftop terrace get more sun than most guests want for themselves.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the candlelit tables on the rooftop terrace are in use above the lit Rhône.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Alps are not visible from the terraces, though the Rhône and the Old Town still are.
phrases.late_night: Back in a king room after a late dinner at SACHI, you would see the Old Town lights reflected in the Rhône.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in a king room now, you would see the waterfront lights blurred by rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were finishing a last drink in a king room, you would see the waterfront lights on the Rhône under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lake sits dark and flat two hundred metres below the suite balconies, with town lights still on.
phrases.clear_morning: From the floor-to-ceiling windows of a Lake Garda room, the water looks calm and the mountains are sharp in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun lights the whole lake, and the infinity pool is where most guests spend the hottest hours.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the infinity pool now, you would see the sun going down behind the mountains across the lake.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear above the terrace, and the lights of distant towns show along the dark shore below.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the mountains this morning, seen from the balcony of a Lake Garda room.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the lake, so the rooftop terrace of the Deluxe Sky Pool Suite gets sun in turns.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests at the fire pit watch the Alpine peaks turn pink under broken cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the lake looks grey too, and the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows frame flat water and dull mountains.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the terrace tables, so a meal at Restaurant Al Tramonto is behind glass with the lake outside.
phrases.thunderstorm: Behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of a Lake Garda room, guests watch the storm flash over the water two hundred metres below.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far shore today, and from two hundred metres up the lake surface is only a pale shape.
phrases.snow: Snow on the eastern shore is rare, but today it is settling on the terrace while the fire pit stays lit.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day the Alpine peaks look sharp from the balcony, and most guests are inside the Senses Spa.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air hangs over the eastern shore, and the infinity pool of the Sky Pool Suite is where guests go.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud cover, and the candlelit terrace tables still have a view of town lights along the dark shore.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Lake Garda rooms the near water shows but the mountains across the lake do not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the lake rooms are unlit, a few town lights show across Lake Garda, and the mountains appear at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: After a late dinner at Restaurant Al Tramonto, rain runs down the suite windows and the distant town lights show blurred below.
phrases.grey_evening: Late after dinner at Al Tramonto, the suite windows show the town lights across Lake Garda under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the crown steeple of St. Giles' Cathedral stands dark against a clear sky outside the high-floor rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the sandstone of the Old Town, and from a floor-to-ceiling window the distant hills are sharp.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, a guest in a high-floor room sees St. Giles' Cathedral, the Tolbooth Kirk and the hills all at once.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low afternoon sun turns the Old Town rooftops orange, seen from the suite windows facing St. Giles' tower.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see St. Giles' Cathedral standing out against the Edinburgh skyline under a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Hub spire this morning, and the Old Town rooftops below the guest rooms change between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, some clouds sit over the distant hills while St. Giles' crown steeple stays in sunlight outside the high-floor rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud above the Tolbooth Kirk picks up colour, visible from the high-floor rooms.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Edinburgh today, so the sandstone buildings look flat from the floor-to-ceiling windows and the hills are faint.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Old Town rooftops and St. Giles' Cathedral look darker and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests in the high-floor rooms watch lightning over the Edinburgh skyline from behind the glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Old Town, so from the guest rooms only the nearest rooftops and St. Giles' steeple are visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the Old Town rooftops and on the crown steeple of St. Giles', seen from the warm high-floor rooms.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it is close to freezing, and the air is so clear that the distant mountains show behind the Old Town rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: Edinburgh is rarely very hot, but today it is, and the floor-to-ceiling windows frame a bright, sharp St. Giles' Cathedral.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the Tolbooth Kirk and St. Giles' Cathedral are still clear shapes from the high-floor rooms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor today, so the distant hills are not visible from the rooms, though nearby St. Giles' Cathedral still is.
phrases.late_night: St Giles' crown steeple shows against scattered Old Town window lights below the high-floor rooms.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open after midnight, rain streaks the high-floor window and the Old Town lights blur around St Giles' crown steeple.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open past midnight, the Old Town glows under cloud and St Giles' crown steeple shows from a high-floor window.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky is still dark over Melbourne, and from the Studio sofa only a few office lights mark the CBD skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: Bright sun on the CBD towers this morning, and from the Studio sofa the Yarra River looks calm and clear.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands high over Australia 108, and the floor-to-ceiling windows get very bright in Corner King rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the west faces of the CBD towers, a good hour to sit at a Studio window.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear, and from a suite living room the lit CBD skyscrapers stand out sharply.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds move over the Melbourne skyline this morning, and the Yarra River below the windows changes between grey and blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were at a Corner King window, you would see sunlight and cloud shadow move across the CBD towers.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud leaves some CBD towers sunlit and others in shade, seen from the Studio sofa.
phrases.overcast: A full grey sky sits over Melbourne today, and the floor-to-ceiling windows show a flat, colourless Yarra River.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Southbank, so guests watch the wet CBD skyline from the Studio sofa rather than walking outside.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Melbourne skyline means the Corner King windows give a wide, safe view of lightning behind the towers.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of the CBD skyline today, and from the rooms only the nearest part of the Yarra River is clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Melbourne, but today a few flakes pass the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Corner King rooms.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it feels close to freezing, but the clear air makes the CBD skyline unusually sharp through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.very_hot: Melbourne is very hot today, and the 25-metre infinity spa pool is where most guests spend the afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the lit CBD skyscrapers still show clearly from the suite living room windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Docklands waterfront is not visible from the corner rooms, only the nearer CBD towers.
phrases.late_night: Were you up for a glass of water near midnight in a Corner King, you would see the CBD lights across the Yarra.
phrases.wet_evening: With a last drink in a Corner King room tonight, you would see the skyline lights blurred by rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in a Corner King room tonight, cloud would hang over the lit CBD towers across the Yarra.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Swan River shows as a dark flat surface from the river-facing rooms, with the CBD towers still lit.
phrases.clear_morning: At the breakfast buffet, guests eat pastries at the marble counters with the Swan River bright and blue behind the glass.
phrases.clear_midday: From the outdoor plunge pool, the Bell Tower and the city skyline stand sharp against a sky with no clouds at all.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: On the Level 5 terrace of Songbird Bar, the Bell Tower, Elizabeth Quay Bridge and the river sit in late orange light.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Ritz-Carlton Suite tonight, one balcony would show the lit CBD towers, the other the dark river.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the Swan River this morning, and from the King rooms the water changes between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Swimmers in the infinity pool look out at Elizabeth Quay Bridge under broken cloud, with the sun in and out all afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: Cloud gaps let the last sun reach the Bell Tower, which is the view from the Songbird Bar terrace right now.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Swan River looks silver from the suite living room, with South Perth low across the water.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the river rooms, and the South Perth foreshore is blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the CBD towers is the main event from the soaking tub right now, and the infinity pool is empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Swan River hides most of the South Perth foreshore, though the Bell Tower still shows from the plunge pool.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Perth, but if it fell now, the river rooms would be the warm place to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air is rare in Perth, so the infinity pool has no swimmers and the view of the bridge is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: From the floor-to-ceiling windows, heat-haze shimmers over the Swan River toward the South Perth foreshore and the Bell Tower.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and guests on the Songbird Bar terrace have Elizabeth Quay Bridge directly in front of them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short, so from the King rooms the Swan River is clear but the South Perth foreshore is only an outline.
phrases.late_night: Up for a glass of water near midnight in a river-facing room, you would see South Perth lights on the Swan River.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink at Songbird Bar tonight, you would see Elizabeth Quay lights on the Swan River in the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in the Songbird Bar tonight, you would see South Perth's lights on the Swan River under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Tyrrhenian Sea is still dark from the Superior balconies, and the heated pool is empty and quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: This morning the sea is bright blue from the panoramic pool, and the coastal cliffs show clearly to the islands.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the rooftop, and guests in the heated pool have the whole Tyrrhenian horizon in front of them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this evening, you would watch the sun drop toward the sea from a Deluxe balcony jacuzzi.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Praiano is clear, and from the dining terrace the cliffside village lights below are easy to see.
