phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the sea this morning, and the canopy beds on the spa terrace are mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the Amalfi Coast this afternoon, and patches of shade move across the sea in front of the pool.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the islands turn orange, seen from the M'Ama! rooftop tables.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the Tyrrhenian today, and the sea looks flat and grey from the Superior room balconies.
phrases.rain: Steady rain over Praiano today, so guests watch the sea from inside their vaulted rooms with the balcony doors shut.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm the rooftop tables stand empty, and lightning over the Tyrrhenian is visible from the room balconies.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the water today, and from the pool the islands are only a faint shape, if visible at all.
phrases.snow: From the heated pool, snow falls on the Praiano rooftops below and on the grey Tyrrhenian Sea.
phrases.very_cold: Steam rises from the heated panoramic pool in the frosty air, with the Tyrrhenian Sea flat and bright below Praiano.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the Amalfi Coast today, so most guests are in the pool or under the spa terrace canopies.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Praiano, and dinner on the dining terrace continues with the dark sea below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today: from the rooftop the nearby cliffs and village are clear, but the islands and far horizon are not.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner at M'Ama!, the Superior room windows show the Tyrrhenian Sea and the lights of Praiano on the cliff.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at M'Ama!, rain runs down the Superior room windows and the lights of Praiano blur above the sea.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at M'Ama! is over, and from the Superior rooms Praiano's lights show along the cliffs under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over the Indian Ocean starts to lighten behind New Pier, as seen from the sea-facing balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun comes in from the ocean side, so the Brasserie Restaurant serves breakfast with the sea bright in the windows.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the whole line from the palm crowns to the container ships is sharp from the upper floor rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on the rooftop pool lounge chairs have sundowners while the light over North Beach and New Pier turns warm.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a sea-facing room tonight, you would see the dark ocean and hear the surf through the balcony door.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the Indian Ocean this morning, and the balconies get sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the clouds put moving shadows on North Beach, easy to follow from a suite window above the promenade.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds over the Golden Mile orange, and the rooftop pool is the usual place to watch it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the ocean looks grey, but the container ships and New Pier still stand out from the upper rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on North Beach and the promenade, and the Brasserie Restaurant is the dry place to watch it over lunch.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Indian Ocean is visible from behind the sliding glass doors of the sea-facing rooms, with the balconies empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Sea haze hides the ships on the horizon today, so the view from the balconies stops somewhere past New Pier.
phrases.snow: Snow over Durban would be new for a hotel open since 1911, and the sea-facing windows are the place to check.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day the ocean stays blue from the suite windows, and the rooftop pool stays mostly unused.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the Golden Mile, and the rooftop pool is where guests watch North Beach from the water.
phrases.mild_night: The night is warm and cloudy, so the glass doors of the sea-facing rooms stay open to the surf on North Beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the balconies today, the container ships are out of view, and only New Pier and North Beach show clearly.
phrases.late_night: Long after midnight, the lights of ships waiting off North Beach keep a sea-facing window worth watching.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open in a sea-facing room, rain on the glass blurs the promenade lamps along the Golden Mile tonight.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open in a sea-facing room, the Golden Mile's promenade lamps shine under low cloud, and a few ship lights offshore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Balcony Junior Suites look out on a dark Seine, with the Eiffel Tower a plain outline behind Pont-Neuf.
phrases.clear_morning: From the guest rooms, the morning sun is on the Haussmann rooftops and the tree-lined quays along the Seine.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the rooftop terrace has the Eiffel Tower and the dome of Les Invalides in full view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the stone balcony now, you would see the low sun on the Seine and the Eiffel Tower beyond.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the rooftop restaurant has a clear view of the Eiffel Tower lights, with the Seine dark below Pont-Neuf.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Paris this morning, and from the suite living room the Eiffel Tower goes in and out of sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, sun comes and goes on the rooftop terrace's red and yellow chairs, with the Seine below.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds sit above the Eiffel Tower as seen from the Quintessence Suite windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Balcony Junior Suites still face the Seine, Pont-Neuf and the Eiffel Tower, all without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Seine, and guests in the indoor pool watch it come down over the city through tall windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Paris, and from the suite living room, lightning shows the Eiffel Tower for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Seine today, so from the guest rooms the near riverbanks are clear but the Eiffel Tower is faint.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over the Seine, and the rooftop terrace chairs are white while the indoor pool stays warm behind glass.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, and the stone balconies are empty, though the Seine and Pont-Neuf are sharp in clear air.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the rooftop terrace chairs sit in full sun above the Seine, and most guests stay inside.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Paris, and the rooftop restaurant windows frame the lit Eiffel Tower and the dome of Les Invalides.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today, so from the Balcony Junior Suites the Seine and Pont-Neuf are clear but the Eiffel Tower is not visible.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Quintessence Suite's lights stay on, quay lights moving on the Seine below.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Quintessence Suite after midnight, and the Seine shows the quay lights in blurred streaks.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the Eiffel Tower's top at two, and quay lights follow the Seine.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Skyline King Studio looks onto a dark Lower Manhattan where One World Trade Center is still lit.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning sky over SoHo, and from the corner rooms every Manhattan rooftop and the midtown towers are sharp.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly above the Jimmy rooftop, and the Hudson River looks like a bright flat strip.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see low sun on the Hudson River and New Jersey behind it.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the soaking tub in the corner room faces a clear view of lit windows across Lower Manhattan.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the Hudson River this morning, visible from the navy loungers beside the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the Jimmy rooftop are watching patches of shade pass across the New Jersey side of the river this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, One World Trade Center is lit on one side, seen from the blue terrace loungers.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Manhattan today, and from the Horizon Suite ADA the midtown towers look flat and colourless.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop terrace, so guests have moved inside the bar, where the windows still show the skyline.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm nobody sits on the rooftop terrace, but the corner rooms give a full view of lightning over Lower Manhattan.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of One World Trade Center today, and the Hudson River is a pale outline from the 18th floor.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Skyline King Studio, and the Manhattan rooftops below turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing on the rooftop terrace, and the few guests outside get a very clear view of the city's bridges.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, and the seasonal rooftop pool is the busiest spot in the hotel, with the Hudson River in view.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the candlelit tables at the rooftop bar look out on One World Trade Center under low cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so New Jersey and the far end of the Hudson River are not visible from the rooftop.
phrases.late_night: Lights off in the Skyline King Studio after midnight, Lower Manhattan's lit skyline is the only glow in its corner windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Skyline King Studio's tall windows tonight, and the downtown skyline lights look soft behind the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, haze hangs over Lower Manhattan, and the city lights spread below it in the Skyline King Studio's corner windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the lake is dark and still, and the balconies of the lake-view rooms are empty for now.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on a balcony this morning comes with a clear view of Monte San Salvatore across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is on the private lido, and swimmers in the lake can see the mountains without any haze.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on the lakeside terrace this afternoon look across Lake Lugano to Monte San Salvatore in the low sun.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a lake-view balcony tonight, you would see stars over Lake Lugano and the lanterns lit on the terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Monte San Salvatore this morning, so the view from the loggia changes every few minutes between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the clay tennis court below the balconies, players get a mix of sun and cloud shadow this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds above the lake, and guests on the candlelit terrace are watching the mountains darken.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky over Lake Lugano makes the art gallery at Arté al Lago more popular than the lido today.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the lake and the park, and guests who want to swim today use the indoor pool, not the lido.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the lake-view balconies, lightning flashes over Lake Lugano and lights the empty boat pier below the subtropical park.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Lake Lugano today, and Monte San Salvatore is not part of the view from the terrace at the moment.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare here, but today it falls on the palm trees in the park, which looks odd from a lake-view room.
phrases.very_cold: On a day close to freezing the lakeside terrace is clear and empty, and the spa is where most guests are.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Lugano today, and the private lido on the lake is the busiest part of the park.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the lake on this mild night, and the wicker lanterns on the terrace are lit for dinner guests.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balconies the lake is clear but Monte San Salvatore is only an outline.
phrases.late_night: The curtain in a lake-view room is left open on purpose, so the shore lights of Lake Lugano shine on the water at bedtime.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass of the lake-view rooms tonight, and the lights of Lugano blur on the lake.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud covers the sky over Lake Lugano, and shore lights show in the water from the lake-view rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Premier Castle View Room shows Prague Castle and St. Vitus as dark shapes against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the red-tiled rooftops of Malá Strana, and from the floor-to-ceiling glass the castle spires stand out clearly.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop terrace loungers sit in full sun, with Prague Castle and the red rooftops under a blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on St. Vitus Cathedral, and guests on the rooftop terrace have the castle in front of them.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at the floor-to-ceiling glass after midnight, you would see Prague Castle lit under a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Hradčany this morning, so the castle changes between sun and shade as seen from the large glass windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Seen from the rooftop terrace, broken afternoon cloud passes over the castle and the St. Nicholas dome is in sunlight only sometimes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, gaps in the cloud light the castle walls in orange, visible from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the castle and St. Vitus are still fully visible from the Premier Castle View Room, just without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the red-tiled rooftops, and the spa in the former chapel is a reasonable place to spend the time.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were in a Premier Castle View Room now, you would watch lightning over Hradčany through floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of Prague Castle today, and from the guest rooms only the nearest red roofs are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the red-tiled rooftops of Malá Strana, and the castle roofs are turning white, seen from the large windows.
phrases.very_cold: The rooftop terrace loungers are empty in this freezing air, but the castle view from the glass-walled rooms is very clear.
phrases.very_hot: On this hot day, the potted palms on the rooftop terrace give a little shade, and the castle sits in strong sunlight.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night, and the candlelit tables on the rooftop terrace face the lit castle with no stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the guest rooms the castle is only an outline and St. Vitus details are not visible.
phrases.late_night: The Premier Castle View Room is dark now, and the only light inside comes from the lit city below the castle hill.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the Premier Castle View Room's floor-to-ceiling glass tonight, and the castle spires blur behind the wet lights of Malá Strana.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Prague tonight, and from the Premier Castle View Rooms the Malá Strana lights show beneath the castle spires.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Prinsengracht lies dark and flat under the canal windows, with the 1909 salon boat still moored below.
phrases.clear_morning: From the canal-house windows, the 1909 salon boat sits moored on the Prinsengracht under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Blue sky over the Westerkerk tower right now, and the canal windows show tour boats moving slowly past the hotel.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: On the terrace, the round tables and olive trees catch the low sun while the canal-house rooftops turn warm orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lights of the canal houses reflected in the still Prinsengracht water.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over Amsterdam this morning, but between them the sun reaches the water under the Keizersgracht windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the Westerkerk tower this afternoon, and the terrace chairs are mostly in use.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky behind the Westerkerk tower, seen from the canal windows.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky today over the canal ring, so the water below the windows looks grey too, and the trees darker.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Prinsengracht and on the covered salon boat, while guests watch from the dry side of the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over Amsterdam at the moment; from the book suite you can watch the rain hit the canal without stepping outside.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs low over the canals today, and the Westerkerk tower is only a faint shape from the upper windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the canal-house rooftops and on the terrace tables, and the Keizersgracht looks very quiet below.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, and the canal windows show the Prinsengracht with very few boats moving.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Amsterdam today, so the terrace chairs stay empty and the trees along the canal give the only shade.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night; from the music suite windows, the canal houses are lit and a late boat passes on the Prinsengracht.
phrases.reduced_visibility: If you were at a canal window now, you would see the Prinsengracht and the houses opposite, but not the Westerkerk tower beyond.
phrases.late_night: Lights from the canal houses reflect in the Prinsengracht beside the moored salon boat tonight.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the canal-suite windows tonight, and the lamps along the Prinsengracht reflect in the water below.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Amsterdam after midnight, and the lamps along the Prinsengracht show in the canal below the suite windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the harbor-view rooms look out on a dark skyline with office lights still on across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From the panoramic windows, the downtown skyline stands sharp across the harbor under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the downtown towers stand sharp across the water, and the patio tables face them in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun drops behind the downtown skyline, so from the patio the towers appear dark against a bright sky.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear sky tonight, the downtown lights show as reflections on the dark harbor, best seen from a high harbor-view room.
phrases.partly_morning: Outside the restaurant, the teal-cushioned tables are set for the morning under a sky with broken cloud over the harbor.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the harbor this afternoon, so the downtown towers switch between sun and shade from the upper rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over downtown turn orange above the skyline seen from the waterfront terrace.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the harbor today, and the skyline across the water looks flat but clear from the restaurant windows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the waterfront lawn, so guests watch the water taxis cross the harbor from behind the restaurant's expansive windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the soundproof windows of the harbor-view rooms keep out most of the noise while lightning shows over downtown.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the harbor hides most of the downtown skyline, and from the upper rooms only the nearest water is visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the harbor, and the water taxis still run across to downtown, visible from the panoramic windows.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day, the waterfront lawn is empty and guests keep the skyline view from inside the restaurant.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today in Boston, and most guests watch the harbor from their rooms rather than from the patio tables.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover Boston on this mild night, and the lawn fire pits are lit, facing the lights of downtown.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the harbor-view rooms, the downtown skyline across the water is only a faint outline in today's haze.
phrases.late_night: The downtown lights reflect in the harbour tonight, and the harbour-view rooms will have the skyline in daylight at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain hits the glass of the harbour-view rooms, and the downtown lights shine on the wet water.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the harbor-view rooms look out on the downtown lights reflected across the water under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Chain Bridge lamps are still on, and the Danube under them is dark from the balcony rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: On a clear morning, the sun reaches Buda Castle on its hill, seen from the back of the Leo Rooftop.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Danube is bright and the Chain Bridge chains show every bolt clearly from the balcony rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun comes from behind the castle and lights the Parliament Building across the Danube for the rooftop bar.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lit Chain Bridge through the floor-to-ceiling windows of your room.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Pest this morning, and from the rooftop terrace the Parliament Building goes in and out of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the Leo Rooftop get patches of sun on the Danube between the clouds this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over Buda Castle turns orange above the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Danube looks grey too, but the Chain Bridge is close enough from the balconies to stay sharp.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Chain Bridge, and guests watch it from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows rather than the terrace.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Danube means the Leo Rooftop is empty, and guests watch the lightning from their rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog on the river today hides the Pest bank, so from the balcony rooms the Chain Bridge seems to end halfway.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the Chain Bridge railings, and the castle hill behind the hotel is turning white.
phrases.very_cold: It is around freezing outside, so the rooftop terrace is quiet and most guests look at the Danube through glass.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the Danube below the Leo Rooftop looks cooler than it actually is.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild under cloud, and the rooftop bar still has the lit Chain Bridge and Parliament Building in view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Parliament Building across the river is faint, though the Chain Bridge is clear from the balconies.
phrases.late_night: After a late drink at Leo Rooftop, the bedroom's floor-to-ceiling windows show the Pest lights on the Danube under the Chain Bridge.
phrases.wet_evening: Past midnight the curtains are open in the bedrooms, and rain on the glass blurs the Pest lights across the Danube.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight the curtain is open, and under low cloud the Pest lights reflect in the Danube beside the Chain Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the upper-floor rooms look onto a dark channel, with the Palace Pier only a dark outline ahead.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Brighton, and the bay-window rooms show the beach, the promenade and the pier in full sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the channel, and from the dining room the Palace Pier is easy to see.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the Atrium Bar, you would get low evening sun through the glass ceiling, with the seafront in front.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the channel is clear, and the sea-view rooms face a dark beach with the pier ahead.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the sea this morning, but the beach is still visible from the yellow armchairs in the lounge.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud move across the channel this afternoon, and the floor-to-ceiling windows upstairs show the promenade below.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the Palace Pier between the clouds, visible from the tables of the dining room.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Brighton today, so the sea from the sea-view suites looks grey too, with the pier a dark line ahead.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the promenade, and the indoor pool is the obvious choice while the upper rooms show a wet beach.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the upper-floor sea-view rooms, lightning over the channel shows the Palace Pier and the wet promenade below.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the sea today, so the pier is hard to see from the bay windows and the beach looks short.
phrases.snow: Today snow falls on the Brighton seafront, and the sea-view suites look onto a white promenade with the pier beyond.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the upper-floor sea-view rooms this afternoon look across an empty promenade to the Palace Pier in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: From the upper-floor sea-view rooms, heat-haze hangs over the Palace Pier and the beach along the promenade.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over the channel, and the Atrium Bar under its glass ceiling works for a late drink.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over the sea today, so from the sea-view rooms the pier is there but nothing beyond it.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the sea-view suites are asleep by now, seafront lights on the water, and Palace Pier back in view at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a sea-view room tonight can watch the rain blur the Palace Pier through the floor-to-ceiling glass after midnight.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a sea-view room tonight can watch low cloud pass over the Palace Pier and the lit promenade.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the open-air lobby is dark and quiet, and the sea beyond it is still a flat grey.
phrases.clear_morning: From the beach this morning, Isla Mujeres and Isla Contoy are both visible across the clear water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the freeform pools, and most guests are under the thatched palapas.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The rope swings at the beach bar are catching the low sun, and the water behind them looks darker.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a suite tonight, you would hear the Caribbean from the private terrace without seeing much of it.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Isla Blanca, so the turquoise water near the beach changes colour every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds give short breaks from the sun this afternoon, which the people on the terrace sun loungers seem to appreciate.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the sea turn orange, seen from the lounge seating in the lobby.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Caribbean looks green rather than turquoise, and the islands are hard to see from the beach.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the freeform pools and the palapas, while the lobby stays dry under its arched wood ceiling.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm sits over the sea; from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the guest rooms, the lightning shows up very clearly.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water today means Isla Mujeres and Isla Contoy cannot be seen from the beach, only the nearest waves.
phrases.snow: Snow here is close to impossible, but the forecast says snow, so the palapas on the beach would look very strange.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day is rare in Cancún; today the pools are mostly empty and guests stay inside behind the big windows.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the Isla Blanca peninsula, and the shade of the beach bar palapas is the busiest place around.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night the pendant light in the open-air lobby is on, and there are no stars over the sea.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means neither island can be seen from the beach; the sea ends in a pale line.
phrases.late_night: Back from a late dinner, guests in the suites watch moonlight on the Caribbean.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a sea-view room tonight can watch the rain run down the floor-to-ceiling windows, the Caribbean grey beyond.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the sea-view suites are likely asleep now, pool lights showing under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over the Acropolis is turning pale, and the private balconies on Vasilissis Sofias are still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were on a balcony at Conrad Athens The Ilisian now, you would see the Acropolis in clear early sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the courtyard, and guests sit under the potted trees inside the arched colonnades.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The terrace awning is pulled out against the low sun while blue striped chairs fill up with guests facing the view.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Parthenon is lit, and from the guest rooms the large windows frame it above the city rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Lycabettus Hill this morning, and runners are already on the 700-metre outdoor track.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on a balcony this afternoon, you would see the Acropolis move in and out of cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds turn orange above the Aegean Sea, which is visible from the upper balconies.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Athens, but the Acropolis is still clear to see from the rooms on Vasilissis Sofias.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the courtyard, and the retractable awning on the terrace keeps the blue striped chairs dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, lightning shows the Acropolis for a second at a time, best watched from inside a guest room.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Athens today, so the Aegean Sea is hard to make out from the balconies, though the Acropolis still shows.
phrases.snow: Snow rarely reaches Athens, but today a few flakes fall on the potted palms of the terrace.
phrases.very_cold: From the balconies on Vasilissis Sofias, the Acropolis stands in hard winter light above empty rooftops and a frost-rimmed courtyard.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Athens this afternoon, and the arched colonnades of the courtyard give the only shade outside.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Athens, and the illuminated Acropolis stands out clearly from the balconies on Vasilissis Sofias.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Aegean Sea is not in view from the balconies, only the nearer Acropolis and rooftops.
phrases.late_night: Around two the Parthenon is in view above the rooftop lights, easy to watch late.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the balcony windows of the Acropolis-view rooms, and the city rooftops show their lights through the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open in a guest room, the Acropolis shows above the city lights under low cloud tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Caribbean south of the villa terraces is a dark flat line under a sky with no clouds.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were there this morning, you would take breakfast on a Royal Villa terrace facing the open sea.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, guests in the private plunge pools get shade only from the villa's palapa roof.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun is on the open-air palapa yoga studio, and the Caribbean beyond the wooden railing looks turquoise.
phrases.clear_night: Guests on the palapa terrace tonight look up from the hammock at bright stars in the clear sky over Xcalacoco Beach.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the sea this morning, and the main pool loungers facing the Caribbean are mostly still empty.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon clouds pass over the beach bar, and guests under its thatched roof watch the sea change colour.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds take on colour over the Caribbean before sunset, while palm trees are reflected in the calm main pool.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky covers the whole south elevation today, so the Caribbean from the Royal Villa terraces looks grey-green rather than turquoise.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the palapa roofs, and the thatch keeps the villa terraces dry while the jungle garden gets wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning is out over the Caribbean, and guests have left the plunge pools for the covered part of their villas.
phrases.fog_haze: From the infinity pool terrace today, haze makes the far Caribbean blend into the sky, with no clear horizon.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Playa del Carmen; if it did, it would sit briefly on the palapa roofs before melting.
phrases.very_cold: Guests on a rare cold day here keep to the walled jungle gardens, and the plunge pools stand unused.
phrases.very_hot: The private plunge pool between the garden walls is the simplest way to cool down on this very hot day.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, with the thatched bar by the main pool lit up and the Caribbean dark beyond the lounge chairs.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so from the beach bar the far horizon of the Caribbean is not clear, only the nearer water.
phrases.late_night: One light is on late in a Royal Villa, the surf white to the south.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the plunge pool outside the Royal Villas tonight, and the Caribbean shows pale through the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Under cloud after midnight, a Royal Villa's lit plunge pool is all the window shows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the floor-to-ceiling windows in the white suites show a dark Red Sea and a clear sky above it.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were there this morning, you would see sunlight on the calm Red Sea from your bed, through glass only.
phrases.clear_midday: Clear midday sky over the infinity pool, and guests in the water look straight out at the flat blue Red Sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches the loungers on the private terrace, where the infinity pool and the Red Sea are both in view.
phrases.clear_night: Late at night, through the suite's floor-to-ceiling windows, stars fill the clear sky above the Red Sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds this morning, so the Red Sea seen from the beach cabanas changes between bright blue and grey-blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Partly cloudy afternoon at Yades, where lunch on the open-air terrace comes with pool views and passing shade from the clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the Red Sea turn orange above the infinity pool and the palm trees.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Red Sea loses its bright colour, but the floor-to-ceiling windows in the white suites still frame it.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Sharm El-Sheikh, so a wet Red Sea through the suite windows is a view most guests never get.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Red Sea right now, and the open-air terrace at Yades is likely empty while it passes.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water, so from the beach cabanas the Red Sea fades into a pale line instead of a sharp horizon.
phrases.snow: Snow in Sharm El-Sheikh is close to impossible, but if it fell, the white suites would finally match the view outside.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air for the Red Sea coast, so the infinity pool is quiet and guests watch the sea from the suites.
phrases.very_hot: Heat like this means the shade of the white arched beach cabanas is the busiest spot on the private shore.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, and dinner at Yades under the white pergola is comfortable without a jacket, pool just beyond the tables.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the floor-to-ceiling windows, the Red Sea shows only near the reef today, with no clear horizon beyond.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, moonlight on the Red Sea fills the suite's floor-to-ceiling glass for hours.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the white suites tonight, and the Red Sea shows grey under low cloud.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the Red Sea after midnight, and the floor-to-ceiling suite windows frame the pale water with no stars above.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky over the Acropolis is clear an hour before sunrise, and from the rooftop terrace the Parthenon is a dark shape.
phrases.clear_morning: From the French doors of the Acropolis suites, the Parthenon sits in full sun this morning, with no cloud anywhere.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the fringe umbrellas on the rooftop give the only shade, and the Parthenon is very bright above the pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Parthenon marble orange, and guests on the loungers have the clearest view of the day.
phrases.clear_night: Clear sky tonight over Monastiraki, and from the rooftop lounge seating the Parthenon stands out against the dark.
phrases.partly_morning: Broken cloud this morning, so from the suite balcony the sun reaches the Parthenon only a few minutes at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some clouds, some sun over the city this afternoon, and swimmers in the rooftop pool have the Parthenon in front of them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud turns the sky behind the Parthenon pink, from the rooftop lounge seating.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Parthenon looks flat and pale from the Acropolis Apartment, but it is fully visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop loungers, and guests watch the wet Acropolis from behind the French doors of their suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Athens has emptied the rooftop pool, but lightning behind the Parthenon is visible from the balconies.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Athens today, and from the rooftop pool the Parthenon is a soft grey shape rather than sharp marble.
phrases.snow: A rare snowfall over Athens today, with flakes settling on the rooftop loungers and the Parthenon behind them under a white sky.
phrases.very_cold: From the rooftop, the Parthenon stands sharp in hard winter light above the empty loungers and the quiet infinity pool.
phrases.very_hot: Athens is very hot today, so most guests stay in the rooftop pool and look at the Parthenon from the water.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm and cloudy, the rooftop street lamps are on, and the lit Acropolis shows above the pool.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so the Parthenon is still clear from the Luxury Junior suite, but the wider city behind it is hidden.
phrases.late_night: From the Acropolis Junior suites around two, the Parthenon's outline is framed by city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain on the Acropolis Junior suites' French doors blurs the Parthenon's outline.
phrases.grey_evening: Thin haze moves across the Acropolis after midnight, and the city lights show through it from the Acropolis Apartment windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, a Tower View room shows the lattice as a dark red shape against a pale, clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights one side of the tower's red steelwork, which takes up most of the pastry counter window.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the upper rooms look straight onto the steel lattice, with the city skyline sharp beyond it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last hour of sun, the red paint on the tower looks darker, and the floor-to-ceiling windows catch the low light.
phrases.clear_night: From a twin room, the clear night sky behind the tower looks dark blue, and the lights go orange at 11 PM.
phrases.partly_morning: If you were in a twin room this morning, you would watch clouds pass behind the red lattice.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the tower top goes in and out of shade as clouds move, visible from the dining tables at the window.
phrases.partly_golden: Right before sunset, broken cloud over Tokyo turns pink above the tower, which is already lit red for the evening.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the red-and-white paint is the only strong colour in the window of an upper room.
phrases.rain: Rain streaks the tall lounge windows today, and the tower just behind the glass looks slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests in the lounge watch lightning behind the tower while the windows keep the weather out.
phrases.fog_haze: In fog, the lower part of the lattice is visible from a Tower View room and the top simply disappears.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Tokyo, but today it falls past the windows and settles briefly on the tower's red steel.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the air over Tokyo is sharp and the lattice shows every detail from the upper rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Tokyo today, and from the upper rooms the red paint looks almost flat under strong sun.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and from the soaking tub the illuminated tower is the brightest thing in the window.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the city skyline beyond the tower is missing, though the lattice itself is still close and clear.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the red-and-white lattice of Tokyo Tower fills the window of a Tower View room.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight rain blurs the Tower View room's windows, and Tokyo Tower's lattice shows through it against the evening city lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Tokyo tonight, and the Tower View windows show the red-and-white lattice close up over a hazy lit city.

phrases.clear_predawn: Dark sky, no cloud, and from the facing rooms the Eiffel Tower is only a black shape until the sun comes.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun on the suite terrace, where the breakfast table of pastries and juice sits directly in front of the tower.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the tower, and the rooftop terrace's green-checked seats are in full light.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the bathroom now, you would see low sun on the Eiffel Tower from the soaking tub.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the wrought-iron balcony now, you would see the Eiffel Tower close against a clear, star-filled night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Paris this morning, and from the wrought-iron balconies the tower shows between patches of blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace this afternoon, the Eiffel Tower is sometimes in sun and sometimes in cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: Late sun and broken cloud over the Eiffel Tower, and the suite terrace has the whole scene at close range.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky today, the tower looks flat and iron-coloured from the forty rooms that face it.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Eiffel Tower this hour, and guests watch it through closed French doors from their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Paris, and guests watch the lightning around the Eiffel Tower from behind closed balcony doors.
phrases.fog_haze: In today's fog, the lower part of the tower is visible from the rooms, but the top is hidden.
phrases.snow: Snow falls around the Eiffel Tower, and the potted topiaries on the rooftop terrace have a white layer.
phrases.very_cold: From the wrought-iron balcony, the Eiffel Tower rises close in hard winter light, with frost on the empty terrace tables.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day like this, the rooftop terrace seats are in full sun with the tower directly ahead.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and guests on the rooftop terrace have cocktails by candlelight facing the lit Eiffel Tower.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the tower is still clear from the rooms, but the rooftops behind it are not.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the tower-facing rooms may fall asleep after midnight with the curtain left open, the Eiffel Tower filling the window.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the Shangri-La Suite after midnight watches rain run down the French doors, the Eiffel Tower close behind them.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has the Shangri-La Suite tonight can watch low cloud pass the top of the Eiffel Tower before bed.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Hollywood Sign on Mount Lee is still a dark shape from the north-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the Hollywood Sign King rooms wake to the white letters clearly readable on the hillside.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop pool gets strong sun, and the Sign stands sharp above the dry hills.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Warm late light falls on the hillside homes and the white cross below the Sign, seen from the balconies.
phrases.clear_night: On the pool deck, the lit HOLLYWOOD letters show in the water while the real Sign is dark on Mount Lee.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Hollywood Hills this morning, but the Sign is easy to read from the north-facing windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the LA sprawl below the floor-to-ceiling windows, with the Sign in and out of sun.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on a balcony now, you would see the last sun catching the Sign between broken clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Sign reads as flat white against the hills from the Hollywood Sign King rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain in Los Angeles is rare, and today it blurs the Sign from the upper-floor windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Hollywood Hills is unusual here, and guests watch it from inside the north-facing rooms rather than the pool deck.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Los Angeles today softens the LA sprawl, and the Sign is a pale outline on Mount Lee.
phrases.snow: Snow around the Hollywood Sign is a rare sight, and today the north-facing rooms have it.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air is unusual in Hollywood, and the rooftop pool deck is empty while the Sign stays sharp in cold light.
phrases.very_hot: From a north-facing window now, you would see heat-haze over the dry hills below the Sign on Mount Lee.
phrases.mild_night: If you were by the rooftop pool tonight, you would sit under cloud with the lit HOLLYWOOD letters reflected nearby.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Sign on Mount Lee is hard to make out from the north-facing rooms.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water at midnight, and the Hollywood Sign King window shows the letters on Mount Lee above the hillside lights.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the north window of the Hollywood Sign King room, and lit hillside homes show under Mount Lee.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, a Hollywood Sign King room looks north to Mount Lee, hazy tonight, above the lit streets of Hollywood.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the IJ harbour is dark and still outside the corner suite balconies, with Centraal Station's roofline a flat shape.
phrases.clear_morning: From a water-facing balcony, the morning sun lights the harbour and the station roofline clearly, with no cloud anywhere over Amsterdam.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the glass facade is in full sun, and the pool at WellCome Wellness is the sensible place to be.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun comes in low through the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the water of the IJ turns gold in front of the suites.
phrases.clear_night: A clear night over Amsterdam, and from the Malabar's top floor the lit waterfront and skyline are easy to see.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the harbour this morning, and from the corner suites the station roofline goes in and out of the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the 9th floor of the Malabar, the afternoon panorama of Amsterdam shows patches of sun moving across the water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the IJ gives the balconies a mix of orange light and grey shadow.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Amsterdam, so the harbour looks flat from the balconies and the atrium plants are the greenest thing around.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests are watching the wet harbour from inside rather than from the balconies.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the IJ harbour, and guests high up in the Malabar watch the lightning through the big windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the harbour, and from the corner suites Centraal Station's roofline is only partly visible across the water.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Eastern Docklands, and the water-facing balconies are white while the sauna at WellCome Wellness is in use.
phrases.very_cold: With the air outside close to freezing, the balconies stay empty and the harbour view is taken through the closed windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over Amsterdam makes the pool at WellCome Wellness busier than the sunny balconies above the IJ.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild under a cloudy sky, and the curved lounge bar's windows frame the lit waterfront without any stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Haze sits low over the IJ today, so from the Malabar the harbour shows but the Centraal Station roofline fades out.
phrases.late_night: After a drink at Malabar, the corner suite windows show lights on the IJ harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the corner suite windows after midnight, and the harbour lights of the IJ show blurred through wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the IJ after midnight, and from the corner suites the harbour lights look soft in the haze.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lights on the Harbour Bridge still show through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the high-floor suites.
phrases.clear_morning: Rooftop yoga at sunrise has the Harbour Bridge and Opera House in warm light, with the CBD towers behind them.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the harbour is bright blue from the suites, and the Opera House sits in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the apartment windows, the Harbour Bridge and Opera House are in golden late-afternoon light before the sun sets.
phrases.clear_night: At night, the illuminated Opera House and Harbour Bridge fill the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the sauna faces the same lights.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning clouds pass over the harbour, with the Harbour Bridge clearly visible from the galley kitchen window in the apartments.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud move over the CBD towers this afternoon, and the Opera House goes in and out of sun.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in a high-floor suite now, you would watch the last sun colour the clouds above the Harbour Bridge.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Sydney today, so the Harbour Bridge looks flat and dull, but the indoor pool still faces it.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the harbour, and guests in the Roman-style indoor pool can see the Opera House through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, lightning over the Harbour Bridge is visible from the apartments, and the gym is probably busier than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog or haze thins the view today, so the Opera House is a pale shape and the Harbour Bridge is partly hidden.
phrases.snow: Snow never falls in Sydney, but if it did, the sauna would be the warmest place to look at the Harbour Bridge.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold day, the clear air gives a sharp view of the Harbour Bridge from the high-floor suites.
phrases.very_hot: Strong heat over Sydney today, and from the indoor pool the Opera House and Harbour Bridge are visible through the glass.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Sydney, with the lit Harbour Bridge and Opera House filling the windows of the one-bedroom apartments.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the CBD towers behind the Opera House are not clear, though the Harbour Bridge is still visible.
phrases.late_night: The curtain is left open after midnight in the high-floor suites, the bridge arch and Opera House sails in view from bed.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the apartments after midnight, and the Harbour Bridge arch blurs behind the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud passes over the Harbour Bridge arch, and the city lights beneath it show through the floor-to-ceiling windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the river-facing rooms look down on a dark Guadalquivir and the lit bridges, with the sky starting to pale.
phrases.clear_morning: From the suites with curved windows, the historic centre is sharp this morning, with the Aljarafe hills clear in the distance.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong over Seville, and the sauna's three windows frame the skyline under a plain blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on the Terraza Atalaya, 37 floors up, are watching the sun drop towards the Aljarafe hills in clear air.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the upper-floor lounge looks out on city lights reaching the horizon and the bridges lit along the Guadalquivir.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the historic centre this morning, and rooms facing that side get sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in the indoor pool on floor 35 this afternoon, you would see broken cloud over Seville through the windows.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun drops between clouds over the Aljarafe hills, and the Terraza Atalaya has its brightest hour.
phrases.overcast: A full grey sky covers Seville today, so the view from the 37th floor is flat and even in every direction.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Seville, and from the river-facing rooms the Guadalquivir looks grey, with the bridges still easy to see.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is crossing the city, and the high-floor lounge, with its floor-to-ceiling windows, is a good place to watch lightning from.
phrases.fog_haze: In today's haze, the hills are missing from the hill-facing rooms, and only the nearer centre shows through the suite windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare here, but if it fell today, the indoor pool on floor 35 would be the place to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold, clear air sits over Seville today, and the Aljarafe hills stand out sharply from the hill-facing rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Seville is very hot today, and from the Terraza Atalaya the historic centre looks pale and still in strong light.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild night under cloud, and the lounge's curved sofas face the lit bridges on the Guadalquivir.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor today, and the Aljarafe hills cannot be seen from the Terraza Atalaya, though the Guadalquivir and nearer bridges can.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has a river-facing suite tonight is likely awake past one, watching city lights along the Guadalquivir from the curved windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the river-facing rooms can watch rain run down the glass while Seville's lights blur along the Guadalquivir tonight.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a river-facing room tonight looks out on low cloud over Seville and the city lights reflected in the Guadalquivir.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the high-floor suites look out on a dark English Bay and the outline of the North Shore Mountains.
phrases.clear_morning: From the fitness room on a clear morning, Thurlow Street and the downtown office towers are sharp in the sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop pool is in full sun, with the downtown towers standing clear on every side.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on the balconies are watching the low sun reach the West End towers and the street below.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a high-floor suite tonight, you would see the lights of the city blocks spread out below the window.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the North Shore Mountains this morning, seen from the upper floors above West Georgia Street.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over English Bay this afternoon, and the water changes from grey to bright as seen from the suites.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the rooftop pool is half in shade and half in sunlight, with towers around it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the floor-to-ceiling windows show the city blocks clearly, but the mountains are flat and dull today.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the tall windows, and inside Carlino the fresh pasta is served to guests who are in no hurry.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the North Shore Mountains shows well from a high-floor suite, which is a better place than the rooftop pool now.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides English Bay and the mountains today, so the view from the suites stops at the nearest towers.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the balconies, and the green rooftop below the windows is turning white.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the North Shore Mountains look close and sharp from the high-floor suites.
phrases.very_hot: Guests in the high-floor suites this afternoon look west through heat-haze over the rooftops to English Bay.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and the balcony tables are in use, with the West End towers lit nearby.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so English Bay and the North Shore Mountains are not in view; the nearby city blocks are.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the West End lights run to the edge of English Bay below a high-floor suite, and one more look is easy.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Carlino, rain runs down the high-floor suite windows and the West End lights blur toward English Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Carlino, the high-floor suites look out on lit city blocks spread west to English Bay under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Duomo spires are already outlined against a clear sky from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in La Cupola, the sky over Milan is clear, and Duomo-facing rooms show every spire sharply.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a cloudless midday sky, the glass roof of the Galleria is bright when seen from the ivy-lined balcony.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lands on the terracotta rooftops below the rooftop terrace, with the cathedral spires behind them.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at the Dehors terrace of MioLab tonight, you would see the Galleria arches lit under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Milan this morning, and the Duomo spires are lit, then shaded, as seen from the terrace suite.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon brings broken cloud over the Galleria, which the restaurant's velvet banquettes face through the windows.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, gaps in the cloud light the Duomo facade for guests in the Montenapoleone suite.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Milan today, and the Duomo looks flat and pale from the Duomo-facing rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the glass roof of the Galleria, so the arcade below stays dry, as seen from the ivy-lined balcony.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Milan, and lightning shows behind the Duomo spires from Duomo-facing rooms, while the rooftop terrace stays empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Duomo today, and from the rooftop terrace only the nearest terracotta rooftops are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Milan and collects on the terracotta rooftops seen from the Duomo terrace suite.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing outside, the rooftop terrace is empty, and the Duomo spires stand sharp in the cold clear air.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the plunge pool of the Duomo terrace suite is the sensible place to look at the cathedral.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild under a cloudy sky, and guests sit outside at the Dehors of MioLab facing the Galleria.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Milan today, so the nearby Galleria facade is clear but the Duomo spires look blurred from the terrace.
phrases.late_night: In a Galleria-facing room the curtain is pulled back tonight, and the glass arches fill the window until sleep comes.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtains in a Duomo-facing room stay open after midnight, and rain on the glass blurs the lights around the cathedral's spires.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open past midnight in the Duomo terrace suite, the cathedral spires show against low cloud over lit rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, La Pedrera across the street is a dark shape, and the balconies of the superior rooms are still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the stone of Casa Milà, so from a superior room balcony the carved details are easy to see.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop infinity pool is in full sun, and the white loungers around it are mostly taken.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the superior room balconies, late afternoon sun lights the stone facade of La Pedrera directly across Passeig de Gràcia.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at Alaire tonight, you would see La Pedrera lit up across the street under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over Barcelona this morning, but the balcony view of Casa Milà and the tree-lined avenue stays clear.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The rooftop pool gets sun between the clouds this afternoon, and the city buildings behind it change from bright to grey.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds shade La Pedrera on and off, as seen from the eighth-floor terrace of Alaire.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the stone of Casa Milà looks flat and pale from the superior room balconies today.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Passeig de Gràcia, so guests watch La Pedrera from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows instead of the balcony.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Barcelona has emptied the rooftop pool area, and the balcony facing Casa Milà is wet and unused.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Barcelona, yet La Pedrera is close enough across the street that its facade is readable from a superior room.
phrases.snow: Snow over Barcelona is unusual, and from the superior room balconies the flakes land on the trees of Passeig de Gràcia.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the rooftop pool area is quiet, and the balcony view of Casa Milà is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: From the Superior room balconies, heat-haze shimmers over Passeig de Gràcia below the stone front of Casa Milà.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the lights on La Pedrera show well from the eighth-floor terrace at Alaire.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far city from the rooftop pool is faint, while Casa Milà across the street remains visible.
phrases.late_night: Around two the Superior lights are off, and only Passeig de Gràcia's street lighting falls on La Pedrera's curved stone front opposite.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain is on the Superior room windows this evening, and La Pedrera's curved stone front shows across the wet Passeig de Gràcia.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low cloud tonight, the Superior rooms look across the lit Passeig de Gràcia to La Pedrera's curved stone front.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the room terraces face a dark sea, with the shapes of Lipari and Salina just starting to show.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were on a room terrace this clear morning, you would see Lipari and Salina sharp across the calm sea.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool is the busiest place here, and the volcanic sea stacks stand out sharply against a blue sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the sea stacks below the pool, and the islands on the horizon turn into flat dark silhouettes.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your terrace tonight, you would see the dark shape of Lipari against a clear, starry sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit above Salina and Filicudi this morning, seen from the room terraces at the tip of Vulcanello.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the infinity pool this afternoon, patches of cloud move across the Tyrrhenian Sea and shadow the sea stacks now and then.
phrases.partly_golden: The covered terrace lounge has the last of the sun, with a few clouds coloured orange above the volcanic sea stack.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey overcast sky, the volcanic rock stacks stand dark against a flat Tyrrhenian Sea beyond the infinity pool.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the tiled courtyard and the palm trees, and the covered terrace lounge is the dry place to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Tyrrhenian Sea is best watched from inside the room with the terrace doors shut, not from the pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the sea today hides Filicudi completely, and Salina is only a faint shape from the room terraces.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on Vulcano, but today a few flakes fall past the terrace doors onto the rocky hillside.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Sicily: the air is clear enough to see Filicudi, but the lava-stone spa is where guests go.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Vulcanello, and the infinity pool is the only comfortable place to look at the islands from.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the white arched facade is lit from inside, and the sea beyond the courtyard is calm.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so Filicudi and Salina cannot be seen from the terraces; the sea stacks near the pool are still clear.
phrases.late_night: Were you up late in a sea-facing room, you could watch the lights of Lipari across the water a while longer.
phrases.wet_evening: Were you having a last drink in your room tonight, you would see rain on the glass and Lipari's lights across the water.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last glass in your room now, you would see Lipari's lights across the water beneath the clouds.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the St. Vitus Cathedral spires are already outlined against a clear sky from the wooden-framed windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is served facing the castle, and this morning the hilltop sits under a completely cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the arched restaurant booth, the red roofs of the Old Town look brightest under the clear midday sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches St. Nicholas Church, and the seasonal terrace is the natural place to watch it.
phrases.clear_night: Through the windows tonight, amber lights cover the rooftops and churches, and the distant TV tower stands out clearly.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Prague Castle this morning, so the castle view at breakfast changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on the terrace this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows moving across the red rooftops of Malá Strana.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the St. Vitus spires from the side, with a few clouds above the hill.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud sits flat over the castle today, but the red rooftops below the terrace still show their colour.
phrases.rain: Rain keeps the seasonal terrace empty, so the view of St. Nicholas Church is taken from inside the restaurant window booth.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is passing over Prague, and from the hotel windows the castle hilltop disappears and reappears with each flash.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Prague Castle today, and from the wooden-framed windows only the nearest red roofs are clearly visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the red rooftops of Malá Strana, seen from the restaurant booth with the arched frame.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold and very clear today, so the St. Vitus Cathedral spires stand sharp above the red rooftops of Malá Strana.
phrases.very_hot: Heat hangs over Prague today, and the seasonal terrace facing St. Nicholas Church gets full sun for most of the afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Hradčany, with amber light on the rooftops and churches visible from the hotel windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today; the red rooftops nearest the terrace are clear, but the distant TV tower is not visible.
phrases.late_night: Around two, the attic room window shows the amber lights over the red roofs of Malá Strana below the castle hill.

phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner at the Mandarin Grill, the suite windows show the Forbidden City roofs under cloud lit by the city.

phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the medina tonight, and from the roof terrace the Koutoubia minaret rises above the lit rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over Green Park is clear, and from the park-facing suites the Park Lane traffic looks light.

phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Green Park this morning, and Buckingham Palace stays visible between them from the Premier King balconies.

phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds above the Shard, a view guests get from the fitness centre windows.

phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the corner window tonight, and the city lights beyond Hyde Park show soft and wet from the park-facing suites.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs low over Green Park after midnight, and the city lights show around the London Eye's wheel from the park-facing suites.

phrases.clear_midday: Lunch at Driftwood means tables in the sand under a full sun, with the Gulf of Thailand bright turquoise beyond.

phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Gulf means Vista's open sides let in wind and noise, and the swing seats are empty.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is dark from every private balcony, and the sky above the horizon starts to lighten.

phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the sand below the balconies, and the Atlantic looks flat and bright from the suite windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the beach from behind the hotel, and the colorful flags along the boardwalk stand out clearly.
phrases.clear_night: At night the boardwalk below the balconies is lit, with benches visible, and the ocean beyond is dark under clear stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over North Virginia Beach this morning, and from the indoor heated pool the windows show the oceanfront skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the suite living room, the wide window frames the beach with patches of sun and cloud shadow moving across the sand.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the clouds over the boardwalk pink, and the benches below the balconies are already lit.
phrases.overcast: Full cloud covers the Atlantic today, but the whole sweep of North Virginia Beach still shows from the upper suites.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the beach and boardwalk, and the sliding glass doors of the king rooms stay closed on the view.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests can watch lightning over the Atlantic from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of the indoor pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over the water today, so the balconies show the sand and the boardwalk but little of the Atlantic beyond.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare here, but today it covers the boardwalk and the beach below the balconies, while the pool indoors stays heated.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day keeps the beach below the balconies empty, and most guests swim in the indoor heated pool instead.
phrases.very_hot: From the oceanfront balcony, heat-haze hangs over the sand and the boardwalk flags below.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky on this mild night, and the lit boardwalk with its benches is the main view from the balconies.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so from the balconies the nearby beach is clear but the distant sweep of the shore is not.
phrases.late_night: Awake after midnight in a king oceanfront room, you could watch the boardwalk lights for hours.
phrases.wet_evening: With a last drink in a king oceanfront suite tonight, you would see rain on the glass and the boardwalk lights.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in an oceanfront king room now, you would see the boardwalk lights under cloud.

phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the terracotta rooftops first, and from a French balcony the castle hill is already in full light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Tagus is a flat bright strip beyond the twin towers of the Sé, seen from the 7th-floor Rooftop Bar.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a Premium Room terrace now, you would see warm late sun on the tiles and the river.
phrases.clear_night: From the Rooftop Bar, stars fill the clear night sky above São Jorge Castle and the lights of the city centre.
phrases.partly_morning: From the French balconies this morning, the Alfama rooftops pass in and out of sunlight as clouds cross the castle hill.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud and some sun this afternoon, and from the Rooftop Bar the Tagus turns grey, then bright, as the sky changes.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests on the 7th-floor rooftop in the last hour of sun look across the tiled roofs to São Jorge Castle under broken cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the terracotta tiles look duller from the terraces, but the castle and the river are still visible.
phrases.rain: Rain on the Rooftop Bar terrace today, so the wicker seats are empty and the Tagus shows only as a pale line.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunderstorm over the Tagus now, and from the Premium Room terraces the castle appears briefly with each flash of lightning.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the city, and from the French balconies São Jorge Castle is soft at the edges and the Tagus barely shows.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Lisbon, but if it fell today the rooftops seen from the Premium Room terraces would briefly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold for Lisbon today, so the iron chairs on the rooftop terrace stay empty and the castle looks sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Lisbon is very hot this afternoon, so the red umbrellas on the rooftop terrace are the only shade with a Tagus view.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the Rooftop Bar tables face the castle hill while the metro runs somewhere beneath the building.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the nearby rooftops and the Sé towers show from the terraces, but the Tagus does not.
phrases.late_night: After an earlier rooftop drink, lights along the Tagus fill a Premium Room window.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain on the Premium Rooms' French doors blurs the Alfama lights spread up the hill toward São Jorge Castle.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner is over, and from a Premium Room the city lights spread up the Alfama hill under low cloud toward the castle.

phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Penthouse tonight, you would see the lit Doha skyline under a clear sky, with no interruption.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Through the floor-to-ceiling glass of the suites, the afternoon skyline shows patches of sun and shade as clouds move across.

phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the Penthouse on the 23rd floor gives a wide view of lightning over the Doha towers.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the city today, and from the suite lounges the distant towers look soft and gray.
phrases.snow: Snow in Doha would be almost unheard of, but if it happened, the indoor pool under the stained-glass ceiling would stay warm.
phrases.very_cold: In hard winter light, the Doha skyline shows sharp through the Penthouse's floor-to-ceiling glass on the 23rd floor.
phrases.very_hot: Outside it is very hot over West Bay Lagoon, so the Walima terrace is mostly empty at this hour.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover Doha on this mild night, and the skyline lights still show from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the triangular suite windows the nearby low-rise districts are clear but the distant towers are not.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has the Penthouse tonight is up late, watching the city lights across Doha.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has the 23rd-floor Penthouse tonight can watch the Doha skyline lights through rain on the tall glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has the 23rd-floor Penthouse tonight can see the lit towers of the Doha skyline under a low, hazy cloud.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the sea today, so from the balconies the Cagarras Islands are hard to make out, though the beach is clear.

phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and guests sit out on the ocean-facing balconies with the sound of the Atlantic below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is reduced today, so Sugarloaf Mountain and the distant hills look faint from the pool, though the beach is clear.
phrases.late_night: Were you up for water around one in Suite 1201, you would see lights along the whole curve of Copacabana Beach.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in an ocean-facing room now, you would see rain over the lamps along Copacabana Beach.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in Suite 1201 tonight, you would see Copacabana's lamps along the whole sweep of sand under cloud.

phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Hinterland turn orange, best seen from the SkyPoint Bistro & Bar.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the 77th-floor view still covers the coast, just with less colour in the ocean.

phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder and lightning move over the ocean, and the high-floor apartments offer a dry, wide place to watch them from.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the coast today, so from level 60 the ocean is visible but Byron Bay is not.

phrases.grey_evening: The curtains are open in a high-floor apartment, and the coast lights curve away under cloud in both directions.

phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over the lake, and the restaurant's glass walls give guests a wide view of lightning above Windermere.

phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in the lounge now, you would see cloud over Windermere and shore lights on the water.

phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the lagoon water around the overwater villas reflects their lights under a clouded sky tonight.
