phrases.clear_night: Dinner at Therasia Restaurant tonight comes with a clear sky, and the caldera below is dark and calm.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the caldera this morning, visible from the twin-bed room through its sheer curtains.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the plunge pool terrace, scattered afternoon clouds cast patches of shadow on the caldera water below the Oia cliff.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights a few clouds over the caldera, seen from the Kirini Suite indoor jacuzzi.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Santorini today, and the caldera seen through the cave-style suite arch looks flat and pale.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Oia, so the spa cave pool, under its barrel-vaulted ceiling, is the busier choice today.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the caldera is visible from inside the Kirini Suite, and the outdoor plunge pool is empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far side of the caldera today, and only the nearest cliffs show from the restaurant terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on Santorini, but today a few flakes fall past the arch of the cave-style suites.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air sits over the caldera today, and the plunge pool terrace of the Kirini Suite has no one on it.
phrases.very_hot: Guests at the restaurant terrace stay under the white umbrellas today, because the sun over the caldera is very hot.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night covers Oia, and dinner at Therasia Restaurant goes on with the caldera dark below the terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Kirini Suite plunge pool the volcanic islands across the caldera cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: Sleep comes easily in the Kirini Suite tonight, a few village lights on the caldera water, the whole caldera back at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Therasia, rain runs down the Kirini Suite windows and blurs the village lights along the caldera.
phrases.grey_evening: Hours after dinner at Therasia, the Kirini Suite window frames Oia's cliff lights on the caldera, low cloud above them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the east-facing rooms face a dark Atlantic, and the sun will come up directly in front of them.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun has already risen over the Atlantic, and the floor-to-ceiling glass in the rooms fills with direct morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: If you stood on a north-facing suite balcony now, you would see the Intracoastal Waterway bright under a clear midday sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the north-facing upper suites, late sun lights the Intracoastal Waterway on one side and the Atlantic on the other.
phrases.clear_night: A clear night over Fort Lauderdale, and from the north-facing suites both the Intracoastal and the Atlantic show as dark water.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered morning clouds put moving patches of shade on the Atlantic, visible from the east-facing rooms through their sliding glass doors.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some clouds this afternoon, so swimmers in the curved lap pool get sun for a few minutes and then shade.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the clouds over the Atlantic orange, seen from the balconies with their teak dining sets.
phrases.overcast: From a north-facing upper suite balcony, the Intracoastal Waterway lies flat and grey under a full overcast sky.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Intracoastal Waterway and the Atlantic at the same time, both visible from the upper north-facing suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm over the Atlantic, the loungers around the lap pool empty and guests watch the lightning from behind glass doors.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water today: from the balconies the Atlantic fades into the sky with no clear horizon line.
phrases.snow: Snow in Fort Lauderdale is unheard of, but if it fell, you would see it from a room facing the Atlantic.
phrases.very_cold: A rare cold day for Fort Lauderdale, so the infinity pool and the loungers stay quiet while the Atlantic is bright blue.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot by the curved lap pool, so guests sit under the grey umbrellas and palm shade between swims.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night, the balcony teak dining sets are comfortable places to sit above a dark Atlantic.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooms the near beach and the first stretch of Atlantic show, but not the horizon.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water after midnight, and the lights along the Intracoastal Waterway show through the north-facing suite windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the north-facing suite windows tonight, and the lights along the Intracoastal Waterway look blurred through the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers Fort Lauderdale this evening, and the north-facing suites look out on the lights along the Intracoastal Waterway.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the harbour north of Britomart is dark and still, and the port cranes stand out against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the floor-to-ceiling windows, the Waitematā Harbour is bright blue this morning, with ships moving across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over Auckland, and the harbour view from Harbour Society is sharp all the way across.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Up on the HI-SO terrace, the low sun is turning the harbour and the port cranes orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a harbour-facing room tonight, you would see the lights of the port and ships across the bay.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit over the Waitematā this morning, and the water below changes between grey and blue as they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at Harbour Society have a mixed view this afternoon: patches of sun on the harbour, cloud shadow on the port.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds pink above the harbour, which is exactly what the HI-SO pod chairs face.
phrases.overcast: Guests at HI-SO this afternoon look north over a grey Waitematā Harbour under low cloud, with the port cranes visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Waitematā, and the harbour-facing rooms behind their floor-to-ceiling windows are the dry place to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the harbour is visible from the Harbour Society windows, and the rooftop terrace is empty for good reason.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has settled on the Waitematā today, and from the rooftop level the port cranes are only faint shapes.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Auckland, but if it were falling today, you would watch it over the harbour from a warm room.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day like this, the harbour is sharp right across the bay, and the HI-SO terrace has few takers.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoons like this one send guests from the rooftop sun to the shade of the pergola, harbour still in view.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Britomart, and on the HI-SO terrace the red pod chairs are mostly taken, facing the lit port.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooms the near waterfront is clear but the far side of the harbour is not.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner at Harbour Society, the port lights reflect on the Waitematā Harbour from the floor-to-ceiling windows upstairs.
phrases.wet_evening: Upstairs after dinner at Harbour Society, rain runs down the room windows and the port lights blur across the Waitematā Harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Harbour Society is over, and the room windows show port lights on the Waitematā Harbour under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before the sun comes up, the Atlantic outside the oceanfront suites is still black and the beach is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From an upper-floor suite this morning, the Grand Strand is visible in both directions under a completely clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands high over the Atlantic, and the two outdoor pools are the busiest places in the hotel.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the covered terrace right now, you would see the beach and the pier in low afternoon light.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the floor-to-ceiling windows of a king room show a dark Atlantic under a sky full of stars.
phrases.partly_morning: From an oceanfront balcony this morning, broken cloud sits over the Atlantic and the Grand Strand beach below.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the poolside bar are watching the clouds pass over the ocean while the sun comes and goes.
phrases.partly_golden: Just before sunset, the covered terrace with its teal curtains faces clouds turning pink above the Atlantic.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the sky over Myrtle Beach today, and the ocean seen from the oceanfront suites looks grey as well.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the beach and the pier, and guests are watching it from the oceanfront restaurant behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: From an upper-floor balcony, lightning flashes far out over the Atlantic while rain falls on the Grand Strand below.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has settled over the water today, and from the suites the pier disappears into it a short way out.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Myrtle Beach, but today a few flakes are falling past the balconies toward the sand below.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air outside keeps the balconies empty today, and the ocean is best seen from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.very_hot: The Grand Strand is very hot today, and most guests have moved into the pools or under the covered terrace.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but it is warm enough to sit on an oceanfront balcony and listen to the surf.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The far ends of the Grand Strand are not visible today, only the beach and the pier close to the hotel.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has an oceanfront suite tonight has turned the room lights off, and only the shoreline lights of Myrtle Beach come in.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the oceanfront suites can watch the rain run down the window tonight, the Grand Strand lights blurred along the shore.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has an oceanfront suite tonight can see the Grand Strand lights along the shore under low cloud after midnight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Burj Khalifa is already a dark outline in the corner suite windows, with the canal below still unlit.
phrases.clear_morning: From the soaking tub, a guest can see the Business Bay towers and the canal in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the rooftop infinity pool, and most guests stay under the umbrellas between swims.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Burj Khalifa from the side, and the corner suites get the clearest version of that view.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Burj Khalifa is lit under a cloudless sky, in full view from the rooftop St. Regis Bar.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass behind the Burj Khalifa this morning, easy to follow from the teal chair beside the window.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds move over Business Bay this afternoon, so the towers seen from the rooftop infinity pool switch between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds behind the Burj Khalifa, visible from the suite lounge windows on the high floors.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Burj Khalifa looks flat and silver through the floor-to-ceiling windows, which is rare in Dubai.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Business Bay, an unusual sight, and guests in the corner suites watch the canal from behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Dubai skyline shows for a second in the suite windows, and nobody is in the rooftop infinity pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the top of the Burj Khalifa today, so the corner suites show only its lower half.
phrases.snow: If snow were falling over the Dubai Water Canal today, every floor-to-ceiling window in the hotel would have someone standing at it.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold day, the rooftop pool is quiet and guests watch the Burj Khalifa from the suite lounge.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot outside, and the rooftop infinity pool is the one outdoor place guests stay, facing the Business Bay towers.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars on this warm night, but the Burj Khalifa lights are clear from the rooftop St. Regis Bar.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the Burj Khalifa is a faint shape from the corner suites, though the canal below is still clear.
phrases.late_night: If you turned off every light in a corner suite now, the skyline around the Burj Khalifa would light the room.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were at the rooftop St. Regis Bar for a last drink, you would see the Burj Khalifa's spire through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: Up at the St. Regis Bar tonight, you would see the Burj Khalifa's spire above lit Business Bay under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Lumi Rooftop is empty and the Tagus shows as a dark band below the quiet Bairro Alto rooftops.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light hits the terracotta rooftops, and from a penthouse window the castle walls look sharp against the sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Tagus is bright blue from the Lumi Rooftop tables, and the bell tower casts almost no shadow.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low afternoon sun turns São Jorge Castle warm orange, which is the main reason people on the rooftop stop talking.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop tonight, you would see the hillside lit up and the castle outlined under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the Tagus, so the river changes from grey to blue while guests eat on the Lumi Rooftop.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Lumi Rooftop, afternoon cloud shadows pass over the Bairro Alto roofs toward the Tagus and São Jorge Castle.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds light up pink over São Jorge Castle while the river turns grey.
phrases.overcast: If you stood at the Lumi Rooftop railing now, you would see São Jorge Castle dull grey under low cloud.
phrases.rain: Rain keeps most guests inside their suites today, where the kitchens are getting more use than the rooftop terrace.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the rooftop terrace empties and lightning over the Tagus is watched from the suite windows instead.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over the river today, so from the Lumi Rooftop the castle is visible but the Tagus is not.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Lisbon, but if flakes fell, the terracotta rooftops below the terrace would stay white for about a minute.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the view is sharp enough that the castle walls show every stone from the glass railing.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoons leave the rooftop terrace almost empty, and most guests return to the glass railing only after sunset.
phrases.mild_night: From the Lumi Rooftop on a mild cloudy night, the lit hillside climbs toward São Jorge Castle under low cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the rooftops and bell tower are clear from the terrace, but the Tagus is only a pale strip.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Penthouse window shows Lisbon's hillside lights, and the Tagus and São Jorge Castle are back in it at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: The penthouse curtain is open after midnight, and the lit hillside toward São Jorge Castle shows through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: The Penthouse curtain is open after midnight, and the hillside lights below São Jorge Castle show hazy under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the private bay is still dark, and the marina lights are the brightest thing seen from a sea-view balcony.
phrases.clear_morning: From the arched balcony doors of a sea-view room, the Arabian Gulf shows its turquoise colour under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a cloudless midday sky, the shade sails on the waterfront terrace are the busiest spot above the private beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun makes the gold façade brighter, and guests on the cream loungers watch it from the waterfront terrace.
phrases.clear_night: On the dining terrace tonight, the illuminated towers and the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque are clearly visible across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the marina this morning, and the beach below the balconies is already in full sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the Arabian Gulf this afternoon, so guests on the waterfront terrace get shade and sun in turns.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the waterfront terrace now, you would see the last sun coming between clouds over the private bay.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Abu Dhabi today, and from the sea-view rooms the Gulf looks flatter and paler than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the private beach, a rare event here, and guests watch it from behind the arched balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Arabian Gulf shows lightning from the balconies, while the dining terrace sits empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Morning haze over the water hides the marina from the balconies, and only the nearest part of the beach is clear.
phrases.snow: Snow in Abu Dhabi is nearly unheard of, but if it fell today the private beach would be the strangest view.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day by Abu Dhabi standards keeps the waterfront terrace quiet, though the sky over the Gulf stays clear.
phrases.very_hot: In the extreme heat, the shade sails on the waterfront terrace are the only reason anyone sits outside before evening.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight's mild air and cloud cover suit the dining terrace, where the lit towers and the Grand Mosque stand out.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balconies the marina is faint and the far Gulf horizon cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: The curtain is left open tonight in a sea-view room, so the marina lights show on the water of the bay.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the balcony doors of a sea-view room and the marina lights blur across the bay.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the arched doors of a sea-view room frame the marina lights and the lit towers under tonight's cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Cathedral View Rooms show the Steffl's stonework as a dark shape against a clear sky over Vienna.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at Café Giacomo Aragall comes with clear morning light on Stephansplatz and the first people crossing the square.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the tiled roof of St Stephen's Cathedral shows its pattern from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Gothic stonework of St Stephen's Cathedral beyond the twin windows of the Cathedral View Rooms.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop terrace tonight, you would see the cathedral roof outlined against a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Stephansplatz this morning, and guests at Café Giacomo Aragall watch the square from the ground floor.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Steffl this afternoon, so the stonework outside the Cathedral View Rooms shifts between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests on the rooftop terrace with an Aperol Spritz get the last hour of sun on the cathedral's tiled roof between clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Gothic stonework looks flat from the twin windows, but it is still very close.
phrases.rain: If you were at a Cathedral View Room window now, you would see rain running down the Steffl's Gothic stonework.
phrases.thunderstorm: There is thunder over Vienna this hour, and the Cathedral View Rooms give a dry, close view of lightning behind the Steffl.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over Vienna today, so even from the twin windows the Steffl's upper stonework is hard to make out.
phrases.snow: From the Cathedral View Rooms, snow settles on the tiled roof and Gothic stonework of St Stephen's Cathedral across Stephansplatz.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Cathedral View Rooms this afternoon look out on frost on the Steffl's tiled roof at near eye level.
phrases.very_hot: The square is very hot this afternoon, the rooftop terrace is in full sun, and an Aperol Spritz warms up fast there.
phrases.mild_night: Late on a mild, cloudy night, guests in the Cathedral View Rooms look out on the lit stonework of St Stephen's Cathedral.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Vienna today, so the Steffl directly opposite is clear enough but nothing farther across the city shows.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Cathedral View Rooms frame the Steffl's stonework above the lit square, easy to watch for one more hour.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Cathedral View Rooms' windows after midnight, and St Stephen's Gothic stonework is close behind the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud passes over the cathedral's tiled roof after midnight, and the lights of Stephansplatz show beneath it from the Cathedral View Rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pike Place Market neon sign is lit, with Elliott Bay dark behind it from the Deluxe Water View rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: From a guest room's corner windows, Elliott Bay looks flat and bright, and a Washington State Ferry crosses toward the waterfront.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Pike Place Market sign stands against Elliott Bay beyond the rooftop railing.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were at a corner window now, you would see low gold sun on Elliott Bay behind the neon market sign.
phrases.clear_night: The market has closed, the firepits on the rooftop terrace are lit, and the neon sign glows against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Elliott Bay this morning, and from the Deluxe Water View rooms both sign and water are clear.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop terrace, patches of afternoon sun lie on Elliott Bay under broken cloud beyond the Pike Place Market sign.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see the last sun light the Seattle Great Wheel between clouds.
phrases.overcast: Gray cloud covers Seattle today, so Elliott Bay looks gray too from the corner windows, with the ferry still crossing.
phrases.rain: Wet weather keeps the rooftop terrace empty, so guests in Deluxe Water View rooms watch the wet neon sign from inside.
phrases.thunderstorm: With thunder over Puget Sound, the firepits on the rooftop terrace stay unlit and guests watch the lightning from their rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Elliott Bay, so from the terrace the neon sign is sharp but the Great Wheel is only an outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Seattle, but today it lands on the rooftop terrace while Elliott Bay stays dark gray behind the sign.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing today, but the air is very clear, and from the rooftop terrace a ferry on Elliott Bay stands out.
phrases.very_hot: From the rooftop terrace, heat-haze hangs over the Pike Place Market sign and the flat water of Elliott Bay beyond.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night, and the firepits on the rooftop terrace are lit while the neon sign shines over Elliott Bay.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so from the corner windows the Great Wheel is clear but the far end of Elliott Bay is not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Deluxe Water View rooms are dark inside, and the only light comes off the waterfront on Elliott Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the corner windows of the Deluxe Water View rooms, and the waterfront lights blur across Elliott Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner and after midnight, the Deluxe Water View corner windows show the waterfront lights on Elliott Bay under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Arno runs dark under Ponte Vecchio, and the fourth-floor terrace is still empty and quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast in the frescoed ballroom comes with a clear view of the Arno this morning, sun already on the water.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests on the fifth-floor rooftop terrace this midday look across the red roofs to the Duomo under a clear blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun falls on Ponte Vecchio, seen straight on from the fourth-floor private terrace above the river.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky with stars over the Duomo, the lights of Ponte Vecchio shine below the fourth-floor terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Florentine hills this morning, visible from the fifth-floor rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the fourth-floor terrace, patches of afternoon sun fall on Ponte Vecchio between the drifting clouds over the Arno.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the fourth-floor terrace now, you would see the last sun on Ponte Vecchio between broken clouds.
phrases.overcast: The sky is grey over Florence today, but the Duomo and Palazzo Vecchio are still clearly visible from the rooftop bar.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Arno, and guests are watching the river from the breakfast room windows instead of the terrace.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows the Florence rooftops now and then from the twin windows of a guest room, with thunder close behind.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog on the Arno today, and from the fourth-floor terrace Ponte Vecchio is only a grey shape fifty meters away.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Florence, but today it is falling on the Duomo and settling on the rooftop's red planters.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold and clear today, so the iron chairs on the rooftop terrace stay empty, though the Duomo view is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Heat sits over the Duomo this afternoon, and most guests leave the rooftop iron chairs for the shade of their rooms.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night over the Arno, and a few guests are still out on the rooftop terrace with a drink.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Florence today, so the Duomo still shows from the rooftop bar but the Florentine hills do not.
phrases.late_night: After a late drink on the rooftop, city lights shine on the Arno beside Ponte Vecchio.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtain stays open after midnight, and rain blurs the city lights along the Arno.
phrases.grey_evening: Before bed the curtain is open in the fourth-floor room, and city lights reflect in the Arno beside Ponte Vecchio under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Kyoto Tower is already a pale white line about two kilometers from the glass of the city-view rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Deluxe City room, morning sunlight falls on the tiled roofs between the hotel and Kyoto Tower.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky over Kyoto is clear, and Kyoto Tower stands sharp and white beyond the treetops and roofs.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The fourth-floor rooftop lounge has its best hour now, with low sun on the roofs and the white spire of Kyoto Tower.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the courtyard garden is dark and quiet, and from the city-view rooms Kyoto Tower is lit against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the hills this morning, and the balcony tea set sits ready on the table between the orange chairs.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in a Junior Suite City this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows crossing the tiled roofs toward Kyoto Tower.
phrases.partly_golden: Under broken cloud, guests on the rooftop terrace watch the last sun color the sky behind Kyoto Tower.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Kyoto today, so the tower, the roofs and the hills show flat, without any shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the tiled roofs, and from the circular soaking pool you can look up at the wet domed skylight.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Higashiyama hills, and the indoor lap pool with its cloud mural is the calmer place to be right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides Kyoto Tower today, and from the city-view rooms only the nearest treetops and tiled roofs can be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the tiled roofs and the courtyard garden, and Kyoto Tower looks greyer than usual two kilometers away.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold outside today, but the sky is clear and the hills behind the roofs are sharp from every city-view balcony.
phrases.very_hot: If you were there this very hot afternoon, you would probably choose the indoor lap pool over the balcony chairs.
phrases.mild_night: Warm air and cloud tonight, and from the rooftop lounge guests can still see the lit tower above the dark roofs.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today, so from the city-view rooms the tiled roofs stay clear but Kyoto Tower two kilometers off is faint.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a water glass by the bed in a City room catches the low city lights and Kyoto Tower's thin spire.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtains open in the City rooms tonight, rain streaks the glass and the low city lights show out to Kyoto Tower's spire.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open after midnight in a City room, the lit rooftops lie under low cloud out to Kyoto Tower's thin spire.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies on Beach Road face a dark Table Mountain and a flat, grey Atlantic under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Penthouse Suite balconies, Lion's Head and Table Mountain stand sharp in clear morning light over Mouille Point.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the heated rooftop pool is in full sun, with DHL Stadium and the Atlantic clearly visible below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun turns Lion's Head and Table Mountain warm orange, seen from the rooftop bar with a cocktail in hand.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the city lights below the rooftop pool are clear, and Table Mountain is a dark shape behind DHL Stadium.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit on top of Table Mountain this morning, visible from every one of the 34 private balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over Lion's Head this afternoon, and swimmers in the heated rooftop pool watch the shade move across the stadium.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken clouds let the last sun reach Table Mountain, seen from the heated rooftop pool with the stadium below.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the Atlantic beyond Beach Road looks flat and silver from the suite windows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites, and Table Mountain is only half visible behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, guests stay off the balconies and watch lightning over the Atlantic from inside their rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Sea fog has come in over Mouille Point, so from the rooftop pool the stadium is faint and Table Mountain is gone.

phrases.very_cold: On this very cold clear day, the heated rooftop pool steams a little, with Lion's Head sharp behind it.

phrases.late_night: Whoever is up late in a Penthouse Suite sees shore lights running toward Lion's Head.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a Penthouse Suite tonight can watch rain run down the glass as the city lights come on under Table Mountain.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the Penthouse Suites sees Table Mountain's flat top under low cloud, the city lights beneath it.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun comes from behind the hotel, so the balcony dining table sits in shade while the Atlantic stays bright.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the veranda tonight, you would see a clear sky over the Atlantic and hear the waves close by.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Atlantic this morning, and guests on the veranda rocking chairs watch cloud shadows on the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Through the two spa treatment room windows, the afternoon sea goes from grey to blue as clouds move across the sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, scattered clouds over the ocean catch some colour, seen from the balcony railing.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Fort Lauderdale today, and from the guest room windows the Atlantic looks grey too, but still very wide.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the private beach, and the wrap-around veranda roof keeps the rocking chairs dry for anyone sitting there.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Atlantic, so the oceanfront pool is empty and guests watch the lightning from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, and from the veranda the Atlantic fades to white a short distance out.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Fort Lauderdale, but if it did today, the private beach in front of the veranda would be white.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold day for Florida, the sun is out, the Atlantic is bright, and the oceanfront pool stays empty.

phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the air is mild and the rocking chairs on the veranda face the dark Atlantic.
phrases.reduced_visibility: If you were on the wrap-around veranda now, you would see the near water and private beach but not the far horizon.
phrases.late_night: With the curtain left open on purpose, the floor-to-ceiling window shows the white edge of the surf on the Atlantic after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the guest rooms, and the Atlantic shows grey under the evening sky.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the Atlantic after midnight, and the floor-to-ceiling windows of the guest rooms show the lit towers to the south.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the terrace now, you would see low sun on Nybroviken and the red geraniums along the railing.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over Nybroviken this afternoon, and guests on the rooftop lounge seating get sun in short periods.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over Strandvägen turns orange, seen best from the rooftop terrace.

phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a balcony room tonight can watch low cloud pass over the lit rooftops from the window after midnight.

phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud moves over Ortigas, and the lit city below Vu's Sky Bar fades and returns through the haze.

phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open after midnight, the old-town lights reach down to Funchal Bay under low cloud from the sea-view rooms.

phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Upper West Side skyline today, and from floor 39 only the nearest Central Park treetops can be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Central Park's bare trees, and the copper-green mansard roof above the top floors turns white.
phrases.very_cold: From the Park View floors, frost edges the window glass over Central Park's bare treetops in hard daylight.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the rooftop terrace gets full sun, and most guests stay inside the Park View suites.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under a cloudy sky, and the rooftop terrace lounge seats face the lit Upper East Side skyline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far Upper West Side skyline is not clear, though Central Park's treetops are.
phrases.late_night: With the suite lights off at three in the morning, the only glow comes from the Upper West Side across Central Park.
phrases.wet_evening: With curtains open after midnight, rain runs down a Park View window and the Upper West Side lights blur across Central Park.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, under the cloud, the Upper West Side lights show across the park through the open curtains of Park View rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Arno is dark and quiet below the river suites, and the Ponte Vecchio shows only its outline.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Rooftop Terrace Suite, the Duomo and Giotto's Campanile stand in full morning sun against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the wicker chairs on the rooftop terrace sit in strong sun, with the Duomo clearly visible across the roofs.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests at the river tables of Borgo San Jacopo this afternoon look across the Arno to the Ponte Vecchio in late sun.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lit windows of the Ponte Vecchio reflected on the calm Arno.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Florence this morning, so the balcony behind the arched terrace doors gets sun in short intervals.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the sun loungers on the roof get a mix of sun and shade as clouds move over Palazzo Vecchio.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests in the Picasso and Cocteau suites watch the low sun turn a few clouds over the Ponte Vecchio orange.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Arno looks brown and flat, and the Ponte Vecchio loses most of its colour from the terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Arno, and guests at Borgo San Jacopo watch the Ponte Vecchio through wet windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Florence shows the Ponte Vecchio for a second at a time, best watched from inside a river suite.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Arno today, and from the hotel windows the Ponte Vecchio is only a grey shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Florence, but today a thin layer covers the rooftop terrace and the roofs around the Duomo.
phrases.very_cold: A clear but very cold day: the rooftop terrace is empty, and the Duomo stands sharp in the dry air.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Florence, and the blue sun loungers on the roof face the Duomo in full, hard sun.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night the Arno runs quietly past the hotel, and the lights on the Ponte Vecchio stay on.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Ponte Vecchio is still clear from the terrace, but the Duomo is hard to make out.
phrases.late_night: Dinner at Borgo San Jacopo done, city lights reflect in the Arno beside the Ponte Vecchio.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Picasso suite windows after midnight, and the lights along the Arno blur toward the Ponte Vecchio.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze drifts over the Arno after midnight, and from the Picasso suite city lights go soft on the water toward Ponte Vecchio.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rice terraces below the villa terraces are still dark shapes, and the infinity pool is quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: From the breakfast terrace, the Tegallalang rice terraces are fully lit, with the mountains clear in the distance.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the pool terraces, so most guests are in the water or under the parasol.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on your villa terrace now, you would see the light on the rice terraces changing by the minute.
phrases.clear_night: Night over the Oos River Valley is clear, and the private pools are the only lit things on the villa terraces.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Tegallalang this morning, putting parts of the rice terraces in shadow while the breakfast terrace stays sunny.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the sky is half cloud, and guests on the poolside deck are watching the shadows move across the valley.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, gaps in the cloud light up single rice terraces while the rest stay grey.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the whole valley today, so the rice terraces look flat green from the villa terraces.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the jungle and the rice terraces, and the thatched pavilion is the one dry spot beside the pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Oos River Valley, and guests watch the lightning from inside their villas rather than the terraces.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist fills the valley today, and from the curved infinity pool only the nearest rice terraces can be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow on the Tegallalang rice terraces would be a first for Bali, and the villa terraces feel unusually cold today.
phrases.very_cold: Cold air like this is rare above the Oos River Valley, and the soaking tub is more popular than the private pools.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today in Tegallalang, and the water of the private pools is the most used part of every villa.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm with cloud over the valley, and the villa terraces are comfortable for sitting out late.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the mountains behind the valley are not visible from the breakfast terrace, only the nearest rice terraces.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water by the villa window, and the moon shows Tegallalang's rice fields.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls over the Oos River Valley after midnight, and the Tegallalang terraces come and go behind the wet villa glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud moves over the Tegallalang terraces after midnight, and the villa pool lights show through the haze.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Duomo dome stands dark against a clear sky, seen from the Prestige room balconies on Via dei Calzaiuoli.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast of Florentine pastries and Tuscan savories is on the buffet, and the dome outside is already bright in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the small table and chairs on a Prestige balcony sit in full sun, facing Brunelleschi's dome.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun warms the colour of the dome, and guests in a Prestige Duomo View room watch it from the balcony.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the lit dome fills the view from a Prestige balcony, and the pedestrian street below has gone quiet.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the dome this morning, so its colour changes every few minutes when seen from the Prestige room windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on a Prestige balcony this afternoon, you would see the dome move in and out of cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the dome between broken clouds, best seen from the small balcony table in a Prestige room.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the dome still fills the open window of a Prestige room, just with less colour than usual.
phrases.rain: If you were on a Prestige balcony now, you would see rain running down the dome of Santa Maria del Fiore.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Florence, and the balcony chairs of the Prestige rooms stay empty while the dome goes dark between flashes.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog today softens the outline of the dome, though from a Prestige balcony it is close enough to still be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Florence, but today a thin layer sits on the dome, visible from the Prestige room windows.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air outside keeps the Prestige balconies empty, so guests look at the dome through closed windows instead.
phrases.very_hot: Strong heat makes the balcony chairs facing the dome unusable until evening, and the cream curtains stay half drawn.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the small balcony tables of the Prestige rooms are in use, facing the dome.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Orsanmichele and the Bargello are harder to see, but the dome close by stays clear.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Prestige Duomo View rooms look onto the dome's curve above the few lit windows of Florence.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Prestige Duomo View windows after midnight, and the dome's outline shows through the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud passes over the dome after midnight, and the Prestige Duomo View windows show the city lights under it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Under a clear sky before sunrise, the Kamogawa below the Grand Deluxe Kamogawa rooms catches the first pale light.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight reaches the Kamogawa early, and from the Lobby Lounge glass the river below is bright and the far bank is sharp.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the green hills behind the tiled rooftops are fully lit when seen from a suite lounge window.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a private suite balcony now, you would see low sun on the Higashiyama mountains across the river.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Kyoto is clear, and the terrace sofa faces city lights and the dark shape of the mountains.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Higashiyama mountains this morning, visible from the twin rooms facing the Kamo River.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun alternate over the river this afternoon, so the view behind a Pierre Hermé afternoon tea changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds turn orange above the far bank, seen through floor-to-ceiling windows in Luxury Rooms.
phrases.overcast: Under a low grey sky, the Kamogawa runs close below the windows toward the far bank and the Higashiyama mountains.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the river today, and guests in the Lobby Lounge watch it through the glass with their tea.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Higashiyama mountains, so the riverside path into Gion is empty and The Bar is busier than usual.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Higashiyama mountains today, and from a Grand Deluxe Kamogawa room only the river and far bank are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the stone lantern outside the tatami room and on the tiled rooftops seen from the suite lounge.
phrases.very_cold: The air is close to freezing today, and from the twin rooms the Kamo River and distant hills look very sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Kyoto is very hot today, so the green maple trees below the glass-railed balconies are the coolest-looking part of the view.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild cloudy night in Kyoto, and guests on the suite balconies hear the Kamogawa more than they see it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Higashiyama mountains behind the river are not visible from the Grand Deluxe Kamogawa rooms.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the far bank's lights show on the Kamogawa directly below the Grand Deluxe Kamogawa rooms.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Grand Deluxe Kamogawa windows tonight, and lights from the far bank shine on the river below.
phrases.grey_evening: Below the Grand Deluxe Kamogawa rooms, the far bank's lights show on the river under low cloud after midnight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pier stands dark against a clear sky, and the Pacific is quiet below the ocean-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Oceanfront Atrium Suite, both floors show the same clear view this morning: sand, calm water and the Pier.
phrases.clear_midday: At the fourth-floor Azure Pool, guests are under mint umbrellas while the sun is directly over the beach below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the sun dropping toward the Pacific from a terrace fire pit.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Ferris wheel on the Pier is lit, and it is the brightest thing visible from the ocean-facing balconies.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Pacific this morning, and the roller coaster on the Pier is clearly visible from the suites.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the beach this afternoon, and the sand seen from the Azure Pool deck changes between bright and shaded.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Pier turn orange, which is the view from the Presidential Suite terraces.
phrases.overcast: Full cloud cover over Santa Monica today, and from the suite windows the ocean and the sky are almost the same colour.
phrases.rain: Rain in Santa Monica is rare, and today the sliding glass doors to the balconies are closed while the beach is empty.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm over the Pacific is unusual here, and guests are watching it from inside their rooms rather than from the terraces.
phrases.fog_haze: Coastal fog is common here, and right now the Pier is only a faint shape from the ocean-facing rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow in Santa Monica almost never happens, so if it is falling now, the beach below the Azure Pool looks very strange.
phrases.very_cold: From the fourth-floor Azure Pool deck, the sand below the Pier lies empty in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the shade of the mint umbrellas at the Azure Pool matters more than the ocean view.
phrases.mild_night: The night is warm and cloudy, the Pier lights show through, and guests sit at the terrace fire pits.
phrases.reduced_visibility: If you were at an ocean-facing window now, you would see the beach and the Pier but not the far Pacific.
phrases.late_night: If you turned off the lights in the Oceanfront Atrium Suite, only the shore lights near the Pier would reach the room.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were with a last drink in an oceanfront room, rain would run down the glass before the Pier's Ferris wheel.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in an oceanfront room now, you would see the Pier's Ferris wheel under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea below Suite 59 is dark and flat, and the coastline toward Praiano is only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast tables look over the Positano coastline this morning, with a cloudless sky and bright blue water below the cliffs.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the half-moon pool faces the blue sea toward Praiano and the rugged cliffs.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Virginia Suite balcony, the low afternoon sun lights the sea and the cliffs toward Praiano under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: Candles are lit on the terrace tables tonight, and the sky above the sea is clear enough to show stars.
phrases.partly_morning: If you were at breakfast now, you would see a few clouds over the sea and sun on the cliffside houses.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Passing clouds give the tennis court, set on the rocks above the water, some shade this afternoon between spells of sun.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds in the west break up the last hour of sun, so the terrace gets light and shade in turns before dinner.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the coast today, but every room still faces the sea, which looks more silver than blue.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the half-moon pool and on the empty orange loungers at the beach club, while guests stay in their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the sea shows up well from the suite balconies, and nobody is on the tennis court right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Guests on the half-moon pool terrace this afternoon look toward Praiano through haze that hides the far coastline.
phrases.snow: A rare sight on the Amalfi Coast: a few snowflakes drift past the suite balconies and melt before reaching the sea.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air on the terraces today, so the half-moon pool is quiet and the coastline toward Praiano looks unusually sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Heat on the cliff today sends most guests down the one-minute lift to the beach club and into the sea.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and the candlelit terrace tables still face the dark sea below the cliffs.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Praiano and the far coastline are not visible from the pool, only the sea nearby.
phrases.late_night: Lights off in the Virginia Suite at two, the moon on the sea gives the room its only light.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Virginia Suite's window after midnight, and the lights of Praiano blur across the water.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain is open late in the Virginia Suite, and lights along the coast show on the sea under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, east-facing rooms look out at a dark Atlantic with a clear sky slowly getting lighter above it.
phrases.clear_morning: From a high-floor balcony this morning, the beach umbrellas are open and the Atlantic is pale green under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The pool is in full sun right now, and the restaurant's open walls frame palm trees and a bright ocean.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light reaches the restaurant's tile floors, and from the Aqua Lounge the marina and Atlantic are both lit warmly.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the twin fire pits in the open-air lobby are burning, with palm trees and a dark ocean beyond them.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Atlantic this morning, so the view from the east-facing rooms changes from bright to shaded.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on the fifth-floor Aqua Lounge this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows moving across the marina and the sea.
phrases.partly_golden: West-facing rooms get the last hour of sun over the marina channel, with some clouds turning orange around it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlantic looks pale green from the balconies, and the wide beach below is quieter than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the beach umbrellas right now, and guests in the rooms watch it through the glass balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, the lightning over the Atlantic is easier to watch from behind the glass doors of an east-facing room.
phrases.fog_haze: From the fifth-floor Aqua Lounge, the Bahia Mar Marina channel and the Atlantic beyond the beach fade into daytime haze.
phrases.snow: Snow in Fort Lauderdale is almost unheard of, but if it fell today the beach umbrellas below the balconies would be white.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare day this cold, the open-air lobby's fire pits are the busiest spot, with the ocean still in view.
phrases.very_hot: If you were on an east-facing balcony now, you would see heat-haze shimmering over the sand toward the Atlantic.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the fifth-floor Aqua Lounge shows marina lights on one side and a dark sea on the other.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so from the east-facing balconies the Atlantic fades out well before the horizon.
phrases.late_night: The curtain stays open on purpose in the west-facing rooms, so the marina lights are the last thing seen before sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass of the west-facing rooms after midnight, and the marina lights show blurred across the channel.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the Atlantic after midnight, and the marina lights show through it below the west-facing rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rice fields below the pool villas are still dark, and the river can be heard but not yet seen.
phrases.clear_morning: From the wooden balcony tables at Seneng Kitchen, the valley and the river below are fully lit under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the infinity pool, and most guests have moved under the umbrellas on the wooden deck.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light reaches the rice fields across the valley, seen from the pool villas and the deck beside the infinity pool.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a pool villa tonight, you would see stars above the valley and hear the river below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are drifting over the Campuhan Valley this morning, and the surface of the infinity pool reflects them between patches of blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Shade on the wooden deck comes and goes this afternoon as clouds pass over the jungle around the pool.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the valley turn orange, and the Seneng Kitchen balcony tables fill up.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the forest canopy outside the restaurant windows looks darker green, and the pool is quiet.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rice fields and the river, while guests in the pool villas watch it from under the wooden pavilion.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder sounds over the Campuhan Valley, and the lounge chairs on the deck beside the infinity pool are empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist fills the valley today, so from the pool the rice fields are only partly visible and the river is hidden.
phrases.snow: From the Seneng Kitchen balcony, snow settles on the rice fields above the Campuhan Valley and the river below.
phrases.very_cold: From the pool deck, the lounge chairs sit empty in hard cold light above the rice fields and the river.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day the infinity pool is the busiest place, and the umbrellas on the wooden deck are all taken.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under clouds, and the outdoor tub on the villa balcony is a reasonable place to hear the river.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low: from the Seneng Kitchen balcony the river below is clear, but the far side of the valley is not.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the pool villas likely fall asleep facing the valley tonight, nothing drawn across the glass, the river loud below.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in a pool villa after midnight can watch the rain fall on the rice fields of the Campuhan Valley.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a pool villa after midnight can watch low cloud pass over the Campuhan Valley from the window.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dolomites are a dark outline from every balcony, and the Sky Pool is already warm.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were there this morning, you would see the Puster Valley fields sharp and green below the pool's glass floor.
phrases.clear_midday: The restaurant's floor-to-ceiling glass shows the Dolomites in full sun today, pale rock against a blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun is turning the limestone peaks orange, and the room balconies all face that direction.
phrases.clear_night: Swimmers in the heated Sky Pool tonight look out at a clear sky and the black shape of the Dolomites.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Puster Valley this morning, and the gym windows frame the peaks between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Heaven and Hell spa platform this afternoon, the Dolomites move in and out of cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: On the dining terrace, the last hour of sun lights the ridges while scattered clouds pass over Valdaora.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the peaks today, so the restaurant view is mostly pine forest and fields below.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Sky Pool, and the glass floor shows wet meadow twelve metres down.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Puster Valley, and guests watch it from their balconies rather than from the pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Dolomites today, and from the gym windows only the nearest pine trees are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow covers the fields of Valdaora, and steam rises from the heated pool while people swim toward the peaks.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold outside, but the Sky Pool is heated, so swimmers look at the Dolomites from warm water.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day like this, the pool cantilevered over the hillside is the most used viewpoint in the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and the room balconies face mountains that are only faint shapes in the dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far Dolomite peaks are not visible from the restaurant, only the nearby fields and forest.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water at the window, and the lights of Valdaora show in the valley under the Dolomites.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtain stays open before bed, and through the rain on the window a few lights of the Puster Valley show below.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtains open before bed, the valley lights of Valdaora show under the cloud that hides the Dolomites tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the upper rooms look down on the Diana the Huntress Fountain and across to El Ángel under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Mexico City, so El Ángel stands out sharply from the upper floors, with the fountain directly below.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over Reforma and guests in the fitness center see the skyline through floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun warms the Torre Libertad, and from the Astor Suite both monuments sit in one golden sightline.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the bar look out from the black chairs at the lit skyscrapers of Mexico City.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds drift over Reforma this morning, but El Ángel is still clear from the upper floors.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun move across the city towers this afternoon, and swimmers in the indoor pool can watch them from the water.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the sky pink behind broken cloud, seen from the suite windows of the Torre Libertad.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the fitness center windows still show the skyline, just without shadows or much colour.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Reforma, and the Diana the Huntress Fountain directly below gets wetter than usual, watched from dry rooms upstairs.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Mexico City, and guests in the bar watch lightning over the towers behind floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Mexico City today, so El Ángel is a soft outline from the upper floors and distant towers fade.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Mexico City, but if it fell today, guests would see flakes passing the suite windows above the fountain.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing outside on Reforma, which is unusual here, while the view of El Ángel stays sharp from the upper floors.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot over Reforma this afternoon, and the indoor pool looks over the city towers from behind its floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Mexico City, and the lit towers show through the suite's floor-to-ceiling window above the fountain.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so far towers are missing from the skyline, though El Ángel still shows from the upper floors.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the lights of the Paseo de la Reforma fill the Astor Suite's window, the Angel's column in the same sightline.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open in the Astor Suite, the Reforma lights blur through rain above the Diana fountain directly below.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, the curtain in the Astor Suite stays open on the lit Reforma towers under a low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea view balconies look out on a dark bay where the moored boats are still hard to make out.
phrases.clear_morning: From the infinity pool, the Li Galli islands are sharp on the horizon this morning, with nothing in the way.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the rooftop pool, and the dark pebbles of Spiaggia Grande show clearly below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the dining terrace at The Covo, and the moored boats in the bay turn slowly on their lines.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a Junior Suite terrace tonight, you would see the lights of the boats on the dark sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the mountains behind Positano this morning, and the heated pool already has its first swimmers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the sun comes and goes on the sun loungers by the rooftop pool, which suits most guests fine.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the Li Galli islands are lit between clouds, seen from the infinity pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Tyrrhenian Sea below the terrace looks flat and pale, with the moored boats still in place.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Spiaggia Grande, and the stone arch of the dining terrace is a sheltered place to watch it from.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the bay, and guests watch the lightning from their sea view balconies rather than the pools.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water today means the Li Galli islands are faint from the infinity pool, and the beach is clearer.
phrases.snow: A few flakes drift down toward Spiaggia Grande today, an unusual sight from the arched windows of the terrace.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold, the heated pool steams a little, and the view down to Spiaggia Grande is unusually sharp.
phrases.very_hot: From the rooftop pool, heat-haze hangs over the dark pebbles of Spiaggia Grande and the moored boats below.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and guests can sit out on the sea view balconies without a jacket, facing a dark bay.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Li Galli islands cannot be seen from the pools, though Spiaggia Grande is right below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, every room already looks out on the harbor and the Pacific under a sky with no clouds.

phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun deck is bright, and guests in the saltwater pool see the Pacific without a single cloud.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the Lanai Suite's rooftop terrace, you would watch the sun drop toward the ocean west of the harbor.
phrases.clear_night: A clear night over Honolulu, and from the pool deck the city skyline is visible beside the dark harbor water.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the Pacific this morning, and the 100 Sails Restaurant serves its buffet with the harbor in view.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the sun deck this afternoon, scattered clouds sit above the sailboats in the harbor, and the Pacific stays blue beyond them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds west of the harbor turn orange above the water seen from the infinity pool.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Honolulu today, so from the king rooms the Pacific looks grey too, though the sailboats are plain to see.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the harbor, so the pool deck is quiet and more guests are at the buffet in 100 Sails Restaurant.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Pacific, nobody is in the infinity pool, and guests watch the lightning from their room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the water today, and from the pool deck the ocean beyond the harbor is a soft blur.
phrases.snow: Snow over Waikiki would be a first; if flakes fell on the sun deck, every camera at the pool would point up.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air in Honolulu is almost unknown, so on a day like this the saltwater pool has far fewer swimmers than usual.
phrases.very_hot: From the fifth-floor pool deck, heat-haze hangs over the sailboats in Ala Wai Boat Harbor and the ocean beyond.
phrases.mild_night: Warm and cloudy tonight, and the Lanai Suite's private rooftop terrace is comfortable for sitting out above the harbor.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, and the sailboats in Ala Wai Boat Harbor show from the rooms but the ocean horizon does not.
phrases.late_night: Falling asleep in a King room tonight, you could leave the curtain open on the boat lights of Ala Wai Harbor.
phrases.wet_evening: Over a last drink at 100 Sails tonight, you would see rain on the glass and boat lights in Ala Wai Harbor.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink at the room window, you would see Ala Wai Harbor lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop is empty and the Telefónica tower is still lit above a dark Gran Vía.
phrases.clear_morning: From the curved bay windows of a Gran Vía room, the ornate facades across the avenue catch the early sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the plunge pool is the busiest place on the rooftop, with the low-rise city clear in every direction.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would watch the sun drop behind Callao under the striped umbrellas.
phrases.clear_night: Diners on the rooftop terrace sit under a clear sky, with the Telefónica tower lit and the domed building lit alongside.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Gran Vía this morning, and the facades opposite the bay windows move in and out of shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Sports Bar terrace, one floor below the pool, gets sun between the clouds this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds near Callao are turning orange in the last hour of sun, seen from the upper level of the rooftop.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky the 360-degree view is still complete, only the skyline looks duller than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop, so guests have moved indoors and watch Gran Vía from the bay windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Madrid closes the rooftop for now, and lightning is visible from the Gran Vía rooms above the avenue.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the city today and the far edges of the 360-degree skyline fade, though Gran Vía below stays clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Madrid, but today flakes fall past the bay windows onto the ornate facades of Gran Vía.
phrases.very_cold: With the air close to freezing, the plunge pool has no swimmers, but the 360-degree skyline is sharp from the upper level.
phrases.very_hot: In very hot afternoon sun, the plunge pool is the only comfortable spot on the rooftop, and it is small.
phrases.mild_night: Guests sit at the rooftop bar on this warm cloudy night, with the Telefónica tower lit and no stars overhead.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop the nearest Gran Vía buildings are clear but the far skyline is not.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, the Gran Vía rooms face the avenue's lit facades through curved bay windows, enough light for a glass of water.
phrases.wet_evening: Past midnight the curtain stays open in a Gran Vía room, and the avenue's lights blur through rain on the bay window.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtains are open in the Gran Vía rooms tonight, and the avenue's facades are lit under a low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the 31st-floor lounge, M Club guests can already see the Chao Phraya bend under a dark, clear sky before sunrise.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast in the 31st-floor lounge comes with a clear view north along the river toward ICONSIAM this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the infinity pool, with city towers to one side and the Chao Phraya to the other.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the 31st-floor lounge now, you would see the low sun lighting the Chao Phraya bend.
phrases.clear_night: Yào Bar on the 33rd floor looks north along the river tonight, and ICONSIAM is lit and easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds hang over Bangkok this morning, so yoga on the rooftop terrace gets a mix of sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the skyline this afternoon, seen from the cabanas by the pool on the eighteenth floor.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun comes through gaps in the cloud, and from Yào Bar the river bend toward ICONSIAM is partly lit.
phrases.overcast: From the 33rd-floor Yào Bar, the Chao Phraya River bends north under a low grey sky toward ICONSIAM.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling over the Chao Phraya, and most guests are watching it from the four-poster beds rather than the pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the thirty-third-floor Yào Bar, lightning over the river bend lights up ICONSIAM and the wet Chao Phraya.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the river today, so from the 31st-floor lounge ICONSIAM is a faint outline rather than a clear shape.
phrases.snow: Snow over Bangkok would be a first, and the eighteenth-floor pool cabanas would be the strangest place to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in coats beside the empty 18th-floor pool cabanas look down on the Chao Phraya in hard daytime light.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Bangkok, and the pool on the eighteenth floor offers cool water with river views.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, but the air is mild and the lounge seats at Yào Bar have the city lights below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means Yào Bar on the 33rd floor shows the nearby river bend but not ICONSIAM further north.
phrases.late_night: Anyone falling asleep in a room facing the Chao Phraya tonight has left the curtain open to the lights along the bend.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has an M Club room tonight can watch rain pass over the Chao Phraya, its lights soft on wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in an M Club room after midnight watches low cloud pass over the lit Chao Phraya River corridor.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the billboards of Times Square are still lit, and the Premier room windows show them without any daylight competition.
phrases.clear_morning: Daylight makes the neon look smaller, and the Premier room windows high above the square show billboards under a blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the Premier rooms look straight down into Times Square, its billboards bright against the sunlit glass.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the rooftop terrace, the horizon turns orange-red behind the Manhattan skyline, and the Times Square signs start to look brighter.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear, which hardly matters here, because the Times Square neon lights the sheer curtains of every Premier room.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the Midtown skyscrapers this morning, seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suite living rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun take turns over Times Square this afternoon, and the balcony suites get both versions from the same spot.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on The Terrace and Outdoor Gardens, you would see clouds colored by the last hour of sun over Manhattan.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Times Square's billboards supply all the color, and the Premier rooms lose nothing of the view.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Times Square, and guests in the Premier rooms watch the neon through wet windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Midtown shows the skyscrapers for a second at a time from the suite windows, while the outdoor terrace stays empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the upper Midtown skyscrapers today, but the Times Square signs are close enough to the lower rooms to stay readable.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the 14th to 40th floor windows onto Times Square, and the neon colors it on the way down.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air sits over Times Square today, so the rooftop terrace is mostly for looking at through glass, not sitting on.
phrases.very_hot: In very hot weather the Premier rooms show the whole of Times Square from behind closed windows, no pavement needed.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the candlelit terrace is in use, with lounge seating turned toward the lit Manhattan skyscrapers.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the far Midtown skyscrapers are missing from the suite windows, while Times Square below stays clear.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours, every light in a Times Square suite is off, and the square's billboards give the only glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Premier room windows after midnight, and the Times Square billboards blur into soft colour on the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight the cloud over Times Square turns red and blue from the billboard screens, seen from the Premier rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lake outside the suite windows is dark and still, and Mont Blanc is not yet lit.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Suite Mont Blanc balcony, the summit is sharp this morning across the whole width of the lake.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the lake is bright blue under the arched suite windows, and L'Atelier Robuchon has the same view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun is now on Mont Blanc, and guests on the wrought-iron balconies are watching the summit slowly change colour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would stand on a suite balcony with the dark lake below and a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are moving over the lake this morning, so Mont Blanc comes and goes from the suite windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the lakeside terrace of the restaurant gets sun between clouds, and the wooded hills across the water stay visible.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, cloud hides part of Mont Blanc, but the lake below the balconies is still bright.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Geneva today, Mont Blanc is out of sight, and the marble fireplaces in the suites get more use.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the lake, so the 21-metre indoor pool at the Guerlain Spa is busier than the balconies.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the suite windows show lightning over Lake Geneva, and the French doors to the balconies stay closed.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the lake today, and from the Suite Mont Blanc balcony the mountain cannot be seen at all.
phrases.snow: Snow covers the wrought-iron balconies right now, and the lake outside the suite windows looks grey and very cold.
phrases.very_cold: With the air close to freezing, the balconies are empty, and guests watch Mont Blanc from behind the large windows instead.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day in Geneva, the lakeside terrace is bright and quiet, and the indoor pool is the popular choice.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, guests sit out on the wrought-iron balconies with a glass of wine, facing the dark lake.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the suite windows show the marina and near lake water, but not Mont Blanc.
phrases.late_night: Dinner at L'Atelier Robuchon over, the Suite Mont Blanc windows show the shore lights of Lake Geneva on the water after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Suite Mont Blanc windows tonight, and the shore lights across Lake Geneva blur on the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Lake Geneva after midnight, and the shore lights across the water show from the Suite Mont Blanc windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the fairways of TPC Las Colinas are still dark grey from the villa balconies, and Lake Carolyn is flat.
phrases.clear_morning: From the guest room's arched window, the opened plantation shutters show a green golf course under a clear Texas sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is on the resort pool, and the cabanas offer the only shade by the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light crosses the TPC fairways, and from the villa balconies Lake Carolyn looks golden rather than blue.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a villa suite tonight, you would see a clear sky over Lake Carolyn with the fireplace lit inside.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the low suburban skyline this morning, seen through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suite living area.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the outdoor daybed under the steel pergola, cloud shadows and sun patches alternate across the golf course this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud is lit by the last sun over the tree-lined suburban skyline, which guests can watch from the balconies.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the TPC fairways look a darker green from the guest rooms, and Lake Carolyn looks grey too.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the two golf courses, so the tennis courts are empty and the spa is the busier choice.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the rolling Texas landscape is best watched from inside a villa suite, behind the closed balcony door.
