phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over Lake Carolyn today, and from the villa balconies only the nearest part of the fairway is clear.
phrases.snow: Snow in Irving is rare, but today it is settling on the TPC fairways while the villa suite fireplaces are lit.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing on the TPC fairways today, which explains why so few golfers are out on the two courses.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot across the 400 acres today, so the resort pool and its cabanas are busier than the golf course.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the air is mild enough that guests are out on the villa balconies above Lake Carolyn.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the near fairways show from the balconies, but the low suburban skyline cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the villa suites have turned off every light, and the skyline lights across Lake Carolyn are the room's only glow.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the villa suites are likely asleep by now, rain on the windows blurring the lights across Lake Carolyn.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a villa suite after midnight can see the lake and the low suburban skyline lights under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Baie des Anges is still dark through the floor-to-ceiling windows, with a clear sky getting lighter over the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Junior Suite Sea View Terrace, the sun is on the water and the palm trees along the Promenade des Anglais.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Mediterranean looks turquoise from the rooftop pool, and the white umbrellas are the only shade up there.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the tenth-floor rooftop, the late sun reaches the whole curve of coast while Elaio's dinner tables face the sea.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a sea-view room tonight, you would see a clear sky and a dark Baie des Anges.
phrases.partly_morning: Some cloud over the bay this morning, and from the balconies the sea changes colour as the sun comes and goes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the rooftop pool has sun between the clouds, and the bar stools up there face the open sea.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun puts orange light under the clouds, seen from the sea-facing terraces with the Promenade des Anglais below.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Baie des Anges is grey too, but the floor-to-ceiling windows still show the whole bay.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Promenade des Anglais today, and from a sea-facing room the bay is visible through wet floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Baie des Anges, and the sea-facing suites give a view of the lightning from behind glass doors.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits on the water today, so the far end of the coast is hard to see from the balconies.
phrases.snow: Snow over Nice is rare, but today it falls on the Promenade des Anglais palms while the rooftop pool stays heated.
phrases.very_cold: The rooftop pool is heated even on this very cold day, and steam rises off the water in front of the coast.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the Promenade des Anglais, and the private beach section across the road is the quickest way into the sea.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild with clouds over the Baie des Anges, and guests on the sea-facing terraces are sitting out late.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the tenth-floor view stops short: the sea in front is visible, but the ends of the coast arc are not.
phrases.late_night: Midnight, a glass of water at the Junior Suite windows, and the Promenade lights show the curve of the Bay of Angels.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner at Elaio, rain covers the suite's floor-to-ceiling glass, and the Promenade lights blur toward the Bay of Angels.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Elaio, the Promenade lights curve along the Bay of Angels under low cloud, seen from the sea view suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Burj Khalifa stands dark and sharp outside every balcony, and the three pools are still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From the infinity pool, early swimmers see the Downtown and DIFC skyline with the Emirates Towers lit by low sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong around the pool, and guests move their lounge seats under the trees facing the tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the glass of the Burj Khalifa orange, seen from the wicker chairs on the balconies.
phrases.clear_night: At night the fountain basin lights up below the balconies, and the tower is lit from base to tip.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass behind the Burj Khalifa this morning, while the first swimmers test the pool water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds give short breaks of shade over the three pools this afternoon, and the tower stays fully in view.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on a balcony now, you would see the last sun colour the clouds behind the Downtown skyscrapers.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Downtown today, so the Burj Khalifa looks flat and silver from the suite windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Dubai, so guests watch the wet balcony chairs and the tower through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Downtown, and the pools are empty, so the lightning near the Burj Khalifa is watched from indoors.
phrases.fog_haze: Morning haze hides the upper part of the Burj Khalifa, and only its lower floors are clear from the pool.
phrases.snow: Snow over the Burj Khalifa almost never happens, but if it did, the pool loungers would be the place to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air today, so the pools are quiet and guests on the balconies keep jackets on facing the tower.
phrases.very_hot: Heat is extreme today, so most guests stay in the pools, with the Burj Khalifa rising directly in front of them.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy sky tonight, the air on the balconies is warm and the fountain basin is lit below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balcony the metro viaduct and boulevard are clear but the far DIFC towers are not.
phrases.late_night: The lights are off in the suite now, and the only light inside comes from Downtown around the Burj Khalifa's outline.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the guest rooms tonight, and the Burj Khalifa is a blurred shape among the wet Downtown towers.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud covers the top of the Burj Khalifa, while Downtown lights show below it from the guest rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Colosseum is a dark shape in the window of every room that faces it.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the rooftop comes with the Colosseum and the Ludus Magnus in full morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Colosseum sits in strong sunlight, clearly visible from the bathroom window as from the four-poster bed.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: As the sun goes down, the tall suite windows show the Colosseum and the streets below in orange evening light.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the Colosseum under a clear night sky from a table at Aroma.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Colosseum this morning, so the light on the rooftop breakfast tables comes and goes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Colosseum goes in and out of shadow as clouds move across Rome, easy to follow from the terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Colosseum catch some colour, seen from the suite windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky the Colosseum still shows clearly from the open window beside the four-poster bed.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Colosseum and the Ludus Magnus, and the glass walls of Aroma keep the rooftop tables dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Colosseum is best watched from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of a suite, not from the terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the outline of the Colosseum this morning, though it is only steps away across Via Labicana.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Rome, but today it falls on the Colosseum while guests watch from the warm rooftop restaurant.
phrases.very_cold: If you were at the front window now, you would see hard winter light on the Colosseum across Via Labicana.
phrases.very_hot: From the rooftop at Aroma, the Colosseum's arches shimmer in the midday heat-haze above Via Labicana.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Rome, and the Colosseum stays in view from the open windows of the rooms facing it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, but the Colosseum is close enough to see clearly; further parts of Rome are not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, sleep comes easy in the rooms opposite the Colosseum, its round arches directly across the street to see at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain streaks the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suite, and the curved wall of the Colosseum looks wet directly opposite.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, haze drifts over the Colosseum, and its curved outline shows against the city lights from the Penthouse Suite windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the KL Tower is already outlined against a clear sky from the Horizon Club Executive Rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: From the curved bay windows, the tree canopy and the city skyline look sharp in this morning's clear light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands high over the outdoor pool, and the skyline around it has almost no shadow.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The late sun gives the KL Tower a warm colour, easy to see from the Malaysian Suite windows right now.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the KL Tower lit up against a clear sky from the Horizon Club.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the city this morning, but the KL Tower is still clear from the tower-facing rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the outdoor pool this afternoon, so swimmers get a few minutes of shade between sunny spells.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds change the light on the skyline seen from the Malaysian Suite.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Kuala Lumpur today, and the KL Tower looks flat and pale from the Horizon Club windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the tree canopy outside the king rooms, and the outdoor pool is empty for now.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes near the KL Tower during this storm, watched by guests from the Horizon Club rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Kuala Lumpur today, so the KL Tower is only a faint shape from the upper rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow in Kuala Lumpur would be a first, but if it fell, the view of the KL Tower would turn white.
phrases.very_cold: A freezing day is almost unknown here, but the Health Club and spa are indoors, away from any cold wind.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot outside, and the outdoor pool, ringed by the skyline, is the busiest place in the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: On this warm, cloudy night, the KL Tower lights show clearly from the Malaysian Suite, with no stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Horizon Club rooms the KL Tower is dim and the far skyline is missing.
phrases.late_night: In the Horizon Club rooms the curtain is left open for sleep, and the KL Tower's thin top shows among the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open before bed, rain blurs the Malaysian Suite window and the KL Tower's spire above the wet city lights.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open in a Horizon Club room after midnight, the city lights show under cloud around the KL Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests in tower rooms can already see the outline of Sydney Harbour under a clear, dark sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the sandstone clock tower, and heritage-wing rooms frame it sharply against a blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: From the twin-bed rooms, the floor-to-ceiling windows show the CBD skyline under a bright, cloudless Sydney midday.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a tower room now, you would see the late sun on Sydney Harbour and the skyline.
phrases.clear_night: At night, tower-room guests see the lit skyline and Sydney Harbour under a clear sky, with cocktails available in the Club Lounge.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Sydney Harbour this morning, and tower rooms get a changing mix of sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon tea is served beneath the arches while scattered clouds move across the skyline outside the tower windows.
phrases.partly_golden: The sandstone clock tower is lit by the last sun between clouds, visible from heritage-wing rooms and the suite bathtub.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Sydney today, and the harbour seen from the tower rooms has lost most of its colour.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Martin Place, and the covered glass-roof walkway lets guests cross to the arched doorway without getting wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Sydney Harbour is visible from the tower rooms, and the heritage tour of the telegraph rooms carries on indoors.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far side of Sydney Harbour today, so tower-room guests see mainly the nearer skyline towers.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Sydney, but if it fell, guests would watch it through the tall windows beside the black marble fireplace.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold Sydney day, the air outside is close to freezing, but the harbour view from tower rooms stays sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Sydney is very hot today, and the sun on the harbour and skyline is strong when seen from the tower rooms.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Sydney, and the sandstone clock tower is lit, visible from the heritage-wing windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the tower rooms the far parts of Sydney Harbour are not visible, only the nearer buildings.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight in a tower room, a glass of water stands on the bedside and Sydney Harbour shows its lights through the window.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the tower-room glass after midnight, and the harbour lights blur and sharpen as each shower passes.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Sydney Harbour after midnight, and the tower rooms look out on the lit skyline under the grey.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific-facing balconies look onto a dark boardwalk and a dark ocean, with the palm trees just visible.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is served at Barlo Kitchen, and from the room windows the boardwalk and the Pacific are clear under a blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Under the cream umbrellas of the rooftop herb garden, the midday sun is strong and the ocean looks very bright.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The yellow chairs on the balconies face west, so the last hours of sun fall straight onto them and onto the Pacific.
phrases.clear_night: At night the rooftop bar Kassi Venice Beach looks over a dark Pacific, and the stars are visible above the water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the ocean this morning, and from the loft suite windows the beach is already in sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Pacific this afternoon, and the rattan seats on the rooftop terrace are mostly in sun.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop terrace, the sun goes down behind broken clouds over the Pacific, and the beach is half in shadow.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky today, so the coastal range is not visible from the roof, but the boardwalk and the ocean are.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Venice Beach, and the market umbrellas on the rooftop terrace are not much help, so guests sit inside.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Pacific is rare here, and the floor-to-ceiling windows give a wide view of the lightning out at sea.
phrases.fog_haze: Marine fog sits on the beach today, and from the balconies only the nearest palm trees can be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow on Venice Beach is very rare, but if it did fall, the loft suite windows would show a white boardwalk.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing is unusual for Santa Monica, so the rooftop terrace seats stay empty while the ocean view is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today on the roof, and the cream umbrellas over the herb garden give shade and still an ocean view.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night the Kassi Venice Beach rooftop seats are in use, and the Pacific is dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop the coastal range cannot be seen and the far ocean is not clear.
phrases.late_night: Once the room goes dark, the only light left comes through the floor-to-ceiling window, from the boardwalk along the Pacific.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Kassi, rain runs down the room's floor-to-ceiling window and the boardwalk lights blur toward the Pacific.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Kassi, the floor-to-ceiling window shows the boardwalk lights and low cloud over the Pacific tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the terrace is empty and the rooftops of Florence are only dark shapes below the hills.
phrases.clear_morning: From the suite sitting room, the telescope points at a sharp view of cypress trees and the Florentine hills.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear sky, guests on white lounge chairs around the heated pool have the whole of Florence below them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Towards sunset, the stone terrace is in warm light, the dinner table laid, and Florence's rooftops below turn orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at La Loggia tonight, you would see the lights of Florence spread across the valley.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Chianti hills this morning, and the wisteria facade stands in sun for a few minutes at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the rooftops of Florence this afternoon, watched from the lounge chairs beside the heated pool.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the Tuscan hills are lit from below, seen from the stone terrace.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Florence today, and the wooded Fiesole hillside outside the guest room arched windows looks flat and dull.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the stone terrace and the terracotta urns, and the Chianti hills show only as a grey line.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, lightning over the Florentine hills shows through the arched window of the suite sitting room.
phrases.fog_haze: From the stone terrace, haze hides the Florence rooftops below and only the near cypress trees show clearly.
phrases.snow: Snow on the terracotta roof is rare here, and steam rises from the heated pool while the hills turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it is close to freezing today, and the garden beyond the marble bathroom's porthole window is white with frost.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the umbrellas by the pool are in demand, and few guests take the shuttle down to Florence.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild cloudy night in Fiesole, dinner continues at La Loggia, and the lights of Florence show under the cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests on the stone terrace this afternoon see the near Fiesole hillside and a few rooftops, but not the Chianti hills.
phrases.late_night: Florence is lights in the valley below Villa San Michele tonight, and dawn will bring back the Chianti hills.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the arched window of the suite sitting room tonight, and the lights of Florence blur in the valley below.
phrases.grey_evening: From the arched suite window, the lights of Florence spread across the valley under tonight's low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the floor-to-ceiling windows show the Yarra River still dark and a few office lights on in the skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: From the upper floors this morning, the view reaches clear across the city and south to Port Phillip Bay.
phrases.clear_midday: Sun on the heated outdoor pool at midday, and Eureka Tower is sharply visible against a blue sky from the rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a Premier Club Suite now, you would watch the sun set behind the Melbourne skyline from the window.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the skyline is fully lit, and from the guest rooms the lights reflect on the calm Yarra River below.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the CBD this morning, so the high-floor suites get sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Broken cloud over Australia 108 this afternoon, while guests in the heated outdoor pool get sun between the gaps.
phrases.partly_golden: Scattered clouds are coloured by the last sun above the skyline, and the Premier Club Suite windows face straight at it.
phrases.overcast: Thick cloud covers Melbourne today, and Australia 108 seen from the suite windows is a dark shape with no sun on it.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the skyline behind the drops looks blurred but is still there.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Port Phillip Bay shows from the highest floors, and most guests are watching it from behind the glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the city today, so Eureka Tower is only a grey outline from the suites and the bay is hidden.
phrases.snow: Snow is extremely rare in Melbourne, but today some flakes fall past the floor-to-ceiling windows toward the Yarra River.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside today, so the heated outdoor pool has steam over it and few swimmers.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot across Melbourne today, and the heated outdoor pool is the one place guests want to be, heating or not.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the skyline is lit as usual from the rooms, but Port Phillip Bay is only darkness.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the view from the rooms stops short, with the nearest CBD towers clear but Port Phillip Bay out of sight.
phrases.late_night: In the Premier Club Suite the curtain is left open tonight, and the city lights reflect on the Yarra until sleep comes.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Premier Club Suite's floor-to-ceiling glass after midnight, and the city lights blur over the Yarra below.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud passes over the skyline, and the city lights show through the haze from the Premier Club Suite's windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Early risers in the Prestige Eiffel room already see the Eiffel Tower, unlit, against a clear sky that is not yet light.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the balcony comes with croissants, orange juice and the Eiffel Tower above the rooftops under blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the suite living room is bright, its floor-to-ceiling windows showing the Eiffel Tower and Paris rooftops in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: On the rooftop terrace, guests on lounge chairs watch the Eiffel Tower in the low sunlight, champagne in hand.
phrases.clear_night: From the Prestige Eiffel balcony, the Eiffel Tower rises above the Paris rooftops under a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Haussmann rooftops this morning, and the balcony breakfast table gets sun between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Eiffel Tower moves in and out of shadow as clouds cross, seen from the suite's large windows.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the rooftop terrace while some clouds sit behind the Eiffel Tower, a good hour for champagne.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Eiffel Tower is still clearly visible from the Apartment Eiffel dining room, just without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Paris today, so the indoor pool under its skylights is busier than the rooftop terrace.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were on the Prestige Eiffel balcony now, you would see lightning flash behind the Eiffel Tower over wet Paris rooftops.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over Paris today means the Eiffel Tower is only a faint shape from the balcony, or hidden completely.
phrases.snow: A snowfall in Paris puts white on the Haussmann rooftops, and the suite windows frame a grey Eiffel Tower behind the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold, clear air over Paris today, and the Eiffel Tower stands sharp above the rooftops from the Prestige Eiffel balcony.
phrases.very_hot: Paris is very hot today, and the rooftop terrace lounge chairs sit in full sun facing the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Paris, and the lit Eiffel Tower is the brightest thing seen from the Apartment Eiffel.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Paris, so the nearby rooftops are clear from the balcony but the Eiffel Tower is hard to see.
phrases.late_night: Sleep suits the Prestige Eiffel room after midnight; the city lights glow outside, and at dawn the windows frame the Eiffel Tower.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Prestige Eiffel room's windows after midnight, and the Eiffel Tower's outline shows through it above wet rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud passes the Eiffel Tower tonight in the Prestige Eiffel windows, and the rooftop lights of Paris glow under it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, under a clear sky, Edinburgh Castle is lit on its rock across Princes Street from the Castle View rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: In the sitting room, morning sun lights the castle walls and the tree-lined gardens below the windows.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the whole castle and its rocky hill are sharp from the Executive King Castle View rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches the castle from the west, and guests taking afternoon tea watch it from the large windows.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the castle is lit up, and the porthole window by the desk frames it against a clear dark sky.
phrases.partly_morning: From The Wallace windows this morning, patches of sun move across the castle walls as broken cloud drifts over Edinburgh.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in a Castle View room this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows crossing the castle rock between sunny spells.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the castle stone orange between clouds, in full view from the Archibald Menzies Suite.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Edinburgh today, and the castle looks flat and dark from the afternoon tea room windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Princes Street, and guests at dinner in The Wallace see the castle through wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the castle on its rock appears briefly in each lightning flash, watched from the sitting room's tartan sofa.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs over the gardens today, and only the upper parts of the castle show from the Castle View rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the castle roofs and the gardens below, seen from the Isobel Wylie Hutchinson Suite windows.
phrases.very_cold: It is bitterly cold outside today, and the castle stands very clear against a pale sky, seen from The Wallace dining room.
phrases.very_hot: On this rare very hot Edinburgh day, the castle and its rock sit in strong sun, viewed from the sitting room.
phrases.mild_night: This mild cloudy night, the floodlit castle is the main thing visible from the beds in the Castle View rooms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the castle is still visible from The Wallace, but the detail of its walls is lost.
phrases.late_night: Guests back from dinner at The Wallace are probably asleep now, the castle outline across Princes Street from their beds.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Castle View rooms are closing the curtains now, rain on the glass and the castle shape across Princes Street.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a Castle View room tonight can see low cloud over the castle's outline and the Princes Street lights before bed.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific is dark grey from the balconies, and the fire pits along the cliff walkway are not lit yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Sliding glass doors are open in the ocean-view rooms, and the water below Shell Beach is bright blue under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the heated pool and hot tub face a flat, sunlit Pacific, with the coastal hills clear in the distance.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on an upper-floor balcony now, you would see the sun dropping toward the Pacific with nothing in the way.
phrases.clear_night: The fire pits at the cliff's edge are lit, and guests in the metal chairs hear the surf below.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the Pacific this morning, and from the restaurant view table the water changes color as they move.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud alternate over Shell Beach this afternoon, and the lounge chairs on the cliff walkway are mostly taken.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the Pacific turn orange above the fire pits and the red flowering shrubs.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the ocean today, so the Pacific from the balconies is grey too, with the coastal hills still visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the bluff, and guests watch the wet Pacific through the sliding glass doors instead of from the balcony.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning is out over the Pacific, the fire pits stay unlit, and guests watch the storm from inside the restaurant.
phrases.fog_haze: Coastal fog covers the water today, so the ocean-view balconies look out at white where the Pacific normally is.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Pismo Beach, but today a few flakes fall past the palm tree outside the sliding glass doors.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day the outdoor hot tub facing the water is the warmest place to watch the Pacific.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the bluff today, and most guests are in the pool rather than beside the fire pits.
phrases.mild_night: This mild cloudy night, the fire pits on the cliff walkway are lit and the metal chairs around them are taken.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balconies the water just below is clear but the coastal hills and horizon are not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the white surf under the moon is easy to watch for a long while from the upper-floor ocean-view rooms.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at the Spyglass Inn Restaurant is over, and after midnight rain runs down the sliding glass doors above the surf.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at the Spyglass Inn Restaurant, haze hides the horizon and the Pacific surf sounds below the upper-floor rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Club Room balconies look out on a dark Atlantic with no clouds above it.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at the Ocean Restaurant comes with a clear sky over the Atlantic and a calm sea this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Around noon, the loungers beside the curved pool are the sunniest place in the resort, with the sea just past the palms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a Club Suite balcony now, you would watch the sun drop low over the open Atlantic.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the sea is clear, and the palm trees stand as dark shapes below the balconies.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the Atlantic this morning, so the sunlight on the pool comes and goes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the beach this afternoon, and the MarClub adults-only area gets sun between them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day passes between clouds, lighting the palms around the pool before it sets.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic looks flat and pale from the room balconies, with no shadows on the sand.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the curved pool and the loungers today, while guests in the sauna and Turkish bath stay warm inside.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder and lightning over the Atlantic right now, best watched from behind the tall glass doors of a Club Room.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of the Atlantic today, and from the balconies only the nearest palm trees are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches the Algarve, yet today white flakes fall on the palms and the empty loungers.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day like this, the ice fountain in the spa is the one thing guests skip.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the beach today, and most guests move between the pool, the jacuzzi and the shaded balconies.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night covers the resort, and the balconies of the Club Rooms are comfortable with the doors open.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the ocean horizon cannot be seen from the balconies, though the beach and pool are clear.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water at a Club Room's sliding doors, and the pool shows pale beyond the palms.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the Club Room glass after midnight, the curtains open to the Atlantic.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the Algarve sky tonight, and from the Club Rooms the pool reflects the resort lights before sleep.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over Ornos Bay is still dark, and a guest in a bathrobe stands at a private pool edge.
phrases.clear_morning: From the suite terraces, Delos is clearly visible across the bay this morning, with a few boats at anchor below.
phrases.clear_midday: Bright midday sun falls on the white villas and the narrow private pools, where swimming is the sensible option.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light reaches the sun loungers under their white umbrellas, and the fire pit at Aloni is not lit yet.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see a clear sky over Ornos Bay from the edge of your private pool.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the green hillside this morning while guests have breakfast at Pere Ubu facing the Aegean.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the bay this afternoon, and the anchored boats below the stone spa terrace barely move.
phrases.partly_golden: At the Aloni Sunset Lounge, the fire pit is lit, and broken cloud sits above Delos as the sun drops.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky hangs over Ornos Bay today, so the private pools look darker than in the brochure photos.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the gravel rooftops and the bay, and guests watch it from behind the closed glass doors of their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Aegean is visible from the guest rooms, and the terrace sun loungers are empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the bay today, so Delos is only a faint shape from the pool terraces, if it shows at all.
phrases.snow: Snow on Mykonos is rare, but today a few flakes fall on the villa rooftops while the bay stays grey below.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold on the island today, so the sun loungers stay empty and guests watch the bay through glass.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the private infinity pool is the only reasonable place to look at Delos from.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy above Ornos Bay, and dinner at Pere Ubu continues with the dark Aegean in view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so Delos cannot be seen from the pools, only the nearer boats in Ornos Bay.
phrases.late_night: Only a few boat lights show on Ornos Bay after midnight, so sleep loses nothing; at dawn the glass doors frame Delos.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Pere Ubu, rain runs down the suite's glass doors and the boat lights on Ornos Bay show through it.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Pere Ubu, the suite doors frame a few boat lights on Ornos Bay under the cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lit observation deck of Kyoto Tower is the brightest thing in a Tower View window.
phrases.clear_morning: This morning the low rooftops between the station and the five mountain ridges look sharp from the upper-floor windows.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Yasaka Pagoda stands far off among the Higashiyama rooftops beyond Kyoto Tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The hotel recommends being back in a Tower View room before sunset; today's thirty-minute twilight over the tower looks unobstructed.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, Kyoto Tower would stand lit and white from the Sky Lounge Southern Court on the 15th floor.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are passing over the five mountains this morning, while Kyoto Tower across the station forecourt stays in full view.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of shade move across the plain of low rooftops below the upper-floor windows this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud behind Kyoto Tower gives the Tower View rooms a changing twilight sky.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Kyoto Tower still stands clear across the station, though the ridgelines behind it look flat and dull.
phrases.rain: Rain is streaking the expanded windows of the Tower View rooms, and the white tower across the station looks slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests in the Sky Lounge Southern Court can watch lightning over the low rooftops of Kyoto.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the Higashiyama mountains today, so the Yasaka Pagoda is not legible and only Kyoto Tower stays distinct.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the low rooftops of Kyoto this hour, with Kyoto Tower showing white against a white sky.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day over Kyoto, and the air is clear enough that the mountain ridgelines behind the tower look unusually sharp.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the city below the 15th-floor Granvia Lounge sits under a bright, washed-out sky, Kyoto Tower included.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and from the bathroom tub window the lit deck of Kyoto Tower is the main thing to see.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today: Kyoto Tower across the station is clear, but the Yasaka Pagoda and the far mountains are not showing.
phrases.late_night: A midnight glass of water, and the Tower View window holds Kyoto Tower above the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open after midnight, rain on the Tower View window blurs the city lights around Kyoto Tower's white shaft.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hangs over the city lights after midnight, and Kyoto Tower's white shaft fills the Tower View window before bed.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the West Bay towers are still lit against a dark sky when seen from the room window seats.
phrases.clear_morning: From the floor-to-ceiling windows, the morning sun shows the bay water blue and the skyline sharp across it.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over Doha, and the West Bay towers stand very clear from the upper rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the West Bay skyline, and the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows frame the water in warm colour.
phrases.clear_night: On the Sora terrace tonight, guests sit at set tables with the lit West Bay skyline across the Gulf.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the West Bay towers this morning, visible from the window seats in the rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun alternate over Doha Bay this afternoon, and the water near the skyline changes between grey and blue.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the Sora terrace now, you would see the last sun colouring broken clouds above the West Bay towers.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the whole sky over Doha, and the West Bay towers look flat and pale from the 21st floor.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Doha, so guests at the restaurant windows watch it fall on the bay with some interest.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Gulf lights up the West Bay towers for a second, best watched from inside the rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Doha today, and from the window seats the West Bay towers appear as soft grey shapes.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Doha, but if it fell, the room windows would show it falling over the West Bay towers.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day is unusual here, and the Sora terrace tables mostly stand empty while the skyline stays sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot sun over Doha leaves the Sora terrace tables empty, and the bay water shows a hard bright blue.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy sky tonight, the covered terrace lanterns are lit and the West Bay skyline shines across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Doha today, so the West Bay towers are hard to see clearly from the 21st floor.
phrases.late_night: With the curtain left open on purpose, the lit towers of West Bay fill the floor-to-ceiling window until sleep comes.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtains are open after midnight, and the lights of the West Bay skyline blur through rain on the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.grey_evening: A curtain left open after midnight shows the West Bay skyline lights across the water under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Downtown skyline north of the 26th floor still shows its lights against a dark clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the suite corner windows, the San Gabriel Mountains to the east are sharp in the clear morning air.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop pool on the 26th floor is in full sun, with city rooftops spread out below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun from the west lights the Downtown towers to the north, seen through the dining room windows.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the jacuzzi tonight, you would see the skyline lit up under a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Hollywood Hills this morning, visible in the distance from the upper suites.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, patches of shade move across the city rooftops below the fitness center treadmills on the 26th floor.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop bar, the setting sun colours the patchy clouds pink and orange over the Downtown towers to the north.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the San Gabriel Mountains to the east are faint, but the Downtown towers remain clear.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the dining room, and the city rooftops below look dark and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Downtown skyline is visible from the 26th floor spa, a rare sight in Los Angeles.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the San Gabriel Mountains today, and from the rooftop pool only the nearest Downtown towers can be made out.
phrases.snow: Downtown Los Angeles almost never sees snow, but if it fell, the area around the rooftop pool would be white.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the heated jacuzzi on the 26th floor has sharp mountain views to the east.
phrases.very_hot: With very hot air over Los Angeles, the rooftop pool on the 26th floor is the busiest spot in the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky on this mild night, and the rooftop bar's pendant lights are on above the skyline view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the San Gabriel Mountains to the east cannot be seen from the suites, only the nearer towers.
phrases.late_night: Up late in a corner suite, you could watch the Downtown skyline lights for hours.
phrases.wet_evening: With a last drink at the rooftop bar tonight, you would see the Downtown lights through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink at the rooftop bar tonight, you would see Downtown's lights to the north under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before the sun comes up, the Twin Towers' lights are the brightest thing in the view from the EWOW suite.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Spectacular Twin Towers room, the towers stand in full morning sunlight, with nothing between the window glass and the steel.
phrases.clear_midday: If you were at the rooftop pool now, you would see the Petronas Twin Towers sharp against a clear midday sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last sun of the day, the Twin Towers turn gold on one side, seen through the bar lounge windows.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the towers are fully lit, and the rooftop pool glows purple as guests swim facing them.
phrases.partly_morning: From the rooftop lap pool, the Petronas Twin Towers stand against a morning sky of broken white cloud.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud move over Kuala Lumpur, and from the EWOW suite the towers pass in and out of shade.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see broken clouds turn orange around the Twin Towers.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the city today, and the Twin Towers look silver rather than bright from the suite windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop lap pool, so most guests have moved inside to the bar lounge and its view.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning appears behind the Twin Towers every few minutes, seen from the bar lounge windows while the storm passes over Kuala Lumpur.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the city today, and from the Spectacular Twin Towers rooms the towers are only a soft grey outline.
phrases.snow: Snow in Kuala Lumpur would be a first; if it happened, the EWOW suite's windows would be the place to check.
phrases.very_cold: A freezing day in Kuala Lumpur is almost unheard of, but the Twin Towers would look the same from the suite.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot outside, and guests in the rooftop lap pool stay in the water longer than usual, facing the towers.
phrases.mild_night: Late tonight under a cloudy sky, guests by the rooftop pool look out at the lit Petronas Twin Towers.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; the Twin Towers are still visible from the pool, but the far skyline behind them is not.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the two spires show in a Spectacular Twin Towers room window among the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the Spectacular Twin Towers rooms after midnight, and the two towers blur through the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud passes over the Twin Towers, and the city lights show beneath it from the EWOW suite.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the bay window seating area looks out on a dark promenade and a pale, calm sea.
phrases.clear_morning: From a sea-view room, the whole bay is in plain sight this morning, with the pier clear at one side.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the bay window frames the promenade, the beach twenty metres away and the pier under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low afternoon sun reaches the wicker seating on the terrace, and the pier stands sharp against a bright bay.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the uplights are on the stone facade, and from the sea-view rooms the bay is dark and quiet.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Llandudno Bay this morning, so the sea seen from the bay window changes colour every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were there this afternoon, you would watch cloud shadows move across the bay from a sea-view room window.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud sits over the pier, and the terrace parasols are still up.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the bay today, and the pier is visible but flat-looking from the bay window seating area.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the promenade, the terrace chairs are empty, and guests watch the wet beach from the sea-view rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Llandudno Bay, and the driest seat for watching lightning past the pier is the bay window inside.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs over the bay today, and from the sea-view rooms the pier is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the promenade, a rare sight in Llandudno, and the terrace balustrade has a thin white line on top.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold, clear day the beach is nearly empty, and most guests watch the bay from inside the window seating.
phrases.very_hot: From the bay window, heat-haze blurs the pier and the beach along Llandudno Bay this afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night the purple terrace lighting is on and the live evening entertainment is under way inside.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility over the bay today means the far shore is not clear, though the pier is still visible nearby.
phrases.late_night: If you had a sea-view room tonight, you would be asleep now, the promenade lights on the bay until first light.
phrases.wet_evening: Over a last drink in a sea-view room tonight, you would see the promenade lights blurred by rain along the bay.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in a sea-view room tonight, you would see the promenade lights along the bay under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the piano nobile balcony looks across dark Bairro Alto rooftops to São Jorge Castle, still lit against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Signature Rooms, the morning sun lights São Jorge Castle clearly above the rooftops of Bairro Alto.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, guests in the Federico Restaurant eat beneath the glass ceiling while the courtyard fills with light.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Warm afternoon light enters the tall windows of the suites, and the rooftops toward the castle turn orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the balcony tonight, you would see São Jorge Castle lit above the dark rooftops of Bairro Alto.
phrases.partly_morning: This morning's scattered clouds leave São Jorge Castle visible above the rooftops when guests step onto the main balcony.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the castle hill this afternoon, so the view from the Signature Rooms changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky behind São Jorge Castle, seen from the main balcony.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the brick chimney tower and Lisbon rooftops look flat from the open casement windows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftops of Bairro Alto, while guests in the Federico Restaurant stay dry under the glass ceiling.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Lisbon, and lightning briefly shows the castle hill through the Signature Rooms' windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of São Jorge Castle today, and from the balcony only the nearest Bairro Alto rooftops are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Lisbon, but if it fell today, guests would watch it from the attic bathroom tub with rooftop views.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold clear day, the balcony view of São Jorge Castle is sharp, though few guests stand outside for long.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Bairro Alto, and the Signature Rooms' balcony gets little use before evening.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and guests on the piano nobile balcony look toward São Jorge Castle's lights without needing a coat.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so São Jorge Castle is only a faint shape from the balcony, though Bairro Alto rooftops are clear.
phrases.late_night: Back late from dinner at Federico, you would see São Jorge Castle above the lit rooftops of Bairro Alto.
phrases.wet_evening: Over a last glass of wine tonight, a Signature Room would show you rain and wet rooftops lit toward São Jorge Castle.
phrases.grey_evening: A last glass in a Signature Room after midnight, and you would see the castle hill above the lit rooftops under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Metrópolis dome is a dark shape in the arched windows of the suite living room.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight reaches the rooftop early, and two guests could do yoga there facing the spired tower.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is blue above the Terrace Suite, and Puerta del Sol lies in full sun below the private terrace.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun turns the copper cupola orange beside the white-linen tables on the Dani Brasserie rooftop.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would eat seafood by candlelight on the rooftop, the bronze quadriga standing against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Madrid this morning, and the rooftop lounge wicker chairs sit half in sun, half in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the suite balcony, the low rooftop skyline of Madrid is partly in shadow as clouds move across the afternoon sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day passes between clouds and lights the bronze chariot above the rooftop dinner tables.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Madrid today, so the Metrópolis dome seen from the suite windows has no shine on it.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the private terrace of the Terrace Suite, and guests watch Puerta del Sol from inside the dry living room.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Madrid right now means the rooftop tables stay empty, while the storm is watched from the suite's tall windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the city, and from the marble bathroom tub the Madrid rooftops look pale and blurred.
phrases.snow: Snow does not come often to Madrid, but today it settles on the rooftop terrace and on the copper cupola.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing on the rooftop, where the wicker chairs stay empty and the sky over the historic rooftops is clear.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot over Madrid this afternoon, and on the Dani Brasserie rooftop the white-linen tables stand in strong sun.
phrases.mild_night: A warm night under clouds, and the candlelit tables on the rooftop are in use next to the bronze quadriga.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the suite's arched windows the Metrópolis dome is clear but the farther rooftops are not.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water in hand, and the suite's arched windows frame the Metrópolis dome against the lit rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Dani Brasserie, rain runs down the suite's arched windows and the Metrópolis dome blurs behind the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Dani Brasserie, the suite's arched windows frame the Metrópolis dome against low cloud over the lit city.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the office towers of Osaka stand dark against a clear sky outside the 33rd-floor rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning sky over Osaka, and the telescopes at the 40th-floor C Grill are ready for anyone who wants detail.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, guests in the indoor lap pool swim with the whole Osaka skyline in the windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the office towers in front of the teppanyaki restaurant windows before dinner service begins.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, Osaka's lit towers spread to the horizon from the floor-to-ceiling windows of a thirty-third-floor room.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Nakanoshima this morning, and the fitness center treadmills face a mostly sunny Osaka skyline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A few clouds move over the city this afternoon, visible from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the spa treatment rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in the lounge bar for the last hour of sun, you would see the clouds turn pink over Osaka.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Osaka today, so the view from the 33rd floor shows a flat, pale city without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain is running down the suite living room windows this hour, and the Osaka towers appear blurred behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunderstorm over Osaka right now, and the 40th-floor C Grill gives a very high, very dry place to watch the lightning.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog or haze hides the far edge of Osaka today, and the C Grill telescopes will not help much this time.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Osaka, a rare sight from the high-ceiling rooms, where the city below slowly turns white.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing in Osaka today, and the clear air makes the far towers sharp from the 33rd floor.
phrases.very_hot: From the 40th-floor C Grill windows, midday heat-haze blurs the office towers along the Dōjima river.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky on a mild night, and the suite bathroom's red soaking tub faces the lit office towers.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited over Osaka today, so the far horizon is missing from the 33rd-floor rooms, though nearby towers are clear.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, guests in the suites are falling asleep with the Osaka lights left in view on purpose.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever is awake in a high-floor room after midnight watches rain run down the glass over Osaka's blurred city lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a suite after midnight can watch low cloud drift over Osaka, city lights showing through in patches.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the palms of Parque Burle Marx are dark shapes outside the guest room windows, and the outdoor pool is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the balcony right now comes with croissants, orange juice and a clear view of the rainforest canopy.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the white umbrellas by the 20-meter outdoor pool are in use, and the forest behind the colonnades is bright green.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were at a room window now, you would see low sun on the tall palms and lawns of Parque Burle Marx.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the rainforest outside the rooms is completely dark under a clear sky, and dinner continues at Tangará Jean-Georges.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds pass over Parque Burle Marx this morning, so the lawns below the guest room windows change between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were by the outdoor pool this afternoon, you would get sun for a while, then a cloud, then sun again.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud in the last hour of sun leaves patches of light on the palm tops below the Grand Suite terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the tall royal palms of Parque Burle Marx stand dark green beyond the guest room windows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the lounge chairs by the outdoor pool today, so swimmers have moved to the 25-meter heated indoor pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the guest room window, lightning flashes over the tall palms and dense rainforest of Parque Burle Marx.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits in the trees of Parque Burle Marx today, and only the nearest palms are clear from the balconies.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in São Paulo, but if it fell today it would land on palm trees and the outdoor pool.
phrases.very_cold: On this rare freezing day the outdoor lounge chairs stay empty, and the palms outside the windows look the same as ever.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in São Paulo today, so the shaded colonnades beside the outdoor pool are the most popular place.
phrases.mild_night: If you were on a balcony tonight, you would feel mild air and hear the rainforest more than see it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the nearest trees are clear from the rooms while the far side of Parque Burle Marx is not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the windows show São Paulo's lights past the trees; by dawn the same glass fills with Parque Burle Marx's palms.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain is on the room windows tonight, and the tall palms of Parque Burle Marx show against the lit São Paulo skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers São Paulo after midnight, and the city lights show beyond the Burle Marx palms from the room windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Andaman Sea is a dark grey band below the five pools, and the jungle hillside is quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: From the top infinity pool, the sea is bright blue this morning and the palms around the water are completely still.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the hillside, so most guests at the pool bars are sitting under shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the sea in front of Chom Talay Restaurant, and the tropical hillside turns a warmer green.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop terrace tonight, you would see stars over the Andaman Sea and no clouds at all.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over Karon Beach this morning, and from the villa pools the sea changes between blue and grey.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, cloud shadows pass across the jungle hillside while guests swim in the lower infinity pool.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop terrace, the evening clouds over the Karon Beach treeline are orange, and the sea below is still bright.
phrases.overcast: A full grey sky sits over the Andaman Sea today, and the water looks flat and pale from the pools.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the five pools and the palms around them, and the sea is a dull grey line.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you stood on the Chom Talay terrace now, you would see lightning flash over the Andaman Sea below the hillside.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the sea today, so from Chom Talay Restaurant the horizon is hard to find.
phrases.snow: Snow over Phuket would be a first, but if it fell today the palms around the infinity pools would turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air is rare here, yet today the pool bars are quiet and guests stay in the villa bedrooms.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the hillside today, and the infinity pools are the busiest places in the resort.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, and the warm air makes the open-air restaurant a comfortable place for dinner.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop terrace the sea is visible but the far horizon is not.
phrases.late_night: In a pool villa after midnight, the curtain is left pulled back on purpose, and Karon Beach lights show between the palms.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Chom Talay, rain runs down the pool villa window and the lights of Karon Beach show through it.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Chom Talay is over, and from the pool villas Karon's shore lights show under low cloud tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the private terraces look out on a dark sea, with Naxos only a shape at the far end.
phrases.clear_morning: On a clear morning, the beach and the small islet are easy to see from the room's sliding glass doors.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the pool deck, and most guests stay on the rattan sun beds with a drink.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light reaches across the vineyard rows and the white villas below the infinity pool, with Naxos sharp behind the sea.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see Naxos as a dark line across the water, with stars above it.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Aegean this morning, and the suite's glass doors are already open to the terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move over the scrubland below the terraces, while the pool deck gets sun between the clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Naxos turn orange, and the dining table on the terrace is set.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the whole view today, but the vineyard rows and white villas below the infinity pool stay clear.
phrases.rain: Rain on Paros is not common, so guests mostly watch it from the suite's two sofas through the glass doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, lightning over the Aegean lights the water below the private terraces and the outline of Naxos.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Aegean today, so Naxos is only a faint shape, though the beach and islet below are still visible.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Paros, but today a few flakes land on the olive trees beside the terrace.
phrases.very_cold: Guests on their terraces this morning look past frosted glass doors and empty sun loungers to the sea and Naxos.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the bean bag loungers sit empty and nearly everyone is in the pool.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the lights of Naxos show across the water beyond the private terraces.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, Naxos is not in view, and only the nearby scrubland and beach show clearly from the terraces.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, the lights of Naxos show across the water through the rooms' sliding glass doors, easy to watch for another hour.
phrases.wet_evening: Past midnight, rain runs down the sliding glass doors, and the lights of Naxos show across the sea.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers Paros after midnight, and through the rooms' glass doors a few lights show across the water on Naxos.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the bay-side balconies look out on a dark Manila Bay under a sky with no clouds at all.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the bay-facing rooms see Manila Bay under a clear morning sky from their beds or their bathtubs.
phrases.clear_midday: Strong midday sun falls on the pool below the suites, and Manila Bay is bright and flat behind it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would watch the sun sink toward Manila Bay through a suite's floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, The Fountain is lit in blue below the balconies, and the bay is dark.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit over Manila Bay this morning, visible from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A few clouds pass over the outdoor pool this afternoon, and swimmers get some shade between them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds over Manila Bay, seen from the bathtub in a bay-side suite.
phrases.overcast: Under grey cloud, Manila Bay lies flat and dull beyond the floor-to-ceiling windows of the bay-side rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Manila Bay and the outdoor pool right now, best watched from a dry suite dining area.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over Manila Bay, and guests watch it from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows in the suites.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Manila Bay today, and from the private balconies the water fades into grey quite close.
phrases.snow: Snow does not fall in Manila, but if it did, guests would see it from the freestanding bathtubs facing Manila Bay.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing weather almost never reaches Manila, but today the bay looks cold and the outdoor pool is empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Manila Bay, and most guests are either in the outdoor pool or behind glass.
phrases.mild_night: On this warm, cloudy night, The Fountain shows blue jets below the balconies and Manila Bay is black behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the bay-side rooms, the outdoor pool and the near water show clearly, but haze hides the far side of Manila Bay.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the bay-side rooms probably fell asleep with the curtain left open, blue fountain light on Manila Bay's water.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the bay-facing rooms watch the evening set in, rain on the glass blurring the lights around Manila Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a bay-side room tonight is likely ending the day at the window, the lights across Manila Bay hazy under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: The Eiffel Tower is still unlit at this hour, a dark shape in a clear sky from the upper-floor street-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast trays go out to the courtyard patio this morning, and the sun is already on the rooftops outside.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Eiffel Tower is sharp and brown-grey above the Haussmann rooftops, with no cloud anywhere in the sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were at an upper-floor front window now, you would see low sun on the Eiffel Tower above the Haussmann rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the upper-floor street-facing rooms tonight look out at the Eiffel Tower against a clear starry sky above the Haussmann rooftops.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Juliet balconies this morning, the Eiffel Tower goes in and out of sun as broken cloud moves across Paris.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Upper-floor guests get white clouds behind the Eiffel Tower this afternoon, while the courtyard patio stays quiet below.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, cloud edges above the rooftops catch orange light, and the tower stands dark in front.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Paris today; the Eiffel Tower is still clearly visible from the street-facing rooms, just without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the courtyard patio, so breakfast moves inside, and the tower is seen through wet window glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the upper-floor rooms give a direct view of lightning near the Eiffel Tower, with the window closed.
phrases.fog_haze: Today the fog covers the upper part of the Eiffel Tower, so from the street-facing rooms only its lower section shows.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Paris, but today it lands on the Haussmann rooftops seen from the arched windows of the upper rooms.
phrases.very_cold: From the upper-floor street-facing rooms, the Eiffel Tower stands above the Haussmann rooftops in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: From the upper-floor Juliet balcony, heat-haze blurs the Eiffel Tower above the Haussmann rooftops in the hard afternoon light.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in the 7th; the Eiffel Tower lights show well from the upper rooms, with no stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; the Eiffel Tower looks pale from the upper rooms and the far rooftops are hard to make out.
phrases.late_night: Sleep comes easy in the street-facing rooms after midnight, since at dawn the arched window will show the Eiffel Tower above the rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the arched windows of the upper-floor street-facing rooms tonight, and the Eiffel Tower shows above the wet Haussmann rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner, the arched window of an upper-floor room frames the Eiffel Tower above the rooftop lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the San Pedro tower stands dark against a clear sky above the rooftop pool, and nobody is swimming yet.
phrases.clear_morning: From the arched window of one room, the bell section of the Giralda is already in full sun this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop loungers are in strong sun, and the Old Town roofline looks pale and sharp.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun is reaching the French windows of the street-facing rooms, and the pool terrace is getting its best hour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop tonight, you would see the San Pedro tower standing against a clear dark sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Old Town roofline this morning, and the pool catches sun between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the light on the rooftop loungers changes every few minutes as clouds cross the San Pedro tower.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over Seville turns orange above the Old Town roofline, seen from the pool.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the Old Town roofline today, and the rooftop loungers are mostly empty.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop pool, and guests are watching the wet street through the tall French windows instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, the courtyard's warm wall lighting stays on while thunder moves over the San Pedro tower outside.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Seville today softens the Old Town roofline, and the San Pedro tower is a faint shape from the rooftop.
phrases.snow: Snow in Seville is rare, but if it fell today the rooftop loungers would carry a thin white layer.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing today, the rooftop pool has no swimmers, and guests watch the Giralda from the arched window instead.
phrases.very_hot: Seville is very hot today, and the rooftop pool is the only part of the terrace where anyone stays long.
phrases.mild_night: It is a warm cloudy night in Seville, and the courtyard's wall lighting is on under the white arches.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the San Pedro tower is clear from the rooftop but the far roofline is not.
phrases.late_night: Past midnight the arched room window frames the Giralda's bell section above the lit roofs of the Old Town.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the arched window, and the lit rooftops of the Old Town show blurred through the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the arched room window frames the Giralda's bell section against low cloud over the lit Old Town rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Fountain of the Naiads is already lit below the piazza-view rooms, with almost nobody crossing the square.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast in La Fontana comes with a clear view of the piazza, the fountain already in full sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the white marble statues of the fountain stand out sharply from the balconies.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop by the pool now, you would see Rome's skyline lit by the low sun.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Piazza della Repubblica is clear, and the lit fountain is in plain view from the piazza-view rooms.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over the Basilica of Santa Maria degli Angeli this morning, seen from the balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooms facing the ruins, patches of sun move across the terracotta rooftops between the afternoon clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the fountain on and off between clouds, which guests on the balconies can watch directly.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the piazza today, but the basilica and the fountain are fully visible from La Fontana.
phrases.rain: If you were on a piazza-view balcony now, you would see rain falling on the Fountain of the Naiads below.
phrases.thunderstorm: With a thunderstorm over Rome, guests watch the lightning above the basilica from behind closed balcony doors.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze reduces the view today: the fountain directly below is clear, but the skyline from the rooftop is faint.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Rome, but today it is settling on the statues of the fountain, seen from the piazza-view rooms.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air over the piazza today; the balcony doors stay shut, and the basilica is seen through the glass.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day like this, the rooftop pool and its striped cabanas are the busiest part of the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Rome, and the fountain is lit below the balconies while guests finish dinner at INEO.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today: the fountain and basilica across the piazza are clear, but the distant skyline from the rooftop is not.
phrases.late_night: Dinner at INEO ends after midnight, and the piazza-view rooms look out on the Fountain of the Naiads in the lit piazza.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on Piazza della Repubblica after midnight, and the wet paving round the Fountain of the Naiads shines from piazza-view rooms.
phrases.grey_evening: A thin haze hangs over Piazza della Repubblica after midnight, so the lights around the fountain look soft from the piazza-view rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over the Atlantic is already pale from the studio king suite's floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests with a balcony chair are watching the sun come up over the ocean, with the boardwalk still quiet below.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the wide sandy beach and the King Neptune statue are in full sun, seen from every ocean-facing room.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late in the afternoon the balconies sit in shade while the beach and the neighboring high-rise still catch warm light.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the ocean is dark beyond the boardwalk lights, and the indoor pool windows are lit.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds are taking some color from the sunrise this morning, as seen from the floor-to-ceiling window in the king room.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the sand this afternoon, and the balcony chairs are the easy place to watch them.
phrases.partly_golden: From a wooden balcony chair, the evening color on the clouds above the Atlantic is the main thing to watch.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlantic looks grey too, and the indoor pool gets more use than the beach today.
phrases.rain: From the balcony, rain falls on the wooden chairs, the boardwalk and the wide beach beside the Atlantic.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Atlantic is easy to see through floor-to-ceiling glass, and the balcony doors stay closed for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the ocean today, so the Neptune statue is a grey shape from the balcony and the horizon is gone.
phrases.snow: Snow on the beach is rare in Virginia Beach, but today the sand and boardwalk are white outside the ocean-facing windows.
phrases.very_cold: It is bitterly cold on the balconies today, so guests watch the bright Atlantic from behind the floor-to-ceiling glass instead.
phrases.very_hot: The heat on the beach is strong today, and the indoor pool is the cooler option a few steps from the sand.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and the lit boardwalk by Neptune's Park is visible from the king room window.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the horizon over the Atlantic is missing, though the beach and Neptune statue are still clear.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the studio king suite is dark, and the boardwalk lights along the Atlantic give the room its only light.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner in the studio king suite, rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass and the boardwalk lights blur over the wet sand.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the floor-to-ceiling glass of the studio king suite shows the boardwalk lights along the Atlantic under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the castle is still illuminated, and from a Club Castle View room its rock stands dark against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light shows every wall of Edinburgh Castle above the rooftops from the castle view rooms.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop hydropool is in full sun, and the castle on its rock is sharp behind the city rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The late afternoon sun lights the castle rock and the Usher Hall dome, both visible from the tartan-walled rooms.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the illuminated castle stands above the city rooftops, seen from a Club Castle View room.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Edinburgh this morning, so the castle moves in and out of shadow for anyone sitting in the rooftop hydropool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, patches of sun and cloud cross the castle and the Assembly Rooms dome, both in view from the hotel.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud leaves the castle rock half lit when seen from the castle view rooms.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Edinburgh today, but the castle is still clear above the rooftops and the indoor pool is the warmer choice.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Festival Square, and guests in the hammam or the crystal steam room are missing nothing outside.
