phrases.snow: Snow in Barcelona is rare, but if it fell today, Barceloneta Beach would turn white under the guest room windows.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside, so the beachfront terrace tables stand empty while the sea stays bright and sharp.
phrases.very_hot: With the air this hot, most guests are in the WET infinity pool high above the beach rather than on the sand.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud cover, and the WOW suite jacuzzis are in use, with the harbour lights visible below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the mountains behind the city cannot be seen from the observation room, only the nearer skyline.
phrases.late_night: In a WOW suite with the lights off, the only light comes from Barceloneta and the harbour, bright on the water.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Eclipse, the guest-room windows show the harbour lights of Barceloneta blurred by rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Eclipse, the harbour lights and Barceloneta show under low cloud from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sabie River is a dark line below the River Lodge deck, and the hippos are mostly sound, not sight.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the canopy beds through the glass walls at Ivory Lodge, with the Kruger sandbanks already in full view.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the pool deck loungers are in full sun, and most animals stay in the shade across the river.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Clear late afternoons are the usual hour for elephants to drink at the Sabie, watched from the River Lodge lounge deck.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a River Suite plunge pool tonight, you would see stars over Kruger and hear hippos in the Sabie.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered morning cloud over the Sabie means the sandbanks are in sun one minute and shade the next, as seen from breakfast.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud takes the glare off the river this afternoon, so the River Lodge boma has easier viewing across to Kruger.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds turn orange above the reed-lined river, and the lounge deck seating is mostly taken.
phrases.overcast: Under full cloud the Sabie looks flat and brown, and animals on the sandbanks are harder to spot from Tinga.
phrases.rain: Rain over the Sabie is watched through floor-to-ceiling windows from the thatched bedrooms, while meals indoors still face the river.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Kruger is visible from the glass-walled Ivory Lodge suites, and the wooden decks are empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: From the River Lodge pool deck, daytime haze over the Sabie River hides the Kruger sandbanks beyond the reeds.
phrases.snow: From the heated rim-flow pool at Ivory Lodge, snow falls over the Sabie River and the Kruger sandbanks beyond.
phrases.very_cold: A rare freezing morning in Kruger means the plunge pools go unused, and the river is watched from inside the glass-walled suites.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day guests are in the rim-flow pools, and the Kruger sandbanks stay in view from the water.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night at the boma means dinner outside facing the dark river, with hippos audible but not visible.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Dusty air cuts the view short: the near bank and reeds show from the lounge deck, but Kruger's far sandbanks do not.
phrases.late_night: Past midnight, the Sabie River glows under the moon beyond Ivory Lodge's glass walls.
phrases.wet_evening: Lightning over Kruger shows the Sabie River for a second through Ivory Lodge's wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud covers the sky over the Sabie River at Ivory Lodge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise under a clear sky, the Adriatic below the fifteen cliff rooms turns pale grey at the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were on a balcony this morning, you would see clear turquoise water and small boats below the dining terrace.
phrases.clear_midday: Bright daylight fills the floor-to-ceiling windows of the guest rooms, and the Adriatic looks its clearest shade of turquoise.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the limestone cliffs under the old town, and the cliffside terrace tables are already set for dinner.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the cave is open on one side to a dark Adriatic, and diners hear the waves against the rock below.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds cross the sky above Polignano a Mare, and the water seen from the balconies changes between blue and grey.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the arched balcony door, cloud shadows cross the turquoise Adriatic below the limestone cliffs of Polignano a Mare.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours a few clouds over the sea beyond Suite 900's private terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Adriatic outside the cave is flat and pale, with no shadows on the limestone cliffs.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the patios above the water, and guests watch it from inside, behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Each lightning flash over the Adriatic shows the whole sea for a second to guests watching from the cliffside balconies.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water today means guests on the balconies see a sea with no clear line where it ends.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Polignano a Mare, but today a few flakes fall past the windows toward the Adriatic.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day like this, the outdoor shower on Suite 900's terrace stays unused and the sea looks very clear.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, the shade of the limestone cave is the most comfortable place to sit facing the open sea.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, but the air on the balconies is mild and the waves are loud below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests on the cliffside terrace today see the Adriatic near the rocks below, but haze hides the far horizon.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the lights in Suite 900 are off, and the moon on the Adriatic is all that shows at the window.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner in the cave restaurant is over, and rain runs down the room windows while the Adriatic breaks on the rock below.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the cave's lights fall on the water below the cliff rooms, and cloud covers the rest of the Adriatic.

phrases.clear_predawn: In the dark before sunrise, upper-floor guests can already see the Eiffel Tower as a black outline against the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Haute Couture Eiffel Suite, the tower stands sharp against a clean blue sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the courtyard terrace has its red umbrellas open and white-clothed tables ready for lunch in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the 8th-floor window, the Eiffel Tower stands against a clear sky in the low afternoon sun.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the Haute Couture Eiffel Suite look out tonight at the Eiffel Tower's outline against a clear, starry sky over Paris.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass behind the Eiffel Tower this morning, seen from the balcony with its red geraniums.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the rooftop terrace this afternoon, the red rattan seats get sun between the clouds, with the tower above the trees.
phrases.partly_golden: Seen from the 8th floor, the last hour of sun lights the Eiffel Tower from one side under moving clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Eiffel Tower still shows clearly from the suite living room with the purple velvet chairs.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the red umbrellas of the courtyard terrace, and the Eiffel Tower looks grey from the upper windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Paris is best watched from behind the closed French doors of a guest room, not from the balcony.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of the Eiffel Tower today, and the 7th floor rooms see only its lower part.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the rooftop terrace hedges, and the Eiffel Tower appears pale through the flakes from the upper floors.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold clear day, few guests step onto the balconies, but the Eiffel Tower view is very sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Avenue Montaigne, and the rooftop terrace seats stay empty until the sun drops.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the Eiffel Tower lights show well from the open window of the suite living room.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the 8th floor the Eiffel Tower is a faint shape rather than a clear view.
phrases.late_night: Dinner long over, the Eiffel Tower's outline shows against the city lights from the Haute Couture Eiffel Suite after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Haute Couture Eiffel Suite windows tonight, and the Eiffel Tower's outline shows through it above wet city lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Paris tonight, and from the Haute Couture Eiffel Suite the tower's iron outline shows above the city lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the harbour-facing rooms show the Elbe still dark, with the port cranes outlined against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Hamburg, and from the curved windows the Speicherstadt rooftops are sharp in the sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the circular balcony window frames the Elbe, the port cranes and a blue sky with nothing in it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the rooftop bar, and the St. Nikolai spire stands out clearly through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the Elbe and the port cranes under a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over HafenCity this morning, and guests with coffee on the bed watch them from the windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the port cranes this afternoon, so the light on the Elbe changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the rooftop bar windows look out on Speicherstadt rooftops under broken cloud.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Hamburg today, but the harbour and the cranes are still fully visible from the harbour-facing rooms.
phrases.rain: Wet weather over the harbour today, and from the tall room windows the Elbe looks grey and still.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Elbe right now, and a high harbour-facing room is a good place to watch the lightning.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the harbour today hides most of the port cranes; the Speicherstadt rooftops nearby still show.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on HafenCity, and from the warm rooms the Speicherstadt rooftops and port cranes slowly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold and clear over the Elbe, so the balcony with the circular window is for a short visit only.
phrases.very_hot: Hamburg is very hot today, and the balcony with the circular window is in full sun over the Elbe.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the rooftop bar windows show the church spire and the Hamburg skyline in the dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooms the near Speicherstadt rooftops are clear but the far port cranes are not.
phrases.late_night: If you were asleep in an Elbe-facing room now, you would miss the port lights on the water and wake to Speicherstadt.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were at BLICK Bar for a last drink tonight, the harbour lights would show blurred through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you took a last drink to the curved window tonight, you would see the harbour lights spread under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lit streets of Luohu District are still visible from the high-floor rooms, with the sky slowly turning blue.
phrases.clear_morning: On a clear morning like this one, the green hills behind the city show sharply from a Skyline room window.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the sightline from the top floors reaches south toward Hong Kong, thirty kilometers away.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Shenzhen skyline from the side, which the five treadmills in the gym happen to face.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the 28-meter indoor pool seems to join the lit supertall towers outside, exactly as the hotel claims it does.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the city this morning, some of them below the windows of the upper floors.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the yoga studio this afternoon, the dense skyline shows in patches of sun and shadow as clouds pass over it.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in the upper-floor lounge now, you would see the last sun catching the clouds above the Shenzhen cityscape.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey cloud layer covers Shenzhen today, and from the 75th-floor Iridium Spa it is quite close overhead.
phrases.rain: Rain is running down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and a meal at Elba Restaurant comes with a wet, blurred skyline.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Luohu District is best watched from a high-floor room, with the window firmly closed.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the city today, so the skyline from the soaking tub looks soft and the hills do not show.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Shenzhen, but today a few flakes pass the windows of the top floors of Kingkey 100.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, unusual for Shenzhen, and clear enough to see the green hills from the rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over Shenzhen today, and from the gym windows the dense skyline looks slightly unsteady in the heat.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Shenzhen, and the lit city streets and the river are still clear from the upper floors.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited, so Hong Kong and the hills are out of sight from the Skyline rooms, though nearby towers still show.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight in a Skyline room comes with the lit streets of Luohu spread out below the window.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Elba, rain runs down the Skyline room window and the lit streets of Shenzhen show through it.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Elba, a Skyline room shows the city lights of Shenzhen spread wide under tonight's low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Guests at the fifty-meter infinity pool before sunrise look out at a clear sky full of stars over the Indian Ocean.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Cliff Edge Villa balcony, the morning ocean is already bright blue and the horizon is sharp.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong here, so most guests take the shaded pavilion beside the pool rather than the lounge chairs.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Sunset Cabana is the obvious place now, with the sun lowering over the water and the light turning gold.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, stars show above the lounge deck, and the ocean below is heard rather than seen.
phrases.partly_morning: If you stood at the cliff-edge infinity pool this morning, you would see broken cloud over the Indian Ocean below.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun move across the lush cliffs below the infinity pool while guests read on the lounge chairs.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in the Sunset Cabana now, you would see the low sun break through the clouds just above the horizon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the ocean looks grey too, but from the clifftop massage terrace the drop is still impressive.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the 50-meter pool and the palms, while the timber lattice pavilion keeps a few guests dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Indian Ocean is best watched from a villa bedroom, not from the edge of the infinity pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, so from the lounge deck the horizon line between sea and sky is hard to find.
phrases.snow: Snow has never been seen here, but if it fell, you would watch it from a Cliff Edge Villa balcony.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air is unknown in Bali, but if it came, the villa bedroom would be a better place than the infinity pool.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, so guests stay in the 50-meter infinity pool or under the shaded pavilion beside it.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, with no stars, and guests still sitting on the lounge deck listening to the waves below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far horizon is missing from the infinity pool, though the nearby cliffs still show clearly.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has the Cliff Edge Villa has turned the lights off, and only the moon on the Indian Ocean lights the bedroom.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the villa bedrooms can end the day watching rain run down the window that faces the Indian Ocean.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the Cliff Edge Villa after midnight looks out at low cloud over the Indian Ocean and surf below.

phrases.clear_predawn: An hour before sunrise, the rooftop pool is empty and Marina Bay Sands still has its lights on across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Marina Bay suite, the floor-to-ceiling windows show Marina Bay Sands and the Esplanade under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun hits the rooftop infinity pool hard, so most guests are in the water rather than on the loungers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the CBD towers, and from the pool deck the glass facades turn yellow for an hour.
phrases.clear_night: After dark, the rooftop pool is lit, and the CBD towers and the Esplanade are clear to see from the water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Marina Bay this morning, and the king rooms get a mix of sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds move across the skyline this afternoon, and swimmers in the 18th floor pool lose the sun every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds over Marina Bay Sands, a good moment on the Flow18 Sky Garden.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Marina Bay skyline looks flat from the suites, but every tower is still clearly visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pool deck, so guests are inside, watching the rain over Marina Bay through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Late at night, lightning over Marina Bay Sands flashes through heavy rain on the suite's floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the city today, and from the infinity pool the downtown towers look pale and less sharp.
phrases.snow: Singapore has never seen snow, but if it fell, the rooftop infinity pool would be the place to watch it from.
phrases.very_cold: From the 18th-floor pool deck, hard cold daylight falls on an empty pool and the towers of Marina Bay Sands.
phrases.very_hot: It is a very hot afternoon over Marina Bay, and the rooftop infinity pool is the only comfortable place outdoors.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night, the two chairs on the terrace face the lights of Marina Bay Sands and the CBD.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the suites Marina Bay Sands is faint and the far side of the bay is unclear.
phrases.late_night: In a Marina Bay suite the curtain is left open after midnight, and the bay lights frame Marina Bay Sands' three towers.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at The NCO Club, rain runs down the suite glass and the waterfront lights blur across Marina Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at The NCO Club, low cloud hangs over Marina Bay Sands and the city lights from the Marina Bay suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic below the balconies is still dark, and the beach at Mawgan Porth shows only as a pale strip.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Just Right room balcony, the surf on Mawgan Porth beach is clearly visible under a clear blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Sun comes straight through the glass walls of the indoor pool, and swimmers can see the sea while doing lengths.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Today's sunset hot tub bookings on the cliff edge are the ones to have, with the headland lit from the west.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on an Indulgent suite terrace tonight, you would see stars over the Atlantic and hear the surf.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the headland this morning, and from the rooftop viewing pods the sea changes colour as they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the restaurant's clifftop terrace, guests eat lunch with the sun in and out of the clouds over Mawgan Porth beach.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests in the clifftop hot tubs get a sunset with some cloud in it tonight, which often means more colour.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud sits over the whole Atlantic today, and robed guests still cross the meadow garden to the barrel sauna.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Mawgan Porth beach, and the floor-to-ceiling windows in the rooms are the dry way to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you stood on your balcony now, you would see lightning flash over the Atlantic beyond Mawgan Porth beach.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has come in off the sea, and from the balconies the headland is a faint shape or not there at all.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare at Mawgan Porth, but today some is falling on the sand, seen from all thirty-seven rooms.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing on the clifftop, so the hot tubs steam more than usual against the view of the Atlantic.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot for Cornwall today, and the natural reed-filtered pool above the beach is the busiest place in the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night: balcony doors stay open in the Indulgent suites and the surf below is the only sound.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the clifftop terrace, the sandy arc of Mawgan Porth beach shows below, but the haze hides the far sea today.
phrases.late_night: Only moonlight on the surf below the Indulgent suites tonight; sleep loses little, and dawn returns Mawgan Porth beach to the windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Around two, rain runs down the glass of the Indulgent suites, and the night surf shows white below on Mawgan Porth beach.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight the curtains stay open in the Indulgent suites, low cloud over the Atlantic and the surf sounding below.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the 37th-floor suites before sunrise, the Han River is dark and N Seoul Tower is still lit across the city.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light shows the Han River and N Seoul Tower from the suite windows, with no haze over the city.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun comes through the glass skylight above the indoor pool, and the city is bright outside its windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun turns the Han River orange, and the corner suites face it from more than one side.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the bridges over the Han River are lit, and N Seoul Tower stands out clearly from the rooftop bar windows.
phrases.partly_morning: If you were there this morning, you would watch cloud shadows moving across the Han River from a corner suite.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some clouds, some sun this afternoon, and N Seoul Tower goes in and out of shadow from the 37th-floor suites.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over Seoul turn orange above the Han River, which the rooftop bar windows face.
phrases.overcast: A grey, even sky over Seoul today, so the Han River looks flat and grey too from the suite living areas.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Han River today, and the lounge chairs beside the indoor pool are under a glass skylight.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Han River shows the bridges for a second at a time, and the 37th-floor windows face the whole scene.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Seoul today, and N Seoul Tower is only a faint shape, or not there at all, from the corner suites.
phrases.snow: Snow is coming down on Yeouido, and from the rooftop bar the Han River looks darker than the snowy city around it.
phrases.very_cold: A bitterly cold, clear day in Seoul, and N Seoul Tower looks closer than usual from the suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Seoul this afternoon, with a shimmer of heat over the Han River below the 37th-floor suites.
phrases.mild_night: Mild and cloudy tonight in Seoul, and the lit bridges on the Han River stand out clearly from the high-floor lounge bar.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Han River below is clear enough, but N Seoul Tower is not visible from the suites.
phrases.late_night: In a corner suite the curtain is left open on purpose tonight, and the Han River bridge lights reach the bed.
phrases.wet_evening: In the corner suites the curtains stay open at bedtime, rain blurring the lit bridges along the Han River.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain is open after midnight in a corner suite, and the bridge lights reflect in the Han River under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Theater rooms show the State House dome and the Zakim Bridge still lit against a dark, clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From floor ten and above, the Charles River and the Public Garden are easy to pick out in clean morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands high over the Beacon Hill rooftops, and the Cambridge skyline across the river looks sharp.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun comes straight through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the penthouse lounge, and the downtown skyline turns orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in Bar Moxy tonight, you would see the lit skyline through the windows while deciding where to go next.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the Charles River this morning, and the corner rooms catch the view on almost every side.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Zakim Bridge and the State House dome move in and out of shadow as clouds drift over Boston.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, guests in the penthouse lounge watch broken clouds turn pink above the downtown skyline.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Boston today, but from floor ten the Public Garden and the river are plain to see.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Theater rooms, and the Charles River below looks dull and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Cambridge skyline, and the nearly all-window Theater rooms show the storm from more than one direction.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Cambridge side of the Charles River today, so the nearest Beacon Hill rooftops are the whole view.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the windows of the penthouse lounge, and the Public Garden below is slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: Guests on floor ten this morning look through frosted floor-to-ceiling windows to the Charles River past Beacon Hill rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: Under a very hot sun, the Charles River looks bright and sharp from floor ten, and the fitness center is quiet.
phrases.mild_night: From a tenth-floor window on a mild cloudy night, downtown lights reach across to the Charles River and Cambridge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the Cambridge skyline across the river is not visible from the upper floors; the State House dome, closer, still is.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has a Theater room tonight may be up late, watching the Cambridge lights reflect on the Charles River.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a Theater room tonight watches rain run down the glass while Cambridge lights blur across the Charles River.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a Theater room tonight can watch the Cambridge lights across the Charles River under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise under a clear sky, the Nest on the thirteenth floor frames the Great Wheel lights beside Elliott Bay.
phrases.clear_morning: From The Nest on the 13th floor, the Olympic Mountains stand sharp across Elliott Bay and a ferry crosses in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun turns Elliott Bay bright blue, and the brass telescope in the suite is pointed at the Great Wheel.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were at The Nest now, you would watch Elliott Bay change colour as the sun drops behind the Olympic Mountains.
phrases.clear_night: At night the Great Wheel is lit, and the suite's floor-to-ceiling windows show it beside the black water of Elliott Bay.
phrases.partly_morning: Patches of sun reach the guest room windows this morning, lighting the pier and the tree-covered island on Elliott Bay.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the rooftop terrace, afternoon sun comes and goes over the port cranes and the Great Wheel across Elliott Bay.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds over the Olympic Mountains, seen from The Nest with Elliott Bay below.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Elliott Bay lies flat below the Nest on the 13th floor, with the port cranes plain against the clouds.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Water View Studio Suite, and Elliott Bay looks grey behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the thunderstorm, lightning over Elliott Bay shows the Seattle Great Wheel and the port cranes through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Elliott Bay today, hiding the Olympic Mountains completely, and the Great Wheel is only an outline below The Nest.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Pike Place roofline below the suite windows, and the ferry on Elliott Bay is hard to see.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold, clear day, the Olympic Mountains look close and white from the rooftop terrace, with Elliott Bay flat below.
phrases.very_hot: If you were at a window in the 13th-floor Nest now, you would see heat-haze over the port cranes along Elliott Bay.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, the Great Wheel is lit over Elliott Bay, and guests stay out on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the suite windows show Elliott Bay and the pier but not the Olympic Mountains.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, room lights are off in the Water View Studio Suite, and only the pier lights on Elliott Bay reach the glass.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open after midnight, rain runs down the Water View Studio Suite windows and waterfront lights blur across Elliott Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Seattle tonight, and the waterfront lights along Elliott Bay show through the Water View Studio Suite's open curtains.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Duomo spire is already a dark outline from the Presidential Suite, with the city lights still on.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Duomo Suite, the cathedral stands in full sun this morning, every spire easy to count from the window.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky over Milan is clear, and the restaurant windows show the Duomo and the Torre Velasca without any haze.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a guest room now, you would see the rooftops and the Duomo turning amber in the late sun.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Duomo spire is lit against a clear dark sky, and the restaurant tables face the whole illuminated skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over Milan this morning, and from the twelfth floor the Duomo passes in and out of sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The restaurant windows this afternoon give a view of the Torre Velasca under broken cloud, with patches of sun on the city.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Milan turn orange, and the Duomo is still clear from the Presidential Suite.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Milan today, so the Duomo from the twelfth floor looks pale but is fully visible.

phrases.snow: Snow over Milan is rare, but when it falls the rooftops seen from the guest rooms turn white.
phrases.very_cold: From the twelfth-floor Presidential Suite, the Duomo stands sharp in hard winter light beyond rooftops and frost-edged glass.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day in Milan, the quiet rooms are a better place to watch the Duomo than the street.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the restaurant tables with their candles face the lit skyline and the glowing Torre Velasca.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Milan today, so the Torre Velasca shows from the restaurant but the Duomo is only a blur.
phrases.late_night: Past midnight the Presidential Suite window frames the Duomo's spires above the lit rooftops, and there is no reason to stop looking.
phrases.wet_evening: With the Duomo Suite curtain open after midnight, rain runs down the glass and the cathedral spires show past wet, lit rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: In the Duomo Suite the curtain is open tonight, and the cathedral's spires show against low cloud above the lit city.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the CBD towers show as dark shapes behind Albert Park from a Deluxe King window.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun lights the tennis courts in Albert Park, and the skyline behind them is sharp from the City View rooms.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the green oval below the balconies is bright and the CBD towers stand out clearly.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a private balcony now, you would see the towers turn gold over the parklands.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the skyline is lit against a clear sky, and the courts in Albert Park are dark and quiet.
phrases.partly_morning: From the red armchairs in a City View room, clouds move over the towers while the park sits in full daylight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Woods Restaurant looks out on Albert Park, where patches of cloud shadow cross the oval this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: Pink and purple clouds sit over the CBD towers, and the tennis courts below catch the last of the sun.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Melbourne today, but the skyline and the sports courts are still fully visible from the large windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Albert Park, and from a Deluxe King room the towers look softer through the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the balconies are empty and lightning over the CBD towers is watched from behind the windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the upper parts of the CBD towers today, while Albert Park below the windows stays clear enough to see.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare here, but if it fell, you would see it on the oval from a City View room.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold clear day in Melbourne: the balconies stay empty, yet the view of the towers across Albert Park is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the oval in Albert Park looks dry and bright, and most guests watch the skyline from indoors.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars on this mild night, but the lit CBD towers are clear from Woods Restaurant.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far CBD towers are faint, while the tennis courts just below are easy to see.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight in a City View King room, and the lit CBD towers show beyond Albert Park.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the City View King windows after midnight, and the CBD tower lights blur across Albert Park.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hangs over the CBD towers after midnight, and the city lights show hazy from the City View King rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Solarium is empty and the Sagrada Família towers stand dark against a clear sky over the Eixample.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the stone of the Sagrada Família orange, seen from the terrace between the potted flowers.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a suite tonight, you would see the cathedral and the city lights under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: On the Solarium this morning, broken cloud over the Eixample leaves the Sagrada Família lit one minute and shaded the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The rooftop garden, the largest in Barcelona, has broken cloud above it this afternoon and patches of sun between.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds turn pink above the Sagrada Família, seen from the Solarium.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the city today, so the Gothic Quarter spires look flat and dull from the rooftop pool.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Solarium and the rooftop garden, and the Sagrada Família is a wet grey shape across the Eixample.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the city today means the Sagrada Família is only a faint outline from the terrace.

phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold, few guests use the rooftop lounge chairs, though the Gothic Quarter spires are sharp and clear.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air covers the Eixample, and the rooftop pool is the busiest part of the hotel this afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night on the Gran Via, and guests are still out in the rooftop garden after dinner.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor today, and the Sagrada Família is hard to make out from the Solarium, unlike the nearby Eixample rooftops.
phrases.late_night: The Sagrada Família shows over lit rooftops from the Art Suites, hard to stop watching.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, the Art Suite windows show the Sagrada Família's towers through steady rain, above the wet, lit Eixample rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the Art Suites look out on the Sagrada Família's towers above the Eixample roofline, under tonight's low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the terrace is empty and the lights of Giardini Naxos still show along the bay below the hotel.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the terrace comes with Mount Etna, the Strait of Messina and the Bay of Giardini Naxos in one clear view.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the balconies, and from the arched windows the Ionian Sea coastline is visible in full.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the terrace tonight, you would see Mount Etna's dark shape and the city lights across the valley.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over Mount Etna this morning, but the Bay of Giardini Naxos is clear from the breakfast terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the Strait of Messina while the infinity pool sits in sunshine for the moment.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the clouds above Taormina's rooftops, seen from the terrace sofa next to the brass telescope.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Taormina today, yet the sea and the coastal town below remain visible from the balconies.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides Mount Etna today, so there is little for the brass telescope on the terrace to show.

phrases.very_cold: On a cold clear day like this, the breakfast terrace is empty, but the view of Mount Etna is very sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Taormina, and most guests stay in the infinity pool, looking at the sea below.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night covers the valley, and the coastal city lights spread below the candlelit terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the town below the hotel can be seen but Mount Etna and the Strait of Messina cannot.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the lights of Giardini Naxos show where the bay curves, seen from the rooms' arched windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the arched room windows after midnight, and the lights of Giardini Naxos blur along the bay below.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Mount Etna after midnight, and the lights of Giardini Naxos show along the bay below the arched windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: If you were on a third-floor balcony now, you would see stars in the clear sky over Pillar Point Harbor before sunrise.

phrases.clear_midday: At midday the outdoor pool is in full sun, with the ocean visible beyond the iron fence.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a third-floor balcony now, you would see ocean, harbor and mountains in one view, lit from the west.
phrases.clear_night: Clear night over the bay, and guests on the oceanfront patio sit by the fire pits with wine glasses.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over Monterey Bay this morning, but the distant mountains are still visible from the white lattice balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud move across the ocean this afternoon, seen from the lounge chairs beside the outdoor pool.
phrases.partly_golden: Last hour of sun, and the clouds over the harbor take some color while sailboats sit on the calm bay.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the ocean looks flat from the suite bedrooms, and the living room fireplace is lit.
phrases.rain: Rain over Pillar Point Harbor today, so the view stays behind the suite windows and the binoculars stay on the coffee table.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is moving across the ocean, and guests watch it from behind the suite windows, fireplace lit.

phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night, and the fire pits on the oceanfront patio are lit while guests finish the wine hour.

phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud passes over Pillar Point Harbor after midnight, and the harbor lights look soft from the Penthouse Ocean View suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea beyond the infinity pool is dark and flat, and the village lights below are still on.

phrases.thunderstorm: From a sea-view balcony, lightning flashes over the Mediterranean while rain falls on the village roofs below the monastery.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water hides the horizon today, so the edge of the infinity pool blurs into grey sea.

phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, the lights of Amalfi show through the rain on the windows of the sea-facing rooms.
phrases.grey_evening: Long after dinner, the village lights of Amalfi show under a low cloud below the sea-facing rooms.

phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at FISH is over, and the waterfront suite looks onto harbour water lit by the city under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the top-floor windows show a Gangnam skyline still lit by office lamps and the hills as dark shapes.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: The last sun of the day is on the Kitayama ridgelines, and from the north-facing rooms the Okazaki district looks orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lanterns lit in the rock garden under a clear, dark sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are moving over the Kitayama ridge this morning, and the north-facing rooms get patches of sun across Okazaki.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the stone bath at Spa KACHO, the garden olive trees go from bright to shaded as clouds pass this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud over Kitayama in the last hour of sun lets light fall on parts of the Okazaki district and not others.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Kyoto today, so the Kitayama ridgelines show as a dull line from the Heian-kyo View suites.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Aoi-den garden, and guests at the RAQOU windows watch it over the low roofs of Okazaki.
phrases.thunderstorm: With thunder over the Higashiyama hills, guests in the indoor stone bath at Spa KACHO can hear each roll through the roof.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the city today means guests in the north-facing rooms see the Aoi-den garden clearly but the Kitayama ridge only faintly.
phrases.snow: Snow has settled on the pines of the Keage hillside, and the Kasui-en annex garden looks white from every room there.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing on the Keage hillside, and the cold clear air makes the Kitayama ridgelines unusually sharp from the deluxe rooms.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Kyoto today, and the shaded Aoi-den garden below the windows is the only cool-looking thing in view.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night on the hillside, and the lanterns in the rock garden are the brightest thing seen from the rooms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the air is not clear, so from the Heian-kyo View suites the Okazaki district shows but the Kitayama ridgelines do not.
phrases.late_night: Midnight, a glass of water in a Heian-kyo View suite, and the low lights of Okazaki are there past the gardens.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the Heian-kyo View suites after midnight, and the lights of Okazaki blur beyond the garden.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud hides the Kitayama ridgelines, and the lights of the Okazaki district show below the north-facing rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise under a clear sky, the first pale light shows the flat top of Table Mountain above the calm marina water.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the superyacht marina, and guests on the waterfront terrace see Table Mountain with no cloud at all.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests on the rooftop balcony this midday look across the yacht marina to the flat top of Table Mountain under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suite dining room, and Table Mountain turns a warm colour over the marina.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop balcony after midnight, you would see yacht lights on the Waterfront marina under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit on top of Table Mountain this morning, seen from the arched window of the restaurant over the marina.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the waterfront terrace watch cloud shadows move across Table Mountain while the yachts in the marina stay in the sun.
phrases.partly_golden: From the Table Mountain-facing balcony, the last sun lights the mountain's flat top under scattered clouds above the marina.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Table Mountain looks flat and dull from the pool deck, and the orange loungers are mostly empty.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the private quay and the yachts, so guests are inside, perhaps at the eight-course tasting menu in Heirloom.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the harbour sends everyone off the waterfront terrace, and lightning is sometimes visible behind Table Mountain from the rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers Table Mountain this morning, so from the rooftop balcony only the nearest yachts in the marina show.
phrases.snow: Cape Town almost never sees snow, but a white Table Mountain would be an unusual sight from the pool deck.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Cape Town: the pool deck is empty and Table Mountain is very clear from the rooftop balcony.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, most guests are in the pool or under the cream umbrellas, with Table Mountain behind them.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the balcony doors of the rooms stay open to the sound of the marina below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today: the arched restaurant window shows the yachts well, but Table Mountain is hard to make out.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, with the rooftop room's lights off, the marina lights on the Waterfront water are the only glow inside.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Heirloom, rain runs down the rooftop room's glass, and the marina lights blur below Table Mountain's flat outline.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Heirloom, the rooftop room window shows the marina lights and a low cloud over Table Mountain tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, under a clear sky, the lit Koutoubia minaret rises above the medina rooftops from the private riad terrace.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop terrace this morning, the date palms and medina rooftops sit under a clear sky, the minaret plain to see.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong, so each riad's plunge pool is probably the most popular place to be.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From a room terrace in late afternoon, the palms by the pool cast long shadows across the sun loungers.
phrases.clear_night: After midnight under a clear sky, the lit Koutoubia minaret rises over the medina roofs beyond the private riad rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Marrakech this morning, but the minaret and the date palms are still clear from the terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the pool this afternoon, and guests on the sun loungers move between shade and sun.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on your rooftop terrace now, you would see the last sun catching the minaret between scattered clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the medina rooftops look flat and brown from the terrace, and the dining table is set for evening.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Marrakech; today it wets the rooftop terraces, while the glass roof keeps it off the indoor pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests inside their riad tonight see lightning flash over the lit Koutoubia minaret and the wet medina rooftops below.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the medina today, so the Koutoubia minaret is a soft shape from the terrace rather than a sharp one.
phrases.snow: Snow in Marrakech almost never happens; if it did, the medina rooftops seen from your terrace would briefly turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air feels close to freezing on the rooftop terrace, which makes the indoor pool under its glass roof the practical choice.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, so by the pool only the sun loungers under the white umbrellas are in use.
phrases.mild_night: From the private rooftop terrace, the lit Koutoubia minaret stands above the medina rooftops under a cloudy night sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; from the rooftop terrace the medina rooftops and the minaret are visible, but nothing beyond them.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water at midnight, and the Koutoubia tower is high above the roofs.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the riad windows, and the Koutoubia minaret shows above the medina's evening lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Marrakech after midnight, and from each riad's top floor the Koutoubia minaret shows above the lit medina rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop pool on the 22nd floor is empty, and Seoul's skyscrapers are still dark shapes against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: This morning the tall glass walls of The Place show Seoul's dense skyline under a clear sky during breakfast.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong at the rooftop pool, so the orange striped umbrellas and the canopied daybed are the shaded spots.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the rooftop pool now, you would watch the late sun on Seoul's skyscrapers from the 22nd floor.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the city lights are on around the rooftop pool, and the Floating bar is serving cocktails next to the water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Hongdae this morning, seen from the large window of a twin room above the low-rise blocks.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the skyline this afternoon, so guests on the blue loungers get sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over Seoul turn orange, visible from the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.overcast: The sky is fully grey over Seoul today, but the skyscrapers are still clear from the 22nd-floor rooftop pool.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the open-air rooftop pool, so the better view of wet Seoul is from a Studio Suite window.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm nobody is in the rooftop pool, and lightning over Seoul's skyscrapers is watched from behind the restaurant's glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Hongdae today, and from the 22nd floor the far skyscrapers are faded outlines rather than clear shapes.
phrases.snow: Light snow is settling around the rooftop pool, and the twin rooms look out on white low-rise roofs across Hongdae.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing beside the rooftop pool, and the air over Seoul is clear enough to count the skyscrapers.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over Seoul today makes the rooftop pool the sensible place, with the Floating bar a few steps away.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests sit at the Floating bar by the pool with Seoul's city lights all around.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Seoul today, so from the rooftop pool the nearest buildings are clear but the far skyscrapers are not.
phrases.late_night: Were you to wake for water in the Studio Suite Room near midnight, you would see Hongdae's lights filling the window.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink at the Floating bar tonight, you would see Hongdae's lights blurred by rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you carried a last drink up to the 22nd-floor rooftop tonight, you would see Hongdae's lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over the Atlantic is still dark from the ocean-view balconies, and the pool deck is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Sun comes up over the Atlantic, and the oversized windows of the ocean-facing rooms get the light straight on.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the pool deck is bright, white loungers and fringed umbrellas under tall palms, Art Deco buildings in view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were at an oversized skyline-facing window now, you would see the Miami skyline clear in low late-afternoon sun.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at one of the oversized windows after midnight, you would see the Miami skyline lit against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Atlantic this morning, and the balconies of the ocean-view rooms are already in use.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the pool deck this afternoon, so the white loungers go from sun to shade every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Miami skyline turn orange, visible from the skyline-side rooms.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Collins Avenue today, and the Atlantic looks flat and grey too from the ocean-view suites.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the pool deck and the fringed umbrellas, so most guests are inside the restaurant behind its floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Atlantic shows clearly from the ocean-facing windows, and nobody is in either pool right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, and the Miami skyline is only a faint outline from the skyline-facing rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow in Miami Beach is almost unheard of, but today a few flakes reach the tall palms on the pool deck.
phrases.very_cold: From the oversized windows, the Miami skyline stands sharp in hard winter light beyond the empty white pool loungers.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on Collins Avenue right now, and the fourth-floor pool is the busiest place in the hotel for a reason.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm and cloudy, and guests on the ocean-view balconies hear the Atlantic more than they see it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today, so the Miami skyline is mostly hidden from the skyline-facing rooms, and the ocean horizon is gone too.
phrases.late_night: If you turned off every light in a skyline-facing suite tonight, Miami's lit towers would be the only glow left.
phrases.wet_evening: If you took a last Rose Bar drink up to a skyline room tonight, you would see Miami's lights through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you came up to a skyline room after a last drink at the Rose Bar, you would see Miami's lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea-view rooms on the upper floors look out at a dark, calm bay and no boats moving yet.
phrases.clear_morning: On the rooftop terrace this morning, breakfast comes with a view of the old village roofs, the water and wooded hills.
phrases.clear_midday: From the suite's arched balcony door, the stone coastal tower and the blue sea sit in sharp midday light.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the rooftop terrace, low afternoon sun lights the village roofs, the bay and the pine hills under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a sea-view room tonight, you would see the bay under a clear starry sky and little else.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the harbour this morning, seen from the sitting room window, with sun between them on the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Through the window, a sailboat crosses the bay while the coastal hills go in and out of cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: The clock tower, framed by the dining room windows, catches the last sun while clouds sit above the village.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the bay today, and the sea seen from the room terraces looks flat and grey rather than blue.
phrases.rain: From the upper-floor terraces, rain falls on the bay of Saint-Tropez and on the stone coastal tower.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the sea is visible from the upper-floor rooms, and the restaurant's windows are shut against the wind.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, and from the suite balcony the stone tower is clear but the distant hills are not.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Saint-Tropez, but today a few flakes fall past the room windows and melt on the terraces.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air for the Riviera today, so the rooftop breakfast tables stay empty while the bay looks bright and clear.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the terraces today, and the sea past the stone tower looks far more tempting than the sun.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over the bay, and guests on the room terraces sit outside late without a jacket.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests on the rooftop terrace today look over the village rooftops to the near bay, with the far hills lost in haze.
phrases.late_night: After midnight one sea-view room keeps its light on, and the harbour lights show on the bay outside its open French windows.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open after midnight, rain runs down the sea-view windows and the harbour lights blur across the bay.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtains are open late in the sea-view rooms, and the harbour lights reflect on the bay under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies face a dark Lake Lugano, and the outline of the Alps shows against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From 850 meters up, guests on their balconies see the whole of Lake Lugano in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the outdoor pool is in full sun, with Lake Lugano and the green hills clearly visible below it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the Bella Vista terrace now, you would watch the low sun turn the lake and mountains golden.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear, and guests in the outdoor whirlpool can see stars above the dark shape of the Alps.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Malcantone mountains this morning, but from the room balconies Lake Lugano is still in sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the lake this afternoon, so swimmers in the infinity pool get sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_golden: Just before sunset, the clouds above the Alps turn orange, and diners on the Radici Gourmet terrace look straight at them.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the lake looks flat and silver from the balconies, and the indoor pool is busier than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the hillside today, and guests have moved from the balconies to the hammam and sauna world.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Lake Lugano right now, and the lightning is best watched from a room, not the outdoor whirlpool.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of Lake Lugano today, so the view from the Bella Vista jacuzzi ends at the nearest trees.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling at 850 meters, and the forested hills around the lake are turning white outside the room windows.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing on the balconies today, so guests look at the Alps through the Radici Gourmet windows.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the outdoor pool at 850 meters is the only sensible place to look at the lake.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests dining on the Radici Gourmet terrace can see the dark mountains across the lake.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the balconies, Lake Lugano shows below in the haze today, while the Alps behind it stay out of sight.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the lake-view rooms are probably asleep by now; a few shore lights mark Lake Lugano until dawn shows the Alps.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever is awake in the Bella Vista suite after midnight watches rain run down the glass, the lakeside lights blurred below.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the Bella Vista suite after midnight watches low cloud pass over Lake Lugano, shore lights visible beneath it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific is still dark from the upper-floor balconies, and the boardwalk below is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From a king room balcony, the morning sun lights the coastal hills and the waves along the shoreline.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the French doors of the living room stand open, and the Pacific outside is bright and calm.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on an upper-floor balcony now, you would see low afternoon sun on calm Pacific water.
phrases.clear_night: From an upper-floor suite, stars fill the clear night sky over the Pacific beyond the balcony's glass railing.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the ocean this morning, and guests with kitchenettes are making coffee behind the glass railings.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon clouds pass over the coastal hills while the shoreline below the suites stays in sunlight most of the time.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the Pacific is visible from the balcony table and chairs.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the ocean looks flat and grey too from the upper-floor suites, but the view is still wide.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the boardwalk below, and guests are watching it from the living room through the French doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over the Pacific right now, and the fireplace in the king room is the better place to sit.
phrases.fog_haze: If you were on an upper-floor balcony, you would see fog over the Pacific and a short stretch of Pismo Beach shoreline.
phrases.snow: From an upper-floor balcony, light snow falls over the Pacific shoreline and the boardwalk below the suites.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, unusual here, and the plastic chair on the balcony is empty while the ocean stays clear.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the French doors stay open for the ocean air, and the shoreline below is full of people.
phrases.mild_night: The night is warm under cloud, and guests are sitting out on the balconies above the quiet boardwalk.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the coastal hills are hard to make out from the balconies, though the nearer waves are clear.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the suite lights are off, and the only glow left comes from the boardwalk along the Pacific.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the French doors of the ocean-facing suites tonight, and the boardwalk lights blur along the Pacific shore.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Pismo Beach after midnight, and from the upper-floor Pacific suites the downtown lights reach the water's edge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the glass of Fountain Place is still dark, seen from the corner suites on the upper floors.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun hits Fountain Place at close range, and guests in the twin-bed rooms see it from their window.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Dallas skyline is sharp in every direction through the mid-century windows of the upper floors.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a corner suite now, you would see low sun on the Margaret Hunt Hill Bridge to the left.
phrases.clear_night: From the bar lounge, Reunion Tower is lit against a clear night sky, with the rest of downtown lit beyond it.
phrases.partly_morning: Broken cloud over Dallas this morning, and from the upper-floor rooms the skyline is half in sun, half in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: With cloud and sun mixed this afternoon, the suite bathroom's soaking tub faces the skyline through one tall window.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights parts of the skyline and leaves others in shadow, visible from the upper-floor rooms.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Dallas, and the skyline from the hotel's room windows looks flat but complete today.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the mid-century windows, and the Margaret Hunt Hill Bridge is only a faint shape from the corner suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over downtown is best watched from the bar lounge, where the floor-to-ceiling windows face Reunion Tower.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of the skyline today, and even Fountain Place, normally at close range, is only an outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Dallas, but today it falls past the upper-floor windows while swimmers stay in the indoor pool.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the skyline looks sharp from the upper-floor corner suites, with the bridge visible to the left.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon in Dallas; through the room windows, the sun is strong on the glass of Fountain Place at close range.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night; from the bar lounge, Reunion Tower is lit and the skyline shows under a covered sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: Fountain Place stays clear at close range, but the Margaret Hunt Hill Bridge is hard to see.
phrases.late_night: In the upper-floor corner suites the curtain is left open on purpose, Fountain Place's glass wedge close by in the lit skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight the curtain is open in a corner suite, and rain runs down the glass over the lit downtown skyline.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers downtown Dallas after midnight, yet the city lights show through the open curtains of the upper-floor corner suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lights on the 25 de Abril Bridge are still on, seen from the upper-floor windows facing south.
phrases.clear_morning: From the 24th-floor Sky Lounge this morning, the aqueduct lies north and the bridge south under a completely clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, the Tagus River bridge shows sharp from the upper rooms, with no cloud over Lisbon's rooftops.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a south-facing room now, you would see the 25 de Abril Bridge turn orange in the low sun.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear, and the lit bridge and Christ the King stand out from the Sky Lounge terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Monsanto park this morning, visible from the rooms with windows facing the aqueduct.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over Lisbon this afternoon, and the bridge drops in and out of shadow from the 24th floor.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the 25 de Abril Bridge turn pink, seen from the Sky Lounge.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky today, the aqueduct and the bridge are both visible, just flatter, from the Sky Lounge.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lisbon, and the bridge is still visible through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the upper rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Tagus can be watched from the 24th floor, with the bridge appearing briefly with each flash.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far end of the 25 de Abril Bridge, so the Sky Lounge view stops short of Christ the King.
phrases.snow: Snow in Lisbon is rare, but if it fell today, the aqueduct valley would look white from the north-facing rooms.
phrases.very_cold: The air is close to freezing on the 24th-floor terrace, yet the view south to the bridge is very clear.
phrases.very_hot: This very hot afternoon, the wooded hillside of Monsanto looks pale and dry from the north-facing suite windows.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Lisbon, and the lit 25 de Abril Bridge is still easy to see from the Sky Lounge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, and the Sky Lounge shows the near rooftops but not Christ the King across the river.
phrases.late_night: Were you asleep in an upper-floor room, city lights would fill the window until the 25 de Abril Bridge shows at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Over a last drink in the Sky Lounge tonight, you would see the 25 de Abril Bridge through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in the Sky Lounge, city lights would spread under cloud to the 25 de Abril Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is still dark beyond the glass-walled balconies, and the pool deck below has no one on it yet.
phrases.clear_morning: From a north-facing room, the full beach is in view this morning, with blue umbrellas going up along the white sand.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday from the glass-walled balcony, the white sand and blue umbrellas sit in clear sun beside the turquoise Atlantic.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the beach from behind the tower, and the turquoise water looks darker from the high balconies.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would hear the Atlantic from your glass-walled balcony and see little of it in the dark.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over the water this morning, so the breakfast buffet at Atlantikos comes with alternating sun and shade by the pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the coastline stretching north, and from the curved high-floor balconies the ocean changes colour where their shadows fall.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Atlantic turn orange, best seen from the south-facing rooms with broader panorama.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the beach today, and the turquoise water on the postcards looks closer to grey from the balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Atlantic, and guests watch it from behind the glass doors of their suite sitting rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the ocean is visible from every room in the twenty-seven-storey tower, since each one faces the Atlantic.
phrases.fog_haze: There is haze over the water today, so South Beach is hard to make out from the south-facing balconies.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Miami Beach, but if it did, it would be falling on palm trees and blue pool loungers.
phrases.very_cold: From the glass-walled balcony, hard winter light falls on the sand and the blue loungers around the curved pool sit empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the sand today, and guests stay in the curved pool or under the patterned umbrellas on the stone deck.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm, cloudy night, the balcony lounge chairs still get used, though the Atlantic beyond is more heard than seen.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the coastline north of the hotel fades early and South Beach cannot be seen from the balconies.
phrases.late_night: With the room lights off after midnight, the only light in a south-facing room comes from South Beach along the shore.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass doors of the south-facing rooms tonight, and the lights along South Beach show through it.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the sky over the Atlantic tonight, and the south-facing rooms look onto the lights of South Beach along the shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky over the Andaman Sea is still dark before sunrise, and the pool loungers have no one on them yet.
phrases.clear_morning: From a private balcony, the water off Panwa Beach looks turquoise this morning and Ko Lon's outline is sharp.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the tan umbrellas and large shade trees around the pool are where most guests sit, out of the sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The infinity pool faces west, so right now swimmers have the sun dropping toward the mountain behind Ko Lon.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your balcony tonight, you would see stars over the Andaman Sea and the dark shape of Ko Lon.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the bay this morning, and from the elevated rooms the sailboats are easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud cross Panwa Beach this afternoon, and the sea seen from the balconies changes between bright and dull.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds west of the infinity pool turn orange above the Ko Lon silhouette.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the bay seen from the terrace lounge looks more green than turquoise, and the sailboats still move.
phrases.rain: Guests on their private balconies watch rain fall across the infinity pool and the sea off Panwa Beach.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Andaman Sea right now, so the pool is empty and guests watch from their balconies.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the water today, and from the balconies Ko Lon's mountain is a faint grey line at best.
phrases.snow: Snow does not happen on Cape Panwa, but if it did, the rooftop terraces of the beach villas would collect it.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside today, very rare for Phuket, and the sun loungers by the infinity pool stand empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today on Cape Panwa; the large shade trees above the pool loungers are where everyone wants to be.
phrases.mild_night: A warm, cloudy night at Cape Panwa, and the terrace lounge glass wall shows only a dark sea and no stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests on the pool terrace this afternoon look out over Panwa Beach and the near water, with Ko Lon's mountain hidden in the haze.
phrases.late_night: In the king rooms the curtain stays open on purpose tonight, and the Andaman Sea shows under the moon until sleep comes.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls over Panwa Beach around two, and from the terrace lounge the wet sea shows grey till first light.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight cloud covers Panwa Beach, and from the king rooms the sea shows as pale water along the shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea-facing balcony rooms look onto a dark, flat Baie des Anges under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From a sea-facing balcony, the Baie des Anges lies flat and blue under a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: The sea is bright blue through the open balcony doors at midday, and the outdoor pool section sits in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun comes low across the Promenade des Anglais and straight into the sea-facing balcony rooms.
phrases.clear_night: After dark on a clear night, the outdoor pool section sits under stars, with a dark Mediterranean at both ends.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit over the Baie des Anges this morning, and the sea shows darker patches through the windows of Le 3e.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the terrace tables get sun one minute and cloud shadow the next, with the Mediterranean in view the whole time.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the bay turn orange and the balcony olive tree casts a long shadow.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky the Baie des Anges looks flat and silver from the sage sofa in the suite living room.
phrases.rain: From a sea-facing balcony, rain falls on the Promenade des Anglais and the grey Baie des Anges beyond the heated pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, lightning over the Baie des Anges is easy to watch from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of Le 3e.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the sea today blurs the line between water and sky, so the balcony view is mostly pale grey.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare here, but if it fell today the sea-facing balconies would turn white and the heated pool would steam.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the sea-facing balconies are mostly empty, and the Baie des Anges is sharp and bright.
phrases.very_hot: If you were at a sea-facing balcony now, you would see heat-haze over the Promenade des Anglais and the Baie des Anges.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night here means the terrace tables are still in use after dinner, with a dark, quiet sea beyond.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the sea-facing rooms only the water near the Promenade is clear, not the far bay.
phrases.late_night: In a sea-facing room tonight you would be asleep, the Promenade lights on the water until the bay turns blue at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last glass in a sea-facing room now, you would see rain on the window and the Promenade lights.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were finishing a last glass in a sea-facing room, you would see the Promenade lights along the bay under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the harbour is dark from the 76th floor, and the skyline lights are still on across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From the fitness center treadmills, the whole of Victoria Harbour and the green hills behind Hong Kong Island are clear this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: The WET Deck pool terrace is in full sun at midday, with the harbour and the skyline sharp below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From a guest room's tall windows, the harbour looks gold before sunset, and boats cross the water below.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the soaking tub tonight, you would see the lit Hong Kong Island skyline across a clear harbour.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over Hong Kong this morning, but the skyline across the harbour shows clearly from the 76th floor.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the harbour this afternoon, and their shadows move across the water below the WET Deck pool terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the Extreme Wow Suite dining room, the last sun colours the clouds above the harbour before the skyline lights come on.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Hong Kong today, and from the 76th floor the harbour and the skyline both look grey.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the WET Deck terrace, so guests are at the indoor pool, watching the wet skyline through the windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the harbour, and from the rooms the storm is safer to watch than from the WET Deck pool terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides Hong Kong Island today, and from the spa treatment room the harbour is only a pale grey space.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare in Hong Kong, so a few flakes over the harbour would be the main view from the rooms.
phrases.very_cold: On the coldest days, the WET Deck pool terrace is almost empty, and the skyline across the harbour stands out sharply.
phrases.very_hot: Heat-haze blurs the Hong Kong Island skyline across Victoria Harbour from the 76th-floor WET Deck pool terrace.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm and cloudy, and the WET Deck pool glows pink with the lit skyline across the harbour.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooms the near harbour is visible but the hills behind Hong Kong Island are not.
phrases.late_night: Back in your room after a late drink at WET Deck, you would see the skyline lit across Victoria Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink at the window now, you would see rain over Victoria Harbour and Hong Kong Island's lights.
phrases.grey_evening: If you took a last drink to the window, Hong Kong Island's lights would show under low cloud across Victoria Harbour.

phrases.clear_predawn: Still dark over Paris, and the unlit Eiffel Tower is a clear shape in the room windows before the sun comes up.
phrases.clear_morning: A clear morning in Paris, and from the rooftop terrace every detail of the Eiffel Tower is sharp above the Haussmann roofs.
