phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the rooftop terrace, and guests eating lunch have the Eiffel Tower in full view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun gives the Haussmann rooftops a golden colour, and the Eiffel Tower rises above them from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight, with no clouds, the rooftop bar has the lit Eiffel Tower at the centre of its 360° panorama.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds this morning, and from the guest room windows the Eiffel Tower appears between the Haussmann buildings.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go this afternoon, so the Eiffel Tower is sunlit one minute and shaded the next, seen from the rooftop.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken clouds this evening, and the low sun reaches the Eiffel Tower now and then, seen from the rooftop dining chairs.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Eiffel Tower is still clear from the floor-to-ceiling windows, just without any shadows on the rooftops.
phrases.rain: Rain on the rooftop terrace means the dining chairs stay empty, while the Eiffel Tower stays mostly visible through wet room windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over Paris right now, so the rooftop bar is empty and guests watch lightning near the Eiffel Tower from their rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over Paris today, and the Eiffel Tower is only a faint shape from the rooftop terrace, sometimes not there at all.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the Haussmann rooftops, and from the room windows the Eiffel Tower looks grey against a white sky.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold today, and the rooftop terrace is nearly empty, though the Eiffel Tower is sharp in the clear air.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the red umbrella on the rooftop terrace gives some shade, with the Eiffel Tower behind it.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, good for the rooftop terrace, where the lit Eiffel Tower shows under the clouds.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Limited visibility today, so the Eiffel Tower is a soft outline from the rooftop terrace and the far panorama is not visible.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the tower-facing rooms turned the lights off, and city light through the glass shows the Eiffel Tower between Haussmann buildings.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in a tower-view room after midnight can watch rain run down the tall glass, the Eiffel Tower between Haussmann rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake at the floor-to-ceiling windows around two can watch low cloud cross the Eiffel Tower above the glowing Haussmann rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the upper south-facing rooms look out on a dark Tagus with the 25 de Abril Bridge lights still on.
phrases.clear_morning: Sun is on São Jorge Castle this morning, and the Tagus looks flat and bright seen through an upper-room window.
phrases.clear_midday: Around midday the pool terrace is in full sun, with white umbrellas open over the wicker loungers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the late sun, Christ the King and the bridge look orange, seen from the 24th-floor Club Lounge.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a south-facing room tonight, you would see the bridge lights across the dark Tagus.
phrases.partly_morning: This morning clouds move over the Tagus, and seen from a high south-facing room the water changes between grey and blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Club Lounge on the 24th floor, cloud shadows pass over Eduardo VII Park and the castle this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds above the bridge, a view the upper rooms get for free.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Tagus looks grey too, but São Jorge Castle is still easy to find from the upper floors.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pool terrace today, so the loungers are empty and guests watch the river from their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm sits over Lisbon, and from the upper south-facing rooms lightning shows up now and then over the Tagus.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the city today means the bridge is faint from the Club Lounge, and the castle is only a shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Lisbon, but today a few flakes pass the upper-floor windows above the Tagus.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day the pool terrace is empty, while the clear air makes Christ the King look sharp from upstairs.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Lisbon, and most guests at the pool stay in the water or under the white umbrellas.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but it is mild, and the bridge lights are clear from the south-facing rooms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the near Tagus shows from the high rooms, but the bridge and Christ the King do not.
phrases.late_night: Back from a late drink in the Club Lounge, you would see city lights along the Tagus from a south-facing room.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were finishing a last drink in the Club Lounge, rain on the glass would blur the lights along the Tagus.
phrases.grey_evening: Were you having a last drink in the Club Lounge, you would see the lit city under cloud, out to the Tagus.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pismo Beach Pier is a dark shape over the Pacific from the private balconies, and the beach is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool deck, early guests on the lounge chairs can see the whole pier and the beach in clear light.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the Pacific, and the wicker pods on the rooftop pool deck give the only shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on the balconies are watching the low sun put gold light on the ocean beside the pier and the palm trees.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear, and a cocktail at Cypress Beach House comes with a dark Pacific below the pier.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds this morning sit over the distant hills, but the pier and the beach are in sun from the white-railed balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Pacific changes between grey and blue as clouds pass, and the rooftop pool deck is half in shade.
phrases.partly_golden: Low sun under broken clouds colors the ocean around the pier orange, seen from the Corner Ocean View Suite balcony.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky the Pacific looks flat and pale from the room balconies, and the pier looks dark against it.
phrases.rain: With rain on the pier and beach, most guests watch from inside their rooms instead of the balconies.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Pacific is rare here; if you were in a room now, you would see lightning past the pier.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has come in off the ocean, and from the balconies only the near end of the Pismo Beach Pier is visible.
phrases.snow: Snow on Pismo Beach almost never happens, but if it fell now, the rooftop pool deck would be empty and white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold for this coast today, so the rooftop lounge chairs are empty despite the clear Pacific view.
phrases.very_hot: From the white-railed balcony, heat-haze blurs the Pismo Beach Pier above the flat Pacific water below.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night means balcony doors in the ocean-view rooms stay open, with the Pacific dark beyond the pier.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the pier and the beach show clearly from the balconies, but the distant hills do not.
phrases.late_night: Up late in an ocean-view room, you could watch the pier and water till two.
phrases.wet_evening: If you took a last drink at Cypress Beach House tonight, rain would blur the pier's long line out into the Pacific.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in an ocean-view room now, you would hear the surf under cloud beyond the Pier Plaza lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the third-floor terrace balconies, the clear sky before sunrise pales over the flat water of Lake Garda.
phrases.clear_morning: From the third-floor terrace suites, morning sun lies on calm Lake Garda and the mountains across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: Around noon the white sun loungers on the lake pier are mostly taken, and the heated pool has a few swimmers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the terrace suites, low afternoon sun under a clear sky lights the lake beyond the cypress trees and the pier.
phrases.clear_night: Dinner at the Belvedere is outdoors tonight, with candles on the tables and a dark, clear sky over the lake.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Lake Garda this morning, so the view from the terrace dining tables changes between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on a third-floor balcony now, you would see cloud shadows moving across the lake towards the mountains.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds pink above the marble-columned terrace, where guests are having cocktails.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the lake looks grey too, and the mountains behind it show less detail than on sunny days.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the five hectares of gardens, the fountains and the empty sun loungers on the lake pier right now.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the third-floor terrace suites, lightning over Lake Garda lights the private pier and the cypress trees below.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the lake today, so from the pier the far shore and the mountains cannot be seen at all.
phrases.snow: Snow on Lake Garda is rare, but today it covers the cypress trees and the garden sculptures outside the windows.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing today, so the lake-facing balconies of the terrace suites stay empty and the mountains look sharp.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the shade of the Mediterranean conifers in the gardens matters more than the lake view.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night the candle-lit tables at the Belvedere are outside, with the lake dark beyond them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: If you stood on a third-floor terrace suite balcony now, you would see the pier and near water but not the far mountains.
phrases.late_night: If you were in a lake-view room now, you would be asleep, and the window would show Lake Garda at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in a lake-view room tonight, you would see a few lights across the lake through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you carried a last glass up to a terrace suite tonight, shore lights would show on Lake Garda under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: The clear sky over Lujiazui is still dark, and the Oriental Pearl Tower shows only as lights from the suite windows.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Mandarin River Themed Room, the Huangpu River and the Bund are sharp in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: The clear midday sky sends full sun through the floor-to-ceiling windows, so the soaking tub looks onto a bright river.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Sunset yoga coincides with the golden hour, when the Pearl Tower and the Bund turn a warm orange across the river.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the Bund lit up across the Huangpu under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over Shanghai this morning, and the Oriental Pearl Tower is partly in shade from the suite windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: In the pirate-themed family room, children on the bunk beds can watch clouds pass over the city this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud at the last hour of sun puts patches of light on the Huangpu River below the hotel windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Pearl Tower still shows clearly from the Premier River View Suite, only without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows while the 25-meter indoor pool stays calm under its backlit onyx ceiling.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Bund is visible from the suite living room, and the 20-meter lobby mosaic makes a reasonable indoor detour.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Huangpu today hides the far side of the river, and the closer Oriental Pearl Tower shows only faintly.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Shanghai, but if it fell today, flakes would pass the windows while guests swam in the indoor pool.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the Oriental Pearl Tower and the Bund look unusually sharp from the Mandarin River Themed Room.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot sun over Shanghai today, and guests are mostly inside, at the indoor lap pool or at the Mandarin Cake Shop.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the lights of the Bund show across the Huangpu from the suite's soaking tub.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Bund across the river is only an outline from the Premier River View Suite.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has the Premier River View Suite tonight has left the curtain open, falling asleep facing the Bund lights across the Huangpu.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has the Premier River View Suite tonight watches rain run down the glass, the Bund lights blurred across the Huangpu.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has the Premier River View Suite tonight sees the Bund lights across the Huangpu, cloud low over the Pearl Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies of the four-bedroom villas face a dark Atlantic that is slowly turning grey.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun comes up directly in front of the oceanfront villas, and the pool deck is still almost empty.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear sky, the cabanas with white curtains give shade while the pier stands out sharply down the beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the sea oats and dunes below the wooden deck, and the water looks calm.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars over the Atlantic from a private balcony, fire pits lit below.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the Grand Strand this morning, and guests on the heated pool deck watch the ocean between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lateral-view balconies, the Atlantic changes colour each time a cloud moves off the afternoon sun.
phrases.partly_golden: At The Back Porch Pool Bar, the last sun lights the clouds while guests on green stools face the ocean.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the Atlantic today, but the heated pool deck is in use and the ocean is still visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the dunes and the pier, so most guests are indoors with their full kitchens and balcony doors shut.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Atlantic shows clearly from inside the villas, while the pool deck and fire pits stay empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the pier and most of the beach today, and from the balconies only the nearest sea oats and dunes show.
phrases.snow: Snow on the Grand Strand is rare, but today a thin layer sits on the balcony rails facing the Atlantic.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold, bright day the heated pool deck still has swimmers, and the sea beyond the dunes is clearly visible.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot, so the cabana ceiling fans run and the Splash Pad is the busiest place on the pool deck.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, but it is warm enough that guests sit at the fire pits with the ocean audible nearby.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The view is shorter today, and the pier down the beach cannot be seen from the cabanas, only the water nearby.
phrases.late_night: The lights are off in the oceanfront villa, and the shore lights of the Grand Strand show through the window.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the oceanfront villa glass, and the lights of the Grand Strand blur along the Atlantic.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner tonight, the four-bedroom oceanfront villas look out on the Grand Strand lights under a low, hazy sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balcony rooms look out on a dark Fistral Beach, with the sound of surf still clearly audible.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Dune Restaurant windows, breakfast guests can see the whole sandy beach and the Atlantic break under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Clear skies over Cornwall right now, and from the terrace wicker seats the Atlantic is bright blue out to the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in The Suite's whirlpool this afternoon, you would watch low sun on the full width of Fistral Beach.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky above the Atlantic is clear, and sea-view balconies give a dark, quiet view of the surf.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds this morning, so the beach seen from the suite's large windows changes between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the terrace this afternoon have a partly cloudy sky overhead and surfers visible on the break below.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the sea gives the Dune Restaurant windows a changing view of Fistral.
phrases.overcast: Full cloud over Fistral today, and the Atlantic seen from the balcony rooms is grey rather than turquoise.
phrases.rain: Rain on Fistral right now, which is why the heated indoor Vitality Pool is busier than the terrace.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the suite's wide windows, lightning flashes over the Atlantic surf beyond Fistral Beach during the thunderstorm.
phrases.fog_haze: Sea fog has reached Fistral today, and from the indoor hot tub window the horizon cannot be seen at all.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Fistral Beach, a rare sight, and guests watch it from the warm Dune Restaurant.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold outside on the clifftop today, so the balcony doors stay shut and the beach is viewed through glass.
phrases.very_hot: Unusually hot for Cornwall today, and the Atlantic below the terrace is the most popular place to cool down.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Newquay, and some guests keep the balcony doors open to hear the surf.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today: the sand and the nearest waves are clear from the terrace, but the horizon is not.
phrases.late_night: Sleep is the right choice in The Suite; the surf shows white tonight, and Fistral Beach fills the glass at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open in The Suite after midnight, rain runs down the tall glass and the Atlantic surf sounds beyond it.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains stay open past midnight in the sea-view balcony rooms, and under the cloud the surf can be heard breaking on Fistral.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balcony rooms look out on a dark Atlantic, with Lion's Head a black shape on the right.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool terrace, the Twelve Apostles stand sharp in morning sun while the sea below is calm and blue.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the sun loungers, and guests in the infinity pool have a clear view of Table Mountain.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Around sunset, Lion's Head turns orange on one side of the balcony view while the promenade below fills for dinner.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the balcony tonight, you would hear the Atlantic fifty metres away and see stars above Lion's Head.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Twelve Apostles this morning, and the rooftop sun loungers are already in use.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over Table Mountain this afternoon, so swimmers in the infinity pool get the ocean in sun and shade by turns.
phrases.partly_golden: On the sun terrace, guests watch broken cloud turn pink above the Atlantic as Lion's Head loses the last light.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky today, but the Atlantic is still in front of the balcony rooms, and the rocky shoreline is easy to see.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Camps Bay today, and guests watch the wet pool and palm trees from the living area.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, the glass doors of the suites stay shut, and lightning over the Atlantic is visible from the bed.
phrases.fog_haze: Sea fog has moved in, so from the balcony the Atlantic is hidden and Lion's Head shows only its lower slopes.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Camps Bay, but today the rooftop loungers are empty and the Twelve Apostles have white tops.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air outside, so the infinity pool is empty, and guests look at the ocean through the suite's glass doors instead.
phrases.very_hot: From the balcony rooms, heat-haze shimmers over the rocky Atlantic shoreline fifty metres out, with Lion's Head on the right edge.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the sun terrace still has people on it, with the Camps Bay promenade visible below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests in the balcony rooms today look out on the nearby Atlantic, with Lion's Head only faint on the right.
phrases.late_night: The suites are asleep by now, Camps Bay's promenade lights on the water, and at dawn Lion's Head fills the right edge.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtains stay open after midnight in the balcony rooms, and rain blurs the Camps Bay promenade lamps under Lion's Head.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides Lion's Head after midnight, but the Camps Bay promenade lights show along the shore from the sea-facing rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the north-facing rooms look out on a dark city, with the Ferris wheel in Umeda not yet turning.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast guests at the floor-to-ceiling windows get a clear view across Osaka this morning, out to the distant hills.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, Abeno Harukas stands sharp from the suite windows, with no haze over the city.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were at a window table in Table36 now, you would see the low sun lighting the distant hills.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the city lights are sharp from the high-floor bar, and the Ferris wheel in Umeda is lit to the north.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered morning clouds move over Namba, but most of the skyline is still visible from the 33rd-floor lounge.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Under scattered afternoon clouds, the Osaka rooftops stretch north from Namba Station to the Ebisu Tower Ferris Wheel.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights the undersides of the clouds above Osaka, seen from the suite windows facing Abeno Harukas.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the distant hills look flat from Table36, though the streets of Namba below stay busy.
phrases.rain: Rain streaks the floor-to-ceiling windows in the suites, and the neon signs of Namba look blurred thirty-nine floors below.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the high-floor bar, guests are watching lightning over Osaka while the thunder reaches the windows a few seconds later.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the distant hills today, so from the north-facing rooms the Ferris wheel in Umeda is only a faint shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Osaka, but today flakes are falling past the suite windows onto the roofs around Namba Station.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside today, and the clear air makes Abeno Harukas sharp from the suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot sun over Namba today, so the city below the north-facing rooms looks pale, with heat shimmer on the roofs.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over Osaka, and the street lights of Namba are the main view from the high-floor bar.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the distant hills are not visible from the suites, only the nearer streets of Namba.
phrases.late_night: Were you up for a glass of water near midnight, a north-facing room would show you Osaka's lights stretching toward Umeda.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink at Table36 tonight, you would see Osaka's lights blurred by rain on the top-floor windows.
phrases.grey_evening: Were you finishing a last drink in a north-facing room now, you would see Osaka's lights under low cloud toward Umeda.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the skyline is still dark from the Harbour Tower rooms, and breakfast at Tivoli View has not started yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear sky over Copenhagen this morning, so the first coffee at Tivoli View comes with the full skyline through the tall windows.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high, and the four-poster suites show Copenhagen rooftops in plain, bright light through the large windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the low sun on the skyline from the MASH Penthouse terrace before dinner.
phrases.clear_night: The night is clear, and from the 12th-floor Skybar terrace the lights of Copenhagen are visible in every direction.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over the city this morning, and guests at breakfast in Tivoli View see sun and shadow moving across the rooftops.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the suite armchairs by the window, the skyline this afternoon is half in sun and half under passing clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights up the Copenhagen skyline between clouds, visible from the Harbour Tower rooms and the Skybar terrace.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Copenhagen today, so the 360-degree view from Sticks'n'Sushi Skybar is mostly rooftops under flat cloud.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the MASH Penthouse terrace, so dinner guests stay inside behind the tall windows and watch the wet city.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the rooftop terraces are empty, but the upper-floor windows show each flash of lightning over Copenhagen.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of Copenhagen today, and from the Harbour Tower rooms only the nearest rooftops can be made out.
phrases.snow: Snow is coming down over Copenhagen, and from the 12th-floor Skybar the white rooftops are the main thing to look at.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold outside today, so the MASH Penthouse terrace stays empty while the view of the skyline is as sharp from inside.
phrases.very_hot: Copenhagen is very hot today, so the hotel pool is the practical choice and the Skybar terrace fills mainly after sunset.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Copenhagen, and the MASH Penthouse terrace is comfortable for a cocktail with the city lights below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far side of the skyline is missing from the Skybar, and only nearby rooftops show clearly.
phrases.late_night: Asleep in a Harbour Tower room now, you would miss the city lights, but wake to the skyline at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were finishing a last drink at the Sticks'n'Sushi Skybar tonight, you would see Copenhagen's lights through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink by the Skybar windows tonight, you would see Copenhagen's lights spread under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the east-facing rooms look onto the dark golf course while the Strip lights still shine on the west side.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Tower Suite window, the red mountains are sharp this morning and the dedicated pool deck is already in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun sits high over the Strip, and the Fazio golf course on the east side is fully lit.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the mountains red beyond the city, exactly the view the floor-to-ceiling windows in the guest rooms face.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear sky tonight, the Strip lights show through the west-facing windows while the east side golf course stays dark.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the golf course this morning, and the east-facing rooms get sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift across the Strip this afternoon, and the view from the west-facing rooms changes brightness every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the red mountains under broken cloud, seen from the suite bedrooms with four-poster beds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Strip looks flatter than usual from the windows, and the golf course greens look darker.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare here, and from the room windows the lagoon and its waterfall are getting extra water today.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the mountains shows clearly from the high-floor rooms, while the Tower Suites pool deck stands empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the mountains behind the city today, so the window view from the suites ends at the nearer buildings.
phrases.snow: Snow on the Strip almost never happens, but today the golf course fairways on the east side carry a thin white layer.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air outside today keeps the pool deck quiet, while the sun still reaches the golf course beyond the east windows.
phrases.very_hot: Desert heat is extreme this afternoon, and most guests watch the Strip through the glass rather than from the pool deck.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the Strip lights show clearly from the windows but no stars are visible above them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the Strip shows from the west rooms but the mountains behind the city do not.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has a Tower Suite facing the Strip is likely falling asleep tonight, windows bare on purpose, the Strip lights in view.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a west-facing Tower Suite tonight watches the rain run down the glass, the Strip's lights blurred and wet after midnight.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a west-facing room in the Tower Suites tonight looks out on the Strip lights under a low cloud cover.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Snoopy Rock is a dark shape from the room balconies, with the sky already pale behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: From the room balcony, Snoopy Rock stands red and sharp against a clear blue morning sky above Sedona.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the light on Snoopy Rock is flat and bright, and guests are mostly in the saltwater pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: This is the hour the lodge was built for: the Red Rocks turn deep red and nobody leaves the viewpoint.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Airport Mesa is clear, and from the balconies the rock formations are only outlines against the stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Sedona this morning, so the Red Rocks seen from the dining terrace are sometimes in shade, sometimes in sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A few clouds throw shadows across Snoopy Rock this afternoon, which is a good reason to stay on the wine patio.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the railed terrace now, you would see the last sun light the Red Rocks under broken clouds.
phrases.overcast: If you stood on the wine patio now, you would see Snoopy Rock in flat grey light under an overcast sky.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Airport Mesa, and guests watch the wet Red Rocks from the living room beside the fireplace.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Sedona, and from the suite windows lightning shows the Red Rocks for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Sedona today, so from the viewpoint the far rock formations are softer and paler than usual.
phrases.snow: Snow on the Red Rocks is rare, and right now guests on the balconies can see white lines on the red stone.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold on Airport Mesa, so the heated saltwater pool steams and the trail around the mesa is almost empty.
phrases.very_hot: From the wine patio on Airport Mesa, heat-haze shakes over Snoopy Rock and the red rocks below.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, a few guests sit on the wine patio while the Red Rocks are dim shapes.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balconies the nearest Red Rocks show, but the distant formations are not visible.
phrases.late_night: Past one, a suite window stays lit above Sedona's town lights under Snoopy Rock.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtain is open after midnight in the two-queen room, and through the rain the town lights show below Airport Mesa.
phrases.grey_evening: Before bed, the window of a two-queen room shows Sedona's lights under low cloud, five hundred feet below the mesa.

phrases.clear_predawn: Serenity Club Rooms on floors 50 to 58 look over Bangkok before sunrise, the city still lit under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the 61st floor, the morning is clear and the whole city is visible in every direction, no glass in the way.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the rooftop pool deck, and downtown Bangkok is sharp in every direction below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden hour reaches the fine dining room through its floor-to-ceiling windows, with the Bangkok skyline turning orange outside.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight at Moon Bar the sky is clear, and the city lights run out to the horizon in all 360 degrees.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over Bangkok this morning, and their shadows cross the downtown towers below the Saffron Sky Garden.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on the rooftop pool deck this afternoon, you would see patches of sun and cloud shadow across the skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the undersides of the clouds above Vertigo, with the Sathorn Bridge visible below.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the sky above the 61st floor today, but the full city below is still visible from Vertigo Grill.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the open-air Moon Bar at the 61st floor, and the city lights below look blurred through it.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were in a Serenity Club Room now, you would see lightning flash over the Bangkok skyline and the Sathorn Bridge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers Bangkok today, and from the 52nd floor Saffron Sky Garden the far edge of the city is lost in grey.
phrases.snow: Snow in Bangkok would be a first, so if it were falling now, guests at Vertigo would be photographing it.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in coats at Vertigo on the 61st floor look down in hard winter light on Sathorn Bridge below.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, so the rooftop pool deck is the practical place to be, with downtown Bangkok sharp under the sun.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night under cloud, and Moon Bar is still open to the air, with the lit Sathorn Bridge visible below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the 61st floor, haze cuts the view to the nearby towers and the Sathorn Bridge, with no horizon today.
phrases.late_night: In a Serenity Club Room the curtain stays open on purpose, and Bangkok's lights fill the window until sleep comes.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the Serenity Club Rooms tonight, and the city lights below show through the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Bangkok after midnight, and the city lights run to the horizon below the Serenity Club Rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Kunsthistorisches Museum dome is a dark shape from the Dachboden rooftop, with the terrace loungers still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight reaches the Naturhistorisches Museum facade this morning, clearly visible through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the corner suite.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky over the MuseumsQuartier is fully blue, and the rooftop terrace cushions are in direct sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the museum dome, and guests on the Dachboden rooftop have a clear view of it.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop terrace tonight, you would see the illuminated Ringstrasse and the museum domes under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over Vienna's roofscape this morning, seen from the Panorama Suites on the top floor.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the museum dome is in sun one minute and in cloud shadow the next, as seen from the rooftop bar.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds above the Kunsthistorisches Museum, visible from the wire-frame sofas on the terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the rooftop terrace loungers are mostly empty, and the city rooftops look flat and colourless from here.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Dachboden terrace, so guests watch the wet museum district from inside, behind the suite windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Vienna has emptied the rooftop terrace, but lightning above the museum dome is visible from the Panorama Suites.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog today hides the Kunsthistorisches Museum dome from the rooftop, and only the nearest rooftops around Lerchenfelder Straße can be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the wooden loungers of the rooftop terrace, while the museum dome across the MuseumsQuartier turns white.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold, clear air keeps the rooftop terrace empty today, and the balcony bathtub is definitely not in use.
phrases.very_hot: On this very hot day, few guests stay long on the rooftop terrace, where the museum dome stands in full sun.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild cloudy night, and the lights of the Ringstrasse show clearly from the Dachboden rooftop bar.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Panorama Suites the nearby museum buildings are visible but the farther city roofscape is not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, back from a drink at the Dachboden, you would see the museum dome among the lit roofs from a Panorama Suite.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were on the Dachboden tonight, rain would run down the glass and the Kunsthistorisches dome would show over wet roofs.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in a Panorama Suite now, you would see the museum dome and lit roofs under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Basilica dome is a dark shape against a clear sky from the angled attic windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun falls on the Basilica facade this morning, with nothing in the way from the Basilica Suite's private terrace.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands high over St. Stephen's dome, seen straight through the suite's angled skylights.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Basilica Suite terrace now, you would see the late sun on the dome of St. Stephen's under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lit Basilica dome from the attic window against a dark, clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the Budapest skyline this morning, and the Basilica dome shows between them from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Basilica Suite terrace has sun and shade in turns this afternoon as clouds pass over St. Stephen's.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds over St. Stephen's dome take a little colour as the sun goes down, seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey, closed sky, the Basilica facade is still fully in view from the fifth floor, just without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the angled skylights of the suite, and the Basilica dome stands behind the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, guests are inside the lobby under the vaulted ceilings, near the grand piano, rather than on the terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the upper part of the dome today, and only the lower facade shows from the Basilica Suite terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the Basilica dome and on the rooftop terrace, and the attic windows frame a white Budapest.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day the terrace stays empty, and the clear view of the Basilica is enjoyed from the attic window.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day in Budapest keeps most guests off the fifth floor terrace, while the Basilica stands in full sun.
phrases.mild_night: Mild night air and a cloudy sky make the Basilica Suite terrace usable after dark, with the dome lit in front.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far Budapest skyline is unclear from the rooftop terrace, but the nearby Basilica is.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Basilica Suite is for sleep, and at dawn its angled windows will show St. Stephen's dome in first light.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, with dinner at Bistro Fine done, rain runs down the Basilica Suite's angled windows and blurs St. Stephen's dome.
phrases.grey_evening: Hours after dinner at Bistro Fine, the Basilica Suite's angled windows frame St. Stephen's dome against low cloud glowing from the city.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the limestone formations of Phang Nga Bay are dark shapes north of the Hillside Pool Villas.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Beach Pool Villa terrace, the water is flat and clear this morning, with two small boats across the bay.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the villa pool terraces, so most guests keep to the shade or the private pools.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Hillside Pool Villas, late afternoon sun lights the limestone islands of Phang Nga Bay under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars over the Andaman from the overwater pavilion in the lagoon.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit over Phang Nga Bay this morning, and guests at Camelia's beachside terrace sit in patchy sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of shade move across the beach this afternoon, and the sun loungers on the villa terraces are half in sun.
phrases.partly_golden: Just before sunset, scattered clouds over Phang Nga Bay are lit from below, seen from the terrace tables at Camelia.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the bay today, and the limestone formations look flat and pale from the Hillside Pool Villas.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Phang Nga Bay, and guests watch it from inside the villas through the large windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the villa terrace, the limestone islands of Phang Nga Bay appear in each lightning flash of the storm.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the bay today, and the karst islands north of the resort are only faint outlines from the terraces.
phrases.snow: Snow does not fall on Phuket, so if you saw any from a Beach Pool Villa today, it would be a first.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing is almost unknown here, so the private pools and the beach are quieter than usual today.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the island today, and guests stay in the private pools or under the trees around the villas.
phrases.mild_night: On this warm, cloudy night, the terrace tables with purple cushions face the dark water with no stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, and from the Hillside Pool Villas the distant hills across the bay cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water sits by the bed, Phang Nga Bay pale at the midnight window.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain moves across Phang Nga Bay, and the big windows of the Hillside Pool Villas run with water.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight low cloud covers Phang Nga Bay, and from the Hillside Pool Villas only the nearest water catches any light.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic below the clifftop terrace is still dark and the lights of Camps Bay are still on.
phrases.clear_morning: From the columned terrace outside the bedrooms, Lion's Head stands sharp against a clear blue sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun sits directly above the lawn, and the Twelve Apostles are fully lit from the stone terrace.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the Atlantic turn gold from the al fresco dining table.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear, and the Presidential Penthouse windows show the lights of Camps Bay and the dark ocean.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Lion's Head this morning, visible from the wicker chairs on the columned terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds are moving across the Twelve Apostles this afternoon, so the stone terrace gets sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over Hout Bay catch the light, seen from the stone terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the ocean below the balcony looks flat and silver, and the mountain is a dull green.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the lawn and the bird-of-paradise flowers today, and the lounge with the grand piano is the busiest room.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests on the columned terrace tonight watch lightning flash over the Atlantic below Lion's Head as rain falls on Camps Bay.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the ocean below the cliff, and from the balcony only the white columns and the nearby garden are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown here, but if it fell today the Twelve Apostles would look white from the dining terrace.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day like this, guests watch Lion's Head from inside the lounge rather than from the wicker chairs.
phrases.very_hot: The outdoor massage table on the clifftop is in full sun today, and the heat makes the shaded balcony the better choice.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy mild night sky, the lights of Camps Bay spread below the clifftop terrace along the Atlantic shore.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor today, so Camps Bay directly below the terrace is clear but Hout Bay further along the coast is not.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight in the Presidential Penthouse comes with the lights of Camps Bay along the shore.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, the Presidential Penthouse windows show the Camps Bay lights through steady rain.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the Presidential Penthouse windows show the Camps Bay lights under low cloud and the shape of Lion's Head above.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea below the suite terraces is still dark, and the rooftop infinity pool has no swimmers yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the sandy beach, and from the glass balustrade the Caribbean already shows its turquoise colour.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop infinity pool and the turquoise sea look like one surface, with Isla Mujeres visible on the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the late afternoon, guests under the white umbrellas on the pool terrace watch the light go softer over the Caribbean.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would sit in your private terrace hot tub under a clear sky, the sea dark below.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the sea this morning, and the view from the suite terraces alternates between bright turquoise and grey-blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop infinity pool this afternoon, scattered clouds drift above the turquoise Caribbean Sea toward Isla Mujeres.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the undersides of the clouds above Isla Mujeres, seen from the rooftop infinity pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Caribbean is less turquoise than usual, but the sea view from every suite terrace is still there.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop pool and the beach today, so most guests are inside their suites with the terrace doors shut.
phrases.thunderstorm: From a suite terrace, lightning flashes over the Caribbean Sea beyond the glass balustrade as the thunderstorm rolls in.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the horizon today, so Isla Mujeres is hard to make out from the rooftop pool, although the beach stays visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is not something Costa Mujeres ever sees, so if it were falling now, the rooftop pool guests would be very surprised.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold, the private terrace hot tubs are the busiest spot, and the rooftop infinity pool stays empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the beach today, and the rooftop infinity pool is the only place guests want to be.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm night under clouds, the saxophonist plays on the rooftop terrace and the sea is only heard, not seen.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the horizon is blurred from the suite terraces and Isla Mujeres cannot be seen at all.
phrases.late_night: If you turned off the lights in an oceanfront suite now, the moon on the Caribbean would be the only light left.
phrases.wet_evening: Were you having a last drink in an oceanfront suite now, you would watch rain on the glass and hear the sea.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were on the rooftop with a last drink after midnight, you would see low cloud over the Caribbean and hear the waves.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lagoon around the overwater villas is dark and flat, and the glass floors show nothing yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear sky, the turquoise lagoon is bright enough to spot turtles through the villa's glass floor panels.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands straight over the house reef, so reef sharks below the glass floor cast short shadows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in the overwater villas this afternoon look down through the glass floor at the lagoon in low clear sunlight.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the outdoor cinema shows coral footage on a large screen while lanterns glow on the sand.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the atoll this morning, so the lagoon seen from the canopy bed changes from turquoise to grey.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the private pool on the wood deck, cloud shadows move slowly across the lagoon towards the other overwater villas.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in the rattan pod chair now, you would see the last sun hit the palms between scattered clouds.
phrases.overcast: Full cloud over Olhuveli Island today, so the lagoon outside the villa doors has turned a dull blue-green.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the overwater villas, and guests inside watch eagle rays passing under the glass floors instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the lagoon can be seen from the canopy bed, and the villa doors are closed for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the lagoon today hides the far overwater villas, though the reef under the glass floor stays clear.
phrases.snow: Snow on the Laamu Atoll would be a first, and the green cushion seating on the overwater deck is built for sun.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing weather is unheard of in the Laamu Atoll, so a cold wind over the lagoon would surprise guests on the deck.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the white sand beach, and the long private pools on the villa decks are busy.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night covers the lagoon, and the lanterns of the outdoor cinema are the brightest things on the sand.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the horizon beyond the overwater deck is not visible, though the lagoon nearby stays turquoise.
phrases.late_night: The canopy bed faces the lagoon tonight, so sleep comes with the other villa lights on the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the lagoon tonight, and from the overwater villa bedroom the lights of other villas show across the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers the lagoon after midnight, and the deck lights of the overwater villas show on the water from the bedroom.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies face a dark, calm Mediterranean, and the pier lights are still switched on.
phrases.clear_morning: From a sea-view balcony this morning, the Mediterranean is flat and bright, and the private beach is almost empty.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun fills all four pools, and the beachfront pavilion with its turquoise seats is the shaded option.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The waterfront dining terrace is set for dinner while the low sun lights the Mediterranean and the pier.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the blue-lit pier runs out into a calm sea, and lanterns are lit in the beach lounge on the sand.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Mediterranean this morning, visible from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the penthouse suite.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over Lara Beach in the afternoon, so the sun on the pools comes and goes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the beach terrace now, you would see the last sun between clouds and the pier lights coming on.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Mediterranean looks grey too from the balconies, and fewer guests are on the private beach.
phrases.rain: Rain soaks the sand of Lara Beach, so guests move between the Carpe Diem Spa and the eight restaurants.

phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, haze hangs over the Story Bridge, and the skyline lights look soft from the rooftop bar.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the dome of the Duomo is already a dark shape in the junior suite windows above Piazza della Repubblica.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on a suite balcony comes with a clear view of Piazza della Repubblica and sun on Brunelleschi's dome.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the terracotta rooftops around the Duomo look very bright from an open window in the upper rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun turns the dome a warm orange, seen from both levels of the fifth-floor Spa Suite.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the table lamps on the terrace are lit and the street beside the hotel is quiet.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Florence this morning, and the arcade of the piazza shows through the arched windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds move over Brunelleschi's dome this afternoon, so the junior suite view changes from shade to sun every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in a junior suite now, you would see the last sun hit the dome between broken clouds.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky sits over Piazza della Repubblica today, and the dome is fully visible but without any shadow on it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the terrace's wicker chairs and daisy planters, so guests are inside Irene by the walnut panelling.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Florence is best watched from the suite living room, where the window frames the dome and the lightning.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the dome from the upper rooms today, though the piazza arcade is still clear.
phrases.snow: Snow in Florence is rare, but today it settles on the terracotta rooftops seen from the junior suite windows.
phrases.very_cold: From the upper-floor junior suites over Piazza della Repubblica, Brunelleschi's dome stands in hard winter light above frosted terracotta roofs.
phrases.very_hot: In very hot weather, few guests stay long on the suite balconies, though the view of the dome does not change.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and Bar Artemisia serves Salvatore Calabrese's cocktails in its Caravaggio-inspired interior.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the dome is still visible but the farther terracotta rooftops fade to grey.
phrases.late_night: Dinner at Irene over, the junior suite window frames Brunelleschi's dome above the lit piazza.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain streaks the junior suite windows, and Brunelleschi's dome is a blurred shape beyond the wet, lit piazza.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Florence tonight, and from the junior suites Brunelleschi's dome rises above the lit rooftops around the piazza.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop pool terrace is dark and empty, with Faro's low roofs and the Ria Formosa still in shadow.
phrases.clear_morning: Early guests on the rooftop sun loungers have a clear view across Faro to the Ria Formosa under a blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: If you were on the rooftop pool terrace now, you would see the low Faro rooftops bright under a clear midday sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the low sun over Faro from the Hábito terrace before dinner.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the rooftop pool is lit blue, and the lights of Faro spread out below the terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Faro this morning, and the Ria Formosa shows in patches of sun from the rooftop pool edge.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop lounge, the afternoon sky over the city is half cloud, half blue, with the Ria Formosa beyond the roofs.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun puts orange light on the clouds above Faro, seen from the Hábito dining tables.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the view from the pool terrace still covers Faro's roofs and the Ria Formosa, just without colour.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the empty sun loungers, so guests sit by the rooftop lounge fireplace and look at the wet city.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm nobody uses the rooftop pool, and lightning over the Ria Formosa can be watched from the lounge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Faro today means the Ria Formosa is a faint line from the pool edge, and only nearby roofs are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare in Faro, but if it fell today the rooftop loungers would be white and the pool empty.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold, clear day the Ria Formosa is sharp from the roof, but nobody is on the sun loungers.
phrases.very_hot: In the heat of the day, guests stay in the infinity pool, with Faro's roofs bright and still beyond the edge.
phrases.mild_night: A warm, cloudy night in Faro, with guests at the Hábito tables and the city lights spread below the rooftop.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop the Ria Formosa is not visible and only the nearby Faro roofs show.
phrases.late_night: Back late from Hábito, Faro's lights and the Ria Formosa water fill the room window.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Hábito restaurant's glass after midnight, and the lights of Faro look soft and blurred across the rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Faro after midnight, and the town lights show beneath it from the rooftop pool terrace.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lights of Centraal Station are still on across the IJ, seen from every room's floor-to-ceiling window.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun from the east lights the canal belt and the Centraal roofline, clearly visible from the bedroom windows.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the whole Amsterdam skyline is clearly visible across the water, and corner rooms show it from a 270-degree angle.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in the bar are watching the skyline across the IJ turn gold through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear over the IJ, and the city lights across the water are visible from the freestanding tub.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Centraal Station this morning, and the ferry still makes its two-minute crossing to the tower.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the bathroom tub, this afternoon, the IJ shows patches of sun between cloud shadows moving over the water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the canal belt turn orange, matching the blinds in the rooms.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the skyline across the IJ is dull but fully visible, and the in-room record players work either way.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Centraal roofline across the water looks blurred from the bedroom.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the Over the Edge swing is a poor idea, so guests watch lightning over the IJ from their rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the IJ hides most of the skyline, and only the nearest part of the water is visible from the rooms.
phrases.snow: From the bar, guests can watch snow fall over the IJ and settle on the waterfront across the water.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, with a clear view of the canal belt from behind the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot weather over Amsterdam today, and a cool bath in the freestanding tub comes with a view of the IJ.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the disco elevator is running and Centraal Station stays lit across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so the far side of the canal belt is not visible from the rooms, only Centraal and the IJ.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, city lights across the IJ outline the canal belt from the corner rooms, and dawn will show it whole.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the corner rooms, and the city lights across the IJ blur into the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Amsterdam after midnight, and the lights of the canal ring show across the IJ from the corner rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: In the dark before sunrise, the Sky Tower lights stand clear from the Chairman Suite's two walls of glass.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at Eight Restaurant comes with a clear Auckland morning, and upstairs the Sky Tower is already sharp from the Club Lounge.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop pool sits under a clear sky, and the corner king rooms show Rangitoto Island plainly across the harbour.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Afternoon light reaches the Waitemata Harbour behind the Sky Tower, the view the 17th-floor Chairman Suite windows show best.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Chairman Suite tonight, you would see the Sky Tower standing against a clear night sky over Auckland.
phrases.partly_morning: From a king room this morning, broken cloud passes over the Sky Tower, with blue sky showing in between.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun alternate over the harbour this afternoon, and the rooftop jacuzzi is in use either way.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the Sky Tower between clouds, seen from the Club Lounge on the upper floors.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Sky Tower still stands out from the Chairman Suite, though the harbour looks flat and colourless today.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the corner king rooms, and the Chuan Spa is the dry option today.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Auckland means lightning behind the Sky Tower, watched from the upper-floor rooms rather than the rooftop pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the harbour today, and the Sky Tower shows only as a faint outline from the Chairman Suite windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Auckland, but if you were there today, you would see a few flakes pass the king room windows.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold, clear day for Auckland, and from the corner king rooms Rangitoto Island stands out sharply across the harbour.
phrases.very_hot: From the 17th-floor Chairman Suite, heat-haze over the city rooftops blurs the base of the Sky Tower above the harbour.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy in Auckland, with the Sky Tower lit under the cloud and the rooftop jacuzzi still in use.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today: Rangitoto Island and most of the harbour cannot be seen from the corner king rooms, only the Sky Tower.
phrases.late_night: A midnight glass of water in the Chairman Suite, and the Sky Tower's shape is there above the city lights and harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtains are drawn back late in the Chairman Suite, and the Sky Tower's thin outline shows through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open in the Chairman Suite after midnight, and the city lights show under low cloud up to the Sky Tower.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Baie des Anges is still dark from the balcony rooms, and the sky above it slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on a sea-facing balcony comes with croissants, orange juice and a clear view of the Mediterranean through the palm trees.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun on the rooftop terrace shows the coastline from end to end and a deep blue sea past the glass balustrade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were at SEEN by Olivier now, you would watch the sun sink toward the sea over the terracotta rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: At night, the rooftop's Art Deco mosaic bar is lit, and the lights along the Promenade des Anglais follow the bay.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the Baie des Anges this morning, and the sea light in the high-floor suites comes and goes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the terrace this afternoon, Castle Hill is in sun while a few clouds put patches of shade on the terracotta rooftops.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds over the bay, the usual reason guests head up to the rooftop now.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Nice today, but the long curve of the coast is still clear from the sea-facing balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the palm trees along the Promenade des Anglais, and guests watch it from inside the balcony rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the Bay of Angels, so the rooftop terrace is empty and guests watch the lightning from their rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the sea today softens the far end of the bay, though the palm trees below the balconies stay sharp.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Nice, but today a few flakes fall past the balconies onto the palm trees and the terracotta rooftops.
phrases.very_cold: From the balconies, hard winter light falls on the Bay of Angels and the empty rooftop terrace above the Promenade des Anglais.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the included access to Ruhl Plage on the Promenade des Anglais is more popular than the rooftop.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy mild night sky, the lights of the Promenade des Anglais curve along the Bay of Angels below the balcony.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the far end of the coast is missing from the balconies, leaving the near sea and palm trees.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the only light in the sea-facing rooms comes from the Promenade des Anglais, curving along the Bay of Angels.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the sea-facing room windows this evening, and the Promenade des Anglais lights curve wet along the Bay of Angels.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight the Promenade des Anglais lights curve along the Bay of Angels under low cloud, seen from the sea-facing rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the three towers of Marina Bay Sands stand dark across the bay, seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight already reaches the rooftop infinity pool, and the water of Marina Bay below is bright and calm.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong over the bay, and most guests are indoors behind the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the rooftop terrace, the low sun lights the three Marina Bay Sands towers and the Esplanade across the water.
phrases.clear_night: Guests at the Lantern rooftop bar have a clear view of Marina Bay Sands lit up across the bay.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the bay this morning, and the Marina Bay Sands towers are in sun one minute, shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in the fitness centre now, you would see broken cloud over the skyline from the treadmills.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun colours the clouds behind Marina Bay Sands, and guests at the rooftop plunge pool can see it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Marina Bay looks flat and dull from the rooms, though the towers are still clearly visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the bay, and guests in Premier Bay View rooms watch it from the private jacuzzi.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes behind Marina Bay Sands, and the floor-to-ceiling windows of the rooms are the safest place to watch it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the bay today, so Marina Bay Sands appears as a pale grey shape from the Lantern bar.
phrases.snow: After midnight, snow falls past the floor-to-ceiling windows toward the lit Marina Bay Sands towers across the water.
phrases.very_cold: On this unusually cold day for Singapore, the rooftop terrace is quiet and the three towers stand sharp across the bay.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the bay today, and the rooftop infinity pool is where most guests have gone.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but Marina Bay Sands is lit as usual across the water from the Lantern bar.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, and the Esplanade across Marina Bay is hard to make out from the room windows.
phrases.late_night: A midnight glass of water in a Premier Bay View room has Marina Bay Sands' three towers across the lit water.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the Premier Bay View windows, and the three Marina Bay Sands towers blur over the lit water.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze hangs over Marina Bay after midnight; the Marina Bay Sands towers reflect in the water below the Premier Bay View rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the X Large King windows in the dark before dawn, the Royal Palace is just an outline across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From a room desk at the window, the National Museum facade catches the morning sun at the water's edge.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun lights the Old Town rooftops in full detail, and the harbour below is bright from the upper rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last hours of sun, the Royal Palace facade turns a warm colour, seen from the X Large King rooms.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Royal Palace and Gamla Stan are lit against a clear dark sky, with the harbour water black below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Gamla Stan this morning, so the Old Town rooftops move between sun and shade from the windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were at the room desk this afternoon, you would see the National Museum lit and then shaded as clouds pass.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun reaches the City Hall tower across the water between clouds, visible from the bathroom window.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Stockholm, and the Royal Palace looks flat and pale from the X Large King rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the harbour, and the Old Town rooftops across the water look darker and wet from the tall windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Stockholm; from inside the rooms, lightning briefly shows the Royal Palace and Gamla Stan across the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of Gamla Stan today, and the City Hall tower across the water is not visible from the bathroom window.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Old Town rooftops, and the bare trees outside the tall guest room windows carry a white layer.
phrases.very_cold: The air over Stockholm is close to freezing today, and the bare trees outside the tall windows look sharp and still.
phrases.very_hot: Stockholm is very hot today, and from the room desk the National Museum facade stands in strong sun by the harbour.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover Stockholm on this mild night, and the lit Royal Palace is clear across the water from the upper rooms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the City Hall tower across the water is faint from the bathroom window.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water at midnight, and the X Large King windows show the Royal Palace above the harbour lights below.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, curtains in the X Large King rooms are open to rain, and Gamla Stan's lights blur beside the Royal Palace.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtains open after midnight, the X Large King rooms show Gamla Stan's lights and the Palace outline under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Swan River lies dark below the corner suite windows, and the Perth skyline is still lit across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the Swan River shines below the lagoon pool, with Matagarup Bridge plain on one side.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky is completely clear, and guests in the Enclave cabanas have shade while the river stays bright.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the Perth skyline from across the Swan River, and the wrap-around balconies face it directly right now.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lit city skyline and the illuminated pool from one suite window.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over Perth this morning, but from the wrap-around balconies the Swan River and city skyline are easy to see.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the Swan River this afternoon, and guests on the lagoon pool tiers get sun in short stretches.
phrases.partly_golden: Gaps in the cloud let the last sun reach the Perth skyline, visible from the candlelit seating on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Perth today, so the Swan River looks grey too from the marble bath windows in the suites.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Swan River, and the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites show it without anyone getting wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: With thunder over Perth right now, the lagoon pool is empty and the storm can be watched from a suite living area.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Swan River today hides most of the Perth skyline, though Matagarup Bridge is still visible from the pool.
phrases.snow: Perth almost never sees snow, but if it fell today the suite windows would show it falling over the Swan River.
phrases.very_cold: Perth is rarely this cold, and today the lagoon pool is quiet while guests look at the river from inside the suites.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot across Perth today, and the infinity edge of the lagoon pool is the busiest place with a Swan River view.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers Perth tonight, but the warm air keeps the rooftop terrace in use, with the city lights clear below the cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Perth today, so the skyline is faint from the balconies, though the Swan River is clear.
phrases.late_night: Over a midnight glass of water, the Perth skyline lights reflect in the Swan River.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites after midnight, and the city lights blur across the Swan River.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Perth after midnight, and the city lights show hazy in the Swan River from the suite windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Retiro treetops outside the higher-floor windows are still dark shapes under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: On the balcony, a breakfast table faces the Prado facade and the green park in clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Suite 309 keeps its direct line to the Prado at midday, with no cloud over Madrid to soften the sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches the Prado facade seen from the upper rooms, while guests take tea in the Palm Court.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Retiro Park is clear, and the park below the tall sash windows is simply dark.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Retiro this morning, seen from the curved suite salon through its arched windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the Prado facade this afternoon, while tea is served under the Palm Court crystal canopy.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in suite 309 now, you would see the last sun hit the Prado facade between broken clouds.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Madrid today, so the green treetops outside the suite windows look flatter than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Retiro Park, and the indoor pool with its marble walls and chandeliers is the indoor option.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the higher-floor rooms, thunderstorm lightning flashes above the Retiro treetops and the rain-wet Prado facade.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Madrid today, and the Prado facade across the park is only a pale outline from the upper rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Retiro, a rare sight in Madrid, and the treetops outside the suite windows turn white.
phrases.very_cold: From the higher-floor windows, frost on the glass blurs the treetops of El Retiro in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: Madrid is very hot today, and the treetops of the Retiro, seen from the suite windows, stand completely still.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Madrid, and the balcony doors beside the marble bathtub can stay open.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Madrid today, so the Prado facade is not clear from the upper rooms, though the Retiro treetops are.
phrases.late_night: Late dinner at Deessa over, the higher-floor rooms look out on El Retiro's treetops against the lit streets around the park.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the tall windows of the higher-floor rooms this evening, and the city lights beside Retiro Park blur through it.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Madrid after midnight, and the higher-floor rooms look out on the city glow around El Retiro.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, nobody is in the rooftop infinity pool yet, and the skyline shows only scattered lit windows.
phrases.clear_morning: From a king room on the 25th floor or higher, the morning skyline is sharp down to the Pinheiros River.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the blue umbrellas on the WET Deck are open, and the skyline sits in full sun on all sides.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun comes straight into the lounge through the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the high-rises take on an orange tint.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the lit high-rises are visible in every direction from the infinity pool, with the Pinheiros River dark below.
phrases.partly_morning: If you were on a cardio machine in the FIT gym this morning, you would see clouds moving between the towers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Scattered clouds cast moving shadows over the skyline this afternoon, seen from the striped lounge chairs beside the pool.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over São Paulo turn pink above the water of the WET Deck pool.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers São Paulo today, and from the suite living room the dense skyline looks flat and colourless.
phrases.rain: Rain falls across the WET Deck today, so guests swim indoors in the green terrazzo spa pool one floor down.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm nobody swims on the WET Deck, and lightning over the towers is seen from the L40 restaurant.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the city today, and from the 25th floor only the nearest towers have clear edges.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches São Paulo, but if it did, guests would watch it from the WET Deck on the 40th floor.
phrases.very_cold: On this unusually cold clear day, the WET Deck chairs are empty and the skyline is sharp in every direction.
phrases.very_hot: The air over São Paulo is very hot today, so guests sit in the infinity pool rather than on the lounge chairs.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the high-rise lights show through the wide windows of the room with the circular bed.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the WET Deck the far side of the skyline is missing and only nearby towers show.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the king rooms are likely asleep now, their wide windows ready to show the São Paulo skyline at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a suite tonight can watch rain slide down the window while São Paulo's skyline lights blur behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a suite after midnight can watch low cloud drift over the lit towers of São Paulo.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the park below the wide windows is still dark, and the skyline shows only scattered lights.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning air gives the king rooms a long look across the Bosque de Chapultepec to the distant mountains.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands high over the skyline, and the treetops of the park look bright green from every floor.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun puts a warm colour on the towers seen from the Master Suite at the top of the building.
