phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the city lights spread wide from the soaking tub beside the window.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over Polanco this morning, and their shadows cross the park seen from the desk by the window.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the skyline sits under a mix of cloud and sun, which the high-floor suites show in full width.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the mountains turn orange, visible from the hydrotherapy pools inside.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Mexico City today, so the rectangular windows frame a flat, even light over park and towers.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Bosque de Chapultepec right now, and guests watch it from the dry side of the wide windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is passing over the city, and lightning over the skyline is easy to follow from the king rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the valley today, so the distant mountains are missing and only the nearest park trees look sharp.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Mexico City, but if it were falling today, the park treetops would look white from above.
phrases.very_cold: From a wide window now you would see hard winter light on the treetops of the Bosque de Chapultepec.
phrases.very_hot: Heat is strong over Mexico City today, and the far skyline looks slightly blurred through the wide windows.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the skyline lights are clear through the picture windows even without any stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the mountains behind the skyline are not in view, though the park below stays clear.
phrases.late_night: Lights off in the Master Suite around two, you would have the skyline lights as the only glow in the room.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were finishing a last drink in a king room now, rain on the wide window would blur the skyline lights.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in a king room now, you would see the city lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise under a clear sky, the pool's fibre-optic lights shine in the water with Marina Bay beyond the lawn.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at the Collection Club Lounge comes with a sharp view of the CBD skyline and the bay in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun in Singapore is strong, so most guests sit under cover in the atrium or swim in the pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden hour light falls on the Esplanade dome and the CBD towers, seen across the lawn from the pool.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the 1,380 fibre-optic lights are on in the pool, and the Marina Bay skyline stands lit behind the swimmers.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the CBD this morning while staff pick herbs in the rooftop garden for lunch service.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From a Signature Marina Bay Room balcony, cloud shadows move across the water and over Marina Bay Sands this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day colours the clouds above the CBD, and candles are being lit on the lawn terrace.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Marina Bay today, so the skyline looks flat from the floor-to-ceiling windows, but every tower is still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pool and lawn, and guests have moved inside to the rattan pods in the atrium.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were in a bay-facing room now, you would watch lightning over Marina Bay Sands through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Singapore today softens the CBD towers, and the Esplanade dome is only a faint outline from the lawn.
phrases.snow: Snow has never been recorded in Singapore, so if it fell now, every balcony over the bay would have a witness.
phrases.very_cold: Cold daylight over Marina Bay today, and the lawn and the pool are nearly empty, though the skyline is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Extreme heat on the rooftop lawn today, so the morning yoga has long finished and the pool is the busiest place.
phrases.mild_night: A warm, cloudy night in Singapore; cocktails at the Club Lounge come with the lit CBD towers but no stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is down today: Marina Bay Sands is clear from the balconies, but the open sea beyond it is not.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water, and the Signature Marina Bay Room's floor-to-ceiling window shows the skyline lights on the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtains open in a Signature Marina Bay Room tonight, rain runs down the glass and the skyline lights blur over the bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Marina Bay after midnight, and the skyline lights show through the open curtains of the Signature Marina Bay Rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: If you were at a faceted suite window, you would see the V&A Waterfront lights below a clear sky before sunrise.
phrases.clear_morning: On a clear morning, Table Mountain stands sharp beyond the faceted suite windows, with Table Bay bright toward Robben Island.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the 11th-floor terrace, and Table Mountain looks sharp from the Silo Restaurant windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From a balcony in the Royal Suites, the late sun lights the harbour and the waterfront buildings in warm orange.
phrases.clear_night: After midnight under a clear sky, the lights of the V&A Waterfront shine below the faceted suite windows.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit on top of Table Mountain this morning, while guests on floors 8–10 still see the whole bay in sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in the rooftop pool this afternoon, you would watch cloud shadows move across Signal Hill and the harbour.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds over Table Bay, seen from the Silo Restaurant windows on the 11th floor.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Cape Town today, so the bathtub by the faceted windows faces a flat, grey Lion's Head.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the geometric windows of the suites, and Table Mountain is only half visible through the wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, the Penthouse cinema room is the dry option, while lightning over Table Bay shows through the suite windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of Table Bay today, and from the rooftop terrace only the nearest waterfront buildings are clear.
phrases.snow: Cape Town almost never sees snow, but today the faceted suite windows face a white top on Table Mountain.
phrases.very_cold: On this unusually cold day the rooftop pool is mostly empty, and the air over Table Mountain is very clear.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot today, and the rooftop pool on the 11th floor is the most popular place in the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: Under a warm, cloudy night sky, guests in the Deluxe Superior suites see the waterfront lights but no stars tonight.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Robben Island is not visible from the terrace, and Table Mountain looks pale and dim.
phrases.late_night: The V&A Waterfront lights fill the faceted glass of the Deluxe Superior suites tonight, and the mountain returns at first light.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at the Silo restaurant, rain runs down the faceted windows and the harbour lights blur across Table Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at the Silo restaurant, the Waterfront lights show under low cloud from the Deluxe Superior suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the upper-floor rooms show a dark skyline with Coit Tower as a small shape against the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at the buffet comes with large windows and a clear view of downtown buildings in morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the city-view rooms show the hills and downtown buildings in full, flat sunlight.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The 28th-floor M Club Lounge is the place for this hour, with low sun on the skyline and Coit Tower.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lit skyline from a city-view room, Coit Tower included.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over San Francisco this morning, and the floor-to-ceiling windows in the double queen rooms frame them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the M Club Lounge this afternoon, clouds pass over the downtown buildings and the hills, with sun between them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun puts orange light on some downtown buildings and shadow on others, seen from upper rooms.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over San Francisco today, and from the 28th floor the skyline looks flat but fully visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the city-view rooms, and the downtown buildings look darker than usual.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the M Club Lounge on the 28th floor is a dry place to watch lightning over the city.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog is in the city today, and Coit Tower may not be visible from the upper-floor rooms for hours.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in San Francisco, so any flakes passing the 39th-floor windows would be a real event for guests.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the air over San Francisco is dry and the hills show sharp detail from upper rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot days are unusual in San Francisco, and the downtown buildings seen from the city-view rooms stand in full sun.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and from a city-view room the downtown lights show clearly under the low clouds.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today; the nearer downtown buildings show from the upper rooms, but Coit Tower is not clearly visible.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, skyline lights show in the upper-floor city-view windows, hard to turn away from.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the city-view rooms, and the skyline lights blur into wet streaks after midnight.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze drifts across the skyline after midnight, so the downtown lights look soft through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the city-view rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the top-floor balcony looks over a dark Douro, with only a few lights along the Ribeira façades.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast in the small eatery is on, and from the terrace the pastel Ribeira façades are in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the two armchairs on the terrace are in direct sun, and the Douro below is bright blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the low sun turn the Ribeira façades a warmer colour from the balcony.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the window bar table has a clear view of the city lights, and a glass of port is a reasonable plan.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Douro this morning, so the terrace armchairs get sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the top-floor balcony this afternoon look down on the Douro, with cloud shadows moving across the pastel riverside houses.
phrases.partly_golden: Just before sunset, the Ribeira façades seen from the balcony are lit in patches between the clouds.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Porto today, and the Douro looks grey too from the terrace, though the façades keep their colour.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Ribeira, and guests are watching it hit the river from inside the granite-walled rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Douro, and the window bar table is a dry place to watch the lightning over the river.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Douro today, and from the terrace the Ribeira façades show only as pale shapes.
phrases.snow: Porto rarely gets snow, yet today flakes drift past the grid window toward the Ferreira Borges Market roof.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing outside, so the two terrace armchairs are empty and the Douro is watched from behind a window.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Porto today, and the terrace armchairs will be more useful after sunset than at noon.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in the Ribeira, and the balcony is comfortable enough for a late look at the river lights.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the terrace the Douro is clear but the far city skyline is not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, the lights of the Ribeira show on the Douro's water through the river-side windows of the hotel.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight the curtain is open to rain on the glass, and the riverside lights of the Ribeira blur over the Douro.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low cloud tonight, the lights along the Ribeira riverside reflect in the Douro through a curtain left open before bed.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the marina lights are still on below the rooftop pool, and the bay behind them is dark.
phrases.clear_morning: From a sea-facing balcony, the cruise terminal and the port are sharp in the early sun this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: The pink tiles of the infinity pool look brighter at midday, and the whole bay is blue behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the hillside houses above the marina, seen from the deck chairs on the terrace.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at the Off-Side Rooftop bar tonight, you would see the marina lights and a clear sky over the Atlantic.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit over the Funchal hillside this morning, while the marina below the rooftop is in full sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests are using the outdoor gym on the grass terrace this afternoon, with broken cloud over the city hillside.
phrases.partly_golden: From the Off-Side Rooftop bar, the low evening sun lights broken cloud above the marina and the hillside houses.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the bay today, but the marina and the port are clearly visible from the upper rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop terrace, so the deck chairs are empty and the hillside looks grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is passing over Funchal Bay; from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows, guests can watch lightning over the Atlantic.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the bay today, so the Atlantic horizon is soft and only the marina is clear from the pool.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Funchal, but today a thin white layer on the hillside is visible from the rooftop.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold for Funchal today, so the deck chairs stay empty while the bay and the port are sharp from the rooftop.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, most guests are in the pink infinity pool, looking out over the marina and the bay.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Funchal, and the Off-Side Rooftop bar has the marina lights spread out below it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balconies the port is clear but the far side of Funchal Bay is not.
phrases.late_night: After a late drink at the Off-Side Rooftop, marina lights show on the water of Funchal Bay from the sea-facing rooms.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the sea-facing rooms after midnight, and the marina lights blur across Funchal Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Funchal Bay after midnight, and the marina lights show below the sea-facing rooms through the haze.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Duomo's spires are already a dark outline from the upper rooms, with Piazza Fontana below still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the side of the Duomo, and the tall glass walls of the guest rooms show the whole view.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the marble spires look very white against the blue sky, and the terrace sun loungers are in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a suite with terrace seating now, you would see the low sun turn the spires a warm colour.
phrases.clear_night: The Duomo is lit after dark, so from the terrace dining table the spires stay clearly visible against a black sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the cathedral this morning, and from the upper rooms the marble flank changes from bright to dull and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the sun comes and goes on the Duomo, so guests on the terrace loungers see the spires in changing light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, pink clouds sit above the cathedral, and the terrace lounge seating faces straight at it.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Duomo's marble looks flat and pale, though the spires stay close and clear from the suites.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Piazza Fontana, and the view of the wet marble spires from the guest room windows stays direct and close.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Milan, and from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows each lightning flash shows the cathedral's spires briefly.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs over the historic centre today, so from the upper rooms only the nearest spires of the Duomo show clearly.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Duomo's spires, which rarely happens in Milan, and the upper rooms have the closest view of it.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold outside, and the terrace sun loungers are empty, but the spires are sharp from the guest room windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Piazza Fontana, the Duomo's marble is almost too bright to look at, and the terrace stays quiet.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, guests on the terrace sit at the dining table with the lit Duomo straight ahead of them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Poor visibility today means nothing beyond the Duomo shows, but its spires are close enough to appear plainly from the suites.
phrases.late_night: If you were in an upper room now, you would be asleep, and at first light the Duomo's spires would fill the window.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in a suite tonight, you would see the Duomo's spires through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink at an upper-room window now, the Duomo's spires would rise before you under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the private terraces of the Ambassador suites face a dark Caribbean that is slowly turning grey.
phrases.clear_morning: From the terrace suites, the sea is already turquoise this morning, and the white sand beach is still mostly empty.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday from the Ambassador terrace, the white sand runs past the palms to the flat turquoise sea under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the palm trees in front of the beachfront restaurant while the sea turns a deeper blue.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your terrace tonight, you would see stars over the Caribbean and hear the waves on the beach.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the sea this morning, and guests on the private terraces watch the water change from grey to turquoise.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The afternoon brings some cloud, and the jet skis on the beach are easy to spot from the terrace suites.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the water turn orange, seen best from the Ambassador ocean-facing suites.
phrases.overcast: Full cloud over the Caribbean today makes the water look green rather than blue, but the beachfront restaurant still serves outdoors.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the main pool and the wood decks, and the thatched roof keeps the beachfront restaurant dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the sea right now, so most guests watch the lightning from behind the sliding glass doors.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, and from the terraces the line between sea and sky is hard to find.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Playa del Carmen, so if it fell today the palm trees would look very odd from the terraces.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day is rare here, and from the terraces the lounge chairs on the beach look unused.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day the private plunge pools on the terrace suites are the shortest walk to cool water.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm and cloudy, and dinner at the open-air beachfront restaurant comes with the sound of waves beyond the palm trees.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Ambassador suites the sea is clear nearby but the horizon is not.
phrases.late_night: Only the sea shows through the Ambassador suites' sliding doors after midnight, and by dawn it will be turquoise again.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the sliding glass doors of the Ambassador suites at dusk, and the resort lights come on along the wet beach.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hides the moon after midnight, and from the Ambassador suites the Caribbean is heard as surf past the beach lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Haystack Rock is a dark shape against a clear sky from the balconies, and the beach below is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balcony of a suite, the morning sun lights the Pacific and Haystack Rock under a sky with no clouds.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the free beach cabanas are in use, and from them Haystack Rock stands sharp against blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in the white Adirondack chairs watch the sun drop toward the Pacific, with Haystack Rock in clear view.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the fire pits are lit, and from them Haystack Rock is only a black outline against the sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the morning sky above Haystack Rock, and the ocean-view windows of the rooms show light changing on the sand.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun and shade pass over the beach this afternoon, seen from the hammock among the beach grasses.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds turn orange over the Pacific, and Haystack Rock looks darker from the balconies.
phrases.overcast: From the wood balconies today, Haystack Rock shows in flat light under a sky with no gaps in the cloud.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the beach this hour, and the bistro table by the ocean-view windows is the dry place to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Pacific right now, and lightning shows Haystack Rock for a second from the balconies.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the shoreline, and from the ocean-view windows Haystack Rock is only partly visible, or not at all.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare here, but today it lands on the dune grass and the wood balconies facing Haystack Rock.
phrases.very_cold: If you were on a balcony now, you would see frost on the wood rail and Haystack Rock beyond the empty beach.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot for the Oregon coast today, so guests use the beach cabanas for shade while looking at Haystack Rock.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests roast marshmallows at the beach bonfire, with Haystack Rock a dark shape behind them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, and from the balconies the far end of the beach is not visible, though Haystack Rock still is.
phrases.late_night: With the lights off in an ocean-view room, the white surf around Haystack Rock is the only glow left after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at the Wayfarer, rain streaks the ocean-view windows and Haystack Rock is a wet outline against the Pacific.
phrases.grey_evening: Hours after dinner at the Wayfarer, the ocean-view windows frame Haystack Rock's broad outline against a grey, clouded sea.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the skyscrapers along Sukhumvit still show their night lights through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the higher rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: From the fitness center, the morning sun falls directly on the exercise machines and on the Bangkok skyline outside.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the elevated highway and the Sukhumvit towers stand in hard sunlight, best seen from a thirtieth-floor room.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop deck of Spectrum now, the low sun would colour the skyscrapers and the river beyond.
phrases.clear_night: Spectrum Lounge at floors 28 and 29 serves cocktails tonight under a clear sky, with the lit towers of Bangkok all around.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the Sukhumvit corridor this morning, and their shadows cross the elevated highway seen from the rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the fitness center have a partly cloudy Bangkok skyline in front of them this afternoon, sun coming and going.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds above the river, a view available from the wooden deck of the rooftop bar.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Bangkok skyline looks flat from the floor-to-ceiling windows, but the elevated highway stays clearly visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the bedrooms, while the skybridge to BTS Nana keeps guests dry on the way out.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Sukhumvit skyscrapers can be watched from the freestanding tub in an upper room, behind thick glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Bangkok today softens the skyscrapers along Sukhumvit, so the view from the 30th floor ends a few blocks away.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Bangkok, so if any fell today every guest at the Spectrum rooftop would stop to look.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air over Sukhumvit almost never happens, but today the skyline from the rooftop deck is unusually sharp and clear.
phrases.very_hot: Heat over Bangkok this afternoon leaves the wooden rooftop deck empty until evening, while guests watch the skyline from their rooms.
phrases.mild_night: After midnight, under a cloudy sky, lit towers and the elevated highway glow below the floor-to-ceiling windows over Sukhumvit.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from the rooftop bar the river beyond the towers is not visible, only the nearer Sukhumvit blocks.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight the city lights along Sukhumvit show in the floor-to-ceiling windows, and a glass of water stands beside the bed.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows after midnight, and the lights along Sukhumvit blur into long wet streaks.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Bangkok after midnight, so from the upper floors the Sukhumvit lights look soft and blurred.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the cathedral bell tower is a dark shape above the terracotta roofs, seen from the rooftop pool.
phrases.clear_morning: From a bay-facing balcony, the Atlantic is already bright blue, and the Desertas islands sit clearly on the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop pool, midday sun falls on the terracotta roofs and the cathedral tower, with Funchal Bay blue beyond.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the terracotta skyline orange, and the church tower stands dark against it from the pool edge.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the jacuzzi tonight, you would see the bell tower above the roofs and a dark Atlantic beyond.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Funchal this morning, so the rooftop pool gets sun in short periods between shadows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The Desertas islands are visible between passing clouds this afternoon, seen from the balcony rooms that face the bay.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud at sunset gives the rooftop loungers a mix of orange light and grey patches over the Atlantic.
phrases.overcast: From the rooftop pool, the terracotta roofs and the cathedral tower sit under a grey overcast sky above Funchal Bay.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop pool and the roofs of the Sé, and from the balconies the cobblestones below are wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: In a thunderstorm, guests stay off the rooftop and watch the lightning over Funchal Bay from their balconies.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the sea hides the Desertas today, so the view from the rooftop stops at the Atlantic near Funchal.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Funchal, so a few flakes over the cathedral tower would surprise everyone at the rooftop pool.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in coats on the rooftop this afternoon look past the empty loungers and the cathedral bell tower to Funchal Bay.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air in the old town makes the rooftop pool the busiest spot, with the Atlantic blue to the horizon.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, guests in the rooftop jacuzzi see no stars, only the bell tower and the city below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the rooftop pool, the cathedral tower and near terracotta roofs show clearly today, but the Desertas stay out of sight.
phrases.late_night: Harbour lights float on Funchal Bay after midnight while the bay rooms sleep, and dawn will bring the Atlantic back in blue.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the windows of the bay-facing rooms, and the lights of Funchal Bay look soft through wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the bay-facing rooms look out on Funchal's lights under low cloud, the bay water showing their glow.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the floor-to-ceiling windows show Darling Harbour's water still dark, with the CBD skyline lit against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, swimmers in the 4th-floor infinity pool look out across Darling Harbour toward Sydney Tower.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the harbour water is bright under full sun, and the lounge windows frame the Barangaroo towers sharply.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the CBD skyline in warm colours, seen from the soaking tubs of the Corner Luxury Rooms.
phrases.clear_night: Clear sky tonight, and from the rooftop bar guests see the lit CBD skyline and the waterfront below.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered morning clouds move over Darling Harbour, and guests in the fitness centre watch them drift past Sydney Tower.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From Club Millésime on level 35, cloud shadows cross the harbour water while the CBD skyline stays in sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours a few clouds over the Barangaroo towers, visible through the lounge's floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Sydney today, so the spa treatment room's window shows a flat harbour and a dull skyline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Darling Harbour, and from the soaking tub in a Corner Luxury Room the skyline looks blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the CBD skyline is visible from the rooftop bar, where guests stay behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Sydney today softens the view from level 35, and Sydney Tower shows only as a pale outline.
phrases.snow: Snow in Sydney is almost unheard of, but if it fell today you would watch it from the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.very_cold: If you were at a floor-to-ceiling window now, you would see hard winter light on the water of Darling Harbour.
phrases.very_hot: From the 4th-floor infinity pool, heat-haze hangs over the Darling Harbour water and the city towers beyond.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars on this mild night, but the lit CBD skyline is clear from the rooftop bar.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooms the marina is visible but the CBD skyline beyond is not.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has a Corner Luxury Room tonight probably fell asleep with the curtain open, the skyline lights on Darling Harbour water.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a Corner Luxury Room tonight can watch rain cross Darling Harbour, the skyline lights blurred on the wet water.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a Corner Luxury Room tonight can watch low cloud drift over Darling Harbour, the skyline lights showing under it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the oceanfront rooms look west over a dark Pacific, with Catalina Island a faint shape beyond the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balcony, Catalina Island is clearly visible across the water this morning, and the sand below is already bright.
phrases.clear_midday: The courtyard pool sits under a clear midday sky, with bougainvillea and hillside homes visible from the upper balcony.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see the sun drop toward the Pacific with nothing in the way.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sliding glass doors open onto a dark ocean, and guests on the balcony hear the waves more than see them.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the cove this morning, and from the oceanfront deck Catalina Island shows between them at times.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud move over the Pacific, so the wood lounge chairs on the deck get sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the western horizon add color to the sunset seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific looks flat and pale from the oceanfront rooms, and Catalina Island is not visible today.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the sand and the deck chairs, so most guests watch the ocean from behind the sliding glass doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Pacific, and the rooftop terrace is empty while lightning shows far out over the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the cove, and from the balcony only a short stretch of water is visible past the white railings.
phrases.snow: From the oceanfront balcony, snow falls on the sand and the grey Pacific beyond the white railing.
phrases.very_cold: From the oceanfront deck, the wood lounge chairs stand empty in hard winter light above the sand and the Pacific.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the sand today, and guests move between the courtyard pool and the shade of the balconies.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the two wood chairs on the balcony are still a comfortable place to sit facing the ocean.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so Catalina Island cannot be seen from the oceanfront rooms, only the nearer water and the sand.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water stands by the bed in an oceanfront room, and pale surf shows through the glass doors.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in an oceanfront room now, rain would run down the sliding doors and blur the Pacific.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze covers the Pacific after midnight; from the oceanfront rooms only the white surf shows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the spruce crowns below the balconies are dark shapes and the Dolomite rock shows pale against the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the window bench in a suite, the larch trunks and the Dolomite peaks stand sharp in clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the outdoor pool terrace is bright and the Dolomite summits stand clear above the Plose forest.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the wood-clad balconies, and guests in the outdoor hot tubs look across the Eisack Valley toward Brixen.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the woven lanterns on the lawn are lit and the Dolomite peaks show as dark outlines.
phrases.partly_morning: If you were on your balcony this morning, you would see clouds moving between the spruce tops and the pale Dolomite rock.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the Plose forest this afternoon, and the infinity pool's far edge still lines up with treetops and Dolomite summits.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun lights some Dolomite peaks and leaves others in cloud shadow, seen from the suite balconies.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Dolomite rock looks flatter than usual, but the spruce crowns below the balcony rail stay green.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Plose forest, and most guests are in the indoor half of the infinity pool or the Spa Arboris.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the suites, guests watch the thunderstorm over the Dolomites through tall sliding glass, with the spruce tops just below.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Dolomite peaks today; from the suites only the nearest spruce crowns and the larch trunks are visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the spruce tops just below the balcony rails, while the in-room pine saunas are heated as usual.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold daylight over the Plose forest, and guests on the sunloungers wear jackets while the Dolomite rock stands clear.
phrases.very_hot: Even at canopy height it is very hot today, and the outdoor part of the infinity pool is the busiest spot.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night; the lawn lanterns are on, the outdoor pool is lit, and the mountains are hidden.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: from the balconies the spruce crowns show clearly, but the Dolomite peaks do not.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the suites are likely asleep, Brixen's lights in the valley below, and first light will reach the Dolomite summits.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever is awake after midnight sees snow on the suite glass and the lights of Brixen blurred through it.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever is awake in a suite after midnight sees cloud hanging low over the Dolomites, Brixen's lights showing in the valley.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Deluxe balconies look onto a dark St. Paul's Cathedral, its spire sharp against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the stone of St. Paul's Cathedral, and from a Deluxe balcony you could count the details on it.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the blue glass towers of the CBD shine behind the cathedral spire, seen from the suite living rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a Deluxe balcony now, you would see low sun turning the cathedral stone a warmer colour.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night the Manchester Unity Building stands directly opposite the Westin Spa corner rooms, with no clouds above the CBD.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over the CBD this morning, so the sun comes and goes on St. Paul's Cathedral outside the Deluxe balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Partly cloudy afternoon; from the King rooms the spire and old stone buildings are lit one moment and shaded the next.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds break up over Flinders Street Station and the cathedral, both close to the Deluxe balconies.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the cathedral stone looks darker from the suite windows, and the glass towers behind it lose their shine.
phrases.rain: Rain on Collins Street today; the small Deluxe balconies are wet, so the cathedral view is better from inside the room.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over Melbourne right now, so the indoor heated lap pool makes more sense than a Deluxe balcony facing the cathedral.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog in the CBD today; the cathedral stays visible from the balconies because it is so close, unlike the far towers.
phrases.snow: Snow in Melbourne is very rare, but if it fell today, the Deluxe balconies would show it settling on the cathedral roof.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold outside today, so a short look at the cathedral from the balcony, then back to the sauna or steam room.
phrases.very_hot: Melbourne is very hot today, and the indoor pool is the cooler option while the cathedral stands in full sun outside.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and guests on the Deluxe balconies are out in light clothes with the cathedral close in front.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The distant CBD towers are hard to make out from the King rooms today, though St. Paul's Cathedral next door stays sharp.
phrases.late_night: In a Deluxe room tonight, you could fall asleep with the curtain open and the cathedral spire close beside the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: If you poured a last drink in a Deluxe room tonight, St Paul's spire would show close through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in a Deluxe room now, you would see St Paul's spire against city lights under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the terrace tables stand empty and the Gulf of Salerno is a dark flat shape far below.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunrise reaches the dining terrace early, and from 365 metres up Minori and Maiori are already in full daylight.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool reflects a sky with no clouds at all, and the mountains behind it show every detail.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the gym windows, the late sun turns the cliffs and the sea a warm orange before it sets.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a suite terrace tonight, you would see the lights of Minori and Maiori along the coast below.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the mountains this morning, and the pool shows them one after another on its surface.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the terrace this afternoon look down on the Gulf of Salerno under a sky of broken cloud.
phrases.partly_golden: Under the wisteria pergola, guests watch the last hour of sun move between clouds above the coast toward Positano.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky covers the whole coast today, but from Ristorante Belvedere the Gulf of Salerno and both villages are still visible.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the terrace tables, and guests in the heated infinity pool watch the wet valleys from the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: In the storm, lightning flashes over the Gulf of Salerno below the terrace, and rain hides Minori and Maiori.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits in the valleys today, so Minori and Maiori below are faint and the mountains show only as outlines.
phrases.snow: Guests on the terrace today look out on snow falling over the surrounding mountains and the Gulf of Salerno below.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air at 365 metres today, so the terrace is empty and the view of the gulf is unusually clear.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the infinity pool is where most guests stay, with the Gulf of Salerno below them.
phrases.mild_night: A warm, cloudy night, and dinner on the Ristorante Belvedere terrace continues late, with the sea dark below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Positano and the far end of the coast cannot be seen from the terrace, only Minori nearby.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and Minori's lights show along the gulf.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight rain is falling over Minori and Maiori, and their lights show from the suites.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the mountains tonight, and the lights of Minori and Maiori show along the coast below the suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lagoon around the overwater villas is dark and flat, and the ocean horizon is a faint grey line.
phrases.clear_morning: From a villa deck this morning, the lagoon is clear turquoise and the palm-covered islet stands out sharply.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly overhead, so the thatched gazebo is the only shaded spot on the villa deck.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Tai Restaurant, on its stilts above the lagoon, faces the sun directly as it drops toward the open sea.
phrases.clear_night: From the teak deck of an overwater villa, stars cover the clear night sky above the Thaa Atoll lagoon.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the atoll this morning, putting slow patches of shadow on the turquoise water below the villas.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the sun loungers get sun and cloud in turns this afternoon, with the lagoon changing colour under each.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds from below, seen from the wooden massage deck over the lagoon.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky today, the lagoon looks pale and flat from the villa decks instead of turquoise.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the lagoon, and the thatched roof of the gazebo keeps a dry corner of the villa deck.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the ocean right now, and the lightning is easy to watch from inside the villa.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the ocean today hides the horizon line, so from Tai Restaurant the water and sky share one grey-blue colour.
phrases.snow: Snow is not something the Thaa Atoll sees, so if it were falling now, it would melt on the warm lagoon instantly.
phrases.very_cold: A freezing day would be a first for this atoll, and the warmest spot would be the villa plunge pool.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the atoll at this hour, and most guests are in the infinity pools or under thatch.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, but the air is warm, and lanterns light the beach dinner setting under the driftwood structure.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from the villa deck the near lagoon is clear but the far ocean horizon is not.
phrases.late_night: If you turned off the overwater villa lights now, moonlight off the lagoon would be the only light left inside.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight rain falls on the thatched roofs of the overwater villas, and the lagoon shows only where the window light reaches.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud passes over the lagoon outside the overwater villas, and the water reflects the lights along the jetty.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise under a clear sky, the first pale light over the bay outlines the mountains beyond the private terraces.
phrases.clear_morning: From an upper-floor room this morning, the turquoise water at Cala Formentor beach looks calm and the pines are bright green.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the adults-only pool terrace has full sun and the sea beyond the pine treetops is deep blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden hour reaches the pool terrace now, and the mountains around the bay turn orange while the water stays flat.
phrases.clear_night: From a private terrace late at night, clear sky stars shine over the calm water of Cala Formentor bay.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the pine forest this morning, so the bay seen from the balconies changes between bright and shaded.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, cloud shadows move across the mountains ringing the bay while guests at the family pool have mostly sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds above the headland, seen from the terrace dining tables with rattan chairs.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the whole bay today, and from the Formentor Suites the sea looks silver instead of blue.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pine forest and the beach, so most guests watch the bay from inside their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls across the mountains around the bay, and the spa is the busiest place in the resort right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the Mediterranean today, so from the balconies the distant mountains are faint and the headland is blurred.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on this peninsula, but today a few flakes fall on the pine forest seen from the upper rooms.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air for Mallorca today, so the private terraces are empty and guests look at the clear bay from inside.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day like this, the shade of the pine trees and the water at Cala Formentor beach matter most.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night here means dinner on the terrace with the dark shape of the mountains beyond the palm trees.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today: the beach and the pines are clear from the terraces, but the far mountains are not visible.
phrases.late_night: The Formentor Suite is dark after midnight, and the only light in the room comes from the water of the bay.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtain is open in a Formentor Suite after midnight, rain on the glass and the sea heard on the beach below.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low cloud after midnight, the curtain in a Formentor Suite stays open to the lights across the bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky over Rome is still dark and clear, and a guest room window shows St Peter's dome under the last stars.
phrases.clear_morning: From a guest room window, the morning sun lights St Peter's dome and the Roman rooftops around it.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun fills the cobblestone seating by the arched glass entrance, and the topiary planters give almost no shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the late afternoon sun, the Pantheon, Vittoriano and Quirinal Palace look orange from the Dolce Vita Suite's terrace.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Rome is clear, and St Peter's dome stays lit and visible from the guest room windows.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Rome, and from the soaking tub window the church domes are in and out of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun take turns over the rooftops this afternoon, which makes the St Peter's dome view change every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the Dolce Vita Suite's terrace now, you would see the low sun light the Vittoriano between the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under full cloud today, St Peter's dome looks flat and grey from the guest room windows, with no shadows anywhere.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Piazza Montecitorio, and the cobblestone seating outside the arched glass doors is empty and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Rome, so the Dolce Vita Suite's terrace is empty and guests watch the lightning from inside.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Rome today means St Peter's dome is only a faint outline from the Dolce Vita Suite's terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow in Rome is rare, but today it is settling on the rooftops seen from the soaking tub window.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air outside today keeps the cobblestone terrace seating empty, though the sky over St Peter's dome is clear.
phrases.very_hot: Rome is very hot today, and the soaking tub beside the window is a cool place to look at the church domes.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and St Peter's lit dome is visible under the clouds from the Dolce Vita Suite's terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the guest room windows St Peter's dome is hard to see beyond the nearest rooftops.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has the dome-view room tonight has turned every light off, and only the city glow around St Peter's dome comes in.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has the Dolce Vita Suite tonight watches rain on the glass and the outline of St Peter's dome over wet rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the Dolce Vita Suite tonight looks out at St Peter's dome above rooftops lit under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Burj Khalifa stands dark and sharp against a clear sky from the Burj-facing private terraces.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning in Dubai, and the rooftop pool on floor 29 already has early swimmers facing the Downtown skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly above the rooftop terrace, so the shade umbrellas over the woven chairs are useful.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From a marina-facing terrace, the yachts in Marasi Bay Marina sit in warm low light this afternoon.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lit Burj Khalifa reflected on the rooftop infinity pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered morning cloud sits over Downtown Dubai, and the Burj Khalifa shows between the gaps from the guest room windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Partly cloudy over Business Bay, and the suite terraces are getting sun and shade in turn through the afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds take some pink colour above the Downtown skyline behind the rooftop pool.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Dubai today, so the Burj Khalifa shows as a flat silhouette from the Burj-facing rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Dubai, and today drops cover the tall room windows that look toward the Burj Khalifa.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the rooms are a dry place to watch lightning behind the Burj Khalifa through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze is common here, and today the upper part of the Burj Khalifa fades into it from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Dubai, but if it did, the rooftop terrace would be an odd place to see it.
phrases.very_cold: From the rooftop terrace, the woven chairs stand empty in hard winter light below the Burj Khalifa.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside, and the rooftop infinity pool on floor 29 is where most guests are at this hour.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Business Bay, and the lit Burj Khalifa shows well from the Burj-facing private terraces.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far Downtown skyline is unclear from the rooftop, and the Burj Khalifa shows only faintly.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner, a Burj Khalifa-facing room has the tower's tall spire above the lights of Downtown Dubai.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Burj Khalifa rooms, the tower's spire visible through it above Downtown's lights.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, haze hides the top of the Burj Khalifa from the Burj-facing rooms, though the city below shows its lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Penthouse Loft windows show the Manhattan skyline still lit, with the East River dark below it.
phrases.clear_morning: From the guest rooms, the Manhattan skyline is sharp under a clear sky, and brunch is on at Le Crocodile downstairs.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is on the East River now, and from the Penthouse Loft the Manhattan towers look pale and sharp.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: On the rooftop terrace, guests are dining under white umbrellas while the low sun hits the Manhattan skyline across the river.
phrases.clear_night: Night has come, and from the Penthouse Loft the Manhattan skyline stands lit across the dark East River under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over lower Manhattan this morning, and from the guest room windows the East River changes colour with each gap.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were at a Penthouse Loft window now, you would see the Manhattan skyline across the East River under patchy afternoon cloud.
phrases.partly_golden: Sunset comes through gaps in the cloud, and guests at the rooftop terrace tables see parts of Manhattan lit and parts dull.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Manhattan skyline across the East River looks flat and close from the Penthouse Loft.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Manhattan skyline across the East River is blurred but still there.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Manhattan is visible from the guest room windows, and nobody is dining on the rooftop terrace right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the top of the Empire State Building today, and the East River below the windows looks grey.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the roofs of Williamsburg below the guest room windows, with Manhattan faint across the East River.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, and the Manhattan skyline across the East River looks very sharp from the Penthouse Loft.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day in Brooklyn, and the white umbrellas give the only shade on the rooftop terrace this afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over Manhattan, and Bar Blondeau on the 6th floor has the skyline lights in its windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the Penthouse Loft, the East River is clear below while haze hides most of the Manhattan skyline beyond.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Penthouse Loft lights are off, and the Manhattan skyline across the East River is the only light left.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, the Penthouse Loft windows are wet with rain, and the Manhattan skyline lights blur across the East River.
phrases.grey_evening: Up in the Penthouse Loft after a late dinner, Manhattan's lights show hazy under low cloud across the East River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the arched windows of the Premium Deluxe Rooms show Prague Castle as a dark shape against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast is being served in the Augustine Restaurant while morning sun reaches the red-tiled rooftops below the castle.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, St. Vitus Cathedral stands sharp and clear in the frame of the corner windows, no haze at all.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Premium Deluxe Rooms, late sun lights the castle walls in warm colour for about an hour before it sets.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the outline of Prague Castle against a clear sky from the corner windows.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Prague Castle this morning, so the cathedral towers are in sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, a few clouds pass above the red-tiled rooftops, and the courtyard fountain is in and out of sunlight.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the castle turn orange, seen through the tall windows of the Premium Deluxe Rooms.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Prague Castle looks pale and flat from the rooms, and the spa is busier than the Waldstein Garden.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the cobblestone courtyard, and guests watch it from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Augustine Restaurant.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Prague, and from the arched windows lightning shows the castle and cathedral for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the castle hill today, so the tall windows show only the nearest red-tiled roofs and grey behind them.
phrases.snow: Guests in the Premium Deluxe Rooms after midnight watch snow fall past the tall arched windows toward Prague Castle.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is very cold, and guests look at Prague Castle from inside the Premium Deluxe Rooms rather than the garden.
phrases.very_hot: On a hot day, the courtyard fountain is the busiest spot, and the Baroque church tower stands in full sun above.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the lanterns in the cobblestone courtyard are lit around the sculpture fountain and the church tower.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so St. Vitus Cathedral is a faint grey outline from the corner windows, with no detail visible.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water at the arched window near midnight, and the castle spires are there on the skyline above Malá Strana's lights.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at the Augustine Restaurant, rain runs down the arched windows upstairs, and Prague Castle shows through it above wet rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at the Augustine Restaurant ended hours ago, and the Premium Deluxe Rooms frame the castle outline under low cloud, rooftops lit beneath.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the boardwalk below the penthouse bungalows is empty, and the Pacific is a dark flat line.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Clara Bow penthouse this morning, early skaters are already at the skate park and the ocean looks calm.
phrases.clear_midday: Bright midday sun on the sand right now; from the room windows, the palms throw short shadows on the boardwalk.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun comes straight in through the dining nook windows, and the Pacific turns gold in front of Venice Beach.
phrases.clear_night: At night, the boardwalk lights are the main thing visible from the bungalows, with the ocean a dark space behind them.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Santa Monica this morning, so the beach seen from the upper-floor windows changes from shade to sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were there this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows moving across the sand and the skate park.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds over the Pacific catch orange light, visible from every penthouse window.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Venice Beach today; from the dining nook, the ocean and the sand look almost the same colour.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the boardwalk, and the skate park below the room windows is nearly empty of people.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Pacific tonight, and guests in the penthouse bungalows watch the flashes from behind closed windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Sea fog has moved onto Venice Beach, so from the Clara Bow penthouse the Pacific is hidden and only the palms show.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Santa Monica, but if it fell today, the sand below the room windows would turn briefly white.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Venice Beach; the sun is out, and the boardwalk under the windows has few walkers.
phrases.very_hot: From the penthouse bungalows, heat-haze shimmers over the boardwalk palms and the bare sand toward the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the boardwalk below the bungalows still has people walking between the palms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The ocean horizon cannot be seen today from the penthouse windows; the skate park and boardwalk are still clear.
phrases.late_night: Past midnight the boardwalk lights keep the Clara Bow penthouse windows worth watching, white surf showing beyond the sand.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the Clara Bow penthouse windows, and the boardwalk lights blur above the sand toward the Pacific.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low haze blurs the boardwalk lights below the penthouse bungalows, and the Pacific is under cloud beyond the palms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Hudson River is dark outside the suite windows, and Jersey City shows only a few lights across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun lights the Jersey City skyline across the Hudson, clearly visible from the large suite windows.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the Statue of Liberty is easy to pick out from the 16th-floor rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun falls on the green-striped chairs of the rooftop terrace as it sinks low over Jersey City.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at Leonessa tonight, you would see Jersey City lit up across the river, the Statue of Liberty far off.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Hudson this morning, but the Jersey City skyline stays clear from the suite windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the rooftop terrace are getting sun between the clouds, with the Hudson River wide and grey-blue below.
phrases.partly_golden: Through the restaurant's blue-framed mirrors, the waterfront shows up in the last sunlight, with some cloud over Jersey City.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the Hudson today, and the Statue of Liberty is visible from the suites but looks flat and distant.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Hudson, the rooftop terrace stands empty, and guests have the 2,000 artworks in the halls instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the suite windows give a wide view of lightning over Jersey City and the Hudson.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the Hudson hides the Statue of Liberty today, and from the suites Jersey City is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the suite windows, and Battery Park turns white while the Hudson stays dark grey.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day, few guests stay on the rooftop terrace, but the Statue of Liberty is sharp across the water.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over New York, and the Hudson looks bright and still from Leonessa on the 16th floor.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild cloudy night, and at Leonessa guests have Italian aperitivo with the Jersey City lights across the river.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the suites the Hudson is visible but the Statue of Liberty is not.
phrases.late_night: Lights off in a suite at two in the morning, the shore lights across the Hudson make the only brightness inside.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight the suite curtains are open, and Jersey City's lights show on the wet Hudson through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: With the suite curtain open after midnight, the Jersey City lights reflect in the Hudson under a low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Empire State Building is already clear across the East River from the Cosy with a Manhattan View rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Manhattan skyline across the river, and the arched windows in the rooms frame it without any haze.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop terrace is bright, and the Manhattan Bridge shows sharply through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun falls on the Empire State Building, and from a Roomy room the whole skyline turns warm in colour.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Empire State Building's lights stand out sharply from the Roomy rooms across the East River.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Manhattan this morning, so the Empire State Building goes in and out of sunlight seen from the rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop bar, the Williamsburg Bridge sits under a sky that is half blue and half cloud this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun reaches the Brooklyn rooftops below the terrace, with some cloud behind the Manhattan Bridge.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Manhattan skyline is still visible across the East River, just flatter and without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the arched windows of the old factory, and the Empire State Building looks blurred across the river.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm sits over Manhattan, and guests on the rooftop watch the lightning from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the East River hides most of the Manhattan skyline today, and the Empire State Building is only a faint shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Brooklyn rooftops below the terrace, and Manhattan across the river is mostly white and grey.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold, the rooftop terrace is empty, but the view of the skyline from the rooms is very sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Brooklyn today, and the Manhattan skyline looks pale from the rooftop restaurant, Laser Wolf.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and from the rooftop bar the lights of the Williamsburg Bridge show past the rattan seating.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, and the Empire State Building is hard to make out from the rooms, though the river remains visible.
phrases.late_night: Lights off after midnight, and the only light left comes from the Manhattan skyline across the East River.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtain open before bed, the Manhattan lights blur through rain on the window of a Cosy with a Manhattan View room.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Manhattan after midnight, and the city lights show through the open curtains of the Manhattan View rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sky Tower is still lit against a dark clear sky, seen from the suite balconies above Albert Park.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light on the Waitemata Harbour, with the Sky Tower and the water in one frame from the upper suites.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Sky Tower stands sharp against blue sky through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the king bedrooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun colours the Sky Tower and the harbour, and guests on the curved balconies are still outside.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the Sky Tower lit and the harbour dark beyond the CBD from your balcony.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Albert Park this morning, and the bedroom balconies look onto green parkland and the cityscape.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud move across the CBD this afternoon, with Vero Tower and a strip of harbour visible from the curved balcony.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud takes colour over the Sky Tower, and the harbour shows grey from the suites.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud sits over Auckland today, the Sky Tower stands against a flat sky, and guests swim in the indoor pool.
phrases.rain: Rain streaks the floor-to-ceiling windows of the pool area, and the city skyline looks blurred from the indoor pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Waitemata Harbour shows briefly from the suite balconies, though most guests watch it from behind the windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the harbour hides the water today, and the Sky Tower is only a grey outline from the upper floors.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Auckland, but if it fell today the green of Albert Park would turn white below the bedroom balconies.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Auckland, and the balcony doors stay shut while the Sky Tower stands clear beyond the glass.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside, so the balconies empty by noon and the indoor lap pool fills instead, skyline still in view.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night the Sky Tower lights still show under the cloud from the king bedroom windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the harbour is hard to see from the balconies, though the Sky Tower is still visible.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the king bedroom's tall windows show the Sky Tower's spire among the CBD lights.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtain is open in the king bedroom, and the Sky Tower's spire shows through the rain over the lit city.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtains open after midnight, low cloud hangs over the lit CBD and the Sky Tower's needle in the suite windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Grand Mosque is still lit across the creek, and the Al Hanah terrace is empty and quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: From a creek-facing balcony, the Grand Mosque is easy to see across the water in the clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: From the Al Hanah terrace, the white domes of the Grand Mosque stand sharp across the creek in the midday sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Al Hanah terrace, the Grand Mosque stands across the still water in low, clear late afternoon light.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the Al Hanah terrace tonight, you would see the Grand Mosque lit up across the dark creek.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Khor Al Maqta waterfront this morning, seen through the arched screen of a creek-facing room.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the Gulf this afternoon, and the gondola rides along the hotel waterway are still running.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud hangs over the creek as the sun drops, and the Grand Mosque lights come on across the water.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky covers Abu Dhabi today, but the two outdoor pools are open and the Grand Mosque is still clearly visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare here, so guests are watching it from the courtyard arches while the reflecting pool fills with ripples.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm over the creek has emptied the Al Hanah terrace, and dinner has moved inside to Shang Palace and Bord Eau.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, and from the rooms the Grand Mosque is a pale shape across the creek.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unheard of in Abu Dhabi, so a white dusting on the beach loungers would be a genuine first.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare bitterly cold day, the outdoor pools are quiet and guests stay behind the arched screens of their rooms.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot outside, so the infinity pool and the shaded cabanas are the only places anyone wants to be.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy sky, the air is warm, the courtyard pool is lit, and the Al Hanah terrace tables are mostly taken.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, and from the Al Hanah terrace the Grand Mosque is only a faint outline across the creek.
phrases.late_night: Awake for water near midnight, you would find the Grand Mosque's domes across the creek.
phrases.wet_evening: Over a last drink tonight, you would see the Grand Mosque's domes through rain.
phrases.grey_evening: Over a last drink, you would see the Mosque's domes across the creek under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, guests at the lookout face Malacara Canyon as the sky brightens from the coast behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests at the sunrise lookout can watch the balloons rising from the valley near Praia Grande on a clear flying morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the heated infinity pool spills toward Malacara, and the flat-topped ridges stand sharp under a blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the suite balconies, where Malacara Canyon stands over the roofs of Praia Grande in warm light.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a Pedra do Segredo suite tonight, you would see a clear sky above the canyon from the balcony.
phrases.partly_morning: Breakfast at the DC Bistrô runs late, and the window shows Praia Grande and the coast under scattered clouds.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the Serra do Faxinal this afternoon, and the sun comes and goes on the glazed balconies of the chalets.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the walls of Malacara Canyon catch light between clouds, seen from the pool edge.
phrases.overcast: If you were on a balcony now, you would see Malacara Canyon grey under low cloud above the rooftops of Praia Grande.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the hillside, and guests in the suites use the fireplace while Malacara Canyon shows through wet balcony glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Praia Grande, and from the suite balconies the lightning shows the canyon walls for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills the valley today, hiding Praia Grande and most of Malacara, while the forest around the spa rooms stays visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare at 300 metres up the Serra do Faxinal, but today the heated pool steams against a white hillside.
phrases.very_cold: Beyond frost on the balcony glass, the walls of Malacara Canyon sit above the rooftops of Praia Grande in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: The air over the canyon is very hot today, and most guests stay in the infinity pool facing Malacara.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night, the hydromassage tub in a Rio do Boi suite faces the dark shape of Malacara Canyon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the coastline is not in the DC Bistrô window, and only the near canyon walls show.
phrases.late_night: In the Rio do Boi suite the window shows the lights of Praia Grande now, and at sunrise Malacara Canyon above them.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open in the Pedra do Segredo suite, rain blurs the lights of Praia Grande under Malacara Canyon.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain is open in the Rio do Boi suite, and the lights of Praia Grande show under cloud below Malacara Canyon.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the pool is quiet and Central Park is still a dark shape beyond the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_morning: Early swimmers in the pool look across Fifth Avenue to Central Park, bright under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over Midtown, and the Grand Luxe rooms get sharp light through their Beaux-Arts windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Warm afternoon light fills the suite living room, and the high-rises outside the large windows turn a soft orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at Salon de Ning, you would see Fifth Avenue lit below and a clear sky over the Midtown skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the pool this morning look across Central Park through floor-to-ceiling glass under a partly cloudy sky.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Midtown skyscrapers outside the rooftop bar windows go in and out of sunshine between the clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: On the rooftop terrace, the last sun catches the boxwood planters while clouds hang low over Midtown.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Midtown today, and Central Park looks flat and dull from the pool windows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the fitness center, and Central Park is hard to see clearly through it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Late at night, lightning over Central Park shows through the floor-to-ceiling glass of the pool, with rain on Fifth Avenue below.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the tops of the Midtown skyscrapers, and from the Grand Luxe rooms only Fifth Avenue itself is clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Fifth Avenue, and swimmers in the pool watch it settle on Central Park through the glass.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing on the rooftop terrace, so the wicker seating is empty and guests stay behind the bar windows.
phrases.very_hot: Midtown is very hot today, and the pool behind the floor-to-ceiling glass is the busiest place to look at Central Park.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and the wicker seating on the Salon de Ning terrace is in use above Fifth Avenue.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the pool Fifth Avenue is clear but the far side of Central Park is not.
phrases.late_night: If you turned off the suite's lights after midnight, the only glow left would come from the towers along Central Park.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were in Salon de Ning for a last drink now, rain on the glass would blur the lights beyond Central Park.
phrases.grey_evening: Were you at Salon de Ning for a last drink, you could see the towers around Central Park lit under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop thermal pool is already warm, and the lights of Zurich are still on around the church tower.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast runs under 33,000 books in the malt house, while up on the roof the Alps are sharp behind Lake Zurich.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the rooftop pool, and Lake Zurich, the city and the Alps are all clearly visible.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light reaches the slatted wood pavilion beside the pool, and the Alps turn pale orange behind the lake.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the rooftop pool tonight, you would float with the church tower in view and stars above Zurich.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over the Alps this morning, seen from the rooftop pool, and the sun reaches the water between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, cloud shadows move across Lake Zurich while swimmers in the rooftop pool get sun in short spells.
phrases.partly_golden: From the rooftop pool, broken cloud over Lake Zurich and the Alps turns orange in the last hour of sun.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky today, the Alps are less distinct from the rooftop pool, and Lake Zurich looks grey too.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop pool, but the water stays warm, and the malt house is dry under its tall windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: There is thunder over Zurich now, and the rooftop pool is not a sensible place to float until the lightning moves on.
phrases.fog_haze: From the rooftop pool, daytime fog hides Lake Zurich and the Alps, with only the church tower in view.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling into the warm rooftop pool, and guests float with wet hair while the roofs of Zurich turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, steam rises from the thermal pool, and the Alps behind Lake Zurich look especially sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Zurich, and the rooftop pool is warm thermal water, so it is more about the view than cooling down.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night, and the rooftop pool is warm under cloud, with the lights of Zurich around the church tower.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so the Alps are not visible from the rooftop pool and only the near end of Lake Zurich shows.
