phrases.late_night: Whoever has an arched-window room tonight has turned every light off, and only the shore lights of Lake Zurich show.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake after midnight in a guest room watches snow pass the arched windows and blur the shore lights of Lake Zurich.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in an arched-window room after midnight can watch low cloud drift over Lake Zurich, the shore lights soft under it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the TV Tower stands as a dark outline against a clear sky, seen from the rooftop sauna.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop balcony, morning sun lights the green treetops and the Gothic church spire under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the orange lounge chairs on the rooftop terrace stand in full sun, with residential rooftops spread out below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the greenhouse courtyard while, upstairs, the TV Tower marks the centre of a clear skyline.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the rooftop sauna tonight, you would see the TV Tower lit against a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Friedrichshain this morning, and from the rooftop lounge the TV Tower is still clear to see.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the rooftop terrace watch cloud shadows move across residential rooftops this afternoon, with gaps of blue sky between.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds turn orange above the TV Tower, visible from the rooftop sauna.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Berlin today, and the TV Tower stands against a flat sky, seen from the rooftop sauna window.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the greenhouse courtyard roof, and from the rooms the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church looks blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Berlin; the rooftop terrace is empty and lightning shows near the TV Tower, seen from the lounge.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the TV Tower today; from the rooftop lounge only the nearest rooftops are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the orange lounge chairs of the rooftop terrace, and the treetops below turn white.
phrases.very_cold: The air on the rooftop terrace is very cold today, but the sky is clear and the TV Tower is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the rooftop terrace, and the orange lounge chairs stay empty until the sun gets lower.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars on this mild night, but the lit TV Tower is still visible from the rooftop sauna.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; from the rooftop lounge the TV Tower is a faint shape and the far skyline cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: Were you asleep in a skyline-facing room after midnight, the TV Tower's sphere would appear over the rooftops at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were in the rooftop lounge for a last drink, you would see the TV Tower through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: A last drink in the rooftop lounge now would show you the TV Tower's sphere over the city lights under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Oriental Pearl Tower stands as a dark outline across the Huangpu River from the windows of Suite 304.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Pudong skyline directly opposite the Tower wing suites, with the Huangpu River flat and bright below.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Shanghai Tower and Jin Mao Tower show sharp edges from the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last hours of sun, guests in the Long Bar watch low light hit the Pudong towers across the water.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Oriental Pearl Tower is fully lit, and the private dining room table for eight faces it directly across the river.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds this morning put moving shadows on the Pudong skyline, seen from the four-poster bed in the suites.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in a Tower wing suite this afternoon, you would see sun and cloud shadow crossing the Huangpu River.
phrases.partly_golden: From the Long Bar, the last sun reaches only some of the Pudong towers through broken cloud, leaving the rest grey.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Pudong today, and the Huangpu River looks almost the same colour from the Suite 304 windows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites, and the Pudong skyline across the river looks less sharp and darker.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, guests at the Long Bar can watch lightning over the Pudong skyline without leaving their stools.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the upper part of the Oriental Pearl Tower today, though the Huangpu River is still clear from the suites.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Shanghai, but today it falls past the suite windows onto the Huangpu River and the Bund.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the Pudong skyline looks especially sharp across the Huangpu River from Suite 304.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside today, and guests at the Long Bar get the Pudong view without stepping out onto the Bund.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night over Shanghai, and the Oriental Pearl Tower lights show clearly across the river from the suite windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from Suite 304 the Huangpu River is clear but the far Pudong towers are only faint shapes.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has Suite 304 tonight probably left the curtain open on purpose, falling asleep to Pudong's lights across the Huangpu River.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has Suite 304 tonight can watch rain move over the Huangpu, the Pearl Tower blurred among Pudong's lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in Suite 304 after midnight can watch haze drift over the Huangpu and blur the Oriental Pearl Tower's spheres.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pathum Wan towers still have their lights on, seen through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear sky over Wireless Road this morning, and the long cantilevered pool up on floor 25 already shows the whole skyline.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the cantilevered pool, and the embassy corridor towers stand sharp against a blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden hour from the fitness center: the floor-to-ceiling windows show the Pathum Wan towers in low orange light.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear, and from the terrace with its set tables the lit towers of Bangkok are fully visible.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over Bangkok this morning, but the suites still get their full city panorama through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in the 25th-floor pool this afternoon, you would see clouds moving above the Pathum Wan towers.
phrases.partly_golden: Last hour of sun: some embassy corridor towers are lit, others sit in cloud shadow, all visible from the pool.
phrases.overcast: A grey ceiling of cloud over Pathum Wan today, and the towers look duller than usual through the room windows.
phrases.rain: Rain over Wireless Road, and the towers of Pathum Wan are only half visible through wet windows on floors 23 to 33.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the floor-to-ceiling windows of the rooms give a wide view of lightning over the Bangkok skyline, from inside.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Bangkok today, so from the 25th-floor pool the farther embassy corridor towers appear as pale outlines only.
phrases.snow: Snow in Bangkok would be a historic event, and guests would watch it from the fitness center windows instead of exercising.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day, the terrace tables sit empty, and the Pathum Wan skyline is viewed from behind the room glass.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Bangkok today, and the water of the 25-metre pool is the most comfortable place to look at the skyline.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the terrace seating faces the lit towers of Bangkok while dinner is served at Yamazato inside.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the pool only the nearest Pathum Wan towers show clearly and the farther ones do not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Pathum Wan towers show as lights in the suite's floor-to-ceiling glass; at dawn they show in daylight.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the suites after midnight, and the Pathum Wan tower lights look blurred behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze drifts over Pathum Wan after midnight, and the city lights look soft through it from the suite windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Moorish Castle is still a dark shape above the valley from the lobby balcony.
phrases.clear_morning: From a valley-side terrace room, the morning sky is clear enough to show the Atlantic coast beyond the hills.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is on the terracotta rooftops below the twin room balconies, with pine trees around them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light reaches the Miranda Terrace Bar, and the valley through the floor-to-ceiling glass takes a warmer colour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the lobby balcony tonight, you would see the Moorish Castle lit up above the dark valley.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the hillside this morning, and the forested slope outside the classic rooms changes from bright to shaded.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the lounge, on the circular leather sofa, watch broken cloud pass over the green treetops this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Sintra valley are partly lit, seen from the private terraces.
phrases.overcast: Full cloud covers Sintra today, and the Moorish Castle on its hill is harder to pick out against the grey.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Sintra valley, and the Miranda Restaurant's floor-to-ceiling glass is the dry place to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the private terraces are empty and guests watch the lightning over the valley from inside their rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has settled on the hillside, so from the balconies the pine trees nearest the hotel are the only clear thing.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Sintra, but today a few flakes fall past the lounge windows onto the green treetops.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, and the terraces stay empty while the valley view is sharp and clear.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, guests stay in the lounge by the spiral wood bookshelf and look at the treetops.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the Moorish Castle lights still show from the valley-side terrace rooms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Atlantic coast is not in view from the rooms, only the nearer valley and castle.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the room lights are off, and a few town windows across the Sintra valley give the only light left.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner at the Miranda Restaurant, rain runs down the room's window and a few town lights blur across the valley.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Miranda is over, and the lights of Sintra show through the tall glass under low cloud tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Level 3 pool deck is quiet and the CBD towers still show their night lighting against a dark sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From a King room's floor-to-ceiling window, the Perth skyline stands sharp in clear morning sunlight.
phrases.clear_midday: If you were on the Level 3 pool deck now, you would see the Perth CBD towers sharp under the midday sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light hits the glass of the CBD towers, and the Level 3 pool deck gets the full view of it.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the rooftop pool tonight, you would swim with the lit Perth skyline directly in front of you.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the CBD this morning, seen from the dual windows of the city-view rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go this afternoon, so the pool deck alternates between shade and sun, with the skyline always in view.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over Perth turns orange above the CBD towers, visible from the upper-floor Junior Suites.
phrases.overcast: From the Level 3 pool deck, the Perth CBD towers stand grey under a low overcast sky today.
phrases.rain: If you were at a Junior Suite window now, you would see rain falling past the lit Perth skyline.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the CBD empties the open pool deck, while the lightning is easy to watch from a Junior Suite.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Perth softens the CBD towers today, and from the King room window the farthest ones are only faint shapes.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Perth, so a few flakes over the CBD would be the main event from every city-view window.
phrases.very_cold: From the Level 3 pool deck, the Perth CBD towers stand sharp in hard winter light beyond the empty pool.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the CBD today, and the Level 3 pool is the busiest place in the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: Under a mild cloudy night sky, guests are in the rooftop pool with the lit CBD skyline in front of them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor today, and from the city-view windows only the nearer CBD towers show, not the farther skyline.
phrases.late_night: Were you in a Junior Suite after midnight, you might leave the curtain open and fall asleep facing the lit Perth skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in a Junior Suite, you would see the CBD lights through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in a Junior Suite now, you would see the skyline lights under the cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Vittoriano stands white and unlit outside most room windows, and the rooftop terrace is still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop, the morning sun is already on the ruins of the Fori Imperiali and the umbrella pines.
phrases.clear_midday: Lunch tables on the rooftop terrace sit under full sun, with the domes and Colonna Traiana sharp in clear air.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun gives the white marble of the Altare della Patria a yellow tone, seen from the room windows and rooftop.
phrases.clear_night: At night, the Vittoriano shows white against a clear dark sky from the room windows that face it directly.
phrases.partly_morning: If you were there this morning, you would see a few clouds passing over the Fori Imperiali from the rooftop.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Altare della Patria this afternoon, so the marble changes from bright to grey and back.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun on the rooftop terrace: broken cloud, low light on the umbrella pines and the Colonna Traiana.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Vittoriano looks flat and very white from the room windows, with no shadows on it.
phrases.rain: Rain today, so the rooftop tables are not in use and guests watch the wet Vittoriano from their room windows instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, lightning flashes over the white marble of the Vittoriano outside the room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Rome today: the Vittoriano is still clear from the rooms, but the domes seen from the rooftop are soft.
phrases.snow: Snow in Rome is rare, but today white flakes are falling past the room windows onto the Altare della Patria.
phrases.very_cold: Frost at the edges of the room windows frames the Vittoriano in hard winter daylight across Piazza Venezia.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Rome today, and the rooftop terrace tables above the Fori Imperiali are in full sun until evening.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, good for eating outside on the rooftop with the Altare della Patria in front of the tables.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the nearby Vittoriano is clear enough, but the far domes are hard to see from the rooftop.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water on the nightstand, and the room's two windows show the Vittoriano's white columns against the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the room windows tonight, and the wet lights of Piazza Venezia blur in front of the Vittoriano's columns.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers Rome late tonight, and the Vittoriano's columned front shows against the lit streets from the two room windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, river-side balconies look out at a dark Río de la Plata with the Ecological Reserve still in shadow.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Dique 2, and dock-side rooms get a sharp view of the old port cranes.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop plunge pool is in full sun, with the Puerto Madero warehouses visible from the deck chairs.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Buenos Aires skyline from the side, seen from the rooftop terrace sun loungers.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the rooftop jacuzzi tonight, you would see a clear sky straight above Puerto Madero and the city skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over the Río de la Plata this morning, and river-side balconies have patches of sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From dock-side balconies this afternoon, clouds pass behind the port cranes and the skyline moves in and out of sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun puts orange light on the Puerto Madero warehouses, seen from the rooftop plunge pool.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Buenos Aires today; the rooftop terrace is quiet and the skyline looks flat without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain on Puerto Madero right now, so guests eat inside at Rëd Resto & Lounge and the balconies are empty.
phrases.thunderstorm: Dock-side rooms have a direct view of lightning above the Buenos Aires skyline, while the rooftop terrace stays empty in the storm.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Río de la Plata today, and river-side rooms see only the nearest part of the Ecological Reserve.
phrases.snow: A rare snowfall today over Puerto Madero would leave a thin white layer on the rooftop sun loungers and port cranes.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside, so the private balconies are mostly empty and steam rises from the rooftop jacuzzi.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Puerto Madero today, and the rooftop plunge pool is the busiest spot in the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and guests sit on their balconies looking at the lit Buenos Aires skyline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the port cranes are still clear from dock-side rooms, but the skyline behind them is not.
phrases.late_night: Guests waking for water in dock-side rooms see Puerto Madero's cranes and the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a dock-side room tonight sees rain on the glass and the old port cranes against the Puerto Madero lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a dock-side room tonight can watch the skyline lights of Puerto Madero under the low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over Marina Bay is clear, and the Town Restaurant opens for breakfast at half past six.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Loft Suite balcony, Marina Bay Sands is clearly outlined against a blue sky while breakfast is served downstairs.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the outdoor pool beside the colonial columns is the easiest place to look at the Singapore River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun falls on the Doric columns of the Loft Suite balconies, with Marina Bay Sands directly across the water.
phrases.clear_night: Stone columns on the terrace frame Marina Bay Sands tonight, its blue lights sharp against a clear dark sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over Marina Bay this morning, and guests at the Town Restaurant watch them pass behind Marina Bay Sands.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A few clouds give short breaks from the sun at the outdoor pool, which looks over Anderson Bridge and the skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds over Marina Bay, seen from a room's balcony doors facing the Singapore Flyer.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Singapore today, so Marina Bay Sands appears flat and pale from the Loft Suite balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Marina Bay, and drops on the balcony doors blur the view of Marina Bay Sands.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Marina Bay, and from inside a Loft Suite the lightning appears behind Marina Bay Sands.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Singapore today, and the Singapore Flyer is only a faint outline from the suite balconies.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Singapore, but if it fell, the Loft Suite balconies would face it over Marina Bay.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air would surprise everyone in Singapore, and the outdoor pool beside the colonial columns would stay empty.
phrases.very_hot: It feels very hot outside, so most guests are in the outdoor pool or under the stone columns of the terrace.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover this warm night, and from the terrace the blue lights of Marina Bay Sands show above the trees.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Town Restaurant Marina Bay is clear but Marina Bay Sands looks faded in the distance.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water is on the Loft Suite nightstand, and Marina Bay Sands shows past the bay lights.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at the Town Restaurant, rain runs down the Loft Suite doors and Marina Bay Sands shows through it.
phrases.grey_evening: Long after dinner at Town Restaurant, a Loft Suite window shows the lit bay and Marina Bay Sands under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Lake Lugano lies dark and flat below the private balconies, with village lights still on across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight is on the green slopes across the lake, and the water below the balconies looks turquoise in clear morning air.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the lakeside outdoor pool is the busiest spot, with Lake Lugano directly behind the swimmers under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun lights the forested hills across Lake Lugano in warm colour, seen from the wicker seats under the gazebo.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the village lights across the lake reflected in still water from your balcony.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the green slopes this morning, and the lake below the balconies changes between grey and turquoise.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the pool watch patches of shade move across the wooded hills as clouds cross Lake Lugano this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds above Lake Lugano are lit orange from below, best seen from the dinner terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, Lake Lugano looks flat and silver through the floor-to-ceiling windows, with the hills still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain marks the surface of Lake Lugano, and most guests move indoors to the Venus Wellness Center or the indoor pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the forested hills across the lake shows clearly from the room windows, and the outdoor pool is empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Lake Lugano today, so from the balconies only the near water and the small dock are visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the hills across the lake, a rare sight from the warm indoor plunge pool with its lake view.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold outside today, so the private balconies are empty and guests watch the clear lake from behind glass.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the lakeside outdoor pool fills early, and the hammam in the Venus Wellness Center is quiet.
phrases.mild_night: The lakeside dinner terrace is in use on this mild cloudy night, with village lights across Lake Lugano and no stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the near shore and dock show from the balconies but the hills across the lake do not.
phrases.late_night: Were you in a lake-view room now, the lights off, the only light would come from the village reflected on Lake Lugano.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in a lake-view room tonight, rain would blur the village lights across Lake Lugano.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in a lake-view room now, you would see village lights reflected on Lake Lugano under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is a dark flat line from the sea-facing rooms, and Fistral Beach is still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From a sea-facing room, the morning sun lights the whole of Fistral Beach and the water looks turquoise.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sea is bright blue on three sides of the hotel, and the Edge Pool loungers are mostly taken.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun comes straight through RenMor's floor-to-ceiling windows, so diners facing the sea may need their sunglasses.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars over the Atlantic from the Trevose Suite balcony.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Fistral Beach this morning, and the sea changes between grey and blue as seen from the bay windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon patches of sun move across the water below the hotel, visible from the hot tub beside the outdoor pool.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the Atlantic turn orange, which RenMor diners can watch through the twelve-foot windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the sea looks grey too, but it still fills the bathroom window above the coastal lawn.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the coastal lawn and the dunes, and most guests have moved to the indoor pool with its fountain.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Atlantic is easy to watch from the bay windows of the sea-facing rooms, with lightning out at sea.
phrases.fog_haze: From RenMor's tall windows, fog hides most of the Atlantic, and only the near edge of Fistral Beach shows.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on this clifftop, but today the coastal lawn below the bedroom windows is white.
phrases.very_cold: The air is very cold today, but the sky is clear and the Atlantic looks sharp blue from the bay windows.
phrases.very_hot: From RenMor's tall windows, heat-haze shimmers over Fistral Beach and the flat Atlantic beyond the Edge Pool.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and a few guests are still in the hot tub beside the outdoor pool after dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far horizon over the Atlantic is missing, though Fistral Beach itself is clear from the rooms.
phrases.late_night: Long after dinner at RenMor, the bay windows show white surf off Fistral Beach, and the sound of the Atlantic carries.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake after midnight in the Trevose Suite watches rain run down the glass while the Atlantic breaks on Fistral Beach.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hangs over Fistral Beach tonight, framed by the sea-facing suites' bay windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Coronado Bridge lights are still on, and the bay is flat and dark outside the suite's arched windows.
phrases.clear_morning: From a balcony with the sliding doors open, the San Diego skyline is sharp across the bay this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the three outdoor pools are busy, and south-facing rooms have a clear line to the Pacific.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The waterfront patio's Adirondack chairs face a low sun over the bay, and the Coronado Bridge is lit from the side.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the skyline lights show clearly across the water from the suite balconies, with the bridge lit beside them.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over San Diego this morning, and the gondolas are already out in the Coronado Cays canals.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Broken cloud sits over the Coronado Bridge this afternoon, so the three outdoor pools get sun only in short periods.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the waterfront patio now, you would see the last sun break between clouds above the bay.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the bay looks grey too, but the skyline and bridge are still plain to see from the rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the marina today, and most guests watch it from the lobby's rear windows rather than the patio.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the thunderstorm nobody is in the three outdoor pools, and the bridge is hard to make out from the suites.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the bay today, so the Coronado Bridge is only a faint shape from the arched windows.
phrases.snow: Snow in San Diego is almost unheard of, but today a few flakes fall past the palms along the bay.
phrases.very_cold: It is unusually cold for Coronado, and the Sea Spa hot tub is the busiest place on the peninsula.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon like this, the three outdoor pools are the busiest spots, and the balconies stay empty until evening.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the Edison bulbs in the private dining room show in the arched windows facing the marina.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the skyline across the bay cannot be seen from the suite windows, though the marina is clear.
phrases.late_night: At two the skyline lights reflect on San Diego Bay, easy to keep watching.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the Coronado suite's arched windows, and the city lights across San Diego Bay look blurred.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the arched windows of the Coronado suite show the skyline lights across the bay under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the upper lake-facing rooms show a dark Lake Geneva and the Alps only as an outline against the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From a high-floor suite, the Jet d'Eau is already running and the Alps are sharp under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: If you were at a high lake-facing window now, you would see the Jet d'Eau white against the blue midday lake.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the low afternoon sun, the high lake-facing windows show the Jet d'Eau bright above Lake Geneva and the Alps.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the city lights end at the dark lake, seen from the lake-facing rooms high above the roofline.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit over part of the Alps this morning, while the Jet d'Eau is clear from the guest-room windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Over the outdoor pool this afternoon the sun comes and goes, and the lake changes colour each time a cloud passes.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in a suite for the last hour of sun, you would see the clouds over the Alps turn orange.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, Lake Geneva looks grey as well, and the high windows show the city roofline without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the empty outdoor pool, and from the guest rooms the lake is a pale strip below the clouds.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the high suites give a wide view of lightning over Lake Geneva, with the Alps hidden behind the clouds.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the lake today means the Jet d'Eau is only a faint shape, even from the highest lake-facing floors.
phrases.snow: Snow covers the wood decking around the outdoor pool, and the Alps are hard to separate from the white sky.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the outside air is sharp and the Alps look closer than usual from the high-floor windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Geneva today, so the outdoor pool and its white umbrellas are the most useful part of the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the lake-facing rooms show the lights of Geneva's roofline with no Alps behind them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Alps are not visible from the rooms, only the lake and the nearer city roofs.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, from the high-floor suites, the shore lights show on the lake water around the Jet d'Eau.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open after midnight, rain streaks the lake-facing windows and the city lights blur along the shore of Lake Geneva.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud hangs over Geneva, and the open curtain of a lake-facing suite shows the lit quays around the lake.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the upper-floor rooms look out on a dark Planten un Blomen with the church towers still unlit.
phrases.clear_morning: From a high-floor room this morning, the Heinrich-Hertz-Turm stands sharp against blue sky above the park's tree canopy.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the whole Hamburg skyline is in plain view from the rooftop terrace, the Alster bright in the sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun turns the church towers a warm colour, seen from the high tables on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_night: The candle lanterns are lit on the rooftop terrace tonight, and the skyline shows as lit windows and towers far below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Planten un Blomen this morning, and the tree canopy below the room windows changes between shade and sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in an upper room this afternoon, you would see patches of cloud shadow crossing the Hamburg rooftops.
phrases.partly_golden: Orange clouds hang over the river in the last hour of sun, and guests take the high tables on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over Hamburg today, but the church towers and the Alster remain clear from the TWOSIX bar.
phrases.rain: Rain streaks the wide room windows, and the park below looks darker green while the skyline goes grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm guests leave the rooftop terrace and watch lightning over the Hamburg skyline from inside the TWOSIX bar.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken most of the view today; from 118 metres up, only the nearest rooftops show under the TWOSIX bar.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Planten un Blomen below the room windows, and the Heinrich-Hertz-Turm fades in and out of the flakes.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold the Spa Soulhouse terrace is mostly empty, though the skyline view is at its sharpest.
phrases.very_hot: Hamburg is very hot today, and a cold gin at TWOSIX comes with a wide view over the park and the river.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the city lights spread out below the TWOSIX bar, one hundred eighteen metres above Hamburg.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor today, so from TWOSIX the Heinrich-Hertz-Turm still shows but the far church towers and the Alster do not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Hamburg skyline is lights from the upper floors, and by dawn the window will show Planten un Blomen green.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain on the upper-floor window blurs the lights of Hamburg around the Heinrich-Hertz-Turm's tall shape.
phrases.grey_evening: Late after dinner, the upper-floor windows show Hamburg's lights spread under low cloud, the Heinrich-Hertz-Turm one tall shape among them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Naxos skyline is already a dark line across the water from the infinity pool terrace.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Veranda Suite, the morning sun comes up over the Naxos mountains and lights the whole Aegean.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Vione Suite pool terraces look out on a flat blue sea and the white villas nearby.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on the infinity pool loungers watch the Naxos mountains turn into dark shapes against an orange sky.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would find a clear sky over the infinity pool and a very dark sea toward Naxos.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Ampelas this morning, and their shadows move across the sea below the Veranda Suites.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the sea beyond the infinity pool switches between bright blue and grey as clouds cross the sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds over Naxos catch orange light while guests finish swims in the infinity pool.
phrases.overcast: Guests at the infinity pool this afternoon look out across a grey Aegean to the Naxos skyline under low cloud.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the coastal scrub around the Vione Suites, and most guests have moved to the indoor pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the channel toward Naxos, and guests watch the lightning from behind their sliding glass doors.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Naxos mountains today, so the view from the infinity pool ends at a pale grey sea.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare on Paros, but if it fell today the indoor pool would be the warmest place to watch it.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing outside today, the infinity pool terrace is empty while guests use the indoor pool and Dione Spa.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day the infinity pool is the only comfortable place outside, with Naxos sharp on the horizon.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm and cloudy, and guests at the poolside bar see only a black sea toward Naxos.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Naxos is not visible from the infinity pool and the view ends a few kilometres out.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has a Vione Suite tonight has the lights off, and only the moon on the Aegean comes through the glass doors.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Veranda Suites are probably asleep by now, rain running down the glass doors and the Aegean heard beyond them.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the Veranda Suites are likely asleep by now, cloud low over the Aegean and the sea heard outside.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, east-facing rooms in the Historic Banyan Wing show Diamond Head as a dark shape against a slowly lightening sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Tower Ocean View rooms look straight down onto Waikiki Beach, where the first swimmers of the day are already in the water.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the banyan tree planted in 1904 shades the courtyard while the beach outside is in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the beachfront terrace, Diamond Head turns orange-brown in the late sun and the Honolulu skyline is clearly visible beside it.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a balcony tonight, you would hear the waves on Waikiki Beach more than you would see them.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Waikiki, and from the suites' arched windows Diamond Head is in sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Lunch on the Veranda at the Beachhouse comes with a few afternoon clouds and a mostly sunny stretch of ocean.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the beachfront terrace faces pink-lit clouds over the ocean and Diamond Head going dark.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Waikiki today, so the ocean from the Tower Ocean View rooms is more grey than turquoise.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Waikiki Beach, and the big banyan tree keeps most of it off the courtyard below.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls in off the Pacific, and guests watch lightning over the water from inside the Beachhouse at the Moana.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Honolulu today softens Diamond Head, which looks pale and further away than usual from the east-facing Banyan Wing rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow in Waikiki would be a first since the hotel opened in 1901, best watched from a high-floor terrace.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day in Honolulu, the lounge chairs on the high-floor terrace stay empty, though the ocean view is unchanged.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the sand today, and most guests are either in the water or under the banyan tree.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night, the rope chairs on the balconies are still in use, even with no stars overhead.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Diamond Head is a faint outline from the Banyan Wing and the horizon is not visible.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the Tower Ocean View window shows the Waikiki shore lights and the outline of Diamond Head.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the arched windows of the suites, and the lights along Waikiki Beach shine through it toward Diamond Head.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Waikiki tonight, and the Tower Ocean View rooms face the beach lights along the sand.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the vineyard rows below the balconies are still dark shapes against a lighter Atlantic.
phrases.clear_morning: From an ocean-view balcony this morning, the north coast cliffs and the sea are both sharply visible.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands over the infinity pool, and the volcanic mountains inland show every ridge.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the terraced vines from the side, and guests on the restaurant terrace watch the cliffs turn orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a balcony tonight, you would see a sky full of stars above the dark Atlantic.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Santana this morning, and their shadows move across the three hectares of vines below the rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the pool has sun between the clouds, and the coastline northeast stays clear enough to follow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the north coast turns pink above the cliffs seen from the terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlantic looks grey too, but the vineyard rows and the cliff edge remain visible from the pool.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the vines today, and most guests watch it from their balconies or the restaurant instead of the pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm sits over the northeast coast, and from the ocean-view rooms the lightning shows up over the open Atlantic.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has settled on the clifftop plateau, so the nearest vine rows are visible from the balconies but the sea is not.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare this close to the Atlantic, but today a few flakes drift past the balcony railings above the vines.
phrases.very_cold: The air feels close to freezing on the balconies today, and the outdoor pool has no swimmers in it.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day like this one, the infinity pool is the most popular place on the whole quinta.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm and cloudy, and guests are finishing estate wine on the restaurant terrace above the dark Atlantic.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the balconies, the vine rows run down to the cliff edge, but haze hides the far northeast coastline today.
phrases.late_night: Dinner long over, a few coast lights show from the ocean-view rooms after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtains open in the ocean-view rooms, rain runs down the glass in the room's light.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains stay back before bed, and low cloud hangs over the north coast after midnight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Club Lounge on the 34th floor looks out on a dark Osaka skyline with only scattered lights still on.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Japanese Suite, early sun reaches the tatami floor, and the Osaka skyline stands sharp in the window frame.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites show Osaka under full sun, the skyline clear from the 33rd floor up.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun comes straight into the Club Lounge on the 34th floor, and the Osaka skyline turns warm in colour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a suite tonight, you would see the lit Osaka skyline through floor-to-ceiling glass under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Osaka this morning, and from the 34th-floor Club Lounge the skyline is lit in patches.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the city-view windows of the rooms show sun on parts of the Osaka skyline and cloud shadow on others.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over Osaka turn orange above the skyline seen from the Japanese Suite.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Osaka today, and the Club Lounge view is a flat city skyline with no shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suite living room, and the Osaka skyline looks blurred behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Osaka is visible from the 34th-floor Club Lounge, with thunder reaching the guests inside a few seconds later.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far edges of Osaka today, so from floors 33 to 35 only the nearest skyline shows.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Osaka, but today flakes pass the 34th-floor windows of the Club Lounge on their way down.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, and the Osaka skyline looks very sharp from the Japanese Suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day over Osaka, and the 34th-floor Club Lounge glass is the only thing between guests and the heat outside.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, children in the Ritz Kids teepee tent can look up at Osaka city lights through the window.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Osaka today, so from the 34th floor only the closer buildings of the skyline can be seen.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water by the bed, the lit Osaka skyline fills the Japanese Suite's window.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Japanese Suite's windows after midnight, and the Osaka skyline lights show soft and blurred behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Osaka after midnight, and from the Club Lounge on the 34th floor the city lights glow under it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lit basilica of Notre-Dame de la Garde is the only bright point above the dark Old Port rooftops.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast tables on the Les Fenêtres terrace face Notre-Dame de la Garde under a clean blue Marseille sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the Old Port, and the basilica stands out clearly from the arched suite windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun from the west lights the limestone of the hotel wings and the hilltop basilica seen from the private terraces.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a terrace tonight, you would see the illuminated Notre-Dame de la Garde above the city under clear stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Le Panier this morning, and the basilica is lit, then shaded, as seen from the balcony breakfast table.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the Old Port rooftops this afternoon while Junior Suite Terrace guests sit outside with the basilica in view.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over Marseille turn orange around Notre-Dame de la Garde, watched from the loggia.
phrases.overcast: Full grey cloud covers Marseille today, and the basilica looks pale and flat from the suite's arched windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Old Port, so lunch at Les Fenêtres happens indoors, the basilica still visible behind wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, lightning above the hill of Notre-Dame de la Garde is visible from rooms facing the Old Port.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Marseille today softens the basilica's outline, though the hilltop can still be made out from the terrace tables.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Marseille, but today a few flakes fall past the balcony doors with the basilica behind them.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, clear day the Old Port and the basilica are unusually sharp from behind the closed arched windows.
phrases.very_hot: Marseille is very hot today, and the private terraces facing Notre-Dame de la Garde stay mostly empty in the afternoon sun.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night the candlelit terrace tables stay busy, with the lit basilica standing out across the Old Port.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor today, so from the terraces the basilica is only a faint shape and the far rooftops are lost.
phrases.late_night: If you were up late, you could watch the port lights below Notre-Dame a while.
phrases.wet_evening: Over a last drink at the Capian Bar tonight, you would see the Old Port lights blur through rain under the basilica.
phrases.grey_evening: If you took a last Capian Bar cocktail up to a suite now, you would see the Old Port lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the Premier rooms above the 21st floor, the Phloen Chit skyline is still dark before sunrise, with few lights on.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop infinity pool, the downtown towers along Phloen Chit stand sharp against a clear morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over Bangkok, so most guests stay behind the floor-to-ceiling glass of their suites.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the skyscrapers gold, and the loungers on the rooftop terrace face directly toward them.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at Lennon's tonight, you would see the lit city skyline through the glass while vinyl plays.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over Phloen Chit this morning, and from the suite windows some towers are in shade, others in sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A few clouds cross the sky this afternoon, so swimmers at the rooftop infinity pool get sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds and towers both catch orange light, best seen from the rooftop bar windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the skyline from the Premier rooms looks closer, with no shadows on the buildings.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the suites, and the downtown towers look less sharp through the wet windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, guests at the rooftop bar watch lightning over Bangkok from behind the glass, under the golden lanterns.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Bangkok today hides the far towers, and from the marble bathtub only the nearest skyscrapers are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Bangkok, but if it did, the skyline from the rooftop terrace would turn white.
phrases.very_cold: If you stood at the floor-to-ceiling glass now, you would see the Phloen Chit skyline in hard cold daylight.
phrases.very_hot: The air outside is very hot today, and the rooftop infinity pool is the busiest spot in the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover Bangkok tonight, and the warm air on the rooftop terrace makes the lounging area the preferred spot.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the suites the nearest Phloen Chit towers show clearly but the distant skyline does not.
phrases.late_night: In the Premier rooms the curtain stays open on purpose tonight, and Phloen Chit's lit towers show through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the Premier rooms, and the lit Phloen Chit skyline shows through it before bed.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Bangkok after midnight, and the Phloen Chit skyline lights show through the floor-to-ceiling glass of the Premier rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the upper-floor windows show the CBD towers as dark shapes against a clear sky over Melbourne.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the spire of St. Paul's Cathedral, seen from the corner guest rooms through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Fitzroy Gardens treetops look bright green from the upper floors, with the distant hills clear behind the city.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the low sun on the CBD skyscrapers from the rooftop terrace chairs.
phrases.clear_night: The fireplace at the Terrace Bar is lit, and the Melbourne skyline shows its office lights under a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the skyline this morning, so the cathedral spire is sometimes in sun and sometimes in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the upper-floor rooms this afternoon, patches of cloud shadow cross the tree canopy and the distant hills.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the CBD towers turn orange, which guests can watch from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Melbourne today, and the skyscrapers look flat and colourless from the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the room windows, and guests are using the heated indoor pool instead of the rooftop terrace.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Melbourne skyline is visible from the corner rooms, while the rooftop terrace chairs stand empty in the storm.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the tops of the CBD towers today, and the cathedral spire appears only as a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Melbourne, but today a few flakes fall past the upper-floor windows towards the Fitzroy Gardens treetops.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, guests gather at the Terrace Bar fireplace while the skyline looks sharp in the dry air.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon in Melbourne: the rooftop terrace is mostly empty, and guests prefer the indoor pool and the Day Spa.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild with a cloudy sky, and the terrace balcony table is a comfortable place to watch the CBD lights.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the distant hills are not visible from the rooms, though the nearer CBD towers still are.
phrases.late_night: Guests on the upper floors are probably asleep by now, facing the skyline lights through windows they chose not to cover.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has the corner room tonight can watch rain run down the tall windows, the skyline lights blurred behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a corner room tonight can watch low cloud pass over the lit skyline through the floor-to-ceiling windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Space Needle is already outlined against a clear sky from the corner suite windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests collecting coffee on the ground floor this morning have a clear sky outside, and corner suites show the Space Needle sharply.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the floor-to-ceiling windows show downtown Seattle buildings in full daylight, no haze at all.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the covered terrace and its wood-slatted seating, while upstairs the Space Needle is lit by the same warm light.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Denny Suite Escape tonight, the Space Needle would be lit against a clear sky beyond the tub.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the Space Needle this morning, seen from the corner suite windows beside the indoor plants.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the corner suite windows, the Space Needle stands against broken afternoon cloud with sun between the gaps.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over Seattle turn orange while the Space Needle stands clear in the suite window.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over downtown Seattle today, and the Space Needle is still fully visible from the corner suites.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Seattle, so the covered terrace keeps its wood-slatted seats dry while the Space Needle looks wet and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests in the Denny Suite Escape can watch lightning flash behind the Space Needle from the tub.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has settled over South Lake Union, and the top of the Space Needle fades in and out of the suite view.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Seattle, which is rare, and the Space Needle has a thin white top outside the suite windows.
phrases.very_cold: Hard winter light falls on the Space Needle, seen through the frosted corner windows of the Denny Suite Escape.
phrases.very_hot: Seattle is unusually hot today, and the covered terrace offers shade for anyone sitting outside with a ground-floor coffee.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the terrace pendant lights hang above the banquette, and the Space Needle is lit under low cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests in the corner suites today see the Space Needle as a faint grey outline, with nothing clear behind it.
phrases.late_night: If you turned off the last light in a corner suite, the city lights around the Space Needle would fill the window.
phrases.wet_evening: With a last drink in a corner suite tonight, you would see the Space Needle's shape through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: A last drink in a corner suite tonight, and you would see the Space Needle's outline under low cloud, city lights around it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the corner rooms look out on dark rooftops, with the church spires just starting to show against the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight reaches the upper-floor windows early, and the spires and treetops over Frederiksberg stand out sharply.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop view from the corner rooms is at its clearest, every spire visible under a blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the upper-floor corner rooms, low afternoon sun lights the Frederiksberg rooftops and the church spires beyond.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a corner room tonight, you would see the spires as dark shapes against a clear, starry sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over Frederiksberg this morning, and the park canopy below the upper rooms changes color as they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the skyline from the upper floors sits under a mix of cloud and sun, with the spires still clear.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over Copenhagen light up above the rooftops seen from the corner rooms.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Frederiksberg today, and the rooftops and spires from the upper rooms look muted but complete.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Copenhagen rooftops right now, and the dark theater-themed rooms are a good place to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over Copenhagen, and from the upper floors the lightning shows the spires for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Thick fog over Copenhagen today means no spires at all, just the rooftops closest to the upper-floor windows.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the Frederiksberg rooftops, and the spires seen from the upper rooms are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: If you were at an upper-floor window now, you would see frost on the glass and church spires over the rooftops.
phrases.very_hot: Copenhagen is very hot today, and the park canopy seen from the upper floors is the only green thing in the view.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy in Frederiksberg, and the rooftops outside the corner rooms are lit only by city light.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The air is not clear today, so the far church spires do not show from the corner rooms, only the nearby treetops.
phrases.late_night: Once dinner downstairs is over, the corner rooms show lit Frederiksberg rooftops and Copenhagen's spires.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the corner-room windows after midnight, and the city lights over the Frederiksberg rooftops blur behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hangs over Frederiksberg after midnight, and from the corner rooms the city lights show under it across the rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the junior-suite balconies look out on a dark Atlantic, with the Sintra range just a shape against the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests at breakfast behind the dining room's arched windows see the Atlantic bright blue and Cape Roca clear on the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands over the terrace, so lunch happens under the umbrellas with the Atlantic very blue below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light hits the stone colonnade from the west, and the sea below the balcony turns a deeper colour.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear over the Atlantic, and from a junior-suite balcony the only light over the water comes from stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Sintra range this morning while the sea in front of the fortress stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on the terrace this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows moving across the water below the cliffs.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun puts colour on the clouds above the Atlantic, best seen from a junior-suite balcony.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlantic turns grey as well, and most guests watch it from inside the Sala das Damas.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the terrace tables, so the vaulted bedrooms with arched windows are the dry place for the sea view.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm over the Atlantic shows lightning out at sea, and the dining room's arched windows frame it from a safe distance.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has come in off the sea, and from the colonnade balcony even Guincho Beach below is hard to see.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on this coast, but if it fell today the fortress walls and terrace would be white above the Atlantic.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air sits over Guincho Beach, and guests look at the clear Atlantic through the arched windows rather than from balconies.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot above Guincho Beach, and the terrace umbrellas are the only shade between the tables and the Atlantic.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the air is mild, so some guests sit late on the terrace above the dark Atlantic.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short, so the water below the balconies shows well but the Sintra range and Cape Roca are hidden.
phrases.late_night: Late dinner at The Spot is over, and fortress lights touch the waves below the suites.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open before bed, rain runs down the arched windows of the junior suites and the Atlantic breaks directly below.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight a junior suite's curtain is open to cloud over the Atlantic, and the waves break against the cliff below.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky over Hong Kong has not started to lighten yet, and the lit Kowloon towers fill the suite dining area windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Wan Chai, and from the upper floors the harbour water and both skylines are sharp.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Plateau Spa pool on the 11th floor faces a bright harbour under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Hong Kong Island towers seen from the lounge's floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Victoria Harbour Suite tonight, you would see the lit skyline on both sides of clear harbour water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Kowloon this morning, and the suite dining area windows look straight at them across the harbour.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Broken cloud this afternoon means the harbour from the Plateau Spa pool changes between bright and shaded every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the distant hills turn orange in the lounge windows.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Victoria Harbour today, so the 270-degree view from the suite is wide but without much colour.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the harbour, and guests in the public area watch it through the glass facing the skyline.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Kowloon right now, and the guest rooms' floor-to-ceiling windows make a dry place to watch it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits on the harbour today, and from the Wan Chai waterfront the Kowloon towers are only faint outlines.
phrases.snow: Snow in Hong Kong is almost unheard of, but if it fell today the suite's 270-degree view would show it.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold for Hong Kong today, and the harbour from the upper floors looks clear and sharp under a bright sky.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day like this, the harbour seen from the 11th-floor Plateau Spa pool is bright and hazy with heat.
phrases.mild_night: Mild cloudy night in Wan Chai, and the lit skyscrapers across the harbour fill the lounge windows as usual.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the lounge the harbour and near towers are visible but the distant hills are not.
phrases.late_night: If you had the Victoria Harbour Suite tonight, you would sleep now and open your eyes to the harbour at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in the Victoria Harbour Suite tonight, rain would blur the skyline lights across the harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in the Victoria Harbour Suite now, you would see Kowloon's lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop pool is still and the marina lights of Port Vell are the brightest thing in view.
phrases.clear_morning: From the sea-view terrace of the Grand Suite Mediterraneo, the morning sun lands on the masts in the marina.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday, clear blue sky over Barcelona, and the sun loungers by the rooftop pool are the busiest seats in the hotel.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the palm-lined Rambla de Mar golden, seen from the rooftop terrace lounge seating.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lights of the Port Vell marina are visible from the rooftop pool edge.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over the harbour this morning, and guests in the yellow lobby armchairs see palm trees through the tall windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the marina, so the rooftop pool gets sun in short turns this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud over the marina is lit orange by the low sun, a view the rooftop pool loungers face directly.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Barcelona today, so the marina water looks grey too and the Informal restaurant seems the better plan.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop pool and the empty loungers, while the Port Vell marina is still visible below.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the harbour right now, best watched from inside the Grand Suite Mediterraneo rather than its terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers Port Vell today, and from the rooftop the masts in the marina are only outlines.
phrases.snow: Snow over Barcelona is rare, so a few flakes landing on the rooftop terrace potted plants counts as an event.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day, the rooftop pool stays empty and the marina view is the only reason to go up.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Barcelona right now, which explains why the outdoor shower beside the rooftop pool is in constant use.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and guests on the rooftop terrace lounge seating look out at the lit marina without jackets.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Limited visibility today, so the Rambla de Mar is visible from the rooftop but the far side of the harbour is not.
phrases.late_night: Long after midnight, the Grand Suite Mediterraneo windows show the marina lights on the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the tall lobby windows this evening, and the marina lights at Port Vell blur between the palms.
phrases.grey_evening: From the rooftop pool, the Port Vell marina lights show on the water under low grey cloud tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the suite terraces are still dark, and the traveller's palms in the gardens stand out against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the 3rd-floor pool, the city skyline and Marina Bay Sands are sharp this morning under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the courtyard, and guests take the shade under the verandah's white arches.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the white heritage building and the palms, seen from the verandah's dark wood planter's chairs.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the courtyard lanterns light the traveller's palms and the ivy-covered walls below the suite terraces.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the pool this morning, and the skyline with Marina Bay Sands stays visible from the 3rd floor.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud in the afternoon makes the suite terraces more comfortable, with the traveller's palms below partly in shade.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the skyline turn orange, seen from the rattan bench on the verandah.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Singapore today, so the 3rd-floor pool is less bright than usual and the gardens look a deeper green.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the courtyard gardens, and guests watch it from the covered verandah in the dark wood planter's chairs.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Singapore: the 3rd-floor pool is empty, and the Writers Bar is the sensible place to wait indoors.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Singapore today, and from the pool the Marina Bay Sands towers are a pale outline rather than a clear shape.
phrases.snow: Snow does not happen in Singapore, but if it ever did, the traveller's palms below the terraces would look very strange.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing weather is unknown here, but on such a day the open-air courtyard would be empty and the Tiffin Room full.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot this afternoon, so the 3rd-floor pool is the obvious place, with the city skyline in full sun behind it.
phrases.mild_night: Cloudy but warm tonight, and the courtyard lanterns are on under the ironwork canopy while dinner is served in the open air.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the pool the far skyline is faint and Marina Bay Sands is hard to see.
phrases.late_night: Anyone up for a glass of water near midnight in a suite above the courtyard sees the palms lit by its lanterns.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever is up in a suite tonight watches the rain fall past the courtyard lanterns onto the traveller's palms.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the suites after midnight sees the courtyard palms under hazy cloud, and the city glow above the rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the marina lights across the Gulf of Saint-Tropez are still on, seen from every room terrace on the hill.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Suite Belrose, the clear morning shows the full line from the bay to the Alps, no haze in between.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the terrace, and most guests choose the sunloungers under the poolside umbrellas.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Massif des Maures, and dinner tables at Le Belrose face a bay that is turning orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your room terrace tonight, you would see the marina lights of Saint-Tropez and sailboats in the Gulf.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Gulf this morning, so the sea seen from the garden rooms switches between grey and blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud shadows move across the Massif des Maures this afternoon, visible from the sunloungers on the terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the bay turn pink and orange, seen from the terrace of Le Belrose.
phrases.overcast: A full grey sky covers the Gulf today, and the Alps are not visible from the Suite Belrose, only the near hills.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the lawn and the sunloungers, so lunch moves inside to the dining room with the arched windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Gulf of Saint-Tropez is easy to watch from the dining room, behind glass and under the chandelier.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits on the bay today, and from the room terraces the sea is a pale strip with no Alps behind it.
phrases.snow: Late at night, snow falls past the terraces on the Gassin hill toward the marina lights on the Gulf of Saint-Tropez.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day the Alps stand out sharply from the Suite Belrose, though the terraces stay empty.
phrases.very_hot: Heat over the Gulf is strong today, so the shaded dining chairs on the terrace are busier than the sunloungers.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy warm night, the marina lights are the brightest thing seen from the terrace of Le Belrose, with no stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the bay still shows from the terraces, but the Alps and the far hills do not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the room lights are off in the Suite Belrose, and only the marina across the Gulf of Saint-Tropez shows.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner at Le Belrose, the room's French windows show rain over the Gulf and blurred marina lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Le Belrose is over, and the marina lights across the Gulf show under low cloud from the Suite Belrose.

phrases.clear_predawn: Guests on upper-floor balconies before sunrise look across Shark's Bay toward the first light over the Red Sea under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From Mezzaluna's window tables this morning, Tiran Island is clearly visible across flat, deep-blue water in Shark's Bay.
phrases.clear_midday: Striped sunloungers on the pool deck are mostly under red umbrellas now, because the midday sun over Sharm is strong.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last hours of sun, snorkellers use the private jetty to reach the house reef while the pool deck empties slowly.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your balcony tonight, you would see a clear sky over Shark's Bay and a dark, quiet sea.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Red Sea this morning, but Tiran Island is still visible from the upper-floor balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the pool complex this afternoon, so the striped sunloungers get sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun puts some colour on the clouds above Tiran Island, seen from Mezzaluna's window tables.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the water in Shark's Bay looks darker from the balconies, and the pool deck is quieter.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Sharm El-Sheikh, and today's wet pool deck sends most guests inside to Silk Road or Mezzaluna.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the balconies are the safest place to watch the bay, and the private jetty is empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Red Sea hides Tiran Island today, so the upper-floor view stops at the water inside the cove.
phrases.snow: Snow in Sharm El-Sheikh is almost unheard of, so the palm trees around the lagoon-style pool would look very strange today.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold day, the pool deck sunloungers stay empty and guests watch the bay from behind balcony doors.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, most guests stay in the lagoon-style pool or the water off the coral beach, under red umbrellas between swims.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Shark's Bay, and the balconies are warm enough to sit out with the sea almost silent below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Tiran Island and the distant headland are not visible from the balconies, only the cove's near water.
phrases.late_night: If you were up late in an upper-floor room, you could sit a while longer watching the resort lights along Shark's Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink at your window now, you would see rain on the glass and the pool lights beside the beach.
phrases.grey_evening: If you took a last drink to the window now, you would see cloud over Shark's Bay and the pool lamps.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the cable stays of the Ponte Estaiada are already visible from the corner suites, with the river below still dark.
phrases.clear_morning: From the marble soaking tub, the bridge and the Pinheiros River show clearly in bright morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the outdoor pool, while the suite windows frame the bridge against a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light hits the skyline, and the Diplomatic Suite's corner windows catch both the bridge and the river.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the Ponte Estaiada and the skyline from a bathtub under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the skyline this morning, and the bridge stands out clearly from the guest room windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the suite living room get a skyline view under broken cloud, with sunlight coming and going this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, gaps in the cloud light the Pinheiros River and the bridge outside the corner suites.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over São Paulo today, so the bridge looks flat from the windows, and the indoor pool is busier.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Pinheiros River right now, and the floor-to-ceiling windows keep it off the bathtub.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the São Paulo skyline is visible from the corner suites, and the outdoor pool is empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides parts of the skyline today, though the near end of the Ponte Estaiada still shows from the suites.
phrases.snow: Snow in São Paulo would be very unusual, but if it fell today the 24-hour fitness room would stay open.
phrases.very_cold: From the corner suite, the Estaiada Bridge cables stand out in hard winter light above the Pinheiros River.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the city, and the outdoor pool is where most guests are right now.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and from the Diplomatic Suite's living room the bridge and river are both in view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far skyline is missing from the windows, while the bridge across the river still shows.
phrases.late_night: City lights lie on the Pinheiros River after midnight, and the Diplomatic Suite's corner windows hold the cable-stayed bridge at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open before bed in the Diplomatic Suite, the bridge cables show through the rain against the lit city.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open after midnight in the Diplomatic Suite, the lit city and the Estaiada Bridge show across the Pinheiros River under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lights of Eureka Tower and Australia 108 are the main thing visible from the skyline-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: A clear morning shows the Southbank roofline sharply below the 27th-floor pool, with Port Phillip Bay bright beyond it.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, guests on the stationary bikes in the gym have the city skyline in front of them under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low afternoon sun lights up Eureka Tower and Australia 108 as seen from the teal velvet chair in a suite.
phrases.clear_night: After dark, swimmers in the heated indoor pool look out at the skyline lights, sharp under a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: If you were there this morning, you would see scattered clouds passing over the Southbank roofline from the indoor lap pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over Port Phillip Bay this afternoon, so the bay-facing rooms get sun in short periods.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds take on colour behind Eureka Tower, visible from the 27th-floor pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Melbourne skyline has less contrast from the rooms, but Australia 108 still stands out clearly.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the 27th-floor pool, while the water inside stays heated and calm.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Port Phillip Bay is visible from the bay-facing rooms, and guests are watching it from behind the glass.
