phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of Eureka Tower today, and the Southbank roofline is only a faint shape from the pool.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Melbourne, but today a few flakes fall past the suite windows while the indoor pool stays heated.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside, and the clear air makes Australia 108 unusually sharp from the gym's stationary bikes.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot Melbourne day, the 27th-floor pool is at least indoors, and the skyline is sharp through the glass.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and from the bay-facing rooms the cloud cover over Port Phillip Bay is easy to see.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is down to a few kilometres today, so Port Phillip Bay is not visible from the pool, only the Southbank roofline.
phrases.late_night: The suite's blinds stay pulled back tonight, so the skyline lights reach the bed until sleep comes.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows this evening, and the Melbourne skyline lights look blurred through the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Melbourne after midnight, and the skyline-facing rooms look out on the lit city beneath it through floor-to-ceiling windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Executive Suite terrace shows the Burj Khalifa as a dark shape east and the Gulf unlit west.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Premier Skyline View room, the morning sun stands behind the Burj Khalifa, so the tower appears almost as a silhouette.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun covers the private beach, and from the Executive Suite terrace the Gulf looks very bright to the west.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Executive Suite terrace faces the sunset over the Gulf while, on the other side, the Burj Khalifa turns gold.
phrases.clear_night: On the Mercury Lounge roof tonight, the shisha tables face a lit Burj Khalifa under a clear sky with no haze.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the city this morning, and from the balcony the Burj Khalifa shows against patches of blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Scattered clouds pass over Dubai this afternoon, so the private beach gets sun and shade in turns every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the balcony with Arabic coffee, you would see the last sun colour the clouds behind the Burj Khalifa.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Dubai today, but the Burj Khalifa still shows from the Premier Skyline View rooms without sun on it.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Dubai, and today it falls on the private beach while guests watch it from the suite balconies.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm over the Gulf means lightning on one side of the Executive Suite terrace and the Burj Khalifa on the other.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Dubai today softens the Burj Khalifa into a pale outline, even from the roof of the Mercury Lounge.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Dubai, so a flake on the private beach would surprise everyone on the suite balconies.
phrases.very_cold: Cold air like this is very rare in Dubai, and the blue sun loungers on the private beach sit mostly empty.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the private beach, so most guests are in the Gulf rather than on the loungers.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the moon tonight, but the Mercury Lounge terrace is warm and the Burj Khalifa lights still show clearly.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Premier Skyline View rooms the Burj Khalifa is a faint shape at best.
phrases.late_night: Lights off in an Executive Suite after midnight, only the skyline glow around the Burj Khalifa spire comes in.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open in a Premier Skyline View room, rain blurs the city lights east toward the Burj Khalifa.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain in a Premier Skyline View room is open late, and the Burj Khalifa's spire stands out above hazy city lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Caribbean outside the balcony soaking tubs is dark and flat, with no tower lights on the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight comes straight through the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the sea beyond the palm trees is already bright blue.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the white umbrellas on the pool deck are the only shade between the freeform pools and the beach.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low sun lights the palm trees around the infinity pool, and the alfresco tables at Malpeque face a calm sea.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars above the fire pit lounge and nothing but dark sea past the pergola.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the beach this morning, and from the balcony seating the sea changes shade under them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun alternate over the freeform pools this afternoon, so the palm-lined deck is bright one minute, shaded the next.
phrases.partly_golden: From the woven chairs on the plunge pool terrace, the clouds over the Caribbean turn orange as the sun drops.
phrases.overcast: From the private balconies, low grey cloud sits over the Caribbean and the palms along the beach show no shadow.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the beach and the pool deck, and guests watch it from the room through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the open Caribbean is easy to see from every room, since no neighboring towers stand in the way.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze blurs the line between sea and sky today, but the palm trees around the infinity pool are still sharp.
phrases.snow: Snow is not something this coast gets, so any flakes reported today would be a surprise to everyone on the pool deck.
phrases.very_cold: Guests on their private balconies this morning look out over the empty pool deck to the Caribbean in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the beach today, so most guests stay in the freeform pools or under the white umbrellas.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night at the sunken fire pit lounge, with the sea beyond the pergola heard more than seen.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from the balcony the horizon is not clear and the far sea blends into the sky.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the ocean-view rooms are likely asleep by now, and the Caribbean will fill their windows at sunrise.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests awake after midnight in the ocean-view rooms watch rain run down the glass, pale surf behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the ocean-view rooms after midnight can watch low cloud pass over the Caribbean through the floor-to-ceiling glass.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Duomo spire is already visible from the Imperial Suite terrace, with Brera's rooftops still dark below.
phrases.clear_morning: From the guest rooms, a clear sky sits over the Porta Nuova towers, and Caffé Parigi is serving breakfast on Bernardaud porcelain.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Duomo stands in full sun, and with no room below the fourth floor, Brera's rooftops stay in view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low afternoon sun turns the Porta Nuova towers orange, seen through the open balcony doors of a guest room.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the Duomo lit up from the Imperial Suite terrace, with the jacuzzi behind you.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Castello Sforzesco this morning, and the Brera rooftops below the guest rooms are sometimes in sun, sometimes in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the Imperial Suite terrace, the Duomo spire stands above the Brera rooftops under patchy afternoon cloud.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds above the Duomo turn pink, seen from the Imperial Suite's dinner table outside.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the Duomo looks pale and flat from the suite's floor-to-ceiling windows, but it is all visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Brera's rooftops, and the indoor pool on the third floor is the obvious choice today.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Porta Nuova towers can be watched from a guest room, with the balcony doors closed for once.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Duomo today, so the view from the Imperial Suite terrace ends at the nearest Brera rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on Brera's rooftops, rare for Milan, and the Duomo spire is white when seen from the suite.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold, the Castello Sforzesco is sharp and clear from the upper rooms, and few guests use the terrace.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the Duomo and the Brera rooftops, and the Imperial Suite terrace is a better idea after sunset.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild, cloudy night in Milan, and the Duomo's lights are easy to see from the suite's living room windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Porta Nuova towers are not clear from the rooms, though Brera's nearby rooftops still are.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Imperial Suite is dark inside, and the skyline lights toward the Duomo are the only light in the room.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Imperial Suite windows this evening, and the Duomo's outline shows through it above the lit Brera streets.
phrases.grey_evening: Tonight the Imperial Suite's windows frame the Duomo's spire as Milan's lights come on under a low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Giralda tower is still dark against a clear sky when seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests on the Grand Deluxe terraces have the Giralda in full sun this morning, with nothing in the sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the pool umbrellas are the most popular spot, with the historic facade in strong Seville sunlight behind them.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The low afternoon sun turns the Giralda tower a warm colour, and the rooftop lounge chairs face straight at it.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Reales Alcazares suite tonight, you would see the Giralda against a clear sky full of stars.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Seville this morning, and from the balcony wicker chairs the treetops are in changing light.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud cross Seville this afternoon, and from the rooftop terrace the Giralda changes from bright to dull every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: From the loggia, the last hour of sun lights up the broken clouds over the city in pink and blue.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Giralda is still clearly visible from the rooftop terrace, just without any shadows today.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the empty pool loungers, and guests have moved under the chandeliers of the tiled atrium.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Seville, and the arched windows of the guest rooms show lightning above the wet garden foliage.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the city today, so the Giralda appears as a soft grey shape from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow in Seville is very rare, but a few flakes are landing on the palm trees in front of the facade today.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, and the colonnaded courtyard of Restaurante San Fernando has only a few brave guests.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon in Seville, the pool is the busiest place in the hotel and the rooftop terrace is empty.
phrases.mild_night: On this warm, cloudy night, the rooftop terrace is comfortable, and the Giralda is visible without any stars behind it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so the city skyline beyond the treetops is unclear from the balcony, though the nearby Giralda remains visible.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Reales Alcazares suite is dark inside, and the only light comes from the city around the Giralda's outline.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Restaurante San Fernando tonight, the Reales Alcazares suite window shows the Giralda's shape through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Restaurante San Fernando, the Reales Alcazares suite window shows the Giralda tower and lit rooftops under low cloud tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the tenth-floor terrace is empty and the Royal Palace stands dark against a clear sky over Madrid.
phrases.clear_morning: If you stood on the tenth-floor terrace now, you would see the Royal Palace clear under a blue morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop pool from 1948 gets full sun, and the Almudena Cathedral is sharp on the skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the tenth floor now, you would see low sun on the terracotta rooftops towards the Royal Palace.
phrases.clear_night: The Royal Palace and the cathedral are lit tonight, and the fire bowl on the terrace is burning too.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Cuatro Torres this morning, while the covered part of the rooftop terrace is in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some clouds cross Madrid this afternoon, so the rooftop pool gets sun for a few minutes, then shade again.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky behind the Royal Palace, seen from the tenth-floor terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Almudena Cathedral still looks clear from the terrace, just without any shadows today.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Gran Vía; from the ninth-floor rooms, the balcony tiles are wet and the traffic moves slowly.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Madrid, and guests on the tenth floor have moved under the covered part of the terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze thins the view today; the Royal Palace is a pale shape from the rooftop, the Cuatro Torres barely there.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Madrid, but today it lands on the terracotta rooftops seen from the guest room balconies.
phrases.very_cold: Bright but very cold today, so the rooftop pool stays empty and the cathedral looks sharp from the tenth floor.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot afternoon in Madrid; the rooftop pool on the tenth floor is the only place guests want to be.
phrases.mild_night: A warm night with cloud cover; guests sit at the bar under the pergola while the Royal Palace lights stay on.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Royal Palace and cathedral are still clear from the terrace, but the Cuatro Torres are not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Royal Palace roofline shows above the lit rooftops, worth another long look.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the ninth-floor windows, and the Royal Palace's long roofline shows past the wet city rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: From the tenth floor after midnight, thin cloud passes over the lit rooftops toward the Royal Palace and the Almudena.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Penthouse terrace is dark and empty, and the Duomo stands against a clear sky over Milan.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Penthouse terrace, the Duomo is sharp in clear morning sun, and the city rooftops are easy to pick out.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the Duomo stands sharp above the Milan rooftops beyond the Penthouse Suite terrace.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the fifth-floor Penthouse terrace, low afternoon sun lights the Duomo above the Milan rooftops under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop terrace tonight, you would see the Duomo lit against a clear sky over Milan.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Milan this morning, but the Duomo is still clear from the Penthouse terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the courtyard this afternoon, and guests on the Stilla terrace move between sun and shade.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the bell tower and rooftops seen from the Penthouse terrace, with broken cloud above.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Duomo looks flat and pale from the Penthouse terrace, and the formal garden is quiet.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Flavio Pollano's formal garden, and the terraces of Stilla and Zelo stand empty while guests eat inside.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Milan, nobody is out on the rooftop terrace, and the Duomo appears in each flash of lightning.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs over Milan today, so the Duomo is only a faint grey shape from the Penthouse terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the clipped topiaries in the courtyard, and the Duomo roof turns white in the view from the Penthouse.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air sits over Milan today, but the sky is clear and the Duomo stands sharp from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.very_hot: From the Penthouse Suite's rooftop terrace, the Duomo stands in heat-haze above the baking Milan rooftops at midday.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and guests on the rooftop terrace can eat outside with the Duomo in view.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor today, so the Duomo is only a dim outline from the Penthouse terrace and distant rooftops are hidden.
phrases.late_night: Lights are off in the Penthouse Suite after midnight, and the city glow around the Duomo's spires is the only light left.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at Zelo is over, and after midnight the Duomo's spires show through rain on the Penthouse Suite windows.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Zelo, the Duomo's spires show under low cloud from the Penthouse Suite, city lights spread around them.

phrases.clear_predawn: In the dark before dawn, the waterhole below the decks is only a grey shape and no animals show yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests on the main lodge pool deck face the waterhole in full sun, waiting to see which animals come to drink.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the heated plunge pools are the coolest places in camp, and the bushveld beyond the decks is very bright.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun from the west lights the marula trees around the waterhole, seen from the private decks of the Luxury Suites.
phrases.clear_night: From the main lodge pool deck, a clear night sky shows bright stars above the resident waterhole and the bushveld.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the Thornybush sky this morning, so the light on the waterhole changes every few minutes from the decks.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the spa treatment room, the lily pond is half in shade and half in sun as clouds pass over the bush.
phrases.partly_golden: At the bush dinner table, the last sun colours the clouds over the distant Kruger mountains before the lanterns are lit.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers the bushveld today, but the waterhole still pulls elephant and buffalo into view from the pool deck.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the waterhole and the dry scrub, while the thatched gazebo on each deck keeps the loungers dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Greater Kruger is visible from the suites, and guests watch it behind the wide glass doors, not the deck.
phrases.fog_haze: Morning haze hides the far bush, so from the decks only the waterhole and the nearest wild fig trees are clear.
phrases.snow: If you were on your suite deck now, you would see snow settling on the dry bush around the waterhole.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear morning, the heated plunge pools steam on the private decks while frost sits on the bush beyond.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air hangs over the bushveld, so the spa bath looking over the bush is a popular place to stay still.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy late-night sky, candles at the Masiya Bar light the near edge of the bushveld in front of camp.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the distant Kruger mountains cannot be seen from camp, only the waterhole and the near trees.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the view from a Luxury Suite is the waterhole in front of camp, where an elephant might come to drink.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner in the Luxury Suites, rain streaks the glass doors and the waterhole in front of camp shows through it.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the glass doors of the Luxury Suites open onto the waterhole, pale under a cloudy sky tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Opera House is a dark shape from the king room window seat, with the Harbour Bridge lights still on.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the Opera House roofs look white from the suite dining room and the North Shore is sharp.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the harbour is bright blue below the king room window, and the sun is strong on the Harbour Bridge steel.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the Aster terrace now, you would see the low sun lighting the Opera House and the harbour.
phrases.clear_night: City lights reflect on the harbour water tonight, and from the terrace the Opera House and Harbour Bridge are clearly lit.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Sydney this morning, but the Royal Botanic Garden is clear from the suite with the daybed.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the North Shore this afternoon, so the Opera House moves in and out of sun from the high-floor window.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds above the Harbour Bridge, and guests on the Aster terrace have oysters and cocktails.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the harbour today, and from the indoor pool the Opera House looks white against the flat clouds.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Circular Quay, so the Harbour Bridge is blurred behind the wet glass of the indoor pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Sydney Harbour keeps guests off the Aster terrace, and they watch the storm from inside the 32nd-floor bar.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog on the harbour hides the North Shore, and only the nearest part of the Harbour Bridge shows from the lounge windows.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never falls in Sydney, but if it did, you would watch it from the bathtub facing the harbour window.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside today, unusual for Sydney, and the Harbour Bridge stands very sharp in the cold clear air.
phrases.very_hot: From the 32nd-floor Aster bar, heat-haze shimmers over Circular Quay and the white roofs of the Opera House.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover Sydney on this mild night, but the Harbour Bridge lights still reflect on the water below the lit terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Sydney today, so the North Shore is not visible from the Aster bar, only the Opera House nearby.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water sits on the king room window seat, and city lights reflect on the harbour under the Bridge.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the king-room window tonight, and city lights shine on the harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight low cloud hangs over the harbour, and the king-room windows frame the Harbour Bridge against city lights on the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Just before dawn, the Acropolis is a dark outline from the Executive room terraces, with the Temple of Olympian Zeus unlit below.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the rooftop this morning faces the Parthenon straight on, with clear light on the Acropolis and the city.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the Acropolis stands sharp from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Acropolis-view bedrooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you stood on a 7th-floor terrace now, you would see low sun on the Acropolis under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: After midnight the lit columns of the Temple of Olympian Zeus stand below the Acropolis under a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Parthenon this morning, seen from a breakfast table on the rooftop with juice and fruit.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Afternoon brings a mix of cloud and sun over the Temple of Olympian Zeus, directly below the Executive room terraces.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Acropolis turn orange, seen from the rooftop restaurant tables.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Athens today, but Hadrian's Arch and the Temple of Olympian Zeus remain clearly visible from the hotel.

phrases.grey_evening: With a last glass on the rooftop after midnight, you would see the Acropolis outlined above the city lights under low cloud.

phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open in a river-facing suite after midnight, the city lights show under low cloud along the Chao Phraya.

phrases.grey_evening: Haze covers Manhattan after midnight, and the Empire State Building fills the guest-room window with the city lights around it.

phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is down today, so from the king bedroom window the beach is clear but the far coastline is not.
phrases.late_night: Around two in the corner suite, the only glow comes through the floor-to-ceiling windows from the moonlit Atlantic.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Albalone, rain runs down the corner suite windows and the surf shows pale through the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Albalone, the corner suite's floor-to-ceiling windows show the lit beachfront and the Atlantic under low cloud.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the west sides of the downtown towers, and the Presidential Suite has the whole cityscape in view.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of shade and sun move across downtown this afternoon, and the heated pool faces the whole skyline.

phrases.grey_evening: With curtains open after midnight, the Sydney Suite faces harbour lights under cloud between the Opera House and the Bridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Dark sea and dark lawns below the upper balconies, and only a thin grey line showing above the Atlantic before sunrise.
phrases.clear_morning: Sun comes in from the sunrise side now, and the red umbrellas by the curved pool are already set out.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the lawns around the pool are bright green and the Atlantic looks flat and blue from every balcony.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on an upper balcony this afternoon, you would see the sun dropping slowly toward the sea.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the Atlantic is clear, and the terraces of the upper suites look out at a dark sea.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the sea this morning, and the palm trees by the pool throw moving shadows on the lawn.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Over the Atlantic the clouds break up this afternoon, and the lawn by the pool turns bright, then dull, then bright.
phrases.partly_golden: From an upper balcony, the last sun is going down between clouds and the headlands along the coast look hazy.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Lagos today, the Atlantic is grey too, and the red umbrellas are the brightest thing in view.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the empty lounge chairs by the pool, while guests move indoors to the sauna and Turkish bath.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were in an upper suite now, you would watch lightning over the Atlantic from behind the closed balcony doors.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the sea today means the headlands are hard to see, though the lawns and palm trees are clear enough.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare in the Algarve, but a few flakes are landing on the lawns around the pool and melting fast.
phrases.very_cold: Hard winter light falls on the curved pool, the palm trees and the empty lounge chairs above the Atlantic.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot this afternoon, so most guests are either in the pool or under the red umbrellas, not on the lawn.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Lagos, and the terraces of the upper rooms are warm enough to sit outside late.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the headlands cannot be seen from the balconies, only the nearby sea and the lawns.
phrases.late_night: In the upper-floor rooms the curtain is left open after midnight, and the moon lies on the Atlantic past the lawns.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight rain runs down the upper-floor windows, and the pool and palms look wet under a low sky over the Atlantic.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud passes over the Atlantic, and from the upper-floor rooms the water shows grey beneath it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Eiffel Tower is already a dark shape in the window of a Premium room, above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_morning: Croissants and orange juice are out on the breakfast terrace, and the sun is on the courtyard trees.
phrases.clear_midday: From a Premium terrace, the Eiffel Tower stands sharp against a blue sky, with no cloud anywhere over Paris.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were at a Premium room window now, you would see the Eiffel Tower lit gold above the 7th arrondissement rooftops.
phrases.clear_night: Night over Paris with a clear sky, and the Eiffel Tower is lit, seen directly from the Premium room windows.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Eiffel Tower this morning, while guests take breakfast on the outdoor terrace.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun and shade move across the Eiffel Tower this afternoon, watched from the Premium terraces.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken clouds over the Eiffel Tower catch some colour before sunset, seen from the Premium room windows.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Paris today, and the Eiffel Tower in the Premium window is grey as well, though fully visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the courtyard trees and the wooden seating, and the Eiffel Tower looks pale through wet Premium windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, the Eiffel Tower is the obvious place to watch for lightning, safely from behind a Premium window.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the 7th arrondissement today; the lower part of the Eiffel Tower shows, the top does not.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the courtyard column and the wooden seats, and the Eiffel Tower appears through flakes from the Premium rooms.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air outside today, so the Premium terraces are mostly unused, and the Eiffel Tower view is enjoyed from behind glass.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the shade of the mature courtyard trees is more popular than a Premium terrace in full sun.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Paris, and the Eiffel Tower lights show clearly from the Premium balconies under the cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Paris today; the Eiffel Tower is a dim outline in the Premium window, nothing more.
phrases.late_night: In a Premium room tonight, the curtain is left open on purpose, so the Eiffel Tower fills the window until sleep comes.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtain pulled back late tonight in the Premium category, rain streaks the glass and the Eiffel Tower rises above wet, lit rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Before bed, with the curtain drawn back, the Eiffel Tower's outline rises above glowing 7th arrondissement rooftops under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gulf is still dark from the balcony, and the hills across the bay are only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun lands on the infinity pool, and from the guest rooms the hilly coastline looks sharp and clear.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a cloudless sky, the bay is flat and bright, and guests on the pool terrace are mostly in the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light reaches across the Gulf, and the first tables on the Moloko rooftop face Saint-Tropez village.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop terrace tonight, you would see the lights of Saint-Tropez village across a dark, calm bay.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the bay this morning, and the umbrella pines below the balconies are still in the shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Gulf, so the water seen from the sunken lounge seating changes from grey-blue to blue.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud sits above the hills across the bay, visible from the rooftop dining tables.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky from edge to edge today, and the Gulf looks flat and pale from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Mediterranean park, and the wooden sun loungers on the private terraces are empty and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Gulf this hour, and from the guest rooms you can watch lightning above the hilly coastline.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the bay today, so the hills across the water are faint from the pool terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare here, but today a few flakes fall on the umbrella pines while the heated pools stay in use.
phrases.very_cold: From the floor-to-ceiling windows, hard winter light falls on the Gulf of Saint-Tropez and the empty sea-facing pool terrace below.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon on Bouillabaisse beach, and most guests are in the infinity pool rather than on the loungers.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night, and dinner on the Moloko rooftop terrace continues with the bay dark beyond the tables.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the hills across the bay cannot be seen from the pool terrace, only the near water.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the village lights show unwatched across the Gulf from the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the coast comes back at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Before bed, with the curtain open, rain on the room's floor-to-ceiling windows blurs the village lights across the bay.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, the curtains of the sea-view rooms are open to the lights of Saint-Tropez village under low cloud across the bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the wooden terrace with its two lounge chairs faces a dark, calm Atlantic and a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the restaurant on the rise, the Martinhal islands sit sharp against a clear sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: From the restaurant's rise, midday sun lights the rocky cliffs and the sand of Martinhal Beach under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the rocky cliffs orange, seen from the bedroom terraces with sea views.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars over the Atlantic from the two lounge chairs on the wooden terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: This morning, patchy cloud sits over the islands, and parents in the dining area have time to finish a cappuccino slowly.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Through the living room's floor-to-ceiling windows, cloud shadows move across the sea in front of the islands.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds pink above Martinhal Beach, watched from the restaurant above the cliffs.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the Atlantic today; the turquoise water looks darker from the pool, but the islands are still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain on Sagres right now, so guests are watching the waves on Martinhal Beach from the dining area instead of kayaking.
phrases.thunderstorm: Guests in the sea-view bedrooms can watch lightning over the Martinhal islands while the storm passes Sagres.
phrases.fog_haze: From the raised restaurant, daytime sea fog hides the Martinhal islands and leaves only the near rocks in view.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Sagres, which almost never happens; from the bedroom terraces the beach is briefly white.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air on the cliffs today, so the pool is empty, although the view to the islands is clear.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon like this, most guests are in the pool or in the sea at Martinhal Beach.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but the air is mild and the wooden terrace is a comfortable place to sit.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the raised restaurant, Martinhal Beach and the near rocky cliffs show clearly, but the Martinhal islands fade into haze today.
phrases.late_night: Anyone awake after midnight in a sea-view bedroom keeps watching the waves break white.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the sea-view bedrooms tonight has rain running down the glass and the sound of Atlantic waves outside.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a sea-view bedroom after midnight has low cloud over the Atlantic and waves breaking on Martinhal Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Dolomites across the valley are only dark shapes from the balconies, and the rooftop pool is already steaming.
phrases.clear_morning: From the room balconies, Peitlerkofel and the Prags peaks stand sharp under a clear sky, with the Pustertal meadows below.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun lands on the outdoor pool loungers, and the forested mountains beyond are clearly visible from the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the late afternoon the pale Dolomite groups across the valley turn warmer in colour, seen from every room's balcony.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the last gondola has stopped and the bar fireplace is still burning for the adults-only guests.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit over parts of the Dolomites this morning, so from the balconies some peaks appear and others stay hidden.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The sauna's panoramic windows face green meadows that go light and dark as afternoon clouds pass over the Pustertal.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in the rooftop pool now, you would see the last sun hitting the Prags peaks between the clouds.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the Pustertal today, and the Dolomites are a flat outline from the floor-to-ceiling room windows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Pustertal meadows, so the four-floor climbing wall in the Acquapura Summit SPA gets more use than usual.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls across the Pustertal, and the safest view of the lightning over the Dolomites is from behind the room glazing.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits in the Pustertal today, so the Dolomites cannot be seen and the sauna windows show only the nearest meadows.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the valley, and swimmers in the heated rooftop pool have both steam and snowflakes above them.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, which is exactly when the heated rooftop pool steams most against the snow-covered valley.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the outdoor pool is the busiest place here, with the forested mountains beyond standing in full sun.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night covers the Pustertal, and the room balconies are warm enough for sitting out after dinner at 7Summit.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the Dolomites across the valley cannot be seen, and the meadows below are what remains.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner at 7Summit, the floor-to-ceiling window frames a few valley lights where the Dolomites will show at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open after midnight, snow falls past the floor-to-ceiling glass, and a few valley lights show toward the Dolomites.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight the curtains stay open in the rooms, and low cloud hides the Dolomites while a few Pustertal lights show below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sky Pool Lounge is empty, and the Tagus estuary is only a pale strip past the dark park.
phrases.clear_morning: From the upper-floor suites, the morning sun lights Eduardo VII Park first and then the terracotta rooftops behind it.
phrases.clear_midday: If you stood at the Sky Pool Lounge now, you would see the Tagus bright under the midday sun beyond Eduardo VII Park.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun turns the terracotta rooftops orange, and the Tagus estuary looks bright beyond the hills from the pool.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at KŌJI on the 12th floor tonight, you would see city lights under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over Eduardo VII Park this morning, and guests on the rooftop terrace sit under the wooden pergola.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the terracotta rooftops this afternoon, while the Tagus estuary stays visible from the Sky Pool Lounge.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the castle hills turn pink, watched from the wicker seats on the terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the view from the king room corner window is treetops and rooftops without strong colour.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop terrace today, and most guests watch the wet rooftops from inside KŌJI or their suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: The infinity pool is closed during the storm, and lightning over the Tagus estuary is visible from the upper-floor suites.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Tagus estuary today, so the Sky Pool Lounge view stops at Eduardo VII Park and the nearest rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Lisbon, but today a few flakes fall past the suite windows above Eduardo VII Park.
phrases.very_cold: On this unusually cold day, the rooftop terrace is almost empty, though the castle hills look sharp in the clear air.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Lisbon today, so guests stay in the infinity pool and look at the Tagus estuary from the water.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under clouds, and guests on the rooftop terrace sit by the glass railings above the city lights.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the Sky Pool Lounge, Eduardo VII Park and the nearby rooftops show clearly, but haze hides the Tagus today.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the upper-floor suites are asleep by now, city lights outside, and at dawn the windows will show the Tagus.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in an upper-floor suite tonight sees rain on the glass and city lights spread down toward the Tagus.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has an upper-floor suite after midnight can see the city lights spread from the park to the Tagus under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the glass wall of an overwater villa shows a dark lagoon and a sky slowly turning grey.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight comes through the bedroom glass and across the pool terrace at the same time, with clear water outside.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the lagoon is bright turquoise, and the sun loungers on the white sand have very short shadows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests in the overwater villas look through the floor-to-ceiling glass at low sun on the turquoise lagoon under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight, through the full glass wall of an overwater villa, the dark ocean sits under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the lagoon this morning, and the hammock near the tall palms is in light shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the dark-wood deck, afternoon cloud shadows move across the turquoise lagoon toward the ocean horizon.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the cloud edges above the horizon, seen from the private pool of a villa.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the lagoon looks a softer turquoise, and dinner on the sand under the wooden teepee still happens.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the glass wall of the villa, and the open ocean outside is grey rather than turquoise today.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the open ocean is visible from inside the villa, where guests wait behind the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water hides the horizon line today, so from the deck the ocean and sky are hard to tell apart.
phrases.snow: Snow is not something the Maldives gets, so if it fell tonight, it would melt on the warm villa deck at once.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day here would be a first, and the lagoon outside the bathroom window would look exactly the same.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day the lap pool on the wood deck is a popular spot, with the palms giving some shade.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky on this warm night, and the hanging rattan egg chair on the beach faces a dark lagoon.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the villa the horizon is not clear, though the lagoon colour is still turquoise.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the lagoon is there through the overwater villa's glass wall, lit by the pool.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the overwater villa, and the lagoon beyond fades into the night.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner is over, and the overwater villa's glass wall shows the lagoon under cloud, the deck light on the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Castle View rooms look onto a dark Edinburgh Castle, with the sky slowly turning pale behind Arthur's Seat.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the W Deck shows Edinburgh Castle, Calton Hill and the Firth of Forth in sharp detail.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun sits high over Arthur's Seat, and guests on the 12th-floor terrace can see the Balmoral clock tower clearly.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the W Deck now, you would see the low sun turning Edinburgh Castle into a dark outline.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the city lights are on, and from the SUSHISAMBA windows the lit skyline fills the whole glass wall.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Calton Hill this morning, while the rest of the view from the W Deck stays in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the Georgian rooftops this afternoon, and the Castle View rooms get the castle in changing light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over Arthur's Seat turns orange, seen from the heated igloos on the W Deck.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Edinburgh today, but the W Deck igloos are heated and Edinburgh Castle is still clear below the cloud.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the sandstone rooftops, so guests sit inside the heated igloos or try the quartz sand bed downstairs.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the Castle View rooms offer a dry seat for watching lightning over Edinburgh Castle through the window.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides Arthur's Seat and the Firth of Forth today, and only the nearest rooftops show from the W Deck.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the Balmoral clock tower and the rooftops, watched by guests from inside the heated igloos.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing on the W Deck today, but the sky is clear and Arthur's Seat is sharp against it.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day for Edinburgh, and guests on the rooftop terrace sit in the purple chairs facing the castle.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, but the air is mild and guests stay out on the W Deck facing Edinburgh Castle.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Firth of Forth is missing from the W Deck panorama and Arthur's Seat looks faint.
phrases.late_night: Guests in Castle View rooms are likely asleep now, city lights in the window and the castle itself back at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a Castle View room tonight can watch the rain pass across the castle and the wet Old Town rooftops.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a Castle View room after midnight can watch haze move across the Castle's outline and the city lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Front Bosphorus View rooms look out on a dark strait with both bridges still lit.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun comes in through the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Old City domes are sharp across the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At the rooftop infinity pool, guests swim with a clear view of the Asian shore and both Bosphorus bridges.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden hour reaches the rooftop bar, where the windows show the Bosphorus turning orange under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Nobu Suite tonight, you would watch the lit Bosphorus Bridge from a soaking bath outside.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the strait this morning, and the Maiden's Tower is still easy to spot from the suite windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of afternoon sun fall between the clouds onto the Bosphorus below the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Front Bosphorus View rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Asian shore turn pink, seen from the covered terrace deck.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Bosphorus looks flat and silver from the rooftop pool, and both bridges are still visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Front Bosphorus View rooms, and the strait below is grey and blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Asian shore is visible from the marble bathroom tub, with the strait lit for a second each time.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Bosphorus today, so the Asian shore is hidden and only the near water shows from the terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Bosphorus, a rare sight, and the Asian shore looks white from the guest room windows.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the air over the strait is sharp and both bridges stand out from the suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: With Istanbul very hot today, the rooftop infinity pool is the sensible place, the Bosphorus right beyond its glass walls.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, guests on the covered terrace deck can see the lit Asian shore across the dark strait.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the Asian shore shows from the rooftop pool, but the Old City domes do not.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner at Atölye, the Asian shore lights lie on the Bosphorus below the Front Bosphorus View rooms.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Atölye, rain runs down the Front Bosphorus View windows and the Asian shore lights blur across the strait.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Atölye, the Front Bosphorus View rooms look onto the Asian shore's lights under low cloud, mirrored in the strait.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the terraces above Kalo Livadi are still dark, and the Aegean shows only as a flat grey band.
phrases.clear_morning: Naxos is visible from the suite terraces this morning, a low shape across the water beyond the private pools.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the grey marble tiles, so most guests keep their legs in the plunge pools.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a terrace now, you would see the late sun on the Aegean and Naxos still clear behind it.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky above the hillside is clear, and from the hot tubs guests can see stars over the dark sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Kalo Livadi this morning, and the sunbeds by the plunge pools get sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, broken cloud sits over the Aegean, and Naxos is sometimes visible and sometimes not from the suite terraces.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the sea turn orange, seen from the butterfly chairs under the reed pergola.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Aegean looks flat from the black-framed bedroom windows, and Naxos is not visible today.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the hillside above Kalo Livadi, and the sunbeds by the private pools are empty for now.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Aegean, and lightning can be watched through the sliding glass doors from inside the suites.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the sea today, so the suite terraces look out at water that fades to grey, with no Naxos.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Mykonos, but today a few flakes fall on the stone walls of the terraces above Kalo Livadi.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing for Mykonos, and the hot tubs on the terraces are the warmest place to sit.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the hillside, and the shade under the reed-and-wood pergola is where guests sit between swims.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, guests sit on the edges of their plunge pools, facing a sea with no stars above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: If you stood on a suite terrace above Kalo Livadi now, you would see the near sea but not Naxos.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the sea-view suite is dark, and the window above the Aegean is the one pale light left in the room.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight rain runs down the black-framed bedroom window, and the Aegean below blurs behind the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Thin cloud drifts over the Aegean around three, and from the sea-view suites the moon looks soft and blurred above the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Han River is a dark band under the top-floor windows, and N Seoul Tower is still lit.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning sun fills the suite living rooms, and the distant mountains behind the skyline look sharp from the high floors.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the river is bright and flat from the corner rooms, with N Seoul Tower standing clearly above the city.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a penthouse now, you would see the late sun colouring the Han River and the city blocks below.
phrases.clear_night: From the top floors tonight, the city lights spread toward the mountains, and N Seoul Tower is lit against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over Seoul this morning, so the Han River changes between grey and silver as seen from the upper rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the dense city blocks this afternoon, while guests skip the view and run laps on the 85-meter indoor track.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights N Seoul Tower between clouds, and the Han River catches an orange tint below the windows.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Seoul today, and the mountains behind the skyline are gone, though the river and tower stay visible.
phrases.rain: Rain streaks the panoramic windows of the guest rooms, and the heated indoor pool is the busier place today.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Han River is visible from the corner rooms, and the soundproofed windows make the thunder arrive muted.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides N Seoul Tower from the top floors today, and the Han River appears only as a pale strip.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the dense city blocks below the top-floor windows, and the 85-meter indoor track gets more runners than usual.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air sits over Seoul, yet the sky is clear, so the distant mountains show sharply from the penthouses.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the Han River below shows a white glare, and most guests stay behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and from the upper rooms the skyline lights and N Seoul Tower stay clearly lit.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the mountains and N Seoul Tower are missing from the view, leaving only the nearer city blocks.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the top-floor windows frame city lights on the Han River and Namsan Tower's shape.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the suite windows tonight, and the lights along the Han River blur.
phrases.grey_evening: The city lights spread under low cloud after midnight, from the top-floor suite windows out toward the Han River and Namsan.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the harbour is a dark strip beyond Albert Park, and Rangitoto Island is only an outline from the penthouse.
phrases.clear_morning: From a high-floor balcony this morning, the port cranes and the Waitematā Harbour are sharp under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Albert Park canopy is bright green below the bedroom windows, and the harbour is a clear blue behind it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the skyline towers from the side, best watched from the private balcony of the One Bedroom Deluxe Apartment.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the Tapestry Bar terrace tonight, you would see city lights through the trees under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the harbour, and swimmers in the indoor lap pool see the city change light through the windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the port cranes stand in patches of sun and shade, easy to pick out from a high-floor balcony.
phrases.partly_golden: Rangitoto Island turns orange between the clouds for the last hour of sun, seen through the penthouse glass doors.
phrases.overcast: Under full cloud cover, the harbour looks flat and grey, and Albert Park's green canopy is the strongest colour in the frame.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Albert Park, and the yellow-striped umbrellas on the terrace are empty while guests eat inside at Tapestry Dining.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Waitematā Harbour shows up well from the bedroom's floor-to-ceiling windows, with the glass between you and the storm.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides Rangitoto Island today, and only the nearest skyline towers show from the penthouse glass doors.
phrases.snow: Snow falling on Albert Park is almost unknown in Auckland, so the view from the bedroom windows is unusual today.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Auckland, with the harbour clear and bright and the indoor pool busier than the Tapestry terrace.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the wicker chairs under the striped umbrellas are the shaded option, with buildings visible through the trees.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night, and guests sit outside in the wicker chairs on the Tapestry terrace without jackets.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is reduced today, so Rangitoto Island is missing from the balcony view, though the port cranes and Albert Park remain clear.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight a glass of water is on the nightstand, and the port lights shine on Waitematā Harbour from the penthouse.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the penthouse glass doors this evening, and the port lights show as blurred spots over Waitematā Harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Auckland after midnight, and the port lights along Waitematā Harbour show through the penthouse glass doors.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Edinburgh Castle is a dark shape on its rock, clear against the sky from the balcony rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the castle rock directly in front of the Castle View Deluxe Room balcony, with nothing in between.
phrases.clear_midday: From the rooftop terrace, the clipped topiary and Edinburgh Castle share the same frame under a clear midday sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the castle rock and the historic buildings framed by the king room's large window.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the balcony tonight, you would see the castle's outline on its rock under a clear, starry sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Broken cloud moves over Edinburgh this morning, so the castle in the yellow-chair room's window is sometimes in sun, sometimes not.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the rooftop terrace, guests sit among the topiary while clouds throw moving shadows across the castle rock.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun reaches the castle between the clouds, visible directly from the Castle View Deluxe Room balcony.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the castle today, which still shows clearly from the balcony with nothing in the way.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Grassmarket, and the balcony rooms give a dry place to watch the castle rock go dark and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: With thunder over Edinburgh, the castle appears for a moment in each flash, seen from the king room window.
phrases.fog_haze: From the Castle View balcony, fog covers the top of Edinburgh Castle and leaves only the lower rock visible.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the castle rock, and the room with yellow chairs is a warm place to watch it from.
phrases.very_cold: The rooftop terrace is close to freezing today, so most guests look at the castle through the king room's large window instead.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day in Edinburgh is rare, and the indoor pool behind its wooden slatted screen is where guests cool down.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy sky, a mild night makes the balcony usable, with the castle's dark shape directly above it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balcony the castle shows as a flat grey shape, and its details are not visible.
phrases.late_night: Grassmarket lights show after midnight from the Castle View Deluxe Room, a good hour to sleep before dawn shows Edinburgh Castle.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner, rain streaks the Castle View Deluxe Room window, and Edinburgh Castle shows through it above the wet Grassmarket lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner after midnight, the Castle View Deluxe Room window frames the Castle's outline above the lit Grassmarket under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, São Jorge Castle is only a dark outline from the Grand View Suite terrace, with Rossio Square quiet below.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the tiled Baixa rooftops, and from the Rossio Gastrobar the Tagus is already clear on the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop terrace is in full sun, and São Jorge Castle stands sharp against a blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light gives the castle walls a warm colour, and guests on the seventh floor watch the Tagus at the horizon.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Rossio Gastrobar tonight, you would see Lisbon's historic skyline through the floor-to-ceiling windows under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Rossio Square this morning, and the two balcony chairs face the Hotel Avenida Palace facade across Restauradores.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud alternate over the Baixa rooftops this afternoon, seen from the patterned chairs on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky above São Vicente church, visible from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the castle looks flatter than usual from the Grand View Suite, but the Tagus is still visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Rossio Square, so guests are inside the Rossio Gastrobar, watching the wet rooftops through the big windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Lisbon means the rooftop terrace is empty, and lightning shows the castle for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over the city today, and from the seventh floor the castle is a soft shape while the Tagus is hidden.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Lisbon, but if it fell today the tiled Baixa rooftops would turn white below the rooftop terrace.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the balcony chairs stay empty and guests watch Restauradores from inside, balcony door closed.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot sun on the rooftop terrace today, so most guests look at the castle from inside the Gastrobar, behind its windows.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night keeps the rooftop terrace comfortable, with the historic skyline still visible below and no stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: from the Grand View Suite the castle is there, but the Tagus cannot be seen on the horizon.
phrases.late_night: Back in your room from a last drink at the Rossio Gastrobar, you would see the castle outline above Baixa's lit rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in the Rossio Gastrobar tonight, rain on the glass would blur the lit Baixa rooftops toward the castle.
phrases.grey_evening: Over a last drink at the Rossio Gastrobar tonight, you would see cloud above the castle hill and the lit Baixa rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Capitol dome is already lit and clear from a Capitol View King window, the avenue below still quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the AC Kitchen, croissants and prosciutto are on the table, and outside the sky over the Capitol is clear.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the white dome stands out sharply through the floor-to-ceiling glass of the Capitol View King rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun falls on the Capitol dome, seen through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Capitol View King room.
phrases.clear_night: On the rooftop terrace tonight, the fire pit is lit and the illuminated Capitol dome is sharp against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Guests in the Capitol View King rooms this morning see the Capitol dome under a partly cloudy sky through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon cloud shadows cross the Capitol dome, and the change is easy to follow from a Capitol View King room.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken clouds let the setting sun reach the Capitol dome in patches, seen from the rooftop terrace bar stools.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Washington today, so the Capitol dome looks pale and less bright from the floor-to-ceiling windows, but still visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the boulevard below, and from a dry Capitol View King room the dome is still in view.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the city, so the rooftop terrace is empty and guests watch the lightning from the AC Lounge.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over Washington, and from the Capitol View King windows the dome is only a faint shape above the industrial buildings.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Capitol dome and the avenue, and most guests stay inside the warm AC Kitchen over breakfast.
phrases.very_cold: In very cold air, the rooftop fire pit is the only reason anyone stands on the terrace to see the dome.
phrases.very_hot: Washington is very hot today, so the balcony is empty and guests look at the Capitol from inside their rooms.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky tonight, but the air is mild and guests sit at the rooftop fire pit facing the lit dome.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, and from the Capitol View King windows the dome is dim, with little detail beyond it.
phrases.late_night: Room lights off in the Capitol View King, the city glow around the dome is the only light inside after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Capitol View King's tall windows late after dinner, and the dome's shape shows past the wet, lit avenue.
phrases.grey_evening: After a late Navy Yard dinner, the Capitol View King's windows show the dome above the lit avenue under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sand outside the arched windows is still grey, and the waves can be heard from most rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: This morning the air is clear and the higher rooms show the whole coast, Palos Verdes to Malibu.
phrases.clear_midday: Bright midday sun on the beach means the blue umbrellas on the pool deck are actually needed right now.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a suite sitting room now, you would see the sun going down beside the pier Ferris wheel.
phrases.clear_night: Clear night over Santa Monica; from most rooms the ocean is dark but the waves are easy to hear.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the water this morning, and the pool deck loungers are mostly still empty.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the beach this afternoon, so the light in Terrazza changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the Pacific turn orange in the arched windows of the upper rooms.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky from Palos Verdes to Malibu today, which makes the hot tub facing the beach a sensible place to sit.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Santa Monica beach, and the floor-to-ceiling windows of the restaurant are the dry way to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Pacific is rare for Santa Monica, and the upper floors have a wide view of the lightning.
phrases.fog_haze: Marine fog covers the beach today, so Malibu is missing from the view and the Ferris wheel is faint.
phrases.snow: Snow on Santa Monica beach almost never happens, but if it did, the hot tub would be the warmest seat facing it.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day by local standards, with the pool deck quiet and the ocean view still sharp from the upper floors.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the sand today, and the secluded pool is the obvious place to spend the day.
phrases.mild_night: Mild night in Santa Monica, so the hot tub facing the beach is comfortable and the waves are loud enough to hear.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the upper floors Palos Verdes and Malibu cannot be seen, only the nearby beach.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the suite is dark, and the only light comes through the arched windows from the shoreline toward Malibu.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the arched windows tonight, and the beach lights blur over the Pacific before the curtains close.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze covers the Pacific after midnight, and the arched windows frame the pier's wheel beside the lights along the beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Baie des Anges is still dark grey from the upper-floor windows, and the Promenade below is nearly empty.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on a balcony this morning comes with a clear view of palm trees, the blue sea and one distant boat.
phrases.clear_midday: At La Rotonde Brasserie, lunch is being served outdoors under a cloudless sky, with the sea just across the Promenade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the high-floor windows, the Baie des Anges curves west into low sunlight and the beach parasols throw long shadows.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Nice is clear, and dinner at Le Chantecler ends with a short walk back to a sea-facing room.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the bay this morning, so the sea seen from the upper rooms changes colour patch by patch.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Promenade des Anglais this afternoon, and the sun loungers on the private beach are mostly taken.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the private beach now, you would see broken clouds turning orange above the pink dome.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Mediterranean outside the sea-facing rooms looks flat, and the hillside view looks dull too.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Promenade des Anglais, the beach parasols stay closed, and guests watch it from their room windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Bay of Angels is best watched from a high-floor window, with the balcony doors shut.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the Mediterranean today, and the far curve of the bay is only a faint line from the sea-facing rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow in Nice is rare, but right now a few flakes land on the palm trees outside the room windows and melt.
phrases.very_cold: On the Promenade the air is close to freezing, the private beach is empty, and the sea looks bright blue from above.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on the beach, so the white parasols are all open and the sea is full of swimmers.
phrases.mild_night: After dinner at Le Chantecler, a mild cloudy night means the balcony doors of the sea-facing suites can stay open.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the upper-floor windows show the beach and the near water, but not the far end of the bay.
phrases.late_night: In a sea-facing upper room the curtain stays open tonight, and the Promenade lights along the bay are last seen before sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtain is open before bed, rain on the high-floor window, and the Promenade lights mark the curve of the bay.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, the curtains of a sea-facing upper room stay open on the Promenade lights along the Bay of Angels under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Great Room windows show only a dark Cox Bay and the white line of the break.
phrases.clear_morning: Surfers are already working the break under a clear sky, visible from the lodge room balconies over morning coffee.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Great Room glass frames the full sweep of Cox Bay, with surfers on the break under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From a shingled balcony, the sun drops toward the forested headland and the waves below turn orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would sit by the fire pit in the beach grass with stars over the Pacific.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Cox Bay this morning, and from the armchairs the break goes bright and dull in turns.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you sat in the Great Room this afternoon, you would see patches of sun crossing Cox Bay between the clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud catches the last sun over the headland, seen from the patio while diners finish Pacific Northwest plates.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the river-stone fireplace is lit and the Great Room glass still frames every wave.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the Great Room windows while, from the armchairs, you can still see surfers in wetsuits on the break.
phrases.thunderstorm: Right now a storm is taking the break apart, and the best place to watch it is an armchair behind the glass.
phrases.fog_haze: From the Great Room windows, fog covers Cox Bay today and the break shows as pale lines in the grey.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on this shore, but today it lands on the cottage decks while the hot tubs stay warm.
phrases.very_cold: From the Great Room glass, hard winter light falls on the break at Cox Bay and frost edges the balcony rails.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day for this coast, the red umbrellas on the beachfront patio give the only shade over lunch.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the hot tubs on the cottage decks are in use under the rainforest fringe.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today: the break shows clearly from the Great Room, but the headland is only an outline.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the gas fireplace stays on in the Oceanview room, Cox Bay surf breaking white.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner tonight, rain runs down the Great Room glass and the Cox Bay surf can be heard through it.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the balcony glass of an Oceanview room shows the lodge lights on the nearest surf under low Pacific cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Canton Tower stands unlit against a clear sky in the south-facing king room windows.
phrases.clear_morning: From the upper floors, the Pearl River is fully visible this morning, with the Canton Tower sharp in clear air.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests on the upper floors at midday see the Canton Tower sharp against a clear sky above the Pearl River.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the fitness center now, you would see late sun on the Canton Tower before its lights come on.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Canton Tower changes colour against a clear sky, visible from the oval bathtub in the suite bathroom.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Guangzhou this morning, and the Pearl River alternates between sun and shade from the upper rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the terrace this afternoon, guests see the Canton Tower with a few clouds behind it, mostly in sunshine.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds above the Canton Tower, seen from the private dining room's windows.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Guangzhou today, so the Canton Tower appears flat and colourless from the south-facing rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the full-height windows of the king rooms, and the indoor pool is the sensible option today.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the Canton Tower is briefly lit by lightning, visible from the upper floors behind the full-height windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the Pearl River today, and the Canton Tower is only a faint outline from the terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare in Guangzhou, but if it were falling now, you would watch it from the indoor pool windows.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing outside, rare for Guangzhou, and the Canton Tower looks very sharp in the cold air from the upper floors.
phrases.very_hot: Through the full-height windows on the south-facing upper floors, heat-haze hangs over the Pearl River and Canton Tower this afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy sky, the night is warm on the terrace, and the Canton Tower's coloured lights are the main attraction.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited, so the Canton Tower is visible from the upper floors but the far side of the river is not.
phrases.late_night: Back late from the Club Lounge, you would find Canton Tower's slim outline above the lights on the Pearl River.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in an upper-floor room now, you would see the Canton Tower and the Pearl River through rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink upstairs now, you would see the Canton Tower's slim shape over the Pearl River under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over the Adriatic is already turning pale, and the rooftop terraces are empty and quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun has come up out of the sea, and coffee at a rooftop railing is the morning plan for most suites.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the whirlpool bubbles beside the main pool, with olive trees and bright open water in every direction.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the suite terraces, the low sun lights the limestone coves toward Castro and the water turns a softer blue.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the string lights are on at the outdoor dining terrace and stars show above the dark sea.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Adriatic this morning, and coffee is taken at the white iron railings of the rooftop terraces.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the sea this afternoon, so the pool water changes from bright blue to grey and back.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on your rooftop terrace now, you would see the last sun catching the clouds above the coves.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the Adriatic looks flat and pale from La Terrazza sul Mare, and lunch continues as usual.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the olive trees and the dry-stone walls, and the sea beyond the terraces is a dull grey line.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Adriatic is visible from the suites right now, and both pools and the garden lawn stand empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the water today, so the coves toward Castro are hard to make out from the rooftop terraces.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on this coast, but a few flakes are falling on the olive trees and the empty sun loungers.
phrases.very_cold: If you stood on a rooftop terrace now, you would see hard winter light on the Adriatic and the coves toward Castro.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air covers the coast today, and most guests are in the pools or under a canopy on their terrace.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night covers the coast, and dinner goes on under the string lights beside the lit mosaic medallions.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop terraces the sea is clear only near the coves and the horizon is missing.
phrases.late_night: Were you up for water around midnight in a suite, you would see coast lights toward Castro and the Adriatic past them.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in your suite tonight, rain on the glass would blur the shore lights along the Adriatic.
phrases.grey_evening: Were you having a last drink in your suite, you would see cloud over the Adriatic and Castro's lights along the coast.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, lagoon-side rooms face the mangrove waterways, which the hotel says are at their most active around dawn.
