phrases.clear_morning: From a beach-side balcony with two chairs, the Caribbean looks turquoise and the white sand is already bright this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Bright midday sun falls on the private terraces, where the plunge pools are surrounded by dense jungle greenery.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the horizon golden, and the driftwood bonfire on the beach is prepared for dusk.
phrases.clear_night: At night the open-air lobby shows the moon through its circular skylight, with the fire feature reflected in the pool.
phrases.partly_morning: If you were on a lagoon-side terrace this morning, you would see clouds passing over the mangrove waterways.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds drift over the Caribbean this afternoon, while the daybed by the plunge pool gets sun between the clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: Under broken clouds at the last hour of sun, the open-air restaurant has its woven lamps lit, ocean visible beyond the columns.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the Caribbean today, so the turquoise from the beach-side balconies looks duller than the photos suggest.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the sand between the palms, and guests watch it from behind the sliding glass doors of their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the lagoon-side rooms face the mangrove waterways while lightning lights the sky over the estate.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze lies over the water today, and from a beach-side balcony the line between sea and sky is not clear.
phrases.snow: Snow would be a first for Playa del Carmen; if it happened, the beach-side balconies would see white sand turn whiter.
phrases.very_cold: A feels-like near freezing is almost unknown here, and the plunge pool on the terrace is far less tempting than usual.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the sandy path to the sea, so the terrace plunge pool is the quickest way to cool off.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, and the fire feature in the open-air lobby is reflected in the pool under the skylight.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from the beach-side balcony the sea is clear nearby but the far horizon is not.
phrases.late_night: Were you falling asleep in a beach-side room now, you might leave the curtain open to keep the Caribbean in view.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink in a beach-side room tonight, you would watch rain fall over the Caribbean past the glass doors.
phrases.grey_evening: A last drink in the open-air lobby now would show you the fire reflected in the pool under a cloudy skylight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the private terraces face a dark Aegean Sea, and the pool's fiber optics are still switched on.
phrases.clear_morning: From the guest rooms, open French doors show a turquoise Aegean under a clear sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool is the obvious place, and the small rocky islet is clearly visible on the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the terraced pool area, and the Mykonos windmills stand out in the low light.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the pool tonight, you would see the fiber optics below you and real stars above.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over Megali Ammos Beach this morning, and the sea below the terraces changes colour as they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The pool villa's lap pool gets sun between the clouds this afternoon, with the thatched roof giving some shade.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the Aegean turn orange, and the white chapel near the pool catches the light.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the sea from the private terraces looks flat and silver rather than turquoise today.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Aegean, and guests are watching it from inside the rooms through the rectangular windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the private terraces are empty, and lightning over the sea is easiest to watch from behind the French doors.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water today means the rocky islet is hard to see from the infinity pool, though swimming is unaffected.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on Mykonos, but if it were falling now, the private terraces would be white and the sea dark grey.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day the pool is probably empty, but the sea view from the rooms is still clear and bright.
phrases.very_hot: It is a very hot afternoon on Megali Ammos, and guests stay in the infinity pool or under the thatched roof.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, with no stars to match the fiber optics, so the lit pool is the brightest thing outside tonight.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so the windmills and the rocky islet cannot be seen from the pool area, only the nearer water.
phrases.late_night: A sea-view room's curtain is left pulled back tonight, so the pool's fiber-optic lights are the last thing in view before sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Yēvo, the pool's fiber-optic lights show through the rain on the room windows.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner at Yēvo, the terrace rooms face the pool, its fiber-optic lights bright in the water under tonight's cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the upper-floor windows show the iron Dom Luís I Bridge as a dark shape over the Douro.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the terracotta rooftops early, and from the balconies the church dome stands out clearly against blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the outdoor pool sits in full sun between the palm trees, and the rooftop view of the bridge is sharp.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the upper rooms, late sun turns the iron of the Dom Luís I Bridge a warmer colour above the Douro.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the façade lit from below and the indoor pool glowing blue inside.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Porto this morning, and the Douro below the upper-floor windows changes from grey to blue and back.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the tiled balcony, wrought-iron chairs sit half in sun and half in cloud shadow, with the pool below.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun breaks between clouds and lights the terracotta rooftops seen from the guest-room balconies.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Dom Luís I Bridge is still clear from the upper floors, just without any shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the outdoor pool, so most guests are in the heated indoor pool under the geometric ceiling lights.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the upper-floor windows give a dry place to watch lightning over the Douro and the bridge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Porto today, and from the rooftop the Dom Luís I Bridge is a soft outline rather than clear iron.
phrases.snow: Porto almost never sees snow, but if it did, the upper-floor windows would show flakes falling past the Dom Luís I Bridge.
phrases.very_cold: The outdoor pool is heated, so on this very cold day steam rises from the water between the palm trees.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot afternoon sends most guests to the outdoor pool between the palm trees rather than the fitness centre.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, guests sit on the balconies with the wrought-iron chairs, looking towards the lit bridge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Douro is visible from the upper floors but the far side of the bridge is not.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the upper rooms show the Dom Luís I Bridge above city lights on the Douro.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the lights along the Douro near the Dom Luís I Bridge after midnight, an upper-floor curtain left open.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open after midnight in an upper-floor room, the Dom Luís I Bridge shows against the lit city under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Beach Cottage terraces are dark and the only sound is the Andaman Sea a few steps away.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Beach Cottage deck, the morning sea at Surin Beach is already turquoise under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong, so most guests stay under the white umbrellas around the hexagonal pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon, guests on the beachfront terrace loungers face the Andaman as the sun drops toward the horizon.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would hear the sea from inside a Beach Cottage, with a clear sky above the bay.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Andaman this morning, but the sand on Surin Beach is already bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun loungers on the beachfront terrace get shade and sun in turns as clouds pass over Surin Beach this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: Seen from the Terrace Suite plunge pool, the broken clouds over the Andaman take on an orange colour before sunset.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Andaman looks grey too, though the water in front of the Beach Cottages stays calm.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Surin Beach, and guests watch it from daybeds through the open doors of their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is moving over the Andaman, and the terrace loungers are empty while guests watch the lightning from inside.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the bay today, so the horizon is unclear, but the sand in front of the cottages is still visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is reported, which almost never happens in Phuket, and the palm trees above the villa terraces look very out of place.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold weather is rare in Phuket, and the infinity pool by the beach has no swimmers at this hour.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot on Surin Beach, and guests in the Terrace Suite stay in the private plunge pool facing the sea.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, guests eat at the Catch restaurant by the water, with no stars over the bay.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the Beach Cottage decks, low visibility hides the far horizon today, though the nearby sand and rocks are clear.
phrases.late_night: Guests in a Beach Cottage tonight have left the curtain open and fall asleep facing the water past the deck.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the Beach Cottages after midnight can watch rain run down the glass doors, the Andaman a few steps beyond.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a Beach Cottage can watch low cloud move over the Andaman after midnight and hear the waves from bed.

phrases.clear_predawn: Guests awake early in the Skyline View rooms see the Burj Khalifa outlined against a clear, still-dark sky.
phrases.clear_morning: This morning the Arabian Gulf is calm and turquoise, seen from a balcony where two lounge chairs face the water.
phrases.clear_midday: Seen from the suite windows at midday, the white beach umbrellas are open and most teal loungers are taken.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The suite living room windows frame a pink-orange sky over the water right now, with the sun low and dropping.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Burj Khalifa is lit, and guests in Skyline View rooms can see it clearly through floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the city this morning, but the Burj Khalifa is still clear from the sixth-floor restaurant.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the long outdoor lap pool this afternoon, and the sea beyond the palm trees shifts from blue to grey.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in Tasca by José Avillez now, you would see the low sun colouring the clouds above the Dubai skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Arabian Gulf looks flat and pale from the balconies, and the Burj Khalifa stands without shadow.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Dubai, and today the beach loungers are empty while guests watch the wet sand from their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Gulf is unusual here, and the sixth-floor restaurant windows give a wide, dry seat for watching it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the city today, and from the restaurant the Burj Khalifa shows only as a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Jumeirah Beach today, which almost never happens, and guests photograph it from their balconies.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold for Dubai today, and from the rooms the beach loungers sit empty and the Burj Khalifa looks sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside, so the long lap pool between the palm trees is busier than the sun loungers on the sand.
phrases.mild_night: A warm night with cloud overhead, and the lit Burj Khalifa is still visible from the Skyline View rooms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the distant Dubai Marina skyline is not visible from the suites, though the beach is.
phrases.late_night: Upper-floor guests have turned everything off, and the only light inside now comes from the skyline around the Burj Khalifa.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the Skyline View rooms after midnight watches rain run down the glass, the Burj Khalifa's tall outline behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a Skyline View room after midnight can watch the city lights blur in haze around the Burj Khalifa.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop terrace is empty and the red-tiled rooftops below are only dark shapes under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooms, morning sun lights the Náplavka riverbank and the Railway Bridge, with no cloud over Prague.
phrases.clear_midday: Through the floor-to-ceiling glass of the rooftop fitness centre, midday sun lights the red-tiled roofs and treetops across Prague.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches the private balconies, and the Lookout Tower on Petřín Hill is easy to find on the horizon.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop terrace tonight, you would see the Gothic church spires against a clear, dark sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Prague this morning, and from the large room windows the Railway Bridge is sometimes in sun, sometimes in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the rooftop terrace this afternoon, the wood decking is partly in shade as clouds cross above the red-tiled rooftops.
phrases.partly_golden: The last sun of the day comes between the clouds and reaches the Vltava and the Náplavka riverbank below the rooms.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the fitness centre windows still show the city rooftops and trees, just with flatter colours.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Náplavka riverbank today, and guests watch the wet Railway Bridge from behind the large room windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the thunderstorm, nobody is out on the rooftop terrace, and lightning over the city is seen from the room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits over the Vltava today, and from the balconies Petřín Hill and its Lookout Tower are hard to make out.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the red-tiled rooftops, and the wood decking of the rooftop terrace is white and untouched.
phrases.very_cold: With the air close to freezing, the rooftop terrace is empty, but the view of the Gothic church spires is very clear.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the balcony chairs stay in full sun, and most guests look at Petřín Hill from inside.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and from the rooftop terrace the red-tiled rooftops are dark shapes with a few lit windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooms the Railway Bridge is clear but Petřín Hill and its tower are not.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, lights along the Náplavka riverbank reflect in the Vltava from the room windows.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open after midnight, rain on the glass blurs the lights along the Náplavka riverbank from the rooms.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain left open in a river-facing room tonight, the Náplavka lights show along the Vltava under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky is already turning pale over the Pacific, seen from the east-facing rooftop pool on the top floor before sunrise.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight comes straight in through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the living rooms, with a clear ocean horizon behind.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun loungers around the level 34 sky pool are in full sun, with the Pacific open to the east.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the wrap-around balconies from the Hinterland side, while the Surfers Paradise towers catch it along the beach.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on a sub-penthouse balcony tonight, you would see the Broadbeach skyline lit up and a dark Pacific beyond.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the ocean this morning, visible from the Water View Apartments between levels 12 and 30.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over Broadbeach in the afternoon, so the level 4 infinity pool gets sun, then shade, then sun again.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the beach turn orange, seen from the balcony dining tables.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Pacific looks flat and grey too from the sky pool, though the swimming is the same.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Broadbeach, and the sauna and steam room on level 4 are the busier option right now.
phrases.thunderstorm: The storm over the Pacific is best watched from inside the sub-penthouses on levels 32 to 34, not from the sky pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the coast today, so the Surfers Paradise towers look faint from the balconies and the horizon is not sharp.
phrases.snow: Snow on the Gold Coast is almost unheard of, so the sky pool loungers on level 34 would be empty today.
phrases.very_cold: From the level 34 sky pool, the blue loungers sit empty above the Pacific in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: Broadbeach is very hot today, so most guests are in the rooftop pool on level 34, with the Pacific straight ahead.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night over Broadbeach, and guests are eating at the balcony dining tables with the skyline lights below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balconies the beach is clear but the far coastline and the Hinterland are not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Water View Apartments look out on the lights of the Surfers Paradise towers along the beach.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the tall windows of the Water View Apartments, and the Broadbeach lights blur along the coast.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud drifts over Broadbeach after midnight, and the Surfers Paradise tower lights show through it from the Water View Apartments.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, suites facing the Atlantic get the pale sky first, while the rooftop lounge chairs stand empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From the fitness center treadmills, the morning run comes with a clear view of the ocean and the palm trees.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the white umbrellas on the circular pool deck are the only shade under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last hours of sun, Intracoastal-facing suites get the direct light, while the ocean side turns a softer blue.
phrases.clear_night: A clear night, and from the upper floor balconies the stars sit above the dark Atlantic with the beach below.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered morning clouds over the Atlantic, seen through the floor-to-ceiling windows of an ocean-facing suite before the beach fills up.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the clouds move over the pool deck now and then, so the lounge chairs get sun in short rounds.
phrases.partly_golden: Late sun colours the clouds above the Intracoastal, a view reserved for suites on that side of the tower.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the whole sky, the Atlantic looks pale from the roof pool deck, and lounge chairs are plentiful.
phrases.rain: Rain moves across the ocean toward the beach, and the floor-to-ceiling suite windows are the driest place to watch it arrive.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm nobody is on the rooftop pool deck, and the lightning over the Atlantic is watched from inside the suites.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water today: from the upper floors the Atlantic is there, but the horizon line is not.
phrases.snow: Snow in Fort Lauderdale would surprise almost everyone, and nobody designed the roof pool deck with that weather in mind.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day by Fort Lauderdale standards, and the circular pool deck has more white umbrellas than swimmers.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the rooftop today, so the lounge chairs under the white umbrellas fill before the sunny ones.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and the balconies of the ocean-facing suites are comfortable for listening to the Atlantic in the dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Limited visibility today: seen from the roof pool deck, the beach is clear but the far Atlantic horizon is not.
phrases.late_night: Were you falling asleep in an Intracoastal-facing suite now, you could leave the curtain open and watch the lights along the water.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were finishing a last drink in an Intracoastal-facing suite, you would see lights along the water through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were finishing a last drink in an Intracoastal-facing suite now, you would see lights along the waterway under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Petanu River is still only a sound below the River Edge Pool Villas, not yet a view.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Canyon Jetty this morning, the cascade below is in full sun and the moss on the cliff looks bright green.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong over Kendran village, and the infinity pools are the most sensible place to spend the next hours.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the wooden dining deck at an angle now, and the waterfall on the cliff is lit by it directly.
phrases.clear_night: Candles are lit on the dining terrace tonight, and above the jungle the sky is clear enough to see stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over the jungle this morning, so the water in the infinity pools changes between sunlit and shaded.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the cascade below the Canyon Jetty move between shade and patches of sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun is partly behind cloud, and from the soaking tub by the wide window the jungle is dimmer.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the jungle around the River Edge Pool Villas is a flatter green, but the waterfall is still running.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the jungle and the cascade, and more water is coming down the moss-covered cliff than usual.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over Kendran village means the Canyon Jetty above the waterfall is not the place to be for the moment.
phrases.fog_haze: Mist sits over the Petanu River today, so from the villas the far side of the jungle is a pale shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is not something Bali gets, but if it fell here it would land on the infinity pools and melt at once.
phrases.very_cold: A cold day is rare this close to Ubud, and the soaking tub on the teak platform would be the right place.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air hangs over the jungle today, and most guests are in the infinity pools rather than on the deck.
phrases.mild_night: It is a warm cloudy night on the dining terrace, where candles are lit and the waterfall is heard more than seen.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the villas the nearby cliff and cascade are clear but the farther jungle is not.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has a River Edge Pool Villa tonight likely left the curtain open and fell asleep facing the white falls.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the River Edge Pool Villas can watch the rain fall into the Petanu River from their windows tonight.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a River Edge Pool Villa tonight can see the waterfall under low cloud from the window after midnight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the oceanfront balconies look out on a dark Pacific, with Diamond Head still only a shape.
phrases.clear_morning: From an oceanfront room this morning, the whole stretch from Diamond Head to Koko Head Crater is sharp and clear.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the blue lounge chairs on the pool deck are mostly in full sun, and the ocean is bright turquoise.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights Diamond Head from the side, and The Veranda is open for tea with an ocean view.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars over the Pacific from your balcony and little else.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Honolulu hillside this morning, seen from the rooms facing the golf course fairways.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the private beach this afternoon, so the sand goes from bright to shaded and back again.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, scattered clouds turn orange above Koko Head Crater, as seen from the oceanfront rooms.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the lagoon looks grey instead of turquoise, though the resident dolphins are still in it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pool deck and the palms, and guests watch it from their balconies instead of the beach.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Pacific right now, and the oceanfront balconies give a wide, if loud, view of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water today makes Koko Head Crater faint from the oceanfront rooms, while Diamond Head stays closer and clearer.
phrases.snow: Snow is reported at the hotel, which has not happened since it opened in 1964, and the pool deck is empty.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold day, the beach is empty and guests stay on their balconies, looking at Diamond Head in coats.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, so most guests are in the water off the private beach rather than on the pool deck chairs.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and The Veranda has evening cocktails with the ocean somewhere out there in the dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the oceanfront rooms Koko Head Crater is not visible and the horizon line is unclear.
phrases.late_night: In an oceanfront room the curtain is left open on purpose, and Diamond Head shows as an outline above the water.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Hoku's, rain runs down the oceanfront room window and the outline of Diamond Head shows along the shore.
phrases.grey_evening: Well after dinner at Hoku's, the oceanfront rooms look out on coast lights and the outline of Diamond Head under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Mountain View rooms show Table Mountain as a dark shape against a clear sky, the city lights on below.
phrases.clear_morning: From the floor-to-ceiling glass, Table Mountain stands sharp in the morning sun, with no cloud on its flat top.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over Table Mountain, and the indoor lap pool is the cooler place to be.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a Mountain View balcony now, you would see Table Mountain turn amber as the sun drops.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the rooftop terrace fire pit is lit, and Table Mountain is a black outline above the city lights.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Table Mountain this morning, so the view from the floor-to-ceiling windows changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon part of Table Mountain is in shadow and part in sun, seen from the rooftop sofas.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over Table Mountain catches orange light above a rooftop dinner table.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky today, Table Mountain looks flat and close from the Mountain View rooms, with no shadows on it.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass, and Table Mountain is only partly visible behind it from the guest rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over the city, and lightning above Table Mountain is best watched from inside a Mountain View room.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the top of Table Mountain today, so the windows show mostly the lower slopes and the city below.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare here, but if it fell today, the Mountain View rooms would be the warmest place to see Table Mountain.
phrases.very_cold: It is unusually cold for Cape Town today, and the sauna at the J Wellness Circle is busier than the rooftop terrace.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day in Cape Town, and the rooftop sofas facing Table Mountain mostly stay empty until the evening.
phrases.mild_night: Cloud covers the sky tonight, but the air is mild and the rooftop fire pit is burning for guests on the sofas.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Mountain View rooms Table Mountain is a faint grey shape rather than a clear view.
phrases.late_night: Guests on the mountain side have switched everything off, and Cape Town's lights below the mountain are the only glow left.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in a Mountain View room after midnight watches rain run down the glass, blurring the city lights below Table Mountain.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the Mountain View rooms after midnight can watch low cloud cross Table Mountain above the city lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Petronas Twin Towers are still lit, seen straight on from the 33rd floor SkyBar pool.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Twin Towers View suite, both spires stand sharp against a clear morning sky, with coffee on the sofa.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun hits the steel of the towers, and the treadmills in the fitness centre face them directly through the glass.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the Twin Towers, and the SkyBar infinity pool is the closest seat for watching it.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a guest room tonight, you would see both towers illuminated through the window, with the city skyline behind.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass behind the Petronas Twin Towers this morning, and the full height still shows from the 33rd floor.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud move over Kuala Lumpur this afternoon, and from the lounge windows the towers stay clear between them.
phrases.partly_golden: From the 33rd-floor pool, the low sun lights both spires of the Petronas Twin Towers under scattered cloud.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Kuala Lumpur today, but the Twin Towers remain fully visible straight on from the SkyBar.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Twin Towers View suites, and the towers show through it, slightly blurred.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning shows behind the Petronas Twin Towers during a storm, and the indoor lounge is a dry place to watch it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze is common in Kuala Lumpur, and today the upper spires of the Twin Towers are partly visible from the 33rd floor.
phrases.snow: Snow does not fall in Kuala Lumpur, so a white Petronas Twin Towers view from the SkyBar would be a genuine first.
phrases.very_cold: In hard cold daylight, the spires of the Petronas Twin Towers stand sharp in the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Twin Towers View suites.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the SkyBar infinity pool is where guests watch the Twin Towers while standing in the water.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, live music plays at SkyBar and the illuminated towers stand at the far end of the pool.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the city skyline behind the Petronas Twin Towers is not clear, though the towers themselves show.
phrases.late_night: Up for a glass of water at midnight in a Twin Towers View suite, you would see both spires against the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink at SkyBar tonight, rain on the glass would blur the Twin Towers and the lit city.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink at SkyBar tonight, you would see both spires end in low cloud over the lit city.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Ferris wheel stands dark and still outside the Contemporary Suite balconies, with the Basilica dome behind it.
phrases.clear_morning: On a clear morning, the tall rounded suite windows show St. Stephen's Basilica with every detail of the dome visible.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun sits high over the Danube, and the BiBo rooftop bar gives the widest view of the city.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a Contemporary Suite balcony, you would see low afternoon sun on the Basilica dome under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight guests at the BiBo rooftop bar sit under a clear sky, with the Ferris wheel and Basilica easy to pick out.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the Parliament dome this morning, visible from the bed in some rooms without getting up.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the rooftop terrace has a mix of sun and cloud, with the Danube changing colour as the light shifts.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds catch some colour above the Ferris wheel, seen from the suite balconies.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky today, the Basilica and the Ferris wheel are still clearly visible from the suites, just without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop terrace right now, so the wider panorama is better enjoyed from behind the suite windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Budapest, and from the curved windows guests can watch lightning behind the Basilica dome.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs over the city today, and the Ferris wheel appears only as a faint shape from the balconies.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the grey seating of the rooftop terrace, and the Basilica dome shows a thin white layer.
phrases.very_cold: With the air near freezing today, guests look at the Basilica through the suite windows rather than from the balconies.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Budapest today, so the rooftop terrace seating stays mostly empty until the sun is lower.
phrases.mild_night: If you were at the BiBo rooftop bar tonight, you would sit under cloud in mild air, with the Danube below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is reduced today, so the Basilica is clear from the suites but Buda Castle and the Parliament dome look faded.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Contemporary Suites are left to sleep, city lights on the rooftops until the Basilica dome shows at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open past midnight, rain on the curved windows blurs the city lights near the Basilica's dome from the Contemporary Suites.
phrases.grey_evening: With the suite curtains drawn back after midnight, the Basilica's dome shows above the lit rooftops under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Story Bridge lights are still on, and the river below the River Master Balcony rooms is dark and calm.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Fiume rooftop, early guests on the sun loungers get a clear view of the Story Bridge and the CBD towers.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the rooftop infinity pool is the obvious place, with the river and bridge beside it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun falls on the Story Bridge, and River room windows show the skyline to the right turning orange.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit Story Bridge and the waterfront dining lights below are visible from the River rooms.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Brisbane this morning, and the rooftop brunch tables have the city towers in plain view.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Story Bridge this afternoon, so swimmers in the Fiume pool get sun in short stretches.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the river gives the bridge and the CBD patches of orange light.
phrases.overcast: The sky over Brisbane is grey today, but the Story Bridge and the river remain clearly visible from the River rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Brisbane River, and the floor-to-ceiling windows keep the view of the bridge while keeping guests dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Brisbane, so the rooftop pool is empty and guests watch lightning near the Story Bridge from their rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the river today blurs the outline of the Story Bridge, though it is still recognisable from the River Master Balcony.
phrases.snow: Snow in Brisbane is unheard of, but if it were falling, guests would watch it over the river from behind the windows.
phrases.very_cold: On this rare cold Brisbane day, the Fiume pool has few takers and most guests view the bridge from indoors.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot across Brisbane today, which makes the rooftop infinity pool beside the Story Bridge the busiest spot.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, so guests are still outside at the Fiume rooftop bar, facing the lit Story Bridge.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Brisbane today, so the CBD towers to the right are indistinct, while the nearby Story Bridge stays clear.
phrases.late_night: If you came back from Fiume to a River room, you would see city lights on the river by the Story Bridge.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink at Fiume tonight, you would see the Story Bridge and the river through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in a River room, you would see the lit city across the river under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the ocean-view rooms show a dark Atlantic and a sky just starting to lighten over the water.
phrases.clear_morning: In season, morning sun is already on the water from the Beach Club terrace, and the hot tub sits unused so far.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun on the infinity pool, and guests under the oceanfront pergola are eating lunch with the Atlantic straight ahead.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in an ocean-view room now, you would see late sun giving the Atlantic a warmer colour before sunset.
phrases.clear_night: Night, clear sky: the indoor lap pool is lit under its glass skylight, and a few guests are swimming slowly.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Virginia Beach this morning, and from the Beach Club lounge the ocean goes bright, then dull, then bright.
phrases.partly_afternoon: A tasting at the Tarnished Truth distillery is happening indoors while patches of cloud move above the pool terrace outside.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the wicker chairs in the Beach Club lounge, with cloud shadows crossing the water beyond.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky all day, so the ocean seen from the upper rooms is grey too, and the spa is busier than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the outdoor infinity pool, while the indoor lap pool under its skylight is where people swim today.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Atlantic empties the pool terrace, and guests watch the lightning from behind the lounge's glass walls.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the ocean from the rooms today, so the visible scene ends at Atlantic Avenue just outside the hotel.
phrases.snow: Snow in Virginia Beach is rare, but today the empty Beach Club terrace and the hot tub cover are white.
phrases.very_cold: From the Beach Club lounge, the poolside terrace sits empty in hard winter light, with the ocean beyond.
phrases.very_hot: Guests on the Beach Club terrace this afternoon look past the infinity pool to heat-haze over the Atlantic.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the oceanfront dining pergola still has a few tables occupied after dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the ocean-view rooms, Atlantic Avenue and the beach show clearly, but haze hides the far water today.
phrases.late_night: If you turned the room lights off now, Atlantic Avenue's streetlights would be the only light left in an ocean-view room.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in the Hunt Room tonight, you would watch the rain outside from a leather sofa.
phrases.grey_evening: If you carried a last Tarnished Truth glass up to an ocean-view room tonight, you would see beachfront lights under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the North Shore Mountains show as a dark outline against a clear sky from the north-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in harbour-facing rooms have Burrard Inlet in full sunlight this morning, with nothing in the sky above it.
phrases.clear_midday: The rooftop terrace is in direct sun right now, and the downtown towers around it reflect a clear blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a high-floor king room now, you would see late sun on the North Shore Mountains across the water.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the downtown skyline is lit from top to bottom, and the soaker tubs in the suites face straight at it.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds are moving over the North Shore Mountains this morning, so the peaks come and go from the north-facing windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Harbour-facing rooms this afternoon have Burrard Inlet half in sun and half under cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the North Shore Mountains are turning orange, seen from the harbour-facing rooms.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky sits over the downtown towers today, and the floor-to-ceiling windows show every one of them without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain is running down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the soaker tub in a high-floor suite is one way to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, lightning over Burrard Inlet can be seen from the harbour-facing rooms, and the rooftop terrace is empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Thick fog sits over Burrard Inlet today, so the north-facing windows show no mountains, just grey and the nearest downtown towers.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the North Shore Mountains are white where they can be seen.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, the rooftop terrace has no one on it, and the North Shore Mountains look very sharp.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the rooftop terrace gets full sun, and most guests stay inside behind the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under low cloud, the downtown towers stay lit, and a few guests are still on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the North Shore Mountains cannot be seen from the rooms, only the closest downtown towers can.
phrases.late_night: In a North Shore-facing king room the bedside light is on past one, and the floor-to-ceiling window shows the lights across Burrard Inlet.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the king rooms facing the North Shore, and lights blur across Burrard Inlet.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud hides the North Shore Mountains, and a few lights show across Burrard Inlet from the north-facing rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies still face a dark Neyphu Valley, and the last stars are visible over the pine forest.
phrases.clear_morning: This morning the tall restaurant windows show the rice terraces and the apple orchard below in clear sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a high midday sun, guests taking tea on their terraces can see Eutok Goenpa monastery across the slopes.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on your private balcony, you would watch the low sun move across the pine forest and the orchards.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Neyphu is dark enough that guests on the balconies look at the stars, not the valley.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the valley this morning, so the rice terraces below the restaurant terrace are lit, then shaded, then lit again.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud and some sun this afternoon, and the indoor pool's three wood-framed windows show both over the forested hills.
phrases.partly_golden: As the sun drops, the clouds over the valley turn orange and the fire pit on the restaurant terrace is lit.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Neyphu today, which makes the pine forest look darker from every room terrace and the pool windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the apple orchards below, and guests have moved behind the sliding glass doors, tea still with them.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the valley right now, so the courtyard is empty and guests watch the storm through the restaurant's tall glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the valley today, so the Eutok Goenpa monastery across the slopes is a faint shape rather than a clear building.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the slate roofs and pine forest, and the indoor pool is the warmest place to watch it from.
phrases.very_cold: Through frost on the sliding balcony glass, the Neyphu Valley drops away in pine forest, rice terraces and apple orchards.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot over Neyphu today, so the indoor pool, with its view of the forested hills, is busier than the balconies.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night with no stars over Neyphu, but the fire pit on the restaurant terrace is lit for dinner.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today: the rice terraces directly below the balconies are clear, but the monastery across the slopes is not.
phrases.late_night: Guests here probably fell asleep with the curtain open on purpose, the stars over Neyphu showing through the sliding glass.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake after midnight hears rain on the sliding glass doors, and only the courtyard lights show through the wet pane.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in their room after midnight sees cloud drift past the sliding glass doors, no stars over Neyphu tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: On the oceanfront balconies this early, the sand is still grey and the Pacific is hard to make out beyond it.
phrases.clear_morning: From the white balcony chairs, the morning sun lights the sand and a calm Pacific all the way out.
phrases.clear_midday: If you stood on a balcony now, you would see the Pacific bright under a clear midday sky beyond the Pismo Pier.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a Pacific Suite balcony now, you would see the sun dropping toward the water behind the pier.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the pier is a dark outline against the Pacific, and guests sit with wine at the fire pits.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the ocean this morning, and the boardwalk below the rooms is already in the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Pacific afternoon, so the pool deck at Star Bar is sometimes in sun, sometimes in shade.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the pier turn orange, seen from the patio seating by the fire pits.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Pacific looks grey too, and the lounge chairs on the pool deck are mostly empty.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the sand and the pier, so the ocean view today is best from inside Péquin Coastal Cocina.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the balconies stay empty, and guests watch the lightning over the Pacific from behind their room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has moved in from the Pacific, and from the oceanfront rooms the pier is only partly visible today.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Pismo Beach, but if it fell today, the pool deck and the sand would both turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day like this, the hot tub on the pool deck is the warmest place to see the Pacific.
phrases.very_hot: Heat-haze hangs over the sand beyond the balcony, and the Pacific lies flat and bright out past Pismo Pier.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the lit pool and hot tub are busier than the dark beach beyond them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the Pacific Suite balcony the pier is clear but the far ocean fades to grey.
phrases.late_night: In the Pacific Suite, lights are off by three, and the pool's glow is the only light on the ocean's edge.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtain open after midnight in the Pacific Suite, rain on the glass blurs the white surf by the lit pool.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Pismo Beach after midnight, and the Pacific Suite's curtain stays open to the sound of the waves.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Story Bridge is a dark outline over the river from the bridge-facing rooms, under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the gym's exercise bikes, the morning sun falls on the Story Bridge and the river under a clear Brisbane sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun covers the rooftop pool, and swimmers face the sandstone front of St John's Cathedral and the city towers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches into the suite living areas, and the Story Bridge and the river below it are clearly lit.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Story Bridge LED display is running late, and guests at Motion Dining's river-side tables have it in full view.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds drift over Brisbane this morning, and the terrace looks out on the river with the Story Bridge behind it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in a twin room this afternoon, you would see the Story Bridge move in and out of cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the club lounge on a high floor has the city skyline under broken cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the indoor pool's glass walls still show the city towers and the river, just without any shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Brisbane River, and guests watch the wet Story Bridge from the windows of the bridge-facing rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, the gym windows are a dry place to watch lightning over the Story Bridge and the river.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the river blurs the Story Bridge today, so from Motion Dining's tables it looks pale and far away.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Brisbane, but if it fell today the Story Bridge would look white from the suite windows.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold Brisbane day, the terrace over the river is mostly empty, though the Story Bridge view is clear.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Brisbane today, and most guests are in the rooftop pool, facing St John's Cathedral and the towers.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover Brisbane on this mild night, but the Story Bridge LED display is clearly seen from the rooftop dining area.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the club lounge the nearer towers show but the far end of the skyline does not.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the bridge-facing suites are likely asleep by now, and dawn will bring them the Story Bridge over the river.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the bridge-facing rooms after midnight can watch rain run down the glass while lights on the Brisbane River blur.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a bridge-facing room after midnight can watch low cloud pass over the Story Bridge and the lit riverbanks.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the full-height glass of the six apartments shows the olive grove in grey and the sea strip still dark.
phrases.clear_morning: From the bed, the sequence is clear this morning: olive crowns, bright sky, then a thin line of blue Adriatic.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the narrow strip of Adriatic shows blue between the olive treetops beyond the pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: On the rooftop terrace, late sun lights the olive grove from the side, and the sea strip turns a deeper blue.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the infinity pool is lit, the stone villa beside it glows, and stars cover the sky over Puglia.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the olive grove this morning, and from the covered terrace the sea strip changes colour as their shadows move.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Half cloud, half sun this afternoon: the wicker seats on the covered terrace are the comfortable place to watch the grove.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see the last sun colouring the clouds over the grove.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky over Puglia today, so from the apartments the grove looks darker green and the sea strip is pale grey.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the olive grove and the pool today, while guests watch it from the wicker seats of the covered terrace.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the plain; from behind the full-height glass, lightning shows the olive trees for a second.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the plain means the sea strip is missing from the view; the olive grove around the pool is still clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Puglia, but today a few flakes fall on the olive trees and the sun loungers by the pool.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing on the pool terrace today, so the saltwater pool is empty and the sun loungers have no takers.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the pool terrace, which explains why most guests are in the saltwater pool and not on the loungers.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in the olive grove; the lit pool is the brightest thing between the villa and the dark sea.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, and the narrow strip of Adriatic is not visible from the rooftop terrace; the olive crowns nearby are.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the lit pool shows from the apartments, and a late hour is easy to spend on the Adriatic's distant seam.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the full-height glass of the apartments, and cloud covers the strip of Adriatic beyond the olive grove.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, low cloud drifts over the olive grove, and the pool lights glow toward the distant Adriatic.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the North Shore Mountains are a dark line across the wall-to-wall windows of the harbour-facing rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Signature Harbour View Suite terrace, the first cruise ship of the day is turning in the clear water below.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the heated outdoor pool gives a direct view of the North Shore Mountains under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on the rooftop terrace watch the Convention Centre living roof and the mountains turn pink as the sun drops.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a king room tonight, you would see the lights of the cruise port below through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit on the North Shore Mountains, while coffee on a balcony comes with a clear look at Stanley Park.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, patches of sun move across Burrard Inlet, easy to follow from the wicker seats on the terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the mountains catches orange light, seen from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the suite living room still frames Burrard Inlet and the Canadian flag, with the mountain tops hidden.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the wall-to-wall windows, and the pier on Burrard Inlet looks grey from the king rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Burrard Inlet shows the North Shore Mountains for a second at a time, seen from the harbour-facing rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Guests at the wall-to-wall windows this morning look out at fog over Burrard Inlet, with the North Shore Mountains hidden behind it.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Stanley Park and the harbour, and steam rises off the heated outdoor pool.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day the snow line on the North Shore Mountains is sharp from every harbour-facing window.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot for Vancouver today, and the outdoor pool is the sensible place to look at the North Shore Mountains from.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and guests on the rooftop terrace can still make out the lights along Coal Harbour below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so the North Shore Mountains are missing from the room windows, though the pier and inlet remain in view.
phrases.late_night: Past one, the North Shore lights across Burrard Inlet are an easy reason to stay up at the king room's floor-to-ceiling window.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open after midnight, rain runs down the king room's tall windows and the harbour lights blur on Burrard Inlet.
phrases.grey_evening: Before bed, with the curtain open, the Signature Harbour View Suite shows cruise-port lights on Burrard Inlet under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, every balcony faces a dark Indian Ocean, with only the lighthouse light marking the rocks below the terrace.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunrise comes up over the open ocean, and from the Junior Suites the Whalebone Pier shows as a dark shape against it.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sea is bright blue from the lawn of loungers, and cargo ships move slowly along the horizon toward Durban.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low sun reaches the Vista Terrace, and the white base of the lighthouse on the rocks below takes on a warmer colour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your balcony tonight, you would see ship lights on the horizon and the lighthouse flashing below.
phrases.partly_morning: From the Vista Terrace, morning sun comes through broken cloud onto the Indian Ocean around the red-and-white lighthouse below.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud, some sun this afternoon, and guests on the loungers under the teal umbrellas watch for dolphins in the surf.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds over the sea, seen from wicker chairs under the white shade sails.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the ocean looks grey too, though the red top of the lighthouse still stands out from the terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the lawn of loungers today, and guests watch the sea from behind the floor-to-ceiling doors of the Junior Suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is out over the ocean, and from the balconies lightning shows above the horizon where the cargo ships usually pass.
phrases.fog_haze: Sea mist hides the horizon today, and even the lighthouse just below the terrace is only a faint red shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Umhlanga, so a few flakes over the heated pool would have every balcony door opening at once.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare freezing day, the heated pool is the busiest spot, and the ocean view from the water stays the same.
phrases.very_hot: Hot air sits over the clifftop, and the shade sails on the terrace have more takers than the loungers.
phrases.mild_night: It is a warm cloudy night on the Vista Terrace, with cocktails out and the lighthouse beam passing over the rocks below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today: the lighthouse below the terrace is clear, but the horizon and any cargo ships are not.
phrases.late_night: Up late in a King room, you could watch the surf break below the lighthouse.
phrases.wet_evening: Over a last drink in a King room, you would watch ship lights through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: Over a last drink in a King room, you would see the lighthouse under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the water of Jimbaran Bay is still dark from the Hilltop Pool Villa terraces.
phrases.clear_morning: From a private infinity pool, the bay looks turquoise and calm this morning, with no clouds above it.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the private beach, and most guests stay under the umbrellas by the loungers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Rumari's floor-to-ceiling windows face the sunset, and the ocean turns orange in the last hour of the afternoon.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a villa tonight, you would see stars over Jimbaran Bay from your own terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the bay this morning, and their shadows move across the water seen from the hillside villas.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Partly cloudy over Jimbaran Bay this afternoon, so from the villa terraces the water looks bright in places and dull in others.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the ocean turn pink, which is easy to see from the Rumari windows.
phrases.overcast: If you stood on a villa terrace now, you would see Jimbaran Bay flat and grey under low cloud.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the thatched villa roofs and on the bay, and guests watch it from inside their villas.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Jimbaran Bay is best seen from inside a villa, not from the private pool, which is empty right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Jimbaran Bay hides the distant volcanic mountains, and only the near water shows from the villa terraces.
phrases.snow: Snow would be new to Jimbaran Bay, and if it ever fell, the Hilltop Pool Villas would still face the water.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day is almost unknown here, but the terraces of the Hilltop Pool Villas still face Jimbaran Bay.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, guests leave the loungers on the beach and stay in their private infinity pools.
phrases.mild_night: The night is warm under clouds, and the Secret Cave, a natural grotto, is the setting for a private dinner tonight.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, and the distant volcanic mountains cannot be seen from the beach, only the nearer bay.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Hilltop Pool Villas are likely asleep by now, and Jimbaran Bay will be waiting in the window at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the Hilltop Pool Villas after midnight can watch the rain move across Jimbaran Bay through the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a Hilltop Pool Villa after midnight can watch low cloud pass over Jimbaran Bay, the shore lights beneath it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Diamond Head is a dark shape from the lanai, and the beach below is still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Premier Suite lanai, the full curve of Waikiki Beach is visible this morning, with Diamond Head sharp at the end.
phrases.clear_midday: The orchid-mosaic pool gets full sun at this hour, and most lounge chairs around it are taken.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: House Without A Key is filling up now, because the sun goes down in about an hour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the lanai tonight, you would hear the waves and see only the dark outline of Diamond Head.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit over Diamond Head this morning, but the ocean in front of the hotel is already bright turquoise.
phrases.partly_afternoon: At the pool, cloud shadows pass over the orchid mosaic every few minutes, then the sun returns.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun at House Without A Key has some cloud in it, which usually makes the colours stronger.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the water off Waikiki Beach looks more green than turquoise, and Diamond Head is still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the beach, so guests in the Premier Suites watch it from their lanais instead of the sand.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the ocean is rare in Honolulu, but today the restaurant's louvered doors frame a wide view of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Waikiki today, and from the lanai Diamond Head is a soft grey shape rather than a sharp crater.
phrases.snow: Snow in Honolulu would be a first, so if you were at the pool you would mostly see very confused guests.
phrases.very_cold: A freezing day in Waikiki almost never happens, but the Premier Suite lanai facing Diamond Head would be the place to sit.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the orchid-mosaic pool is the busiest part of the hotel, with the ocean a close second.
phrases.mild_night: Warm night, cloudy sky, no stars over Diamond Head, but the lanai is still a comfortable place to sit late.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the air over Waikiki is not clear enough to show Diamond Head properly, though the beach in front stays visible.
phrases.late_night: The curtain stays open on purpose at bedtime in a Premier Suite, and Waikiki's shore lights show beside Diamond Head's outline.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Premier Suite windows after midnight, and the Waikiki shoreline lights blur along the beach toward Diamond Head.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers Waikiki tonight, and from a Premier Suite the beachfront lights show along the sand toward Diamond Head.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the suite terraces look toward dark mountain outlines, and the coastal plain below is still without colour.
phrases.clear_morning: On a clear morning like this one, the sea is visible beyond the coastal plain from the panoramic terraces.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun falls straight onto the wooden deck of the outdoor pool, and the umbrellas are the only shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the infinity pool, the forested hills turn orange in the late sun, with a few swimmers still in the water.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight a clear sky covers the Monchique range, and from a suite terrace very few lights show below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the hills this morning, and from the bedroom terrace the vineyard landscape is alternately bright and shaded.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the sun loungers get a mixed afternoon: cloud shadows crossing the mountains, sunshine on the pool deck between them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the undersides of the clouds, seen from the infinity pool over the forested hills.
phrases.overcast: Through the floor-to-ceiling suite windows, the rolling hills are under a flat grey sky, and the sea is not visible today.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the mountain terraces today, the sun loungers stand empty, and the Caldas spa is the busier option.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the Monchique range, and the hotel's windows are a dry place to watch lightning above the hills.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the slopes today, and from the suite terraces even the nearest trees are only partly visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare here, but today a thin white layer covers the sun loungers on the panoramic terraces above the plain.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold on the mountain today, the terraces are empty, but the view down to the coastal plain is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: In this heat, most guests are in the outdoor pool or under the umbrellas, and the hills look pale in the glare.
