phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning sky over Pacific Beach, and from the upper floors the water looks flat all the way to the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the clear sky sits over the open Pacific, and Crystal Pier runs out from the sand below the balconies.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From a balcony chair, the low sun is now sitting just above the Pacific, with Crystal Pier in front of it.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Grand Pacific Suite tonight, you would see a clear sky and a dark ocean from two sides.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the ocean this morning, and cyclists are already passing on the path below the pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud throw shade on parts of the beach this afternoon, visible from the ocean-facing rooms on the upper floors.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun is colouring the clouds over the pier, seen from the poolside lounge chairs.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Pacific Beach today, so the ocean from the balcony looks grey too, with the horizon hard to pick out.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the beach and the oceanfront path today, and the balcony chairs outside the rooms are wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Pacific this hour, and the upper-floor rooms give the widest view of the lightning over the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has moved in from the ocean, and from the pool Crystal Pier is only partly visible, if at all.
phrases.snow: Snow in San Diego is almost unheard of, but if it fell today, the heated outdoor pool would still be warm.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold for San Diego today, and the beach chairs below the hotel stay empty while the heated pool steams.
phrases.very_hot: If you were on the balcony now, you would see heat-haze over the sand between the hotel and the water.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Pacific Beach, and guests on the balconies can hear the waves without seeing much of them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the beach and lifeguard tower are clear, but the far horizon is not visible from the rooms.
phrases.late_night: Lights turned off in the Grand Pacific Suite, the moon on the ocean is the only light left in the room.
phrases.wet_evening: Late after dinner, rain runs down the Grand Pacific Suite windows, and the surf can be heard below on the beach.
phrases.grey_evening: After a late dinner, cloud is low over the ocean, and the Grand Pacific Suite looks out on pale surf lines.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the six suite balconies look onto a dark Pacific, with nothing moving yet on Los Alemanes beach.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear sky over Academy Bay this morning, and the first finches are already drinking at the pool edge.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the light on Los Alemanes beach is strong, and the pool is where most guests spend the next hours.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun sits low over the open Pacific, and guests at the beachfront bar face straight into it from their chairs.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the pool lit blue, the opuntia cacti lit around it, and dark water beyond.
phrases.partly_morning: Some cloud over Santa Cruz this morning, but the view from the suite balconies to the open Pacific is unchanged.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds move across the afternoon sky, and a heron has taken a place at the pool between the lounge chairs.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, two guests on the lounge terrace watch the clouds change colour over the ocean.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky from end to end today, so the Pacific in front of Los Alemanes beach looks grey as well.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the wooden walkways between the garden rooms, and the duck at the pool does not mind.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the open water, and the suite balconies are empty while guests watch the storm from inside the lounge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Academy Bay, and from the sun terrace the line between sea and sky is hard to find.
phrases.snow: Snow is not something the Galapagos gets, but the suite balconies would still look onto the open Pacific if it came.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold outside today, which is rare for Santa Cruz; the pool is empty and the finches have its edge to themselves.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on Los Alemanes beach this afternoon, so most guests are in the pool rather than on the sun terrace.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud overhead; the candlelit lounge is open to the terrace and the ocean is dark but audible.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from the suite balconies the open Pacific fades a few kilometres out and the horizon is missing.
phrases.late_night: If you were in one of the suites now, you would sleep well, knowing the window shows the open Pacific at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in a suite now, you would watch rain fall on the Pacific past the beach.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in the lounge now, you would see cloud over the Pacific and hear the sea.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Breezy rooms look out over a dark Swan River, with the Perth Hills a dark line beyond.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear sky this morning, so the floor-to-ceiling windows show the Swan River and the Perth Hills in sharp detail.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the outdoor pool is in full sun, and the Swan River shows clearly from the upper-floor windows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the rooftop terrace in the last sun, the city skyline and the Swan River are both lit from the side.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a Breezy room tonight, you would see a clear sky over the Swan River and the suburbs.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds this morning over the Swan River, exactly the kind of sky the upper-floor windows frame best.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the suburban rooftops this afternoon, with the Perth Hills still visible from the Breezy rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: The rooftop terrace gets the last hour of sun, and the clouds over the city skyline take some colour.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Swan River looks grey too, but the Perth Hills are still there behind the glass.
phrases.rain: Rain on the floor-to-ceiling windows today, so the Swan River is watched from a dry Breezy room rather than the pool.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Perth Hills is visible from the upper floors, and the outdoor pool is empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the river today, so the Perth Hills are faint and the Swan River is the closest clear thing.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Perth, but if it fell today the Breezy rooms would still face the Swan River.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing outside this morning, a rare thing in Perth, with the Perth Hills unusually sharp beyond the Swan River.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Perth today, and the outdoor pool is the one place at the hotel where the heat is welcome.
phrases.mild_night: A warm, cloudy night, and the rooftop terrace has the city skyline and the dark Swan River in front of it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Perth Hills cannot be seen from the Breezy rooms, only the Swan River nearby.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Breezy rooms who wake for water near midnight find the Swan River outside, a few lights along it.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Breezy rooms watch rain run down the floor-to-ceiling glass as suburban lights come on along the Swan River.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a Breezy room tonight can watch the suburban lights along the Swan River under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Strip's neon is still on, and south-facing suites look down its full length under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Las Vegas, and from the floor-to-ceiling windows the Paris Eiffel Tower replica stands sharp against the mountains.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the desert sun hits the gold glass directly, and the rooftop pool is the obvious place to be.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun from the west lights the mountains behind the Strip, seen from the high-floor suites through tinted gold glass.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the casino neon and the moving traffic along the Strip from a south-facing suite.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds over the valley this morning, but the Strip below the windows stays fully visible along its south axis.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the Strip this afternoon, and guests at the rooftop pool get short breaks from the sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the broken clouds turn orange above the mountains, framed by the suites' floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.overcast: The sky over Las Vegas is fully grey today, and from the suites the Strip looks flatter without its usual shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Las Vegas, so guests in the south-facing suites watch the wet Strip as a small event.
phrases.thunderstorm: A desert thunderstorm has reached the city, and from the high-floor suites lightning shows over the mountains behind the Strip.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the valley today softens the far end of the Strip, but the nearer casinos remain clear from the windows.
phrases.snow: Snow in Las Vegas happens about once a decade, so a white Strip seen from the suites is worth a photo.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing outside today, the rooftop pool has no swimmers, and the Strip looks unusually sharp from the suites.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in the valley today, and the rooftop pool on the gold glass tower is where most guests spend the afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: Mild cloudy night over the Strip, and the casino neon is still fully visible from the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is down today; the near Strip and the Eiffel replica are visible from the suites, but the mountains behind are not.
phrases.late_night: Were you in a south-facing suite tonight, you might leave the curtain open and fall asleep facing the lights of the Strip.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in a south-facing suite now, rain on the glass would blur the Strip lights.
phrases.grey_evening: If you poured a last drink in a south-facing suite tonight, you would see the Strip's lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the downtown skyline is a dark outline from the Club Lounge floors, and the rooftop pool is still empty.
phrases.clear_morning: This morning the downtown towers and the green streets below them show clearly through the window above the suite soaking tub.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun lands on the rooftop pool above McKinney Avenue, and the downtown towers are easy to count against a blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light comes through the large suite windows and onto the cream sofa, with the skyline turning orange outside.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a Club Lounge room tonight, you would see the downtown Dallas towers lit up under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over downtown this morning, while the first Club Lounge food presentation of the day is set out.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the rooftop pool get sun between the clouds this afternoon, with the downtown buildings in view the whole time.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds over the skyline, seen from the upper-floor rooms on McKinney Avenue.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the downtown towers look flat from the suite windows, and the rooftop pool is quieter than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop pool and the city outside; the marble soaking tub by the window is the indoor option.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over downtown Dallas is visible from the Club Lounge floors, and nobody is in the rooftop pool right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the lower part of the skyline today, so from the suite windows only the tops of the towers show.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Dallas, but today it falls past the suite windows, and the downtown towers are partly hidden.
phrases.very_cold: From the upper floors, the downtown Dallas skyline stands sharp in hard winter light above the empty rooftop pool terrace.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Dallas today, so the rooftop pool is the sensible place to look at the skyline from.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night over McKinney Avenue, and the lit downtown towers are still clear from the rooftop pool.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the upper floors the nearer downtown buildings show but the far ones do not.
phrases.late_night: Were you in a suite around three with every light off, the downtown Dallas skyline would be the only light inside.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in a Club Lounge room, you would see downtown's lights through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in a Club Lounge room now, you would see the downtown skyline lit under the cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Atlantic is still dark from the oceanfront balconies, and the sun will come up straight over the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From a balcony suite this morning, the sea looks calm and blue, and the sand below is already in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the 200-foot sun deck, so the shade of a private balcony is the sensible place for lunch.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the yellow tower from the land side, while guests on the oceanfront balconies watch the water turn darker blue.
phrases.clear_night: A clear night over Myrtle Beach, with dark water below the oceanfront balconies and a sky full of stars above the Atlantic.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the beach this morning, so the sea seen from the ocean-view bedrooms changes between grey and blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the lazy river gets sun and shade in turns, depending on which cloud is crossing the Atlantic.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the water go pink, and every oceanfront balcony faces straight at them.
phrases.overcast: Guests on the oceanfront balconies this afternoon look out over the sandy shore to a grey Atlantic under a full grey sky.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the two pools and the sun deck, and most guests watch it from behind their suite's sliding glass doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, lightning over the Atlantic is visible from the suite living rooms, with the glass doors firmly closed.
phrases.fog_haze: Sea fog has moved onto the shore, and from the balconies the water is heard more than it is seen today.
phrases.snow: Snow on a Myrtle Beach balcony is rare, but today the sand below the tower is white instead of pale yellow.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing wind comes off the Atlantic today, so the sun deck is empty and guests watch the calm sea from inside.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over North Ocean Boulevard today, and the lazy river is the one part of the resort still busy.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night there are no stars above the oceanfront balconies, but the sound of the waves is clear.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The horizon is missing today: from the ocean-view bedrooms the beach and the nearest water are clear, but nothing further out.
phrases.late_night: Light stays on late in an oceanfront suite while Atlantic surf shows white outside.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the sliding glass doors of the oceanfront suites, and the shore lights of Myrtle Beach blur behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Myrtle Beach after midnight, and the shore lights look hazy through the sliding glass doors of the oceanfront suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Maximilian terrace is empty and the mountains across Lake Garda show as a dark line above the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast tables on the terrace look out at calm blue water, with the island clearly visible this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the pool loungers face a bright lake, and the wooded headland is clearly outlined under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low afternoon sun reaches the balconies of the third-floor terrace rooms, lighting the cypress trees and the mountains behind the lake.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at the Maximilian restaurant tonight, candles would light your table and the lake would lie dark below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the mountains this morning, but from the Suite Loggia's private terrace most of the lake is in sunshine.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pool, patches of shade cross the water as clouds pass, while the headland stays mostly in sunlight.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights some mountain slopes and leaves others grey, seen from the colonnaded terrace of the rooms.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the lake looks flat and pale from the breakfast terrace, and the island is still easy to spot.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the pool and the closed umbrellas; guests watch the wet gardens from behind the arched glass doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, lightning over the mountains can be watched from the Heydweiller Suite's private terrace, and the candles outside stay unlit.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Lake Garda today hides the far mountains, and from the pool only the nearest headland is clear.
phrases.snow: Snow covers the mountains across the lake and dusts the pool loungers, a rare sight from the third-floor balconies.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day the gardens are quiet, and the lake looks unusually clear from the Suite Loggia's terrace.
phrases.very_hot: From the Maximilian terrace, heat-haze hangs over the water of Lake Garda below the empty loungers by the pool.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night, dinner continues on the candlelit Maximilian terrace with the lake dark and the mountains barely visible.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the island is a faint shape from the breakfast terrace and the far shore cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: Long after dinner at the Maximilian, far-shore lights reflect in the lake below the suites.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at the Maximilian, the Suite Loggia's arched glass doors show rain over Lake Garda and town lights across the water.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at the Maximilian, the far-shore lights of Lake Garda are visible under low cloud from the Suite Loggia.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the bay below the hill is still dark, and the church spire is only an outline from the balcony.
phrases.clear_morning: From the checkered-tile balcony, the neighbourhood rooftops and the forested slopes are sharp under a clean blue sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the lap pool, and the palm trees give the only shade on the wooden deck.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests at the elevated pool are watching the sun drop while Guanabara Bay turns gold below the hill.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight, from the rooftop pool, the city lights spread across the neighbourhood, with no cloud between the hotel and the stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds pass over the bay this morning, and the church spire is in sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the leafy terrace, the hammock gets sun between the clouds this afternoon, and the rooftops below stay bright.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the pool deck now, you would see the last sun light the clouds above Guanabara Bay.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the bay below the hotel is flat and pale, but the church spire is clear from the balcony.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pool deck, and the louvered window by the soaking tub is a dry place to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Guanabara Bay is visible from the large windows of the Térèze restaurant, and the pool deck is empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the bay today, so from the balcony the church spire is clear but the water beyond is not.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Rio, but if it fell today the palm trees around the lap pool would be a strange sight.
phrases.very_cold: A day close to freezing is rare here, and the lap pool is empty, though the view over the rooftops is clear.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Santa Teresa, and the lap pool under the palm trees is the busiest spot in the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, so the city lights below the restaurant windows are the view instead of stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the rooftops and church spire near the hotel show clearly but Guanabara Bay is a faint shape.
phrases.late_night: A good hour to be asleep: city lights outline Guanabara Bay below the hotel, and at dawn the window shows the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner at Térèze, the room window shows rain over Guanabara Bay and the city lights blurred below.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Térèze, the lights around Guanabara Bay show below the hotel under a low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the volcano across the water is a dark shape from the suite terraces, with nobody at the infinity pool yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast at Charisma has started, and the caldera beside the infinity pool tables is already fully blue in the morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Under strong midday sun, the whitewashed terraces and sundecks down the cliff are bright, and the volcano is sharp across the water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a suite terrace now, you would see the late sun lighting the caldera cliffs and the water below.
phrases.clear_night: At the outdoor bar the candles are lit, and the white Cycladic buildings beyond it are only small lights now.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the caldera this morning, so the volcano moves in and out of shadow from the Charisma tables.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the Aegean this afternoon, and guests on the sundecks get sun for a while, then shade, then sun again.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the volcano turns orange, and the small terrace table is a good seat.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Santorini, and from the arched suite doors the caldera water looks grey too, which is rare here.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the whitewashed terraces, and the volcano across the water is a soft blur from the suite doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the caldera is visible from inside the cave suites, which are a solid place to watch it from.
phrases.fog_haze: Today a thick haze sits between the suite terraces and the volcano, which is hard to make out.
phrases.snow: Oia almost never sees snow, yet a few flakes are falling past the terrace table toward the caldera water.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air on the Oia cliff keeps guests off the sundecks, though the volcano is clearly visible from behind the suite doors.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot sun on the terraces means most guests are in the infinity pool, looking at the volcano from the water.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night in Oia, and dinner at Lure goes on with the caldera dark below the restaurant.
phrases.reduced_visibility: If you were at the terrace table now, you would see the nearby water but not the volcano across the caldera.
phrases.late_night: The curtain stays open on purpose in the cave suites, so a few lights across the caldera water show until sleep comes.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the suite door glass after midnight, and the lights of Oia blur along the caldera edge.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain left open tonight, the suite's arched doorway frames Oia's lights along the caldera under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balcony loungers face a dark Karon Noi bay, and the Andaman is still only a flat grey line.
phrases.clear_morning: From the upper-floor rooms, the bay is already turquoise, and the sand of Karon Noi is almost empty.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the striped loungers on the terrace are mostly in full sun, so the pool is the busier place.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the forested headland from the side, and the terrace is the easiest place to watch it.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your balcony tonight, you would see a clear sky over the Andaman and no lights on the water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the bay this morning, and guests on the beach do their yoga in patches of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the palm-covered hillside this afternoon, and the sea in front of the terrace changes colour with them.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the clouds above Karon Noi orange, a good moment for the balcony loungers.
phrases.overcast: From an upper-floor balcony, Karon Noi beach lies pale and quiet under a grey sky, the Andaman flat beyond it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Karon Noi beach, and the ten dining options are getting more guests than the loungers today.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Andaman, seen from a balcony, is a reasonable excuse to stay indoors and try the spa.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far edge of the Andaman today, so the view from the upper rooms stops near the headland.
phrases.snow: Snow over Karon Noi would be a first for Phuket, and the balcony would be the place to see it.
phrases.very_cold: From the balconies, hard winter light falls on the empty terrace loungers and the Karon Noi sand below.
phrases.very_hot: On a hot afternoon the sand of Karon Noi is hard to walk on barefoot, and the pool is the sensible option.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky tonight, and the air on the terrace is warm enough to sit out late facing the dark bay.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the upper rooms the open Andaman is not really visible beyond the bay itself.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the pool lights show from the upper-floor rooms while the Andaman washes onto Karon Noi.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight the upper-floor curtains are open to rain over Karon Noi, and the resort lights show on the wet sand.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight the curtain stays open in an upper-floor room, and the resort lights show Karon Noi's sand under the cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Melbourne skyline shows as dark towers with lit windows from the floor-to-ceiling glass of every room.
phrases.clear_morning: Eureka Tower stands sharp against a clear sky this morning while Salted Egg serves breakfast on the first floor.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop pool sits under full sun, and from the upper rooms the parklands and distant bay are clear.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests at The Q's outdoor terrace are watching the sun go down behind the CBD towers in warm light.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a room tonight, you would see the lit towers of the CBD through the floor-to-ceiling window.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the skyline this morning, and the gym's windows show city towers alternately in sun and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, a reader at a window table has patches of sun on the skyscrapers between the clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the bottoms of the clouds over Melbourne, seen from the 28th-floor bar's outdoor seats.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the CBD today, and Eureka Tower looks flat and dull from the city-facing rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the 241 rooms, and the skyline behind the drops is wet and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Melbourne skyline is best seen from The Q's indoor seating, with the outdoor terrace empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the upper CBD today, and the 28th-floor bar's windows show white instead of the skyline.
phrases.snow: Melbourne almost never sees snow, but if flakes fell today, the skyline from the 28th-floor bar's windows would turn white.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the gym's treadmills face sharp city towers while the outdoor terrace stays empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the CBD today, and the rooftop pool is the busiest part of the hotel.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy but mild sky, guests on The Q's outdoor terrace have the lit skyline without needing a coat.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooms the distant bay is not visible and Eureka Tower is only a dim shape.
phrases.late_night: Guests at the Quincy are likely asleep, blinds up on purpose, Eureka Tower and the skyline lights the last thing they saw.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a city-facing room tonight can watch rain run down the floor-to-ceiling glass, the skyline lights blurred behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests awake in their rooms after midnight have the CBD tower lights under low cloud through the floor-to-ceiling glass.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the suite windows show Emirates Palace still lit, with the Arabian Gulf dark and flat beyond it.
phrases.clear_morning: From the infinity pool, the Corniche skyline is sharp this morning, Emirates Palace on the left, Qasr Al Watan further off.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands high over the infinity pool, and the Arabian Gulf looks bright and almost white.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the balcony now, you would watch the low sun colour Emirates Palace and the gardens below.
phrases.clear_night: On the rooftop lounge, the purple pillars are lit and Emirates Palace shows as a line of lights across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Corniche skyline this morning, and the infinity pool already has its first swimmers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the Arabian Gulf in the afternoon, so the water seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows changes colour often.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights Emirates Palace from the side while broken clouds hang above the Corniche skyline.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Gulf looks flat and pale from the rooms, and Emirates Palace stands out less than usual.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare here, but today it is falling on the infinity pool, and the Corniche skyline looks washed and dull.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm the guests watch from inside; lightning over the Arabian Gulf is visible from the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the Corniche today, and Qasr Al Watan, usually visible from the pool, is only a faint shape.
phrases.snow: Snow in Abu Dhabi would be a first; if it fell, the infinity pool would be the strangest place to see it.

phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside today, so the infinity pool is the only comfortable spot with a view of Emirates Palace.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and from the rooftop lounge the purple pillars glow against the lit Corniche skyline.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the pool Emirates Palace is clear but Qasr Al Watan is not visible.
phrases.late_night: Inside the suite the lights are off, and the Corniche lights along the Gulf are the only glow left.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the suite windows tonight, and the Corniche lights look soft and blurred along the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hangs over the Corniche tonight, and the skyline lights show beneath it from the suite windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sky Tower stands dark against a clear sky in the view from the Junior King Suite balcony.
phrases.clear_morning: Daylight comes through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the atrium lobby, and the Sky Tower is sharp from the Club Lounge.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low afternoon sun lights one side of the Sky Tower, seen from the balcony of the Junior King Suite.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the balcony tonight, you would see the illuminated Sky Tower above the city skyline under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass behind the Sky Tower this morning, and from the Club Lounge the tower moves in and out of shadow.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, patches of cloud move over the Sky Tower while guests swim lengths in the heated indoor pool.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud turns orange behind the Sky Tower in the view from the balcony.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Auckland today, and the Sky Tower is a flat shape from the Club Lounge windows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Sky Tower is visible but blurred from the suites facing north.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the Sky Tower is lit briefly by lightning, best watched from inside the Club Lounge rather than the balcony.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Sky Tower today, so the view from the Junior King Suite stops partway up.
phrases.snow: Snow in Auckland is rare, but if it were falling now you would see it against the Sky Tower from the balcony.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Club Lounge this morning see the Sky Tower in hard winter light, with frost on the glass.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Auckland today, and the Sky Tower shimmers slightly in the heat from the Junior King Suite balcony.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, the Sky Tower is lit above the skyline, and The Aviary lobby bar is serving drinks.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Sky Tower is still there from the Club Lounge but the skyline beyond it is not.
phrases.late_night: Up after midnight in the Junior King Suite, you might go on watching the Sky Tower.
phrases.wet_evening: If you carried a last glass to the Club Lounge tonight, you would see the Sky Tower through rain-streaked windows.
phrases.grey_evening: A last drink in the Club Lounge now would show you the Sky Tower's top in low cloud above the lit city.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sky Floor rooms look out on a dark bay, with the port lights still on along the water.
phrases.clear_morning: A clear morning from floor 50 shows the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge far to the west, a thin line on the horizon.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a cloudless noon sky, Osaka Bay looks flat and bright from the restaurant windows, right out to the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun sits over the bay to the west, and guests at the high-floor restaurant get the orange sky before dinner.
phrases.clear_night: At the bar counter tonight, the floor-to-ceiling windows show Osaka's city lights and the port lights on the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds this morning put moving shadows on the bay, seen from the upper-floor guest rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From a Sky Floor room this afternoon, the skyline sits under broken cloud and the bay changes colour with the sun.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were at a restaurant table now, the last sun would be colouring the clouds red over the bay.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Osaka today, so the bay and skyline are visible from the 46th floor, but the bridge is not.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows at the bar, and the bay below is grey with a low sky.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Osaka Bay is visible from fifty floors up, and the Sky Floor rooms have the widest view of it.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the bay today, and from the restaurant the water fades out well before the horizon.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the upper-floor windows, rare for Osaka, and the bay is a dull grey behind it.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the distant mountains behind the city show well from the guest room windows.
phrases.very_hot: Osaka is very hot today, and from the Sky Floor rooms the bay looks pale and bright in the strong sun.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the bar counter has a full view of the city lights, with no stars above them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge and distant mountains cannot be seen, only the near bay.
phrases.late_night: The Sky Floor curtain stays open on purpose, so the port lights on Osaka Bay are the last thing seen tonight.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtain is open in a Sky Floor room after midnight, and rain on the glass blurs Osaka Bay's port lights.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open in a Sky Floor room, the port lights reflect on Osaka Bay under low cloud after midnight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Church of Bethlehem across Las Ramblas is still a dark shape from the sixth-floor balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the rooftop pool early, and the Cathedral of Barcelona stands out clearly above the roofscape.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the tree canopy of Las Ramblas, seen from a sixth-floor balcony, gives the only shade in sight.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the stone front of the Church of Bethlehem, and the balconies above Las Ramblas face it directly.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop tonight, you would see the Cathedral of Barcelona lit against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the roofscape this morning, and the rooftop tapas bar changes from sun to shade every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the infinity pool this afternoon, the medieval bell tower switches between bright and dull as clouds move across.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud leaves some Barcelona rooftops bright and others grey, all visible from the sixth-floor terraces.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Las Ramblas today, so the Church of Bethlehem looks flat and plain from the balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Las Ramblas, and most guests watch it from behind the French balcony doors rather than outside.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the rooftop pool is empty, and the lounge with the blue velvet sofa is where guests wait it out.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Barcelona today softens the roofscape, and the Cathedral is only a faint outline from the rooftop.
phrases.snow: Snow in Barcelona is rare, but if it fell today the tree canopy of Las Ramblas would turn white below the balconies.
phrases.very_cold: The sixth-floor terraces are empty on this freezing day, and guests watch the Church of Bethlehem through the balcony doors.
phrases.very_hot: With the city very hot today, the rooftop infinity pool is the most sensible place to look at the Cathedral of Barcelona.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild cloudy night over Las Ramblas, and the sixth-floor balcony doors can stay open until late.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the Church of Bethlehem and nearby rooftops are clear, but the far side of Barcelona is not.
phrases.late_night: Las Ramblas lights fill the sixth-floor view at two, hard to stop watching.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the sixth-floor windows above Las Ramblas, and the lamps along the walkway shine on the wet trees.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight the open curtains of the sixth-floor rooms show the lamps of Las Ramblas under a low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sea outside the upper-floor balconies is still dark and flat, with the Taurus peaks slowly turning grey.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop sun deck, the snow caps of the Taurus show clearly above the treeline this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the wooden loungers on the rooftop have no shade, and the Mediterranean looks very blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a private balcony now, you would see the late sun lighting the sea and the pier below.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight, the upper-floor balconies look out on a dark Mediterranean under a clear sky full of stars.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Taurus Mountains this morning, but the sea from the rooftop terrace is clear and calm.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the beachfront umbrellas this afternoon, so the loungers near the pier get sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the red woven chairs on the terrace face a sea half lit, half in cloud shadow.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Belek today; the rooftop panorama still shows the sea, though the Taurus snow caps are hard to pick out.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the six outdoor pools and the wooden rooftop loungers, while guests watch the grey sea from their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Mediterranean right now; from the sea-view rooms you can watch lightning over the water from behind the glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze today: from the terrace, the beach umbrellas are clear, but the far sea and the mountains are only pale shapes.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Belek, but today a few flakes fall on the rooftop jacuzzi, with the sea grey below.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the hot tubs on the upper-floor balconies are the warmest place to look at the sea.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Belek today; the six outdoor pools and the sea off the private beach are where most guests stay.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Belek; the rooftop jacuzzi is in use, with no stars and a dark sea below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the rooftop sun deck, the pier and the near sea show clearly today, but haze hides the Taurus Mountains.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner, the pier lights show on the sea from the upper-floor rooms.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open in the sea-view rooms, rain runs down the balcony glass and the Mediterranean shows grey through it.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hides the moon tonight, and from the sea-view rooms the open curtains show the Mediterranean and the beach lamps.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the high-floor rooms look over a dark Amstelkanaal, with the Rembrandt Tower lit against a clear sky.

phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun sits high over De Pijp, and the telescope in the suite gives a look at the Rembrandt Tower.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Amstel River from the west, and the Twenty Third Bar has the clearest seat for it.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a high-floor room tonight, you would see the Munttoren and the Rembrandt Tower against a clear night sky.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of sun and shade cross the rooftops this afternoon, visible from the soaking tub in the high-floor bathrooms.
phrases.partly_golden: Gaps in the cloud let the last sun reach the Munttoren, seen from the Twenty Third Bar.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Amstelkanaal looks flat and dull, but the whole city is still in view from the 23rd floor.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on De Pijp, and from the suite windows the Munttoren is a blurred shape behind wet glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Amstel River shows clearly through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the upper suites, twenty-three floors up.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has shortened the view today, and from the high floors even the Rembrandt Tower is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the rooftops of De Pijp, and the view from the high-floor bathrooms is mostly white and grey.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air outside makes the view sharp today, and the Munttoren stands out clearly from the Twenty Third Bar.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon in Amsterdam, the indoor pool at Nagomi Spa is probably the most popular place in the building.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, lights along the Amstel River reflect in the water below the upper-floor windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so the Munttoren and the distant churches cannot be seen from the high floors, only the nearby Amstelkanaal.
phrases.late_night: Awake for water around one, you would see lights along the Amstel from your suite.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were in the Twenty Third Bar for a last drink, rain on the glass would blur the Amstel lights.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were at the Twenty Third Bar for a last drink, you would see the Amstel's lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Elliott Bay is still dark from the bed by the window, with Smith Tower a dark outline on one side.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the gray brick facade, and guests on the red and yellow stools under the canopy sit in it.

phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Elliott Bay today, so from the bed the window shows mostly white where the port usually is.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on Pioneer Square, seen from the lobby's floor-to-ceiling windows, and the globe pendant lights are on all day.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, and the red and yellow stools under the canopy are empty while the bay stays clear.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day in Seattle, which is unusual, the water of Elliott Bay at least looks cool from the bed.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, guests sit on the stools under the wood canopy while the bar inside stays open.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the window Elliott Bay is there but the far side of the port is not.
phrases.late_night: Elliott Bay's port lights fill the bedside window after midnight, reason enough to stay up.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the wall-to-wall window after midnight, and the port lights along Elliott Bay blur behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud drifts over Elliott Bay after midnight, and the port lights show faintly under it from the bedside picture window.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Warm late sun is falling on the city bowl and Table Mountain, seen from the suite living rooms right now.

phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the waterfront buildings and moored yachts stay visible from the marina-facing rooms.

phrases.very_cold: From a Skyline View room, the Burj Khalifa stands sharp in hard winter light above the empty beach loungers.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot today, and most guests stay in the pool or behind the lattice screens of their suites.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, guests sit at the tables on the dining terrace and the Burj Khalifa shows between the clouds.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the upper-floor rooms already show St. Mark's Campanile as a dark shape above the rooftops.

phrases.very_hot: Venice is very hot today, and the terrace tables of Caffè Nolinski are mostly empty while the sun is directly on them.

phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility over Venice today: from the upper rooms the Campanile is still clear, but the farther rooftops are not.
phrases.late_night: Were you asleep in an upper-floor room tonight, you would wake at dawn to St. Mark's Campanile in the arched window.
phrases.wet_evening: If you took a last drink at Caffè Nolinski tonight, you would watch rain run down the glass onto the wet stones outside.
phrases.grey_evening: If you carried a last glass from Caffè Nolinski upstairs tonight, you would see the Campanile's outline under low cloud.

phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the neon lights of Bangkok show clearly from ANJU Korean Rooftop Bar on the 31st floor.

phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the palms around the pool, a rare sight in Marrakech, and the garden paths are empty.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, the snow-capped Atlas Mountains stand out sharply beyond the olive groves from the upper-floor rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today in Marrakech; the pool is the busiest place in the garden and the cabanas are all taken.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild under cloud, and dinner is served on the balconies, the pool lit below among the palms.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the Atlas Mountains cannot be seen from the garden rooms, and the minaret shows without its tile detail.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, with the Koutoubia Suite's own lights switched off, only Marrakech's lights around the minaret's outline show in its windows.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtain stays open in the Koutoubia Suite, and the minaret's shape shows through rain on the glass against the city lights.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain open in the Koutoubia Suite, the minaret's square shape shows against the city lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the surf below the Signature Ocean suites is heard long before it can be seen from the terrace.
phrases.clear_morning: From a guest-room balcony this morning, the Pacific is calm and the palm trees stand out sharply against a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun lights the mosaic tile floor of the pool, and the white umbrellas are the only shade on the deck.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: On a private terrace, the outdoor dining table faces the sun as it drops toward the Pacific between the palm trees.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a Signature Ocean suite tonight, you would hear the surf under the terrace without seeing much of it.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the cove this morning, and the turquoise surf turns grey and back again below the cliff-edge pools.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pool deck cabanas, the hillside homes are lit and shaded in turn as clouds move across the afternoon sky.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun puts orange edges on the clouds over the Pacific, seen from the guest-room balconies.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Laguna Beach today, and from the terrace the ocean looks flat and the palm trees look darker.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the three outdoor pools and the empty lounge chairs, while guests watch the wet cove from their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Pacific is visible from the guest-room balconies, and nobody is in the three outdoor pools right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Coastal fog hides the Pacific from the terrace today, though the sound of breaking surf still reaches the suites.
phrases.snow: Snow is extremely rare in Laguna Beach, but a few flakes are falling past the balcony toward the cold Pacific.
phrases.very_cold: Hard winter light falls on the empty lounge chairs along the cliff-edge pools above the Pacific surf.
phrases.very_hot: The pool deck is very hot today, and most guests are either in the water or under the white umbrellas.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night like this one, the surf below the terrace is easier to hear than to see.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the pool deck the hillside homes and the horizon are hard to see.
phrases.late_night: In the Signature Ocean suites the curtain is left open, and the white surf shows below the bluff after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the balcony glass of the Signature Ocean suites, and the last lights in the hillside homes blur after midnight.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the Pacific in the small hours, and from the guest rooms the hillside homes show only as lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lake below the terrace is still dark, and the wooded hills show only as outlines.
phrases.clear_morning: From a King bedroom window, Windermere lies flat and bright this morning, with every wooded hill clearly defined.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the lake, and guests on the terrace see Windermere spread wide below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the pine trees by the garden swing, and the hills across the lake look orange.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a Lake View Hot Tub suite tonight, you would see stars over Windermere and lit gardens below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the wooded hills this morning, and from the conservatory lounge the lake changes between grey and blue.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The terrace has sun for a few minutes, then shade, as broken cloud moves across Windermere this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: From the dining terrace, the low sun lights Lake Windermere and the wooded hills under broken cloud.
phrases.overcast: Under grey cloud the lake looks the same colour as the sky, and guests sit under the conservatory skylight.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the lake and the garden, and from the indoor hot tub the large windows show all of it.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is moving over the hills, and the floor-to-ceiling windows beside the dining terrace give a clear view of each flash.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Windermere today, so from the terrace the lake is hidden and only the nearest pine trees are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the wooded hills across the lake, while inside the suites the heated floors stay warm.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold on the private verandas today, but the clear air makes the hills around Windermere unusually sharp.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, rare here, the garden swing under the pine trees offers shade and a view of the lake.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over the lake, and the lit gardens around the ivy-clad facade are the brightest things visible.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the terrace the near shore of Windermere is clear but the far hills are not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Lake View Hot Tub suites are for sleep; at first light their windows show Windermere and wooded hills below.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Henrock, rain runs down the windows of the Lake View Hot Tub suites, and the garden lights blur.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Henrock, low cloud hangs over Windermere and shore lights show across the lake from the Lake View suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, every balcony faces the dark Atlantic, and the 24-hour fitness center already has a few early runners.
phrases.clear_morning: The sun comes up over the Atlantic right in front of the balconies, while the pool loungers are still empty.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity-edge pool sits in full sun above the beach, and most guests have moved under the white umbrellas.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the late afternoon sun, the sand below the ocean-facing balconies runs out to a calm Atlantic under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the 23rd-floor Orion's Roof windows show the lights along the coastline and a very dark ocean beyond.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Atlantic this morning, so the light on each balcony changes every few minutes, which is not a complaint.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the pergola deck this afternoon, you would see patches of sun moving across the water between the clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: Broken cloud over the ocean takes some colour from the setting sun behind the tower, best seen from a high balcony.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the whole sky over the beach today, and the Atlantic seen from the balconies is flat and calm.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the beach and the empty sun loungers, while the indoor pool with its water jets stays busy.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were there now, you would watch the lightning over the Atlantic from behind closed balcony doors, not from the deck.
phrases.fog_haze: If you stood on your ocean-facing balcony now, you would see fog hiding the Atlantic beyond the sand.
phrases.snow: Snow on the Virginia Beach sand is rare, but today it is there, seen from warm rooms through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, so the outdoor pool is for looking at, and the indoor pool is for swimming.
phrases.very_hot: From an ocean-facing balcony, heat-haze hangs over the wide sand between the infinity-edge pool and the Atlantic.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, so a few guests sit on the pergola deck with the dark Atlantic in front of them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the 23rd-floor Orion's Roof the beach is clear but the coastline further along is not.
phrases.late_night: Well past two, the white surf of the Atlantic is hard to stop watching through the floor-to-ceiling doors of an oceanfront room.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the balcony doors of the oceanfront rooms, and the surf shows white along the sand.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs low over the Atlantic after midnight, and from the oceanfront rooms the lights of Virginia Beach show along the shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the upper rooms look down on a dark Presqu'île, with the Saône and the Rhône still unlit on either side.
phrases.clear_morning: On the terrace, breakfast trays go out early, and the Saône bridges are easy to pick out from this height.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is high over Lyon, and from the hundred-square-metre apartment both rivers and the Part-Dieu tower are sharp.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the rooftops below the upper rooms, and the Saône shines between its bridges.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the terrace tonight, you would see the lit Part-Dieu tower and the lights on the Saône bridges.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over the Presqu'île this morning, and the gardens are a quiet place to watch them pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the gourmet restaurant this afternoon, patches of sun move across Lyon's rooftops between the clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun reaches the terrace between broken clouds, and the Saint-Jean Cathedral stands out below the hill.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Lyon today, but from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the guest rooms the domed landmarks are still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the terrace furniture, so guests watch the Saône from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, guests stay inside, and from the upper rooms lightning can be seen over the Rhône and the Presqu'île.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the city today, so the river is faint from the terrace and Mont Blanc is not visible at all.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the landscaped gardens and the terrace chairs, while Lyon's rooftops below the hill turn white.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, and on a clear winter day like this Mont Blanc can appear on the eastern horizon.
phrases.very_hot: Fourvière Hill is very hot today, so the indoor pool under the stone arches has more guests than the sunny terrace.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild under cloud, and guests sit late on the terrace above the lights of the Presqu'île.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor today, so from the upper rooms the Saône is clear but the Part-Dieu tower and Mont Blanc are not.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water on the nightstand, and the upper rooms' tall windows show bridge lights along the Saône.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the upper rooms after midnight, and the Presqu'île lights blur between the Saône and the Rhône.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Lyon after midnight, and from the top apartment the lights along both rivers come and go in the haze.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lake outside the lakefront rooms is dark and still, and the Jet d'Eau has not started yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the lakefront rooms wake to a clear sky over Lake Geneva, with the Jet d'Eau already visible from the window.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is on the lake, and from the balcony of the Mont-Blanc Suite the fountain stands in the light.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the wrought-iron balconies, and the Jet d'Eau catches the low light while the lake turns a deeper blue.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the Grace Kelly Suite balcony tonight, you would see the lit fountain and the skyline across the lake.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Lake Geneva this morning, and the two pale blue chairs by the window face a fountain in changing light.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony bistro table, the Jet d'Eau is bright one minute and grey the next, as clouds cross the afternoon sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud sits over the city skyline while the lake below the balconies is partly lit.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Geneva today, and the Jet d'Eau is still easy to see from the lakefront rooms, white against grey.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lake Geneva, so the balcony tables are empty and guests watch the fountain through closed windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the Jet d'Eau is usually switched off, so the view from the suites is lightning over the lake instead.
phrases.fog_haze: The brass telescope in the suite is not much use today, because fog over the lake covers the Jet d'Eau.
phrases.snow: Snow falls over the lake and settles on the wrought-iron railings, and the Jet d'Eau is likely off in this weather.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air on Quai du Mont-Blanc keeps the balcony doors closed, so the clear lake view today comes through glass.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day the wrought-iron railing is hot to touch, and the lake below looks like the better place.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, guests can sit at the balcony bistro table with the lit Jet d'Eau straight ahead.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor over the lake: the Jet d'Eau is clear from the lakefront rooms, but the skyline behind it is not.
phrases.late_night: The lakefront rooms are for sleeping now; city lights show on the lake, and the Jet d'Eau fills the window at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain blurs the Mont-Blanc Suite windows tonight, and the far shore's lights show on Lake Geneva near the Jet d'Eau.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers Lake Geneva this evening, and from the Mont-Blanc Suite the shore lights reflect in the water near the Jet d'Eau.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Strip's neon signs are still switched on below the 23rd floor windows of the Tea Lounge.
phrases.clear_morning: From the One-Bedroom King Suite with Panoramic View, the Eiffel Tower replica stands in plain daylight, with no neon needed yet.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun fills the Hotel Bar on the 23rd floor, and the Strip below looks bright and quiet through the tall glass.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the Strip golden below the suite living room windows, before the neon takes over.
phrases.clear_night: On the outdoor terrace tonight, guests look down at the lit Eiffel Tower replica and the neon signs under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Strip this morning, and the Tea Lounge windows show Planet Hollywood in changing light.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in the Hotel Bar this afternoon, you would see cloud shadows moving slowly across the Strip below.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds pink and red over the Strip, framed by the guest room windows.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the Strip today, so the golden globe lighting in the Tea Lounge provides most of the colour.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Las Vegas, and today the wet Strip reflects the neon signs below the 23rd floor windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the southern Strip is best watched from the Hotel Bar, behind floor-to-ceiling glass, with a drink.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the view today, and the Eiffel Tower replica appears as a grey outline from the guest room windows.
phrases.snow: Snow in Las Vegas is unusual, and the soaking tub in the marble bathroom faces white flakes falling past the lit Strip.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside, so the outdoor terrace is empty and guests watch the Strip from inside the Hotel Bar.
phrases.very_hot: Under a very hot desert sun, the Strip below the 23rd floor windows looks pale, with few people walking it.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, but the Strip's neon signs are bright enough from the outdoor terrace on a warm night.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, and from the Tea Lounge the far end of the Strip is simply not visible.
phrases.late_night: Were you in the Panoramic View suite tonight, you might leave the curtain open and fall asleep facing the Strip's lights.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were at the Hotel Bar on the twenty-third floor now, rain on the glass would blur the Strip's neon below.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were up in the Hotel Bar for a last drink, you would see the Strip's lights under low cloud tonight.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the oceanfront balconies look out on a dark Atlantic, and Bar Moxy is still open downstairs.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were in an oceanfront room this morning, you would see the sun over the Atlantic from your balcony.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the saltwater pool deck faces a bright Atlantic, and the fishing pier shows from the balconies.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The lounge windows frame the rooftop pool and the ocean horizon as the afternoon sun turns golden.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the balconies face a dark ocean under stars, and Bar Moxy stays open for anyone still awake.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit over the beach this morning, seen from the floor-to-ceiling window of a high bunk bed room.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the saltwater pool deck this afternoon, clouds pass over the Atlantic without blocking the sun for long.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the lounge windows show the rooftop pool and clouds above the ocean horizon.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Virginia Beach today, and the oceanfront rooms look onto a flat, grey Atlantic.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the pool deck and the boardwalk, so guests are mostly inside at Bar Moxy or the diner.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Atlantic right now, so the saltwater pool deck is empty and guests watch the lightning from oceanfront windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the fishing pier and most of the beach, and from the oceanfront balconies only white is visible today.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the saltwater pool deck and the beach, a rare sight from the oceanfront windows in Virginia Beach.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing outside, the saltwater pool deck is empty and the beach below the balconies is empty too.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the saltwater pool deck is the busiest part of the hotel, facing straight onto the Atlantic.
phrases.mild_night: On this warm, cloudy night, Bar Moxy is open and the ocean beyond the balconies is simply dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The ocean horizon is missing today from the oceanfront balconies, and the beach and the nearest water are all that show.
phrases.late_night: After midnight an oceanfront room goes dark, and the only light left in it comes from the boardwalk along the sand.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the oceanfront windows tonight, and the boardwalk lights blur through the wet glass before the curtains close.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtains open after midnight, the oceanfront rooms look onto a cloudy Atlantic and the boardwalk lights along the sand.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Loop skyscrapers stand as dark shapes against a clear sky outside the Spa King Guestroom windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Early guests on the fitness center treadmills face downtown skyscrapers lit by low morning sun under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the distant Ferris wheel is easy to pick out from the king guest rooms, with no cloud over Chicago.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: This afternoon the retractable ceiling over The Roof is open, and the Loop towers turn orange in the low sun.
phrases.clear_night: Guests on The Roof after midnight look out at the lit downtown towers under a clear night sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Patches of cloud move over the Loop this morning, so some skyscrapers outside the room windows are sunlit and others shaded.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on The Roof this afternoon, you would see sun and shadow move across the skyline between clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the Loop skyscrapers catch orange light under broken cloud outside the corner suite windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the downtown skyscrapers outside the fitness center windows look sharp but without any colour.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Chicago today, so the retractable ceiling over The Roof is closed and the skyline stays visible behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, lightning over the Loop can be watched from the Spa King Guestroom, behind closed floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the upper floors of the downtown towers today, and the distant Ferris wheel is not visible from the rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow falls past the floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Loop skyscrapers appear in grey and white from the king guest rooms.
phrases.very_cold: The air over Chicago is very cold today, and the Loop skyscrapers look unusually sharp from the 27th-floor Roof.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, guests on The Roof sit under an open ceiling with the full Loop skyline in strong sun.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Chicago, and the corner suite windows show illuminated downtown skyscrapers with no stars above them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the distant Ferris wheel cannot be seen from the king guest rooms, only the nearer Loop towers.
phrases.late_night: Awake for a glass of water after midnight, you would see the Loop towers lit beyond the corner room's full-height windows.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were up at The Roof for a last drink tonight, you would see the Loop towers through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were up on The Roof for a last drink now, you would see the Loop's lit towers under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Chao Phraya is already busy, and from a balcony room you can watch the earliest long-tail boats go by.
phrases.clear_morning: A clear morning over Bang Rak, and breakfast guests at NEXT2 Café have the river and its boats in full view.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests at NEXT2 Café this midday watch long-tail boats pass on the Chao Phraya under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the river, and from the marble soaking tub the Bangkok skyline is clear and sharp.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at The Long Bar tonight, you would see long-tail boats passing on the Chao Phraya under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Some cloud over Bangkok this morning, and the balcony rooms look out on green treetops and a river already full of boats.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Chao Phraya this afternoon, and guests at the pool get sun between the clouds.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds above the skyline, seen from the riverside restaurant as boats pass close by.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey midday sky, long-tail boats pass the hotel jetty on the brown Chao Phraya below the balcony rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the river, and from inside a suite the floor-to-ceiling windows show boats moving through it.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Bangkok, and the safest seat for watching lightning above the skyline is behind the suite windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over the Chao Phraya today, so the skyline is faint, though the boats nearest the jetty are still clear.
phrases.snow: Snow over Bangkok would be a first, but if it fell, the balcony rooms would still face the Chao Phraya.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air is rare in Bangkok, and today guests watch the river from the balcony rooms rather than the pool.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot across Bang Rak today, and both hotel pools are the practical places to watch boats on the river.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night on the river, and The Long Bar has its full view of the boats passing close.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far skyline cannot be seen from the balconies, but the Chao Phraya and its boats can.
phrases.late_night: Around two the suite is unlit, and the only light left comes from the city reflected on the Chao Phraya.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at NEXT2 Café, the suite's tall windows show rain over the Chao Phraya and blurred lights across the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at NEXT2 Café is over, and the suite windows show the city lights on the Chao Phraya under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the first balloon burners can already be heard from the rooftop terrace, and the sky over Göreme is clear.
phrases.clear_morning: Dozens of balloons are crossing the Göreme valley, visible from the breakfast terraces and from bed through the arched windows.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the balloons are gone, and Uçhisar Castle stands in full sun just past the far edge of the infinity pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Low afternoon sun lights the terraced houses on the castle slopes, seen from the front terrace about five hundred metres away.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the castle as a dark shape against a starry sky from the front terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: From the rooftop terrace this morning, balloons cross the Göreme valley under a sky that is part blue, part cloud.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests in the infinity pool are watching cloud shadows move across Uçhisar Castle and the village houses below it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the clouds behind the castle orange, and the front terrace faces it directly.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the castle rock looks flat and pale from the breakfast terraces, but it is still clearly visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the valley, so no balloons today; the fireplace in the stone dining room is lit instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Göreme is best watched from inside, through the tall windows of a suite sitting area, not from the rooftop.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has settled in the valley, and from the infinity pool the castle five hundred metres away is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the fairy chimneys outside the stone arch of the indoor cave pool, seen from the water.
phrases.very_cold: A freezing clear day in Uçhisar; the private heated pools of some suites are the warmest place to watch the castle.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot over the valley today, so most guests are inside the cave pool, looking at the fairy chimneys through the arch.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and a few guests are still out on the front terrace facing the dark shape of the castle.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the castle, five hundred metres off, can be seen from the pool, but the valley beyond Göreme cannot.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the cave suites' arched windows show a few village lights on the Uçhisar slope, hours before the balloons.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the arched suite windows, and the lights of Uçhisar's terraced houses blur below the castle.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud moves over Uçhisar after midnight, and the village lights below the castle rock show through the arched suite windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies face a dark Pacific, and the beach stretching north is still empty of walkers.
phrases.clear_morning: From an ocean-facing room, guests can see the full beach to the north under a clear blue sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is on the wide sand, and Haystack Rock stands out clearly from the hotel's beach side.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light reaches the balcony chairs, and the surf below looks calm from the beach-facing suites.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see campfires on the sand from the balcony and stars over the ocean.
phrases.partly_morning: Broken cloud sits over the Pacific this morning, and the beach north of the hotel is easy to see from the balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud moves over the ocean this afternoon, with sun on the sand between the shadows seen from the rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds pink above Haystack Rock, a scene visible from the hotel's seaward side.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky covers the whole beach today, so the fireplaces in the suites are probably more used than the balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the sand and the surf, and guests watch it through the sliding glass doors of their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Pacific puts lightning in the ocean view, best watched from inside with the balcony door shut.
phrases.fog_haze: From the beach-facing balconies, daytime fog covers the surf and Haystack Rock, leaving only the near sand in view.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare here, but today it falls on the sand outside while the indoor saltwater pool stays warm.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air sits over the beach today, and the balcony chairs outside the rooms are likely to stay empty.
phrases.very_hot: Unusually hot for the Oregon coast today, and the sand in front of the hotel has more people on it than usual.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the balcony is comfortable enough to sit out and listen to the surf below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so Haystack Rock is not clear from the hotel, though the surf nearest the sand can still be seen.
phrases.late_night: If you were awake late in an ocean-facing room, the surf would show pale against the sand.

phrases.grey_evening: Over a last drink in an ocean-facing room tonight, you would see campfires glowing on the sand under cloud.

phrases.clear_midday: If you stood on the terraced garden now, you would see Monte San Salvatore sharp across Lake Lugano under the clear midday sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the ivy-clad terracotta façade, and the lake below Collina d'Oro takes a golden colour before sunset.

phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds above Monte San Salvatore turn pink, seen best from the terraced garden.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Lugano today, so the lake looks flat and grey, though the mountains are still visible from the pool.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the terraced garden and the pool, and guests watch it through the terrace doors of their suites.

phrases.fog_haze: Fog on the lake today hides the water, and from Collina d'Oro only the nearest hillside is visible.

phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night on Collina d'Oro, with the suite terrace doors open and live music coming from the piano bar.

phrases.late_night: Dinner at Principe Leopoldo is over; the Panorama suites show town lights on Lake Lugano.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at the Principe Leopoldo restaurant is over, and rain on the Panorama suite windows blurs the shore lights around Lake Lugano.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at the Principe Leopoldo restaurant is over, and the lights of Lugano reflect in the lake under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the city lights are still on across the Yarra, and the apartment windows face a dark river.
