phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun hits Eureka Tower, and the private terraces are the place to watch the skyline change colour.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Penthouse shows what it is sold for: a clear sky, the whole lit skyline and the Yarra River below.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Melbourne skyline this morning, with the river and Flinders Street Station clear from the apartment windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the CBD this afternoon, easy to follow from the floor-to-ceiling windows of a high-floor apartment.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds sit over Crown Tower, and the city lights come on below the balcony.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the skyline looks flat today, but the river and Flinders Street Station are still clear from the apartments.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Yarra; the indoor heated pool is under a roof, and the apartment windows show a wet city.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over Melbourne: from the floor-to-ceiling windows, lightning over the CBD is the main event, and the private terraces are empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Yarra and much of the skyline today, so the high-floor windows show mostly grey with a few tower tops.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Melbourne, but if it fell today, you would see it from a heated apartment window over the Yarra.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air over Southbank today; the private terraces are empty, and guests watch the skyline from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.

phrases.mild_night: Clouds sit over Melbourne tonight, the air is mild, and the balcony table faces the lit city grid.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Port Phillip Bay is missing from the apartment windows today, with visibility short, though Eureka Tower and the Yarra stay clear.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight in a high-floor bedroom comes with the skyline lights across the Yarra River.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain on the Penthouse windows blurs the skyline lights, and the Yarra looks wet and bright below.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner done, the Penthouse's floor-to-ceiling windows show the Yarra River under low cloud, the city lights spread along the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Andaman horizon is a flat dark line from the villa pools, and the Sky Bar is still closed.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Sky Bar at the resort's peak, the low sun lights Kamala Bay and the clear Andaman horizon.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the sea is clear, so guests in the private pools can see stars above the horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit over Kamala Bay this morning, but the open doors of the villas still show blue sea beyond the lawn.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the sea this afternoon, seen from the stone soaking tub behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_golden: Some clouds catch orange light over the sea, and the Infinity Restaurant terrace has its tables set for dinner.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the whole 180-degree view from the upper villas today, and the sea looks grey too.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the jungle slope below the villas, and the beach shuttle to Kamala has few takers right now.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Andaman is visible from the villa windows, and the Sky Bar at the peak has closed for now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Kamala Bay today, so the horizon line from the private pools is soft rather than sharp.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Phuket, but if it fell today, the view from the spa pavilion would be very unusual.

phrases.mild_night: The night is warm and cloudy, so the Sky Bar has no stars tonight, only the dark sea below.

phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight in an Ocean Grand Pool Villa, and the moon is on Kamala Bay below.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtains are open after midnight, and through rain on the villa windows a few lights show along Kamala Bay below.
phrases.grey_evening: Before bed, the Ocean Grand Pool Villa windows frame Kamala Beach lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Strip lights are still on, and from a Deluxe Strip View room the boulevard looks almost empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From the king rooms, the Strat Tower and the Venetian stand sharp under a clear desert sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: The seven pools are busy at midday, and AYU Dayclub has full sun with no shade from any cloud.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the Encore and Palazzo towers, seen through the curved windows of the corner suites.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, guests in the velvet chairs by the windows see the lit Palazzo and Venetian towers clearly.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Las Vegas this morning, and the boulevard below the Deluxe Strip View rooms is quiet.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the seven pools this afternoon, giving swimmers at AYU Dayclub short breaks from the sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky behind the Strat Tower, seen from the king rooms.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Strip looks flat and plain from the corner suites, but the Venetian is still easy to spot.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare here, and today guests watch the wet boulevard from the floor-to-ceiling windows instead of using the seven pools.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Strip is visible through the curved windows of the corner suites while nobody sits at the rooftop terrace tables.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the Strip today, and from the king rooms the Strat Tower is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow on the Strip is a rare event, and guests in the Deluxe Strip View rooms are photographing it through the glass.
phrases.very_cold: On this freezing day, the seven pools stand empty and most guests watch the Strip from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.

phrases.mild_night: It is a mild cloudy night, good for the rooftop terrace cocktail tables, while ZOUK Nightclub fills up inside.

phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the Deluxe Strip View window shows Las Vegas Boulevard lit from end to end.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Deluxe Strip View rooms, and the boulevard lights blur through the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the Strip tonight, and the Deluxe Strip View rooms face the boulevard lights spread out under it.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky over the Atlantic is grey and pale from the high-floor balconies, and sunrise is still some minutes away.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests in the king bedrooms can open the balcony doors to a clear blue sky and a calm sea.
phrases.clear_midday: From a high-floor balcony, the wide sandy beach and the dune grass are in full sun right now.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches the outdoor pool, and swimmers there can see the beach below without leaving the water.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars over the Atlantic from the fire pit on the patio.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the water this morning, and the balconies on the upper floors have the widest view.

phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Atlantic looks flat and grey too, but the ocean-view balconies still face the whole beach.

phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the balconies are empty and guests watch lightning over the ocean from behind the balcony doors.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the Grand Strand hides the Atlantic today, and from the 24th floor only the nearest dunes are clear.
phrases.snow: A thin white layer covers the sand in front of the tower today, which almost never happens in Myrtle Beach.
phrases.very_cold: On a day close to freezing, the outdoor pool is quiet and the fire pit on the patio gets the most use.
phrases.very_hot: It is a very hot afternoon on the beach, and guests move between the outdoor pool and the shade of their balconies.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the Adirondack chairs around the fire pit face a dark beach and no stars at all.

phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the glass of the oceanfront suites after midnight, and the Boardwalk lights blur along the wet beach.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open after midnight in the king bedroom, the Boardwalk lights show where the beach meets the Atlantic under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Royal Palace facade across Dam Square is still dark, seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows of upper rooms.

phrases.very_cold: Under a clear, freezing sky, the Royal Palace facade is sharp from the windows, and the Anantara Spa saunas are busy.

phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night like this, the illuminated Royal Palace facade is the main view from the Dam Square rooms.

phrases.very_hot: A very hot day in Buenos Aires, and guests in the suite watch the skyline from behind floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night over Montserrat, the lights of the financial district towers are visible from the high-floor rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the Duomo's spires are already a dark outline from the Bamboo Bar terrace, under a clear sky.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the outline of Mount Agung is already visible from the villa pools, with the rice paddies still dark below.
phrases.clear_morning: From the open-air Sleeping Gajah Kitchen, breakfast comes with a full, cloud-free view of Mount Agung this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the villa decks, and the rice terraces below look very green under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last hours of sun, the slopes of Mount Agung turn warm in colour, seen from the infinity pools.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars above the ridge and the dark shape of Mount Agung from your villa.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit around the top of Mount Agung this morning, while the paddies below the villas are in sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the Sidemen hillside this afternoon, so Mount Agung appears and disappears from the restaurant tables.
phrases.partly_golden: At the last hour of sun, broken cloud over Mount Agung catches orange light above the rice terraces.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Sidemen today and hides Mount Agung, though the rice terraces beside the villas stay easy to see.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rice paddies, and guests in the open-air Sleeping Gajah Kitchen eat under its roof.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Sidemen valley, and lightning sometimes shows the ridge where Mount Agung normally stands.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the valley makes Mount Agung faint today, but the rice terraces nearest the villas remain visible.
phrases.snow: Snow does not happen in Sidemen, so if snow were reported, the rice terraces below the villas would still be green.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air is unusual on this hillside, yet Mount Agung stands sharp and clear above the terraces from the pool deck.
phrases.very_hot: The heat is heavy today, so the villa infinity pools are busy, with Mount Agung clear beyond the rice fields.
phrases.mild_night: A warm, cloudy night in Sidemen hides Mount Agung, while lamps in the open-air Sleeping Gajah Kitchen light the tables.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Today the poor visibility hides Mount Agung from the villa pool deck, leaving only the close rice terraces and palms.
phrases.late_night: A villa curtain left open tonight keeps Mount Agung's outline in view from the bed after midnight.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls on the villa infinity pools in the small hours, and low cloud keeps Mount Agung out of view until morning.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the ridge below Mount Agung tonight, and the villa pools show the only light left in the view.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the caldera below the terraces is still dark, and Nea Kameni is only a flat shape in the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From the infinity pool this morning, the view runs north to Oia with nothing in the way.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the caldera is its deepest blue, and the sun loungers beside the plunge pools are fully in the sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests at the 363 Bar are watching the sun go down over the caldera, with cocktails in hand.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the caldera is clear, and from a terrace the water below Imerovigli is black and quiet.
phrases.partly_morning: From the fitness room's open white doors, a few morning clouds hang above the caldera and Nea Kameni island.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the caldera this afternoon, and any sailboat below the plunge pool terraces goes in and out of them.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the whitewashed terrace now, you would see the clouds over the caldera turning orange above Nea Kameni.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the caldera from the 363 metre position looks flat and silver, and the loungers are mostly empty.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Imerovigli, so the rattan chairs on the terraces are wet and the caldera is partly hidden.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the caldera, and from the bedroom with the blue pillows you can watch lightning above the water.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the caldera today means Oia to the north is only a pale line from the infinity pool.
phrases.snow: Snow rarely reaches Santorini, but today flakes land on the whitewashed terraces and melt in the plunge pools.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold for Santorini, the caldera is clear from the terraces, but nobody is in the plunge pools.
phrases.very_hot: With the air this hot, guests are in the infinity pool rather than on the loungers, facing north toward Oia.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild under cloud, so the 363 Bar terrace is comfortable even if the caldera below is just dark water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the infinity pool Oia to the north cannot be seen, only the near caldera cliffs.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, after a glass of water, the lights of Oia shine across the caldera from the cave suites.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the terrace doors of the caldera rooms after midnight, and the lights of Oia blur across the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud hangs over the caldera after midnight, and from the cave-style suites the lights of Oia show faintly to the north.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Reunion Tower still shows its lights against a dark clear sky, seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.clear_morning: Under a clear morning sky, the downtown skyline is sharp from every room, and Chef's Palette is serving breakfast.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the rooftop infinity pool gets full sun and Reunion Tower stands out sharply downtown.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see the low sun lighting the downtown skyline and Reunion Tower.
phrases.clear_night: The rooftop infinity pool glows green tonight, and Bank of America Plaza is lit up behind it under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the Dallas skyline this morning, visible from the floor-to-ceiling windows of all 76 rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the sun comes and goes between clouds, so the rooftop pool has shade one minute and full sun the next.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, pink and blue colours fill the gaps between clouds above the Gallery Rooftop Lounge terrace.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey cloud layer sits over downtown today, but Reunion Tower remains clearly visible from the rooftop lounge.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop terrace, so guests watch the wet skyline from behind the folding glass doors of the lounge.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, the floor-to-ceiling windows give a dry seat for watching lightning flash behind Reunion Tower and the skyline.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the skyline today; Reunion Tower is a faint shape from the rooftop pool rather than a sharp one.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Dallas, but today flakes fall on the rooftop terrace while the fire pit area stays lit.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day the rooftop pool is not a tempting idea, but the skyline view from the rooms is sharp.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over Dallas today means the rooftop infinity pool is the busiest spot, with Reunion Tower in plain view.
phrases.mild_night: Guests sit tonight in the wicker seating by the lit rooftop bar, city lights ahead under a mild cloudy sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so the distant cable-stayed bridge is hard to see from the rooftop, though Reunion Tower still shows.
phrases.late_night: If you switched off every light in a suite, only the skyline would glow through the window, Reunion Tower's round top included.
phrases.wet_evening: Were you having a last drink in the Gallery Rooftop Lounge tonight, you would see Reunion Tower's ball through the wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Were you up at the Gallery Rooftop Lounge now, Reunion Tower's round top would show under low cloud over lit downtown.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the mountains are only a dark shape from the balconies, and the Atlantic below has no colour yet.
phrases.clear_morning: From the floor-to-ceiling windows of a king room, Recreio beach and the deep green Atlantic are fully lit by morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the cream umbrellas around the rooftop pool are all in use, and the Cagarras Islands stand out clearly.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last hours of sun, guests on the rooftop loungers watch the light turn warm over Barra da Tijuca Beach.
phrases.clear_night: A clear night over Rio: from the rooftop pool, city lights on one side, dark Atlantic on the other.
phrases.partly_morning: Broken clouds this morning put moving patches of shade on Barra da Tijuca Beach, seen from the rooftop sun loungers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the mountains this afternoon, so the view from the mountain-facing balconies changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on a balcony now, you would see the last sun colouring the clouds above the mountains.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Atlantic outside the king room windows looks grey too, and the Cagarras Islands are a flat outline.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop pool, so the sun loungers are empty and the beach below is almost without people.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm nobody is at the rooftop pool, and guests watch the lightning over the Atlantic from their room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze today softens the mountains seen from the balconies, and the Cagarras Islands are hard to find on the water.
phrases.snow: Snow in Rio would be a rarity, but if it fell, the rooftop pool loungers would be the place to see it.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold weather is rare in Barra, and the king room windows show the Atlantic without anyone needing to step outside.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the rooftop pool is where most guests are, with the cream umbrellas giving the only shade.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the rooftop pool stays in use late, with the lights of Barra visible along the beach.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Cagarras Islands cannot be seen from the rooftop pool and the mountains are only faint.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the king rooms have left the curtain open on purpose and fall asleep facing the Atlantic and the beachfront lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the king rooms sees rain on the Atlantic, and the beachfront lamps of Barra shine along the wet sand.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a king room tonight can watch the lights of Barra da Tijuca spread along the beach under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky over the Gulf of Aqaba is clear, and Tiran Island is already a dark shape from the balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast tables on the private balconies look straight at Tiran Island this morning, under a sky with no cloud at all.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the striped awnings on the balconies are useful, because the sun over the Red Sea is strong right now.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: On the lawn facing the sea, guests holding a yoga pose see the low sun lighting Tiran Island in front of them.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on an upper-floor balcony tonight, you would see a clear night sky over the gulf, full of stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the Gulf of Aqaba this morning, but Tiran Island is still clear from the funicular ride down.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the water this afternoon, giving the wicker seats at the beachfront bar extra shade beyond the sails.
phrases.partly_golden: Late sun colours the broken cloud over the sea, and guests at Zitouni's outdoor tables watch it over dinner.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky covers the gulf today, so the Red Sea looks grey too from the balconies, with Tiran Island still visible.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare here, and today it falls on the wooden pier and the sand around the beachfront bar.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests watch lightning over the gulf from inside the villa living rooms, with the pool doors shut.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water today makes Tiran Island faint from the terraces, though the beach below is still clear.
phrases.snow: Snow in Sharm El-Sheikh almost never happens, so guests on the ten terraces facing the gulf have something unusual to watch.
phrases.very_cold: A cold day like this is rare on the gulf, so guests keep the balcony doors shut and watch the blue sea.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the clifftop today, and the spa's two outdoor cabanas facing the Red Sea are the shaded option.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night with cloud over the gulf, the Moorish lanterns on the dining terrace do most of the lighting.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so Tiran Island is not visible from the balconies, and only the near water shows clearly.
phrases.late_night: Whoever is up late in an upper-floor room watches the gulf water toward Tiran Island.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests on the upper floors are probably asleep by now, the Gulf of Aqaba wide and pale beyond their balcony doors.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has an upper room tonight looks out on the Gulf of Aqaba under cloud, Tiran Island a low shape on the horizon.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sixth-floor gym is already open, and the CBD towers show as dark shapes against a paling sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooms on the 36th to 39th floors, Port Phillip Bay is clearly visible this morning, with Williamstown beyond it.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the Yarra River, and Strato's seven-metre windows show the whole sweep without a cloud.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Docklands towers, seen from the curved windows of the upper guest rooms.
phrases.clear_night: The floor-to-ceiling window of a 38th-floor room shows the lit CBD skyline tonight, with the Yarra River dark below it.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the city skyline this morning, visible from the gym windows on the sixth floor.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sunshine alternate over Port Phillip Bay this afternoon, and the water changes colour as seen from the 40th floor.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the broken clouds over the Yarra River, a good moment for a drink at Strato.
phrases.overcast: From the rooms on the 39th floor, the city towers stand under a low grey sky above the Yarra River.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the seven-metre windows at Strato, and the Yarra River below is visible but hazy.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Port Phillip Bay can be seen from the high-floor apartments, with the thunder arriving a few seconds later.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the lower city today, and from the 40th floor only the tallest CBD towers stand above it.
phrases.snow: Melbourne almost never sees snow, yet today some wet flakes are blowing past the seven-metre windows of Strato on the 40th floor.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, clear day, Williamstown is easy to pick out across Port Phillip Bay from the upper rooms.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day over Melbourne, and from the 39th-floor rooms Port Phillip Bay looks pale under the strong sun.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the lights of Southbank and the CBD show through the floor-to-ceiling room windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so Williamstown and Port Phillip Bay are not visible from Strato, only the nearer CBD towers.
phrases.late_night: In a thirty-eighth-floor room the curtain stays open for sleep, the CBD lights reflected in the Yarra River.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at Strato is done, and the city lights along the Yarra River shine soft through rain on a 38th-floor window.
phrases.grey_evening: After a late dinner at Strato, the CBD lights show under low cloud through a 38th-floor window, and the Yarra reflects them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Amstel is dark and still under a clear sky, seen from the prestige suite balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: From a window table at Bord'Eau, morning sun falls straight on the Amstel and the water looks bright.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is high over the canal ring, and Hèt Terras is open to the waterside with no cloud.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Golden hour light comes low along the Amstel, and from a prestige suite balcony the Munttoren at the bend is lit.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see a calm black Amstel from a riverside-facing room, the Munttoren at the bend.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds and sun alternate over the canal houses this morning, seen from a balcony with potted flowers on it.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the sun comes and goes over the Amstel, and the window tables at Bord'Eau get light in short periods.
phrases.partly_golden: Just before sunset, broken cloud sits over the red-roofed buildings that the beamed suites look out on.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky the Amstel looks grey too, but the Munttoren at the bend is still clear from riverside-facing rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Amstel, so Hèt Terras stays closed and guests eat indoors at the Bord'Eau window tables.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is passing over Amsterdam, and flashes show through the windows of the indoor pool under its curved ceiling.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the far side of the Amstel today, and from the balconies the Munttoren is only a grey shape, if that.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the red roofs seen from the suite with wooden beams, while the Amstel below stays dark and unfrozen.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air hangs over the Amstel under a bright sky, and nobody stays long on the prestige suite balconies.
phrases.very_hot: The sun on Hèt Terras is very hot, and more guests choose a window table inside Bord'Eau than a terrace seat.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy over the Amstel, and the prestige suite balconies are comfortable enough to sit on after dinner.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is poor today: the far red roofs are a blur from the suites, though the Amstel directly below stays clear.
phrases.late_night: Guests back from dinner at Bord'Eau are likely asleep in the prestige suites, city lights on the Amstel below.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the riverside-facing rooms tonight can watch rain fall on the Amstel, the Munttoren at the bend.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the prestige suites after midnight sees the canal-house lights reflected in the Amstel under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the docks sit in shadow and the skyline towers show as dark shapes from the balconies.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the private balconies early, and the yellow cranes on the docks stand out clearly against a blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop pool of the Ciel Spa is in full sun, and guests swim with the skyline in view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls across the balconies, and the water in the docks reflects a low, warm sun before it sets.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the lit towers of the skyline are visible through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suite lounge.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Puerto Madero this morning, so the sun comes and goes on the docks below the balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Passing clouds this afternoon put the yellow cranes on the docks in and out of sun, as seen from the room balconies.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the Buenos Aires skyline take on colour, seen from every balcony.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky covers the whole skyline today, and the docks look flat and quiet from the suite lounge windows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the docks and the furnished balconies, so the windows are the better place to watch Puerto Madero.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Buenos Aires right now, with lightning visible from the rooms and the balconies empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Puerto Madero today, and the far towers of the skyline are only pale outlines from the balconies.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Buenos Aires, but if a few flakes fell today, guests would watch them from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.very_cold: If you stood at a balcony window now, you would see hard winter light on the docks and the yellow cranes.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon in Puerto Madero, and the rooftop pool at the Ciel Spa is where most guests are right now.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over the city, and guests are sitting out on their balconies above the lit boulevard.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far end of the skyline is missing from the balcony view, though the docks remain clear.
phrases.late_night: Were you up late, you could watch the Puerto Madero dock lights for a while.
phrases.wet_evening: Were you finishing a last drink in your room now, you would see Puerto Madero's dock lights through rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in your room now, you would see the skyline lights across the docks under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Palace-View Executive Suites look down on the roofs of Gyeongbokgung while the sky over Seoul slowly turns pale.
phrases.clear_morning: A clear morning in Seoul: from a high-floor suite, every roof line of the six-hundred-year-old palace is easy to count.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is straight over Gyeongbokgung, and the high-floor lounge shows Bugaksan mountain clearly behind the city.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun hits the palace roofs below the suites, and the skyline seen from the soaking tub turns warm orange.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the palace is lit up below the lounge windows, and swimmers in the indoor pool see city lights through the glass.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered morning clouds move over Bugaksan, so the palace below the Executive Suites is in sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows cross the city high-rises outside the LEGO play room this afternoon, which the children inside mostly ignore.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in a Palace-View suite for the last hour of sun, broken clouds would colour the palace roofs in patches.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Gyeongbokgung looks flat and quiet from the suites, and Bugaksan is a dull outline from the lounge.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the palace roofs below the suite windows, and the choice indoors is between Cantonese, Japanese, Korean and Italian.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Seoul skyline is visible from the soaking tub, which is probably the most comfortable seat for a storm.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Seoul today, so the palace below the suites is a soft shape and Bugaksan is hard to make out.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the palace roofs below the Executive Suites, while the indoor pool stays warm behind its glass.
phrases.very_cold: It is below freezing outside today, yet the clear air gives the suites a sharp view of the palace.
phrases.very_hot: Seoul is very hot today, and from the high-floor lounge the palace roofs sit in strong, direct sunlight.
phrases.mild_night: A warm, cloudy night in Seoul, and the lit palace below the lounge windows is the clearest thing in the dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Seoul today: the palace below the suites is still clear, but Bugaksan behind the city is not.
phrases.late_night: Whoever wakes for water in a Palace-View Executive Suite near midnight sees Gyeongbokgung's roofs in the window, city lights behind them.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a Palace-View Executive Suite tonight watches rain slide down the window, Gyeongbokgung's roofs wet among the city lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has a Palace-View Executive Suite after midnight can watch the city lights under low cloud around the palace roofs.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Palisades are only a dark edge above the private patios, and nobody is in the mineral pools yet.
phrases.clear_morning: From a studio patio, Mount Saint Helena shows clearly against a blue sky while the first guests walk to the mud bar.
phrases.clear_midday: Under full sun on the pool complex, the white umbrellas are open and the Palisades ridgeline looks sharp and clear.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the forested Palisades hills orange, seen from the lounge chairs beside the adults-only pool.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a mineral soak tonight, you would see stars above the dark shape of Mount Saint Helena.
phrases.partly_morning: From the private patios, morning light shows the Palisades under a few scattered clouds above the north-valley ridgeline.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the pickleball courts this afternoon, so players get shade for a few minutes at a time.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds above the Palisades turn pink and the two tall palms are reflected in the pool.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the whole valley today, but the Palisades are still visible from every private patio.
phrases.rain: Wet weather over Calistoga today, so the sun loungers by the pool are empty and the Palisades look grey through the rain.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over Mount Saint Helena means the pickleball courts are empty and guests watch the lightning from behind their sliding glass doors.
phrases.fog_haze: Guests at the Picobar lounge today see the tall palms by the pool while fog hides the Palisades behind them.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Calistoga, but today a few flakes fall on the pool complex and steam rises from the mineral water.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the geothermal mineral pools are the busiest place at Solage, with the Palisades in full view.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the valley, and the shade under the white umbrellas by the family pool is where people stay.
phrases.mild_night: Mild and cloudy tonight, guests are still sitting outside at the Picobar lounge, the ridgeline a dark line beyond them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Mount Saint Helena is not clear from the patios; the palms and oak trees nearby are.
phrases.late_night: Studio guests awake after midnight watch the garden through the glass, in no hurry to sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the suites tonight sees rain on the patio doors and the pool lights blurred behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the studios after midnight sees no stars over the valley, just the pool lights through the glass doors.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Bay of Palma is still dark from the upper sea-facing rooms, and the cathedral spires are just visible.
phrases.clear_morning: Early sun on the Almaq rooftop: the sea is bright blue, and the first guests take the white loungers.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the rooftop Almaq looks across the old city walls to the flat blue Bay of Palma.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the Almaq terrace now, you would see the cathedral quarter turn orange while the sea stays blue.
phrases.clear_night: From a sea-facing balcony tonight, the Bay of Palma is a dark flat surface under a clear sky full of stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the city walls this morning, and the rooftop bar at Almaq is getting its first coffee orders.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Broken cloud this afternoon means the rooftop loungers are half in sun, half in shade, with the sea changing colour below.
phrases.partly_golden: Seen from the rooftop dining tables, the last hour of sun lights the cathedral quarter while clouds turn grey over the bay.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Palma today: the Bay looks grey too from the upper rooms, and the indoor spa pool is busier.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Almaq wooden deck, and guests have moved to the 18-meter indoor pool at the Cocó Spa.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Bay of Palma is best watched from a sea-facing room, with the balcony doors shut this time.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze today: from the rooftop the cathedral quarter is clear enough, but the far side of the bay has disappeared.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Almaq deck today, something Palma almost never sees, and the sauna at Cocó Spa is the warm option.
phrases.very_cold: From the Almaq rooftop, hard winter light falls on the Baluard walls and the empty loungers above the Bay of Palma.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the Almaq rooftop this afternoon, where the parasols and the pool are the only reasons to be outside.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Palma, and the rooftop bar still has people at the rattan chairs looking toward the cathedral.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the upper rooms the walls and cathedral are clear but the far bay is not.
phrases.late_night: After a late dinner at Almaq, the sea-facing upper rooms show the lights along the Bay of Palma reflected in the water.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtains are open in the sea-facing rooms tonight, and Palma's old town lights blur through the rain on the glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open after midnight in an upper sea-facing room, the city lights show under low cloud down to the bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Caribbean is still dark grey from the private terraces, and the jungle behind the suites is quiet.
phrases.clear_morning: From a suite terrace this morning, the sea shows two clear bands of turquoise and deep blue under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the white sand, so the six pools between jungle and beach are the busiest places right now.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the woven sculpture in the gardens, and the sea beyond the beach turns a deeper blue.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your terrace tonight, you would hear the sea in the dark and see stars over the water.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Caribbean this morning, and guests on the balconies have breakfast with the sea in view.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the beach this afternoon, and guests in the swim-out suites step straight from the room into the pool.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the water catch orange light, seen from the open balconies of the suites.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Caribbean looks more green than turquoise today, and the jungle around the spa is dim.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the beach and the terraces today, and the sliding doors in the suites are mostly closed.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Caribbean keeps guests off the beach, watching the storm through the floor-to-ceiling glass of their suites.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the water today, so from the terraces the horizon is hard to find, while the sand stays clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Playa del Carmen, so if any fell today, guests on the terraces would be very surprised.
phrases.very_cold: If you were on a suite terrace now, you would see the sand empty under the palms, nobody near the Caribbean water.
phrases.very_hot: The air is very hot this afternoon, and the swim-out rooms let guests stay in the pool water most of the day.
phrases.mild_night: The night is warm and cloudy, the sea is only audible from the terraces, and the five restaurants are serving plant-based dinners.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balconies the far horizon is missing, but the beach and the near water are clear.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water around midnight, and through the suite's sliding doors the Caribbean shows pale under the moon.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner the suite lights reflect in the rain-wet glass doors, surf sounding beyond.
phrases.grey_evening: Back from dinner, the suites' floor-to-ceiling doors open to low cloud over the Caribbean and the white sand of the beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Golden Horn is a dark band below the Hemingway Suite balcony, with the Süleymaniye Mosque only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Mata Hari Suite this morning, the Golden Horn and the mosque silhouette are both sharp under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands over the Golden Horn, and the wrought iron balcony railings cast short, hard shadows.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a room balcony, you would see the Süleymaniye Mosque as a dark shape against a low orange sun.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the lobby chandelier is lit, and from the upper suites the lights along the Golden Horn are easy to count.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the Golden Horn this morning, and guests on the room balconies watch cloud shadows cross the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the historic facades this afternoon, seen from a balcony with the red damask curtains tied back.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud turns the Golden Horn patchy, bright in places and grey in others.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Golden Horn looks flat and pale from the Hemingway Suite, while the Kubbeli Saloon domes stay lit.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the wrought iron balconies, and afternoon tea under the six domes of the Kubbeli Saloon goes on as usual.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over Istanbul, and lightning briefly shows the Süleymaniye Mosque outline to anyone standing at a suite window.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the Golden Horn today, and from the Mata Hari Suite the mosque silhouette on the horizon is missing.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the wrought iron railings, and the Golden Horn seen from the suites is a dull grey strip.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the balconies stay empty and guests look at the Golden Horn through closed suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: Under a very hot sun, the iron railings are too warm to touch, and the Golden Horn is full of glare.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the Hemingway Suite balcony door can stay open above the dark Golden Horn.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Süleymaniye Mosque on the far horizon cannot be seen from the suites, only the nearer water.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the Mata Hari Suite are asleep by now, the city lights reflected in the water until dawn colours it.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the Mata Hari Suite after midnight can watch rain move across the water, city lights blurred on the inlet.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests awake in the Hemingway Suite around two watch low cloud pass over the waterway, the shore lights soft beneath it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the ocean-view rooms look out on a dark Atlantic, with the ochre cliffs still only a shape.
phrases.clear_morning: From the clifftop terraces, the morning sun lights the ochre cliffs and the sea below Falésia Beach is already blue.
phrases.clear_midday: At Maré, lunch is served on the wooden deck above the sand, with the waves arriving a few metres away.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The Mirador Champagne Bar faces the low sun now, and the cliffs below it turn a deeper orange.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the sea-view terraces give you stars over the Atlantic and the sound of waves below.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the resort grounds this morning, and the pool area under the pines has patches of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Devil's Parlour hole has broken cloud above it, so golfers get shade and sun by turns.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on a sea-view terrace now, you would see the last sun between clouds over the Atlantic.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the water off Falésia Beach looks darker, and the ochre cliffs are the brightest thing in view.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the clifftop today; from the ocean-view rooms the Atlantic is grey and the beach is almost empty.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, the ocean-view rooms give a wide view of lightning over the Atlantic, from behind closed glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the coast today, and from the clifftop the sea below Falésia Beach is only partly visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in the Algarve, but if it fell today the pines around the pool would hold it briefly.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for the Algarve, and the wicker chairs on the sea-view terraces are empty while the sea stays blue.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot this afternoon, and most guests are in the pool under the pines rather than out on the golf course.
phrases.mild_night: If you stood at a window now, you would see the Mirador Champagne Bar's lit deck under a mild cloudy sky.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the Mirador Champagne Bar today, the near cliffs and Falésia Beach are clear, but the far sea has no visible horizon.
phrases.late_night: Sleep is the right use of the small hours, since at dawn the ocean-view windows will show Falésia Beach.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open, rain runs down the ocean-view windows and white surf shows on Falésia Beach below.
phrases.grey_evening: In the ocean-view rooms the curtain is open to low cloud over the Atlantic, and the surf shows pale along Falésia Beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Pacific below the balconies is still dark, and only the pool lights mark the edge of the bluff.
phrases.clear_morning: From any ocean-facing balcony this morning, the Pacific is clear to the horizon and Shell Beach shows plainly a hundred feet down.
phrases.clear_midday: The heated pool at the cliff edge has full sun right now, with the Pacific flat and blue below it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: At Marisol's terrace the bell rings soon; the sun is already low over the Pacific with no cloud in the way.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your balcony tonight, you would hear the Pacific below but see mostly stars and the lit pool.
phrases.partly_morning: This morning the sky over Shell Beach is half cloud, half sun, and the cliff-edge pool changes between light and shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of shade move across the lawns and the pool this afternoon, while the ocean stays mostly bright.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests on the Marisol terrace are waiting for the bell, with the sun dropping between clouds over the Pacific.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers the Pacific today, and the ocean looks the same colour as the clouds from the balconies.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the balconies and the bluff, so the lobby lounge with its arched windows and fireplace is the busy spot.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Pacific is visible from the lobby lounge, and nobody is in the cliff-edge pool right now.
phrases.fog_haze: From the balconies, fog sits over the Pacific today and hides the horizon, with Shell Beach dim below the bluff.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare here, but if it fell today it would land on the lawns and palms above the Pacific.
phrases.very_cold: On a day this cold for the coast, the heated pool steams at the cliff edge and the balconies are mostly empty.
phrases.very_hot: If you were on your balcony now, you would see heat-haze over the Pacific below the bluff at Shell Beach.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy on the bluff, with the Pacific dark below the balconies and the conservatory windows lit.
phrases.reduced_visibility: The view is short today: Shell Beach and the near water show from the balconies, but the Pacific horizon does not.
phrases.late_night: Around two, lights off on the ocean-facing side, the lit pool at the cliff's edge shows alone above the Pacific.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain falls through the pool lights at the cliff's edge, and the Pacific is only surf sound below the bluff after midnight.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight the cloud stays low over the Pacific, and the lit pool shows from the lobby lounge windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Skyline View Rooms look onto a dark river and the first lit windows of Puerto Madero.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool, the brick buildings of Puerto Madero stand in full sun, and the red loungers are still empty.
phrases.clear_midday: Clear sky over the river at midday, so the Ecological Reserve shows every shade of green from the upper rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites, and the city skyline turns orange above the river.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the lanterns on the rooftop terrace are lit, and the city skyline is sharp beyond the red geraniums.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Puerto Madero this morning, visible from the Skyline View Rooms along with the river.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop pool, the Ecological Reserve and the river at Puerto Madero lie under broken afternoon cloud.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see the last sun colour the clouds over the city skyline.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the river today; from the suites the skyline looks flat and most colour comes from the red curtains.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop pool, so the red loungers are empty and guests are reading in The Library Lounge.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the river; from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites, the storm is the show before tango at El Cabaret.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Puerto Madero, and from the Skyline View Rooms the Ecological Reserve is visible but the far skyline is not.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Buenos Aires, but today a few flakes fall past the suite windows above the river.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Buenos Aires, so the rooftop pool is deserted and the river view is enjoyed from behind glass.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot over Puerto Madero today, and the turquoise rooftop pool is busier than the red loungers around it.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night: tango is running at El Cabaret while the city skyline shows under cloud from the rooftop terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today, so from the rooftop pool the nearby brick buildings are in view but the distant skyline is not.
phrases.late_night: Well past midnight, Puerto Madero's lights reflect in the river from the Skyline View Room.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the Skyline View Room windows, and the Puerto Madero lights blur on the wet river.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Puerto Madero after midnight, and the dock lights shine on the river.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Gulf is dark and flat outside the fitness center windows, and the skyline lights are still on.
phrases.clear_morning: From a balcony on a high floor, morning sun lands on the marina water and on the skyline across the waterway.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands directly over the pool, and the turquoise water of the marina shows its colour fully.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Guests on the Eclipse Terrace are now facing west into a low sun, with the skyline turning orange behind them.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a west-facing room tonight, you would see the skyline lights and a clear sky over the Gulf.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the Arabian Gulf this morning, and the fitness center windows show patches of sun on the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds cross the sun now and then, so the marina seen from the pool changes between bright and dull turquoise.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the skyline catch orange light while guests settle on the rooftop lounge chairs.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Gulf looks pale and the skyline flat, seen through the floor-to-ceiling windows beside the oval tub.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare here, and today it blurs the skyline seen from the balconies while the rooftop lounge chairs stay empty.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Abu Dhabi is unusual, and the fitness center windows give a wide, dry view of lightning above the Gulf.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the Gulf today, so from the Eclipse Terrace the far towers of the skyline look faded and grey.
phrases.snow: Snow in Abu Dhabi would be a first, and the rooftop terrace would give a direct view of it over the Gulf.
phrases.very_cold: Abu Dhabi rarely gets this cold, and today the pool is quiet while sun shines on the marina water.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot outside today, and the pool water is the only comfortable place to look at the marina from.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is warm under a cloudy sky, and guests on the rooftop terrace see the skyline lights without any stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the balconies today, the near marina is clear but the farther skyline towers are lost in low visibility.
phrases.late_night: Guests on the high west floors are probably asleep now; the skyline lights on the Gulf fade into daylight at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a west room tonight sees rain on the glass, and the skyline lights blur over the Gulf.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in a high room after midnight watches low cloud pass over the skyline lights across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies face a dark Andaman Sea, with Patong Bay still quiet below the hillside garden.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the infinity pool early, and the first loungers under the red umbrella are already taken.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sea below the balconies turns a flat bright blue, and the offshore island is easy to see.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a sea-facing balcony right now, you would watch the sun going down over the Andaman Sea.
phrases.clear_night: Guests in the sea-facing Jacuzzi suites have a clear night sky over Patong Bay tonight, and the Jacuzzi water is warm.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Andaman this morning, but the balconies still get sun between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the balcony, afternoon clouds drift over Patong Bay, and sunlight falls in patches on the water below the hill.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over the Andaman turn orange, seen from every room balcony.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the whole bay today, so the sea looks grey too, though the hillside garden is still green.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the hillside garden and the pool umbrellas, and the view of Patong Bay is less clear than usual.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the Andaman right now, so guests are watching the lightning from covered balconies rather than the pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the sea today hides the offshore island, and Kalim Beach is only a faint line from the balconies.
phrases.snow: Snow does not happen in Phuket, but if it did, the balconies over Patong Bay would be the place to see it.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day is almost unknown here, yet the sea-facing Jacuzzis would be the warmest spot on the hill.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot above Patong today, so the pools are full and the tennis courts are empty.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, so the balcony daybeds are comfortable even if the stars over Patong Bay are hidden.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the offshore island and the far end of Patong Bay cannot be seen from the balconies.
phrases.late_night: A Jacuzzi suite curtain is left open tonight, and the lights of Patong Beach are the last thing seen before sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the windows of the Jacuzzi suites after midnight, and the lights of Patong Beach blur along the bay below.
phrases.grey_evening: Haze moves over Patong Beach after midnight, and the beachfront lights show softly through it from the sea-facing Jacuzzi suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies look out on a dark, still Bosphorus, with the bridge lights on across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From any balcony this morning, the strait is clear and bright, and the wooded Asian hills opposite show every tree.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun sits high over the Bosphorus, and guests on the terrace watch yachts pass under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the 15 July Martyrs Bridge from the side, seen clearly from the waterfront dining terrace.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the bridge is lit across the water, and diners at the terrace restaurant sit under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the Asian hills this morning, while the strait below the balconies stays mostly in sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Bosphorus, so the blue terrace seating is in sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in the Royal Suite now, you would see the last sun on clouds across three sides of the strait.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Istanbul today, and the Bosphorus outside the floor-to-ceiling windows looks grey too, flat and without shine.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the balconies and on the strait, so guests watch the bridge through wet glass from the suite living rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Bosphorus is easy to see from the suites, since the water is only metres from the windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the strait today, and the Asian hills opposite the balconies are hidden, with only nearby water showing.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the terrace decking and into the Bosphorus, a rare sight from the balconies in Istanbul.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, so the balconies are empty and guests watch the strait from behind the glass.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon like this one, the two outdoor pools at the spa are busier than the sunny terrace.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy but warm night sky, the terrace restaurant is full and the Bosphorus Bridge is lit across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balconies the Asian hills across the strait are not visible, only the nearby water.
phrases.late_night: After midnight only shore lights mark the strait, and sleep is easy in the Royal Bosphorus Suite before dawn's three-sided view.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtains left open past midnight, rain streaks the suite windows and the lights of the far shore spread across the Bosphorus.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains in the Royal Bosphorus Suite stay open past midnight, and the Asian shore lights show across the strait under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the beach below the Colonial Rooms is empty and the Atlantic is just a dark line.
phrases.clear_morning: From the French doors of a Colonial Room, the sand looks clean and the sea is bright turquoise this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is straight over Tolcarne Beach, and the waves breaking near the headland show white against blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Colonial restaurant, guests are watching the sun drop toward the Atlantic while the cliffs turn golden.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the four-poster room tonight, you would see stars over the Atlantic from the sea-view windows.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds are passing over the headland this morning, so the sea in front of the beach terraces shifts between grey and turquoise.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some sun, some cloud over Tolcarne Beach this afternoon, and the wicker chairs on the balconies are mostly taken.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun puts orange light between the clouds, visible from the wooden gazebo on the terrace.
phrases.overcast: Under grey cloud, the Atlantic looks flat and pale from the beach garden of the Hot Tub Beach Suite.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the sand, and the French doors of the Colonial Rooms stay closed while guests watch from inside.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Atlantic means the beach terraces are empty and the lightning is easy to see from the Colonial restaurant.
phrases.fog_haze: Sea fog has reached the beach, so from the balconies the headland is hidden and only the nearest waves show.
phrases.snow: Snow on a Cornish beach is rare, but today a thin layer sits on the sand outside the Hot Tub Beach Suite.
phrases.very_cold: From the Colonial Room terraces, hard winter light falls on empty Tolcarne Beach and the cold Atlantic beyond.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot for Cornwall today, and the sea just past the Hot Tub Beach Suite's garden looks more tempting than the tub.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night at sea level, and guests with cocktails at the Colonial restaurant can still hear the waves.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balconies the sand and waves are clear but the headland is only a faint shape.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Colonial Rooms are made for sleep, the Atlantic only white surf at the sand until dawn fills the window.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the French doors of the Colonial Rooms after midnight, and the room's light shows wet sand on Tolcarne Beach.
phrases.grey_evening: From the Hot Tub Beach Suite, the white surf shows on the sand under low cloud around two.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the terrace above the private beach is empty and the shape of Naxos is already visible across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear sky over the Aegean this morning, and the Naxos mountains look sharp from the sun loungers by the infinity pool.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the restaurant terrace has a table set for lunch and the sea is flat blue to the horizon.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun on the curved pool, and guests in the wooden cabanas look out at a calm, orange-lit Aegean.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a Signature Suite tonight, you would sit in the hot tub under a clear, starry sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds this morning, but Naxos is still clear across the water from the dual windows of the suites.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the infinity pool this afternoon, so the sun loungers get sun and shade in turns.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the Aegean turn orange, and the daybeds on the shaded terrace fill up.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky over Ampelas beach today, and the indoor pool and spa are busier than the terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain on the restaurant terrace, so meals move inside while the sea toward Naxos looks grey and flat.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Aegean, and the arched doorway of the suite is the place to watch lightning out toward Naxos.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the sea today, so Naxos is only a faint outline from the sun loungers by the infinity pool.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on Paros, and the hotel closes in winter, so this would be a view with nobody on the terrace.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air for Paros, and the indoor pool makes more sense than the sun loungers by the sea.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon on Ampelas beach, and most guests stay in the water of the private plunge pools or the sea.
phrases.mild_night: A warm, cloudy night at the restaurant terrace, with no stars but the sound of the sea below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Naxos and its mountains cannot be seen from the terrace, only the nearby sea.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight a glass of water stands by the bed, and the Aegean moves past the suite windows.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the two windows of the Signature Sea View Suites, and the Aegean breaks on Ampelas beach outside.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner is over, cloud hangs over the Aegean, and the sea moves pale under the windows of the Signature Sea View Suites.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the 606 Popolo Suite looks onto a dark Piazza del Popolo, with Santa Maria in Montesanto still unlit.
phrases.clear_morning: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see St. Peter's dome sharp in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a blue sky, the courtyard terrace at Le Jardin de Russie has lunch tables set beneath red-striped umbrellas.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see the sun dropping behind St. Peter's dome.
phrases.clear_night: At night, the Stravinskij Bar is busy inside, while upstairs the suite windows show St. Peter's dome lit against a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Piazza del Popolo this morning, and from the Popolo suite terrace the square is half in sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, the umbrella pines outside the guest-room windows move between shade and sun as clouds cross Rome.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds over the rooftop terrace turn orange above St. Peter's dome.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Rome today, so from the balcony door the Pantheon dome looks flat and pale.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the courtyard terrace, so the red-striped umbrellas are closed and nobody is eating outside.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, guests in the 606 Popolo Suite can watch lightning over Piazza del Popolo from behind closed windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Rome, and from the suite living room St. Peter's dome is only a faint grey shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Rome, but today the rooftop terrace lounge chairs carry a thin white layer and nobody sits there.
phrases.very_cold: The air is close to freezing, so the rooftop terrace is empty and guests watch Piazza del Popolo from the suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Rome, and the red-striped parasol on the rooftop terrace is the only shade up there.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night, the rooftop terrace seating is still occupied, with St. Peter's dome lit below the cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balcony door the Pantheon dome is hard to see, though nearby rooftops are clear.
phrases.late_night: Sleep comes easily in the 606 Popolo Suite after midnight; at dawn the window will show Santa Maria in Montesanto again.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Le Jardin de Russie, Piazza del Popolo looks wet and bright through rain on the 606 Popolo Suite window.
phrases.grey_evening: Long after dinner at Le Jardin de Russie, the 606 Popolo Suite window shows the square's lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Under a clear sky before dawn, the upper-floor river view rooms look over an unlit Brisbane River and the suburbs beyond.
phrases.clear_morning: On the balcony, a breakfast table with croissants and juice looks over the river and the city rooftops in full sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Yellow umbrellas beside the rooftop pool give the only shade at midday, and Suncorp Stadium sits directly below.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches across the Brisbane skyline and the historic buildings, seen from loungers beside the rooftop pool.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the lit Brisbane skyline can be seen from the executive rooms, with no cloud in the sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the Brisbane River this morning, visible from the upper-floor river view rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop pool, patches of cloud move across the city skyline while swimmers keep an eye on the stadium below.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the river turn orange, best seen from the wooden pool decking.
phrases.overcast: Full cloud covers Brisbane today, and the river looks grey rather than blue from the upper-floor windows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop loungers, so guests watch the wet city skyline from behind their floor-to-ceiling windows instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Brisbane River can be watched from the river view rooms, and nobody is on the pool terrace right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Brisbane, so the historic buildings and far suburbs look faint from the rooftop terrace today.
phrases.snow: Snow in Brisbane almost never happens, yet flakes are falling past the floor-to-ceiling windows of the river view rooms.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside, so the rooftop loungers stay empty and the river is best viewed through the windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the stadium today, and the rooftop pool is where most guests spend the afternoon.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds hide the stars tonight, but a warm night keeps guests on the pool terrace watching the city lights.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the river view rooms the Brisbane River is clear but the far suburbs are not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, the river view rooms on the upper floors frame the Brisbane River and its reflected city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtains open late in a river view room, the city lights show in the rain-wet Brisbane River.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open after midnight in the river view rooms, and the city lights reflect in the Brisbane River under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Grand Canal outside the Monet Suite terrace is dark and quiet, with only a few water taxis passing.
phrases.clear_morning: Sun on the water, and from the guestroom balconies the dome of Santa Maria della Salute is sharp across the canal.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the lagoon is bright, and guests on Gio's Terrace watch gondolas pass under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun hits the striped mooring poles below the terrace, and the Salute dome is lit from the west.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop terrace tonight, you would see water taxis crossing the dark Grand Canal under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Some cloud this morning, but the San Giorgio Maggiore bell tower is still clear from the guestroom balconies.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Grand Canal this afternoon, so the light on the Salute dome changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the terrace sofas by the blue plumbago face a Salute dome partly in cloud shadow.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Venice today, and the Grand Canal from the Monet Suite terrace is flat and grey too.
phrases.rain: Rain on the Grand Canal: the terrace chairs at Gio's are empty, and the Salute dome looks grey across the water.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the lagoon, so the rooftop terrace is empty and guests watch the lightning from their room windows instead.
phrases.fog_haze: From the guestroom balconies today, fog sits over the lagoon and hides most of San Giorgio Maggiore's bell tower.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Venice, settling on the striped mooring poles outside the hotel and melting on the Grand Canal.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold, clear day in Venice; the Salute dome is sharp across the water, and nobody lingers on the terrace.
phrases.very_hot: From the Monet Suite terrace, heat-haze blurs the dome of Santa Maria della Salute across the Grand Canal.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night, and the rooftop dining tables are set with glassware while the lagoon below is dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so from the hotel terraces the Salute dome is clear but San Giorgio Maggiore across the lagoon is not.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight in the Monet Suite, and the Grand Canal is there, lights moving on the water.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down the Monet Suite windows, and the lights along the Grand Canal move on the wet water.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, haze hangs low over the Grand Canal, and the lights along the far bank blur from the Monet Suite windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the south-facing rooms look out on a dark Lake Zurich with the Alps just beginning to show.
phrases.clear_morning: From the window seat, Lake Zurich and the city rooftops are clearly visible this morning, with no haze in between.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests on the south-facing balcony at midday look down on Lake Zurich under a clear sky, with the Alps beyond.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches across the lawns below the terrace, and Lake Zurich turns a lighter colour before sunset.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the wrap-around balcony tonight, you would see the lights of Zurich around a dark lake.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Lake Zurich this morning, so the view from the balcony table changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the terrace, the yellow umbrellas are only half needed, as clouds cover the sun for part of the afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: From the south-facing balcony, the last low sun falls on Lake Zurich and the city rooftops between scattered clouds.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Lake Zurich and the city rooftops are still visible from the window seat, only with less colour.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the terrace today, the glass doors stay shut, and Lake Zurich is seen through wet windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Zurich, and from the south-facing rooms you can watch the lightning above the lake behind closed glass doors.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills the valley today, and even from this hill above it, Lake Zurich is not visible from the balconies.
phrases.snow: Snow covers the lawns and the hedges around the terrace, and the Zürichberg forest trails at the door are white.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing outside, the balcony tables stand empty, but the Alps behind Lake Zurich are clearly visible from the window.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, guests keep to the shade of the tall trees and yellow umbrellas on the terrace.
phrases.mild_night: This mild cloudy night, guests can sit out at the balcony table and see the lights of Zurich without any stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so the nearer rooftops are visible from the window seat, but the Alps behind the lake are not.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, city lights are reflected in Lake Zurich below the south-facing room.
phrases.wet_evening: The south room's curtain is open before bed, and through rain on the glass the city lights along Lake Zurich blur.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain stays open past midnight in the south-facing room, and under low cloud the city lights show along Lake Zurich's shore.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Frioul Islands are only dark shapes from the terrace, and the heated seawater pool is empty.
phrases.clear_morning: From the breakfast table on the terrace, the sea is deep blue and Château d'If is easy to pick out.
phrases.clear_midday: Sunlight comes straight through the floor-to-ceiling windows of the sixteen rooms, and the rocky coastline shows every detail.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the last hours of sun, the sea seen from the dining room turns orange, and the islands stand out sharply.
phrases.clear_night: From the suite's floor-to-ceiling glass, bright stars show across the clear night sky above the Mediterranean off the terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Frioul Islands this morning, but the breakfast terrace is in sun most of the time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: The seawater pool gets sun between clouds this afternoon, and the sea changes colour each time a cloud moves.
phrases.partly_golden: Clouds near the horizon catch the low sun, so the view from the suites is partly gold and partly grey.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the sea past the rocks looks flat and dull, though Château d'If is still visible from the terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the terrace and the pool, so lunch guests watch the wet coastline from inside the dining room.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the sea is visible from behind the floor-to-ceiling glass, and the pool and terrace are empty for now.
phrases.fog_haze: From the terrace, haze hides the Frioul Islands and leaves only the nearest rocks and a short stretch of grey water.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Marseille, but today a few flakes fall on the terrace and melt on the rocks.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it is close to freezing on the terrace, yet the heated seawater pool is in use, steam rising above it.
phrases.very_hot: Most guests choose the seawater pool over the terrace chairs this very hot afternoon, the islands clear across the water.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night, guests sit late on the terrace lounge seating, though the islands are not visible in the dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: If you stood on the terrace now, you would see the near rocks and grey water but not the Frioul Islands.
phrases.late_night: In the suites the curtain is left open after midnight, so the sea shows in the floor-to-ceiling glass until sleep comes.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the suite's floor-to-ceiling glass after midnight, and the sea is heard on the rocks beyond the open curtain.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight the curtains are open in the sea-facing suites, cloud covers the sky and the sea is heard on the rocks.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Bay of Palma is still dark from the fortress walls, and the drawbridge has not come down yet.
phrases.clear_morning: From the bedroom windows, the sea and the distant mountains are sharp under a clear Mallorcan sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the white awning over the terrace restaurant gives shade, while the Mediterranean below stays a deep blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the clifftop plunge pool terrace, guests watch the sun drop toward the sea before the bridge rises for the night.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the Bay of Palma under a clear sky from your private stone terrace.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the distant mountains this morning, seen from the wooden daybed gazebo above the sea.
