phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the Bay of Palma this afternoon, so the saltwater pool on the fortress walls gets sun on and off.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the sea turns orange above the courtyard palm trees.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Mediterranean looks flat and pale from the stone rooms, and the mountains are only a dim line.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the fortress terraces, and the tables under the terrace restaurant awning are the dry place to sit.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Bay of Palma is easy to watch from inside the cave-carved lounge, with thick stone walls around you.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the sea hides the distant mountains today, so the bedroom windows show only water and the coastal shrubs.
phrases.snow: A rare snowfall is passing over the Bay of Palma, and a few flakes settle on the courtyard hedges and stone walls.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing outside, the private patios are empty, and the clear view of the sea is best from behind a window.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, most guests are in the saltwater pool on the fortress walls or in the shaded daybed gazebo.
phrases.mild_night: The drawbridge is up for the night, the air is warm, and clouds cover the stars above the Bay of Palma.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; the sea in front of the fortress is clear enough, but the distant mountains cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and from the bedroom window the lights of Palma shine across the bay.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the bedroom windows after midnight, and the lights around the Bay of Palma blur across the water.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the Bay of Palma after midnight, and from the bedroom windows the lights of Palma show across the water.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the 22nd-floor lofts look out at the Horseshoe Falls, still lit by the night illumination.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight now reaches both the Canadian and American cascades, seen through the floor-to-ceiling glass of the Fallsview rooms.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, guests at the window tables of Milestones on the Falls get the Horseshoe Falls under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun falls on the Horseshoe Falls, and the panoramic windows in the two-queen rooms face the brink directly.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the Horseshoe Falls illuminated in colour from the 22nd-floor glass.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over Niagara Falls this morning, with sun on the water between them, visible from the Fallsview rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the two-story suite living room, the afternoon view is the Horseshoe Falls under a mix of cloud and sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the edges of the clouds above the Horseshoe Falls, framed by the loft windows.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Niagara Falls today, but the Horseshoe Falls stays in full frame from the 22nd floor.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Horseshoe Falls right now; guests watch it from the window tables at Milestones on the Falls.
phrases.thunderstorm: There is thunder over Niagara Falls at the moment, and the storm above the Horseshoe Falls is visible from behind floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hangs over the river today, so the Horseshoe Falls shows only in part from the Fallsview rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling past the 22nd-floor windows, and the Horseshoe Falls keeps running in white below the lofts.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold today at Niagara Falls, and the Horseshoe Falls still runs in full frame through the Fallsview windows.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot afternoon over Niagara Falls, and the Horseshoe Falls is in direct view from the two-story suite windows.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky on this mild night, and the illuminated Horseshoe Falls is in view from the 22nd-floor lofts.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Horseshoe Falls shows from the Fallsview rooms but the American cascade is hard to make out.
phrases.late_night: The Horseshoe Falls pours white in the loft windows tonight, reason enough to stay up.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain streaks the 22nd-floor loft glass, and the Horseshoe Falls appears through blurred night lights.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight, haze moves across the Horseshoe Falls, and from the 22nd-floor lofts the white water shows through it in turns.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the cove below the room balconies is still dark, and the two rocky promontories are just outlines against the sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Early guests on the floating sea platform have the calm, transparent bay of Baia delle Sirene to themselves this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: Under the midday sun, the striped umbrella on the terrace is the most popular spot for looking at the bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the panoramic restaurant terrace, the late sun lights the green hillsides and the rocky headland in warm colour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on your balcony tonight, you would see stars over the Ionian coast and hear the water of the cove.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Taormina cliffs this morning, and the set tables on the restaurant terrace already have guests.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the green hillside towns this afternoon, seen from the two sun loungers on the stone terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the clouds over the bay orange, a good moment to be on the deck terrace.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky today, but the water of the cove under the balconies is still clear enough to see the bottom.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the floating sea platform, so guests watch the cove from inside the glass-walled restaurant instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Ionian coast is easier to appreciate from a guest room with the terrace doors closed.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the hillside towns across the bay today; only the nearer rocky promontory is clear from the balconies.
phrases.snow: Snow in Taormina is rare, but today a few flakes fall on the deck terrace and melt on contact with the sea.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day like this, the floating sea platform is empty and the sun loungers on the stone terrace too.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon in the cove, and most guests have moved from the sun loungers into the turquoise water.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night; the terrace doors of the guest rooms stay open to the sound of the bay below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today: the green hillside towns across Taormina bay are not visible from the restaurant terrace, only the near cove.
phrases.late_night: After midnight a few hillside lights show across Taormina Bay, and at dawn the cove's turquoise water fills the guest-room windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the guest-room glass tonight, and the hillside town lights blur above the bay at Baia delle Sirene.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Taormina Bay after midnight, and the hillside town lights reflect on the water from the guest rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: Dark and clear over Manhattan, with the Empire State Building's lights on in the bedroom window before the sun comes up.
phrases.clear_morning: On a clear morning, the high-floor rooms look across Lower Manhattan rooftops to One World Trade Center.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday under a clear sky, the oversized windows show the Chrysler Building and Empire State Building in full sunlight.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Midtown skyline from the SoHo Balcony Studio terrace, the Empire State Building sharp against it.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky is clear, and the lit Manhattan Bridge and downtown skyscrapers fill the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_morning: If you were on a high floor this morning, you would see a few clouds passing over the Lower Manhattan rooftops.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over Midtown this afternoon, so the Empire State Building moves in and out of shade in the bedroom window.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over the Manhattan skyline turn orange above the terrace's white lounge seating.
phrases.overcast: The sky is grey all over Manhattan today, and the Empire State Building looks flat and colourless from the room.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the oversized windows, and the downtown skyscrapers look blurred behind the drops.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests stay inside and watch lightning over the Manhattan skyline through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Empire State Building today, and only the nearer Lower Manhattan rooftops show from the room.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over SoHo, and the white lounge seating on the terrace sits empty while guests watch from inside.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold today, so the SoHo Balcony Studio terrace is for a quick look at the Manhattan skyline, not for sitting.
phrases.very_hot: The city is very hot today, and guests watch the Empire State Building from air-conditioned rooms rather than the terrace.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the terrace's white lounge seating faces the lit bridge and the city lights across Manhattan.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today means the Manhattan Bridge shows clearly from the windows, but the Empire State Building is a faint shape.
phrases.late_night: Around two the Empire State spire shows above the Midtown lights, worth another hour awake.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows after midnight, so the Empire State Building looks blurred among the wet midtown lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud drifts across the Empire State Building's spire after midnight, and the midtown lights glow beneath it from the bedroom window.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Dolomite summits at the end of the Val Casies show pale against a clear sky from the rooftop pool.
phrases.clear_morning: From a south-facing balcony, the wooded slopes of the Val Casies are in full sun and the Dolomite rock is sharp.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests in the rooftop infinity pool look straight down the valley to the Dolomites, with no cloud anywhere over the peaks.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the pale Dolomite rock at the end of the Val Casies, seen from the outdoor infinity sport pool.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the adults-only rooftop pool tonight, you would see stars above the Dolomites at the valley end.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Dolomite peaks this morning, while the Gsies pastures below the panoramic pool are in sunlight.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the wooded slopes on both sides of the Val Casies, watched from the suite balconies.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud above the Dolomites turns pink, best seen from the rooftop pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Dolomite summits look flat and distant from the balconies, but the green valley is still clear.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Val Casies today, and most guests have moved from the outdoor pools into the twelve saunas.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is moving down the Val Casies, and the Dolomites Bio Sauna is the driest place to watch it.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog fills the Val Casies today, and from the rooftop pool the Dolomites are not visible, only the nearest trees.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the slopes of the Val Casies while guests sit in the steaming outdoor infinity pool and watch it.
phrases.very_cold: From the rooftop pool, steam rises in hard winter light toward the pale Dolomite rock at the end of the Val Casies.
phrases.very_hot: At midday, heat-haze shimmers over the Val Casies below the rooftop infinity pool, out to the pale Dolomite rock.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the balcony doors stay open and the Dolomites are a dark shape across the valley.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so from the suite balconies the far Dolomite rock is hidden and only the near wooded slopes show.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the suite window shows village lights down the Val Casies toward the Dolomites.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, snow falls past the south-facing suite windows, and the village lights down the Val Casies blur toward the Dolomites.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the Dolomite summits after midnight, and from the suites only the village lights down the valley show.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the London Eye stands dark and still outside the river-facing suites, with Big Ben already easy to pick out.
phrases.clear_morning: From a balcony suite this morning, the Thames and Westminster Bridge are sharp under a clear London sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun sits high over the Houses of Parliament, and the king rooms get a direct view of Big Ben.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on Big Ben and the Palace of Westminster, seen from suites with the balcony doors open.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the London Eye is lit up, and from a balcony Parliament and Westminster Bridge are also lit, under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Thames this morning, and the London Eye goes in and out of sunshine outside the river-facing rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in the bar lounge this afternoon, you would see Big Ben through the windows, with clouds passing behind it.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun is lighting Big Ben between the clouds, seen from the duplex suite's tall windows.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers London today, but Big Ben and the Thames are clear through the library windows, where afternoon tea is served.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Thames, and guests in the river-facing suites watch it from behind closed balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over London, so the balconies are empty and the London Eye is watched from inside the suites.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Thames today, the London Eye still visible from the balcony rooms and Big Ben only a faint shape.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Westminster Bridge, and the indoor swimming pool is the warmer place to be right now.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing on the balconies, so guests look at Big Ben through the glass of the king rooms instead.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day for London, and the balcony doors toward the Palace of Westminster are open to let some air in.
phrases.mild_night: Under a cloudy sky on a mild night, the Thames and Westminster Bridge are lit up outside the balcony suites.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the London Eye is clear from the river-facing rooms but the skyline beyond the Thames is not.
phrases.late_night: Sleep comes after midnight in the river-facing suites; bridge lights show on the Thames, and the Eye fills the window at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open in a river-facing room, rain on the glass blurs the lights along the Thames near the London Eye.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hangs over the Thames after midnight, and the river-facing rooms' open curtains frame the wheel against the lit city.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Taktsang cliff is a dark shape from the guest rooms, with the forest below still unlit.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests planning the climb can see Taktsang clearly from a Vista table, six kilometres away across protected forest.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun falls directly on the Taktsang cliff, and the monastery is clear from every guest room window.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the snow-capped peaks beyond the terrace, where staff set candles on the dining tables for the evening.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, stars show above the forested mountains from the fire pit, whisky from the Paro Lounge in hand.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass across the Taktsang cliff this morning, hiding and showing the monastery while breakfast continues at Vista.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the lobby's floor-to-ceiling windows, patches of shade and sun move over the valley hills this afternoon.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the clouds pink over the forested hills, seen from the candlelit terrace tables.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers the Paro Valley today, and the monastery is a flat shape on the cliff from the rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the forest between the resort and Taktsang, and the heated indoor pool is the sensible place to be.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Paro Valley sends guests from the terrace into the Paro Lounge, where the storm is watched through glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Taktsang cliff completely today; from Vista, only the nearest trees of the forest are visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the forest and the monastery roof, and from the guest room window the hills are turning white.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold, clear day in the Paro Valley, and the snow-capped peaks beyond the terrace show every ridge.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day for Bhutan, and the shaded tables at Vista are busier than the walk up to Taktsang.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the fire pit is lit and the water features are the main sound on the terrace.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, and the monastery six kilometres away cannot be seen from Vista, only the nearer forest.
phrases.late_night: Guests who wake for water near midnight find their window facing Taktsang's cliff, six kilometres away across the forest.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the Taktsang-facing rooms are probably asleep now, rain running down the window.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests awake in their rooms after midnight have cloud over Taktsang's cliff, and a few lights spread across the Paro Valley.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lake below the wraparound terrace is dark and flat, and the wooded hills are only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast, the croissants and carved watermelon sit beside a window with a clear view over Lake Zurich.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the moored sailboats in front of the lakeside terrace show up sharply against turquoise water.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Tower Suite terrace, the late sun is low over Lake Zurich and the wooded hills turn darker.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would stand on the wraparound terrace under a clear sky, the private sauna warm behind you.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds over Zurich this morning, and the lake-view windows of the suite living area show patches of sun on the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, cloud shadows cross the wooded hills beyond the lake, seen from the lakeside terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds take some colour above Lake Zurich, visible through the open wooden balcony doors.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Lake Zurich today, so the water looks grey too from the lakeside window at breakfast.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the lakeside promenade and the moored sailboats, while the suite's curved seating offers a dry place to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, lightning over Lake Zurich is best watched from inside the suite, behind closed wooden balcony doors.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the lake today hides the wooded hills, and from the terrace the far shore cannot be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the hills beyond Lake Zurich, as seen through the room's wooden balcony doors.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold clear day, the wraparound terrace is empty but the snow-dusted hills across the lake are easy to see.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Zurich today, and the turquoise water in front of the lakeside terrace looks even more inviting than usual.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and guests on the wraparound terrace can sit outside without a coat, the lake dark below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today; the moored sailboats near the terrace are clear, but the wooded hills across the lake are not.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water in the Tower Suite Lake View comes with the promenade lights on the water of Lake Zurich.
phrases.wet_evening: Tonight rain covers the Tower Suite windows, and the lights along Lake Zurich show through the wet glass as soft smears.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers Lake Zurich after midnight, and lights along the opposite shore reflect on the water from the lake-view windows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the upper terraces look east over the dark olive grove to a grey line of Adriatic.
phrases.clear_morning: From a suite balcony this morning, the French doors are open and the sea beyond the olive rows is fully blue.
phrases.clear_midday: Guests on the upper terraces at midday look over the olive rows to the Adriatic under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun comes from behind the masseria, so the olive grove and the sea in front of the terraces are evenly lit.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop terrace tonight, you would see stars above the olive grove and a black Adriatic.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the golf course this morning, and the bunkers and the sea beyond change colour as each one goes by.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Under the reed pergola on the stone terrace, there is shade this afternoon whether the clouds cooperate or not.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the whitewashed parapets on the terraces turn orange while clouds sit low over the Adriatic.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Puglia today, and from the upper rooms the sea and the sky meet without a clear line.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the olive grove and on the seawater pool, so the thalasso spa is busier than the terraces.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the upper rooms face the lightning over the Adriatic, the same water the 15th-century tower was built to watch.
phrases.fog_haze: From the whitewashed terraces, daytime haze hides the Adriatic beyond the 500 metres of old olive grove.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Puglia, but today the olive trees below the terraces are white and the sea behind them stays dark.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, and the seawater pool among the rocks is one hotel feature nobody is using today.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the white drapes of the terrace restaurant give welcome shade between the tables and the sea.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, so guests on the rooftop terrace by the plunge pool get warm air but no stars.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the terraces show the whole olive grove but the Adriatic beyond it is not clearly visible.
phrases.late_night: Dinner at La Nassa is long over, and after midnight the upper rooms look out on the Adriatic past the olive tops.
phrases.wet_evening: Dinner at La Nassa is long finished, and after midnight rain runs down the upper-room windows that face the Adriatic.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at La Nassa is over, and after midnight the suite's French doors frame low cloud over the Adriatic and the sea's sound.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the moored boats sit in the dark Viaduct under a clear sky, and the Sky Tower stands above the skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balconies, the morning sun is on the sailboats, and the waterfront promenade below is already busy.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Viaduct water is bright under a clear sky, and La Marée serves lunch beside the same water view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the city skyline and the Sky Tower, seen from floor-to-ceiling windows in the marina-facing suites.
phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, the Sky Tower stands lit above the skyline, seen from the courtyard or a marina-facing balcony.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Auckland this morning, and the moored boats in the Viaduct move between shade and sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the waterfront terrace, a guest can read a newspaper while clouds and sun alternate over the moored yachts.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun reaches the Sky Tower between clouds, seen from the courtyard as the windows light up.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Auckland today, so the Viaduct water looks flat and the city skyline has no shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the promenade and the moored boats, while guests inside use the two indoor pools and the steam room.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over the Viaduct right now, and each lightning flash shows the masts of the moored boats from the suite windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the Viaduct today, so the nearest sailboats are visible from the balconies but the Sky Tower is not.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare in Auckland, but if it fell today it would settle on the moored boats below the balconies.
phrases.very_cold: Cold air over the Viaduct today, so more guests are in the sauna than on the marina-facing balconies.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot sun on the Viaduct today, and most guests choose the indoor pools over the balconies until evening.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Auckland, and dinner at La Marée looks out on the moored boats in the dark Viaduct.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balconies the sailboats and the promenade are clear but the Sky Tower is faint.
phrases.late_night: Long after dinner at La Marée, the marina-facing rooms face the moored sailboats and the Sky Tower on the skyline.
phrases.wet_evening: The marina lights look soft through rain on the floor-to-ceiling windows after midnight.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud covers the top of the Sky Tower after midnight, and the marina lights show on the water from the marina-facing rooms.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky is clear before sunrise, and from the skylight window St. Vitus Cathedral is a dark outline above the rooftops.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balconies facing the Vltava, the morning sun is on the castle walls and the Rudolfinum below.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the red terracotta rooftops of Malá Strana look very bright from the upper-floor rooms under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Afternoon sun lights Charles Bridge and the Old Town skyline, seen from a room window above the Vltava.
phrases.clear_night: With a clear sky tonight, the outline of Prague Castle stands above the river, seen from the upper-floor room windows.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Hradčany this morning, and the suite windows show the wooded hillside between patches of sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the Vltava changes from grey to blue each time a cloud moves off the sun, as seen from the balconies.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the castle walls catch light between clouds while the Rudolfinum below is already in shade.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, St. Vitus Cathedral is still clear through the skylight window, just without any shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftops of Malá Strana, and guests watch it from the suite living area with the windows closed.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over Prague right now, and guests in the suite living area watch the sky flash above the wooded hillside.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog lies on the Vltava today, so from the balconies the Rudolfinum is visible but Charles Bridge is not.
phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the terracotta rooftops below the skylight window, and Prague Castle looks white at the top.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, so most guests look at the castle walls through closed room windows today.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Prague today, but from the room windows the Vltava and Charles Bridge are sharp in the strong sun.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under a cloudy sky, and a few guests stay out on the balconies facing the river.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Rudolfinum and castle walls are clear from the rooms but the Old Town skyline is not.
phrases.late_night: If you got up for water near midnight, the attic suite's skylight would show the castle's shape above the Malá Strana rooftops.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last glass of wine in the attic suite tonight, rain would run down the skylight framing Prague Castle.
phrases.grey_evening: Pouring a last glass in the attic suite tonight, you would see low cloud over the castle and Malá Strana lit below.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the suites above the 53rd floor already show a grey ocean and the dark shapes of the Surfers Paradise skyline.
phrases.clear_morning: On the high-floor balcony, breakfast comes with a clear view of the Broadwater and the Surfers Paradise towers.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the ocean beyond Surfers Paradise is deep blue from the living area window, with no cloud anywhere.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the Surfers Paradise skyline from the west, and the rooftop pool is still in use.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lit towers of Surfers Paradise from a bedroom above level 25.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Broadwater this morning, and the marina below the rooftop pool is fully visible.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the rooftop spa, guests watch cloud shadows move across the Broadwater marina and the Gold Coast skyline.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud turns orange above Surfers Paradise beach, seen from the 3 Bedroom Ocean Suites.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the ocean from the living area window looks flat and silver, but the skyline stays sharp.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling bedroom windows, and the Broadwater Parklands directly below look empty and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a storm, the high suites give a wide view of lightning over the ocean beyond Surfers Paradise, from indoors.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Broadwater today softens the Surfers Paradise towers, though the marina near the hotel is still clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is not a Gold Coast thing, so if it fell, the rooftop pool would be the strangest place to see it.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air for the Gold Coast, but the sky is clear and the ocean view from the suites is unchanged.
phrases.very_hot: Heat like this sends guests to the rooftop pool, and the Broadwater marina below is bright in the sun.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and from the balcony the Surfers Paradise skyline is lit while the ocean beyond is dark.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the far end of Surfers Paradise beach is lost, but the Broadwater Parklands directly below are clear.
phrases.late_night: After midnight the Surfers Paradise skyline lights show across the Broadwater from the Ocean Suites, and dawn will add the beach.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open in a 3 Bedroom Ocean Suite, rain on the glass blurs the Surfers Paradise skyline lights.
phrases.grey_evening: Bedroom curtains open after midnight, and the Surfers Paradise skyline is lit across the Broadwater under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop terrace is quiet and Senso-ji's pagoda stands below without the daytime crowds, Skytree clear beyond.
phrases.clear_morning: Early morning on the rooftop, the pagoda and Tokyo Skytree are both sharp, and the crowds have not arrived yet.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a blue sky at midday, the terrace seating is in full sun, with Skytree standing clear over the city skyline.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the side of Senso-ji's pagoda below the terrace, and Skytree is in the same low light.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight Skytree is lit, and from the rooftop pool you can see its lights repeated on the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Tokyo this morning, and from the terrace Skytree goes in and out of shade above the pagoda.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the high-floor lounge this afternoon, broken cloud sits behind Skytree, and the floor-to-ceiling windows frame the whole tower.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, gaps in the cloud put patches of light on the pagoda roof below the terrace.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Tokyo today, and Skytree is a flat shape behind Senso-ji's pagoda when seen from the rooftop.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop terrace, so Skytree is best watched from the lounge windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: If you were in the high-floor lounge right now, you would see lightning over Tokyo behind Skytree through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Tokyo today makes Skytree pale from the terrace, while the pagoda, much closer, keeps its colour.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Asakusa, and from the rooftop the pagoda roof turns white while Skytree is hard to see.
phrases.very_cold: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see Skytree beyond the pagoda in hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the terrace this afternoon, so the rooftop pool is where guests are, with Skytree in direct sun.
phrases.mild_night: On a warm cloudy night, the rooftop pool shows Skytree's lights on its surface, with no moon tonight.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Tokyo today: Senso-ji's pagoda is clear from the terrace, but Skytree beyond is only partly visible.
phrases.late_night: If you were falling asleep there after midnight, you might leave the curtain open, the Skytree in view above the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were in the high-floor lounge after midnight, you would see rain on the tall windows and Tokyo Skytree's outline beyond.
phrases.grey_evening: If you carried a last drink up to the lounge now, you would see Skytree's outline above Asakusa's lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Just before sunrise, the first balloons rise over Göreme and show up as dark shapes from the private patios.
phrases.clear_morning: From the heated panoramic pool, guests can follow the last balloons drifting over the valleys before the morning flight ends.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the pool terrace, and every ridge and rock shape around Cappadocia shows sharp edges.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun is low over the Ürgüp panorama, and from the patios the cave walls turn a warmer colour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see a clear sky over Göreme town and the valley hills from the rooftop pool.
phrases.partly_morning: This morning a few clouds hang over Göreme, and the balloons cross between them as seen from the patios.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun take turns over the ridgelines this afternoon, changing the colour of the rock around the pool terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, cloud gaps let light fall on the Ürgüp panorama seen from Revithia's terrace.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Cappadocia today, and the rock formations look flat and even from the outdoor pool terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the hillside above Ürgüp, and guests inside the cave suites have the fireplace lit under the arched ceilings.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the balloons stay on the ground, and the view from the patios is mainly lightning over the valley.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog today hides Göreme town and the valley hills; from the rooftop pool only the nearest rock is clear.
phrases.snow: Snow lies on the ridgelines around Ürgüp, seen from the heated panoramic pool, where the water stays warm.
phrases.very_cold: It is very cold outside this morning, so the balloon flight over Göreme is best watched from behind a suite window.
phrases.very_hot: The afternoon is very hot across the valleys, and the 90 m² panoramic pool is the busiest spot on the hillside.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night like this one, the stone fireplace burns on the Manzara Bistro terrace and tables are set outside.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so Göreme town is not clearly seen from the rooftop pool, though the nearby ridgelines are.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water in a cave suite, and Ürgüp's lights fill the window where balloons rise at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Revithia, rain blurs the cave suite windows and the lights of Göreme, where the balloons rise at dawn.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner at Revithia is over; under low cloud, the lights of Göreme mark the valley where the balloons will launch at sunrise.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Duomo is already a dark shape above Florence's rooftops from the panoramic terrace, with no cloud anywhere.
phrases.clear_morning: From a room facing the city this morning, the Duomo dome stands out clearly over the terracotta rooftops and olive groves.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Italian garden's lemon trees and boxwood hedges give little shade, so guests prefer the pool loungers.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the late sun, the terracotta rooftops below the panoramic terrace turn a deeper orange and the Duomo is clearly lit.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the balcony tonight, you would see the lights of Florence below and stars above the hills.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Florentine hills this morning, seen through the arched brick window of a suite.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the Duomo this afternoon, so the dome passes between sun and shadow, watched from the terrace.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the cypress trees below the terrace, while scattered clouds over Florence turn pink.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky today, the Duomo is still easy to find above the rooftops, just without any shine on the dome.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Italian garden and its small fountain, so meals move indoors to the Sala Affresco.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is passing over Florence; from the Villa Rooms the lightning shows the Duomo for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze fills the valley today, so from the terrace Florence is mostly hidden while the nearest cypresses and olive slopes stay sharp.
phrases.snow: Snow on the Fiesole hills is rare, but today the boxwood hedges and lemon trees carry a thin white layer.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it is close to freezing today, and the heated pool gives off visible steam in front of the Tuscan hills.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Florence today, so guests stay in the pool water rather than on the loungers facing the Tuscan hills.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night like this, dinner on the panoramic terrace runs late, with Florence spread out below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the terrace the Duomo is a faint outline and the far Tuscan hills cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: Guests back from a late dinner in the Sala Affresco probably see, before sleep, the dome's shape above Florence's scattered lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has a Signature Suite tonight watches the rain fall over Florence, the city lights spread below the dome's outline.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the Duomo-facing rooms after midnight sees Florence lit under low cloud, the dome's outline above the rooftops.

phrases.clear_predawn: The sky over Seville is only starting to brighten, and from the rooftop La Giralda is a dark outline.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop pool, La Giralda and the Old Town domes are sharp in the clear morning light.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun is strong on the rooftop, and the first swimmers are in the pool with La Giralda in view.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon turns La Giralda and the church spires orange, seen from the rooftop pool and La Terraza bar.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at La Terraza tonight, you would have a cocktail with La Giralda standing against a clear starry sky.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Seville this morning, and the Old Town domes seen from the rooftop are partly in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on La Terraza are eating tapas while clouds pass over La Giralda and the minarets of the Old Town.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights La Giralda between clouds, and the rooftop pool is at its busiest.
phrases.overcast: From the rooftop pool, La Giralda and the Old Town domes stand in the middle distance under a flat grey sky.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop pool and La Terraza, so guests watch the wet street through their glass balcony doors.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm nobody is on the rooftop, and guests wait in the reception with its hand-painted azulejo tiles.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Seville makes La Giralda a pale outline from the rooftop pool, with the nearer domes clearer.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Seville, so flakes falling on the rooftop terrace are the main subject of conversation at La Terraza.
phrases.very_cold: Nobody is swimming in the rooftop pool on this freezing clear day, and La Giralda is very clear from La Terraza.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Seville today, so most guests are in the rooftop pool while servers at La Terraza bring cold drinks.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy in Seville, so the Penthouse Apartment's private terrace on Calle Céspedes is comfortable for sitting outside.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop pool the nearer domes are clear but La Giralda is only a faint shape.
phrases.late_night: A glass of water near midnight, and the Giralda's outline is there over the lit Old Town roofs from the rooftop pool.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight the curtains are open, and through rain on the glass the Giralda's outline shows above the lit Old Town roofs.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight a low cloud covers Seville, and from the rooftop pool the Old Town lights glow around the Giralda's tall outline.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, harbor-side rooms look out on still-dark water, with the marina and its moored yachts only just taking shape.
phrases.clear_morning: Early swimmers in the indoor pool get a clear morning look at Boston Harbor through the tall glass walls around the water.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop terrace has its teal umbrellas open, and the moored yachts in the harbor sit in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop balcony now, you would see the low sun on Boston Harbor and the brick cityscape.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the waterfront outside Waterline is dark and clear, and the evening menu of New England classics is being served.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over Boston Harbor this morning, seen through the arched windows of the suites above the marina.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud and some sun over the harbor this afternoon, and the gray lounge chairs on the rooftop balcony are in use.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clouds over East Boston, seen from rooms on the North End side of the pier.
phrases.overcast: Under a gray sky, the indoor pool still gives a flat, wide view of the harbor water through its corner windows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the indoor pool, and the moored yachts in the harbor look gray and wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, the two-story lounge gives a dry seat to watch lightning over the water of Boston Harbor.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has taken most of the view today, and from the harbor-side rooms only the nearest moored yachts can be made out.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling onto the rooftop terrace, where the wicker chairs are empty and the harbor is a white-gray blur.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold clear day keeps the rooftop balcony empty, and the harbor and marina are best seen from a high-floor room.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the teal umbrellas on the rooftop terrace give shade for anyone looking out at the harbor.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, Waterline is serving New England seafood with the dark waterfront just outside its windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the harbor-side rooms the far side of the harbor is not visible, only the nearby marina.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, small lights on the moored boats are easy to watch for a long while from the arched suite windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the suite windows tonight, and the marina lights blur across Boston Harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: From the harbor-side rooms after midnight, the waterfront lights reflect on the harbor water under a low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, Cascais Bay is still dark, and a guest on an upper-floor balcony sees mostly sea and sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the Bago du Vin terrace comes with a clear Atlantic and, now and then, a ship passing far out.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the infinity pool and the Atlantic beyond it are the same shade of blue, more or less.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: The afternoon sun sits low over the Atlantic, and every balcony, even in the cheapest rooms, faces it directly.
phrases.clear_night: Stars are out above the Atlantic tonight, and a guest on an ocean-facing balcony sees dark water under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over Cascais Bay this morning, so the sea seen from the room windows changes colour every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests at the infinity pool get sun in short spells this afternoon, as clouds move over Cascais Bay and the Atlantic.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Cascais Bay turn orange, as seen from the Bago du Vin terrace.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the Atlantic today, and the sea off Cascais looks grey too, which is at least consistent.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the pool gardens today, but the glass-enclosed Bago du Vin terrace stays dry with the same Atlantic view.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Atlantic is best watched from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of an ocean-facing room, not from the balcony.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has moved in over Cascais Bay, and from the balconies the Atlantic is visible only a short distance past the promenade.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare on this coast, but if it fell, the white umbrellas by the pool would collect a little of it.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing on the balconies this morning, which is unusual here; the Atlantic below is clear and very bright.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air over Cascais today, so most guests are in the infinity pool or under the white umbrellas beside it.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night on the coast, and the balcony doors of the ocean-facing rooms can stay open until late.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: the promenade and the marina are clear from the balconies, but the horizon and cargo ships are not.
phrases.late_night: In the small hours only the marina lights mark Cascais Bay from the upper floors; dawn brings the water back.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Bago du Vin, the room's floor-to-ceiling windows show rain on the glass and town lights across Cascais Bay.
phrases.grey_evening: Hours after dinner at Bago du Vin, the floor-to-ceiling windows show the lights of Cascais along the bay under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the port-view rooms on the upper floors look over a still-dark Old Port with its sailboat masts.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light falls on the sailboats in the marina, seen from a balcony table facing Fort Saint-Jean.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the rooftop pool, and the white umbrellas are the only shade on the deck.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun lights the walls of Fort Saint-Nicolas, clearly visible from the sun loungers by the rooftop pool.
phrases.clear_night: Under a clear night sky, the Old Port is visible from the harbour terrace of Le Quai du 7ème.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over Marseille this morning, but the Old Port is still clearly in view from the upper-floor rooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the rooftop deck, the sun comes and goes between clouds, so the white umbrellas are only needed half the time.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns Fort Saint-Jean orange between the clouds, straight ahead from the balcony chairs.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the water of the Old Port looks flat and grey too, seen from the restaurant terrace.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Quai de Rive Neuve, so the port-view rooms are the dry place to watch the boats.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is passing over Marseille, and lightning over the Old Port is visible from the upper-floor windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog over the harbour hides Fort Saint-Nicolas today, and from the rooftop terrace only the nearest masts show.
phrases.snow: Snow in Marseille is rare, but today it is falling on the empty sun loungers of the rooftop pool deck.
phrases.very_cold: The air feels close to freezing, so the balcony table and chairs are empty, with the marina in clear view.
phrases.very_hot: It is a very hot afternoon in Marseille, and most guests are in the rooftop pool rather than on the loungers.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the hidden patio of Le Quai du 7ème is in use for evening dining.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so from the rooftop terrace the near side of the Old Port is clear but Fort Saint-Nicolas is not.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has a port-view room tonight has turned the light off, and the Vieux-Port quay lights show on the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Guests in the upper-floor port-view rooms watch rain run down the glass tonight, the quay lights blurred across the Vieux-Port water.
phrases.grey_evening: Guests in the upper-floor port-view rooms can watch the quay lights reflect in the Vieux-Port under tonight's low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the terrace pool is still lit blue, and the downtown towers stand dark against a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From a Gold Suite, the floor-to-ceiling windows show the downtown skyscrapers sharp and sunlit on a clear Dallas morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the Reunion Tower sphere is easy to pick out from the sunloungers beside the terrace pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the glass of the downtown towers, and guests on the terrace watch the colour change before dinner.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the skyline lights are reflected in the rooftop pool, and the red lounge chairs are mostly taken.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over downtown Dallas this morning, seen through the suite windows while breakfast arrives.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go above the skyscrapers this afternoon, and the sunloungers by the pool get sun in short stretches.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the terrace for the last hour of sun, you would see clouds lit orange above the towers.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the downtown towers look flat from the guest room desk, but the view is still complete.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the terrace pool and the rooftop herb garden; inside, the Pyramid Bar is the busier place.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests leave the pool terrace and watch lightning over the skyscrapers from the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze blurs the downtown towers today, and the Reunion Tower sphere is only a faint shape from the terrace.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Dallas, but today it settles on the red lounge chairs around the empty rooftop pool.
phrases.very_cold: Clear but very cold over Dallas today, so the gym and the spa get more guests than the terrace pool.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon in Dallas: the terrace pool is the only comfortable outdoor spot, and the sunloungers stay in full sun.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and dinner at the candlelit terrace tables goes on with the lit skyscrapers behind.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the Reunion Tower sphere is not visible from the pool, though the nearer towers are.
phrases.late_night: Through the small hours the downtown towers shine outside the Gold Suite, and the same skyline is back at sunrise.
phrases.wet_evening: With the curtain open after midnight, rain streaks the Gold Suite windows and the downtown lights blur behind it.
phrases.grey_evening: The Gold Suite curtains stay open after midnight, and the lit downtown skyscrapers show under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Empire State Building is a dark outline in the north-facing windows, with the rooftops and water towers still unlit.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun reaches the water towers on the neighborhood rooftops, seen through the steel-frame windows of the East Village rooms.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday, guests in the 14th-floor Penthouse corner suite see One World Trade Center sharp against a sky with no clouds.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun warms the red chaise lounges on the rooftop terrace, and the city skyline beyond them is lit from the side.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a north-facing room tonight, you would see the Empire State Building lit up through the oversized window.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Manhattan this morning, and from the north-facing rooms the Empire State Building is sometimes sunlit, sometimes shaded.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, the Penthouse Terrace Suite has both landmarks in view, with scattered clouds casting patches of shadow across the rooftops.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over the skyline turn orange above the rooftop terrace and its striped canopy.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the water towers on the neighborhood rooftops look flat and dull from the steel-frame windows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the glass roof of the conservatory lounge, where guests sit on wicker seats among the ivy and stay dry.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over New York, and lightning around the Empire State Building can be seen from the north-facing rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Empire State Building today, so the north-facing windows show only the nearer rooftops and water towers.
phrases.snow: White snow settles on the water towers outside the steel-frame windows, and nobody is using the red chaise lounges upstairs.
phrases.very_cold: On a very cold day, the rooftop terrace is unused, and guests look at the skyline from behind the steel-frame windows.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day, the striped canopy over the red chaise lounges is the only shade on the rooftop terrace.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night, and the private terrace of Suite 705 is comfortable enough to sit outside after a dinner at Gemma.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Empire State Building is a faint shape from the north-facing rooms, if it shows at all.
phrases.late_night: If you turned off the lights in a north-facing room now, city light around the Empire State's spire would fill the window.
phrases.wet_evening: If you carried a last drink up to a north-facing room tonight, you would see the Empire State Building through rain-streaked glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Finishing a drink in a north-facing room tonight, you would see the Empire State Building's spire above the lit city under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the floor-to-ceiling windows of every suite show a dark Atlantic and the last lights of Funchal's hillside.
phrases.clear_morning: From the infinity pool, early swimmers look straight down into Funchal Bay under a sky with no clouds at all.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the lawn loungers, and the Atlantic below the cliff is bright blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a private garden terrace now, you would see the low sun on Funchal's coastline.
phrases.clear_night: The infinity pool is lit after dark, and the city lights of Funchal sit along the bay below it.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds this morning, so the sea seen from the twin-bedded rooms changes between grey and blue every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the promontory this afternoon, and guests on the lawn loungers move in and out of shade.
phrases.partly_golden: Seen from the infinity pool edge, scattered clouds above Funchal Bay take on an orange colour as the sun drops.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Funchal today, but the view from the suites still reaches across the whole bay.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the lawn and the loungers, so guests watch the wet Atlantic from behind floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning flashes over the Atlantic right now, and from a suite window the whole storm over Funchal Bay is visible.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Funchal Bay today, so the far side of the bay is faint from the infinity pool edge.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Funchal, but if it fell today, you would watch it over the Atlantic from a suite window.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Madeira, so the lawn loungers are empty and guests keep the sea view from inside their suites.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today on the promontory, which explains why most guests are in the infinity pool rather than on the lawn.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and from a balcony table the lit hillside of Funchal is clear across the water.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the infinity pool, Funchal Bay shows directly below today, while the far coastline fades out of sight in low visibility.
phrases.late_night: Back from dinner at The Cliff Bay, you would see Funchal's lights around the bay.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in your suite tonight, you would see the lights around Funchal Bay through the rain.
phrases.grey_evening: If you were having a last drink in your suite tonight, Funchal's lights would show along the bay under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise the rooms face away from the sun, so the terraces above Praia da Galé stay in shadow for a while.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on the terrace comes with a clear view of the golden cliffs and the flat Atlantic below.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool is in full sun, and the sun loungers around it are the busiest spot.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Every room faces southwest, so right now each terrace has a direct view of the sun going down over the Atlantic.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in Suite Joia tonight, you would see stars from the Jacuzzi terrace, with no cloud over the sea.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over Praia da Galé this morning, so the breakfast terrace is sometimes in sun, sometimes in shade.
phrases.partly_afternoon: From the infinity pool this afternoon, guests see patches of blue between the clouds and a sea that is turquoise in places.
phrases.partly_golden: Some cloud sits over the Atlantic in the last hour of sun, which often makes the sunset from the terraces more colourful.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the sea off Praia da Galé looks grey, and the rooftop sauna is a sensible place to be.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the terrace furniture and the pool, and most guests have moved indoors to the Turkish bath or the restaurant.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Atlantic can be seen from every room, since all face the sea, and the pool area is empty.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water hides the horizon today, so the view from the bedroom terraces ends not far past the beach.
phrases.snow: Snow on the Algarve cliffs would be a rare sight from the terraces, and the hotel is closed from December to February.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for the Algarve, which is when the Royal Suite Alegria's heated plunge pool makes most sense.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot this afternoon, and the sun loungers by the infinity pool are mostly empty while guests stay in the water.
phrases.mild_night: A mild night with cloud over the sea, warm enough for dinner outside on the terrace under the woven pendant lights.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Guests by the infinity pool today look down on the sand of Praia da Galé while the far Atlantic horizon stays soft.
phrases.late_night: Long after the last course, only the Atlantic sounds under the Suite Joia windows.
phrases.wet_evening: After midnight, rain runs down Suite Joia's windows and the Atlantic sounds through them.
phrases.grey_evening: After midnight low cloud covers Praia da Galé, and from Suite Joia's windows only the white edge of the waves shows.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the pool terrace is empty and the thatched parasols stand dark against a pale sky over the bay.
phrases.clear_morning: From an upper terrace room, the sea toward the headland is flat and blue, and early swimmers use the private jetty.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear sky the sun is strong, so most guests stay under the thatched parasols beside the pool.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on your balcony now, you would see the hillside town across the bay turn orange in low sun.
phrases.clear_night: In the open-air lounge, the rattan pendant lights are on and the sea beyond the thatched columns is black and still.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Göltürkbükü Bay this morning, and guests on the wooden deck watch the light change on the water.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the headland this afternoon, while the loungers under the beige umbrellas stay mostly full.
phrases.partly_golden: From the terrace with the reed pergola, the last sun comes through gaps in the clouds over the headland.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over the whole bay today, so the Aegean looks grey too from the balconies, though still calm.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the pool terrace, and guests have moved to the hammam or the covered lounge seating.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the open sea is visible from the upper terraces, and nobody is using the private jetty right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the bay, so from the wooden deck the hillside town opposite is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Bodrum, but today a few flakes land on the thatched parasols and melt on the pool terrace.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air for Bodrum today; the sea is clear and bright from the balconies, but the loungers are empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot this afternoon, and most guests are in the water off the private jetty or under the reed pergola.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, and guests stay late on the sofas of the open-air lounge with the sea dark beyond.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the distant headland and the open sea beyond it cannot be seen from the terraces.
phrases.late_night: Were you in an upper-floor room now, you would be asleep, town lights across the bay on the water until dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: With a last drink at the window after midnight, you would see rain on the glass and hillside lights across the bay.
phrases.grey_evening: With a last drink in an upper-terrace room now, you would see the hillside town lit across the bay under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Arabian Gulf outside the John Jacob Suite is dark and flat, and the Corniche lights are still on.
phrases.clear_morning: From an upper Gulf-facing room, the morning sea looks turquoise all the way across to The Pearl-Qatar.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly over the private beach, and most guests have moved to the loungers under the palms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the striped pavilion of the Vilebrequin beach club, with the Gulf flat behind it.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the John Jacob terrace tonight, you would see West Bay lit up and the Gulf completely dark.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over the Gulf this morning, and the water below the step-out terrace changes colour as they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over West Bay this afternoon, so the pool gets sun for a while, then shade, then sun.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the clouds over the Gulf orange, visible from the sea-facing tables at Saffron.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Gulf outside the guest rooms is grey too, and The Pearl-Qatar looks pale across the water.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Doha, and today the step-out terraces are empty while guests watch wet West Bay from behind the glass.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Arabian Gulf is visible from the floor-to-ceiling windows, and nobody is on the private beach right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the water today, so from the suites The Pearl-Qatar is only a faint shape and the skyline is softened.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Doha, so a white layer on the pool loungers and beach pavilion would be a genuine rarity.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare cold day in Doha, the loungers by the pool stay empty and the Gulf outside is clear and bright.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over West Bay, and the few guests outside are in the pool, not on the loungers around it.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild with a cloudy sky, and the lit pool with the city lights beyond is where most guests are sitting.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short, so from the Gulf-facing rooms the near water is clear but The Pearl-Qatar across the bay is not visible.
phrases.late_night: Whoever came back from dinner at Saffron to the John Jacob Suite now sees the West Bay lights across the water.
phrases.wet_evening: Whoever has the John Jacob Suite tonight sees the West Bay lights blurred by rain on the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Anyone awake in the John Jacob Suite after midnight sees West Bay's lights along the Corniche under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop terrace at Cielo Bar is empty and St Peter's dome is already a clear shape on the horizon.
phrases.clear_morning: From a guest room balcony this morning, the Pantheon dome and Rome's rooftops stand sharp under a cloudless blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong on the Spanish Steps below, and the inner courtyard offers some shade inside the hotel.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the Cielo Bar terrace now, you would see St Peter's dome lit orange by the setting sun.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over Rome is clear, and from the suite terraces the lit dome of St Peter's is easy to find.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds move over the Altare della Patria this morning, seen from the rooftop terrace above the Spanish Steps.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun alternate over the distant hills this afternoon, and the small balcony tables are a good place to watch.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds turn orange behind St Peter's dome and the Cielo Bar terrace fills up.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky today, the view from the rooftop is flat but complete: Spanish Steps below, St Peter's dome far off.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Spanish Steps right now, and guests watch it from behind the balcony doors of their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Rome, so the rooftop umbrellas stay closed and the storm is watched from the suite living room window.
phrases.fog_haze: From the balconies today, haze hides the distant hills, though the obelisk near the hotel is still clearly visible.
phrases.snow: Snow in Rome is rare, but today it is falling on the Spanish Steps and the rooftops seen from the balconies.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing, so the Cielo Bar terrace is quiet and St Peter's dome is watched from the suite window.
phrases.very_hot: From the rooftop, heat-haze hangs over the Roman roofs between the Spanish Steps and the dome of St Peter's.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Rome, with the red-striped seats on the rooftop still occupied and the Altare della Patria lit below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop the Spanish Steps are clear but St Peter's dome and the hills are not.
phrases.late_night: Room lights off in the Suite de la Ville, the only light after midnight is the lit city around St Peter's dome.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtain is open after midnight, and rain runs down the window while the rooftops around the Spanish Steps look wet and lit.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain is open in the Suite de la Ville after midnight, and Rome's lights show under cloud toward St Peter's dome.

phrases.clear_predawn: If you were awake in a king room before dawn, you would see the Space Needle dark under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: From a king room this morning, the Space Needle, Lake Union and the mountain range all fit in one window.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sky over Seattle is fully blue, and the mountains behind the Space Needle are sharp from the sixteenth floor.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun is lighting the Space Needle, and the folding doors of the rooftop bar are open to the terrace.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Altitude Sky Lounge tonight, you would see the Space Needle lit up under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over Lake Union this morning, and the Space Needle is clear from the suite windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun alternate over the Belltown rooftops this afternoon, seen from the high-top tables on the sixteenth floor.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds around the Space Needle turn orange above the rooftop terrace seating.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Seattle today; the Space Needle is still visible from the upper rooms, but the mountains are not.
phrases.rain: Rain is running down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the rooftop bar, and guests sit near the electric fireplace instead of outside.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Lake Union is visible from the sixteenth floor, with the rooftop folding doors closed against the storm.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top of the Space Needle today, so the upper-floor windows show only the nearest Belltown rooftops.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Belltown rooftops, and the Space Needle looks white and grey from the king rooms upstairs.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside is close to freezing, and the mountain range behind the Space Needle is unusually sharp from the suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot afternoon in Seattle, so guests watch the Space Needle from inside the rooftop bar rather than the terrace.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Seattle, and the terrace seating by the rooftop bar is in use, facing the lit Space Needle.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over Seattle today: the Space Needle shows from the upper floors, but the mountain range behind it does not.
phrases.late_night: After one, the Space Needle's outline shows against the city lights from the upper-floor rooms, hard to turn away from.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Altitude Sky Lounge windows tonight, and the Space Needle's outline shows above the wet, lit rooftops of Belltown.
phrases.grey_evening: Under low cloud after midnight, the upper-floor windows show the lit Belltown rooftops and the Space Needle's saucer shape above them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the office towers around the 27th floor still show their night lights against a clear, dark sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning over Seoul, and breakfast at the top-floor C'café comes with sharp views of high-rises in every direction.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands high over Myeongdong, and the city windows of the rooms show the high-rises in flat, even light.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would watch the late sun light up the sides of the office towers.
phrases.clear_night: From a king room tonight, the lit office towers stand out clearly, with the mountain silhouette visible behind them.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds cross the morning sky above Seoul, and guests at the buffet see shadows moving over the high-rises.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud sit over the skyline this afternoon, and the treadmills in the fitness center still face a mostly clear view.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds leave some office towers lit and others in shadow, seen from the 27th floor.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Seoul today, so the view from the top-floor restaurant is flat, with the high-rises standing without shadows.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the 27th-floor restaurant, and the nearest high-rises look blurred and grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, guests at the C'café windows can watch lightning over the Seoul skyline from the top floor.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Seoul today, and from the 27th floor only the closest office towers can be made out.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Myeongdong, and from the king rooms the roofs of the nearby high-rises are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: If you stood at the 27th-floor C’café windows now, you would see hard winter light on the high-rises below.
phrases.very_hot: Seoul is very hot today, and the skyline from the 27th floor shows the high-rises in strong, hard sunlight.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night in Seoul, and from a king room the lit office towers show clearly under the cloud cover.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the 27th-floor C'café, the near Seoul high-rises stand clear in the haze while the far mountain stays hidden.
phrases.late_night: Drapes pulled back for the night, Seoul's lit office towers fill the glass beside a king bed until sleep comes.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the King room window after midnight, and Seoul's office tower lights blur behind the open curtains.
phrases.grey_evening: With the curtain left open in a King room after midnight, the office tower lights show under low cloud across Seoul.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the ocean-view rooms look out on a dark harbour where the first ferries already show their lights.
phrases.clear_morning: Yachts and ferries cross the Waitemata Harbour under a clear sky, seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows of the lounge.
phrases.clear_midday: From a balcony, the Sky Tower stands sharp against blue sky while ferries move across the harbour below the hotel.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the rooftop terrace, where guests on the transparent chairs face the historic clock tower and the skyline.
phrases.clear_night: On the 13th floor, BODA serves Korean fusion dinner while the lights of the North Shore show clearly across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds and some sun over the harbour this morning, so from the ocean-view rooms the water changes colour as they pass.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were in the lounge this afternoon, you would see ferries crossing under a sky half covered by cloud.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the clock tower in patches, visible from the rooftop terrace between passing clouds.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the Waitemata Harbour today, and guests drink espresso by the high-floor windows looking at it.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the harbour and the ferries keep running, watched from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of the bedrooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the North Shore is visible from the ocean-view rooms, and the yachts have mostly gone back to their moorings.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog on the harbour hides the North Shore today, so from BODA on the 13th floor only the nearest water shows.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare in Auckland, so if flakes did reach the rooftop terrace, guests would be photographing them.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Auckland, with clear air over the harbour and the ferries looking unusually sharp from the ocean-view rooms.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot on the balcony today, so the yachts on the harbour are watched mostly from behind the bedroom windows.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and ferry lights cross the harbour in front of the BODA tables on the 13th floor.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Low visibility today, so from the ocean-view rooms the North Shore is a faint shape and only nearer ferries show clearly.
phrases.late_night: In an ocean-view room you would sleep through the harbour lights tonight and wake to ferries on Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in the lounge, rain on the glass would blur the ferry lights on Waitemata Harbour.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in the lounge now, you would see North Shore lights across Waitemata Harbour under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the arched windows of the atrium show a dark, clear sky over Budapest, and the café is still closed.
phrases.clear_morning: Sunlight comes through the arched windows of the atrium and lights the gilded ceiling while the first guests sit down.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the restored arcade is bright, and from a corner suite the Franciscan church stands in full sun.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From a corner suite, low sun hits the Franciscan church across the street, while the Moorish ceiling inside stays in shade.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see a clear sky over the Franciscan church from a corner suite window.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the city this morning, seen through the arched windows of the atrium during coffee.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go this afternoon, and the living room's floor-to-ceiling windows give a changing light on the historic buildings opposite.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky above the Franciscan church seen from a corner suite.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey daytime sky, flat light comes through the arched atrium windows onto the gilded Moorish ceiling of the passage.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the street outside the corner suites, and guests move to the Párisi Passage Café, which is covered.
phrases.thunderstorm: Late at night, lightning over the Franciscan church lights the wet street below the corner suite windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of the historic buildings opposite the living room windows, so the gilded ceiling gets more attention than usual.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Franciscan church, visible from the corner suites, while the spa plunge pool stays warm indoors.
phrases.very_cold: From the corner suite windows, hard winter light falls across the Franciscan church and the frosted street below.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the shaded passage and the indoor pool are where most guests spend the daylight hours.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and a few guests still sit at the Párisi Passage Café under the Moorish ceiling.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the living room windows the far side of Budapest is not visible, only the historic buildings.
