phrases.late_night: Sleep comes easily in the corner suite after midnight; street lights show the Franciscan church's outline, and dawn will show the rest.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the corner suite windows after midnight, and the wet street lights blur around the Franciscan church.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud covers Budapest after midnight, and the corner suite windows show the Franciscan church's outline against the street lights.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Washington Channel is dark and quiet outside the Waterfront View rooms, with the Jefferson Memorial visible across the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From the Waterfront View rooms, morning sun lights the Potomac River and the Jefferson Memorial under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Around midday the rooftop pool at WAVES is in full sun, and the Jefferson Memorial stands out sharply across the channel.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were on a balcony now, you would see low sun on the marina yachts and the Virginia treeline.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the Jefferson Memorial is lit across the water, and guests at the WAVES rooftop bar have a clear view of it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds drift over the Capitol dome this morning, seen from the rooftop, with gaps of blue sky between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Scattered clouds pass over the Potomac this afternoon, and the rooftop loungers get sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the Jefferson Memorial sits under broken cloud, seen through the Waterfront View room windows.
phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the marina yachts and the Jefferson Memorial look dull but clear from the Waterfront View rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Washington Channel, and from the Waterfront View room windows the water taxis keep running through it.
phrases.thunderstorm: With thunder over the Potomac, the rooftop pool stays empty and guests watch the lightning from their room windows instead.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on the channel today, so the Jefferson Memorial is hidden and only the nearest yachts show from the balconies.
phrases.snow: Snow settles on the rooftop loungers at WAVES, and the Jefferson Memorial across the channel is only partly visible.
phrases.very_cold: The air outside feels close to freezing, so the rooftop loungers sit empty while guests watch the river from the fitness center.
phrases.very_hot: Most people at WAVES are in the infinity pool this very hot afternoon, not on the loungers beside it.
phrases.mild_night: It is a mild cloudy night at the WAVES rooftop bar, and boat lights are moving along the Washington Channel below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is reduced today, so the Jefferson Memorial still shows from the rooftop but the Capitol dome is only a faint shape.
phrases.late_night: Well after midnight the marina lights shine on the Potomac in the Waterfront View rooms' windows, no reason yet to stop looking.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Willowsong, the Waterfront View rooms show rain on the glass and boat lights on the Potomac.
phrases.grey_evening: After a late dinner at Willowsong, the Waterfront View windows show marina lights on the Potomac under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Canton Tower lights are still on, and the Pearl River still looks dark from the Club rooms.
phrases.clear_morning: From the classic suite's three tall windows, Canton Tower is fully visible against a clear sky this morning.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the outdoor heated pool is in full sun, with the glass skyscrapers around it reflecting the light.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the IFC tower and the Opera House, seen from the windows that overlook the Tianhe CBD.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight Canton Tower is lit up, and the city view from the Churchill Bar is clear for anyone ordering a single malt.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over Pearl River New City this morning, but Canton Tower stays in view from the Club Lounge windows.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Some cloud this afternoon, so the pool between the hedge walls gets sun for a few minutes and then shade.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in a Club Canton Tower River room, you would see the last sun on the river between the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Grey sky over Guangzhou today, and from the floor-to-ceiling windows Canton Tower has no blue behind it.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Pearl River and on the outdoor pool, which stays heated between its columns in any weather.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the city, and lightning shows up now and then behind Canton Tower from the guest room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits over Guangzhou, so Canton Tower is only an outline from the Club rooms and the river is hard to see.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Guangzhou, but today a few flakes pass the suite's tall windows and fall toward the Pearl River.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing outside today, unusual for Guangzhou, and steam rises off the heated outdoor pool.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Guangzhou this afternoon, and the outdoor pool between the hedge walls is the only reasonable place to be outside.
phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, and from the guest room windows Canton Tower is lit in colour under the low cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: Canton Tower is there across the river, but the IFC tower and the far skyline are not clear.
phrases.late_night: City lights show on the Pearl River after midnight, and dawn will put Canton Tower in the Club Canton Tower River windows.
phrases.wet_evening: Curtains open late in a Club Canton Tower River room, rain streaks the glass and city lights blur on the Pearl River.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtain is open in a Club Canton Tower River room, the tower's slim shape above the lit river under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the 33rd-floor lounge looks out on a dark Umeda, with the Hep Five Ferris Wheel not yet lit.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning in Osaka: Club guests eat their complimentary breakfast while the Ferris wheel stands sharp against a blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday sun over Umeda shows the Osaka skyline clearly from the upper-floor rooms, and the river is visible too.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the corner windows of the twin rooms, and the Hep Five Ferris Wheel turns slowly in warm light.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the soaking tub tonight, you would see the lit Ferris wheel, the river, and a clear city skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Broken cloud over Umeda this morning, and the Hep Five Ferris Wheel appears between the gaps for Club guests in the lounge.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, patches of sun move across the Osaka skyline, seen from the suite living room's floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the clouds over Osaka orange, and from the 34th-floor Club rooms the skyline goes dark slowly.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Umeda looks flat and quiet from the upper floors, and the Ferris wheel is the only colour.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the corner windows of the twin rooms, and guests arrive dry through the connection to Hankyu Umeda Station.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm over Osaka, each flash shows the Hep Five Ferris Wheel for a moment to guests in the Club lounge.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the far edge of the Osaka skyline today, though the Hep Five Ferris Wheel nearby still shows from the lounge.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on Umeda, a rare sight, and the Ferris wheel turns with white flakes passing the suite windows.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside in Osaka, and the cold air makes the skyline unusually sharp from the 34th floor.
phrases.very_hot: A very hot day in Osaka, and the soaking tub with its skyline view is a cooler option than Umeda's streets.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night the city lights of Osaka spread below the suite living room windows, river and Ferris wheel included.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the distant Osaka skyline is missing from the upper rooms, but the nearby Ferris wheel remains clear.
phrases.late_night: If you were in a Club room now, you might leave the curtain open and fall asleep facing Umeda's lights below.
phrases.wet_evening: If you took a last drink to a Club room window now, rain would blur the Hep Five wheel and Umeda's lights.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink in a Club room tonight, you would see Umeda's lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balcony rooms look at the Arco da Rua Augusta clock face with the Tagus still dark behind.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop terrace this morning, the terracotta roofs toward São Jorge Castle are sharp under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is straight over Praça do Comércio, and the Tagus shows bright and flat from the balconies.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light turns the roofs rising toward Lisbon Cathedral orange, seen from the rooftop bar's yellow sofas.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the balcony tonight, you would see the arch's clock face close up and the Tagus dark behind it.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Tagus this morning, and the rooftop restaurant terrace gets sun in short periods between them.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Partly cloudy over Praça do Comércio this afternoon, and the rooftop bar's tile mural is sometimes in shade, sometimes in sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds put patches of light on the river below the arch, seen from the terrace.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Lisbon today, and from the balcony the Tagus looks grey too, with the arch standing out against it.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Praça do Comércio, so guests watch the wet square from their rooms rather than from the open rooftop.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Tagus, and the rooftop bar, which has no roof, is empty while guests watch from their rooms.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the river today, and from the balcony the arch's clock face is clear while the Tagus behind it is not.
phrases.snow: Snow in Lisbon is rare, but if it fell today, the rooftop bar's checkered floor would be white and the terrace empty.
phrases.very_cold: It is close to freezing outside, rare for Lisbon, and the rooftop terrace is bright, clear and mostly empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot over Praça do Comércio today, and the yellow sofas of the rooftop bar sit in full sun with no takers.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and guests on the rooftop terrace have the arch and the dark Tagus below them.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the rooftop the arch is clear but the far bank of the Tagus is not.
phrases.late_night: Guests in the river-facing rooms are rightly asleep now, the Tagus below the square showing the city lights until dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in a river-facing room after midnight watches rain fall over the Tagus, the waterfront lights blurred on wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever is awake in a river room after midnight watches low cloud pass over the Tagus, the waterfront lights under it.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the high-floor lounge, before sunrise, the Danube is a dark line and the DC Tower lights are still on.
phrases.clear_morning: Clear morning light reaches the Vienna Hills, and guests on the high floors can easily pick out the Donauturm.
phrases.clear_midday: Midday brings a completely clear sky over Vienna, so everything between the Donauturm and the Steffl can be seen from upstairs today.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun hits the glass towers of the Vienna International Centre, which guests in the high-floor restaurant can see at their tables.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a high-floor suite tonight, you would see the DC Tower lit up and the Danube below it.
phrases.partly_morning: Some clouds sit over the Vienna Hills this morning, while the Danube and Donaupark below the upper floors are in full sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the DC Tower skyline this afternoon, and the lounge's floor-to-ceiling windows show patches of sun on the river.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds turn orange over the Vienna Hills, a view guests have from the restaurant tables.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Vienna, so the Danube and DC Tower stay visible from upstairs but the Vienna Hills are harder to see.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the high-floor suites, and the Danube below looks grey rather than blue.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Donaustadt, and from the lounge guests watch lightning behind the DC Tower through the glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the Vienna Hills today, and from the upper floors only the nearest glass towers and the river are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling over Donaupark, and from the high-floor restaurant the Danube and DC Tower are visible but less sharp.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it is very cold but clear, so the whole line from the Donauturm to the Steffl is visible from upstairs.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day in Vienna, guests in the high-floor lounge watch the Danube through the glass rather than go out.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, and the DC Tower lights are the main thing to see from the suite windows.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so the Vienna Hills and Steffl are out of view, though the DC Tower and Danube remain clear.
phrases.late_night: The suite curtain stays open on purpose after midnight, and the lights along the Danube are the last thing seen before sleep.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, the high-floor suite shows rain on its wide windows and the lit city blurred along the Danube.
phrases.grey_evening: Dinner done upstairs, the suite windows show low cloud over Donaustadt and the lit city reflected in the Danube.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before the sun is up, a high corner room shows downtown towers with only scattered lit windows under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun lights the Arts District, then the office towers behind it, seen from a corner king high up.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the rooftop pool is in full sun, and every downtown tower shows clearly against a blue sky.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun turns the glass of the downtown towers orange, seen from the Museum Suites and Vincent's Skybar.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at Vincent's Skybar tonight, you would see the lit downtown towers under a clear sky, without a cloud.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over the Arts District this morning, and guests on the treadmills watch them between the high-rises.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds and sun alternate over downtown this afternoon, so the cabanas by the rooftop pool get extra shade at times.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over downtown turn pink above the terrace of Vincent's Skybar.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the downtown high-rises look dull from the fitness center windows, and the rooftop pool stays quiet.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass of the corner rooms, and the downtown towers appear blurred through the wet windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over downtown Dallas is visible from the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows, a safer seat than the open-air Skybar terrace.
phrases.fog_haze: Today's haze over Dallas hides the tops of the taller downtown towers, even for guests in high corner rooms.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Dallas, but today it falls past the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Museum Suites onto the Arts District.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold, clear day, steam rises from the heated rooftop pool while the downtown towers remain clear behind it.
phrases.very_hot: Dallas is very hot today, and most guests at the rooftop pool are in the water or under the draped cabanas.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, so the open-air Skybar terrace is comfortable in a light shirt, with downtown lit below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the corner rooms the nearest downtown towers are clear but the farther skyline is not.
phrases.late_night: Back in a corner king after a drink at Vincent's Skybar, you would see the lit downtown towers beyond the Arts District.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were up at Vincent's Skybar for a last drink tonight, rain would blur the cathedral and the downtown towers.
phrases.grey_evening: If you looked out from the eleventh floor tonight, by Vincent's Skybar, you would see the downtown towers lit under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Chao Phraya is already busy with boats, visible from the Thai Suite on the 36th floor.
phrases.clear_morning: Guests on the riverside terrace have a clear morning view of the river while the shuttle boat leaves for ICONSIAM.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is strong, and the shaded seating on the riverside terrace is where guests watch the river.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From a Grand Deluxe balcony, the late sun lights the Bangkok skyline across the Chao Phraya before it sets.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the Thai Suite tonight, you would see the skyline lit up and boat lights moving on the river.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Bangkok this morning, and the riverside pool already has its first swimmers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the clouds give short breaks from the sun, useful for anyone on a floating mat in the riverside pool.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun comes through gaps in the clouds, and the river changes colour below the Thai Suite windows.
phrases.overcast: From the 36th-floor Thai Suite you would see the Chao Phraya flat and grey under low cloud, boats passing the hotel pier.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Chao Phraya, and guests watch it from behind the panoramic windows of the suites.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over Bangkok empties the riverside terrace, while lightning over the skyline is easy to see from the suites.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Bangkok today, and the far part of the skyline is only a soft outline from the Thai Suite.
phrases.snow: Snow in Bangkok would be a first, but the Thai Suite windows would still frame the river and the skyline.
phrases.very_cold: From the 36th-floor Thai Suite, the Chao Phraya River lies in hard winter light below the empty riverside terrace.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Bangkok, and most guests are either in the riverside pool or under the shaded seating.
phrases.mild_night: On this mild cloudy night, the Grand Deluxe balconies are comfortable places to watch boats pass on the river.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the pool the near river is clear but the far skyline is mostly hidden.
phrases.late_night: The Thai Suite's curtain is left open on purpose at bedtime, and the skyline lights reflect in the Chao Phraya.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the Thai Suite's windows, and the lights along the Chao Phraya look blurred on the water.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, the Thai Suite windows show the skyline lights under low cloud, reflected on the Chao Phraya.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Nile shows as a dark strip under the spa's circular arched window, with the city lights still on.
phrases.clear_morning: Warm morning light reaches the balconies above the tree canopy, and early swimmers are already on the fourth-floor pool terrace.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun stands high over the Nile, and the complimentary cabanas by the fourth-floor pool are the shaded option.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in a Nile-view suite now, you would see the river turn gold and the pyramids outlined against the sky.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the city lights show along the Nile from the riverside dinner tables, where tea comes in brass pots.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit over Giza this morning, and the tree canopy below the balconies looks green and fresh.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds cross the skyline seen from the guest room balconies, and the Nile is in sun one minute and shade the next.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun colours the clouds over the pyramids orange and pink, seen from the Nile-view suites.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Nile looks flat and brown from the spa's circular window, and the pool terrace is quiet.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Cairo, but today it is falling on the fourth-floor pool and the gardens below it.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the Nile means the pool terrace is empty, and guests watch the lightning from the restaurants and suites.
phrases.fog_haze: Morning haze over Giza softens the city skyline, though the Nile is still clear from the spa's circular arched window.
phrases.snow: Snow in Cairo is almost unheard of, so if flakes fell today, guests would watch them from the balconies in disbelief.
phrases.very_cold: Guests in the Nile suites this cold afternoon look across the river from Giza under hard winter light.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot in Giza today, so the complimentary pool cabanas fill early and the Nile is watched from the shade.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Cairo, with the city lights along the Nile still clear from the riverside dinner tables.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today, so the pyramids and the far skyline are not visible, though the Nile below the spa window is.
phrases.late_night: In a Nile-view suite the curtain stays open on purpose tonight, and the city lights show on the river.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtains in the Nile-view suites are open after midnight, and the city lights across the river show through wet glass.
phrases.grey_evening: The curtains are open late in a Nile-view suite, and the city lights show along the river under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Seahorse suite's balcony shows Lion's Head as a dark shape against a clear sky over Camps Bay.
phrases.clear_morning: From the terrace this morning, Lion's Head and Hout Bay harbour are both clearly visible under a blue sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the outdoor pool is in full sun, and the Atlantic below Camps Bay looks very bright and blue.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Toward sunset, the terrace fills with guests holding their free drinks, watching the sun go down over the Atlantic.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the hot tub tonight, you would see stars over the ocean and no clouds at all.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds sit above Lion's Head this morning, seen straight from the Seahorse suite's top-floor balcony.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, patches of cloud move over Camps Bay, and the floor-to-ceiling windows frame the rocky coastline in changing light.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the Atlantic turns orange above the terrace plunge pool.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, Lion's Head is still visible from the balconies, though the sea looks flat and dull today.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Camps Bay, so guests are indoors, watching the wet rocky shoreline through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, the terrace is empty, and lightning over the Atlantic can be seen from the room balconies.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides most of Lion's Head today, and from the Seahorse balcony only the nearest rocks show below.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare in Camps Bay, but if it fell today, you would watch it from the terrace, not the pool.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold clear day, the hot tub is the warmest spot with a view of the Atlantic.
phrases.very_hot: From the Seahorse suite balcony, afternoon heat-haze blurs the slopes of Lion's Head above the rocky Camps Bay shoreline.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars on this mild night, but guests still sit on the terrace with their evening drinks.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Hout Bay harbour cannot be seen from the terrace, though Lion's Head remains clear.
phrases.late_night: The Seahorse suite after midnight has the Camps Bay lights along the water and the shape of Lion's Head in its window.
phrases.wet_evening: Back from dinner, rain streaks the Seahorse suite windows, and the lights of Camps Bay look blurred along the shore.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner, low cloud covers Lion's Head, and the Camps Bay shore lights are visible from the Seahorse suite.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the North Shore Mountains show as a dark line from the north-facing balconies, with Burrard Inlet still unlit.
phrases.clear_morning: The North Shore Mountains stand sharp above Burrard Inlet this morning, seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows of north-facing suites.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the white dome of BC Place is bright under a clear sky from the city-view King rooms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the north-facing balconies, late afternoon sun lights the snow on the North Shore Mountains above Burrard Inlet.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the lights of BC Place and the downtown towers from the heated outdoor pool.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cover the tops of the North Shore Mountains this morning, so only the lower slopes show from the harbour-facing suites.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon patches of sun and shadow move across Burrard Inlet, visible from the north-facing suite balconies.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud above the North Shore Mountains turns pink, a view included with the north-facing suites.
phrases.overcast: If you were on a north-facing balcony now, you would see the North Shore Mountains grey and flat above Burrard Inlet.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows right now, and the soaker tub in every suite is a sensible indoor alternative.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Burrard Inlet shows from the north-facing suites, and the pool deck is not the place to be right now.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the North Shore Mountains today, and from the north-facing balconies the view ends somewhere over Burrard Inlet.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the pool deck while the heated saltwater pool stays open, steam rising above the water.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air over Burrard Inlet today, and the snow-capped North Shore Mountains look very sharp from the north-facing suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the third-floor saltwater pool is the busiest part of the hotel, BC Place in view.
phrases.mild_night: The night is warm and cloudy, and guests in the third-floor whirlpool can see the lit dome of BC Place.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the north-facing balconies Burrard Inlet is clear but the North Shore Mountains are not.
phrases.late_night: Up late in a north-facing suite, you could watch North Shore lights across Burrard Inlet.
phrases.wet_evening: If you were having a last drink in a north-facing suite, rain on the glass would blur the lights across Burrard Inlet.
phrases.grey_evening: If you poured a last drink in a north-facing suite tonight, you would see harbour lights under low cloud over Burrard Inlet.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Ocean Suite balconies look out on a dark Indian Ocean with no one yet on Seminyak Beach.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning light reaches the water in front of the Ocean Suites while the beach is still almost empty.
phrases.clear_midday: High sun over the Indian Ocean at midday, and the pool water is nearly the same colour as the sea.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were in the restaurant now, you would watch the sun drop toward the Indian Ocean behind the palm trees.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the lit pathways through the gardens are the brightest thing, and the ocean beyond the pool is heard more than seen.
phrases.partly_morning: From a guest room behind the bamboo screens, white clouds sit over the Indian Ocean this morning without blocking the sun.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Swimmers in the infinity pool get short breaks of shade this afternoon as broken cloud crosses the Indian Ocean.
phrases.partly_golden: Orange light comes through gaps in the cloud over the water, and the Ocean Suite terraces face it directly.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Indian Ocean looks grey too, but the floor-to-ceiling windows of the suites still frame the whole beach.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Seminyak Beach right now, and most guests watch the waves from their rooms instead of the sand.
phrases.thunderstorm: A storm is over the Indian Ocean, and from the ocean suites you can see lightning far out past the waves.
phrases.fog_haze: In today's haze, the Indian Ocean beyond the infinity pool fades to pale grey well before the horizon.
phrases.snow: Snow does not happen in Bali, so any white near the infinity pool today is sea foam, not snow.
phrases.very_cold: From the Ocean Suite windows, hard cold daylight falls on the Indian Ocean and the empty infinity pool.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot outside today, so most guests take in the ocean view from inside the infinity pool, not the sand.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Burj Khalifa stands dark against a clear sky in the north-facing corner suites' double-height windows.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop infinity pool, early swimmers see Sheikh Zayed Road towers in sharp morning light under a cloudless sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun is directly overhead, and the white boulder sculptures on the pool deck cast almost no shadow.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: South-facing rooms get the low sun now, with the highway interchanges and the Gulf coastline turning gold before sunset.
phrases.clear_night: In the cocktail lounge, guests watch the lit Burj Khalifa and the traffic on Sheikh Zayed Road through angled windows.
phrases.partly_morning: Morning sun comes and goes on the rooftop infinity pool as broken cloud moves over the Sheikh Zayed Road skyscrapers.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds move across the afternoon sky, so the sun loungers by the infinity pool get shade now and then.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were in a north-facing corner suite now, you would see the last sun hitting the Burj Khalifa between scattered clouds.
phrases.overcast: Grey cloud covers Dubai today, and the top of the Burj Khalifa is likely hidden from the corner suites.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Dubai, and today the latticed bathroom windows show streaks of water instead of clear daylight.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Sheikh Zayed Road shows through the king room windows, and nobody is using the rooftop pool deck.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the city today, and from the corner suites the Burj Khalifa looks pale and flat.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Dubai, but if it did, the rooftop pool deck would give a clear view of it falling.
phrases.very_cold: The air feels close to freezing today, so the sun loungers and white umbrellas on the pool deck are mostly empty.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot day in Dubai, and most guests by the rooftop infinity pool are in the water rather than on the loungers.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the live tasting menu in the Club Lounge is a reasonable alternative to the pool deck.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low, so the Gulf coastline cannot be seen from the south-facing rooms, while the close Burj Khalifa still shows.
phrases.late_night: Room lights off in a north-facing corner suite, the skyline glow around the Burj Khalifa's spire is the only light left.
phrases.wet_evening: The curtain is open in a north-facing corner suite, and rain on the double-height window blurs the Burj Khalifa's spire.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains open after midnight, a north-facing corner suite's double-height window shows the Burj Khalifa's spire and the lit city under cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Passion Suite terrace looks onto a dark Aegean, with the small island only a shape.
phrases.clear_morning: From the tall windows of the four-poster bedroom, the rooftops of Mykonos town are already bright in morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the infinity pool is the sensible place, with sailboats and distant islands sharp in the strong light.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the white stepped terraces, and from the pool the superyachts stay visible until the sun goes down.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in the pergola hot tub tonight, you would see stars over the Aegean and the small island.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds pass over Mykonos bay this morning, seen from the balcony with the blue-trimmed chairs.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds come and go over the Aegean this afternoon, so the pool terrace gets sun in intervals.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud over the rocky headland gives the poolside tables of Efisia changing light.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the turquoise of the Aegean is less turquoise, though the infinity pool still works as a pool.
phrases.rain: Rain on Mykonos today, so the lounge with the cobalt blue sofas and sea mirrors is busier than the loungers.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the Aegean, and guests watch it from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows rather than from the pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze softens the view today; from the pool the distant islands are faint while the rocky headland stays clear.
phrases.snow: Snow on Mykonos is rare, but today it falls on the pine tree and the stepped terraces, which were already white.
phrases.very_cold: Cold air over the island today, and the pergola hot tub is the only outdoor space in much use.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, and guests stay in the infinity pool, where the view of the sailboats comes with cooler water.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the Passion Suite jacuzzi terrace is comfortable even without stars above the Aegean.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today: from the pool the small island and the distant islands cannot be seen, only the nearer rocks.
phrases.late_night: Mykonos town lights across the bay make staying up after midnight in the Passion Suite easy.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner at Efisia, the Passion Suite windows show rain on the glass and the town lights across the bay.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner at Efisia, the Passion Suite windows show the lights of Mykonos town under tonight's low cloud over the bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies on the upper floors face a dark Pacific with a thin pale band along the east.
phrases.clear_morning: From the 75th-floor Ocean Sky Suite, the morning sun is already on the water and the sand of Surfers Paradise Beach.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the outdoor pool sundeck is in full sun, and the ocean below the tower shows its brightest turquoise.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late in the afternoon, the tower's shadow stretches toward the beach while guests on the COAST rooftop terrace watch the sea.
phrases.clear_night: At night the city lights of the Gold Coast skyline spread below the suites, and the ocean is a dark flat space.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the coast this morning, moving their shadows across the surf seen from the high-floor bedrooms.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on a balcony this afternoon, you would see patches of sun and cloud shade moving along the coastal road.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds above the skyline pick up gold and purple, visible from the living room windows.
phrases.overcast: From the floor-to-ceiling windows now, you would see the grey Pacific meet a flat grey sky above Surfers Paradise Beach.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Surfers Paradise Beach, and the glass walls of the indoor pool keep it off the water inside.
phrases.thunderstorm: From the 75th-floor Ocean Sky Suite, lightning over the Pacific appears at almost the same height as the windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze covers the coast today, so from the rooftop terrace the beach is visible but the far coastline is not.
phrases.snow: Snow is almost unknown in Surfers Paradise, so a few flakes outside the balcony windows would surprise every guest in the building.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare cold day for the Gold Coast, the outdoor pool sundeck stays empty and the beach below has few swimmers.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Surfers Paradise, and from the upper suites the beach looks crowded along the water's edge.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild cloudy night, the COAST rooftop bar looks out on the Gold Coast city lights with no stars above.
phrases.reduced_visibility: From the 75th-floor windows, Surfers Paradise Beach and the near surf show clearly, but haze hides the far ocean horizon today.
phrases.late_night: Sleep is right in the Ocean Sky Suite now; Gold Coast lights fill its windows until the Pacific shows at dawn.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the Ocean Sky Suite after midnight, and the Surfers Paradise lights blur along the beach.
phrases.grey_evening: Cloud moves over Surfers Paradise after midnight, and the skyline lights along the beach show under it from the Ocean Sky Suite.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Sea Link's lights are still on, and the sea below the Serene Infinity rooms is dark and flat.
phrases.clear_morning: From the higher floors, the bridge and the Arabian Sea are both sharp this morning, with nothing in the way.
phrases.clear_midday: The outdoor pool is the sensible place at noon: white umbrellas, striped loungers, and the sea in full sun beyond the palms.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: From the Serene Infinity Sea View rooms, the Bandra-Worli Sea Link stands clear over the Arabian Sea in low afternoon sun.
phrases.clear_night: If you were on the rooftop terrace tonight, you would see the Sea Link lit up and the skyline across the water.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move over the Arabian Sea this morning, so the water is sometimes in sun, sometimes grey, from the sea-facing fitness centre.
phrases.partly_afternoon: By mid-afternoon, broken cloud sits over the bay, and the Luxury Suite Sea View windows show patches of bright water.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken cloud sits over the Arabian Sea and the Bandra-Worli Sea Link below the Taj Club Lounge.
phrases.overcast: Full grey cloud over Mumbai today, but the Sea Link is still visible from the higher floors above a flat, grey sea.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the sea, and the floor-to-ceiling windows of the sea view rooms are the dry place to watch it.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the sea right now, so the Atrium Bar and Lounge is busier than the rooftop terrace, for obvious reasons.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the water today, and from the guest rooms the Sea Link is a faint grey line rather than a bridge.
phrases.snow: Snow does not happen in Mumbai, but if it ever did, the pool loungers would be the first things to go white.
phrases.very_cold: From the Serene Infinity rooms, hard winter light falls on the Sea Link and the Arabian Sea in one frame.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot over Bandra today, and most guests are in the elevated pool or under its white umbrellas, with the sea beyond.
phrases.mild_night: Mild and cloudy tonight, the hot jacuzzi is open, and from the rooftop terrace the Sea Link lights show under the cloud.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the near sea is clear from the suites but the skyline across the water cannot be seen.
phrases.late_night: Up for water after midnight, a Serene Infinity room would show you city lights across the water past the Sea Link's curve.
phrases.wet_evening: If you carried a last drink up to a Sea View room, rain on the glass would blur the Sea Link's towers.
phrases.grey_evening: With a last drink in a sea-view room now, you would see the Sea Link's cables and city lights under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lake-facing rooms look out on a dark Leopoldskroner Weiher, with the Fortress Hohensalzburg a shape on its ridge.
phrases.clear_morning: From the panoramic balcony this morning, the Alps and the Fortress Hohensalzburg stand clear across the still water of the lake.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a midday sun, the balcony gives a clear view of the fortress and the Alps across the lake.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light falls on the Fortress Hohensalzburg, and the lake-facing rooms get the warm colours across the water.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the sky over the lake is clear, and from the balcony the stars are visible above the Alps.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Alps this morning, and the lake-facing rooms get a light that changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on the panoramic balcony this afternoon, you would see the fortress between moving clouds over Salzburg.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, parts of the Alps are lit and parts in cloud shadow, seen from the lake-facing rooms.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over the Leopoldskroner Weiher today, and the fortress on its ridge looks flat and far from the balcony.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the lake and the formal gardens, so guests watch it from the arched windows of the dining hall.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder rolls over the Alps, and from the lake-facing rooms lightning shows the fortress for a second at a time.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog on the Leopoldskroner Weiher today hides the Alps, and from the balcony only the near pine trees are visible.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the formal gardens and the lake, and through the white-framed windows the Alps are mostly lost in it.
phrases.very_cold: Very cold air sits over the lake today, and the snow-capped Alps and the fortress look sharp from the panoramic balcony.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot day in Salzburg, the lake-facing rooms look out on a still Leopoldskroner Weiher and the Alps beyond.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Salzburg, and the lanterns at the palace entrance are the brightest thing seen from the gardens.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so from the balcony the lake and pine trees are clear but the Alps and fortress are not.
phrases.late_night: Near midnight, a glass of water at a lake-facing window, and Hohensalzburg shows on its ridge above the city lights.
phrases.wet_evening: With curtains open after midnight, rain streaks the lake-facing windows and the city lights show across the water below the fortress ridge.
phrases.grey_evening: Curtains in the lake-facing rooms are open after midnight, and the city glows under low cloud below the fortress ridge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the lake is still dark from the balconies, and Isola Comacina is only a flat shape on the water.
phrases.clear_morning: From the terrace breakfast tables, the mountains across Lake Como show sharp edges, and the village on the shore is clearly visible.
phrases.clear_midday: Bright sun falls on the terrace at midday, and the copper-domed pavilion and the garden pool both get their share of it.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon light reaches the Grand Suite balcony, and Isola Comacina turns warm-coloured across the water before the sun goes down.
phrases.clear_night: If you were at GAIA Bar tonight, you would see a clear sky over the lake and stars above the Alpine peaks.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds sit on some of the mountain tops this morning, but the lake in front of the lounge windows is calm.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Sun and cloud take turns over the terrace this afternoon, so the sun loungers get shade without anyone moving them.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, gaps in the cloud light up parts of the mountains across the lake from the balconies.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the lake looks grey-blue from the terrace breakfast tables, and the forested mountains keep their green.
phrases.rain: With rain on Lake Como today, lunch and dinner are served indoors behind glass walls, with the water still in full view.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the lake, and from the lounge's floor-to-ceiling windows guests can watch lightning above the mountains.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog on Lake Como today hides Isola Comacina from the Grand Suite, leaving only the nearest water in view.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the Alpine peaks and on the terrace loungers, so the deep marble bathtubs get more use than the pool.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing air over the lake today, and the Alpine peaks look very sharp from the balcony of the Grand Suite.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon the garden pool is the busiest spot, with the lake and mountains visible from the water.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and the terrace is still comfortable for a cocktail from GAIA Bar with the dark lake below.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the Alpine peaks and the far shore cannot be seen from the terrace, only Isola Comacina nearby.
phrases.late_night: After midnight, dinner over, the Grand Suite window shows village lights across the lake.
phrases.wet_evening: After dinner, rain runs down the Grand Suite's glass doors, and village lights across Lake Como blur in the wet.
phrases.grey_evening: After dinner in the glass dining room, the Grand Suite window shows village lights across the lake under low cloud.

phrases.clear_predawn: Breakfast has already started in the restaurant, and the sky over Guanabara Bay is beginning to lighten before sunrise.
phrases.clear_morning: From the rooftop terrace, Sugarloaf Mountain stands sharp across the bay in the clear morning sun.
phrases.clear_midday: Under a clear midday sky, the rooftop pool is the coolest place to look at Sugarloaf and Guanabara Bay.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: On the rooftop terrace, guests on the striped sofas under the teak pergola watch the sun drop toward Rio's hills.
phrases.clear_night: At night the city lights of Rio fill the guest room window, and the bay below them is dark water.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds pass over the bay while breakfast is served behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of the restaurant.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon a few clouds move over Sugarloaf, and the wicker chairs on the terrace are mostly in sun.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, clouds over Rio's hills turn orange, seen from the rooftop pool terrace.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Guanabara Bay today, and Sugarloaf Mountain looks flatter than usual from the rooftop.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Guanabara Bay, and the restaurant's indoor palms are the closest guests get to any greenery today.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Guanabara Bay is best watched from inside the restaurant, behind its floor-to-ceiling windows, not from the pool.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the bay hides most of Sugarloaf Mountain today, so the view from the breakfast space is shorter than usual.
phrases.snow: Snow is not something Rio sees, but if it fell today, guests would watch it from the rooftop pool with disbelief.
phrases.very_cold: A rare very cold day in Rio: the rooftop pool stays empty while Sugarloaf is watched from the restaurant windows.
phrases.very_hot: In the very hot afternoon, most guests are in the rooftop pool, looking at Guanabara Bay with only their heads above water.
phrases.mild_night: The rooftop terrace is open on this mild cloudy night, and guests on the striped sofas face Rio's city lights.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today: Sugarloaf is only a faint shape from the rooftop, and Corcovado is not visible from the rooms.
phrases.late_night: If you turned off every light now, the only glow would be the lit shore under Sugarloaf, across Guanabara Bay.
phrases.wet_evening: If you had a last drink at your room window tonight, you would see rain over Guanabara Bay and Sugarloaf behind.
phrases.grey_evening: If you had a last drink at the room window now, you would see cloud on Sugarloaf and lights around the bay.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Stadtpark under the park-side suites is still dark, and the thermal pool is already lit for early swimmers.
phrases.clear_morning: From the corner suite, the arched windows show St. Stephen's spire sharp against a clear blue morning sky.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the sun sits high over the Stadtpark, and guests in park-side suites see the trees and the Ringstrasse clearly.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the green dome of Karlskirche, seen through the hotel's round porthole window at this hour.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see the roofline of Vienna against a clear night sky from the attic room window.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Stadtpark this morning, so the park below the suites changes from sun to shade every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the sun comes and goes over St. Stephen's spire, visible from the sitting room of the corner suite.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds colour the sky behind Karlskirche's dome in the porthole window view.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the Stadtpark looks flat and quiet from the park-side suites, and the indoor thermal pool looks more tempting.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Stadtpark and the Ringstrasse today, and most guests stay in the thermal pool or the steam bath.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over Vienna, and from the corner suite you can watch lightning behind St. Stephen's spire through the arched windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides St. Stephen's spire from the corner suite today, and the Stadtpark trees below the suites are only grey shapes.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the Stadtpark, and from the park-side suites the trees and the Ringstrasse are slowly turning white.
phrases.very_cold: Close to freezing outside, the Stadtpark under the park-side suites is bare and bright under a clear winter sky.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot Vienna afternoon, the Stadtpark trees give the only shade visible from the park-side suites.
phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night, and from the attic room the city skyline shows only scattered lights under the clouds.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so St. Stephen's spire is hard to see from the corner suite, though the Stadtpark is clear.
phrases.late_night: Whoever has the corner suite tonight is up late, in no hurry, the cathedral spire framed by the arched windows over Vienna's rooftop lights.
phrases.wet_evening: Anyone awake in the park-side suites sees rain on the glass and the Ringstrasse lights shining through it.
phrases.grey_evening: Whoever has the corner suite after midnight can see the lit rooftops of Vienna under the cloud, St. Stephen's spire among them.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the floor-to-ceiling windows of a high-floor Deluxe King Room show Namsan as a dark shape under a clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: At breakfast in the Evolution restaurant, robot waiters move between tables while clear morning sun lights the city outside.
phrases.clear_midday: From the lounge windows at midday, the city rooftops sit in flat sunlight with no cloud anywhere above Seoul.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun reaches the Deluxe King Rooms on the high floors, and N Seoul Tower stands clear on Namsan.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a high-floor room tonight, you would see N Seoul Tower lit above the city skyline.
phrases.partly_morning: Seen from the King room window, N Seoul Tower goes in and out of sunlight as clouds pass over Namsan this morning.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon the lounge sofas face a sky of broken cloud, with patches of sun moving across the city rooftops.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, a few clouds over Namsan take colour while the Deluxe King Room windows face the mountain.
phrases.overcast: A full grey sky sits over Seoul today, and from the high floors Namsan looks dull but is still visible.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows of the lounge, and the city rooftops below look wet and darker than usual.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, guests in high-floor rooms watch lightning over the skyline from behind the glass, with N Seoul Tower sometimes visible.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over Seoul today means N Seoul Tower is only a faint outline from the Deluxe King Room windows.
phrases.snow: Snow falls on the city rooftops below the lounge windows, and from the King rooms Namsan is turning white.
phrases.very_cold: On a freezing clear day, the air over Seoul is very clean and the mountains look close from the high-floor windows.
phrases.very_hot: Outside it is very hot today, and from the Deluxe King Rooms Namsan sits under a pale, bright sky.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover Seoul on this mild night, but the lit skyline and N Seoul Tower are still visible from the high floors.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the lounge windows still show nearby rooftops, but Namsan and N Seoul Tower are not.
phrases.late_night: In a high-floor Deluxe King Room the curtain is left open, and city lights spread toward N Seoul Tower on Namsan.
phrases.wet_evening: Rain runs down the Deluxe King Rooms' tall windows tonight, and the wet city lights blur in front of N Seoul Tower.
phrases.grey_evening: Low cloud hangs over Seoul tonight, and from the Deluxe King Rooms the city lights spread beneath it toward N Seoul Tower.
